evidence: "Political Science" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science'" "Political Science" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '17'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.TERM_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE != '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.TERM_CODE ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(subject_count) AS highest_unique_subjects_in_a_term FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY highest_unique_subjects_in_a_term DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each academic year, provide the academic year description and the highest average total units for subjects offered in current or previous terms by each department. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "math" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'" "Course 18" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER IN ('SIS_CURRENT_TERM', 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(avg_total_units) AS highest_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY highest_avg_total_units DESC;

question: For each academic building at MIT with more than 10 rooms, provide the building name, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the areas of its rooms, along with the total assignable area and the year the building was built. Sort the results by the range of room areas in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "buildings at MIT" is predicated by "TABLE.SITE = 'MIT'" "academic building" is predicated by "TABLE.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC'" "buildings at MIT" is predicated by "TABLE.SITE = 'MIT'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_BUILDING b JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.SITE = 'MIT' AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME HAVING COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 10 ) SELECT ic.BUILDING_NAME, ic.area_range, ic.area_variance, ic.area_stddev, b.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, b.DATE_BUILT FROM inner_cte ic JOIN FCLT_BUILDING b ON ic.BUILDING_NAME = b.BUILDING_NAME ORDER BY ic.area_range DESC;

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding Mathematics) with a non-null department full name, show the department name, the average CIP program code for its courses, the range and variance of CIP program codes, and classify the department as 'HIGH_VARIANCE' if its variance is at least 20% higher than the average variance across all such departments, 'LOW_VARIANCE' if at least 20% lower, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "math" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'" "Course 18" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'" "Mathematics" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_program_code, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS range_cip_program_code, VARIANCE(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS var_cip_program_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), variance_benchmark AS ( SELECT AVG(var_cip_program_code) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_cip_program_code, i.range_cip_program_code, i.var_cip_program_code, CASE WHEN i.var_cip_program_code > v.avg_variance * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN i.var_cip_program_code < v.avg_variance * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN variance_benchmark v;

question: For each organization that has a non-null description, belongs to the 'Standard Hierarchy' type, is not the 'Cambridge-MIT Institute', and where the department is 'Political Science' (Course 17), show the organization name, department name, department code, department hierarchy level 2 name, and the maximum dense rank (partitioned by department long name and ordered by department long name) across all such organizations. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "except Cambridge-MIT Institute" is predicated by "TABLE.ORGANIZATION_NAME NOT IN ('CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST')" "Course 17" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG ORDER BY h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG) AS window_column FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON m.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION f ON h.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE f.DESCRIPTION IS NOT NULL AND m.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' AND f.ORGANIZATION_NAME NOT IN ('CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST') AND h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' ) SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, MAX(window_column) AS max_dense_rank FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ORGANIZATION_NAME, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME;

question: For each organization, what is the organization name, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the department codes (HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) among its associated HR org units, and the number of unique HR department names among those org units, considering only organizations that have more than 3 associated HR org units, and excluding organizations '138' and '250' as well as any organizations named 'ADMISSIONS'? Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "exclude organizations '138' and '250'" is predicated by "TABLE.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250')" "admissions" is predicated by "TABLE.ORGANIZATION_NAME = 'ADMISSIONS'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS dept_code_stddev FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'ADMISSIONS' GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 3 ) SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.dept_code_stddev, COUNT(DISTINCT HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS unique_hr_department_names FROM inner_cte JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID GROUP BY inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.dept_code_stddev ORDER BY inner_cte.dept_code_stddev DESC;

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding 'Political Science'), what is the average total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2022 academic year, and how does this average compare to the overall average total units for all degree-granting departments (excluding 'Political Science') in 2022? Provide the department name, the department's average total units, and the deviation from the overall average. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "degree-granting" is predicated by "TABLE.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'" "Political Science" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS dept_avg_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ), overall_avg AS ( SELECT AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS overall_avg_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.dept_avg_units, (d.dept_avg_units - o.overall_avg_units) AS deviation_from_overall_avg FROM dept_avg d CROSS JOIN overall_avg o;

question: For each building and department, what is the building key, department name, the number of courses, average total units, the minimum and maximum total units of courses held in rooms of that building, considering only courses that are offered this year and have more than 0 total units? Include subtotals for each building (the corresponding building field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all buildings (the corresponding building field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the building key if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by building and department. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "math" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'" "Course 18" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM FCLT_ROOMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.MEET_PLACE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(building) OVER (ORDER BY building_sort, building, dept_sort) = building THEN NULL ELSE building END AS building, dept, course_count, avg_total_units, min_total_units, max_total_units FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE FCLT_BUILDING_KEY END AS building_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE FCLT_BUILDING_KEY END AS building, CASE WHEN GROUPING(FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, DEPARTMENT_NAME AS dept, COUNT(*) AS course_count, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP ) tbl ORDER BY building_sort, dept_sort;

question: For each academic year, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18), considering only subjects from terms with a term status indicator of 'P' and with total units greater than 0, and for each subject, indicate whether its total units are at least 10% greater than the academic year's average ('HIGH_UNIT'), at least 10% less than the average ('LOW_UNIT'), or otherwise 'AVERAGE_UNIT'? Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "math" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'" "Course 18" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ss.SUBJECT_ID, ss.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ) , year_stats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.TOTAL_UNITS, y.avg_total_units, y.var_total_units, y.stddev_total_units, CASE WHEN i.TOTAL_UNITS > y.avg_total_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_UNIT' WHEN i.TOTAL_UNITS < y.avg_total_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_UNIT' ELSE 'AVERAGE_UNIT' END AS unit_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN year_stats y ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = y.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.SUBJECT_ID;

question: Among departments in the School of Engineering that grant degrees (excluding the Department of Management), which departments have a total student enrollment in their offered courses greater than 50, and for each such department, what is the most popular course (by enrollment) they offer and its enrollment count? Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "degree-granting" is predicated by "TABLE.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'" "Course 15" is predicated by "UPPER(TABLE.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 'MANAGEMENT'" "Management" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '15'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50 ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_enrollment, t.SUBJECT_TITLE AS Most_Popular_Course, t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS Course_Enrollment FROM inner_cte ic JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = ( SELECT MAX(t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 WHERE t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) ORDER BY ic.total_enrollment DESC;

question: For each faculty organization with a faculty organization key greater than 100, except organizations '101' and '103', and only for DLCs whose name is 'Political Science', show the faculty organization key, the associated department or lab center (DLC) key, the DLC name, the average faculty organization key within each DLC key group, and the highest department hierarchy level 2 name for each DLC, ordered by faculty organization key. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "except organizations '101' and '103'" is predicated by "TABLE.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('101', '103')" "Political Science" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.DLC_KEY, t0.DLC_NAME, AVG(t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DLC_KEY ORDER BY t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS window_column FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY > 100 AND t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY NOT IN ('101', '103') AND t0.DLC_NAME = 'Political Science' ) SELECT icte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, icte.DLC_KEY, icte.DLC_NAME, icte.window_column, MAX(mdh.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME) AS max_level_2_name FROM inner_cte icte JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY mdh ON icte.DLC_KEY = mdh.DLC_KEY GROUP BY icte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, icte.DLC_KEY, icte.DLC_NAME, icte.window_column ORDER BY icte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding the Biology department), what is the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the most recent academic year, and what is the average subject enrollment for those subjects? Only include departments with more than one subject in that year. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "degree-granting" is predicated by "TABLE.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'" "Biology" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '7'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH most_recent_year AS ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ), dept_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS, ccs.SUBJECT_ID FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID, TOTAL_UNITS FROM dept_units ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ic.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation, AVG(sos.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS avg_subject_enrollment FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON ic.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each DLC name, what is the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the organization numbers among organizations associated with that DLC, considering only organizations that have a non-null organization number, are assignable, and are in the history department, excluding organizations '138' and '250'? Additionally, for each DLC, what is the total number of organizations meeting these criteria, and what percentage of these organizations have an organization number greater than 50000? Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "history department" is predicated by "LOWER(TABLE.DLC_NAME) = LOWER('History')" "exclude organizations '138' and '250'" is predicated by "TABLE.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250')" "Departments, Laboratories, and Centers" are abbreviated by "DLCs"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT o.DLC_NAME, o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER, o.ORGANIZATION_ID FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY WHERE o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER IS NOT NULL AND o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND LOWER(o.DLC_NAME) = LOWER('History') AND o.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') ) SELECT ic.DLC_NAME, VARIANCE(ic.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_variance, STDDEV(ic.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev, COUNT(*) AS total_orgs, 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN ic.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER > 50000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS pct_orgs_over_50000 FROM inner_cte ic GROUP BY ic.DLC_NAME ORDER BY org_number_variance DESC;

question: For each department name and course level, where the total number of enrolled students in offered subjects is greater than the average number of enrolled students for that department, and the department is Mathematics (Course 18), provide the number of unique courses and the minimum total units among those subjects that are degree-granting courses. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "degree-granting courses" is predicated by "TABLE.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'" "Course 18" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS ) , dept_avg AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.COURSE_LEVEL, i.course_count, i.min_total_units FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_avg a ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = a.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > a.avg_enrolled;

question: For each department that grants degrees (excluding the Electrical Engineering and Computer Science department, Course 6), provide the department name, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students per subject offered by that department in the 2022FA term, along with the school name and department phone number. Only include departments that offered at least one subject in 2022FA. Sort the results by department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "degree-granting" is predicated by "TABLE.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'" "Electrical Engineering and Computer Science" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '6'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '6' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(tso.SUBJECT_ID) > 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.enrolled_range, inner_cte.enrolled_variance, inner_cte.enrolled_stddev, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each academic year and department, what is the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in that year and department, considering only subjects that are offered in the current term, have more than 0 total units, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Additionally, for each result, include the school name and the department phone number. Sort the results by variance in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_units_variance, inner_cte.total_units_stddev, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.total_units_variance DESC;

evidence: "Stata building" is predicated by "TABLE.BUILDING_NAME = 'Ray and Maria Stata Center'" "Stata building" is predicated by "TABLE.BUILDING_KEY = '32'
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SPACE_DETAIL.ROOM_NUMBER, SPACE_DETAIL.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE FROM SPACE_DETAIL JOIN SPACE_USAGE ON SPACE_DETAIL.SPACE_USAGE_KEY = SPACE_USAGE.SPACE_USAGE_KEY WHERE SPACE_DETAIL.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 100 AND SPACE_USAGE.SPACE_USAGE = 'RESEARCH CENTER' AND SPACE_DETAIL.BUILDING_KEY = 32 ) SELECT inner_cte.ROOM_NUMBER, inner_cte.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, (inner_cte.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE - avg_stats.avg_sqft) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS avg_sqft FROM inner_cte ) avg_stats;

question: For each department, list the department name, the average and variance of the total units for all degree-granting courses with non-null total units in the Mathematics department (Course 18), and for each department, also display the course with the highest total units, including its course number and total units. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "math" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'" "Course 18" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT = '18'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.TOTAL_UNITS, scd.COURSE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT = '18' ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, ic2.COURSE AS course_with_max_units, ic2.TOTAL_UNITS AS max_total_units FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE, TOTAL_UNITS FROM ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE, TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY TOTAL_UNITS DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte ) ranked WHERE rn = 1 ) ic2 ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic2.DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic2.COURSE, ic2.TOTAL_UNITS ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

question: From the top 10 academic years with the highest standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of enrolled students in library subjects offered during terms in that year (considering only years with more than 5 subjects offered, and only including subjects that are offered in the fall term and are from the Mathematics department), display each academic year's description, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of enrolled students, and the subject with the highest enrollment in that year, along with its subject title and number of enrolled students. Do not return any rounded answers.

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_num_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON lso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON lso.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.stddev_num_enrolled_students, ls.SUBJECT_ID AS Top_Subject_ID, ls.SUBJECT_TITLE AS Top_Subject_Title, ls.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS Top_Enrollment FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, lso.SUBJECT_ID, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC) AS rn FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON lso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON lso.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' ) ls ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ls.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND ls.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.stddev_num_enrolled_students DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For the top 5 departments (from Chemistry and Biology) with the highest total number of enrolled students in courses that have at least one reserved library material and are offered in the term '2009SP', display each department's name, the total number of enrolled students, the course with the highest enrollment in that department, and the number of students enrolled in that course. SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t.SUBJECT_ID, t.SUBJECT_TITLE, t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') ) SELECT d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, d.total_enrolled, c.SUBJECT_TITLE AS Top_Course_Title, c.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS Top_Course_Enrollment FROM ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10 ORDER BY total_enrolled DESC LIMIT 5 ) d LEFT JOIN ( SELECT i1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i1.SUBJECT_TITLE, i1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM inner_cte i1 JOIN ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrolled FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) i2 ON i1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = i2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND i1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = i2.max_enrolled ) c ON d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = c.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY d.total_enrolled DESC;

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding Chemistry, Course 5), what is the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2008 academic year, and for each such department, also list the number of subjects offered and the average number of enrolled students per subject? question: For each department, what is the department's full name, and for each subject code in that department, what are the range and variance of CIP program codes among its courses that are degree granting, have a non-null CIP program code, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18)? SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, scd.COURSE, scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), SubjectStats AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, MAX(ic.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(ic.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_range, VARIANCE(ic.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON ic.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ssc.SUBJECT_CODE ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, SUM(cip_code_range) AS total_cip_code_range, SUM(cip_code_variance) AS total_cip_code_variance FROM SubjectStats GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(cip_code_range) IS NOT NULL ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, total_cip_code_range, total_cip_code_variance FROM RollupResults ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_units_variance, ic.total_units_stddev, ccc.SUBJECT_CODE AS highest_units_subject_code, ccc.TOTAL_UNITS AS highest_total_units FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ccc.SUBJECT_CODE, ccc.TOTAL_UNITS FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc WHERE ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ) ccc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS = ( SELECT MAX(ccc2.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc2 WHERE ccc2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND ccc2.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ) ORDER BY ic.total_units_variance DESC LIMIT 10;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.SUBJECT_ID, sos.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' ) SELECT stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME, stats.total_units_range, stats.total_units_variance, stats.total_units_stddev, top_subject.SUBJECT_ID AS subject_with_max_units, top_subject.max_total_units FROM ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) stats LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID, TOTAL_UNITS AS max_total_units FROM ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID, TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY TOTAL_UNITS DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte ) ranked WHERE rn = 1 ) top_subject ON stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME = top_subject.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stats.total_units_range DESC LIMIT 10;

question: From the top 10 departments (excluding 'Political Science') with the highest average number of enrolled students in their degree-granting subjects (where each subject has more than 0 enrolled students), display each department's name, average enrollment, enrollment variance, the subject with the highest enrollment in that department, and the number of students enrolled in that subject. SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, tso.SUBJECT_ID, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, ic2.SUBJECT_TITLE AS top_subject_title, ic2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS top_subject_enrollment FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ic1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic1.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ic1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ic1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte ic1 ) ic2 ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic2.rn = 1 GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic2.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS ORDER BY avg_enrollment DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each academic year, list the academic year description, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in regular terms by the Mathematics department (Course 18), and the earliest and latest term start dates for those regular terms in that academic year. SQL: WITH most_recent_year AS ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ), dept_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ), Department_CV AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ), Political_Science_Students AS ( SELECT msd.FULL_NAME, msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR) AS student_year_rank FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.DEPARTMENT = '17' AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' ) SELECT dcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcv.coefficient_of_variation, pss.FULL_NAME, pss.SCHOOL_NAME, pss.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, pss.student_year_rank FROM Department_CV dcv JOIN Political_Science_Students pss ON dcv.DEPARTMENT_CODE = pss.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY dcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, pss.student_year_rank;

SQL: WITH DeptUnitsCV AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ), MathSubjectStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE ) SELECT dcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcv.coefficient_of_variation, mss.SUBJECT_CODE, mss.subject_code_count, mss.min_dept_budget_code FROM DeptUnitsCV dcv LEFT JOIN MathSubjectStats mss ON dcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mss.DEPARTMENT_NAME

SQL: WITH student_counts AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Biology' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR ), DepartmentStudentStats AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(num_students) AS variance_num_students, STDDEV(num_students) AS stddev_num_students FROM student_counts GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ), MathSubjectStats AS ( SELECT cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects, MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.variance_num_students, dss.stddev_num_students, mss.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mss.num_unique_subjects, mss.min_total_units FROM DepartmentStudentStats dss LEFT JOIN MathSubjectStats mss ON dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mss.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SQL: WITH dept_terms AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, sos.TERM_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' ), subjects_per_term AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE, COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE ), dept_subject_stats AS ( SELECT spt.DEPARTMENT_CODE, spt.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(spt.num_subjects) - MIN(spt.num_subjects) AS range_num_subjects, VARIANCE(spt.num_subjects) AS variance_num_subjects, STDDEV(spt.num_subjects) AS stddev_num_subjects FROM subjects_per_term spt WHERE spt.DEPARTMENT_CODE IN (SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM dept_terms) GROUP BY spt.DEPARTMENT_CODE, spt.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), top3_depts AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) DESC LIMIT 3 ) SELECT t3.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t3.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t3.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.range_num_subjects, dss.variance_num_subjects, dss.stddev_num_subjects FROM top3_depts t3 JOIN dept_subject_stats dss ON t3.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dss.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t3.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SQL: WITH DeptUnits2022 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), EngDeptSubjects2021 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS subject_count, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ) SELECT d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d1.avg_total_units, d1.var_total_units, d2.subject_count, d2.total_enrollment FROM DeptUnits2022 d1 JOIN EngDeptSubjects2021 d2 ON d1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SQL: WITH DeptEnrolledStatsGrad AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), DeptEnrolledStatsAll AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS range_enrolled, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d1.enrolled_range, d1.enrolled_variance, d2.avg_enrolled, d2.range_enrolled, d2.var_enrolled FROM DeptEnrolledStatsGrad d1 JOIN DeptEnrolledStatsAll d2 ON d1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY d1.enrolled_range DESC, d2.avg_enrolled DESC;

SQL: WITH CoefficientOfVariation AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ccso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), EnrolledStats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC ) SELECT cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, cov.coefficient_of_variation, es.enrolled_range, es.enrolled_variance FROM CoefficientOfVariation cov JOIN EnrolledStats es ON cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR = es.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

SQL: WITH DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), MathSubjects AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, sc.COURSE_LEVEL, sc.SCHOOL_NAME, c.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS min_total_units_per_dept FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION sc ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND sc.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ORDER BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.var_total_units, ms.SUBJECT_CODE, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS math_dept_name, ms.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ms.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ms.COURSE_LEVEL, ms.SCHOOL_NAME, ms.min_total_units_per_dept FROM DeptUnitsStats dus LEFT JOIN MathSubjects ms ON dus.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.SUBJECT_CODE;

SQL: WITH department_enrollment_stats AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC ), benedict_students AS ( SELECT t1.FIRST_NAME, t1.LAST_NAME, t1.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.STUDENT_YEAR, MIN(t1.DEPARTMENT) OVER (ORDER BY t1.FULL_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t1 JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT t0 ON t0.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT = '6' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND t1.FIRST_NAME = 'Benedict' ) SELECT des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.enrolled_students_variance, des.enrolled_students_stddev, bs.FIRST_NAME, bs.LAST_NAME, bs.EMAIL_ADDRESS, bs.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS STUDENT_DEPARTMENT_NAME, bs.STUDENT_YEAR, bs.window_column FROM department_enrollment_stats des JOIN benedict_students bs ON des.DEPARTMENT_NAME = bs.DEPARTMENT_NAME

SQL: WITH EnrolledStddev AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING COUNT(*) > 10 ORDER BY enrolled_stddev DESC ), UnitsStats AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT e.ACADEMIC_YEAR, e.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, e.enrolled_stddev, u.total_units_range, u.total_units_variance FROM EnrolledStddev e JOIN UnitsStats u ON e.ACADEMIC_YEAR = u.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY e.enrolled_stddev DESC;

SQL: WITH math_subject_stats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(subject_count) - MIN(subject_count) AS subject_count_range, VARIANCE(subject_count) AS subject_count_variance, STDDEV(subject_count) AS subject_count_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cd.DEPARTMENT JOIN ( SELECT cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON cd.DEPARTMENT = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE cd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT ) course_subject_stats ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = course_subject_stats.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subject_count_range DESC ), dept_units_stddev AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY total_units_stddev DESC ) SELECT mss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mss.subject_count_range, mss.subject_count_variance, mss.subject_count_stddev, dus.total_units_stddev FROM math_subject_stats mss LEFT JOIN dept_units_stddev dus ON mss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SQL: WITH DeptStddev AS ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sos.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 0 GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 ), TopDeptStudents AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND ( d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' OR d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '8' ) GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY student_count DESC LIMIT 10 ), CombinedDeptInfo AS ( SELECT tds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tds.SCHOOL_NAME, tds.student_count, ds.stddev_total_units FROM TopDeptStudents tds LEFT JOIN DeptStddev ds ON tds.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, student_count, stddev_total_units FROM CombinedDeptInfo ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SQL: WITH EngEECS_Courses AS ( SELECT t2.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t0.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t2.COURSE_NUMBER) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ), Dept_Subject_Stats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(subj_count) AS avg_subject_codes, STDDEV(subj_count) AS stddev_subject_codes, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM ( SELECT cd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' GROUP BY cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT ) course_subjects JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON course_subjects.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_CODE != '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY stddev_subject_codes DESC ) SELECT e.COURSE_NUMBER, e.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.window_column, d.avg_subject_codes, d.stddev_subject_codes FROM EngEECS_Courses e JOIN Dept_Subject_Stats d ON e.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY e.COURSE_NUMBER;

SQL: WITH MathCourseStats AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, t0.COURSE_LEVEL, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.GRADE_TYPE, MAX(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (ORDER BY t0.COURSE ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS MAX_ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), MathYearStats AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT mcs.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, mcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mcs.SCHOOL_NAME, mcs.COURSE_LEVEL, mcs.SUBJECT_TITLE, mcs.TOTAL_UNITS, mcs.GRADE_TYPE, mcs.MAX_ACADEMIC_YEAR, mys.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, mys.variance_total_units, mys.stddev_total_units FROM MathCourseStats mcs JOIN MathYearStats mys ON mcs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = mys.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY mcs.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, mys.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ;

SQL: WITH most_recent_year AS ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ), dept_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ), coefficient_variation AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ), math_dept_info AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.SCHOOL_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY d.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.DEPARTMENT_CODE, m.SCHOOL_NAME, m.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.avg_dept_budget_code, c.coefficient_of_variation FROM coefficient_variation c JOIN math_dept_info m ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

SQL: WITH MathDeptStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.COURSE) AS num_unique_courses, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS num_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d LEFT JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION sc ON sc.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DeptSubjectCodeCounts AS ( WITH dept_code_counts AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), stats AS ( SELECT AVG(subject_code_count) AS mean_count, STDDEV(subject_code_count) AS stddev_count FROM dept_code_counts ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.subject_code_count FROM dept_code_counts d CROSS JOIN stats s WHERE d.subject_code_count > s.mean_count + s.stddev_count ORDER BY d.subject_code_count DESC, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT mds.DEPARTMENT_CODE, mds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mds.num_unique_courses, mds.num_students, dscc.subject_code_count FROM MathDeptStats mds LEFT JOIN DeptSubjectCodeCounts dscc ON mds.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dscc.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

SQL: WITH ClearingCostDepartments AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS total_clearing_cost_collector FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > 100000 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), GeometricMeanDepartments AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE))) AS geometric_mean_cip FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE > 0 AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), CombinedDepartments AS ( SELECT ccd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccd.total_clearing_cost_collector, NULL AS geometric_mean_cip, 'ClearingCost' AS Reason FROM ClearingCostDepartments ccd UNION ALL SELECT gmd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS total_clearing_cost_collector, gmd.geometric_mean_cip, 'GeometricMeanCIP' AS Reason FROM GeometricMeanDepartments gmd ) SELECT * FROM CombinedDepartments ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, Reason;

question: List, for all departments that either (a) are degree-granting and offer more than five subjects or are the Mathematics department, or (b) are degree-granting, are not the Biology department, and have a total subject code count greater than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the mean across all departments, the department code, department name, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (if applicable), the total number of subject codes associated with the department (if applicable), and the reason for inclusion ('Stddev' for the first group and 'CodeCount' for the second group), showing the department code, department name, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, subject code count, and reason in that order. SQL: WITH DeptStddev AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 OR sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), DeptCodeCounts AS ( WITH dept_code_counts AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), stats AS ( SELECT AVG(subject_code_count) AS mean_count, STDDEV(subject_code_count) AS stddev_count FROM dept_code_counts ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.subject_code_count FROM dept_code_counts d CROSS JOIN stats s WHERE d.subject_code_count > s.mean_count + s.stddev_count ), CombinedDepts AS ( SELECT d1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d1.stddev_total_units, NULL AS subject_code_count, 'Stddev' AS Reason FROM DeptStddev d1 UNION ALL SELECT d2.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS stddev_total_units, d2.subject_code_count, 'CodeCount' AS Reason FROM DeptCodeCounts d2 ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, stddev_total_units, subject_code_count, Reason FROM CombinedDepts ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, Reason;

SQL: WITH GeometricMeanDeptBudget AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, EXP(AVG(LOG(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE))) AS geometric_mean_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME ), AvgAndVarianceBudget AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_budget, VARIANCE(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS budget_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_CODE = SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN ('Mathematics', 'Physics', 'Chemistry', 'Biology') AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Biology' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY budget_variance DESC ) SELECT g.SCHOOL_NAME, g.geometric_mean_dept_budget_code, a.avg_budget, a.budget_variance FROM GeometricMeanDeptBudget g JOIN AvgAndVarianceBudget a ON g.SCHOOL_NAME = a.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY g.SCHOOL_NAME;

SQL: WITH DeptEnrolledStats AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME NOT IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC ), MathEnrollments AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollments FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER p JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON p.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE WHERE p.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 10 ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.enrolled_students_variance, d.enrolled_students_stddev, m.total_enrollments FROM DeptEnrolledStats d LEFT JOIN MathEnrollments m ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = m.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d.enrolled_students_variance DESC;

SQL: WITH StudentEECS AS ( SELECT msd.FIRST_NAME, msd.LAST_NAME, msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, MIN(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME) AS MIN_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.DEPARTMENT = '6' AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ORDER BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME ), SchoolGeomMeanUnits AS ( SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, EXP(AVG(LOG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT s.FIRST_NAME, s.LAST_NAME, s.EMAIL_ADDRESS, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.STUDENT_YEAR, s.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, s.MIN_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, g.geometric_mean_total_units FROM StudentEECS s JOIN SchoolGeomMeanUnits g ON s.SCHOOL_NAME = g.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY s.SCHOOL_NAME;

SQL: WITH EnrolledStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), UnitsStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NOT IN ('Biology', 'Chemistry') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.enrolled_range, e.enrolled_variance, u.total_units_range, u.total_units_variance, u.total_units_stddev FROM EnrolledStats e JOIN UnitsStats u ON e.DEPARTMENT_CODE = u.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY e.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SQL: WITH StddevUnits AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ), CoeffVarEnrolled AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), CombinedDeptStats AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, total_units_stddev, NULL AS coefficient_of_variation FROM StddevUnits UNION ALL SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS total_units_stddev, coefficient_of_variation FROM CoeffVarEnrolled ) SELECT * FROM CombinedDeptStats ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SQL: WITH DeptMaterialStats AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ), DeptUnitsStddev AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY total_units_stddev DESC ), CombinedDeptStats AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, subject_count, min_total_units, NULL AS total_units_stddev, 'MaterialStats' AS Reason FROM DeptMaterialStats UNION ALL SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS subject_count, NULL AS min_total_units, total_units_stddev, 'UnitsStddev' AS Reason FROM DeptUnitsStddev ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, subject_count, min_total_units, total_units_stddev, Reason FROM CombinedDeptStats ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SQL: WITH DepartmentUnitsStats AS ( SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) <> 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS range_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT dus.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_variance, dus.total_units_stddev, des.avg_enrolled_students, des.range_enrolled_students, des.var_enrolled_students FROM DepartmentUnitsStats dus JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON dus.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN DepartmentEnrollmentStats des ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dus.total_units_variance DESC;

SQL: WITH OrgSpaceWindow AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.SPACE_UNIT, t0.DLC_KEY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SPACE_UNIT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN SPACE_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 AND t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'ADMISSIONS' AND t0.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') ), OrgDlcStats AS ( SELECT d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND d.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME != 'ADMISSIONS' AND o.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ) SELECT ows.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ows.DESCRIPTION, ows.SPACE_UNIT, ows.window_column, ods.organization_count, ods.min_organization_number FROM OrgSpaceWindow ows JOIN OrgDlcStats ods ON ows.DLC_KEY = ods.DLC_KEY AND ows.ORGANIZATION_NAME = ods.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY ows.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ows.SPACE_UNIT;

SQL: WITH CourseMaxCIP AS ( SELECT scd.COURSE, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS max_cip_program_code, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.COURSE, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) IS NOT NULL ), DepartmentSubjectEnrollment AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT std ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = std.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ) SELECT cmc.COURSE, cmc.max_cip_program_code, cmc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dse.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dse.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, dse.subject_count, dse.total_enrollment FROM CourseMaxCIP cmc JOIN DepartmentSubjectEnrollment dse ON cmc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dse.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE dse.total_enrollment > 100 ORDER BY dse.total_enrollment DESC;

SQL: WITH DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ), DeptUnitsVarianceStddev AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d1.avg_total_units, d1.total_units_range, d1.total_units_variance, d2.total_units_stddev, ROUND(d1.avg_total_units / NULLIF(d2.total_units_stddev, 0), 2) AS avg_units_to_stddev_ratio FROM DeptUnitsStats d1 JOIN DeptUnitsVarianceStddev d2 ON d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY avg_units_to_stddev_ratio DESC;

question: List, for each department, the department name, the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in Chemistry courses with at least one associated material record, and the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered by degree-granting departments (excluding Biology) in the 2022 academic year. SQL: WITH ChemistryEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE WHERE td.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC ), DegreeDeptUnitStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), CombinedStats AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_enrollment, enrollment_variance, NULL AS avg_total_units, NULL AS var_total_units, 'ChemistryEnrollment' AS Reason FROM ChemistryEnrollmentStats UNION ALL SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL, NULL, avg_total_units, var_total_units, 'DegreeDeptUnits' AS Reason FROM DegreeDeptUnitStats ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_enrollment, enrollment_variance, avg_total_units, var_total_units, Reason FROM CombinedStats ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each DLC key and organization name where the organization is assignable, the DLC key is not null, and the organization is not 'ADMISSIONS', and excluding organizations with organization IDs '138' and '250', provide the number of organizations, the minimum organization number, the average HR department code for its associated HR org units, and the variance of the HR department codes, listing the DLC key, organization name, organization count, minimum organization number, average department code, and department code variance in that order. SQL: WITH OrgDLCStats AS ( SELECT d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND d.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME != 'ADMISSIONS' AND o.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ), OrgHRStats AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS avg_dept_code, VARIANCE(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS dept_code_variance FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD IS NOT NULL AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME != 'ADMISSIONS' AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME ) SELECT ods.DLC_KEY, ods.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ods.organization_count, ods.min_organization_number, ohs.avg_dept_code, ohs.dept_code_variance FROM OrgDLCStats ods JOIN OrgHRStats ohs ON ods.ORGANIZATION_NAME = ohs.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY ods.organization_count DESC, ohs.dept_code_variance DESC;

SQL: WITH AssignableAreaStddev AS ( SELECT FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_NAME, STDDEV(FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS assignable_area_stddev FROM FCLT_BUILDING JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST ON FCLT_BUILDING.COST_CENTER_CODE = FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.COST_CENTER_CODE WHERE FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_NAME <> 'BROWN BUILDING' GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 3 ORDER BY assignable_area_stddev DESC ), RoomAreaStats AS ( SELECT fbh.BUILDING_NAME, AVG(fr.AREA) AS avg_area, VARIANCE(fr.AREA) AS var_area FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST fbh JOIN FCLT_ROOMS fr ON fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fbh.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' OR fbh.BUILDING_NUMBER = '32' GROUP BY fbh.BUILDING_NAME ) SELECT aas.BUILDING_NAME, aas.assignable_area_stddev, ras.avg_area, ras.var_area FROM AssignableAreaStddev aas JOIN RoomAreaStats ras ON aas.BUILDING_NAME = ras.BUILDING_NAME

SQL: WITH DeptReservedMaterials AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS total_reserved_materials FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm ON td.SUBJECT_ID = lrm.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Science') AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) > 10 ), ChemistrySubjects AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_enrolled_students, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS join_dept_name FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 AND t0.TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' ) SELECT drm.department_name, drm.total_reserved_materials, cs.SUBJECT_TITLE, cs.TERM_CODE, cs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cs.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, cs.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, cs.SCHOOL_NAME, cs.max_enrolled_students FROM DeptReservedMaterials drm JOIN ChemistrySubjects cs ON drm.department_name = cs.join_dept_name ORDER BY drm.total_reserved_materials DESC, cs.max_enrolled_students DESC
