ORDER BY port_status_sort, port_status, device_owner ), TenantAdminUpIpAllocations AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ia.subnet_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subnet_id_rows FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON ia.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND ia.ip_address IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address ) SELECT inner_cte.tenant_id AS ports_tenant_id, COUNT(inner_cte.port_id) AS total_admin_up_ports_with_ip_allocations, SUM(inner_cte.ip_allocation_count) AS total_ip_allocations, SUM(inner_cte.subnet_id_rows) AS total_subnet_id_rows, avg_ports.avg_port_count AS avg_ports_per_tenant FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(port_count) AS avg_port_count FROM ( SELECT COUNT(port_id) AS port_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY tenant_id ) AS sub ) AS avg_ports GROUP BY inner_cte.tenant_id, avg_ports.avg_port_count ) SELECT psor.port_status, psor.device_owner, psor.port_count, psor.earliest_standard_attr_update, taua.ports_tenant_id, taua.total_admin_up_ports_with_ip_allocations, taua.total_ip_allocations, taua.total_subnet_id_rows, taua.avg_ports_per_tenant FROM PortStatusOwnerRollup psor CROSS JOIN ( SELECT MIN(ports_tenant_id) AS ports_tenant_id, SUM(total_admin_up_ports_with_ip_allocations) AS total_admin_up_ports_with_ip_allocations, SUM(total_ip_allocations) AS total_ip_allocations, SUM(total_subnet_id_rows) AS total_subnet_id_rows, MAX(avg_ports_per_tenant) AS avg_ports_per_tenant FROM TenantAdminUpIpAllocations ) taua;

question: For IPv4 subnets whose DNS nameserver order range is greater than the average order range across all IPv4 subnets, list each subnet name along with its DNS nameserver order range and variance, plus the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the order values and how far that coefficient deviates from the average coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) across all IPv4 subnets. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, MAX(d.ORDER) - MIN(d.ORDER) AS order_range, VARIANCE(d.ORDER) AS order_variance FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN DNSNAMESERVERS AS d ON s.id = d.subnet_id WHERE s.ip_version = 4 GROUP BY s.name ORDER BY order_range DESC) SELECT subnet_name, order_range, order_variance FROM inner_cte WHERE order_range > (SELECT AVG(order_range) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY order_range DESC ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, STDDEV(d.ORDER) / NULLIF(AVG(d.ORDER), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM subnets AS s JOIN dnsnameservers AS d ON d.subnet_id = s.id JOIN ipallocationpools AS p ON p.subnet_id = s.id WHERE s.ip_version = 4 GROUP BY s.name HAVING AVG(d.ORDER) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.subnet_name, i.coefficient_of_variation, (i.coefficient_of_variation - a.avg_coefficient_of_variation) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_cte a ORDER BY deviation_from_avg DESC ) SELECT q1.subnet_name, q1.order_range, q1.order_variance, q2.coefficient_of_variation, q2.deviation_from_avg FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.subnet_name = q2.subnet_name ORDER BY q1.order_range DESC, q2.deviation_from_avg DESC;

question: For DOWN ports on network ID `0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d` that are bound to a security group, show the port name, network ID, MAC address, admin state, status, device owner, security group ID, and the minimum admin_state_up over a window of 3 preceding and 1 following rows (ordered by port ID), along with (per device owner) the total number of such ports and the average of these totals across device owners; additionally, only include device owners whose DOWN ports (bound to a security group) for tenant `17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7` have a distinct port count greater than the average across all (status, device owner) groups, and for those owners also display that distinct port count and the minimum standard attribute ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Network ID "0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d" is predicated by "ports.network_id IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d')" Tenant ID "17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')"
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.NAME, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER ( ORDER BY p.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.NETWORK_ID IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d') ) SELECT inner_cte.NAME, inner_cte.NETWORK_ID, inner_cte.MAC_ADDRESS, inner_cte.ADMIN_STATE_UP, inner_cte.STATUS, inner_cte.DEVICE_OWNER, inner_cte.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, inner_cte.window_column, owner_stats.total_ports_per_owner, avg_owner_stats.avg_ports_per_owner FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT DEVICE_OWNER, COUNT(*) AS total_ports_per_owner FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEVICE_OWNER ) AS owner_stats ON inner_cte.DEVICE_OWNER = owner_stats.DEVICE_OWNER JOIN ( SELECT AVG(port_count) AS avg_ports_per_owner FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS port_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEVICE_OWNER ) AS sub ) AS avg_owner_stats ON 1 = 1 ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS min_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS spb ON p.ID = spb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(port_count) AS avg_port_count FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.port_status, i.device_owner, i.port_count, i.min_standard_attr_id FROM inner_cte i WHERE i.port_count > (SELECT avg_port_count FROM avg_cte) ) SELECT q1.NAME, q1.NETWORK_ID, q1.MAC_ADDRESS, q1.ADMIN_STATE_UP, q1.STATUS, q1.DEVICE_OWNER, q1.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, q1.window_column, q1.total_ports_per_owner, q1.avg_ports_per_owner, q2.port_count, q2.min_standard_attr_id FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.STATUS = q2.port_status AND q1.DEVICE_OWNER = q2.device_owner;

question: For IPv4 subnets whose ID is in ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48'), return (with tenant subtotals and a grand total) the average range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of routes per subnet (computed per next hop), and alongside that return (with rollup subtotals and a grand total) the RBAC action statistics for the **access_as_shared** permission: the average subnet IP version, the IP-version range (max minus min), and the variance of subnet IP version for subnets whose network is referenced by that RBAC entry. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Subnet ID "012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48" is predicated by "subnets.id IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48')" "access_as_shared" permission is predicated by "networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared'"
SQL: WITH SubnetRouteRollup AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, MAX(route_count) - MIN(route_count) AS route_count_range, VARIANCE(route_count) AS route_count_variance, STDDEV(route_count) AS route_count_stddev FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN ( SELECT sr.SUBNET_ID, COUNT(*) AS route_count FROM SUBNETROUTES AS sr GROUP BY sr.SUBNET_ID, sr.NEXTHOP ) AS route_stats ON s.ID = route_stats.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') GROUP BY s.NAME ORDER BY route_count_range DESC), SubnetTenantStats AS ( SELECT s.tenant_id, i.subnet_name, i.route_count_range, i.route_count_variance, i.route_count_stddev FROM inner_cte i JOIN subnets s ON s.name = i.subnet_name AND s.ip_version = 4 AND s.id IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE tenant_id END AS tenant_id, CASE WHEN GROUPING(subnet_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(tenant_id) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(subnet_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE subnet_name END AS subnet_name, AVG(route_count_range) AS avg_route_count_range, AVG(route_count_variance) AS avg_route_count_variance, AVG(route_count_stddev) AS avg_route_count_stddev FROM SubnetTenantStats GROUP BY tenant_id, subnet_name WITH ROLLUP ), RbacIpVersionRollup AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.ACTION AS rbac_action, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, MAX(s.IP_VERSION) - MIN(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_range, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION IN (4, 6) AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_range DESC) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(rbac_action) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE rbac_action END AS rbac_action, AVG(avg_ip_version) AS avg_ip_version, MAX(ip_version_range) AS ip_version_range, AVG(ip_version_variance) AS avg_ip_version_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY rbac_action WITH ROLLUP ) SELECT srr.tenant_id, srr.subnet_name, srr.avg_route_count_range, srr.avg_route_count_variance, srr.avg_route_count_stddev, rir.rbac_action, rir.avg_ip_version, rir.ip_version_range, rir.avg_ip_version_variance FROM SubnetRouteRollup srr CROSS JOIN RbacIpVersionRollup rir;

question: For each (port status, device owner) group, considering only ports whose standard attribute resource type is 'ports' and excluding shared networks (networks whose IDs appear in networkrbacs with action = 'access_as_shared' and target_tenant = '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'), return the port count, the earliest standard attribute updated timestamp, the overall average port count across all returned groups, and each group’s deviation from that average. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "exclusion of shared networks" is predicated by "networks.id NOT IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))"
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ) SELECT inner_cte.port_status, inner_cte.device_owner, inner_cte.port_count, inner_cte.earliest_standard_attr_update, avg_groups.avg_port_count_across_groups FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(port_count) AS avg_port_count_across_groups FROM inner_cte ) AS avg_groups ON 1 = 1 ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(port_count) AS avg_port_count FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.port_status, i.device_owner, i.port_count, i.earliest_standard_attr_update, (i.port_count - a.avg_port_count) AS deviation_from_avg_port_count FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_cte a ) SELECT s1.port_status, s1.device_owner, s1.port_count, s1.earliest_standard_attr_update, s1.avg_port_count_across_groups, s2.deviation_from_avg_port_count FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.port_status = s2.port_status AND s1.device_owner = s2.device_owner;

question: For tenant ID `98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57`, find ports where an administratively up port (from the ML2 binding view) matches a DOWN port by the same tenant and MAC address, and return the admin-up port’s ID, host, VIF/VNIC type, network ID, MAC, status, device owner, its 2-preceding/2-following windowed average standard attribute ID (partitioned by VIF type), the total ports in that VIF type, and its deviation from the overall average of that windowed average; also include the matched DOWN port’s security group ID, its rank within that security group by port ID, the tenant’s total number of DOWN ports, and the average number of DOWN ports per tenant across all tenants. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')"
SQL: WITH admin_up_ports AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), VifTypeCounts AS ( SELECT VIF_TYPE, COUNT(*) AS ports_in_vif_type FROM inner_cte GROUP BY VIF_TYPE ), OverallWindowAvg AS ( SELECT AVG(window_column) AS overall_avg_window_column FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.PORT_ID, i.HOST, i.VIF_TYPE, i.VNIC_TYPE, i.TENANT_ID, i.NETWORK_ID, i.MAC_ADDRESS, i.STATUS, i.DEVICE_OWNER, i.window_column, vtc.ports_in_vif_type, (i.window_column - owa.overall_avg_window_column) AS deviation_from_overall_window_avg FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN VifTypeCounts AS vtc ON i.VIF_TYPE = vtc.VIF_TYPE CROSS JOIN OverallWindowAvg AS owa ), down_ports AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, sgpb.security_group_id, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sgpb.security_group_id ORDER BY p.id) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ) SELECT inner_cte.port_id, inner_cte.tenant_id, inner_cte.mac_address, inner_cte.security_group_id, inner_cte.window_column, tenant_down.total_down_ports_for_tenant, avg_down.avg_down_ports_per_tenant FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT tenant_id, COUNT(*) AS total_down_ports_for_tenant FROM ports WHERE status = 'DOWN' GROUP BY tenant_id ) AS tenant_down ON inner_cte.tenant_id = tenant_down.tenant_id JOIN ( SELECT AVG(down_port_count) AS avg_down_ports_per_tenant FROM ( SELECT tenant_id, COUNT(*) AS down_port_count FROM ports WHERE status = 'DOWN' GROUP BY tenant_id ) AS sub ) AS avg_down ON 1 = 1 ) SELECT aup.PORT_ID AS admin_up_port_id, aup.HOST, aup.VIF_TYPE, aup.VNIC_TYPE, aup.TENANT_ID, aup.NETWORK_ID, aup.MAC_ADDRESS, aup.STATUS AS admin_up_port_status, aup.DEVICE_OWNER, aup.window_column AS admin_up_window_avg_standard_attr_id, aup.ports_in_vif_type, aup.deviation_from_overall_window_avg, dp.security_group_id, dp.window_column AS down_port_rank_within_security_group, dp.total_down_ports_for_tenant, dp.avg_down_ports_per_tenant FROM admin_up_ports AS aup JOIN down_ports AS dp ON aup.TENANT_ID = dp.tenant_id AND aup.MAC_ADDRESS = dp.mac_address;

question: For tenant ID `17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7`, among ports on host `drive-59` whose running sum of `STANDARD_ATTR_ID` within each `VIF_TYPE` group (ordered by `STANDARD_ATTR_ID`) is greater than the overall average running sum for those ports, show each port’s ID, tenant ID, MAC address, VIF type, running sum and its overall average, plus the port’s port-security binding count, total enabled port-security flags, the average binding-count benchmark across the tenant’s administratively up ports, and the binding category (HIGH/LOW/AVERAGE). Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each port as 'HIGH_BINDINGS' (at least 50% more than average), 'LOW_BINDINGS' (at least 50% less than average), or 'AVERAGE_BINDINGS'.
evidence: Tenant ID "17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')"
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT b.PORT_ID, p.TENANT_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE b.HOST = 'drive-59' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')) SELECT i.PORT_ID, i.TENANT_ID, i.MAC_ADDRESS, b.VIF_TYPE, i.window_column, (SELECT AVG(window_column) FROM inner_cte) AS avg_window_column FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b ON i.PORT_ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE i.window_column > (SELECT AVG(window_column) FROM inner_cte) ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(psb.port_id) AS binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN psb.port_security_enabled THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS port_security_enabled_total FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address ), AverageBindings AS ( SELECT AVG(binding_count) AS avg_binding_count FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.port_id, ic.tenant_id, ic.mac_address, ic.binding_count, ic.port_security_enabled_total, ab.avg_binding_count AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.binding_count > ab.avg_binding_count * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_BINDINGS' WHEN ic.binding_count < ab.avg_binding_count * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_BINDINGS' ELSE 'AVERAGE_BINDINGS' END AS binding_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AverageBindings ab ) SELECT q1.port_id, q1.tenant_id, q1.mac_address, q1.vif_type, q1.window_column AS running_standard_attr_id_sum, q1.avg_window_column AS avg_running_sum_over_filtered_ports, q2.binding_count, q2.port_security_enabled_total, q2.benchmark AS avg_binding_count_benchmark, q2.binding_category FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.port_id = q2.port_id ORDER BY q1.vif_type, q1.window_column DESC, q2.binding_count DESC;

question: For each port status (plus a final TOTAL row), show the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of allocated IP address string lengths for ports with port security enabled where the allocated IP address is '10.150.64.113/8', and also show (for the same status values) the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of port security bindings per port for ports belonging to tenant ID '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7', along with the overall average number of port security bindings per port across that tenant’s ports. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: IP Address "10.150.64.113/8" is predicated by "ipallocations.ip_address IN ('10.150.64.113/8')" Tenant ID "17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')"
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.status, STDDEV(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) / NULLIF(AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM portsecuritybindings psb JOIN ports p ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON p.id = ia.port_id WHERE psb.port_security_enabled = 1 AND ia.ip_address IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(status) OVER (ORDER BY status_sort, status) = status THEN NULL ELSE status END AS status, coefficient_of_variation FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(status) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE status END AS status_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(status) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE status END AS status, AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte GROUP BY status WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY status_sort, status ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.status, MAX(ps.binding_count) - MIN(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_range, VARIANCE(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_variance, STDDEV(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_stddev FROM ports AS p JOIN ( SELECT p2.id AS port_id, COUNT(*) AS binding_count FROM ports AS p2 JOIN portsecuritybindings AS b ON p2.id = b.port_id WHERE p2.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p2.id ) AS ps ON p.id = ps.port_id GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY binding_count_range DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.status, inner_cte.binding_count_range, inner_cte.binding_count_variance, inner_cte.binding_count_stddev, avg_bindings.avg_binding_count FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(binding_count) AS avg_binding_count FROM ( SELECT p2.id AS port_id, COUNT(*) AS binding_count FROM ports AS p2 JOIN portsecuritybindings AS b ON p2.id = b.port_id WHERE p2.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p2.id ) AS sub ) AS avg_bindings ON 1 = 1 ORDER BY inner_cte.binding_count_range DESC ) SELECT q1.status, q1.coefficient_of_variation, q2.binding_count_range, q2.binding_count_variance, q2.binding_count_stddev, q2.avg_binding_count FROM q1 LEFT JOIN q2 ON q1.status = q2.status ORDER BY CASE WHEN q1.status = 'TOTAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, q1.status;

question: For tenant ID '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57', list ports that can be matched by MAC address between (a) administratively up ports with ML2 binding details and (b) DOWN ports that are bound to security groups, showing the port ID, tenant ID, network ID, MAC address, host, VIF type, VNIC type, status, device owner, the windowed average standard attribute ID (2 preceding/2 following within each VIF type) with its per-VIF-type port count and deviation from the overall windowed average, along with the matched security group ID, the port’s rank within that security group by port ID, the total number of such DOWN ports in the security group, the average DOWN-port count benchmark across security groups, and the security group category (HIGH_USER/LOW_USER/AVERAGE_USER). evidence: Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')"
SQL: WITH down_ports_by_sg AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, sgpb.security_group_id, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sgpb.security_group_id ORDER BY p.id) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), SecurityGroupPorts AS ( SELECT security_group_id, COUNT(port_id) AS total_ports FROM inner_cte GROUP BY security_group_id ), AveragePorts AS ( SELECT AVG(total_ports) AS avg_ports FROM SecurityGroupPorts ) SELECT i.port_id, i.tenant_id, i.mac_address, i.security_group_id, i.window_column AS port_rank_within_security_group, sgp.total_ports AS total_down_ports_in_security_group, ap.avg_ports AS benchmark, CASE WHEN sgp.total_ports > ap.avg_ports * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_USER' WHEN sgp.total_ports < ap.avg_ports * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_USER' ELSE 'AVERAGE_USER' END AS user_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN SecurityGroupPorts sgp ON i.security_group_id = sgp.security_group_id CROSS JOIN AveragePorts ap), admin_up_ports_by_vif AS (WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), VifTypeCounts AS ( SELECT VIF_TYPE, COUNT(*) AS ports_in_vif_type FROM inner_cte GROUP BY VIF_TYPE ), OverallWindowAvg AS ( SELECT AVG(window_column) AS overall_avg_window_column FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.PORT_ID, i.HOST, i.VIF_TYPE, i.VNIC_TYPE, i.TENANT_ID, i.NETWORK_ID, i.MAC_ADDRESS, i.STATUS, i.DEVICE_OWNER, i.window_column, vtc.ports_in_vif_type, (i.window_column - owa.overall_avg_window_column) AS deviation_from_overall_window_avg FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN VifTypeCounts AS vtc ON i.VIF_TYPE = vtc.VIF_TYPE CROSS JOIN OverallWindowAvg AS owa) SELECT a.PORT_ID, a.TENANT_ID, a.NETWORK_ID, a.MAC_ADDRESS, a.HOST, a.VIF_TYPE, a.VNIC_TYPE, a.STATUS, a.DEVICE_OWNER, a.window_column AS admin_up_windowed_avg_standard_attr_id, a.ports_in_vif_type, a.deviation_from_overall_window_avg, d.security_group_id, d.port_rank_within_security_group, d.total_down_ports_in_security_group, d.benchmark AS down_ports_benchmark_avg_per_security_group, d.user_category AS security_group_down_port_user_category FROM admin_up_ports_by_vif a JOIN down_ports_by_sg d ON a.TENANT_ID = d.tenant_id AND a.MAC_ADDRESS = d.mac_address;

question: From the top 10 RBAC actions restricted to the access_as_shared permission (ranked by the range of referenced subnets’ IP version), show each action’s name, average subnet IP version, IP-version range (max minus min), variance of subnet IP version, and whether any referenced subnet has DHCP enabled—only including actions whose average IP version is greater than 4. SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.ACTION AS rbac_action, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, MAX(s.IP_VERSION) - MIN(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_range, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION IN (4, 6) AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_range DESC) SELECT rbac_action, avg_ip_version, ip_version_range, ip_version_variance FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_ip_version > 4 ORDER BY ip_version_range DESC ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT n.ACTION AS rbac_action, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, MAX(s.IP_VERSION) - MIN(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_range, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION IN (4, 6) AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_range DESC ) SELECT i.rbac_action, i.avg_ip_version, i.ip_version_range, i.ip_version_variance, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.ENABLE_DHCP = 1 THEN s.ID END) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_dhcp_enabled_subnets FROM inner_cte i JOIN NETWORKRBACS n ON n.ACTION = i.rbac_action JOIN SUBNETS s ON s.NETWORK_ID = n.OBJECT_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION IN (4, 6) AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY i.rbac_action, i.avg_ip_version, i.ip_version_range, i.ip_version_variance ORDER BY i.ip_version_range DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT q2.rbac_action, q2.avg_ip_version, q2.ip_version_range, q2.ip_version_variance, q2.has_dhcp_enabled_subnets FROM q2 JOIN q1 ON q1.rbac_action = q2.rbac_action ORDER BY q2.ip_version_range DESC;

question: For each port status and device owner (considering only ports whose standard attribute resource type is 'ports' and excluding shared networks whose IDs appear in networkrbacs with action = 'access_as_shared' and target_tenant = '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'), show the port status, device owner, number of ports, and earliest standard attribute updated timestamp, and also (for the same port status) include the range/variance/standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of port security bindings per port for ports that have at least one port security binding and belong to tenant ID '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7', plus how that binding-count range deviates from the average binding-count range across all statuses. evidence: "exclusion of shared networks" is predicated by "networks.id NOT IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))" Tenant ID "17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')"
SQL: WITH port_status_owner_rollup AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(port_status) OVER (ORDER BY port_status_sort, port_status, device_owner) = port_status THEN NULL ELSE port_status END AS port_status, device_owner, port_count, earliest_standard_attr_update FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.port_status) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.port_status END AS port_status_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.port_status) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.port_status END AS port_status, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.device_owner) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE i.device_owner END AS device_owner, SUM(i.port_count) AS port_count, MIN(i.earliest_standard_attr_update) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM inner_cte i GROUP BY i.port_status, i.device_owner WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY port_status_sort, port_status, device_owner ), port_security_binding_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.status, MAX(ps.binding_count) - MIN(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_range, VARIANCE(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_variance, STDDEV(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_stddev FROM ports AS p JOIN ( SELECT p2.id AS port_id, COUNT(*) AS binding_count FROM ports AS p2 JOIN portsecuritybindings AS b ON p2.id = b.port_id WHERE p2.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p2.id ) AS ps ON p.id = ps.port_id GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY binding_count_range DESC ), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(binding_count_range) AS avg_binding_count_range FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.status, i.binding_count_range, i.binding_count_variance, i.binding_count_stddev, (i.binding_count_range - a.avg_binding_count_range) AS deviation_from_avg_binding_count_range FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_cte a ORDER BY i.binding_count_range DESC ) SELECT r.port_status, r.device_owner, r.port_count, r.earliest_standard_attr_update, s.binding_count_range, s.binding_count_variance, s.binding_count_stddev, s.deviation_from_avg_binding_count_range FROM port_status_owner_rollup r LEFT JOIN port_security_binding_stats s ON r.port_status = s.status ORDER BY r.port_status, r.device_owner;

question: For each IPv4 subnet (by subnet name) that is not on a network shared via `access_as_shared` to `*` or to tenant `9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b`, return the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of DNS nameserver order values, the overall average coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) across all such subnets, and (when applicable) the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) for only those subnets whose coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) is above that overall average. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "exclusion of shared networks" is predicated by "networks.id NOT IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))"
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, STDDEV(d.order) / NULLIF(AVG(d.order), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM subnets AS s JOIN dnsnameservers AS d ON d.subnet_id = s.id JOIN ipallocationpools AS p ON p.subnet_id = s.id JOIN networks AS n ON n.id = s.network_id WHERE s.ip_version = 4 AND n.id NOT IN ( SELECT r.object_id FROM networkrbacs AS r WHERE r.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (r.target_tenant = '*' OR r.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY s.name HAVING AVG(d.order) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.subnet_name, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, avg_cv.avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte ) AS avg_cv ON 1 = 1 ORDER BY inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, STDDEV(d.order) / NULLIF(AVG(d.order), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM subnets AS s JOIN dnsnameservers AS d ON d.subnet_id = s.id JOIN ipallocationpools AS p ON p.subnet_id = s.id JOIN networks AS n ON n.id = s.network_id WHERE s.ip_version = 4 AND n.id NOT IN ( SELECT r.object_id FROM networkrbacs AS r WHERE r.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (r.target_tenant = '*' OR r.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY s.name HAVING AVG(d.order) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT i.subnet_name, i.coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN subnets AS s ON s.name = i.subnet_name WHERE i.coefficient_of_variation > ( SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) FROM inner_cte ) ORDER BY i.coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT q1.subnet_name, q1.coefficient_of_variation, q1.avg_coefficient_of_variation, q2.coefficient_of_variation AS above_avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM q1 LEFT JOIN q2 ON q2.subnet_name = q1.subnet_name ORDER BY q1.coefficient_of_variation DESC;

question: For RBAC entries restricted to the action value access_as_shared, among actions that have a non-zero subnet IP-version range (max minus min) across their referenced subnets, return the action name, the average subnet IP version, the IP-version range, the variance of subnet IP version, whether any referenced subnets have DHCP enabled, and the IPv4-only standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of subnet IP version. MIN(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_range, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION IN (4, 6) AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_range DESC ) SELECT i.rbac_action, i.avg_ip_version, i.ip_version_range, i.ip_version_variance, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.ENABLE_DHCP = 1 THEN s.ID END) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_dhcp_enabled_subnets FROM inner_cte i JOIN NETWORKRBACS n ON n.ACTION = i.rbac_action JOIN SUBNETS s ON s.NETWORK_ID = n.OBJECT_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION IN (4, 6) AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY i.rbac_action, i.avg_ip_version, i.ip_version_range, i.ip_version_variance ORDER BY i.ip_version_range DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT q2.rbac_action, q2.avg_ip_version, q2.ip_version_range, q2.ip_version_variance, q2.has_dhcp_enabled_subnets, q1.ip_version_stddev AS ipv4_only_ip_version_stddev FROM q2 JOIN q1 ON q1.ACTION = q2.rbac_action WHERE q2.ip_version_range > 0 ORDER BY q2.ip_version_range DESC;

question: For the top 10 port statuses (ranked by number of ports) among ports bound with VIF type 'ovs' and having device_id 'da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7', show each status along with the total number of ports, the minimum admin_state_up value, the average standard_attr_id, and (for the same status) the maximum across networks of the per-network range of port security bindings per port considering only ports that have at least one port security binding and belong to tenant ID '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7'. evidence: Tenant ID "17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')" Device ID "da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7" is predicated by "ports.device_id IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7')"
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.status, MAX(ps.binding_count) - MIN(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_range, VARIANCE(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_variance, STDDEV(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_stddev FROM ports AS p JOIN ( SELECT p2.id AS port_id, COUNT(*) AS binding_count FROM ports AS p2 JOIN portsecuritybindings AS b ON p2.id = b.port_id WHERE p2.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p2.id ) AS ps ON p.id = ps.port_id GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY binding_count_range DESC), status_network_ranges AS ( SELECT p.status, p.network_id, MAX(ps.binding_count) - MIN(ps.binding_count) AS network_binding_count_range FROM ports AS p JOIN ( SELECT p2.id AS port_id, COUNT(*) AS binding_count FROM ports AS p2 JOIN portsecuritybindings AS b ON p2.id = b.port_id WHERE p2.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p2.id ) AS ps ON p.id = ps.port_id GROUP BY p.status, p.network_id ) SELECT i.status, MAX(snr.network_binding_count_range) AS max_network_binding_count_range FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN status_network_ranges AS snr ON i.status = snr.status GROUP BY i.status ORDER BY max_network_binding_count_range DESC ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.STATUS, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) AS min_admin_state_up, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS avg_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS b ON p.ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE b.VIF_TYPE = 'ovs' AND p.DEVICE_ID IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS ) SELECT i.status, COUNT(DISTINCT p2.id) AS total_ports, i.min_admin_state_up, i.avg_standard_attr_id FROM inner_cte i JOIN ports p2 ON p2.status = i.status JOIN ml2_port_bindings b2 ON p2.id = b2.port_id WHERE b2.vif_type = 'ovs' AND p2.device_id IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7') GROUP BY i.status, i.min_admin_state_up, i.avg_standard_attr_id ORDER BY total_ports DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT q2.status, q2.total_ports, q2.min_admin_state_up, q2.avg_standard_attr_id, q1.max_network_binding_count_range FROM q2 LEFT JOIN q1 ON q2.status = q1.status ORDER BY q2.total_ports DESC;

question: For each network ID that (a) has at least one administratively up port belonging to tenant `98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57` with at least one IP allocation and (b) has allocated IP address `10.150.64.113/8` on a port with port security enabled, return the network ID, the highest number of IP allocations on any single qualifying port in that network, and the maximum coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) (stddev/avg) of allocated IP address string lengths across port statuses. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')" IP Address "10.150.64.113/8" is predicated by "ipallocations.ip_address IN ('10.150.64.113/8')"
SQL: WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ia.subnet_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subnet_id_rows FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON ia.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND ia.ip_address IS NOT NULL AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address) SELECT p.network_id, MAX(inner_cte.ip_allocation_count) AS max_ip_allocations_on_a_port FROM inner_cte JOIN ports p ON p.id = inner_cte.port_id GROUP BY p.network_id), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.status, STDDEV(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) / NULLIF(AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM portsecuritybindings psb JOIN ports p ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON p.id = ia.port_id WHERE psb.port_security_enabled = 1 AND ia.ip_address IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT ia.network_id, MAX(inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation) AS max_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte JOIN ports p ON p.status = inner_cte.status JOIN ipallocations ia ON ia.port_id = p.id GROUP BY ia.network_id) SELECT q1.network_id, q1.max_ip_allocations_on_a_port, q2.max_coefficient_of_variation FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q2.network_id = q1.network_id;

question: For DOWN ports on network ID `0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d` and DOWN ports for tenant ID `98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57`, matched by MAC address, return the network ID and tenant ID along with: the number of matched DOWN-port rows, the average deviation of each port’s windowed minimum `admin_state_up` from the overall average of that windowed minimum, the average running sum of `standard_attr_id` within each security group, the total number of DOWN ports for that tenant, and the average number of DOWN ports across all tenants. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Network ID "0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d" is predicated by "ports.network_id IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d')" Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')"
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.NAME, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER ( ORDER BY p.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.NETWORK_ID IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d')), avg_window AS (SELECT AVG(window_column) AS avg_window_column FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.NAME, i.NETWORK_ID, i.MAC_ADDRESS, i.ADMIN_STATE_UP, i.STATUS, i.DEVICE_OWNER, i.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, i.window_column, (i.window_column - a.avg_window_column) AS deviation_from_avg_window_min FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_window a ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')) SELECT inner_cte.port_id, inner_cte.tenant_id, inner_cte.mac_address, inner_cte.window_column, tenant_counts.total_down_ports_for_tenant, avg_counts.avg_down_ports_across_tenants FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT p.tenant_id AS tenant_id, COUNT(p.id) AS total_down_ports_for_tenant FROM ports p WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' GROUP BY p.tenant_id) AS tenant_counts ON inner_cte.tenant_id = tenant_counts.tenant_id JOIN (SELECT AVG(port_count) AS avg_down_ports_across_tenants FROM (SELECT COUNT(p.id) AS port_count FROM ports p WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' GROUP BY p.tenant_id) AS sub) AS avg_counts ON 1 = 1 ) SELECT subq1.NETWORK_ID, subq2.tenant_id, COUNT(*) AS joined_down_port_rows, AVG(subq1.deviation_from_avg_window_min) AS avg_deviation_from_avg_window_min, AVG(subq2.window_column) AS avg_running_sum_standard_attr_id_within_sg, MAX(subq2.total_down_ports_for_tenant) AS total_down_ports_for_tenant, MAX(subq2.avg_down_ports_across_tenants) AS avg_down_ports_across_tenants FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.MAC_ADDRESS = subq2.mac_address GROUP BY subq1.NETWORK_ID, subq2.tenant_id;

question: For each (port status, device owner) group, considering only ports whose standard attribute resource type is 'ports' and excluding shared networks (networks listed in networkrbacs with action = 'access_as_shared' and target_tenant = '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'), return the port status, device owner, port count, earliest standard attribute updated timestamp, the overall average port count across all groups, and the deviation from that average—but only for groups whose port count is greater than the overall average. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "exclusion of shared networks" is predicated by "networks.id NOT IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))"
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ) SELECT inner_cte.port_status, inner_cte.device_owner, inner_cte.port_count, inner_cte.earliest_standard_attr_update, avg_groups.avg_port_count_across_groups FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(port_count) AS avg_port_count_across_groups FROM inner_cte ) AS avg_groups ON 1 = 1 ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(port_count) AS avg_port_count FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.port_status, i.device_owner, i.port_count, i.earliest_standard_attr_update, (i.port_count - a.avg_port_count) AS deviation_from_avg_port_count FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_cte a ) SELECT s2.port_status, s2.device_owner, s2.port_count, s2.earliest_standard_attr_update, s1.avg_port_count_across_groups, s2.deviation_from_avg_port_count FROM subq2 s2 JOIN subq1 s1 ON s2.port_status = s1.port_status AND ( (s2.device_owner = s1.device_owner) OR (s2.device_owner IS NULL AND s1.device_owner IS NULL) ) WHERE s2.port_count > s1.avg_port_count_across_groups ORDER BY s2.port_count DESC;

question: For tenant ID '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57' and ports that are administratively up, list each port’s ID and tenant ID along with two stacked “signals”: (1) a DNS signal showing the port’s DNS record count versus the overall average and its DNS category (HIGH_DNS/LOW_DNS/AVERAGE_DNS) for ports bound to a security group, and (2) an IP signal showing the port’s IP allocation count versus the overall average and its IP usage category (HIGH_IP/LOW_IP/AVERAGE_IP) for ports with at least one IP allocation. Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each port as 'HIGH_DNS' (at least 50% more than average), 'LOW_DNS' (at least 50% less than average), or 'AVERAGE_DNS'.
evidence: Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')"
SQL: WITH DnsPerPort AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.name AS port_name, COUNT(sgpb.security_group_id) AS security_group_binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pd.port_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS dns_record_count FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS sgpb JOIN PORTS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id LEFT JOIN PORTDNSES pd ON p.id = pd.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.name ), AverageDns AS ( SELECT AVG(dns_record_count) AS avg_dns_records FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.port_id, ic.tenant_id, ic.port_name, ic.security_group_binding_count, ic.dns_record_count, ad.avg_dns_records AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.dns_record_count > ad.avg_dns_records * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_DNS' WHEN ic.dns_record_count < ad.avg_dns_records * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_DNS' ELSE 'AVERAGE_DNS' END AS dns_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AverageDns ad ), IpPerPort AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ia.subnet_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subnet_id_rows FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON ia.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND ia.ip_address IS NOT NULL AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address ), AverageAllocations AS ( SELECT AVG(ip_allocation_count) AS avg_ip_allocations FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.port_id, ic.tenant_id, ic.mac_address, ic.ip_allocation_count, ic.subnet_id_rows, aa.avg_ip_allocations AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.ip_allocation_count > aa.avg_ip_allocations * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_IP' WHEN ic.ip_allocation_count < aa.avg_ip_allocations * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_IP' ELSE 'AVERAGE_IP' END AS ip_usage_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AverageAllocations aa ), CombinedPortSignals AS ( SELECT dpp.port_id, dpp.tenant_id, 'DNS' AS signal_type, dpp.dns_category AS category, dpp.dns_record_count AS signal_count, dpp.benchmark AS benchmark FROM DnsPerPort dpp UNION ALL SELECT ipp.port_id, ipp.tenant_id, 'IP' AS signal_type, ipp.ip_usage_category AS category, ipp.ip_allocation_count AS signal_count, ipp.benchmark AS benchmark FROM IpPerPort ipp ) SELECT port_id, tenant_id, signal_type, category, signal_count, benchmark FROM CombinedPortSignals ORDER BY tenant_id, port_id, signal_type;

question: For the RBAC action access_as_shared, show (1) the top 10 actions by subnet IP-version variance across referenced subnets including the average/variance/standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of subnet IP version and whether any referenced subnets have DHCP enabled, and (2) for the same action where the RBAC entry is public (target_tenant = '*'), also show the subnet IP-version variance and the total number of distinct subnets involved, aligned by action. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "access_as_shared" permission is predicated by "networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared'" "public access" (wildcard) is predicated by "networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*'"
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.ACTION, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_variance DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACTION, inner_cte.avg_ip_version, inner_cte.ip_version_variance, inner_cte.ip_version_stddev, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.ENABLE_DHCP = 1 THEN s.ID END) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_dhcp_enabled_subnets FROM inner_cte JOIN NETWORKRBACS AS n ON n.ACTION = inner_cte.ACTION JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON s.NETWORK_ID = n.OBJECT_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY inner_cte.ACTION, inner_cte.avg_ip_version, inner_cte.ip_version_variance, inner_cte.ip_version_stddev ORDER BY inner_cte.ip_version_variance DESC LIMIT 10 ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' AND n.TARGET_TENANT = '*' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_variance DESC ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(action) OVER (ORDER BY action_sort, action) = action THEN NULL ELSE action END AS action, ip_version_variance, distinct_subnets FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.action) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.action END AS action_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.action) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.action END AS action, i.ip_version_variance AS ip_version_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT s2.id) AS distinct_subnets FROM inner_cte i JOIN NETWORKRBACS n2 ON n2.action = i.action AND n2.action = 'access_as_shared' AND n2.target_tenant = '*' JOIN SUBNETS s2 ON s2.network_id = n2.object_id GROUP BY i.action, i.ip_version_variance WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY action_sort, action ) SELECT q1.ACTION, q1.avg_ip_version, q1.ip_version_variance AS top10_ip_version_variance, q1.ip_version_stddev, q1.has_dhcp_enabled_subnets, q2.ip_version_variance AS public_access_ip_version_variance, q2.distinct_subnets FROM q1 LEFT JOIN q2 ON q2.action = q1.action ORDER BY q1.ip_version_variance DESC;

question: For the top 10 port statuses (by number of ports) among ports with VIF type 'ovs' and device_id 'da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7', report each status along with its total ports, minimum admin_state_up, average standard_attr_id, and the maximum (across networks) per-network range of port security bindings per port for that same status considering only ports in tenant ID '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7' that have at least one port security binding. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Tenant ID "17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')" Device ID "da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7" is predicated by "ports.device_id IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7')"
SQL: WITH psb_status_ranges AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.status, MAX(ps.binding_count) - MIN(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_range, VARIANCE(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_variance, STDDEV(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_stddev FROM ports AS p JOIN ( SELECT p2.id AS port_id, COUNT(*) AS binding_count FROM ports AS p2 JOIN portsecuritybindings AS b ON p2.id = b.port_id WHERE p2.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p2.id ) AS ps ON p.id = ps.port_id GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY binding_count_range DESC), status_network_ranges AS ( SELECT p.status, p.network_id, MAX(ps.binding_count) - MIN(ps.binding_count) AS network_binding_count_range FROM ports AS p JOIN ( SELECT p2.id AS port_id, COUNT(*) AS binding_count FROM ports AS p2 JOIN portsecuritybindings AS b ON p2.id = b.port_id WHERE p2.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p2.id ) AS ps ON p.id = ps.port_id GROUP BY p.status, p.network_id ) SELECT i.status, MAX(snr.network_binding_count_range) AS max_network_binding_count_range FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN status_network_ranges AS snr ON i.status = snr.status GROUP BY i.status ORDER BY max_network_binding_count_range DESC), ovs_device_top_statuses AS (WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.STATUS, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) AS min_admin_state_up, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS avg_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS b ON p.ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE b.VIF_TYPE = 'ovs' AND p.DEVICE_ID IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS ) SELECT i.status, COUNT(DISTINCT p2.id) AS total_ports, i.min_admin_state_up, i.avg_standard_attr_id FROM inner_cte i JOIN ports p2 ON p2.status = i.status JOIN ml2_port_bindings b2 ON p2.id = b2.port_id WHERE b2.vif_type = 'ovs' AND p2.device_id IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7') GROUP BY i.status, i.min_admin_state_up, i.avg_standard_attr_id ORDER BY total_ports DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT o.status, o.total_ports, o.min_admin_state_up, o.avg_standard_attr_id, p.max_network_binding_count_range FROM ovs_device_top_statuses o JOIN psb_status_ranges p ON o.status = p.status ORDER BY o.total_ports DESC, p.max_network_binding_count_range DESC;

question: Give (1) the total number of administratively up ports for tenant ID `98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57`, (2) the total number of ports on host `drive-59` for tenant ID `17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7` whose running sum of standard attribute IDs (within each VIF type) is above the overall average running sum, and (3) the ratio of (2) to (1). SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), VifTypeCounts AS ( SELECT VIF_TYPE, COUNT(*) AS total_ports FROM inner_cte GROUP BY VIF_TYPE ), AverageVifTypePorts AS ( SELECT AVG(total_ports) AS avg_ports FROM VifTypeCounts ) SELECT i.PORT_ID, i.HOST, i.VIF_TYPE, i.VNIC_TYPE, i.TENANT_ID, i.NETWORK_ID, i.MAC_ADDRESS, i.STATUS, i.DEVICE_OWNER, i.window_column, vtc.total_ports, avp.avg_ports AS benchmark, CASE WHEN vtc.total_ports > avp.avg_ports * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_USER' WHEN vtc.total_ports < avp.avg_ports * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_USER' ELSE 'AVERAGE_USER' END AS user_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN VifTypeCounts vtc ON i.VIF_TYPE = vtc.VIF_TYPE CROSS JOIN AverageVifTypePorts avp ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT b.PORT_ID, p.TENANT_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE b.HOST = 'drive-59' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')) SELECT i.PORT_ID, i.TENANT_ID, i.MAC_ADDRESS, b.VIF_TYPE, i.window_column, (SELECT AVG(window_column) FROM inner_cte) AS avg_window_column FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b ON i.PORT_ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE i.window_column > (SELECT AVG(window_column) FROM inner_cte) ) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM q1) AS Total_Ports_Tenant_98333_Admin_Up, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM q2) AS Total_Ports_Drive_59_Tenant_17ea_Above_Avg_RunningSum, ROUND( (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM q2) / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM q1), 0), 4 ) AS Ratio_Drive_59_AboveAvg_To_Tenant_98333_AdminUp;

question: For administratively up ports belonging to tenant ID `17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7`, and active networks belonging to tenant ID `98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57`, return a combined report showing each port’s port ID, tenant ID, MAC address, number of port security bindings, and total times port security is enabled, alongside each active network’s tenant ID, network ID, network name, admin_state_up flag, MTU, standard attribute updated_at timestamp, row number within the tenant ordered by network name, and the subtotal count of networks (including the TOTAL/subtotal rows produced by each section). Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Tenant ID "17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')" Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "networks.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')"
SQL: WITH port_security_by_port AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(psb.port_id) AS binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN psb.port_security_enabled THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS port_security_enabled_total FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(port_id) OVER (ORDER BY port_id_sort, port_id) = port_id THEN NULL ELSE port_id END AS port_id, tenant_id, mac_address, binding_count, port_security_enabled_total FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.port_id) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.port_id END AS port_id_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.port_id) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.port_id END AS port_id, MAX(i.tenant_id) AS tenant_id, MAX(i.mac_address) AS mac_address, SUM(i.binding_count) AS binding_count, SUM(i.port_security_enabled_total) AS port_security_enabled_total FROM inner_cte i GROUP BY i.port_id WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY port_id_sort ), active_networks_by_tenant AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM NETWORKS n JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND n.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(tenant_id) OVER (ORDER BY tenant_id_sort, tenant_id, network_name) = tenant_id THEN NULL ELSE tenant_id END AS tenant_id, network_id, network_name, admin_state_up, mtu, standard_attr_updated_at, window_column, total_networks FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE tenant_id END AS tenant_id_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE tenant_id END AS tenant_id, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE network_id END AS network_id, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE network_name END AS network_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE admin_state_up END AS admin_state_up, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE mtu END AS mtu, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE standard_attr_updated_at END AS standard_attr_updated_at, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE window_column END AS window_column, COUNT(*) AS total_networks FROM inner_cte GROUP BY tenant_id, network_id, network_name, admin_state_up, mtu, standard_attr_updated_at, window_column WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY tenant_id_sort, tenant_id, network_name ) SELECT ps.port_id, ps.tenant_id AS port_tenant_id, ps.mac_address, ps.binding_count, ps.port_security_enabled_total, an.tenant_id AS network_tenant_id, an.network_id, an.network_name, an.admin_state_up AS network_admin_state_up, an.mtu, an.standard_attr_updated_at, an.window_column, an.total_networks FROM port_security_by_port ps CROSS JOIN active_networks_by_tenant an;

question: For tenant ID `17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7`, list the ports that are administratively up and also have status `DOWN` with a standard-attribute running-sum (within each resource type ordered by standard attribute ID) greater than 1000; for each such port return the port ID, tenant ID, MAC address, the number of port security bindings, the total number of times port security is enabled across those bindings, the deviation of that enabled total from the average enabled total across all administratively up ports for the tenant, and the running-sum value. a.avg_standard_attr_id) AS deviation_from_avg_standard_attr_id FROM inner_cte i JOIN SUBNETS s ON s.NAME = i.subnet_name AND s.CIDR = i.subnet_cidr CROSS JOIN AvgStdAttr a ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, s.CIDR AS subnet_cidr, n.TARGET_TENANT AS rbac_target_tenant, SUM(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY s.IP_VERSION ORDER BY s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN NETWORKRBACS AS n ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' AND n.TARGET_TENANT IN ('1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b')), IpVersionCounts AS (SELECT s.IP_VERSION, COUNT(*) AS total_subnets FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN NETWORKRBACS AS n ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' AND n.TARGET_TENANT IN ('1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b') GROUP BY s.IP_VERSION), AverageSubnets AS (SELECT AVG(total_subnets) AS avg_subnets FROM IpVersionCounts) SELECT i.subnet_name, i.subnet_cidr, i.rbac_target_tenant, i.window_column, c.IP_VERSION, c.total_subnets, a.avg_subnets AS benchmark, CASE WHEN c.total_subnets > a.avg_subnets * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_SUBNET_USAGE' WHEN c.total_subnets < a.avg_subnets * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_SUBNET_USAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_SUBNET_USAGE' END AS usage_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN SUBNETS s2 ON s2.NAME = i.subnet_name AND s2.CIDR = i.subnet_cidr JOIN IpVersionCounts c ON c.IP_VERSION = s2.IP_VERSION CROSS JOIN AverageSubnets a ) SELECT q2.IP_VERSION, q2.usage_category, COUNT(*) AS total_filtered_subnets, AVG(q1.deviation_from_avg_standard_attr_id) AS avg_deviation_from_avg_standard_attr_id, MAX(q2.window_column) AS max_running_sum_standard_attr_id, AVG(q2.benchmark) AS avg_benchmark_subnets_per_ip_version FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.subnet_name = q2.subnet_name AND q1.subnet_cidr = q2.subnet_cidr AND q1.rbac_target_tenant = q2.rbac_target_tenant AND q1.window_column = q2.window_column GROUP BY q2.IP_VERSION, q2.usage_category ORDER BY total_filtered_subnets DESC;
