SQL: WITH DownPortsAboveAvgRunningSum AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')) SELECT port_id, tenant_id, mac_address, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > (SELECT AVG(window_column) FROM inner_cte) ), AdminUpPortsAboveVifTypeWindowAvg AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), VifTypeAverages AS ( SELECT VIF_TYPE, AVG(window_column) AS avg_window_column FROM inner_cte GROUP BY VIF_TYPE ) SELECT i.PORT_ID, i.HOST, i.VIF_TYPE, i.VNIC_TYPE, i.TENANT_ID, i.NETWORK_ID, i.MAC_ADDRESS, i.STATUS, i.DEVICE_OWNER, i.window_column FROM inner_cte i JOIN VifTypeAverages v ON v.VIF_TYPE = i.VIF_TYPE WHERE i.window_column > v.avg_window_column ) SELECT a.PORT_ID, a.HOST, a.VIF_TYPE, a.VNIC_TYPE, a.TENANT_ID, a.NETWORK_ID, a.MAC_ADDRESS, a.STATUS, a.DEVICE_OWNER, a.window_column AS admin_up_window_avg_standard_attr_id FROM AdminUpPortsAboveVifTypeWindowAvg a WHERE a.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') AND a.PORT_ID IN (SELECT port_id FROM DownPortsAboveAvgRunningSum) ORDER BY a.NETWORK_ID, a.PORT_ID;

question: For ports that have an IP allocation of 10.150.64.113/8, and using the standard port filtering rules (standard attribute resource type = 'ports' and excluding shared networks whose IDs appear in networkrbacs with action = 'access_as_shared' and target_tenant = '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'), for each (port status, device owner) show the port count, the earliest standard attribute updated timestamp, the overall average port count benchmark and volume category, along with the variance of STANDARD_ATTR_ID for that status and the average of those variances across statuses. Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each group as 'HIGH_VOLUME' (at least 50% above average), 'LOW_VOLUME' (at least 50% below average), or 'AVERAGE_VOLUME'.
evidence: IP Address "10.150.64.113/8" is predicated by "ipallocations.ip_address IN ('10.150.64.113/8')" "exclusion of shared networks" is predicated by "networks.id NOT IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))"
SQL: WITH ip_status_variance AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.STATUS, VARIANCE(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS standard_attr_id_variance FROM PORTS AS p JOIN IPALLOCATIONS AS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID IS NOT NULL AND ia.IP_ADDRESS IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.STATUS ORDER BY standard_attr_id_variance DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.status, inner_cte.standard_attr_id_variance, avg_vars.avg_standard_attr_id_variance FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(standard_attr_id_variance) AS avg_standard_attr_id_variance FROM inner_cte ) AS avg_vars ), status_owner_volume AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(port_count) AS avg_port_count FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.port_status, i.device_owner, i.port_count, i.earliest_standard_attr_update, a.avg_port_count AS benchmark, CASE WHEN i.port_count > a.avg_port_count * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VOLUME' WHEN i.port_count < a.avg_port_count * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VOLUME' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VOLUME' END AS volume_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_cte a ) SELECT sov.port_status, sov.device_owner, sov.port_count, sov.earliest_standard_attr_update, sov.benchmark, sov.volume_category, isv.standard_attr_id_variance, isv.avg_standard_attr_id_variance FROM status_owner_volume AS sov JOIN ip_status_variance AS isv ON isv.status = sov.port_status;

question: For tenant ID `17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7`, list each administratively up port (including the final TOTAL rollup row) with its port ID, tenant ID, MAC address, the number of port security bindings, and the total number of times port security is enabled across those bindings, and also show (when available for the same tenant and MAC address) the running sum of standard attribute IDs for DOWN ports where that running sum is greater than 1000. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Tenant ID "17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')"
SQL: WITH AdminUpPortSecurityRollup AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(psb.port_id) AS binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN psb.port_security_enabled THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS port_security_enabled_total FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(port_id) OVER (ORDER BY port_id_sort, port_id) = port_id THEN NULL ELSE port_id END AS port_id, tenant_id, mac_address, binding_count, port_security_enabled_total FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.port_id) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.port_id END AS port_id_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.port_id) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.port_id END AS port_id, MAX(i.tenant_id) AS tenant_id, MAX(i.mac_address) AS mac_address, SUM(i.binding_count) AS binding_count, SUM(i.port_security_enabled_total) AS port_security_enabled_total FROM inner_cte i GROUP BY i.port_id WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY port_id_sort ), DownPortsWindowedStandardAttrSum AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, SUM(sa.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY sa.RESOURCE_TYPE ORDER BY sa.ID) AS window_column FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')) SELECT port_id, tenant_id, mac_address, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > 1000 ) SELECT a.port_id, a.tenant_id, a.mac_address, a.binding_count, a.port_security_enabled_total, d.window_column AS down_ports_running_standard_attr_id_sum_gt_1000 FROM AdminUpPortSecurityRollup a LEFT JOIN DownPortsWindowedStandardAttrSum d ON a.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND a.mac_address = d.mac_address ORDER BY a.port_id;

question: For subnets on networks shared via RBAC with action `access_as_shared` to target tenant `1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b`, return only those subnets (matched by subnet name) whose IPv4 DNS nameserver order coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) is above the overall average (excluding subnets on networks shared to `*` or tenant `9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b`), and list the subnet name, CIDR, RBAC target tenant, the running sum of standard attribute IDs within each IP version ordered by standard attribute ID, the deviation of each subnet’s standard attribute ID from the filtered-subnet average, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP). Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Target Tenant ID "1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b" is predicated by "networkrbacs.target_tenant IN ('1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b')" "exclusion of shared networks" is predicated by "networks.id NOT IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))"
SQL: WITH SubnetRbacWindowAndDeviation AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, s.CIDR AS subnet_cidr, n.TARGET_TENANT AS rbac_target_tenant, SUM(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY s.IP_VERSION ORDER BY s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN NETWORKRBACS AS n ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' AND n.TARGET_TENANT IN ('1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b')), AvgStdAttr AS (SELECT AVG(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS avg_standard_attr_id FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN NETWORKRBACS AS n ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' AND n.TARGET_TENANT IN ('1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b')) SELECT i.subnet_name, i.subnet_cidr, i.rbac_target_tenant, i.window_column, (s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID - a.avg_standard_attr_id) AS deviation_from_avg_standard_attr_id FROM inner_cte i JOIN SUBNETS s ON s.NAME = i.subnet_name AND s.CIDR = i.subnet_cidr CROSS JOIN AvgStdAttr a), SubnetDnsCvAboveAvg AS (WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, STDDEV(d.order) / NULLIF(AVG(d.order), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM subnets AS s JOIN dnsnameservers AS d ON d.subnet_id = s.id JOIN ipallocationpools AS p ON p.subnet_id = s.id JOIN networks AS n ON n.id = s.network_id WHERE s.ip_version = 4 AND n.id NOT IN ( SELECT r.object_id FROM networkrbacs AS r WHERE r.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (r.target_tenant = '*' OR r.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY s.name HAVING AVG(d.order) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT i.subnet_name, i.coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN subnets AS s ON s.name = i.subnet_name WHERE i.coefficient_of_variation > ( SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) FROM inner_cte ) ORDER BY i.coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT s1.subnet_name, s1.subnet_cidr, s1.rbac_target_tenant, s1.window_column, s1.deviation_from_avg_standard_attr_id, s2.coefficient_of_variation FROM SubnetRbacWindowAndDeviation AS s1 JOIN SubnetDnsCvAboveAvg AS s2 ON s2.subnet_name = s1.subnet_name WHERE s1.rbac_target_tenant IN ('1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b') ORDER BY s2.coefficient_of_variation DESC;

question: Return (1) the count of ports that are DOWN in network ID `0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d` with security-group bindings and the average deviation of each port’s windowed minimum `admin_state_up` from the overall average of that windowed minimum, together with (2) the TOTAL number of IP allocations and TOTAL number of subnet-id rows for administratively up ports in tenant ID `98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57` that have at least one IP allocation. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Network ID "0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d" is predicated by "ports.network_id IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d')" Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')"
SQL: WITH q1_inner_cte AS (SELECT p.NAME, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER ( ORDER BY p.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.NETWORK_ID IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d')), q1_avg_window AS (SELECT AVG(window_column) AS avg_window_column FROM q1_inner_cte), q1 AS ( SELECT i.NAME, i.NETWORK_ID, i.MAC_ADDRESS, i.ADMIN_STATE_UP, i.STATUS, i.DEVICE_OWNER, i.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, i.window_column, (i.window_column - a.avg_window_column) AS deviation_from_avg_window_min FROM q1_inner_cte i CROSS JOIN q1_avg_window a ), q2_inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ia.subnet_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subnet_id_rows FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON ia.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND ia.ip_address IS NOT NULL AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address ), q2 AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(port_id) OVER (ORDER BY port_id_sort, port_id) = port_id THEN NULL ELSE port_id END AS port_id, tenant_id, mac_address, ip_allocation_count, subnet_id_rows FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.port_id) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.port_id END AS port_id_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.port_id) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.port_id END AS port_id, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.port_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE i.tenant_id END AS tenant_id, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.port_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE i.mac_address END AS mac_address, SUM(i.ip_allocation_count) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(i.subnet_id_rows) AS subnet_id_rows FROM q2_inner_cte i GROUP BY i.port_id, i.tenant_id, i.mac_address WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY port_id_sort, port_id ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS Down_Ports_In_Network_With_SG_Bindings, AVG(q1.deviation_from_avg_window_min) AS Avg_Deviation_From_Avg_Window_Min_Admin_State_Up, MAX(CASE WHEN q2.port_id = 'TOTAL' THEN q2.ip_allocation_count END) AS Total_Ip_Allocations_For_Admin_Up_Ports_In_Tenant, MAX(CASE WHEN q2.port_id = 'TOTAL' THEN q2.subnet_id_rows END) AS Total_Subnet_Id_Rows_For_Admin_Up_Ports_In_Tenant FROM q1 CROSS JOIN q2;

question: For tenant ID '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7' and port status 'DOWN', list the top 10 device owners (with security-group-bound ports) showing their distinct port count, minimum standard attribute ID, whether any of their ports have multiple security group bindings, the maximum number of ports owned by any single device owner for that same port status among non-shared networks with standard attribute resource type 'ports', and the normalized ratio (device owner distinct port count divided by that per-status maximum).
evidence: "exclusion of shared networks" is predicated by "networks.id NOT IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))" Tenant ID "17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')"
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER) SELECT port_status, MAX(port_count) AS max_ports_for_any_device_owner FROM inner_cte GROUP BY port_status ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS min_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS spb ON p.ID = spb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ) SELECT i.port_status, i.device_owner, i.port_count, i.min_standard_attr_id, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT spb2.security_group_id) > COUNT(DISTINCT p2.id) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_multi_sg_bindings FROM inner_cte i JOIN ports p2 ON p2.status = i.port_status AND p2.device_owner = i.device_owner AND p2.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') JOIN securitygroupportbindings spb2 ON p2.id = spb2.port_id GROUP BY i.port_status, i.device_owner, i.port_count, i.min_standard_attr_id ORDER BY i.port_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT q2.port_status, q2.device_owner, q2.port_count AS distinct_port_count, q2.min_standard_attr_id, q2.has_multi_sg_bindings, q1.max_ports_for_any_device_owner, ROUND(q2.port_count / NULLIF(q1.max_ports_for_any_device_owner, 0), 2) AS normalized_device_owner_port_count_ratio FROM q2 JOIN q1 ON q1.port_status = q2.port_status ORDER BY normalized_device_owner_port_count_ratio DESC, q2.port_count DESC;

SQL: WITH network_mtu_details AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM NETWORKS n JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND n.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), AverageMtu AS ( SELECT AVG(mtu) AS avg_mtu FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.network_id, ic.network_name, ic.tenant_id, ic.admin_state_up, ic.mtu, ic.standard_attr_updated_at, ic.window_column, am.avg_mtu AS benchmark_mtu, CASE WHEN ic.mtu > am.avg_mtu * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_MTU' WHEN ic.mtu < am.avg_mtu * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_MTU' ELSE 'AVERAGE_MTU' p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), VifTypeCounts AS ( SELECT VIF_TYPE, COUNT(*) AS total_ports FROM inner_cte GROUP BY VIF_TYPE ), AverageVifTypePorts AS ( SELECT AVG(total_ports) AS avg_ports FROM VifTypeCounts ) SELECT i.PORT_ID, i.HOST, i.VIF_TYPE, i.VNIC_TYPE, i.TENANT_ID, i.NETWORK_ID, i.MAC_ADDRESS, i.STATUS, i.DEVICE_OWNER, i.window_column, vtc.total_ports, avp.avg_ports AS benchmark, CASE WHEN vtc.total_ports > avp.avg_ports * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_USER' WHEN vtc.total_ports < avp.avg_ports * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_USER' ELSE 'AVERAGE_USER' END AS user_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN VifTypeCounts vtc ON i.VIF_TYPE = vtc.VIF_TYPE CROSS JOIN AverageVifTypePorts avp ) SELECT nmd.network_id, nmd.network_name, nmd.tenant_id, nmd.admin_state_up, nmd.mtu, nmd.standard_attr_updated_at, nmd.window_column AS network_row_number_within_tenant, question: For ACTIVE networks excluding shared networks (RBAC action = 'access_as_shared' with target tenant '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'), return (1) the count of rows grouped by RBAC action and whether the network is External vs Internal (including subtotals per action and a grand total), and also return (2) the overall TOTAL network RBAC entry count and the overall average MTU across those rows. SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.name, n.status, n.admin_state_up, r.action, r.target_tenant, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.id ORDER BY n.id) AS window_column FROM networksecuritybindings b JOIN networks n ON b.network_id = n.id JOIN networkrbacs r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND n.id NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') )), ActionExternalSummary AS (SELECT i.action, CASE WHEN en.network_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'External' ELSE 'Internal' END AS external_status, COUNT(*) AS total_rows FROM inner_cte i JOIN networks n ON n.name = i.name AND n.status = i.status AND n.admin_state_up = i.admin_state_up LEFT JOIN externalnetworks en ON n.id = en.network_id GROUP BY i.action, external_status) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(action) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE action END AS action, CASE WHEN GROUPING(external_status) = 1 AND GROUPING(action) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE external_status END AS external_status, SUM(total_rows) AS total_rows FROM ActionExternalSummary GROUP BY action, external_status WITH ROLLUP ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.name, n.status, n.admin_state_up, r.action, r.target_tenant, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.id ORDER BY n.id) AS window_column FROM networksecuritybindings b JOIN networks n ON b.network_id = n.id JOIN networkrbacs r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND n.id NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') )) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(network_name) OVER (ORDER BY network_name_sort, network_name) = network_name THEN NULL ELSE network_name END AS network_name, status, admin_state_up, action, target_tenant, window_column, total_rbac_entries, avg_mtu FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.name END AS network_name_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.name END AS network_name, i.status, i.admin_state_up, i.action, i.target_tenant, i.window_column, COUNT(*) AS total_rbac_entries, AVG(n2.mtu) AS avg_mtu FROM inner_cte i JOIN networks n2 ON n2.name = i.name AND n2.status = i.status AND n2.admin_state_up = i.admin_state_up GROUP BY i.name, i.status, i.admin_state_up, i.action, i.target_tenant, i.window_column WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY network_name_sort, network_name ) SELECT q1.action, q1.external_status, q1.total_rows, q2.total_rbac_entries, q2.avg_mtu FROM q1 CROSS JOIN ( SELECT total_rbac_entries, avg_mtu FROM q2 WHERE network_name = 'TOTAL' ) question: For tenant ID `98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57`, return (1) the total number of administratively up ports that have at least one IP allocation and whose IP allocation count is greater than that tenant’s average, (2) the total number of ACTIVE networks for that tenant (from the tenant subtotal row), and (3) the average number of such above-average ports per active network.
evidence: Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')" Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "networks.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')"
SQL: WITH PortAllocationsAboveTenantAvg AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ia.subnet_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subnet_id_rows FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON ia.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND ia.ip_address IS NOT NULL AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address ), TenantAverages AS ( SELECT tenant_id, AVG(ip_allocation_count) AS avg_ip_allocs FROM inner_cte GROUP BY tenant_id ) SELECT i.port_id, i.tenant_id, i.mac_address, i.ip_allocation_count, i.subnet_id_rows FROM inner_cte i JOIN TenantAverages ta ON ta.tenant_id = i.tenant_id WHERE i.ip_allocation_count > ta.avg_ip_allocs ), ActiveNetworksWithTenantRollup AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM NETWORKS n JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND n.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(tenant_id) OVER (ORDER BY tenant_id_sort, tenant_id, network_name) = tenant_id THEN NULL ELSE tenant_id END AS tenant_id, network_id, network_name, admin_state_up, mtu, standard_attr_updated_at, window_column, total_networks FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE tenant_id END AS tenant_id_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE tenant_id END AS tenant_id, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE network_id END AS network_id, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE network_name END AS network_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE admin_state_up END AS admin_state_up, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE mtu END AS mtu, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE standard_attr_updated_at END AS standard_attr_updated_at, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE window_column END AS window_column, COUNT(*) AS total_networks FROM inner_cte GROUP BY tenant_id, network_id, network_name, admin_state_up, mtu, standard_attr_updated_at, window_column WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY tenant_id_sort, tenant_id, network_name ), TotalPortsAboveAvg AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_ports_above_avg FROM PortAllocationsAboveTenantAvg ) SELECT tpa.total_ports_above_avg, anwr.total_networks, ROUND(tpa.total_ports_above_avg / NULLIF(anwr.total_networks, 0), 2) AS avg_ports_above_avg_per_active_network FROM TotalPortsAboveAvg tpa CROSS JOIN ( question: For tenant ID `98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57`, list ports that (1) are administratively up and have a VIF-type windowed average standard attribute ID (2 preceding and 2 following, ordered by standard attribute ID) greater than the overall average for that VIF type, and that also (2) appear among DOWN ports whose running sum of standard attribute ID within each security group (ordered by standard attribute ID) is greater than the average running sum across those DOWN ports. Return the port ID, host, VIF type, VNIC type, tenant ID, network ID, MAC address, status, device owner, the admin-up windowed average metric, and the DOWN-port running-sum metric. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')"
SQL: WITH down_ports AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')) SELECT port_id, tenant_id, mac_address, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > (SELECT AVG(window_column) FROM inner_cte) ), admin_up_ports AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), VifTypeAverages AS ( SELECT VIF_TYPE, AVG(window_column) AS avg_window_column FROM inner_cte GROUP BY VIF_TYPE ) SELECT i.PORT_ID, i.HOST, i.VIF_TYPE, i.VNIC_TYPE, i.TENANT_ID, i.NETWORK_ID, i.MAC_ADDRESS, i.STATUS, i.DEVICE_OWNER, i.window_column FROM inner_cte i JOIN VifTypeAverages v ON v.VIF_TYPE = i.VIF_TYPE WHERE i.window_column > v.avg_window_column ) SELECT a.PORT_ID, a.HOST, a.VIF_TYPE, a.VNIC_TYPE, a.TENANT_ID, a.NETWORK_ID, a.MAC_ADDRESS, a.STATUS, a.DEVICE_OWNER, a.window_column AS admin_up_windowed_avg_standard_attr_id, d.window_column AS down_running_sum_standard_attr_id FROM admin_up_ports a JOIN down_ports d ON d.port_id = a.PORT_ID ORDER BY a.window_column DESC, d.window_column DESC;

question: For RBAC entries restricted to the access_as_shared action, list each RBAC action whose referenced subnets have an average IP version greater than 4, and show (1) the average, range (max minus min), and variance of subnet IP version across the referenced subnets, along with (2) the maximum average, maximum variance, and maximum standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of subnet IP version computed for that same action. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "access_as_shared" permission is predicated by "networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared'"
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.ACTION AS rbac_action, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, MAX(s.IP_VERSION) - MIN(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_range, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION IN (4, 6) AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_range DESC) SELECT rbac_action, avg_ip_version, ip_version_range, ip_version_variance FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_ip_version > 4 ORDER BY ip_version_range DESC ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_variance DESC ) SELECT i.ACTION, MAX(i.avg_ip_version) AS max_avg_ip_version, MAX(i.ip_version_variance) AS max_ip_version_variance, MAX(i.ip_version_stddev) AS max_ip_version_stddev FROM inner_cte i JOIN NETWORKRBACS n2 ON n2.ACTION = i.ACTION GROUP BY i.ACTION ) SELECT q1.rbac_action, q1.avg_ip_version, q1.ip_version_range, q1.ip_version_variance, q2.max_avg_ip_version, q2.max_ip_version_variance, q2.max_ip_version_stddev FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q2.ACTION = q1.rbac_action ORDER BY q1.ip_version_range DESC;

question: For the top 10 administratively up ports belonging to tenant `98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57` with the most IP allocations, list each port’s ID, tenant ID, MAC address, IP allocation count, subnet-id row count from those allocations, and whether the port has any floating IPs; also show (in the same result) for tenant `17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7` the total number of ports that are `DOWN` with port security enabled and whether any of those ports have floating IPs allocated.
