evidence: Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')" Tenant ID "17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')"
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ia.subnet_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subnet_id_rows FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON ia.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND ia.ip_address IS NOT NULL AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address ) SELECT i.port_id, i.tenant_id, i.mac_address, i.ip_allocation_count, i.subnet_id_rows, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT f.id) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_floating_ips FROM inner_cte i LEFT JOIN floatingips f ON i.port_id = f.fixed_port_id GROUP BY i.port_id, i.tenant_id, i.mac_address, i.ip_allocation_count, i.subnet_id_rows ORDER BY i.ip_allocation_count DESC LIMIT 10 ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS down_ports_with_port_security_enabled FROM PORTS p JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND psb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') ) SELECT p.tenant_id, inner_cte.down_ports_with_port_security_enabled AS total_down_ports_with_port_security_enabled, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT f.id) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_floating_ips FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON p.id = psb.port_id LEFT JOIN floatingips f ON p.id = f.fixed_port_id CROSS JOIN inner_cte WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' AND psb.port_security_enabled = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.tenant_id, inner_cte.down_ports_with_port_security_enabled ) SELECT s1.port_id, s1.tenant_id AS tenant_id_admin_up_top_ip_allocations, s1.mac_address, s1.ip_allocation_count, s1.subnet_id_rows, s1.has_floating_ips AS port_has_floating_ips, s2.tenant_id AS tenant_id_down_ports_port_security_enabled, s2.total_down_ports_with_port_security_enabled, s2.has_floating_ips AS down_ports_have_any_floating_ips FROM subq1 s1 CROSS JOIN subq2 s2;

question: For each RBAC action (including subtotals per action and a grand total), show whether the counted ACTIVE, non-shared networks are External or Internal and the number of such networks, along with the subnet IP-version statistics (average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP)) computed for the “access_as_shared” RBAC action on IPv4 subnets; also compute the share of each External/Internal count within its action total.
evidence: "exclusion of shared networks" is predicated by "networks.id NOT IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))" "access_as_shared" permission is predicated by "networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared'"
SQL: WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.name, n.status, n.admin_state_up, r.action, r.target_tenant, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.id ORDER BY n.id) AS window_column FROM networksecuritybindings b JOIN networks n ON b.network_id = n.id JOIN networkrbacs r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND n.id NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') )), ActionExternalSummary AS (SELECT i.action, CASE WHEN en.network_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'External' ELSE 'Internal' END AS external_status, COUNT(*) AS total_rows FROM inner_cte i JOIN networks n ON n.name = i.name AND n.status = i.status AND n.admin_state_up = i.admin_state_up LEFT JOIN externalnetworks en ON n.id = en.network_id GROUP BY i.action, external_status) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(action) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE action END AS action, CASE WHEN GROUPING(external_status) = 1 AND GROUPING(action) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE external_status END AS external_status, SUM(total_rows) AS total_rows FROM ActionExternalSummary GROUP BY action, external_status WITH ROLLUP), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_variance DESC ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(action) OVER (ORDER BY action_sort, action) = action THEN NULL ELSE action END AS action, avg_ip_version, ip_version_variance, ip_version_stddev FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.action) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.action END AS action_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.action) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.action END AS action, AVG(i.avg_ip_version) AS avg_ip_version, AVG(i.ip_version_variance) AS ip_version_variance, AVG(i.ip_version_stddev) AS ip_version_stddev FROM inner_cte i GROUP BY i.action WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY action_sort) SELECT q1.action, q1.external_status, q1.total_rows, q2.avg_ip_version, q2.ip_version_variance, q2.ip_version_stddev, ROUND(q1.total_rows / NULLIF(SUM(q1.total_rows) OVER (PARTITION BY q1.action), 0), 4) AS pct_of_action_total FROM q1 LEFT JOIN q2 ON q2.action = q1.action ORDER BY CASE WHEN q1.action = 'GRAND TOTAL' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END, q1.action, CASE WHEN q1.external_status = 'SUBTOTAL' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END, q1.external_status;

question: For each (port status, device owner) group under the standard-attributes port filtering rules (resource_type = 'ports' and excluding shared networks listed in networkrbacs for access_as_shared to '*' or tenant '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'), show the port count, the earliest standard attribute updated timestamp, the overall average port count benchmark and volume category, and also include (by matching port status) the subtotal total number of ports and the count of DOWN ports with port security enabled for tenant ID '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7' considering only ports that have a port security binding. Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each group as 'HIGH_VOLUME' (at least 50% above average), 'LOW_VOLUME' (at least 50% below average), or 'AVERAGE_VOLUME'.
evidence: Tenant ID "17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')" "exclusion of shared networks" is predicated by "networks.id NOT IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))"
SQL: WITH ps_rollup AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS down_ports_with_port_security_enabled FROM PORTS p JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND psb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')), PortSecurityStatus AS (SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, CASE WHEN psb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED = 1 THEN 'Enabled' ELSE 'Disabled' END AS port_security_state, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS total_ports FROM PORTS p JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS, port_security_state) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(port_status) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE port_status END AS port_status, CASE WHEN GROUPING(port_security_state) = 1 AND GROUPING(port_status) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE port_security_state END AS port_security_state, SUM(total_ports) AS total_ports, MAX(inner_cte.down_ports_with_port_security_enabled) AS down_ports_with_port_security_enabled FROM PortSecurityStatus CROSS JOIN inner_cte GROUP BY port_status, port_security_state WITH ROLLUP ), volume_by_owner AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(port_count) AS avg_port_count FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.port_status, i.device_owner, i.port_count, i.earliest_standard_attr_update, a.avg_port_count AS benchmark, CASE WHEN i.port_count > a.avg_port_count * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VOLUME' WHEN i.port_count < a.avg_port_count * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VOLUME' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VOLUME' END AS volume_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_cte a ) SELECT v.port_status, v.device_owner, v.port_count, v.earliest_standard_attr_update, v.benchmark, v.volume_category, p.total_ports AS tenant17_total_ports_with_port_security_binding, p.down_ports_with_port_security_enabled AS tenant17_down_ports_with_port_security_enabled FROM volume_by_owner v LEFT JOIN ps_rollup p ON p.port_status = v.port_status AND p.port_security_state = 'SUBTOTAL' ORDER BY v.port_status, v.port_count DESC, v.device_owner;

question: For port statuses that (1) have an IP allocation with IP address 10.150.64.113/8 and (2) also appear among the above-average port-count (status, device owner) groups for ports with standard attribute resource type = 'ports' excluding shared networks, return each matching port status along with its standard attribute ID variance, the overall average variance benchmark and variance category, plus the device owner, port count, and earliest standard attribute updated timestamp for that status-owner group. Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each status as 'HIGH_VARIANCE' (at least 50% above the benchmark), 'LOW_VARIANCE' (at least 50% below the benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE'.
evidence: IP Address "10.150.64.113/8" is predicated by "ipallocations.ip_address IN ('10.150.64.113/8')" "exclusion of shared networks" is predicated by "networks.id NOT IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.STATUS, VARIANCE(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS standard_attr_id_variance FROM PORTS AS p JOIN IPALLOCATIONS AS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID IS NOT NULL AND ia.IP_ADDRESS IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.STATUS ORDER BY standard_attr_id_variance DESC ), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(standard_attr_id_variance) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte ), variance_by_status AS ( SELECT i.STATUS, i.standard_attr_id_variance, a.avg_variance AS benchmark, CASE WHEN i.standard_attr_id_variance > a.avg_variance * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN i.standard_attr_id_variance < a.avg_variance * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_cte a ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), above_avg_status_owner AS ( SELECT port_status, device_owner, port_count, earliest_standard_attr_update FROM inner_cte2 WHERE port_count > (SELECT AVG(port_count) FROM inner_cte2) ) SELECT v.STATUS AS port_status, v.standard_attr_id_variance, v.benchmark, v.variance_category, a.device_owner, a.port_count, a.earliest_standard_attr_update FROM variance_by_status v JOIN above_avg_status_owner a ON a.port_status = v.STATUS;

question: For RBAC entries with action = 'access_as_shared' and public access (target_tenant = '*'), and for networks excluding any shared networks (i.e., excluding networks that have an RBAC entry with action = 'access_as_shared' and target_tenant = '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'), what are: (1) per RBAC action, the variance of subnet IP version across the referenced subnets and the total number of distinct subnets (with a grand total row), and (2) per network status, the number of distinct networks plus the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED across networks with at least one security binding (with a grand total row)? Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "public access" (wildcard) is predicated by "networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*'" "exclusion of shared networks" is predicated by "networks.id NOT IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))"
SQL: WITH rbac_action_subnet_ip_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' AND n.TARGET_TENANT = '*' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_variance DESC ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(action) OVER (ORDER BY action_sort, action) = action THEN NULL ELSE action END AS action, ip_version_variance, distinct_subnets FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.action) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.action END AS action_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.action) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.action END AS action, i.ip_version_variance AS ip_version_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT s2.id) AS distinct_subnets FROM inner_cte i JOIN NETWORKRBACS n2 ON n2.action = i.action AND n2.action = 'access_as_shared' AND n2.target_tenant = '*' JOIN SUBNETS s2 ON s2.network_id = n2.object_id GROUP BY i.action, i.ip_version_variance WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY action_sort, action ), network_status_security_binding_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT n.STATUS AS network_status, VARIANCE(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_variance, STDDEV(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_stddev FROM NETWORKS AS n JOIN NETWORKSECURITYBINDINGS AS nsb ON n.ID = nsb.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.STATUS ORDER BY port_security_enabled_variance DESC ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(network_status) OVER (ORDER BY network_status_sort, network_status) = network_status THEN NULL ELSE network_status END AS network_status, networks_count, port_security_enabled_variance, port_security_enabled_stddev FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(n.STATUS) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE n.STATUS END AS network_status_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(n.STATUS) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE n.STATUS END AS network_status, COUNT(DISTINCT n.ID) AS networks_count, ic.port_security_enabled_variance, ic.port_security_enabled_stddev FROM NETWORKS AS n JOIN NETWORKSECURITYBINDINGS AS nsb ON n.ID = nsb.NETWORK_ID LEFT JOIN inner_cte AS ic ON ic.network_status = n.STATUS WHERE n.ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.STATUS, ic.port_security_enabled_variance, ic.port_security_enabled_stddev WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY network_status_sort, network_status ) SELECT r.action, r.ip_version_variance, r.distinct_subnets, n.network_status, n.networks_count, n.port_security_enabled_variance, n.port_security_enabled_stddev FROM rbac_action_subnet_ip_stats r CROSS JOIN network_status_security_binding_stats n;

question: For tenant ID '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7', how many DOWN ports have a running sum of standard attribute IDs (partitioned by resource type and ordered by standard attribute ID) greater than 1000, and how many administratively up ports have port security binding statistics (including the average-binding benchmark and binding category)? Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each port as 'HIGH_BINDINGS' (at least 50% more than average), 'LOW_BINDINGS' (at least 50% less than average), or 'AVERAGE_BINDINGS'.
evidence: Tenant ID "17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')"
SQL: WITH down_ports_window AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, SUM(sa.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY sa.RESOURCE_TYPE ORDER BY sa.ID) AS window_column FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')) SELECT port_id, tenant_id, mac_address, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > 1000 ), admin_up_ports_bindings AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(psb.port_id) AS binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN psb.port_security_enabled THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS port_security_enabled_total FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address ), AverageBindings AS ( SELECT AVG(binding_count) AS avg_binding_count FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.port_id, ic.tenant_id, ic.mac_address, ic.binding_count, ic.port_security_enabled_total, ab.avg_binding_count AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.binding_count > ab.avg_binding_count * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_BINDINGS' WHEN ic.binding_count < ab.avg_binding_count * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_BINDINGS' ELSE 'AVERAGE_BINDINGS' END AS binding_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AverageBindings ab ), counts AS ( SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM down_ports_window) AS down_ports_window_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM admin_up_ports_bindings) AS admin_up_ports_bindings_count ) SELECT c.down_ports_window_count, c.admin_up_ports_bindings_count FROM counts c;

question: For the top 10 port statuses (by distinct port count) among ports that have an IP allocation with IP address 10.150.64.113/8, show each status along with (1) the total number of distinct ports in that status and the variance of their standard attribute IDs, and also (2) the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of standard attribute IDs and the total number of distinct security groups bound to ports in that same status (considering only ports that have both a security group port binding and a port security binding, restricted to tenant_id '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7'). Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: IP Address "10.150.64.113/8" is predicated by "ipallocations.ip_address IN ('10.150.64.113/8')" Tenant ID "17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')"
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.STATUS, VARIANCE(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS standard_attr_id_variance FROM PORTS AS p JOIN IPALLOCATIONS AS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID IS NOT NULL AND ia.IP_ADDRESS IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.STATUS ORDER BY standard_attr_id_variance DESC ) SELECT p.status, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_ports, i.standard_attr_id_variance FROM ports p JOIN ipallocations ia ON p.id = ia.port_id JOIN inner_cte i ON p.status = i.status WHERE ia.ip_address IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.status, i.standard_attr_id_variance ORDER BY total_ports DESC LIMIT 10 ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.status, STDDEV(p.standard_attr_id) / NULLIF(AVG(p.standard_attr_id), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM securitygroupportbindings AS sgpb JOIN ports AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN portsecuritybindings AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(p.standard_attr_id) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(status) OVER (ORDER BY status_sort, status) = status THEN NULL ELSE status END AS status, coefficient_of_variation, distinct_security_groups FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.status) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.status END AS status_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.status) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.status END AS status, i.coefficient_of_variation AS coefficient_of_variation, COUNT(DISTINCT sgpb.security_group_id) AS distinct_security_groups FROM inner_cte i JOIN ports p ON p.status = i.status JOIN securitygroupportbindings sgpb ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON psb.port_id = p.id WHERE p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY i.status, i.coefficient_of_variation WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY status_sort, status ) SELECT s1.status, s1.total_ports, s1.standard_attr_id_variance, s2.coefficient_of_variation, s2.distinct_security_groups FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s2.status = s1.status;

question: For tenant ID `17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7`, show the ports that are administratively up (and also have status `DOWN` with a running sum of standard attribute IDs greater than 1000), returning each port’s ID, tenant ID, MAC address, number of port security bindings, total times port security is enabled across those bindings, the deviation of that enabled total from the average across such ports, and the running-sum standard-attribute value. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Tenant ID "17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')"
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(psb.port_id) AS binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN psb.port_security_enabled THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS port_security_enabled_total FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(port_security_enabled_total) AS avg_enabled_total FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.port_id, i.tenant_id, i.mac_address, i.binding_count, i.port_security_enabled_total, (i.port_security_enabled_total - a.avg_enabled_total) AS deviation_from_avg_enabled_total FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_cte a ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, SUM(sa.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY sa.RESOURCE_TYPE ORDER BY sa.ID) AS window_column FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')) SELECT port_id, tenant_id, mac_address, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > 1000 ) SELECT q1.port_id, q1.tenant_id, q1.mac_address, q1.binding_count, q1.port_security_enabled_total, q1.deviation_from_avg_enabled_total, q2.window_column FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.port_id = q2.port_id AND q1.tenant_id = q2.tenant_id AND q1.mac_address = q2.mac_address;

question: For tenant ID `98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57`, return the ports that (a) are administratively up (and have port security bindings) and (b) are also DOWN and security-group bound, showing the port ID, host, VIF type, VNIC type, tenant ID, network ID, MAC address, status, device owner, the windowed average standard attribute ID (2 preceding/2 following within each VIF type), the total number of such administratively-up ports per VIF type, the deviation of that windowed average from the overall windowed-average across all returned administratively-up ports, plus the security group ID, the port’s rank within its security group (ordered by port ID), and the deviation of that rank from the average rank across all returned DOWN ports. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')"
SQL: WITH up_ports AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), VifTypeCounts AS ( SELECT VIF_TYPE, COUNT(*) AS ports_in_vif_type FROM inner_cte GROUP BY VIF_TYPE ), OverallWindowAvg AS ( SELECT AVG(window_column) AS overall_avg_window_column FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.PORT_ID, i.HOST, i.VIF_TYPE, i.VNIC_TYPE, i.TENANT_ID, i.NETWORK_ID, i.MAC_ADDRESS, i.STATUS, i.DEVICE_OWNER, i.window_column, vtc.ports_in_vif_type, (i.window_column - owa.overall_avg_window_column) AS deviation_from_overall_window_avg FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN VifTypeCounts AS vtc ON i.VIF_TYPE = vtc.VIF_TYPE CROSS JOIN OverallWindowAvg AS owa ), down_ports AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, sgpb.security_group_id, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sgpb.security_group_id ORDER BY p.id) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), avg_rank_cte AS (SELECT AVG(window_column) AS avg_rank FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.port_id, i.tenant_id, i.mac_address, i.security_group_id, i.window_column AS rank_within_security_group, (i.window_column - a.avg_rank) AS deviation_from_avg_rank FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_rank_cte a ) SELECT u.PORT_ID, u.HOST, u.VIF_TYPE, u.VNIC_TYPE, u.TENANT_ID, u.NETWORK_ID, u.MAC_ADDRESS, u.STATUS, u.DEVICE_OWNER, u.window_column AS up_ports_window_avg_standard_attr_id, u.ports_in_vif_type, u.deviation_from_overall_window_avg, d.security_group_id, d.rank_within_security_group, d.deviation_from_avg_rank FROM up_ports u JOIN down_ports d ON u.PORT_ID = d.port_id ORDER BY u.VIF_TYPE, u.PORT_ID;

question: For tenant ID '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57', return (1) the total number of DOWN ports whose security-group rank (ordered by port ID within each security group) is greater than the average rank across those DOWN ports, and (2) the total number of administratively up ports that have at least one IP allocation and where more than 75% of their IP allocations are on distinct subnets. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')"
SQL: WITH DownPortsRanked AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, sgpb.security_group_id, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sgpb.security_group_id ORDER BY p.id) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')) SELECT port_id, tenant_id, mac_address, security_group_id, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > (SELECT AVG(window_column) FROM inner_cte) ), AdminUpPortsIpStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ia.subnet_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subnet_id_rows FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON ia.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND ia.ip_address IS NOT NULL AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address) SELECT inner_cte.port_id, inner_cte.tenant_id, inner_cte.mac_address, inner_cte.ip_allocation_count, inner_cte.subnet_id_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT ia2.subnet_id) AS distinct_subnet_count FROM inner_cte JOIN ipallocations ia2 ON ia2.port_id = inner_cte.port_id WHERE ia2.ip_address IS NOT NULL GROUP BY inner_cte.port_id, inner_cte.tenant_id, inner_cte.mac_address, inner_cte.ip_allocation_count, inner_cte.subnet_id_rows HAVING inner_cte.ip_allocation_count > 0 AND (COUNT(DISTINCT ia2.subnet_id) * 1.0 / inner_cte.ip_allocation_count) > 0.75 ) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DownPortsRanked) AS Down_Port_Count_Above_Avg_Rank, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM AdminUpPortsIpStats) AS Admin_Up_Port_Count_With_Distinct_Subnet_Ratio_Above_75pct;

question: How many administratively up ports exist for tenant ID `98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57`, and how many distinct statuses are present in the top 10 port statuses (by port count) for ports with VIF type `ovs` and device_id `da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7`? Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each VIF type as 'HIGH_USER' (at least 50% more than average), 'LOW_USER' (at least 50% less than average), or 'AVERAGE_USER'.
evidence: Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')" Device ID "da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7" is predicated by "ports.device_id IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7')"
SQL: WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), VifTypeCounts AS ( SELECT VIF_TYPE, COUNT(*) AS total_ports FROM inner_cte GROUP BY VIF_TYPE ), AverageVifTypePorts AS ( SELECT AVG(total_ports) AS avg_ports FROM VifTypeCounts ) SELECT i.PORT_ID, i.HOST, i.VIF_TYPE, i.VNIC_TYPE, i.TENANT_ID, i.NETWORK_ID, i.MAC_ADDRESS, i.STATUS, i.DEVICE_OWNER, i.window_column, vtc.total_ports, avp.avg_ports AS benchmark, CASE WHEN vtc.total_ports > avp.avg_ports * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_USER' WHEN vtc.total_ports < avp.avg_ports * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_USER' ELSE 'AVERAGE_USER' END AS user_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN VifTypeCounts vtc ON i.VIF_TYPE = vtc.VIF_TYPE CROSS JOIN AverageVifTypePorts avp), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.STATUS, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) AS min_admin_state_up, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS avg_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS b ON p.ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE b.VIF_TYPE = 'ovs' AND p.DEVICE_ID IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS ) SELECT i.status, COUNT(DISTINCT p2.id) AS total_ports, i.min_admin_state_up, i.avg_standard_attr_id FROM inner_cte i JOIN ports p2 ON p2.status = i.status JOIN ml2_port_bindings b2 ON p2.id = b2.port_id WHERE b2.vif_type = 'ovs' AND p2.device_id IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7') GROUP BY i.status, i.min_admin_state_up, i.avg_standard_attr_id ORDER BY total_ports DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT q1.PORT_ID) AS tenant_98333_admin_up_ports_count, COUNT(DISTINCT q2.status) AS top10_ovs_device_status_count FROM q1 CROSS JOIN q2;

question: For tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57", for each administratively-up port on an ACTIVE network in that tenant, list the network details (network ID, name, admin_state_up, MTU, standard attribute updated_at, the row number of the network within the tenant ordered by network name, and the network’s MTU deviation from the tenant’s average MTU across those ACTIVE networks) together with the port details (port ID, host, VIF/VNIC type, MAC address, status, device owner, the windowed average standard attribute ID over 2 preceding and 2 following rows within each VIF type, the total ports per VIF type, and the deviation of that windowed average from the overall average windowed average across all returned ports). Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "networks.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')" Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')"
SQL: WITH networks_subq AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM NETWORKS n JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND n.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), avg_mtu_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(mtu) AS avg_mtu FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.network_id, i.network_name, i.tenant_id, i.admin_state_up, i.mtu, i.standard_attr_updated_at, i.window_column, (i.mtu - a.avg_mtu) AS deviation_from_avg_mtu FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_mtu_cte a ), ports_subq AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), VifTypeCounts AS ( SELECT VIF_TYPE, COUNT(*) AS ports_in_vif_type FROM inner_cte GROUP BY VIF_TYPE ), OverallWindowAvg AS ( SELECT AVG(window_column) AS overall_avg_window_column FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.PORT_ID, i.HOST, i.VIF_TYPE, i.VNIC_TYPE, i.TENANT_ID, i.NETWORK_ID, i.MAC_ADDRESS, i.STATUS, i.DEVICE_OWNER, i.window_column, vtc.ports_in_vif_type, (i.window_column - owa.overall_avg_window_column) AS deviation_from_overall_window_avg FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN VifTypeCounts AS vtc ON i.VIF_TYPE = vtc.VIF_TYPE CROSS JOIN OverallWindowAvg AS owa ) SELECT n.network_id, n.network_name, n.tenant_id, n.admin_state_up AS network_admin_state_up, n.mtu, n.standard_attr_updated_at, n.window_column AS network_row_number_within_tenant, n.deviation_from_avg_mtu, p.PORT_ID, p.HOST, p.VIF_TYPE, p.VNIC_TYPE, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER, p.window_column AS port_windowed_avg_standard_attr_id, p.ports_in_vif_type, p.deviation_from_overall_window_avg FROM networks_subq n JOIN ports_subq p ON p.NETWORK_ID = n.network_id AND p.TENANT_ID = n.tenant_id;

question: For ACTIVE networks, return the network ID, its total number of subnets, the overall average subnet count across ACTIVE networks shared via RBAC action 'access_as_shared' (only keeping networks whose subnet totals are more than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above that mean), and the maximum dense-rank value for that same network ID computed from ACTIVE non-shared networks (excluding RBAC shared networks where the action is 'access_as_shared' and the target tenant is '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'). Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "access_as_shared" permission is predicated by "networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared'" "exclusion of shared networks" is predicated by "networks.id NOT IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))"
SQL: WITH shared_subnet_outliers AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.id AS network_id, SUM(1) AS total_subnets FROM NETWORKS AS n JOIN NETWORKRBACS AS r ON n.id = r.object_id JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON r.object_id = s.network_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND r.action = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.id HAVING SUM(1) > ( SELECT AVG(subnet_cnt) + STDDEV(subnet_cnt) FROM ( SELECT n2.id AS network_id, SUM(1) AS subnet_cnt FROM NETWORKS AS n2 JOIN NETWORKRBACS AS r2 ON n2.id = r2.object_id JOIN SUBNETS AS s2 ON r2.object_id = s2.network_id WHERE n2.status = 'ACTIVE' AND r2.action = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n2.id ) AS per_network )) SELECT inner_cte.network_id, inner_cte.total_subnets, stats.avg_subnet_count FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(subnet_cnt) AS avg_subnet_count FROM ( SELECT n2.id AS network_id, SUM(1) AS subnet_cnt FROM NETWORKS AS n2 JOIN NETWORKRBACS AS r2 ON n2.id = r2.object_id JOIN SUBNETS AS s2 ON r2.object_id = s2.network_id WHERE n2.status = 'ACTIVE' AND r2.action = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n2.id ) AS per_network ) AS stats ON 1 = 1), nonshared_active_network_ranks AS (WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT n.name, n.status, n.admin_state_up, r.action, r.target_tenant, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.id ORDER BY n.id) AS window_column FROM networksecuritybindings b JOIN networks n ON b.network_id = n.id JOIN networkrbacs r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND n.id NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) ) SELECT n.id AS network_id, MAX(inner_cte.window_column) AS max_dense_rank FROM inner_cte JOIN networks n ON n.name = inner_cte.name AND n.status = inner_cte.status AND n.admin_state_up = inner_cte.admin_state_up GROUP BY n.id) SELECT sso.network_id, sso.total_subnets, sso.avg_subnet_count, nar.max_dense_rank FROM shared_subnet_outliers sso JOIN nonshared_active_network_ranks nar ON nar.network_id = sso.network_id;

question: For tenant ID '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57', for each ACTIVE network, return the network’s ID, name, admin_state_up flag, MTU, standard attribute updated_at timestamp, its row number within the tenant ordered by network name, and its MTU deviation from the average MTU; additionally, for each such network, report how many admin_state_up=1 ports on that network are bound to a security group, the average DNS record count across those ports, and how many of those ports are categorized as HIGH_DNS, LOW_DNS, or AVERAGE_DNS (relative to the tenant-wide average DNS record benchmark used for the ports). Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each port as 'HIGH_DNS' (at least 50% more than average), 'LOW_DNS' (at least 50% less than average), or 'AVERAGE_DNS'.
evidence: Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')" Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "networks.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')"
SQL: WITH PortDnsAndSg AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.name AS port_name, COUNT(sgpb.security_group_id) AS security_group_binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pd.port_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS dns_record_count FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS sgpb JOIN PORTS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id LEFT JOIN PORTDNSES pd ON p.id = pd.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.name ), AverageDns AS ( SELECT AVG(dns_record_count) AS avg_dns_records FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.port_id, ic.tenant_id, ic.port_name, ic.security_group_binding_count, ic.dns_record_count, ad.avg_dns_records AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.dns_record_count > ad.avg_dns_records * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_DNS' WHEN ic.dns_record_count < ad.avg_dns_records * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_DNS' ELSE 'AVERAGE_DNS' END AS dns_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AverageDns ad ), ActiveNetworksMtu AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM NETWORKS n JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND n.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), avg_mtu_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(mtu) AS avg_mtu FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.network_id, i.network_name, i.tenant_id, i.admin_state_up, i.mtu, i.standard_attr_updated_at, i.window_column, (i.mtu - a.avg_mtu) AS deviation_from_avg_mtu FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_mtu_cte a ) SELECT an.network_id, an.network_name, an.tenant_id, an.admin_state_up AS network_admin_state_up, an.mtu, an.standard_attr_updated_at, an.window_column, an.deviation_from_avg_mtu, COUNT(DISTINCT pds.port_id) AS admin_up_sg_bound_port_count, AVG(pds.dns_record_count) AS avg_dns_records_per_port, SUM(CASE WHEN pds.dns_category = 'HIGH_DNS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_dns_port_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pds.dns_category = 'LOW_DNS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS low_dns_port_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pds.dns_category = 'AVERAGE_DNS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS average_dns_port_count FROM ActiveNetworksMtu an JOIN PORTS p ON p.network_id = an.network_id AND p.tenant_id = an.tenant_id AND p.admin_state_up = 1 JOIN PortDnsAndSg pds ON pds.port_id = p.id AND pds.tenant_id = an.tenant_id GROUP BY an.network_id, an.network_name, an.tenant_id, an.admin_state_up, an.mtu, an.standard_attr_updated_at, an.window_column, an.deviation_from_avg_mtu ORDER BY an.tenant_id, an.network_name;

question: For ports on host "drive-59" that belong to tenant ID "17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7", list the VIF type and port status (including subtotals per VIF type and a grand total) with the number of distinct ports, and also show—by VIF type—the maximum of the per-status minimum admin_state_up values and the maximum of the per-status average standard_attr_id values for ports whose device_id is "da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7". Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Device ID "da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7" is predicated by "ports.device_id IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7')" Tenant ID "17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')"
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.STATUS, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) AS min_admin_state_up, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS avg_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS b ON p.ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE b.VIF_TYPE = 'ovs' AND p.DEVICE_ID IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS) SELECT b.VIF_TYPE, MAX(inner_cte.min_admin_state_up) AS max_of_min_admin_state_up, MAX(inner_cte.avg_standard_attr_id) AS max_of_avg_standard_attr_id FROM inner_cte JOIN PORTS p ON p.STATUS = inner_cte.STATUS JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS b ON p.ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE p.DEVICE_ID IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7') GROUP BY b.VIF_TYPE ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT b.PORT_ID, p.TENANT_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE b.HOST = 'drive-59' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')), PortRollup AS (SELECT b.VIF_TYPE, p.STATUS AS port_status, COUNT(DISTINCT inner_cte.PORT_ID) AS total_ports FROM inner_cte JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b ON inner_cte.PORT_ID = b.PORT_ID JOIN PORTS AS p ON inner_cte.PORT_ID = p.ID GROUP BY b.VIF_TYPE, p.STATUS) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(VIF_TYPE) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE VIF_TYPE END AS VIF_TYPE, CASE WHEN GROUPING(port_status) = 1 AND GROUPING(VIF_TYPE) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE port_status END AS port_status, SUM(total_ports) AS total_ports FROM PortRollup GROUP BY VIF_TYPE, port_status WITH ROLLUP ) SELECT subq2.VIF_TYPE, subq2.port_status, subq2.total_ports, subq1.max_of_min_admin_state_up, subq1.max_of_avg_standard_attr_id FROM subq2 LEFT JOIN subq1 ON subq2.VIF_TYPE = subq1.VIF_TYPE;

question: For ports that are in status DOWN on network ID `0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d`, return the port name, network ID, MAC address, admin_state_up, status, device owner, and bound security group ID, along with (1) the minimum admin_state_up over a window of 3 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by port ID, (2) the total number of such DOWN ports per device owner and the average of these totals across device owners, and (3) for the same network (as computed from tenant `17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7`), the count of DOWN ports with port security enabled and that count’s deviation from the average across the tenant’s networks. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Network ID "0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d" is predicated by "ports.network_id IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d')" Tenant ID "17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')"
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.NAME, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER ( ORDER BY p.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.NETWORK_ID IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d') ) SELECT inner_cte.NAME, inner_cte.NETWORK_ID, inner_cte.MAC_ADDRESS, inner_cte.ADMIN_STATE_UP, inner_cte.STATUS, inner_cte.DEVICE_OWNER, inner_cte.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, inner_cte.window_column, owner_stats.total_ports_per_owner, avg_owner_stats.avg_ports_per_owner FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT DEVICE_OWNER, COUNT(*) AS total_ports_per_owner FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEVICE_OWNER ) AS owner_stats ON inner_cte.DEVICE_OWNER = owner_stats.DEVICE_OWNER JOIN ( SELECT AVG(port_count) AS avg_ports_per_owner FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS port_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEVICE_OWNER ) AS sub ) AS avg_owner_stats ON 1 = 1 ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS down_ports_with_port_security_enabled FROM PORTS p JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND psb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')), NetworkCounts AS ( SELECT p.NETWORK_ID AS network_id, COUNT(*) AS down_ports_with_port_security_enabled FROM PORTS p JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND psb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.NETWORK_ID ), AverageCounts AS ( SELECT AVG(down_ports_with_port_security_enabled) AS avg_down_ports_with_port_security_enabled FROM NetworkCounts ) SELECT nc.network_id, nc.down_ports_with_port_security_enabled, (nc.down_ports_with_port_security_enabled - ac.avg_down_ports_with_port_security_enabled) AS deviation_from_avg FROM NetworkCounts nc CROSS JOIN AverageCounts ac ) SELECT q1.NAME, q1.NETWORK_ID, q1.MAC_ADDRESS, q1.ADMIN_STATE_UP, q1.STATUS, q1.DEVICE_OWNER, q1.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, q1.window_column, q1.total_ports_per_owner, q1.avg_ports_per_owner, q2.down_ports_with_port_security_enabled, q2.deviation_from_avg FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.NETWORK_ID = q2.network_id;

question: Show the rolled-up subnet summary (subnet name, gateway IP, max IP version, and number of groups) for subnets on networks shared via RBAC action 'access_as_shared' with public target tenant ('*') where the max IP version is greater than 3, alongside the rolled-up counts of distinct subnets by IP version for networks shared via the same RBAC action with target tenant '1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b' (including subtotals and grand totals for both summaries). Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "public access" (wildcard) is predicated by "networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*'" Target Tenant ID "1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b" is predicated by "networkrbacs.target_tenant IN ('1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b')"
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.name, MAX(s.ip_version) AS max_ip_version, s.gateway_ip FROM NETWORKRBACS n JOIN SUBNETS s ON n.object_id = s.network_id WHERE n.action = 'access_as_shared' AND n.target_tenant = '*' GROUP BY s.name, s.gateway_ip HAVING MAX(s.ip_version) > 3 ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(name) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE name END AS name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(gateway_ip) = 1 AND GROUPING(name) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(gateway_ip) = 1 AND GROUPING(name) = 1 THEN 'ALL' ELSE gateway_ip END AS gateway_ip, MAX(max_ip_version) AS max_ip_version, COUNT(*) AS total_groups FROM inner_cte GROUP BY name, gateway_ip WITH ROLLUP ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, s.CIDR AS subnet_cidr, n.TARGET_TENANT AS rbac_target_tenant, SUM(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY s.IP_VERSION ORDER BY s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS window_column FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN NETWORKRBACS AS n ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' AND n.TARGET_TENANT IN ('1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b') ), SubnetCounts AS ( SELECT s.IP_VERSION, i.rbac_target_tenant, COUNT(DISTINCT s.ID) AS total_subnets FROM inner_cte i JOIN SUBNETS s ON s.NAME = i.subnet_name AND s.CIDR = i.subnet_cidr GROUP BY s.IP_VERSION, i.rbac_target_tenant ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(IP_VERSION) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE CAST(IP_VERSION AS CHAR) END AS ip_version, CASE WHEN GROUPING(rbac_target_tenant) = 1 AND GROUPING(IP_VERSION) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE rbac_target_tenant END AS rbac_target_tenant, SUM(total_subnets) AS total_subnets FROM SubnetCounts GROUP BY IP_VERSION, rbac_target_tenant WITH ROLLUP ) SELECT q1.name AS subnet_name, q1.gateway_ip, q1.max_ip_version, q1.total_groups, q2.ip_version, q2.rbac_target_tenant, q2.total_subnets FROM q1 CROSS JOIN q2;

question: For DOWN ports belonging to tenant ID '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57', list each port’s ID, tenant ID, MAC address, and its rank within its security group (ordered by port ID), while also showing for the port’s security group the total number of such DOWN ports, the average (benchmark) across security groups, and the security group’s usage category (HIGH_USER/LOW_USER/AVERAGE_USER). Do not repeat the security group ID on consecutive rows when ordering by security group ID then port ID. Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each security group as 'HIGH_USER' (at least 50% more than average), 'LOW_USER' (at least 50% less than average), or 'AVERAGE_USER'.
evidence: Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')"
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, sgpb.security_group_id, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sgpb.security_group_id ORDER BY p.id) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(security_group_id) OVER (ORDER BY security_group_id, port_id) = security_group_id THEN NULL ELSE security_group_id END AS security_group_id, port_id, tenant_id, mac_address, window_column AS port_rank_within_security_group FROM inner_cte ORDER BY security_group_id, port_id ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, sgpb.security_group_id, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sgpb.security_group_id ORDER BY p.id) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), SecurityGroupPorts AS ( SELECT security_group_id, COUNT(port_id) AS total_ports FROM inner_cte GROUP BY security_group_id ), AveragePorts AS ( SELECT AVG(total_ports) AS avg_ports FROM SecurityGroupPorts ) SELECT i.port_id, i.tenant_id, i.mac_address, i.security_group_id, i.window_column AS port_rank_within_security_group, sgp.total_ports AS total_down_ports_in_security_group, ap.avg_ports AS benchmark, CASE WHEN sgp.total_ports > ap.avg_ports * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_USER' WHEN sgp.total_ports < ap.avg_ports * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_USER' ELSE 'AVERAGE_USER' END AS user_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN SecurityGroupPorts sgp ON i.security_group_id = sgp.security_group_id CROSS JOIN AveragePorts ap ) SELECT q2.security_group_id, q2.total_down_ports_in_security_group, q2.benchmark, q2.user_category, q1.port_id, q1.tenant_id, q1.mac_address, q1.port_rank_within_security_group FROM q2 JOIN q1 ON q2.port_id = q1.port_id ORDER BY q2.security_group_id, q1.port_id;

question: For tenant ID '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57', for each port status and DNS presence category (Has DNS vs No DNS) among security-group-bound, admin-up ports, show the port status, DNS presence, total ports (including subtotals per status and a grand total), the tenant’s total number of ACTIVE networks, and the ports-per-active-network ratio (total ports divided by total active networks, rounded to 2 decimals).
evidence: Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')" Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "networks.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')"
SQL: WITH PortStatusDns_rollup AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.name AS port_name, COUNT(sgpb.security_group_id) AS security_group_binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pd.port_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS dns_record_count FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS sgpb JOIN PORTS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id LEFT JOIN PORTDNSES pd ON p.id = pd.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.name), PortStatusDns AS ( SELECT p.status, CASE WHEN inner_cte.dns_record_count > 0 THEN 'Has DNS' ELSE 'No DNS' END AS dns_presence, COUNT(DISTINCT inner_cte.port_id) AS total_ports FROM inner_cte JOIN PORTS p ON inner_cte.port_id = p.id GROUP BY p.status, dns_presence ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(status) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE status END AS status, CASE WHEN GROUPING(dns_presence) = 1 AND GROUPING(status) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE dns_presence END AS dns_presence, SUM(total_ports) AS total_ports FROM PortStatusDns GROUP BY status, dns_presence WITH ROLLUP ), ActiveNetworks_rollup AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM NETWORKS n JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND n.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(tenant_id) OVER (ORDER BY tenant_id_sort, tenant_id, network_name) = tenant_id THEN NULL ELSE tenant_id END AS tenant_id, network_id, network_name, admin_state_up, mtu, standard_attr_updated_at, window_column, total_networks FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE tenant_id END AS tenant_id_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE tenant_id END AS tenant_id, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE network_id END AS network_id, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE network_name END AS network_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE admin_state_up END AS admin_state_up, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE mtu END AS mtu, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE standard_attr_updated_at END AS standard_attr_updated_at, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE window_column END AS window_column, COUNT(*) AS total_networks FROM inner_cte GROUP BY tenant_id, network_id, network_name, admin_state_up, mtu, standard_attr_updated_at, window_column WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY tenant_id_sort, tenant_id, network_name ) SELECT psd.status, psd.dns_presence, psd.total_ports, an.total_networks, ROUND(psd.total_ports / NULLIF(an.total_networks, 0), 2) question: For each port status, among ports whose standard attribute resource type is 'ports' and that are not on shared networks (networks listed in networkrbacs with action = 'access_as_shared' and target_tenant = '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'), report the maximum number of ports owned by any single device owner in that status, along with the range/variance/standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of port security binding counts per port (considering only ports with at least one binding for tenant '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') and the spread category ('HIGH_SPREAD' if the range is at least 5, otherwise 'LOW_SPREAD'). Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "exclusion of shared networks" is predicated by "networks.id NOT IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))" Tenant ID "17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')"
SQL: WITH MaxPortsPerStatus AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER) SELECT port_status, MAX(port_count) AS max_ports_for_any_device_owner FROM inner_cte GROUP BY port_status), PortSecurityBindingSpreadByStatus AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.status, MAX(ps.binding_count) - MIN(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_range, VARIANCE(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_variance, STDDEV(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_stddev FROM ports AS p JOIN ( SELECT p2.id AS port_id, COUNT(*) AS binding_count FROM ports AS p2 JOIN portsecuritybindings AS b ON p2.id = b.port_id WHERE p2.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p2.id ) AS ps ON p.id = ps.port_id GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY binding_count_range DESC) SELECT ic.status, ic.binding_count_range, ic.binding_count_variance, ic.binding_count_stddev, CASE WHEN ic.binding_count_range >= 5 THEN 'HIGH_SPREAD' ELSE 'LOW_SPREAD' END AS spread_category FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN ports AS p3 ON p3.status = ic.status GROUP BY ic.status, ic.binding_count_range, ic.binding_count_variance, ic.binding_count_stddev ORDER BY ic.binding_count_range DESC) SELECT mpps.port_status, mpps.max_ports_for_any_device_owner, psbs.binding_count_range, psbs.binding_count_variance, psbs.binding_count_stddev, psbs.spread_category FROM MaxPortsPerStatus AS mpps JOIN PortSecurityBindingSpreadByStatus AS psbs ON psbs.status = mpps.port_status ORDER BY psbs.binding_count_range DESC;

question: For each port status, considering only ports with an IP allocation of '10.150.64.113/8' (and with port security enabled where applicable), show the status, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of allocated IP address string length and its deviation from the overall average coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), along with the variance of STANDARD_ATTR_ID for that status and the overall average of these variances. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: IP Address "10.150.64.113/8" is predicated by "ipallocations.ip_address IN ('10.150.64.113/8')"
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.status, STDDEV(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) / NULLIF(AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM portsecuritybindings psb JOIN ports p ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON p.id = ia.port_id WHERE psb.port_security_enabled = 1 AND ia.ip_address IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.status, i.coefficient_of_variation, (i.coefficient_of_variation - a.avg_coefficient_of_variation) AS deviation_from_avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_cte a ORDER BY deviation_from_avg_coefficient_of_variation DESC ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.STATUS, VARIANCE(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS standard_attr_id_variance FROM PORTS AS p JOIN IPALLOCATIONS AS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID IS NOT NULL AND ia.IP_ADDRESS IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.STATUS ORDER BY standard_attr_id_variance DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.status, inner_cte.standard_attr_id_variance, avg_vars.avg_standard_attr_id_variance FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(standard_attr_id_variance) AS avg_standard_attr_id_variance FROM inner_cte ) AS avg_vars ) SELECT q1.status, q1.coefficient_of_variation, q1.deviation_from_avg_coefficient_of_variation, q2.standard_attr_id_variance, q2.avg_standard_attr_id_variance FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.status = q2.status ORDER BY q1.deviation_from_avg_coefficient_of_variation DESC;

question: For tenant_id '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7', among ports with status restricted to 'DOWN' that are bound to a security group, list the top 10 device owners by distinct port count, and for that same port status also show the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of standard attribute IDs and the total distinct port count for ports that have both a security group port binding and a port security binding, plus whether any of those ports have floating IPs allocated and whether any ports under each device owner have more than one security group binding. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Tenant ID "17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')"
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.status, STDDEV(p.standard_attr_id) / NULLIF(AVG(p.standard_attr_id), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM securitygroupportbindings AS sgpb JOIN ports AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN portsecuritybindings AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(p.standard_attr_id) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT i.status, i.coefficient_of_variation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_ports, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT f.id) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_floating_ips FROM inner_cte i JOIN ports p ON p.status = i.status AND p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') JOIN securitygroupportbindings sgpb ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON psb.port_id = p.id LEFT JOIN floatingips f ON f.fixed_port_id = p.id GROUP BY i.status, i.coefficient_of_variation ORDER BY i.coefficient_of_variation DESC ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS min_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS spb ON p.ID = spb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ) SELECT i.port_status, i.device_owner, i.port_count, i.min_standard_attr_id, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT spb2.security_group_id) > COUNT(DISTINCT p2.id) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_multi_sg_bindings FROM inner_cte i JOIN ports p2 ON p2.status = i.port_status AND p2.device_owner = i.device_owner AND p2.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') JOIN securitygroupportbindings spb2 ON p2.id = spb2.port_id GROUP BY i.port_status, i.device_owner, i.port_count, i.min_standard_attr_id ORDER BY i.port_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT q2.port_status, q2.device_owner, q2.port_count, q2.min_standard_attr_id, q2.has_multi_sg_bindings, q1.coefficient_of_variation, q1.total_ports, q1.has_floating_ips FROM q2 JOIN q1 ON q1.status = q2.port_status ORDER BY q2.port_count DESC, q2.device_owner;

question: For the IPv4 subnet with ID '012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48', list the subnet ID, name, and CIDR, the total number of distinct subnet routes, the maximum number of distinct route destinations that share the same next hop, compute the ratio of that maximum to the total routes (rounded to 2 decimals), and indicate whether the subnet has any IP allocation pools defined.
evidence: Subnet ID "012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48" is predicated by "subnets.id IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48')"
SQL: WITH max_dest_per_nexthop AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT r.DESTINATION, r.NEXTHOP, s.NAME AS subnet_name, s.CIDR AS subnet_cidr, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.SUBNET_ID ORDER BY r.SUBNET_ID) AS window_column FROM SUBNETROUTES r JOIN SUBNETS s ON r.SUBNET_ID = s.ID JOIN IPALLOCATIONPOOLS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48')) SELECT subnet_name, subnet_cidr, MAX(destination_count) AS max_destinations_per_nexthop FROM (SELECT subnet_name, subnet_cidr, NEXTHOP, COUNT(DISTINCT DESTINATION) AS destination_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY subnet_name, subnet_cidr, NEXTHOP) t GROUP BY subnet_name, subnet_cidr ), top_routes_and_pools AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT r.DESTINATION, r.NEXTHOP, s.NAME AS subnet_name, s.CIDR AS subnet_cidr, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.SUBNET_ID ORDER BY r.SUBNET_ID) AS window_column FROM SUBNETROUTES r JOIN SUBNETS s ON r.SUBNET_ID = s.ID JOIN IPALLOCATIONPOOLS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48')) SELECT s.ID AS subnet_id, s.NAME AS subnet_name, s.CIDR AS subnet_cidr, COUNT(DISTINCT r.DESTINATION) AS total_routes, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_allocation_pools FROM SUBNETS s LEFT JOIN SUBNETROUTES r ON r.SUBNET_ID = s.ID LEFT JOIN IPALLOCATIONPOOLS p ON p.SUBNET_ID = s.ID JOIN inner_cte i ON i.subnet_name = s.NAME AND i.subnet_cidr = s.CIDR WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') GROUP BY s.ID, s.NAME, s.CIDR ORDER BY total_routes DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT t.subnet_id, t.subnet_name, t.subnet_cidr, t.total_routes, m.max_destinations_per_nexthop, ROUND(m.max_destinations_per_nexthop / NULLIF(t.total_routes, 0), 2) AS max_nexthop_destination_share, t.has_allocation_pools FROM top_routes_and_pools t JOIN max_dest_per_nexthop m ON m.subnet_name = t.subnet_name AND m.subnet_cidr = t.subnet_cidr ORDER BY max_nexthop_destination_share DESC, t.total_routes DESC;

question: For each VIF type among administratively up ports for tenant ID `98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57`, when restricted to networks that also have DOWN ports in network ID `0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d` whose windowed minimum admin_state_up is below the average of that windowed minimum, list the VIF type, the total number of such up ports in that VIF type, the number of distinct security group IDs on those qualifying DOWN ports, and the ratio of distinct security groups to up-port count (rounded to 2 decimals).
evidence: Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')" Network ID "0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d" is predicated by "ports.network_id IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d')"
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), VifTypeCounts AS ( SELECT VIF_TYPE, COUNT(*) AS ports_in_vif_type FROM inner_cte GROUP BY VIF_TYPE ), OverallWindowAvg AS ( SELECT AVG(window_column) AS overall_avg_window_column FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.PORT_ID, i.HOST, i.VIF_TYPE, i.VNIC_TYPE, i.TENANT_ID, i.NETWORK_ID, i.MAC_ADDRESS, i.STATUS, i.DEVICE_OWNER, i.window_column, vtc.ports_in_vif_type, (i.window_column - owa.overall_avg_window_column) AS deviation_from_overall_window_avg FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN VifTypeCounts AS vtc ON i.VIF_TYPE = vtc.VIF_TYPE CROSS JOIN OverallWindowAvg AS owa ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.NAME, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER ( ORDER BY p.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.NETWORK_ID IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d') ) SELECT i.NAME, i.NETWORK_ID, i.MAC_ADDRESS, i.ADMIN_STATE_UP, i.STATUS, i.DEVICE_OWNER, i.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, i.window_column FROM inner_cte AS i WHERE i.window_column < (SELECT AVG(window_column) FROM inner_cte) ) SELECT q1.VIF_TYPE, q1.ports_in_vif_type, COUNT(DISTINCT q2.SECURITY_GROUP_ID) AS distinct_security_groups_on_down_ports_in_network, ROUND( COUNT(DISTINCT q2.SECURITY_GROUP_ID) / NULLIF(q1.ports_in_vif_type, 0), 2 ) AS security_groups_per_up_port_ratio FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.NETWORK_ID = q2.NETWORK_ID GROUP BY q1.VIF_TYPE, q1.ports_in_vif_type ORDER BY security_groups_per_up_port_ratio DESC;

question: For ports that have an IP allocation with IP address 10.150.64.113/8, what is (1) the variance of STANDARD_ATTR_ID by port STATUS including subtotals by status and a grand total, and (2) for each STATUS the same variance alongside the overall average of these per-status variances? Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: IP Address "10.150.64.113/8" is predicated by "ipallocations.ip_address IN ('10.150.64.113/8')"
SQL: WITH rollup_vars AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.STATUS, VARIANCE(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS standard_attr_id_variance FROM PORTS AS p JOIN IPALLOCATIONS AS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID IS NOT NULL AND ia.IP_ADDRESS IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.STATUS ORDER BY standard_attr_id_variance DESC ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(status) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE status END AS status, SUM(standard_attr_id_variance) AS standard_attr_id_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY status WITH ROLLUP ), status_vars_with_avg AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.STATUS, VARIANCE(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS standard_attr_id_variance FROM PORTS AS p JOIN IPALLOCATIONS AS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID IS NOT NULL AND ia.IP_ADDRESS IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.STATUS ORDER BY standard_attr_id_variance DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.status, inner_cte.standard_attr_id_variance, avg_vars.avg_standard_attr_id_variance FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(standard_attr_id_variance) AS avg_standard_attr_id_variance FROM inner_cte ) AS avg_vars ), avg_only AS (SELECT DISTINCT avg_standard_attr_id_variance FROM status_vars_with_avg) SELECT rv.status, rv.standard_attr_id_variance AS rollup_standard_attr_id_variance, sva.standard_attr_id_variance AS per_status_standard_attr_id_variance, ao.avg_standard_attr_id_variance FROM rollup_vars rv LEFT JOIN status_vars_with_avg sva ON rv.status = sva.status CROSS JOIN avg_only ao;

question: For IPv4 subnet ID `012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48`, return the (up to) top 10 subnets by number of distinct subnet routes, showing subnet ID, subnet name and CIDR, total distinct routes, whether the subnet has any IP allocation pools, and the dense-rank window value computed from the subnet’s associated standard attribute updated-at timestamp (using a window frame of the current row and the 2 preceding rows). SQL: WITH subnet_attr_dense_ranks AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.NAME, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY sa.UPDATED_AT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES AS sa ON sa.ID = s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(subnet_name) OVER (ORDER BY subnet_name_sort, subnet_name, window_column) = subnet_name THEN NULL ELSE subnet_name END AS subnet_name, window_column FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.NAME END AS subnet_name_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.NAME END AS subnet_name, i.window_column FROM inner_cte AS i GROUP BY i.NAME, i.window_column WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY subnet_name_sort, subnet_name, window_column ), top_subnets_by_routes AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT r.DESTINATION, r.NEXTHOP, s.NAME AS subnet_name, s.CIDR AS subnet_cidr, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.SUBNET_ID ORDER BY r.SUBNET_ID) AS window_column FROM SUBNETROUTES r JOIN SUBNETS s ON r.SUBNET_ID = s.ID JOIN IPALLOCATIONPOOLS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48')) SELECT s.ID AS subnet_id, s.NAME AS subnet_name, s.CIDR AS subnet_cidr, COUNT(DISTINCT r.DESTINATION) AS total_routes, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_allocation_pools FROM SUBNETS s LEFT JOIN SUBNETROUTES r ON r.SUBNET_ID = s.ID LEFT JOIN IPALLOCATIONPOOLS p ON p.SUBNET_ID = s.ID JOIN inner_cte i ON i.subnet_name = s.NAME AND i.subnet_cidr = s.CIDR WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') GROUP BY s.ID, s.NAME, s.CIDR ORDER BY total_routes DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT ts.subnet_id, ts.subnet_name, ts.subnet_cidr, ts.total_routes, ts.has_allocation_pools, sar.window_column AS standard_attr_dense_rank_window FROM top_subnets_by_routes ts JOIN subnet_attr_dense_ranks sar ON sar.subnet_name = ts.subnet_name ORDER BY ts.total_routes DESC, ts.subnet_name, sar.window_column;

question: For DOWN ports belonging to tenant ID `98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57`, for each security group, how many distinct ports have a running sum of the port standard attribute ID (within that security group) that is both greater than 100 and greater than the overall average running sum across all such ports, and what is the average of that running sum for those ports?
