evidence: Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')"
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')) SELECT port_id, tenant_id, mac_address, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > (SELECT AVG(window_column) FROM inner_cte) ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')) SELECT inner_cte.port_id, inner_cte.tenant_id, inner_cte.mac_address, sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID AS security_group_id, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb ON inner_cte.port_id = sgpb.PORT_ID WHERE inner_cte.window_column > 100 ORDER BY sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, inner_cte.window_column ) SELECT q2.security_group_id, COUNT(DISTINCT q2.port_id) AS ports_meeting_both_thresholds, AVG(q2.window_column) AS avg_running_sum_for_these_ports FROM q2 JOIN q1 ON q2.port_id = q1.port_id AND q2.tenant_id = q1.tenant_id AND q2.mac_address = q1.mac_address AND q2.window_column = q1.window_column GROUP BY q2.security_group_id ORDER BY ports_meeting_both_thresholds DESC, q2.security_group_id;

question: What are (1) the total number of port security bindings and the total number of times port security is enabled across those bindings for administratively up ports belonging to tenant ID `17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7`, and (2) the total number of ACTIVE networks belonging to tenant ID `98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57`? Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Tenant ID "17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')" Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "networks.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')"
SQL: WITH port_security_by_port AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(psb.port_id) AS binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN psb.port_security_enabled THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS port_security_enabled_total FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(port_id) OVER (ORDER BY port_id_sort, port_id) = port_id THEN NULL ELSE port_id END AS port_id, tenant_id, mac_address, binding_count, port_security_enabled_total FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.port_id) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.port_id END AS port_id_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.port_id) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.port_id END AS port_id, MAX(i.tenant_id) AS tenant_id, MAX(i.mac_address) AS mac_address, SUM(i.binding_count) AS binding_count, SUM(i.port_security_enabled_total) AS port_security_enabled_total FROM inner_cte i GROUP BY i.port_id WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY port_id_sort ), active_networks_by_tenant AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM NETWORKS n JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND n.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(tenant_id) OVER (ORDER BY tenant_id_sort, tenant_id, network_name) = tenant_id THEN NULL ELSE tenant_id END AS tenant_id, network_id, network_name, admin_state_up, mtu, standard_attr_updated_at, window_column, total_networks FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE tenant_id END AS tenant_id_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE tenant_id END AS tenant_id, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE network_id END AS network_id, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE network_name END AS network_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE admin_state_up END AS admin_state_up, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE mtu END AS mtu, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE standard_attr_updated_at END AS standard_attr_updated_at, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE window_column END AS window_column, COUNT(*) AS total_networks FROM inner_cte GROUP BY tenant_id, network_id, network_name, admin_state_up, mtu, standard_attr_updated_at, window_column WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY tenant_id_sort, tenant_id, network_name ) SELECT (SELECT SUM(binding_count) FROM port_security_by_port WHERE port_id = 'TOTAL') AS total_port_security_bindings_for_admin_up_ports, (SELECT SUM(port_security_enabled_total) FROM port_security_by_port WHERE port_id = 'TOTAL') AS total_port_security_enabled_across_bindings, (SELECT MAX(total_networks) FROM active_networks_by_tenant WHERE tenant_id = 'TOTAL') AS total_active_networks_for_tenant FROM (SELECT 1 AS dummy) d;

question: For tenant ID '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7', return (1) the number of ports on host 'drive-59' whose running sum of standard attribute IDs within each VIF type group (ordered by standard attribute ID) is greater than the overall average running sum for those ports, and (2) the number of DOWN ports whose running sum of standard attribute IDs within each resource type group (ordered by standard attribute ID) is greater than 1000. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Tenant ID "17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')"
SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT b.PORT_ID, p.TENANT_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE b.HOST = 'drive-59' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')) SELECT i.PORT_ID, i.TENANT_ID, i.MAC_ADDRESS, b.VIF_TYPE, i.window_column, (SELECT AVG(window_column) FROM inner_cte) AS avg_window_column FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b ON i.PORT_ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE i.window_column > (SELECT AVG(window_column) FROM inner_cte) ), Subquery2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, SUM(sa.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY sa.RESOURCE_TYPE ORDER BY sa.ID) AS window_column FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')) SELECT port_id, tenant_id, mac_address, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > 1000 ) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s1.PORT_ID) AS Ports_On_drive_59_Above_Avg_VIF_RunningSum_Count, COUNT(DISTINCT s2.port_id) AS DOWN_Ports_Above_1000_ResourceType_RunningSum_Count FROM Subquery1 s1 CROSS JOIN Subquery2 s2;

question: For RBAC actions that (a) have more than 5 DHCP-enabled subnets per network after excluding shared networks (networks with an `access_as_shared` RBAC entry targeting `'*'` or `9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b`), and that also appear in the top 10 `access_as_shared` actions by subnet IP-version range (considering only IP versions 4 and 6), return the action name, the maximum per-network standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of subnet IP version, the average subnet IP version, the IP-version range, the variance of subnet IP version, and whether any referenced subnets have DHCP enabled. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "exclusion of shared networks" is predicated by "networks.id NOT IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))" "access_as_shared" permission is predicated by "networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.ACTION, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.ENABLE_DHCP = 1 AND s.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.ACTION HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY ip_version_stddev DESC) , inner_cte_2 AS ( SELECT n.ACTION AS rbac_action, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, MAX(s.IP_VERSION) - MIN(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_range, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION IN (4, 6) AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_range DESC ) SELECT q1.ACTION, q1.max_ip_version_stddev, q2.avg_ip_version, q2.ip_version_range, q2.ip_version_variance, q2.has_dhcp_enabled_subnets FROM (SELECT n.ACTION, MAX(inner_cte.ip_version_stddev) AS max_ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID JOIN inner_cte ON inner_cte.ACTION = n.ACTION WHERE s.ENABLE_DHCP = 1 AND s.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY max_ip_version_stddev DESC) q1 JOIN (SELECT i.rbac_action, i.avg_ip_version, i.ip_version_range, i.ip_version_variance, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.ENABLE_DHCP = 1 THEN s.ID END) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_dhcp_enabled_subnets FROM inner_cte_2 i JOIN NETWORKRBACS n ON n.ACTION = i.rbac_action JOIN SUBNETS s ON s.NETWORK_ID = n.OBJECT_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION IN (4, 6) AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY i.rbac_action, i.avg_ip_version, i.ip_version_range, i.ip_version_variance ORDER BY i.ip_version_range DESC LIMIT 10) q2 ON q1.ACTION = q2.rbac_action ORDER BY q1.max_ip_version_stddev DESC;

question: For the RBAC action access_as_shared, show the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of subnet IP version for referenced subnets restricted to IPv4 subnets, including how far each statistic deviates from the overall average of that statistic; also, for the same action limited to public access RBAC entries (where target_tenant = '*'), show the subnet IP-version variance, the overall average variance benchmark, and the variance category (HIGH_VARIANCE/LOW_VARIANCE/AVERAGE_VARIANCE). Do not return any rounded answers. Classify each action as 'HIGH_VARIANCE' (at least 50% above the average), 'LOW_VARIANCE' (at least 50% below the average), or 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE'.
evidence: "access_as_shared" permission is predicated by "networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared'" "public access" (wildcard) is predicated by "networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*'"
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_variance DESC ), overall_avgs AS ( SELECT AVG(avg_ip_version) AS overall_avg_ip_version, AVG(ip_version_variance) AS overall_avg_variance, AVG(ip_version_stddev) AS overall_avg_stddev FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.ACTION, i.avg_ip_version, i.ip_version_variance, i.ip_version_stddev, (i.avg_ip_version - o.overall_avg_ip_version) AS deviation_avg_ip_version, (i.ip_version_variance - o.overall_avg_variance) AS deviation_ip_version_variance, (i.ip_version_stddev - o.overall_avg_stddev) AS deviation_ip_version_stddev FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN overall_avgs o ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' AND n.TARGET_TENANT = '*' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_variance DESC ), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(ip_version_variance) AS avg_ip_version_variance FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.ACTION, i.ip_version_variance, a.avg_ip_version_variance AS benchmark, CASE WHEN i.ip_version_variance > a.avg_ip_version_variance * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN i.ip_version_variance < a.avg_ip_version_variance * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_cte a ) SELECT q1.ACTION, q1.avg_ip_version, q1.ip_version_variance AS ip_version_variance_ipv4_only, q1.ip_version_stddev, q1.deviation_avg_ip_version, q1.deviation_ip_version_variance, q1.deviation_ip_version_stddev, q2.ip_version_variance AS ip_version_variance_public_access, q2.benchmark AS variance_benchmark_across_actions, q2.variance_category FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.ACTION = q2.ACTION ORDER BY q2.ip_version_variance DESC;

question: For administratively up ports in tenant ID `98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57`, return each port’s ID, host, VIF type, VNIC type, tenant ID, network ID, MAC address, status, device owner, and the 2-preceding/2-following windowed average of standard attribute ID (partitioned by VIF type); also include, per VIF type, the total port count, the overall average port count benchmark and the HIGH_USER/LOW_USER/AVERAGE_USER category, and for the same port status show the variance of standard attribute ID, the number of distinct ports, and the deviation of that variance from the overall average variance among ports with IP allocation `10.150.64.113/8`. Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each VIF type as 'HIGH_USER' (at least 50% more than average), 'LOW_USER' (at least 50% less than average), or 'AVERAGE_USER'.
evidence: Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')" IP Address "10.150.64.113/8" is predicated by "ipallocations.ip_address IN ('10.150.64.113/8')"
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), VifTypeCounts AS ( SELECT VIF_TYPE, COUNT(*) AS total_ports FROM inner_cte GROUP BY VIF_TYPE ), AverageVifTypePorts AS ( SELECT AVG(total_ports) AS avg_ports FROM VifTypeCounts ) SELECT i.PORT_ID, i.HOST, i.VIF_TYPE, i.VNIC_TYPE, i.TENANT_ID, i.NETWORK_ID, i.MAC_ADDRESS, i.STATUS, i.DEVICE_OWNER, i.window_column, vtc.total_ports, avp.avg_ports AS benchmark, CASE WHEN vtc.total_ports > avp.avg_ports * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_USER' WHEN vtc.total_ports < avp.avg_ports * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_USER' ELSE 'AVERAGE_USER' END AS user_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN VifTypeCounts vtc ON i.VIF_TYPE = vtc.VIF_TYPE CROSS JOIN AverageVifTypePorts avp ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.STATUS, VARIANCE(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS standard_attr_id_variance FROM PORTS AS p JOIN IPALLOCATIONS AS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID IS NOT NULL AND ia.IP_ADDRESS IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.STATUS ORDER BY standard_attr_id_variance DESC ), StatusPortCounts AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS status, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS distinct_ports FROM PORTS AS p JOIN IPALLOCATIONS AS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID IS NOT NULL AND ia.IP_ADDRESS IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.STATUS ), AverageVariance AS ( SELECT AVG(standard_attr_id_variance) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.STATUS, i.standard_attr_id_variance, spc.distinct_ports, (i.standard_attr_id_variance - av.avg_variance) AS deviation_from_avg_variance FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN StatusPortCounts AS spc ON i.STATUS = spc.status CROSS JOIN AverageVariance AS av ORDER BY i.standard_attr_id_variance DESC ) SELECT q1.PORT_ID, q1.HOST, q1.VIF_TYPE, q1.VNIC_TYPE, q1.TENANT_ID, q1.NETWORK_ID, q1.MAC_ADDRESS, q1.STATUS, q1.DEVICE_OWNER, q1.window_column, q1.total_ports, q1.benchmark, q1.user_category, q2.standard_attr_id_variance, q2.distinct_ports, q2.deviation_from_avg_variance FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.STATUS = q2.STATUS;

question: For the top 10 device owners (status = 'DOWN') with the most distinct security-group-bound ports in tenant '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7', show the port status, device owner, distinct port count, minimum standard attribute ID, whether any ports have multiple security group bindings, and—using the same non-shared-network ports filtering based on standard attributes—also include the earliest standard attribute updated timestamp and the deviation of that (status, device owner) port count from the overall average across all such groups. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "exclusion of shared networks" is predicated by "networks.id NOT IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))" Tenant ID "17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')"
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(port_count) AS avg_port_count FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.port_status, i.device_owner, i.port_count, i.earliest_standard_attr_update, (i.port_count - a.avg_port_count) AS deviation_from_avg_port_count FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_cte a ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS min_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS spb ON p.ID = spb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ) SELECT i.port_status, i.device_owner, i.port_count, i.min_standard_attr_id, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT spb2.security_group_id) > COUNT(DISTINCT p2.id) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_multi_sg_bindings FROM inner_cte i JOIN ports p2 ON p2.status = i.port_status AND p2.device_owner = i.device_owner AND p2.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') JOIN securitygroupportbindings spb2 ON p2.id = spb2.port_id GROUP BY i.port_status, i.device_owner, i.port_count, i.min_standard_attr_id ORDER BY i.port_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT q2.port_status, q2.device_owner, q2.port_count AS distinct_port_count, q2.min_standard_attr_id, q2.has_multi_sg_bindings, q1.earliest_standard_attr_update, q1.deviation_from_avg_port_count FROM q2 JOIN q1 ON q1.port_status = q2.port_status AND q1.device_owner = q2.device_owner ORDER BY q2.port_count DESC;

question: For each port status, produce a combined report that (1) lists port counts by device owner and the earliest standard-attribute updated timestamp for ports whose standard attribute resource type is 'ports' while excluding networks shared via networkrbacs (action = 'access_as_shared' and target_tenant = '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'), including subtotals per status and a grand total with repeated statuses suppressed, and (2) shows port-security-binding statistics per status (range/variance/stddev of bindings per port, plus deviation from the average range) for ports that have at least one binding and belong to tenant '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7'. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "exclusion of shared networks" is predicated by "networks.id NOT IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))" Tenant ID "17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')"
SQL: WITH PortStatusOwnerRollup AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(port_status) OVER (ORDER BY port_status_sort, port_status, device_owner) = port_status THEN NULL ELSE port_status END AS port_status, device_owner, port_count, earliest_standard_attr_update FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.port_status) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.port_status END AS port_status_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.port_status) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.port_status END AS port_status, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.device_owner) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE i.device_owner END AS device_owner, SUM(i.port_count) AS port_count, MIN(i.earliest_standard_attr_update) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM inner_cte i GROUP BY i.port_status, i.device_owner WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY port_status_sort, port_status, device_owner ), PortStatusBindingStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.status, MAX(ps.binding_count) - MIN(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_range, VARIANCE(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_variance, STDDEV(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_stddev FROM ports AS p JOIN ( SELECT p2.id AS port_id, COUNT(*) AS binding_count FROM ports AS p2 JOIN portsecuritybindings AS b ON p2.id = b.port_id WHERE p2.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p2.id ) AS ps ON p.id = ps.port_id GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY binding_count_range DESC ), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(binding_count_range) AS avg_binding_count_range FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.status, i.binding_count_range, i.binding_count_variance, i.binding_count_stddev, (i.binding_count_range - a.avg_binding_count_range) AS deviation_from_avg_binding_count_range FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_cte a ORDER BY i.binding_count_range DESC ), CombinedStatusMetrics AS ( SELECT psor.port_status AS port_status, psor.device_owner AS device_owner, psor.port_count AS port_count, psor.earliest_standard_attr_update AS earliest_standard_attr_update, NULL AS binding_count_range, NULL AS binding_count_variance, NULL AS binding_count_stddev, NULL AS deviation_from_avg_binding_count_range, 'Port Count / Earliest Update (non-shared networks)' AS metric_type FROM PortStatusOwnerRollup psor UNION ALL SELECT psbs.status AS port_status, NULL AS device_owner, NULL AS port_count, NULL AS earliest_standard_attr_update, psbs.binding_count_range AS binding_count_range, psbs.binding_count_variance AS binding_count_variance, psbs.binding_count_stddev AS binding_count_stddev, psbs.deviation_from_avg_binding_count_range AS deviation_from_avg_binding_count_range, 'Port Security Binding Stats (tenant 17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7)' AS metric_type FROM PortStatusBindingStats psbs ) SELECT port_status, device_owner, port_count, earliest_standard_attr_update, binding_count_range, binding_count_variance, binding_count_stddev, deviation_from_avg_binding_count_range, metric_type FROM CombinedStatusMetrics ORDER BY port_status, metric_type, device_owner;

question: For the tenant ID '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7' and status 'DOWN', list the top 10 device owners (for ports bound to a security group) by distinct port count, showing the port status, device owner, distinct port count, minimum standard attribute ID, and whether any of those ports have more than one security group binding; also include, for the same (status, device owner) groups, the overall port count when filtering to standard attribute resource type = 'ports' and excluding shared networks via networkrbacs, along with the earliest standard attribute updated timestamp and the deviation of that overall port count from the average across all returned (status, device owner) groups. question: For tenant ID '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57', list ports that (a) are admin_state_up = 1 and have a security group binding count greater than the average among such admin-up, security-group-bound ports (including each port’s DNS record count), and (b) are also DOWN with their MAC address and the running sum of STANDARD_ATTR_ID within each security group (ordered by STANDARD_ATTR_ID); return the port ID, tenant ID, port name, security group binding count, DNS record count, MAC address, windowed running-sum value, the total number of DOWN ports for that tenant, and the average number of DOWN ports across all tenants. pd.port_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS dns_record_count FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS sgpb JOIN PORTS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id LEFT JOIN PORTDNSES pd ON p.id = pd.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.name ) SELECT port_id, tenant_id, port_name, security_group_binding_count, dns_record_count FROM inner_cte WHERE security_group_binding_count > (SELECT AVG(security_group_binding_count) FROM inner_cte) ), down_ports_window_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')) SELECT inner_cte.port_id, inner_cte.tenant_id, inner_cte.mac_address, inner_cte.window_column, tenant_counts.total_down_ports_for_tenant, avg_counts.avg_down_ports_across_tenants FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT p.tenant_id AS tenant_id, COUNT(p.id) AS total_down_ports_for_tenant FROM ports p WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' GROUP BY p.tenant_id) AS tenant_counts ON inner_cte.tenant_id = tenant_counts.tenant_id JOIN (SELECT AVG(port_count) AS avg_down_ports_across_tenants FROM (SELECT COUNT(p.id) AS port_count FROM ports p WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' GROUP BY p.tenant_id) AS sub) AS avg_counts ON 1 = 1 ) SELECT s.port_id, s.tenant_id, s.port_name, s.security_group_binding_count, s.dns_record_count, d.mac_address, d.window_column, d.total_down_ports_for_tenant, d.avg_down_ports_across_tenants FROM sg_admin_ports_above_avg s JOIN down_ports_window_stats d ON s.port_id = d.port_id AND s.tenant_id = d.tenant_id;

question: Among ports whose standard attribute resource type is 'ports' and that are not on shared networks (i.e., networks listed in networkrbacs with action = 'access_as_shared' and target_tenant = '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'), for which port statuses does the maximum number of ports owned by any single device owner exceed the total number of ACTIVE, non-shared networks, and what are that port status, the maximum ports for any device owner, and the count of ACTIVE non-shared networks? SQL: WITH PortStatusMaxByDeviceOwner AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER) SELECT port_status, MAX(port_count) AS max_ports_for_any_device_owner FROM inner_cte GROUP BY port_status ), ActiveNetworkRbacRollup AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.name, n.status, n.admin_state_up, r.action, r.target_tenant, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.id ORDER BY n.id) AS window_column FROM networksecuritybindings b JOIN networks n ON b.network_id = n.id JOIN networkrbacs r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND n.id NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') )) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(network_name) OVER (ORDER BY network_name_sort, network_name) = network_name THEN NULL ELSE network_name END AS network_name, status, admin_state_up, action, target_tenant, window_column, total_rbac_entries, avg_mtu FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.name END AS network_name_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.name END AS network_name, i.status, i.admin_state_up, i.action, i.target_tenant, i.window_column, COUNT(*) AS total_rbac_entries, AVG(n2.mtu) AS avg_mtu FROM inner_cte i JOIN networks n2 ON n2.name = i.name AND n2.status = i.status AND n2.admin_state_up = i.admin_state_up GROUP BY i.name, i.status, i.admin_state_up, i.action, i.target_tenant, i.window_column WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY network_name_sort, network_name ), ActiveNonSharedNetworkCount AS ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT n.id) AS active_nonshared_networks FROM networks n WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND n.id NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) ) SELECT ps.port_status, ps.max_ports_for_any_device_owner, anc.active_nonshared_networks FROM PortStatusMaxByDeviceOwner ps CROSS JOIN ActiveNonSharedNetworkCount anc WHERE ps.max_ports_for_any_device_owner > (anc.active_nonshared_networks * 1.0);

question: For the top 10 tenants with the most distinct DOWN ports on network ID `0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d`, return the tenant ID, total distinct ports, whether they have any security-group-bound ports, the count of DOWN ports on that network, and the number of qualifying DOWN ports for tenant `98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57` (ports whose standard attribute ID is above that tenant’s average), but only include tenants where more than 75% of their total ports are DOWN on that network. SQL: WITH TenantPortSummary AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.NAME, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER ( ORDER BY p.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.NETWORK_ID IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d')) SELECT p.tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_ports, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT inner_cte.security_group_id) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_security_groups FROM ports p LEFT JOIN inner_cte ON p.network_id = inner_cte.network_id AND p.mac_address = inner_cte.mac_address GROUP BY p.tenant_id ORDER BY total_ports DESC LIMIT 10 ), TenantDownPortWindowed AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), TenantAvg AS ( SELECT p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS avg_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.TENANT_ID ) SELECT i.port_id, i.tenant_id, i.mac_address, i.window_column FROM inner_cte i JOIN PORTS p2 ON p2.ID = i.port_id JOIN TenantAvg ta ON ta.tenant_id = i.tenant_id WHERE p2.STANDARD_ATTR_ID > ta.avg_standard_attr_id ), TenantDownPortCounts AS ( SELECT p.tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS down_ports_in_network FROM PORTS p WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' AND p.network_id IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d') GROUP BY p.tenant_id ) SELECT tps.tenant_id, tps.total_ports, tps.has_security_groups, tdc.down_ports_in_network, COUNT(DISTINCT tdpw.port_id) AS qualifying_down_ports_for_tenant_98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57 FROM TenantPortSummary tps JOIN TenantDownPortCounts tdc ON tps.tenant_id = tdc.tenant_id LEFT JOIN question: For tenant ID `98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57`, list all administratively up ports that have at least one IP allocation, and return (per port) the port ID, tenant ID, MAC address, IP allocation count, and a subnet-related count, along with either (a) the average IP-allocation count across all such ports or (b) that port’s deviation from the average—stacked together with a metric type indicating which value is shown. SQL: WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ia.subnet_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subnet_id_rows FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON ia.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND ia.ip_address IS NOT NULL AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address ) SELECT inner_cte.port_id, inner_cte.tenant_id, inner_cte.mac_address, inner_cte.ip_allocation_count, inner_cte.subnet_id_rows, avg_allocs.avg_ip_allocation_count FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(ip_allocation_count) AS avg_ip_allocation_count FROM inner_cte ) AS avg_allocs), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ia.subnet_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subnet_id_rows FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON ia.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND ia.ip_address IS NOT NULL AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address ), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(ip_allocation_count) AS avg_ip_allocation_count FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.port_id, i.tenant_id, i.mac_address, i.ip_allocation_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ia2.subnet_id) AS distinct_subnet_count, (i.ip_allocation_count - a.avg_ip_allocation_count) AS deviation_from_avg_ip_allocations FROM inner_cte i JOIN ports p2 ON p2.id = i.port_id JOIN ipallocations ia2 ON ia2.port_id = p2.id CROSS JOIN avg_cte a WHERE ia2.ip_address IS NOT NULL GROUP BY i.port_id, i.tenant_id, i.mac_address, i.ip_allocation_count, a.avg_ip_allocation_count), CombinedPortMetrics AS ( SELECT q1.port_id, q1.tenant_id, q1.mac_address, q1.ip_allocation_count, q1.subnet_id_rows AS subnet_metric, q1.avg_ip_allocation_count AS metric_value, 'Average IP Allocation Count' AS metric_type FROM q1 UNION ALL SELECT q2.port_id, q2.tenant_id, q2.mac_address, q2.ip_allocation_count, q2.distinct_subnet_count AS subnet_metric, q2.deviation_from_avg_ip_allocations AS metric_value, 'Deviation From Average IP Allocation Count' AS metric_type FROM q2 ) SELECT port_id, tenant_id, mac_address, ip_allocation_count, subnet_metric, metric_value, metric_type FROM CombinedPortMetrics ORDER BY tenant_id, port_id, metric_type;

SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ) SELECT inner_cte.port_status, inner_cte.device_owner, inner_cte.port_count, inner_cte.earliest_standard_attr_update, avg_groups.avg_port_count_across_groups FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(port_count) AS avg_port_count_across_groups FROM inner_cte ) AS avg_groups ON 1 = 1 ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(port_count) AS avg_port_count FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.port_status, i.device_owner, i.port_count, i.earliest_standard_attr_update, (i.port_count - a.avg_port_count) AS deviation_from_avg_port_count FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_cte a ) SELECT s1.port_status, s1.device_owner, s1.port_count, s1.earliest_standard_attr_update, s1.avg_port_count_across_groups, s2.deviation_from_avg_port_count FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.port_status = s2.port_status AND s1.device_owner = s2.device_owner ORDER BY s1.port_status, s1.device_owner;

question: For each ACTIVE network that is shared via an RBAC action of 'access_as_shared' and has a total subnet count more than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the overall mean subnet count for such ACTIVE shared networks, list the network ID, its total subnets, the overall average subnet count, the maximum dense-rank value for that same network ID from the ACTIVE non-shared network RBAC dense-rank analysis, and the ratio of total subnets to the overall average (rounded to 2 decimals).

r.object_id = s.network_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND r.action = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.id HAVING SUM(1) > ( SELECT AVG(subnet_cnt) + STDDEV(subnet_cnt) FROM ( SELECT n2.id AS network_id, 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n2.id ) AS per_network )) SELECT inner_cte.network_id, inner_cte.total_subnets, stats.avg_subnet_count FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(subnet_cnt) AS avg_subnet_count FROM ( SELECT n2.id AS network_id, SUM(1) AS subnet_cnt FROM NETWORKS AS n2 JOIN NETWORKRBACS AS r2 ON n2.id = r2.object_id JOIN SUBNETS AS s2 ON r2.object_id = s2.network_id WHERE n2.status = 'ACTIVE' AND r2.action = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n2.id ) AS per_network ) AS stats ON 1 = 1), active_nonshared_dense_rank_max AS (WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT n.name, n.status, n.admin_state_up, r.action, r.target_tenant, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.id ORDER BY n.id) AS window_column FROM networksecuritybindings b JOIN networks n ON b.network_id = n.id JOIN networkrbacs r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND n.id NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) ) SELECT n.id AS network_id, MAX(inner_cte.window_column) AS max_dense_rank FROM inner_cte JOIN networks n ON n.name = inner_cte.name AND n.status = inner_cte.status AND n.admin_state_up = inner_cte.admin_state_up GROUP BY n.id) SELECT saso.network_id, saso.total_subnets, saso.avg_subnet_count, anrd.max_dense_rank, ROUND(saso.total_subnets / NULLIF(saso.avg_subnet_count, 0), 2) AS subnet_count_to_avg_ratio FROM shared_active_subnet_outliers saso LEFT JOIN active_nonshared_dense_rank_max anrd ON anrd.network_id = SQL: WITH Top10PortStatuses AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.STATUS, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) AS min_admin_state_up, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS avg_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS b ON p.ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE b.VIF_TYPE = 'ovs' AND p.DEVICE_ID IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS ) SELECT i.status, COUNT(DISTINCT p2.id) AS total_ports, i.min_admin_state_up, i.avg_standard_attr_id FROM inner_cte i JOIN ports p2 ON p2.status = i.status JOIN ml2_port_bindings b2 ON p2.id = b2.port_id WHERE b2.vif_type = 'ovs' AND p2.device_id IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7') GROUP BY i.status, i.min_admin_state_up, i.avg_standard_attr_id ORDER BY total_ports DESC LIMIT 10 ), StatusRollup AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.STATUS, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) AS min_admin_state_up, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS avg_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS b ON p.ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE b.VIF_TYPE = 'ovs' AND p.DEVICE_ID IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(status) OVER (ORDER BY status_sort, status) = status THEN NULL ELSE status END AS status, min_admin_state_up, avg_standard_attr_id FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(status) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE status END AS status_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(status) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE status END AS status, MIN(min_admin_state_up) AS min_admin_state_up, AVG(avg_standard_attr_id) AS avg_standard_attr_id FROM inner_cte GROUP BY status WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY status_sort, status ) SELECT sr.status, t10.total_ports, sr.min_admin_state_up, sr.avg_standard_attr_id FROM StatusRollup sr LEFT JOIN Top10PortStatuses t10 ON t10.status = sr.status WHERE sr.status IN (SELECT status FROM Top10PortStatuses) OR sr.status = 'TOTAL' ORDER BY CASE WHEN sr.status = 'TOTAL' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END, sr.status;

ON pr.port_id = p.id AND pr.tenant_id = an.tenant_id ORDER BY an.total_active_networks DESC, an.network_name, pr.security_group_id, pr.port_id;

question: For subnets whose networks are shared via RBAC action `access_as_shared` to target tenant `1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b`, group results by RBAC target tenant, IP version, and the IP-version subnet usage category (HIGH/LOW/AVERAGE). For each group, return how many matching subnet rows there are, the average coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of DNS nameserver order values (from the IPv4 subnet DNS-order variability rollup results, matched by subnet name), and the average running-sum of subnet standard attribute IDs. Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each IP version as 'HIGH_SUBNET_USAGE' (at least 50% more than average), 'LOW_SUBNET_USAGE' (at least 50% less than average), or 'AVERAGE_SUBNET_USAGE'.
evidence: "exclusion of shared networks" is predicated by "networks.id NOT IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))" Target Tenant ID "1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b" is predicated by "networkrbacs.target_tenant IN ('1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b')"
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, STDDEV(d.order) / NULLIF(AVG(d.order), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM subnets AS s JOIN dnsnameservers AS d ON d.subnet_id = s.id JOIN ipallocationpools AS p ON p.subnet_id = s.id JOIN networks AS n ON n.id = s.network_id WHERE s.ip_version = 4 AND n.id NOT IN ( SELECT r.object_id FROM networkrbacs AS r WHERE r.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (r.target_tenant = '*' OR r.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY s.name HAVING AVG(d.order) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC), SubnetSharedStatus AS ( SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, CASE WHEN r.object_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'Shared' ELSE 'Not Shared' END AS shared_status, i.coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte i JOIN subnets s ON s.name = i.subnet_name JOIN networks n ON n.id = s.network_id LEFT JOIN networkrbacs r ON r.object_id = n.id AND r.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (r.target_tenant = '*' OR r.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(shared_status) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE shared_status END AS shared_status, CASE WHEN GROUPING(subnet_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(shared_status) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(subnet_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(shared_status) = 1 THEN 'ALL SUBNETS' ELSE subnet_name END AS subnet_name, AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM SubnetSharedStatus GROUP BY shared_status, subnet_name WITH ROLLUP ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, s.CIDR AS subnet_cidr, n.TARGET_TENANT AS rbac_target_tenant, SUM(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY s.IP_VERSION ORDER BY s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN NETWORKRBACS AS n ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' AND n.TARGET_TENANT IN ('1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b')), IpVersionCounts AS (SELECT s.IP_VERSION, COUNT(*) AS total_subnets FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN NETWORKRBACS AS n ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' AND n.TARGET_TENANT IN ('1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b') GROUP BY s.IP_VERSION), AverageSubnets AS (SELECT AVG(total_subnets) AS avg_subnets FROM IpVersionCounts) SELECT i.subnet_name, i.subnet_cidr, i.rbac_target_tenant, i.window_column, c.IP_VERSION, c.total_subnets, a.avg_subnets AS benchmark, CASE WHEN c.total_subnets > a.avg_subnets * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_SUBNET_USAGE' WHEN c.total_subnets < a.avg_subnets * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_SUBNET_USAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_SUBNET_USAGE' END AS usage_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN SUBNETS s2 ON s2.NAME = i.subnet_name AND s2.CIDR = i.subnet_cidr JOIN IpVersionCounts c ON c.IP_VERSION = s2.IP_VERSION CROSS JOIN AverageSubnets a ) SELECT q2.rbac_target_tenant, q2.IP_VERSION, q2.usage_category, COUNT(*) AS matched_subnet_rows, AVG(q1.avg_coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_dns_order_coefficient_of_variation, AVG(q2.window_column) AS avg_running_sum_standard_attr_id FROM q2 JOIN q1 ON q1.subnet_name = q2.subnet_name WHERE q2.rbac_target_tenant IN ('1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b') GROUP BY q2.rbac_target_tenant, q2.IP_VERSION, q2.usage_category ORDER BY avg_dns_order_coefficient_of_variation DESC;

question: For default external networks (IS_DEFAULT = 0), identify the top 10 tenants by how many of their networks have an RBAC action of 'access_as_external', and for each of those tenants show: the tenant ID, the total number of qualifying networks, whether any of those networks have a targeted RBAC entry (TARGET_TENANT is not '*'), and a breakdown of how many default external networks they have in each network status after excluding networks shared via RBAC (action = 'access_as_shared' with TARGET_TENANT = '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'). Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "access_as_external" permission is predicated by "networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_external'" "exclusion of shared networks" is predicated by "networks.id NOT IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))"
SQL: WITH TopTenantsExternalAccess AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT n.NAME, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY r.ACTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM EXTERNALNETWORKS e JOIN NETWORKS n ON e.NETWORK_ID = n.ID JOIN NETWORKRBACS r ON n.ID = r.OBJECT_ID WHERE e.IS_DEFAULT = 0 AND r.ACTION = 'access_as_external' ) SELECT n.tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id) AS total_qualifying_networks, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.target_tenant <> '*' THEN r.id END) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_targeted_rbac FROM inner_cte i JOIN networks n ON n.name = i.name JOIN externalnetworks e ON e.network_id = n.id JOIN networkrbacs r ON r.object_id = n.id WHERE e.is_default = 0 AND r.action = 'access_as_external' GROUP BY n.tenant_id ORDER BY total_qualifying_networks DESC LIMIT 10 ), TenantStatusRollup AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT e.NETWORK_ID, e.IS_DEFAULT, n.TENANT_ID, n.NAME, n.STATUS, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP, n.MTU, n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID, MIN(n.MTU) OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.TENANT_ID) AS window_column FROM EXTERNALNETWORKS e JOIN NETWORKS n ON e.NETWORK_ID = n.ID WHERE e.IS_DEFAULT = 0 AND n.ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) ), TenantStatusCounts AS ( SELECT i.tenant_id, i.status, COUNT(DISTINCT i.network_id) AS total_networks FROM inner_cte i GROUP BY i.tenant_id, i.status ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE tenant_id END AS tenant_id, CASE WHEN GROUPING(status) = 1 AND GROUPING(tenant_id) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE status END AS status, SUM(total_networks) AS total_networks FROM TenantStatusCounts GROUP BY tenant_id, status WITH ROLLUP ) SELECT t.tenant_id, t.total_qualifying_networks, t.has_targeted_rbac, r.status, r.total_networks FROM TopTenantsExternalAccess t JOIN TenantStatusRollup r ON r.tenant_id = t.tenant_id WHERE r.status <> 'SUBTOTAL' AND r.tenant_id <> 'GRAND TOTAL' ORDER BY t.total_qualifying_networks DESC, r.status;

question: For subnets whose network RBAC action is 'access_as_shared' and whose RBAC target tenant is public ('*'), show (1) the rollup results per subnet name and gateway IP (including subtotals and a grand total) with the maximum IP version (only where that maximum IP version is greater than 3), and (2) the corresponding detail rows where the subnet name is suppressed when it repeats in the ordered list. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "public access" (wildcard) is predicated by "networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*'"
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.name, MAX(s.ip_version) AS max_ip_version, s.gateway_ip FROM NETWORKRBACS n JOIN SUBNETS s ON n.object_id = s.network_id WHERE n.action = 'access_as_shared' AND n.target_tenant = '*' GROUP BY s.name, s.gateway_ip HAVING MAX(s.ip_version) > 3 ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(name) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE name END AS name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(gateway_ip) = 1 AND GROUPING(name) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(gateway_ip) = 1 AND GROUPING(name) = 1 THEN 'ALL' ELSE gateway_ip END AS gateway_ip, MAX(max_ip_version) AS max_ip_version, COUNT(*) AS total_groups FROM inner_cte GROUP BY name, gateway_ip WITH ROLLUP ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.name, MAX(s.ip_version) AS max_ip_version, s.gateway_ip FROM NETWORKRBACS n JOIN SUBNETS s ON n.object_id = s.network_id WHERE n.action = 'access_as_shared' AND n.target_tenant = '*' GROUP BY s.name, s.gateway_ip HAVING MAX(s.ip_version) > 3 ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(name) OVER (ORDER BY name, gateway_ip) = name THEN NULL ELSE name END AS name, max_ip_version, gateway_ip FROM inner_cte ORDER BY name, gateway_ip ) SELECT q1.name, q1.gateway_ip, q1.max_ip_version, q1.total_groups, q2.name AS non_repeated_name, q2.max_ip_version AS detail_max_ip_version, q2.gateway_ip AS detail_gateway_ip FROM q1 LEFT JOIN q2 ON q1.name = q2.name AND q1.gateway_ip = q2.gateway_ip ORDER BY q1.name, q1.gateway_ip;

question: For tenant ID '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57', for each ACTIVE network, list the network details (network ID, name, admin_state_up, MTU, standard attribute updated_at, row number by network name within the tenant, and MTU deviation from the tenant’s average), along with each associated port that is admin_state_up = 1 and bound to a security group, including the port ID and name, the port’s security-group binding count, its total DNS record count, the average DNS record count benchmark across these ports, and whether the port is categorized as HIGH_DNS, LOW_DNS, or AVERAGE_DNS. Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each port as 'HIGH_DNS' (at least 50% more than average), 'LOW_DNS' (at least 50% less than average), or 'AVERAGE_DNS'.
evidence: Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')" Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "networks.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')"
SQL: WITH port_dns_security AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.name AS port_name, COUNT(sgpb.security_group_id) AS security_group_binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pd.port_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS dns_record_count FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS sgpb JOIN PORTS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id LEFT JOIN PORTDNSES pd ON p.id = pd.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.name ), AverageDns AS ( SELECT AVG(dns_record_count) AS avg_dns_records FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.port_id, ic.tenant_id, ic.port_name, ic.security_group_binding_count, ic.dns_record_count, ad.avg_dns_records AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.dns_record_count > ad.avg_dns_records * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_DNS' WHEN ic.dns_record_count < ad.avg_dns_records * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_DNS' ELSE 'AVERAGE_DNS' END AS dns_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AverageDns ad ), active_network_mtu AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM NETWORKS n JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND n.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), avg_mtu_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(mtu) AS avg_mtu FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.network_id, i.network_name, i.tenant_id, i.admin_state_up, i.mtu, i.standard_attr_updated_at, i.window_column, (i.mtu - a.avg_mtu) AS deviation_from_avg_mtu FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_mtu_cte a ), port_network_bridge AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.network_id FROM PORTS p WHERE p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ) SELECT anm.network_id, anm.network_name, anm.tenant_id, anm.admin_state_up AS network_admin_state_up, anm.mtu, anm.standard_attr_updated_at, anm.window_column, anm.deviation_from_avg_mtu, pds.port_id, pds.port_name, pds.security_group_binding_count, pds.dns_record_count, pds.benchmark AS avg_dns_records_benchmark, pds.dns_category FROM active_network_mtu anm JOIN port_network_bridge pnb ON pnb.network_id = anm.network_id JOIN port_dns_security pds ON pds.port_id = pnb.port_id WHERE anm.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57');

question: For ports with status = 'DOWN' that belong to tenant ID '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57', show each port’s ID, tenant ID, MAC address, and security group ID, along with (1) the port’s rank within its security group by port ID, (2) the total number of such DOWN ports in that security group, (3) the average of those totals across security groups as a benchmark, (4) a category per security group (HIGH_USER/LOW_USER/AVERAGE_USER) based on that benchmark, and also (5) the running sum of the port’s standard attribute ID within its security group (ordered by standard attribute ID) plus (6) the deviation of the port’s standard attribute ID from the overall average standard attribute ID across these DOWN ports. Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each security group as 'HIGH_USER' (at least 50% more than average), 'LOW_USER' (at least 50% less than average), or 'AVERAGE_USER'.
evidence: Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')"
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, sgpb.security_group_id, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sgpb.security_group_id ORDER BY p.id) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), SecurityGroupPorts AS ( SELECT security_group_id, COUNT(port_id) AS total_ports FROM inner_cte GROUP BY security_group_id ), AveragePorts AS ( SELECT AVG(total_ports) AS avg_ports FROM SecurityGroupPorts ) SELECT i.port_id, i.tenant_id, i.mac_address, i.security_group_id, i.window_column AS port_rank_within_security_group, sgp.total_ports AS total_down_ports_in_security_group, ap.avg_ports AS benchmark, CASE WHEN sgp.total_ports > ap.avg_ports * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_USER' WHEN sgp.total_ports < ap.avg_ports * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_USER' ELSE 'AVERAGE_USER' END AS user_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN SecurityGroupPorts sgp ON i.security_group_id = sgp.security_group_id CROSS JOIN AveragePorts ap ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), AverageStdAttr AS (SELECT AVG(p2.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS avg_standard_attr_id FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS sgpb2 JOIN PORTS p2 ON sgpb2.PORT_ID = p2.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS psb2 ON p2.ID = psb2.PORT_ID WHERE p2.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p2.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')) SELECT i.port_id, i.tenant_id, i.mac_address, i.window_column, (p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID - a.avg_standard_attr_id) AS deviation_from_avg_standard_attr_id FROM inner_cte i JOIN PORTS p ON p.ID = i.port_id CROSS JOIN AverageStdAttr a ) SELECT q1.port_id, q1.tenant_id, q1.mac_address, q1.security_group_id, q1.port_rank_within_security_group, q1.total_down_ports_in_security_group, q1.benchmark AS avg_down_ports_benchmark_across_security_groups, q1.user_category, q2.window_column AS running_sum_standard_attr_id_within_security_group, q2.deviation_from_avg_standard_attr_id FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.port_id = q2.port_id AND q1.tenant_id = q2.tenant_id AND q1.mac_address = q2.mac_address;

question: Return a combined rollup report that (1) lists administratively up ports for tenant `17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7` with port ID, tenant ID, MAC address, the number of port security bindings, and the total count of enabled port security across those bindings (including tenant subtotals and a grand total), and (2) alongside that, shows the rollup summary for ACTIVE networks owned by tenant `98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57` grouped by `admin_state_up` with the number of networks and the maximum standard-attribute `updated_at` timestamp (including subtotals and a grand total). Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Tenant ID "17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')" Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "networks.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')"
SQL: WITH port_security_rollup AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(psb.port_id) AS binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN psb.port_security_enabled THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS port_security_enabled_total FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE tenant_id END AS tenant_id, CASE WHEN GROUPING(port_id) = 1 AND GROUPING(tenant_id) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE port_id END AS port_id, CASE WHEN GROUPING(port_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE mac_address END AS mac_address, SUM(binding_count) AS binding_count, SUM(port_security_enabled_total) AS port_security_enabled_total FROM inner_cte GROUP BY tenant_id, port_id, mac_address WITH ROLLUP ), active_networks_rollup AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM NETWORKS n JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND n.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(admin_state_up) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE CAST(admin_state_up AS CHAR) END AS admin_state_up, COUNT(DISTINCT network_id) AS total_networks, MAX(standard_attr_updated_at) AS max_standard_attr_updated_at FROM inner_cte GROUP BY admin_state_up WITH ROLLUP ) SELECT psr.tenant_id, psr.port_id, psr.mac_address, psr.binding_count, psr.port_security_enabled_total, anr.admin_state_up AS networks_admin_state_up, anr.total_networks, anr.max_standard_attr_updated_at FROM port_security_rollup psr CROSS JOIN active_networks_rollup anr ORDER BY psr.tenant_id, psr.port_id, anr.admin_state_up;

question: For subnets on networks shared via the RBAC action `access_as_shared` with target tenant `1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b`, list each subnet’s name and CIDR, the RBAC target tenant, the running sum of subnet standard attribute IDs within each IP version group (ordered by standard attribute ID), the deviation of each subnet’s standard attribute ID from the overall average standard attribute ID across these shared subnets, and (for those same subnets) the DNS nameserver-order coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) for IPv4 subnets that is above the overall average—along with a normalized coefficient-of-variation ratio (subnet CV divided by the average CV across the returned subnets).
evidence: Target Tenant ID "1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b" is predicated by "networkrbacs.target_tenant IN ('1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b')" "exclusion of shared networks" is predicated by "networks.id NOT IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))"
SQL: WITH SubnetRbacStdAttr AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, s.CIDR AS subnet_cidr, n.TARGET_TENANT AS rbac_target_tenant, SUM(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY s.IP_VERSION ORDER BY s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN NETWORKRBACS AS n ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' AND n.TARGET_TENANT IN ('1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b')), AvgStdAttr AS (SELECT AVG(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS avg_standard_attr_id FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN NETWORKRBACS AS n ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' AND n.TARGET_TENANT IN ('1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b')) SELECT i.subnet_name, i.subnet_cidr, i.rbac_target_tenant, i.window_column, (s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID - a.avg_standard_attr_id) AS deviation_from_avg_standard_attr_id FROM inner_cte i JOIN SUBNETS s ON s.NAME = i.subnet_name AND s.CIDR = i.subnet_cidr CROSS JOIN AvgStdAttr a ), SubnetDnsCv AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, STDDEV(d.order) / NULLIF(AVG(d.order), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM subnets AS s JOIN dnsnameservers AS d ON d.subnet_id = s.id JOIN ipallocationpools AS p ON p.subnet_id = s.id JOIN networks AS n ON n.id = s.network_id WHERE s.ip_version = 4 AND n.id NOT IN ( SELECT r.object_id FROM networkrbacs AS r WHERE r.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (r.target_tenant = '*' OR r.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY s.name HAVING AVG(d.order) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT i.subnet_name, i.coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN subnets AS s ON s.name = i.subnet_name WHERE i.coefficient_of_variation > ( SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) FROM inner_cte ) ORDER BY i.coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT s1.subnet_name, s1.subnet_cidr, s1.rbac_target_tenant, s1.window_column, s1.deviation_from_avg_standard_attr_id, s2.coefficient_of_variation, ROUND(s2.coefficient_of_variation / NULLIF(AVG(s2.coefficient_of_variation) OVER (), 0), 4) AS normalized_coefficient_of_variation_ratio FROM SubnetRbacStdAttr AS s1 JOIN SubnetDnsCv AS s2 ON s2.subnet_name = s1.subnet_name WHERE s1.rbac_target_tenant IN ('1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b') ORDER BY normalized_coefficient_of_variation_ratio DESC, s2.coefficient_of_variation DESC;

question: For each tenant (excluding the subtotal and grand total rollup rows) and each network status, among non-shared networks that are marked as default external networks (excluding networks whose IDs appear in networkrbacs with action = 'access_as_shared' and target_tenant = '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'), list the tenant ID, network status, and the count of such networks; also compute the tenant’s total port count under the same non-shared network filter and show the derived ports-per-default-external-network ratio. Alongside this, include the overall port volume benchmark analysis by (port status, device owner)—port count, benchmark average, volume category, and earliest standard attribute updated timestamp—using the same non-shared network filtering rules. Categorize each group as 'HIGH_VOLUME' (at least 50% above average), 'LOW_VOLUME' (at least 50% below average), or 'AVERAGE_VOLUME'.
evidence: "exclusion of shared networks" is predicated by "networks.id NOT IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))"
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT e.NETWORK_ID, e.IS_DEFAULT, n.TENANT_ID, n.NAME, n.STATUS, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP, n.MTU, n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID, MIN(n.MTU) OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.TENANT_ID) AS window_column FROM EXTERNALNETWORKS e JOIN NETWORKS n ON e.NETWORK_ID = n.ID WHERE e.IS_DEFAULT = 0 AND n.ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) ), TenantStatusCounts AS ( SELECT i.tenant_id, i.status, COUNT(DISTINCT i.network_id) AS total_networks FROM inner_cte i GROUP BY i.tenant_id, i.status ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE tenant_id END AS tenant_id, CASE WHEN GROUPING(status) = 1 AND GROUPING(tenant_id) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE status END AS status, SUM(total_networks) AS total_networks FROM TenantStatusCounts GROUP BY tenant_id, status WITH ROLLUP ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(port_count) AS avg_port_count FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.port_status, i.device_owner, i.port_count, i.earliest_standard_attr_update, a.avg_port_count AS benchmark, CASE WHEN i.port_count > a.avg_port_count * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VOLUME' WHEN i.port_count < a.avg_port_count * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VOLUME' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VOLUME' END AS volume_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_cte a ), TenantPortCounts AS ( SELECT p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, COUNT(p.ID) AS tenant_port_count FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.TENANT_ID ) SELECT q1.tenant_id, q1.status AS network_status, q1.total_networks, tpc.tenant_port_count, ROUND(tpc.tenant_port_count / NULLIF(q1.total_networks, 0), 2) AS ports_per_default_external_network, q2.port_status, q2.device_owner, q2.port_count, q2.benchmark, q2.volume_category, q2.earliest_standard_attr_update FROM q1 JOIN TenantPortCounts tpc ON tpc.tenant_id = q1.tenant_id CROSS JOIN q2 WHERE q1.tenant_id NOT IN ('GRAND TOTAL', 'SUBTOTAL') ORDER BY ports_per_default_external_network DESC, q1.tenant_id, q1.status, q2.port_count DESC;

question: For each tenant and network status (excluding shared networks whose IDs appear in networkrbacs with action = 'access_as_shared' and target_tenant = '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') among networks marked as default external networks, list the tenant ID, the network status, the number of such networks, and—restricted to statuses that are in the top 10 by distinct non-shared networks with at least one security binding—the total number of networks with a security binding plus the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED for that status. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "exclusion of shared networks" is predicated by "networks.id NOT IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))"
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT n.STATUS AS network_status, VARIANCE(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_variance, STDDEV(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_stddev FROM NETWORKS AS n JOIN NETWORKSECURITYBINDINGS AS nsb ON n.ID = nsb.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.STATUS ORDER BY port_security_enabled_variance DESC ) SELECT n.STATUS AS network_status, COUNT(DISTINCT n.ID) AS total_networks_with_security_binding, inner_cte.port_security_enabled_variance, inner_cte.port_security_enabled_stddev FROM NETWORKS AS n JOIN NETWORKSECURITYBINDINGS AS nsb ON n.ID = nsb.NETWORK_ID JOIN inner_cte ON n.STATUS = inner_cte.network_status WHERE n.ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.STATUS, inner_cte.port_security_enabled_variance, inner_cte.port_security_enabled_stddev ORDER BY total_networks_with_security_binding DESC LIMIT 10 ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT e.NETWORK_ID, e.IS_DEFAULT, n.TENANT_ID, n.NAME, n.STATUS, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP, n.MTU, n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID, MIN(n.MTU) OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.TENANT_ID) AS window_column FROM EXTERNALNETWORKS e JOIN NETWORKS n ON e.NETWORK_ID = n.ID WHERE e.IS_DEFAULT = 0 AND n.ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) ), TenantStatusCounts AS ( SELECT i.tenant_id, i.status, COUNT(DISTINCT i.network_id) AS total_networks FROM inner_cte i GROUP BY i.tenant_id, i.status ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE tenant_id END AS tenant_id, CASE WHEN GROUPING(status) = 1 AND GROUPING(tenant_id) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE status END AS status, SUM(total_networks) AS total_networks FROM TenantStatusCounts GROUP BY tenant_id, status WITH ROLLUP ) SELECT q2.tenant_id, q2.status, q2.total_networks AS total_default_external_networks, q1.total_networks_with_security_binding, q1.port_security_enabled_variance, q1.port_security_enabled_stddev FROM q2 JOIN q1 ON q2.status = q1.network_status WHERE q2.tenant_id NOT IN ('GRAND TOTAL') AND q2.status NOT IN ('SUBTOTAL') AND q1.total_networks_with_security_binding > 0 ORDER BY q2.total_networks DESC, q2.tenant_id, q2.status;

question: For tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57", for each administratively-up port (with its binding details) that belongs to an ACTIVE network in the same tenant, list the network details (network ID, name, admin_state_up, MTU, standard attribute updated_at, the row number within the tenant ordered by network name, and the deviation of the network MTU from the average MTU across these networks) together with the port details (port ID, host, VIF type, VNIC type, MAC address, status, device owner, the windowed average standard attribute ID, the total ports in that VIF type, and the deviation of the port’s windowed average from the overall windowed average). Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "networks.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')" Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')"
SQL: WITH networks_subq AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM NETWORKS n JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND n.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), avg_mtu_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(mtu) AS avg_mtu FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.network_id, i.network_name, i.tenant_id, i.admin_state_up, i.mtu, i.standard_attr_updated_at, i.window_column, (i.mtu - a.avg_mtu) AS deviation_from_avg_mtu FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_mtu_cte a ), ports_subq AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), VifTypeCounts AS ( SELECT VIF_TYPE, COUNT(*) AS ports_in_vif_type FROM inner_cte GROUP BY VIF_TYPE ), OverallWindowAvg AS ( SELECT AVG(window_column) AS overall_avg_window_column FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.PORT_ID, i.HOST, i.VIF_TYPE, i.VNIC_TYPE, i.TENANT_ID, i.NETWORK_ID, i.MAC_ADDRESS, i.STATUS, i.DEVICE_OWNER, i.window_column, vtc.ports_in_vif_type, (i.window_column - owa.overall_avg_window_column) AS deviation_from_overall_window_avg FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN VifTypeCounts AS vtc ON i.VIF_TYPE = vtc.VIF_TYPE CROSS JOIN OverallWindowAvg AS owa ) SELECT n.network_id, n.network_name, n.tenant_id, n.admin_state_up AS network_admin_state_up, n.mtu, n.standard_attr_updated_at, n.window_column AS network_row_number_within_tenant_by_name, n.deviation_from_avg_mtu, p.PORT_ID, p.HOST, p.VIF_TYPE, p.VNIC_TYPE, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER, p.window_column AS port_windowed_avg_standard_attr_id, p.ports_in_vif_type, p.deviation_from_overall_window_avg FROM networks_subq n JOIN ports_subq p ON p.NETWORK_ID = n.network_id AND p.TENANT_ID = n.tenant_id;

question: From the top 10 RBAC actions with action = 'access_as_shared' (based on highest subnet IP-version variance across referenced subnets, considering IPv4 subnets), show each action’s average subnet IP version, variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), whether any referenced subnets have DHCP enabled, and—using only public RBAC entries where target_tenant = '*'—the overall average variance benchmark across actions and the variance category (HIGH_VARIANCE/LOW_VARIANCE/AVERAGE_VARIANCE). Do not return any rounded answers. Classify each action as 'HIGH_VARIANCE' (at least 50% above the average), 'LOW_VARIANCE' (at least 50% below the average), or 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE'.
evidence: "access_as_shared" permission is predicated by "networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared'" "public access" (wildcard) is predicated by "networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*'"
SQL: WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.ACTION, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_variance DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACTION, inner_cte.avg_ip_version, inner_cte.ip_version_variance, inner_cte.ip_version_stddev, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.ENABLE_DHCP = 1 THEN s.ID END) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_dhcp_enabled_subnets FROM inner_cte JOIN NETWORKRBACS AS n ON n.ACTION = inner_cte.ACTION JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON s.NETWORK_ID = n.OBJECT_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY inner_cte.ACTION, inner_cte.avg_ip_version, inner_cte.ip_version_variance, inner_cte.ip_version_stddev ORDER BY inner_cte.ip_version_variance DESC LIMIT 10), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' AND n.TARGET_TENANT = '*' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_variance DESC ), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(ip_version_variance) AS avg_ip_version_variance FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.ACTION, i.ip_version_variance, a.avg_ip_version_variance AS benchmark, CASE WHEN i.ip_version_variance > a.avg_ip_version_variance * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN i.ip_version_variance < a.avg_ip_version_variance * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_cte a) SELECT q1.ACTION, q1.avg_ip_version, q1.ip_version_variance AS top10_ip_version_variance, q1.ip_version_stddev, q1.has_dhcp_enabled_subnets, q2.benchmark AS avg_variance_benchmark_across_actions, q2.variance_category FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q2.ACTION = q1.ACTION ORDER BY q1.ip_version_variance DESC;

question: For subnet ID '012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48' (IPv4 only), list the top 10 subnets by number of distinct subnet routes, showing each subnet’s name and CIDR, total distinct routes, whether it has any IP allocation pools, and (for the same subnet name) the tenant-level average route-count range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of routes per subnet as computed per next hop. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Subnet ID "012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48" is predicated by "subnets.id IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48')"
SQL: WITH subnet_route_dispersion AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, MAX(route_count) - MIN(route_count) AS route_count_range, VARIANCE(route_count) AS route_count_variance, STDDEV(route_count) AS route_count_stddev FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN ( SELECT sr.SUBNET_ID, COUNT(*) AS route_count FROM SUBNETROUTES AS sr GROUP BY sr.SUBNET_ID, sr.NEXTHOP ) AS route_stats ON s.ID =
