SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.ACTION, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.ENABLE_DHCP = 1 AND s.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.ACTION HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY ip_version_stddev DESC) SELECT n.ACTION, MAX(inner_cte.ip_version_stddev) AS max_ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID JOIN inner_cte ON inner_cte.ACTION = n.ACTION WHERE s.ENABLE_DHCP = 1 AND s.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY max_ip_version_stddev DESC;

question: For each network name and RBAC action, show the maximum MTU among ACTIVE networks that have an RBAC entry (only actions 'access_as_shared' or 'access_as_external') and keep only groups where that maximum MTU is greater than 8000. Do not repeat the network name if it is the same as the previous row, and include a final TOTAL row across all networks. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "access_as_shared" permission is predicated by "networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared'" "access_as_external" permission is predicated by "networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_external'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT n.name AS network_name, r.action AS rbac_action, MAX(n.mtu) AS max_mtu FROM NETWORKSECURITYBINDINGS nsb JOIN NETWORKS n ON nsb.network_id = n.id JOIN NETWORKRBACS r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND r.action IN ('access_as_shared', 'access_as_external') GROUP BY n.name, r.action HAVING MAX(n.mtu) > 8000 ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(network_name) OVER (ORDER BY network_name_sort, network_name, rbac_action) = network_name THEN NULL ELSE network_name END AS network_name, rbac_action, max_mtu FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.network_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.network_name END AS network_name_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.network_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.network_name END AS network_name, i.rbac_action, MAX(i.max_mtu) AS max_mtu FROM inner_cte i GROUP BY i.network_name, i.rbac_action WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY network_name_sort, network_name, rbac_action;

question: For load balancers provided by “haproxy”, compute the maximum bytes in observed across those load balancers, but only considering load balancers whose VIP address is in the fixed IP address list (10.20.127.222/8). Use a two-level aggregation where you first list each qualifying load balancer’s name, VIP address, bytes in, total connections, and its row number (ordered by load balancer name with a window frame of 2 preceding and 1 following rows), and then take the maximum bytes in from that intermediate result. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Fixed IP Address "10.20.127.222/8" is predicated by "floatingips.fixed_ip_address IN ('10.20.127.222/8')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lb.NAME AS loadbalancer_name, lb.VIP_ADDRESS AS vip_address, stats.BYTES_IN AS bytes_in, stats.TOTAL_CONNECTIONS AS total_connections, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY lb.NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM LBAAS_LOADBALANCER_STATISTICS AS stats JOIN LBAAS_LOADBALANCERS AS lb ON stats.LOADBALANCER_ID = lb.ID JOIN PROVIDERRESOURCEASSOCIATIONS AS pra ON lb.ID = pra.RESOURCE_ID WHERE pra.PROVIDER_NAME = 'haproxy' AND lb.VIP_ADDRESS IN ('10.20.127.222/8') ) SELECT MAX(bytes_in) AS max_bytes_in FROM inner_cte;

question: For active networks that belong to tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57", list the network ID, network name, tenant ID, admin_state_up flag, MTU, and the standard attribute updated_at timestamp, along with the row number within each tenant ordered by network name. Do not repeat the tenant ID if it is the same as the previous row, and include a subtotal row per tenant showing the total number of networks. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "networks.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM NETWORKS n JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND n.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(tenant_id) OVER (ORDER BY tenant_id_sort, tenant_id, network_name) = tenant_id THEN NULL ELSE tenant_id END AS tenant_id, network_id, network_name, admin_state_up, mtu, standard_attr_updated_at, window_column, total_networks FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE tenant_id END AS tenant_id_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE tenant_id END AS tenant_id, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE network_id END AS network_id, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE network_name END AS network_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE admin_state_up END AS admin_state_up, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE mtu END AS mtu, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE standard_attr_updated_at END AS standard_attr_updated_at, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE window_column END AS window_column, COUNT(*) AS total_networks FROM inner_cte GROUP BY tenant_id, network_id, network_name, admin_state_up, mtu, standard_attr_updated_at, window_column WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY tenant_id_sort, tenant_id, network_name;

question: For the top 10 port statuses (ranked by number of ports) among ports bound with VIF type 'ovs' and having device_id 'da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7', show each status, the total number of ports, the minimum admin_state_up value, and the average standard_attr_id. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Device ID "da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7" is predicated by "ports.device_id IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.STATUS, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) AS min_admin_state_up, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS avg_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS b ON p.ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE b.VIF_TYPE = 'ovs' AND p.DEVICE_ID IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS ) SELECT i.status, COUNT(DISTINCT p2.id) AS total_ports, i.min_admin_state_up, i.avg_standard_attr_id FROM inner_cte i JOIN ports p2 ON p2.status = i.status JOIN ml2_port_bindings b2 ON p2.id = b2.port_id WHERE b2.vif_type = 'ovs' AND p2.device_id IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7') GROUP BY i.status, i.min_admin_state_up, i.avg_standard_attr_id ORDER BY total_ports DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For ACTIVE networks that are not shared (exclude networks whose RBAC action is 'access_as_shared' and whose target tenant is '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'), show each network’s name, status, admin_state_up, RBAC action, target tenant, and its dense rank within the network (partitioned by network ID and ordered by network ID). Then summarize the results by RBAC action and whether the network is External (has a matching row in externalnetworks) or Internal, returning counts per group along with subtotals per action and a grand total. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "exclusion of shared networks" is predicated by "networks.id NOT IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.name, n.status, n.admin_state_up, r.action, r.target_tenant, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.id ORDER BY n.id) AS window_column FROM networksecuritybindings b JOIN networks n ON b.network_id = n.id JOIN networkrbacs r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND n.id NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') )), ActionExternalSummary AS (SELECT i.action, CASE WHEN en.network_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'External' ELSE 'Internal' END AS external_status, COUNT(*) AS total_rows FROM inner_cte i JOIN networks n ON n.name = i.name AND n.status = i.status AND n.admin_state_up = i.admin_state_up LEFT JOIN externalnetworks en ON n.id = en.network_id GROUP BY i.action, external_status) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(action) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE action END AS action, CASE WHEN GROUPING(external_status) = 1 AND GROUPING(action) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE external_status END AS external_status, SUM(total_rows) AS total_rows FROM ActionExternalSummary GROUP BY action, external_status WITH ROLLUP;

question: For each subnet name, show the range and variance of allocation pool starting IP addresses (FIRST_IP) across that subnet’s IP allocation pools, considering only routes whose next hop is 10.30.19.197/8 and only subnets with ID 012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48, and also report how each subnet’s FIRST_IP range deviates from the average FIRST_IP range across the selected subnets. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Subnet ID "012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48" is predicated by "subnets.id IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, MAX(p.FIRST_IP) - MIN(p.FIRST_IP) AS first_ip_range, VARIANCE(p.FIRST_IP) AS first_ip_variance FROM SUBNETROUTES r JOIN SUBNETS s ON r.SUBNET_ID = s.ID JOIN IPALLOCATIONPOOLS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE r.NEXTHOP = '10.30.19.197/8' AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') GROUP BY s.NAME ORDER BY first_ip_range DESC ), avg_ranges AS ( SELECT AVG(first_ip_range) AS avg_first_ip_range FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.subnet_name, i.first_ip_range, i.first_ip_variance, (i.first_ip_range - a.avg_first_ip_range) AS deviation_from_avg_first_ip_range FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_ranges a ORDER BY deviation_from_avg_first_ip_range DESC;

question: Considering only load balancers in ACTIVE provisioning status and excluding shared networks (i.e., networks not granted `access_as_shared` to `*` or tenant `9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b`), list the top 10 operating statuses by total incoming bytes. For each operating status, show the operating status, the total incoming bytes, and whether any load balancer in that operating status has more than 10,000 total connections. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "exclusion of shared networks" is predicated by "networks.id NOT IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lb.OPERATING_STATUS, SUM(s.BYTES_IN) AS total_bytes_in FROM LBAAS_LOADBALANCERS AS lb JOIN LBAAS_LOADBALANCER_STATISTICS AS s ON lb.ID = s.LOADBALANCER_ID WHERE lb.PROVISIONING_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND lb.VIP_SUBNET_ID IN ( SELECT subnets.id FROM subnets JOIN networks ON networks.id = subnets.network_id WHERE networks.id NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) ) GROUP BY lb.OPERATING_STATUS HAVING SUM(s.BYTES_IN) > 1000000) SELECT i.OPERATING_STATUS, i.total_bytes_in, CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN s.TOTAL_CONNECTIONS > 10000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_any_lb_over_10000_total_connections FROM inner_cte i JOIN LBAAS_LOADBALANCERS lb ON lb.OPERATING_STATUS = i.OPERATING_STATUS JOIN LBAAS_LOADBALANCER_STATISTICS s ON s.LOADBALANCER_ID = lb.ID WHERE lb.PROVISIONING_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY i.OPERATING_STATUS, i.total_bytes_in ORDER BY i.total_bytes_in DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each port status, report the status and the maximum (across networks) of the per-network range of port security bindings per port, considering only ports that have at least one port security binding and belong to tenant ID '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7'. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Tenant ID "17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.status, MAX(ps.binding_count) - MIN(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_range, VARIANCE(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_variance, STDDEV(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_stddev FROM ports AS p JOIN ( SELECT p2.id AS port_id, COUNT(*) AS binding_count FROM ports AS p2 JOIN portsecuritybindings AS b ON p2.id = b.port_id WHERE p2.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p2.id ) AS ps ON p.id = ps.port_id GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY binding_count_range DESC), status_network_ranges AS ( SELECT p.status, p.network_id, MAX(ps.binding_count) - MIN(ps.binding_count) AS network_binding_count_range FROM ports AS p JOIN ( SELECT p2.id AS port_id, COUNT(*) AS binding_count FROM ports AS p2 JOIN portsecuritybindings AS b ON p2.id = b.port_id WHERE p2.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p2.id ) AS ps ON p.id = ps.port_id GROUP BY p.status, p.network_id ) SELECT i.status, MAX(snr.network_binding_count_range) AS max_network_binding_count_range FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN status_network_ranges AS snr ON i.status = snr.status GROUP BY i.status ORDER BY max_network_binding_count_range DESC;

question: For each port status, among ports bound with VIF type 'ovs' and having device_id 'da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7', which statuses have an average standard_attr_id greater than the overall average standard_attr_id across all such ports, and what are their minimum admin_state_up and average standard_attr_id values? Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Device ID "da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7" is predicated by "ports.device_id IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.STATUS, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) AS min_admin_state_up, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS avg_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS b ON p.ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE b.VIF_TYPE = 'ovs' AND p.DEVICE_ID IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS) SELECT STATUS, min_admin_state_up, avg_standard_attr_id FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_standard_attr_id > (SELECT AVG(avg_standard_attr_id) FROM inner_cte);

question: For subnets whose network has a RBAC action of 'access_as_shared' and whose RBAC target tenant is '1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b', list each subnet name, its CIDR, the RBAC target tenant, the running sum of subnet standard attribute IDs within each IP version group ordered by standard attribute ID, along with the total number of such subnets per RBAC target tenant and the average of that subnet count across all RBAC target tenants. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Target Tenant ID "1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b" is predicated by "networkrbacs.target_tenant IN ('1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, s.CIDR AS subnet_cidr, n.TARGET_TENANT AS rbac_target_tenant, SUM(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY s.IP_VERSION ORDER BY s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN NETWORKRBACS AS n ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' AND n.TARGET_TENANT IN ('1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b') ) SELECT inner_cte.subnet_name, inner_cte.subnet_cidr, inner_cte.rbac_target_tenant, inner_cte.window_column, tenant_counts.total_subnets_for_target_tenant, avg_counts.avg_subnets_per_target_tenant FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT rbac_target_tenant, COUNT(*) AS total_subnets_for_target_tenant FROM inner_cte GROUP BY rbac_target_tenant ) AS tenant_counts ON tenant_counts.rbac_target_tenant = inner_cte.rbac_target_tenant JOIN ( SELECT AVG(subnet_count) AS avg_subnets_per_target_tenant FROM ( SELECT rbac_target_tenant, COUNT(*) AS subnet_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY rbac_target_tenant ) AS sub ) AS avg_counts;

question: For each network that has at least one port bound to a security group, with admin_state_up = 1 and belonging to tenant ID '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57', list the network ID and the maximum (across ports in that network) of the per-port security group binding count and the per-port DNS record count. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.name AS port_name, COUNT(sgpb.security_group_id) AS security_group_binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pd.port_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS dns_record_count FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS sgpb JOIN PORTS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id LEFT JOIN PORTDNSES pd ON p.id = pd.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.name ) SELECT p.network_id, MAX(inner_cte.security_group_binding_count) AS max_security_group_bindings_on_a_port, MAX(inner_cte.dns_record_count) AS max_dns_records_on_a_port FROM inner_cte JOIN PORTS p ON inner_cte.port_id = p.id GROUP BY p.network_id;

question: For each security group, list the security group ID and its geometric mean of the standard attribute IDs (computed over ports with standard attribute ID greater than 0 and tenant ID `17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7`), but only include security groups whose geometric mean is greater than 1000. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Tenant ID "17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, EXP(AVG(LN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID))) AS geometric_mean_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS AS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID > 0 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY geometric_mean_standard_attr_id DESC ) SELECT SECURITY_GROUP_ID, geometric_mean_standard_attr_id FROM inner_cte WHERE geometric_mean_standard_attr_id > 1000 ORDER BY geometric_mean_standard_attr_id DESC;

question: For each port status and port security state (Enabled if port security is enabled, Disabled otherwise), list the port status, the port security state, and the number of ports for tenant ID '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7'. Include subtotals for each port status and a grand total, considering only ports that have a port security binding. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Tenant ID "17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS down_ports_with_port_security_enabled FROM PORTS p JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND psb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')), PortSecurityStatus AS (SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, CASE WHEN psb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED = 1 THEN 'Enabled' ELSE 'Disabled' END AS port_security_state, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS total_ports FROM PORTS p JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS, port_security_state) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(port_status) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE port_status END AS port_status, CASE WHEN GROUPING(port_security_state) = 1 AND GROUPING(port_status) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE port_security_state END AS port_security_state, SUM(total_ports) AS total_ports, MAX(inner_cte.down_ports_with_port_security_enabled) AS down_ports_with_port_security_enabled FROM PortSecurityStatus CROSS JOIN inner_cte GROUP BY port_status, port_security_state WITH ROLLUP;

question: For each IPv4 subnet (by subnet name), return the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the DNS nameserver order values across all DNS nameservers on that subnet, excluding subnets that belong to shared networks (i.e., networks granted `access_as_shared` to `*` or to tenant `9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b`), but only include subnets whose coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) is greater than the average coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) across all such eligible IPv4 subnets. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "exclusion of shared networks" is predicated by "networks.id NOT IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, STDDEV(d.order) / NULLIF(AVG(d.order), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM subnets AS s JOIN dnsnameservers AS d ON d.subnet_id = s.id JOIN ipallocationpools AS p ON p.subnet_id = s.id JOIN networks AS n ON n.id = s.network_id WHERE s.ip_version = 4 AND n.id NOT IN ( SELECT r.object_id FROM networkrbacs AS r WHERE r.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (r.target_tenant = '*' OR r.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY s.name HAVING AVG(d.order) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), CVAverages AS ( SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_cv FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.subnet_name, i.coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte i JOIN subnets s ON s.name = i.subnet_name JOIN networks n ON n.id = s.network_id WHERE i.coefficient_of_variation > (SELECT avg_cv FROM CVAverages) ORDER BY i.coefficient_of_variation DESC;

question: For IPv4 subnets whose subnet ID is `012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48`, show the subnet name, its dense rank (ordered by the associated standard attribute’s updated-at timestamp using a window frame of the current row and the 2 preceding rows), and indicate whether the subnet’s standard attribute has a non-empty description. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Subnet ID "012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48" is predicated by "subnets.id IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.NAME, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY sa.UPDATED_AT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES AS sa ON sa.ID = s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') ) SELECT inner_cte.NAME, inner_cte.window_column, CASE WHEN sa.DESCRIPTION IS NOT NULL AND sa.DESCRIPTION <> '' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_description FROM inner_cte JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON s.NAME = inner_cte.NAME JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES AS sa ON sa.ID = s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID;

question: For each VIF type, what is the maximum of the per-status minimum admin_state_up values and the maximum of the per-status average standard_attr_id values for ports whose device_id is 'da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7'? Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Device ID "da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7" is predicated by "ports.device_id IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.STATUS, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) AS min_admin_state_up, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS avg_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS b ON p.ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE b.VIF_TYPE = 'ovs' AND p.DEVICE_ID IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS) SELECT b.VIF_TYPE, MAX(inner_cte.min_admin_state_up) AS max_of_min_admin_state_up, MAX(inner_cte.avg_standard_attr_id) AS max_of_avg_standard_attr_id FROM inner_cte JOIN PORTS p ON p.STATUS = inner_cte.STATUS JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS b ON p.ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE p.DEVICE_ID IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7') GROUP BY b.VIF_TYPE;

question: For active networks that belong to tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57", list the network ID, network name, tenant ID, admin_state_up flag, MTU, and the standard attribute updated_at timestamp, along with the average MTU across those networks as a benchmark, and categorize each network as 'HIGH_MTU' (at least 10% above average), 'LOW_MTU' (at least 10% below average), or 'AVERAGE_MTU'. Also assign row numbers within each tenant ordered by network name. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "networks.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM NETWORKS n JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND n.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), AverageMtu AS ( SELECT AVG(mtu) AS avg_mtu FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.network_id, ic.network_name, ic.tenant_id, ic.admin_state_up, ic.mtu, ic.standard_attr_updated_at, ic.window_column, am.avg_mtu AS benchmark_mtu, CASE WHEN ic.mtu > am.avg_mtu * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_MTU' WHEN ic.mtu < am.avg_mtu * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_MTU' ELSE 'AVERAGE_MTU' END AS mtu_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AverageMtu am;

question: For ports that are DOWN and belong to tenant ID `98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57`, list only the ports whose running sum of the port’s standard attribute ID within each security group is greater than 100, showing the port ID, tenant ID, MAC address, security group ID, and the running sum, ordered by security group ID and standard attribute ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')) SELECT inner_cte.port_id, inner_cte.tenant_id, inner_cte.mac_address, sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID AS security_group_id, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb ON inner_cte.port_id = sgpb.PORT_ID WHERE inner_cte.window_column > 100 ORDER BY sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, inner_cte.window_column;

question: For each RBAC action, show the action name, the variance of the subnet IP version (IPv4 vs IPv6) across the subnets on the referenced network (only for RBAC entries with action = 'access_as_shared' and public access where target_tenant = '*'), also report the overall average of that variance across actions as a benchmark, and classify each action as 'HIGH_VARIANCE' (at least 50% above the average), 'LOW_VARIANCE' (at least 50% below the average), or 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE'. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "public access" (wildcard) is predicated by "networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' AND n.TARGET_TENANT = '*' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_variance DESC ), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(ip_version_variance) AS avg_ip_version_variance FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.ACTION, i.ip_version_variance, a.avg_ip_version_variance AS benchmark, CASE WHEN i.ip_version_variance > a.avg_ip_version_variance * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN i.ip_version_variance < a.avg_ip_version_variance * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_cte a;

question: For each IPv4 network ID, show the network’s highest route-count range (max minus min), highest variance, and highest standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) observed among its subnets, considering only subnets whose ID is in ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48'). Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Subnet ID "012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48" is predicated by "subnets.id IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, MAX(route_count) - MIN(route_count) AS route_count_range, VARIANCE(route_count) AS route_count_variance, STDDEV(route_count) AS route_count_stddev FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN ( SELECT sr.SUBNET_ID, COUNT(*) AS route_count FROM SUBNETROUTES AS sr GROUP BY sr.SUBNET_ID, sr.NEXTHOP ) AS route_stats ON s.ID = route_stats.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') GROUP BY s.NAME ORDER BY route_count_range DESC ) SELECT s.NETWORK_ID AS network_id, MAX(inner_cte.route_count_range) AS max_route_count_range, MAX(inner_cte.route_count_variance) AS max_route_count_variance, MAX(inner_cte.route_count_stddev) AS max_route_count_stddev FROM inner_cte JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON s.NAME = inner_cte.subnet_name WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') GROUP BY s.NETWORK_ID;

question: For ports that are DOWN and belong to network ID `0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d`, list the port name, network ID, MAC address, admin state, status, device owner, bound security group ID, and the windowed minimum admin_state_up (3 preceding to 1 following ordered by port ID). Do not repeat the network ID if it is the same as the previous row, and include a subtotal row per network showing the total number of matching ports. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Network ID "0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d" is predicated by "ports.network_id IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.NAME, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER ( ORDER BY p.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.NETWORK_ID IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d') ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(network_id) OVER (ORDER BY network_id_sort, network_id, name, mac_address, security_group_id) = network_id THEN NULL ELSE network_id END AS network_id, name, mac_address, admin_state_up, status, device_owner, security_group_id, window_column, total_ports FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.network_id) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.network_id END AS network_id_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.network_id) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.network_id END AS network_id, i.name, i.mac_address, i.admin_state_up, i.status, i.device_owner, i.security_group_id, i.window_column, COUNT(*) AS total_ports FROM inner_cte AS i GROUP BY i.network_id, i.name, i.mac_address, i.admin_state_up, i.status, i.device_owner, i.security_group_id, i.window_column WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY network_id_sort, network_id, name, mac_address, security_group_id;

question: Among networks that are marked as default external networks (IS_DEFAULT = 0) and have the RBAC permission action set to 'access_as_external', show the top 10 tenants (by number of such networks) along with each tenant's ID, the total number of qualifying networks they own, and whether any of those networks have at least one RBAC entry targeting a specific tenant (i.e., TARGET_TENANT is not '*'). Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "access_as_external" permission is predicated by "networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_external'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT n.NAME, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY r.ACTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM EXTERNALNETWORKS e JOIN NETWORKS n ON e.NETWORK_ID = n.ID JOIN NETWORKRBACS r ON n.ID = r.OBJECT_ID WHERE e.IS_DEFAULT = 0 AND r.ACTION = 'access_as_external' ) SELECT n.tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id) AS total_qualifying_networks, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.target_tenant <> '*' THEN r.id END) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_targeted_rbac FROM inner_cte i JOIN networks n ON n.name = i.name JOIN externalnetworks e ON e.network_id = n.id JOIN networkrbacs r ON r.object_id = n.id WHERE e.is_default = 0 AND r.action = 'access_as_external' GROUP BY n.tenant_id ORDER BY total_qualifying_networks DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each subnet name and its gateway IP, show the maximum IP version among subnets whose network has a RBAC action of 'access_as_shared' and whose RBAC target tenant is public (`'*'`), keeping only groups where that maximum IP version is greater than 3; also include, for each result row, the overall average of these per-(subnet name, gateway IP) maximum IP versions across all such groups. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "public access" (wildcard) is predicated by "networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.name, MAX(s.ip_version) AS max_ip_version, s.gateway_ip FROM NETWORKRBACS n JOIN SUBNETS s ON n.object_id = s.network_id WHERE n.action = 'access_as_shared' AND n.target_tenant = '*' GROUP BY s.name, s.gateway_ip HAVING MAX(s.ip_version) > 3) SELECT inner_cte.name, inner_cte.gateway_ip, inner_cte.max_ip_version, avg_maxes.avg_max_ip_version FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(max_ip_version) AS avg_max_ip_version FROM inner_cte ) AS avg_maxes;

question: For the top 3 publicly shared networks (RBAC action = 'access_as_shared' and target_tenant = '*') with the most subnets, list the network ID, subnet count, and the number of distinct subnet tenant IDs contributing subnets to that network. Do not repeat the network ID if it is the same as the previous row, and include a final TOTAL row across all returned networks. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "public access" (wildcard) is predicated by "networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT n.OBJECT_ID AS network_id, COUNT(*) AS subnet_count FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' AND n.TARGET_TENANT = '*' GROUP BY n.OBJECT_ID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 3 ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(network_id) OVER (ORDER BY network_id_sort, network_id) = network_id THEN NULL ELSE network_id END AS network_id, subnet_count, distinct_subnet_tenants FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.network_id) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.network_id END AS network_id_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.network_id) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.network_id END AS network_id, SUM(i.subnet_count) AS subnet_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.TENANT_ID) AS distinct_subnet_tenants FROM inner_cte i JOIN SUBNETS s ON s.NETWORK_ID = i.network_id GROUP BY i.network_id WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY network_id_sort, network_id;

question: For each IPv4 subnet (by subnet name), show the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the DNS nameserver order values across all DNS nameservers on that subnet (excluding subnets that belong to shared networks, i.e., networks granted `access_as_shared` to `*` or to tenant `9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b`). Do not repeat the subnet name if it is the same as the previous row, and include a grand total row across all returned subnets. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "exclusion of shared networks" is predicated by "networks.id NOT IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, STDDEV(d.order) / NULLIF(AVG(d.order), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM subnets AS s JOIN dnsnameservers AS d ON d.subnet_id = s.id JOIN ipallocationpools AS p ON p.subnet_id = s.id JOIN networks AS n ON n.id = s.network_id WHERE s.ip_version = 4 AND n.id NOT IN ( SELECT r.object_id FROM networkrbacs AS r WHERE r.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (r.target_tenant = '*' OR r.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY s.name HAVING AVG(d.order) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(subnet_name) OVER (ORDER BY subnet_name_sort, subnet_name) = subnet_name THEN NULL ELSE subnet_name END AS subnet_name, coefficient_of_variation FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(subnet_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE subnet_name END AS subnet_name_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(subnet_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE subnet_name END AS subnet_name, AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte GROUP BY subnet_name WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY subnet_name_sort, subnet_name;

question: For ports that are DOWN and belong to tenant ID '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57', list only those ports whose security group has more ports bound to it than the average number of ports per security group (computed across all security groups). Show the port ID, tenant ID, MAC address, the security group ID from the security-group-to-port binding, and the rank of each port within its security group when ordered by port ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, sgpb.security_group_id, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sgpb.security_group_id ORDER BY p.id) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), SecurityGroupAverages AS (SELECT AVG(sg_port_count) AS avg_ports_per_sg FROM (SELECT sgpb2.security_group_id, COUNT(*) AS sg_port_count FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb2 JOIN PORTS AS p2 ON sgpb2.port_id = p2.id JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb2 ON p2.id = psb2.port_id GROUP BY sgpb2.security_group_id) sg_counts) SELECT i.port_id, i.tenant_id, i.mac_address, i.security_group_id, i.window_column FROM inner_cte i JOIN (SELECT sgpb3.security_group_id, COUNT(*) AS total_ports_in_sg FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb3 JOIN PORTS AS p3 ON sgpb3.port_id = p3.id JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb3 ON p3.id = psb3.port_id GROUP BY sgpb3.security_group_id) sg_totals ON sg_totals.security_group_id = i.security_group_id WHERE sg_totals.total_ports_in_sg > (SELECT avg_ports_per_sg FROM SecurityGroupAverages);

question: Among the top 10 network statuses (ranked by the number of distinct non-shared networks that have at least one security binding), show each status, the total number of such networks, and compute both the variance and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the security group binding order (PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) across those networks. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "exclusion of shared networks" is predicated by "networks.id NOT IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT n.STATUS AS network_status, VARIANCE(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_variance, STDDEV(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_stddev FROM NETWORKS AS n JOIN NETWORKSECURITYBINDINGS AS nsb ON n.ID = nsb.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.STATUS ORDER BY port_security_enabled_variance DESC ) SELECT n.STATUS AS network_status, COUNT(DISTINCT n.ID) AS total_networks_with_security_binding, inner_cte.port_security_enabled_variance, inner_cte.port_security_enabled_stddev FROM NETWORKS AS n JOIN NETWORKSECURITYBINDINGS AS nsb ON n.ID = nsb.NETWORK_ID JOIN inner_cte ON n.STATUS = inner_cte.network_status WHERE n.ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.STATUS, inner_cte.port_security_enabled_variance, inner_cte.port_security_enabled_stddev ORDER BY total_networks_with_security_binding DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each administratively up port in tenant ID `98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57` that has at least one IP allocation, list the port ID, tenant ID, MAC address, IP allocation count, and subnet-id row count, but only include ports whose IP allocation count is greater than the average IP allocation count across all such ports in that tenant. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ia.subnet_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subnet_id_rows FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON ia.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND ia.ip_address IS NOT NULL AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address ), TenantAverages AS ( SELECT tenant_id, AVG(ip_allocation_count) AS avg_ip_allocs FROM inner_cte GROUP BY tenant_id ) SELECT i.port_id, i.tenant_id, i.mac_address, i.ip_allocation_count, i.subnet_id_rows FROM inner_cte i JOIN TenantAverages ta ON ta.tenant_id = i.tenant_id WHERE i.ip_allocation_count > ta.avg_ip_allocs;

question: For the ACTIVE networks that have an RBAC permission action of 'access_as_shared', group results by network status and whether the network is “High Subnet Count” (its subnet total is more than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the mean subnet count across all such ACTIVE shared networks) or “Normal Subnet Count” otherwise. Return the network status, the subnet-count category, and the number of networks in each group, including subtotals per status and a grand total. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "access_as_shared" permission is predicated by "networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT n.id AS network_id, SUM(1) AS total_subnets FROM NETWORKS AS n JOIN NETWORKRBACS AS r ON n.id = r.object_id JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON r.object_id = s.network_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND r.action = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.id HAVING SUM(1) > ( SELECT AVG(subnet_cnt) + STDDEV(subnet_cnt) FROM ( SELECT n2.id AS network_id, SUM(1) AS subnet_cnt FROM NETWORKS AS n2 JOIN NETWORKRBACS AS r2 ON n2.id = r2.object_id JOIN SUBNETS AS s2 ON r2.object_id = s2.network_id WHERE n2.status = 'ACTIVE' AND r2.action = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n2.id ) AS per_network ) ), NetworkSubnetCategory AS ( SELECT n.status, CASE WHEN ic.network_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'High Subnet Count' ELSE 'Normal Subnet Count' END AS subnet_count_category, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id) AS total_networks FROM NETWORKS n JOIN NETWORKRBACS r ON n.id = r.object_id LEFT JOIN inner_cte ic ON n.id = ic.network_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND r.action = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.status, subnet_count_category ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(status) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE status END AS status, CASE WHEN GROUPING(subnet_count_category) = 1 AND GROUPING(status) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE subnet_count_category END AS subnet_count_category, SUM(total_networks) AS total_networks FROM NetworkSubnetCategory GROUP BY status, subnet_count_category WITH ROLLUP;

question: For each port status, report the status and the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of port security bindings per port, considering only ports that have at least one port security binding and belong to tenant ID '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7', and also include the overall average number of port security bindings per port across those same ports. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Tenant ID "17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.status, MAX(ps.binding_count) - MIN(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_range, VARIANCE(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_variance, STDDEV(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_stddev FROM ports AS p JOIN ( SELECT p2.id AS port_id, COUNT(*) AS binding_count FROM ports AS p2 JOIN portsecuritybindings AS b ON p2.id = b.port_id WHERE p2.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p2.id ) AS ps ON p.id = ps.port_id GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY binding_count_range DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.status, inner_cte.binding_count_range, inner_cte.binding_count_variance, inner_cte.binding_count_stddev, avg_bindings.avg_binding_count FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(binding_count) AS avg_binding_count FROM ( SELECT p2.id AS port_id, COUNT(*) AS binding_count FROM ports AS p2 JOIN portsecuritybindings AS b ON p2.id = b.port_id WHERE p2.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p2.id ) AS sub ) AS avg_bindings ON 1 = 1 ORDER BY inner_cte.binding_count_range DESC;

question: For each ACTIVE network that has an RBAC permission action of 'access_as_shared', return the network ID and its total number of subnets, along with the overall benchmark threshold (mean subnet count plus one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) across all such networks) and a usage category of 'ABOVE_THRESHOLD' or 'NOT_ABOVE_THRESHOLD'. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "access_as_shared" permission is predicated by "networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared'"

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, STDDEV(d.order) / NULLIF(AVG(d.order), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM subnets AS s JOIN dnsnameservers AS d ON d.subnet_id = s.id JOIN ipallocationpools AS p ON p.subnet_id = s.id JOIN networks AS n ON n.id = s.network_id WHERE s.ip_version = 4 AND n.id NOT IN ( SELECT r.object_id FROM networkrbacs AS r WHERE r.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (r.target_tenant = '*' OR r.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY s.name HAVING AVG(d.order) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.subnet_name, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, avg_cv.avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte ) AS avg_cv ON 1 = 1 ORDER BY inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC;

question: For each port status, show the port status and the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of port security bindings per port for ports that have at least one port security binding and belong to tenant ID '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7'. Also include subtotals per status and a grand total across all statuses. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Tenant ID "17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.status, MAX(ps.binding_count) - MIN(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_range, VARIANCE(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_variance, STDDEV(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_stddev FROM ports AS p JOIN ( SELECT p2.id AS port_id, COUNT(*) AS binding_count FROM ports AS p2 JOIN portsecuritybindings AS b ON p2.id = b.port_id WHERE p2.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p2.id ) AS ps ON p.id = ps.port_id GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY binding_count_range DESC ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(status) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE status END AS status, MAX(binding_count_range) AS binding_count_range, AVG(binding_count_variance) AS binding_count_variance, AVG(binding_count_stddev) AS binding_count_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY status WITH ROLLUP;

question: From the ports that are administratively up and belong to tenant ID `98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57` (and have at least one IP allocation), show the top 10 ports with the most IP allocations. For each of these ports, display the port ID, tenant ID, MAC address, number of IP allocations, the number of subnet-id rows from those allocations, and whether the port has any floating IPs associated. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ia.subnet_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subnet_id_rows FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON ia.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND ia.ip_address IS NOT NULL AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address ) SELECT i.port_id, i.tenant_id, i.mac_address, i.ip_allocation_count, i.subnet_id_rows, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT f.id) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_floating_ips FROM inner_cte i LEFT JOIN floatingips f ON i.port_id = f.fixed_port_id GROUP BY i.port_id, i.tenant_id, i.mac_address, i.ip_allocation_count, i.subnet_id_rows ORDER BY i.ip_allocation_count DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For ports that are administratively up and belong to tenant ID `98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57`, show the port ID, host, VIF type, VNIC type, tenant ID, network ID, MAC address, status, device owner, and the average standard attribute ID in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows partitioned by VIF type and ordered by standard attribute ID; additionally, for each VIF type, include the total number of such ports and the deviation of each port’s windowed average standard attribute ID from the overall average of that windowed average across all returned ports. evidence: Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), VifTypeCounts AS ( SELECT VIF_TYPE, COUNT(*) AS ports_in_vif_type FROM inner_cte GROUP BY VIF_TYPE ), OverallWindowAvg AS ( SELECT AVG(window_column) AS overall_avg_window_column FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.PORT_ID, i.HOST, i.VIF_TYPE, i.VNIC_TYPE, i.TENANT_ID, i.NETWORK_ID, i.MAC_ADDRESS, i.STATUS, i.DEVICE_OWNER, i.window_column, vtc.ports_in_vif_type, (i.window_column - owa.overall_avg_window_column) AS deviation_from_overall_window_avg FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN VifTypeCounts AS vtc ON i.VIF_TYPE = vtc.VIF_TYPE CROSS JOIN OverallWindowAvg AS owa;

question: From the top 10 port statuses (by number of ports) among ports that have an IP allocation with IP address 10.150.64.113/8, show each status, the total number of distinct ports in that status, and the variance of the standard attribute ID for those ports. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: IP Address "10.150.64.113/8" is predicated by "ipallocations.ip_address IN ('10.150.64.113/8')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.STATUS, VARIANCE(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS standard_attr_id_variance FROM PORTS AS p JOIN IPALLOCATIONS AS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID IS NOT NULL AND ia.IP_ADDRESS IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.STATUS ORDER BY standard_attr_id_variance DESC ) SELECT p.status, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_ports, i.standard_attr_id_variance FROM ports p JOIN ipallocations ia ON p.id = ia.port_id JOIN inner_cte i ON p.status = i.status WHERE ia.ip_address IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.status, i.standard_attr_id_variance ORDER BY total_ports DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For active networks that belong to tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57", group the results by admin_state_up and show the admin_state_up flag, the number of networks, and the maximum standard attribute updated_at timestamp. evidence: Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "networks.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM NETWORKS n JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND n.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(admin_state_up) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE CAST(admin_state_up AS CHAR) END AS admin_state_up, COUNT(DISTINCT network_id) AS total_networks, MAX(standard_attr_updated_at) AS max_standard_attr_updated_at FROM inner_cte GROUP BY admin_state_up WITH ROLLUP;

question: For each port status, list the status, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the ports’ standard attribute IDs, and the total number of distinct security groups bound to ports in that status. Do not repeat the status if it is the same as the previous row, and include a grand total row across all statuses. Consider only ports that have both a security group port binding and a port security binding, restricting to ports whose tenant_id is '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7'. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Tenant ID "17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.status, STDDEV(p.standard_attr_id) / NULLIF(AVG(p.standard_attr_id), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM securitygroupportbindings AS sgpb JOIN ports AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN portsecuritybindings AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(p.standard_attr_id) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(status) OVER (ORDER BY status_sort, status) = status THEN NULL ELSE status END AS status, coefficient_of_variation, distinct_security_groups FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.status) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.status END AS status_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.status) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.status END AS status, i.coefficient_of_variation AS coefficient_of_variation, COUNT(DISTINCT sgpb.security_group_id) AS distinct_security_groups FROM inner_cte i JOIN ports p ON p.status = i.status JOIN securitygroupportbindings sgpb ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON psb.port_id = p.id WHERE p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY i.status, i.coefficient_of_variation WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY status_sort, status;

question: For each load balancer operating status, show the operating status and the total number of incoming bytes across load balancers that are in ACTIVE provisioning status, excluding shared networks (i.e., networks not granted `access_as_shared` to `*` or tenant `9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b`), keeping only operating statuses where the total incoming bytes exceed 1,000,000. Do not repeat the operating status if it is the same as the previous row, and include a grand total row. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "exclusion of shared networks" is predicated by "networks.id NOT IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lb.OPERATING_STATUS, SUM(s.BYTES_IN) AS total_bytes_in FROM LBAAS_LOADBALANCERS AS lb JOIN LBAAS_LOADBALANCER_STATISTICS AS s ON lb.ID = s.LOADBALANCER_ID WHERE lb.PROVISIONING_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND lb.VIP_SUBNET_ID IN ( SELECT subnets.id FROM subnets JOIN networks ON networks.id = subnets.network_id WHERE networks.id NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) ) GROUP BY lb.OPERATING_STATUS HAVING SUM(s.BYTES_IN) > 1000000 ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(operating_status) OVER (ORDER BY operating_status_sort, operating_status) = operating_status THEN NULL ELSE operating_status END AS operating_status, total_bytes_in FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.operating_status) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.operating_status END AS operating_status_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.operating_status) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.operating_status END AS operating_status, SUM(i.total_bytes_in) AS total_bytes_in FROM inner_cte i GROUP BY i.operating_status WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY operating_status_sort;

question: For each port status and device owner, considering only ports that are bound to a security group and whose tenant ID is '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7', list the port status, device owner, number of distinct ports, and minimum standard attribute ID. Do not repeat the port status if it is the same as the previous row. Include subtotals for each port status. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Tenant ID "17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS min_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS spb ON p.ID = spb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(port_status) OVER (ORDER BY port_status_sort, port_status, device_owner) = port_status THEN NULL ELSE port_status END AS port_status, device_owner, port_count, min_standard_attr_id FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.port_status) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.port_status END AS port_status_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.port_status) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.port_status END AS port_status, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.device_owner) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE i.device_owner END AS device_owner, SUM(i.port_count) AS port_count, MIN(i.min_standard_attr_id) AS min_standard_attr_id FROM inner_cte i GROUP BY i.port_status, i.device_owner WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY port_status_sort, port_status, device_owner;

question: For each RBAC action restricted to the **access_as_shared** permission, show the action name and compute the average, range (max minus min), and variance of the subnet IP version for subnets whose network is referenced by that RBAC entry; additionally, only return actions where the average IP version is greater than 4. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "access_as_shared" permission is predicated by "networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.ACTION AS rbac_action, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, MAX(s.IP_VERSION) - MIN(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_range, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION IN (4, 6) AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_range DESC) SELECT rbac_action, avg_ip_version, ip_version_range, ip_version_variance FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_ip_version > 4 ORDER BY ip_version_range DESC;

question: For each IPv4 subnet name, show the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of routes per subnet (as computed per next hop), considering only subnets whose ID is in ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48'). Also include subtotals per tenant and a grand total across all included subnets. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Subnet ID "012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48" is predicated by "subnets.id IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, MAX(route_count) - MIN(route_count) AS route_count_range, VARIANCE(route_count) AS route_count_variance, STDDEV(route_count) AS route_count_stddev FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN ( SELECT sr.SUBNET_ID, COUNT(*) AS route_count FROM SUBNETROUTES AS sr GROUP BY sr.SUBNET_ID, sr.NEXTHOP ) AS route_stats ON s.ID = route_stats.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') GROUP BY s.NAME ORDER BY route_count_range DESC), SubnetTenantStats AS ( SELECT s.tenant_id, i.subnet_name, i.route_count_range, i.route_count_variance, i.route_count_stddev FROM inner_cte i JOIN subnets s ON s.name = i.subnet_name AND s.ip_version = 4 AND s.id IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE tenant_id END AS tenant_id, CASE WHEN GROUPING(subnet_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(tenant_id) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(subnet_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE subnet_name END AS subnet_name, AVG(route_count_range) AS avg_route_count_range, AVG(route_count_variance) AS avg_route_count_variance, AVG(route_count_stddev) AS avg_route_count_stddev FROM SubnetTenantStats GROUP BY tenant_id, subnet_name WITH ROLLUP;

question: For networks that are marked as default external networks (IS_DEFAULT = 0) and have the RBAC permission action set to 'access_as_external', list the network name, its dense rank when ordered by the RBAC action using a window frame of the current row and the 2 preceding rows, and the deviation of that dense rank from the average dense rank across all such networks. SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT n.NAME, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY r.ACTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM EXTERNALNETWORKS e JOIN NETWORKS n ON e.NETWORK_ID = n.ID JOIN NETWORKRBACS r ON n.ID = r.OBJECT_ID WHERE e.IS_DEFAULT = 0 AND r.ACTION = 'access_as_external' ), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(window_column) AS avg_window_column FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.NAME, i.window_column, (i.window_column - a.avg_window_column) AS deviation_from_avg_window_column FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_cte a;

question: Among the top 10 RBAC actions (restricted to "access_as_shared") with the highest subnet IP-version variance across referenced subnets, show the action, the average/variance/standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of subnet IP version, and whether any of those referenced subnets have DHCP enabled. evidence: "access_as_shared" permission is predicated by "networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.ACTION, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_variance DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACTION, inner_cte.avg_ip_version, inner_cte.ip_version_variance, inner_cte.ip_version_stddev, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.ENABLE_DHCP = 1 THEN s.ID END) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_dhcp_enabled_subnets FROM inner_cte JOIN NETWORKRBACS AS n ON n.ACTION = inner_cte.ACTION JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON s.NETWORK_ID = n.OBJECT_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY inner_cte.ACTION, inner_cte.avg_ip_version, inner_cte.ip_version_variance, inner_cte.ip_version_stddev ORDER BY inner_cte.ip_version_variance DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For ports on host "drive-59" that belong to tenant ID "17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7", list the port ID, tenant ID, MAC address, and running sum of the port standard attribute IDs within each VIF type group ordered by standard attribute ID. evidence: Tenant ID "17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, p.TENANT_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE b.HOST = 'drive-59' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(vif_type) OVER (ORDER BY vif_type_sort, vif_type, standard_attr_id) = vif_type THEN NULL ELSE vif_type END AS vif_type, port_id, tenant_id, mac_address, window_column FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(b.VIF_TYPE) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE b.VIF_TYPE END AS vif_type_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(b.VIF_TYPE) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE b.VIF_TYPE END AS vif_type, i.PORT_ID AS port_id, i.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, i.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, i.window_column, p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID AS standard_attr_id FROM inner_cte i JOIN PORTS p ON p.ID = i.PORT_ID JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS b ON b.PORT_ID = i.PORT_ID GROUP BY b.VIF_TYPE, i.PORT_ID, i.TENANT_ID, i.MAC_ADDRESS, i.window_column, p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY vif_type_sort, vif_type, standard_attr_id;

question: For ports that are DOWN and belong to tenant ID '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57', list the port ID, tenant ID, MAC address, security group ID, and the rank of each port within its security group (ordered by port ID), but only return rows where the port’s rank is greater than the average rank across all such ports. evidence: Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, sgpb.security_group_id, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sgpb.security_group_id ORDER BY p.id) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')) SELECT port_id, tenant_id, mac_address, security_group_id, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > (SELECT AVG(window_column) FROM inner_cte);

question: For each security group, show the security group ID, the geometric mean of the standard attribute IDs of the ports bound to that security group (only for ports with standard attribute ID > 0 and tenant ID `17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7`), and the deviation of that geometric mean from the overall average geometric mean across all security groups. evidence: Tenant ID "17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, EXP(AVG(LN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID))) AS geometric_mean_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS AS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID > 0 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY geometric_mean_standard_attr_id DESC ), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(geometric_mean_standard_attr_id) AS avg_geometric_mean_standard_attr_id FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, i.geometric_mean_standard_attr_id, (i.geometric_mean_standard_attr_id - a.avg_geometric_mean_standard_attr_id) AS deviation_from_avg_geometric_mean FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_cte a ORDER BY i.geometric_mean_standard_attr_id DESC;

question: For each port status and device owner, using only ports that are bound to a security group and whose tenant ID is '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7', return the number of distinct ports and the minimum standard attribute ID, along with the overall average port count across all such (status, device owner) groups as a benchmark, and categorize each group as 'HIGH_GROUP' (at least 50% above average), 'LOW_GROUP' (at least 50% below average), or 'AVERAGE_GROUP'. Do not return any rounded answers.

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT r.DESTINATION, r.NEXTHOP, s.NAME AS subnet_name, s.CIDR AS subnet_cidr, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.SUBNET_ID ORDER BY r.SUBNET_ID) AS window_column FROM SUBNETROUTES r JOIN SUBNETS s ON r.SUBNET_ID = s.ID JOIN IPALLOCATIONPOOLS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48')), SubnetRouteCounts AS ( SELECT s.ID AS subnet_id, COUNT(r.DESTINATION) AS total_routes FROM SUBNETS s LEFT JOIN SUBNETROUTES r ON r.SUBNET_ID = s.ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 GROUP BY s.ID ), AverageRoutes AS ( SELECT AVG(total_routes) AS avg_routes FROM SubnetRouteCounts ) SELECT i.DESTINATION, i.NEXTHOP, i.subnet_name, i.subnet_cidr, i.FIRST_IP, i.LAST_IP, i.window_column, src.total_routes, ar.avg_routes AS benchmark, CASE WHEN src.total_routes > ar.avg_routes * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_ROUTE_SUBNET' WHEN src.total_routes < ar.avg_routes * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_ROUTE_SUBNET' ELSE 'AVERAGE_ROUTE_SUBNET' END AS route_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN SUBNETS s ON s.NAME = i.subnet_name AND s.CIDR = i.subnet_cidr JOIN SubnetRouteCounts src ON src.subnet_id = s.ID CROSS JOIN AverageRoutes ar;

evidence: "exclusion of shared networks" is predicated by "networks.id NOT IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))"
SQL: SELECT p.status, STDDEV(p.standard_attr_id) / NULLIF(AVG(p.standard_attr_id), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM securitygroupportbindings AS sgpb JOIN ports AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN portsecuritybindings AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.network_id NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(p.standard_attr_id) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC;

question: For ACTIVE networks that have the RBAC action set to 'access_as_shared', list the network name, the RBAC action, the subnet CIDR, and the running sum of the network MTU within each RBAC action group ordered by MTU. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "access_as_shared" permission is predicated by "networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared'"
SQL: SELECT n.NAME AS network_name, r.ACTION AS rbac_action, s.CIDR AS subnet_cidr, SUM(n.MTU) OVER (PARTITION BY r.ACTION ORDER BY n.MTU) AS window_column FROM NETWORKS AS n JOIN NETWORKRBACS AS r ON n.ID = r.OBJECT_ID JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON r.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND r.ACTION = 'access_as_shared';

question: For each subnet name and its gateway IP, find the maximum IP version among subnets whose network has a RBAC action of 'access_as_shared' **and whose RBAC target tenant is public (i.e., `'*'`)**, and only keep subnet name/gateway IP groups where that maximum IP version is greater than 3. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "public access" (wildcard) is predicated by "networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*'"
SQL: SELECT s.name, MAX(s.ip_version) AS max_ip_version, s.gateway_ip FROM NETWORKRBACS n JOIN SUBNETS s ON n.object_id = s.network_id WHERE n.action = 'access_as_shared' AND n.target_tenant = '*' GROUP BY s.name, s.gateway_ip HAVING MAX(s.ip_version) > 3;

question: For each network status, show the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the network MTU for networks that are marked as default external networks, have an RBAC action of 'access_as_shared', and are not shared publicly (i.e., exclude networks where the RBAC target tenant is '*'). SQL: SELECT n.status, AVG(n.mtu) AS avg_mtu, VARIANCE(n.mtu) AS mtu_variance, STDDEV(n.mtu) AS mtu_stddev FROM EXTERNALNETWORKS e JOIN NETWORKS n ON e.network_id = n.id JOIN NETWORKRBACS r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE e.is_default = 0 AND r.action = 'access_as_shared' AND r.target_tenant <> '*' GROUP BY n.status ORDER BY mtu_variance DESC;

question: For each port status, show the status value and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) (standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) divided by average) of the length of the allocated IP address strings for ports that have port security enabled, restricting to allocated IP addresses in ('10.150.64.113/8'). SQL: SELECT p.status, STDDEV(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) / NULLIF(AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM portsecuritybindings psb JOIN ports p ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON p.id = ia.port_id WHERE psb.port_security_enabled = 1 AND ia.ip_address IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC;

SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_networks_with_ports_tag FROM TAGS t JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON t.STANDARD_ATTR_ID = sa.ID JOIN NETWORKS n ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND t.TAG = 'ports' AND n.ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') );

question: For each subnet name, calculate the range and variance of the allocation pool starting IP addresses (FIRST_IP) across that subnet’s IP allocation pools, considering only routes whose next hop is 10.30.19.197/8 and only subnets with ID 012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48. SQL: SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, MAX(p.FIRST_IP) - MIN(p.FIRST_IP) AS first_ip_range, VARIANCE(p.FIRST_IP) AS first_ip_variance FROM SUBNETROUTES r JOIN SUBNETS s ON r.SUBNET_ID = s.ID JOIN IPALLOCATIONPOOLS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE r.NEXTHOP = '10.30.19.197/8' AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') GROUP BY s.NAME ORDER BY first_ip_range DESC;

question: For each port that is bound to a security group, has admin_state_up = 1, and belongs to tenant ID '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57', list the port ID, tenant ID, port name, and the number of security group bindings for that port along with the total number of DNS records associated with the port. question: For each network, return the network ID and the total number of subnets on that network, considering only ACTIVE networks, excluding shared networks (i.e., networks whose ID appears in NETWORKRBACS with action = 'access_as_shared' and target_tenant = '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'), and only keeping networks whose total subnet count is more than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the mean subnet count across all ACTIVE (non-shared) networks. SQL: SELECT n.id AS network_id, SUM(1) AS total_subnets FROM NETWORKS AS n JOIN NETWORKRBACS AS r ON n.id = r.object_id JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON r.object_id = s.network_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND n.id NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.id HAVING SUM(1) > ( SELECT AVG(subnet_cnt) + STDDEV(subnet_cnt) FROM ( SELECT n2.id AS network_id, SUM(1) AS subnet_cnt FROM NETWORKS AS n2 JOIN NETWORKRBACS AS r2 ON n2.id = r2.object_id JOIN SUBNETS AS s2 ON r2.object_id = s2.network_id WHERE n2.status = 'ACTIVE' AND n2.id NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n2.id ) AS per_network );

question: For the security group ID 0008e629-5619-41e0-b86c-4eecfeaacb6c, list only the networks where more than 50% of the ports bound to that security group are in DOWN status, returning the network ID, total bound ports, total DOWN ports, and the DOWN-to-total ratio.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH Subq1 AS ( SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.STATUS AS port_status, ia.IP_ADDRESS AS ip_address, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY p.NETWORK_ID ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS sgpb JOIN PORTS p ON sgpb.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN IPALLOCATIONS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID = '0008e629-5619-41e0-b86c-4eecfeaacb6c' ), Subq2 AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY psb.port_security_enabled ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM ports AS p JOIN portsecuritybindings AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' ), PortNetwork AS ( SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.NETWORK_ID AS network_id FROM PORTS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS sgpb ON sgpb.PORT_ID = p.ID WHERE sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID = '0008e629-5619-41e0-b86c-4eecfeaacb6c' ) SELECT pn.network_id, COUNT(DISTINCT s1.port_id) AS total_ports_in_security_group, COUNT(DISTINCT s2.port_id) AS total_down_ports, ROUND( COUNT(DISTINCT s2.port_id) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT s1.port_id), 0), 2 ) AS down_port_ratio FROM PortNetwork pn LEFT JOIN Subq1 s1 ON s1.port_id = pn.port_id LEFT JOIN Subq2 s2 ON s2.port_id = pn.port_id GROUP BY pn.network_id ) SELECT network_id, total_ports_in_security_group, total_down_ports, down_port_ratio FROM inner_cte WHERE total_ports_in_security_group > 0 AND down_port_ratio > 0.50;

question: From the top 10 tenants (by number of qualifying subnets) where the qualifying subnets are IP version 4 and are on networks with an RBAC action of 'access_as_shared' (and whose subnet name/gateway IP group has a maximum IP version greater than 3), show each tenant’s ID, the total number of qualifying subnets, and whether they have any qualifying subnet whose maximum-IP-version-to-window-rank ratio (rounded to 2 decimals) is at least 2.00.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH SubnetWindowRanks AS ( SELECT s.NAME, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY sa.UPDATED_AT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES AS sa ON sa.ID = s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 ), SharedNetworkSubnetMaxIP AS ( SELECT s.name, MAX(s.ip_version) AS max_ip_version, s.gateway_ip FROM NETWORKRBACS n JOIN SUBNETS s ON n.object_id = s.network_id WHERE n.action = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY s.name, s.gateway_ip HAVING MAX(s.ip_version) > 3 ) SELECT swr.NAME AS subnet_name, swr.window_column, sns.gateway_ip, sns.max_ip_version, ROUND(sns.max_ip_version / NULLIF(swr.window_column, 0), 2) AS max_ip_version_per_window_rank FROM SubnetWindowRanks swr JOIN SharedNetworkSubnetMaxIP sns ON sns.name = swr.NAME ORDER BY max_ip_version_per_window_rank DESC ) SELECT s.tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) AS total_qualifying_subnets, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN inner_cte.max_ip_version_per_window_rank >= 2.00 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_ratio_at_least_2 FROM inner_cte JOIN subnets s ON s.name = inner_cte.subnet_name AND s.gateway_ip = inner_cte.gateway_ip GROUP BY s.tenant_id ORDER BY total_qualifying_subnets DESC LIMIT 10;
