question: For tenant ID '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7' and considering only DOWN ports, for each (port status, device owner) combination where the ports are bound to a security group, return the distinct port count and the minimum standard attribute ID, and also include (by matching on port status) the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of port security bindings per port for that same tenant. Additionally, keep only those (port status, device owner) rows whose distinct port count is greater than the average distinct port count across device owners for the same port status (within that tenant and DOWN ports bound to a security group). Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Tenant ID "17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH PortStatusOwnerSecurityGroupStats AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS min_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS spb ON p.ID = spb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), PortStatusBindingCountDispersion AS ( SELECT p.status, MAX(ps.binding_count) - MIN(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_range, VARIANCE(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_variance, STDDEV(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_stddev FROM ports AS p JOIN ( SELECT p2.id AS port_id, COUNT(*) AS binding_count FROM ports AS p2 JOIN portsecuritybindings AS b ON p2.id = b.port_id WHERE p2.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p2.id ) AS ps ON p.id = ps.port_id GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY binding_count_range DESC ) SELECT psosgs.port_status, psosgs.device_owner, psosgs.port_count, psosgs.min_standard_attr_id, psbcd.binding_count_range, psbcd.binding_count_variance, psbcd.binding_count_stddev FROM PortStatusOwnerSecurityGroupStats psosgs JOIN PortStatusBindingCountDispersion psbcd ON psosgs.port_status = psbcd.status ORDER BY psosgs.port_status, psosgs.device_owner ), StatusOwnerAverages AS ( SELECT port_status, AVG(port_count) AS avg_port_count_per_owner FROM inner_cte GROUP BY port_status ) SELECT i.port_status, i.device_owner, i.port_count, i.min_standard_attr_id, i.binding_count_range, i.binding_count_variance, i.binding_count_stddev FROM inner_cte i JOIN StatusOwnerAverages soa ON i.port_status = soa.port_status WHERE i.port_count > soa.avg_port_count_per_owner ORDER BY i.port_status, i.device_owner;

question: For tenant ID '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57', for each network, find the network ID and the highest DNS-records-per-max-binding ratio among its security groups (where each security group is computed only from security groups that have DOWN ports, using the ratio of total DNS record count across the tenant’s admin_state_up = 1 ports in that group divided by the maximum number of security-group bindings among those admin_state_up ports, rounded to 2 decimals).
evidence: Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DownPortsBySecurityGroup AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, sgpb.security_group_id, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sgpb.security_group_id ORDER BY p.id) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), AdminUpPortBindingAndDnsCounts AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.name AS port_name, COUNT(sgpb.security_group_id) AS security_group_binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pd.port_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS dns_record_count FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS sgpb JOIN PORTS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id LEFT JOIN PORTDNSES pd ON p.id = pd.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.name ) SELECT dpsg.security_group_id, COUNT(DISTINCT dpsg.port_id) AS down_port_count, MAX(au.security_group_binding_count) AS max_security_group_binding_count_among_admin_up_ports, SUM(au.dns_record_count) AS total_dns_record_count_for_admin_up_ports, ROUND( SUM(au.dns_record_count) / NULLIF(MAX(au.security_group_binding_count), 0), 2 ) AS dns_records_per_max_binding_ratio FROM DownPortsBySecurityGroup dpsg JOIN AdminUpPortBindingAndDnsCounts au ON au.port_id = dpsg.port_id AND au.tenant_id = dpsg.tenant_id WHERE dpsg.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY dpsg.security_group_id ORDER BY dns_records_per_max_binding_ratio DESC) , NetworkSecurityGroupRatios AS ( SELECT p.network_id, i.security_group_id, i.dns_records_per_max_binding_ratio FROM inner_cte i JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS sgpb ON sgpb.security_group_id = i.security_group_id JOIN PORTS p ON p.id = sgpb.port_id ) SELECT network_id, MAX(dns_records_per_max_binding_ratio) AS max_dns_records_per_max_binding_ratio FROM NetworkSecurityGroupRatios GROUP BY network_id;

question: Using the existing result set of ACTIVE networks that have an RBAC entry and max MTU greater than 8000 (restricted to the shared RBAC action) along with the IPv4 subnet IP-version statistics for the "access_as_shared" permission, show the same network-level rows but also include subtotals by RBAC action and a grand total, reporting the number of networks and the maximum MTU across each rollup level. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "access_as_shared" permission is predicated by "networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared'" "access_as_external" permission is predicated by "networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_external'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH RbacIpVersionStats AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_variance DESC ), HighMtuRbacNetworks AS ( SELECT n.name AS network_name, r.action AS rbac_action, MAX(n.mtu) AS max_mtu FROM NETWORKSECURITYBINDINGS nsb JOIN NETWORKS n ON nsb.network_id = n.id JOIN NETWORKRBACS r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND r.action IN ('access_as_shared', 'access_as_external') GROUP BY n.name, r.action HAVING MAX(n.mtu) > 8000 ), FilteredHighMtuSharedNetworks AS ( SELECT hmn.network_name, hmn.rbac_action, hmn.max_mtu FROM HighMtuRbacNetworks hmn WHERE hmn.rbac_action = 'access_as_shared' ) SELECT f.network_name, f.rbac_action, f.max_mtu, r.avg_ip_version, r.ip_version_variance, r.ip_version_stddev FROM FilteredHighMtuSharedNetworks f JOIN RbacIpVersionStats r ON r.ACTION = f.rbac_action ORDER BY f.max_mtu DESC, f.network_name) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.rbac_action) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE inner_cte.rbac_action END AS rbac_action, CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.network_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(inner_cte.rbac_action) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE inner_cte.network_name END AS network_name, COUNT(DISTINCT inner_cte.network_name) AS total_networks, MAX(inner_cte.max_mtu) AS max_mtu, MAX(inner_cte.avg_ip_version) AS avg_ip_version, MAX(inner_cte.ip_version_variance) AS ip_version_variance, MAX(inner_cte.ip_version_stddev) AS ip_version_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.rbac_action, inner_cte.network_name WITH ROLLUP;

question: For tenant ID '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7' and port status 'DOWN', produce the same combined two-part report as before (security-group-bound port summary by device owner, plus port-security-binding dispersion by status with a reason label), and additionally include a tenant-level context column that shows the total number of ports owned by that tenant and the average number of ports per tenant across the whole system. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Tenant ID "17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH PortStatusOwnerStats AS (SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS min_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS spb ON p.ID = spb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER), PortSecurityBindingDispersion AS (SELECT p.status, MAX(ps.binding_count) - MIN(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_range, VARIANCE(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_variance, STDDEV(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_stddev FROM ports AS p JOIN ( SELECT p2.id AS port_id, COUNT(*) AS binding_count FROM ports AS p2 JOIN portsecuritybindings AS b ON p2.id = b.port_id WHERE p2.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p2.id ) AS ps ON p.id = ps.port_id GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY binding_count_range DESC), CombinedPortStats AS ( SELECT pso.port_status AS status, pso.device_owner AS device_owner, pso.port_count AS port_count, pso.min_standard_attr_id AS min_standard_attr_id, NULL AS binding_count_range, NULL AS binding_count_variance, NULL AS binding_count_stddev, 'Security Group Bound Port Summary' AS reason FROM PortStatusOwnerStats pso UNION ALL SELECT psbd.status AS status, NULL AS device_owner, NULL AS port_count, NULL AS min_standard_attr_id, psbd.binding_count_range AS binding_count_range, psbd.binding_count_variance AS binding_count_variance, psbd.binding_count_stddev AS binding_count_stddev, 'Port Security Binding Dispersion' AS reason FROM PortSecurityBindingDispersion psbd ) SELECT * FROM CombinedPortStats ORDER BY status, reason, device_owner) SELECT inner_cte.*, tenant_totals.total_ports_for_tenant, avg_ports.avg_port_count_across_tenants FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT p.tenant_id, COUNT(p.id) AS total_ports_for_tenant FROM ports p GROUP BY p.tenant_id) AS tenant_totals ON tenant_totals.tenant_id = '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7' JOIN (SELECT AVG(port_count) AS avg_port_count_across_tenants FROM (SELECT COUNT(id) AS port_count FROM ports GROUP BY tenant_id) AS sub) AS avg_ports ON 1 = 1 ORDER BY inner_cte.status, inner_cte.reason, inner_cte.device_owner;

question: For each (non-shared) network status, show the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED across networks with at least one security binding, the number of RBAC rows for ACTIVE (non-shared) networks in that same status, and also include the average of those ACTIVE-network RBAC row counts across all statuses. SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH network_status_security_stats AS ( SELECT n.STATUS AS network_status, VARIANCE(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_variance, STDDEV(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_stddev FROM NETWORKS AS n JOIN NETWORKSECURITYBINDINGS AS nsb ON n.ID = nsb.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.STATUS ORDER BY port_security_enabled_variance DESC ), active_network_rbac_details AS ( SELECT n.name, n.status, n.admin_state_up, r.action, r.target_tenant, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.id ORDER BY n.id) AS window_column FROM networksecuritybindings b JOIN networks n ON b.network_id = n.id JOIN networkrbacs r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND n.id NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) ), active_network_rbac_summary AS ( SELECT status AS network_status, COUNT(*) AS active_network_rbac_row_count FROM active_network_rbac_details GROUP BY status ) SELECT nsss.network_status, nsss.port_security_enabled_variance, nsss.port_security_enabled_stddev, anrs.active_network_rbac_row_count FROM network_status_security_stats nsss LEFT JOIN active_network_rbac_summary anrs ON anrs.network_status = nsss.network_status) SELECT i.network_status, i.port_security_enabled_variance, i.port_security_enabled_stddev, i.active_network_rbac_row_count, avg_counts.avg_active_network_rbac_row_count FROM inner_cte i JOIN (SELECT AVG(active_network_rbac_row_count) AS avg_active_network_rbac_row_count FROM inner_cte) AS avg_counts ON 1 = 1;

question: For each ACTIVE network (with a security binding) that has an RBAC action of either 'access_as_shared' or 'access_as_external' and whose maximum MTU is greater than 8000, list the network name, the RBAC action, that maximum MTU, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of subnet IP version numbers for that RBAC action considering only DHCP-enabled subnets and excluding shared networks (those with an `access_as_shared` RBAC entry targeting `'*'` or `'9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'`), keeping only RBAC actions with more than 5 matching subnets, and also include the deviation of each network’s maximum MTU from the overall average of these maximum MTUs across all returned networks. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "exclusion of shared networks" is predicated by "networks.id NOT IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))" "access_as_shared" permission is predicated by "networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared'" "access_as_external" permission is predicated by "networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_external'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH RbacActionIpVersionStddev AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.ENABLE_DHCP = 1 AND s.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.ACTION HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY ip_version_stddev DESC ), ActiveHighMtuNetworksByRbacAction AS ( SELECT n.name AS network_name, r.action AS rbac_action, MAX(n.mtu) AS max_mtu FROM NETWORKSECURITYBINDINGS nsb JOIN NETWORKS n ON nsb.network_id = n.id JOIN NETWORKRBACS r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND r.action IN ('access_as_shared', 'access_as_external') GROUP BY n.name, r.action HAVING MAX(n.mtu) > 8000 ) SELECT ahmn.network_name, ahmn.rbac_action, ahmn.max_mtu, raivs.ip_version_stddev FROM ActiveHighMtuNetworksByRbacAction ahmn JOIN RbacActionIpVersionStddev raivs ON ahmn.rbac_action = raivs.ACTION ORDER BY ahmn.max_mtu DESC, raivs.ip_version_stddev DESC), AvgMaxMtu AS (SELECT AVG(max_mtu) AS avg_max_mtu FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.network_name, i.rbac_action, i.max_mtu, i.ip_version_stddev, (i.max_mtu - a.avg_max_mtu) AS deviation_from_avg_max_mtu FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN AvgMaxMtu a ORDER BY i.max_mtu DESC, i.ip_version_stddev DESC;

question: For the IPv4 subnet whose ID is `012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48`, return the subnet name, (1) the dense rank of its associated standard attribute when ordered by the standard attribute UPDATED_AT timestamp using a window frame of the current row and the 2 preceding rows, and (2) the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of routes per subnet; additionally, indicate whether the subnet’s standard attribute has a non-empty DESCRIPTION. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Subnet ID "012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48" is predicated by "subnets.id IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH SubnetWindowRanks AS ( SELECT s.NAME, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY sa.UPDATED_AT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES AS sa ON sa.ID = s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') ), SubnetRouteStats AS ( SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, MAX(route_count) - MIN(route_count) AS route_count_range, VARIANCE(route_count) AS route_count_variance, STDDEV(route_count) AS route_count_stddev FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN ( SELECT sr.SUBNET_ID, COUNT(*) AS route_count FROM SUBNETROUTES AS sr GROUP BY sr.SUBNET_ID, sr.NEXTHOP ) AS route_stats ON s.ID = route_stats.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') GROUP BY s.NAME ORDER BY route_count_range DESC ) SELECT swr.NAME AS subnet_name, swr.window_column, srs.route_count_range, srs.route_count_variance, srs.route_count_stddev FROM SubnetWindowRanks AS swr JOIN SubnetRouteStats AS srs ON srs.subnet_name = swr.NAME ORDER BY swr.NAME, swr.window_column) SELECT i.subnet_name, i.window_column, i.route_count_range, i.route_count_variance, i.route_count_stddev, CASE WHEN COALESCE(sa.DESCRIPTION, '') <> '' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_standardattr_description FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON s.NAME = i.subnet_name AND s.IP_VERSION = 4 JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES AS sa ON sa.ID = s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ORDER BY i.subnet_name, i.window_column;

question: For tenant ID '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7', using the counts of (1) administratively up ports with port security bindings and (2) DOWN ports with a standard-attributes running-sum window value, what is the maximum of these two counts? Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Tenant ID "17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH admin_up_port_security AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(psb.port_id) AS binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN psb.port_security_enabled THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS port_security_enabled_total FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address ), down_ports_window AS ( SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, SUM(sa.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY sa.RESOURCE_TYPE ORDER BY sa.ID) AS window_column FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') ) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM admin_up_port_security) AS admin_up_ports_with_security_bindings_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM down_ports_window) AS down_ports_with_standardattributes_window_count FROM admin_up_port_security aups CROSS JOIN down_ports_window dpw ) SELECT MAX(cnt) AS max_of_the_two_counts FROM ( SELECT inner_cte.admin_up_ports_with_security_bindings_count AS cnt FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT inner_cte.down_ports_with_standardattributes_window_count AS cnt FROM inner_cte ) t;

question: For the subnet with ID `012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48`, considering only subnet routes whose next hop is `10.30.19.197/8`, return the subnet name, (1) the range and variance of allocation-pool starting IPs (FIRST_IP), and (2) the dense-rank (using a window of the current row and 2 preceding rows) of its associated standard attribute when ordered by the standard attribute’s UPDATED_AT timestamp. Also include a rollup that adds a subtotal row per subnet name and a grand total row across all returned subnets. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Subnet ID "012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48" is predicated by "subnets.id IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH first_ip_stats AS ( SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, MAX(p.FIRST_IP) - MIN(p.FIRST_IP) AS first_ip_range, VARIANCE(p.FIRST_IP) AS first_ip_variance FROM SUBNETROUTES r JOIN SUBNETS s ON r.SUBNET_ID = s.ID JOIN IPALLOCATIONPOOLS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE r.NEXTHOP = '10.30.19.197/8' AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') GROUP BY s.NAME ORDER BY first_ip_range DESC ), subnet_attr_dense_rank AS ( SELECT s.NAME, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY sa.UPDATED_AT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES AS sa ON sa.ID = s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') ) SELECT fis.subnet_name, fis.first_ip_range, fis.first_ip_variance, sadr.window_column FROM first_ip_stats fis JOIN subnet_attr_dense_rank sadr ON sadr.NAME = fis.subnet_name ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.subnet_name) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE i.subnet_name END AS subnet_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.first_ip_range) = 1 AND GROUPING(i.subnet_name) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE CAST(i.first_ip_range AS CHAR) END AS first_ip_range, SUM(i.first_ip_variance) AS summed_first_ip_variance, SUM(i.window_column) AS summed_window_dense_rank FROM inner_cte i JOIN SUBNETS s2 ON s2.NAME = i.subnet_name LEFT JOIN SUBNETROUTES r2 ON r2.SUBNET_ID = s2.ID GROUP BY i.subnet_name, i.first_ip_range WITH ROLLUP;

question: For DOWN ports that belong to tenant ID '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57' and are on network ID '0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d', list the port ID, tenant ID, network ID, port name, MAC address, admin state, status, device owner, and security group ID, along with (1) the rank of each port within its security group ordered by port ID and (2) the minimum admin_state_up over a window of 3 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by port ID, but only for security groups that have at least 2 such DOWN ports. Additionally, do not repeat the security group ID if it is the same as the previous row, and include a subtotal row per security group showing the total number of qualifying DOWN ports. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')" Network ID "0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d" is predicated by "ports.network_id IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH TenantDownPortsBySecurityGroup AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, sgpb.security_group_id, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sgpb.security_group_id ORDER BY p.id) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), NetworkDownPortsWithMinAdminStateWindow AS ( SELECT p.NAME, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER ( ORDER BY p.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.NETWORK_ID IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d') ), SecurityGroupDownPortCounts AS ( SELECT sgpb.security_group_id, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS down_port_count FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') AND p.network_id IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d') GROUP BY sgpb.security_group_id ) SELECT tdp.port_id, tdp.tenant_id, ndp.network_id, ndp.name AS port_name, tdp.mac_address, ndp.admin_state_up, ndp.status, ndp.device_owner, tdp.security_group_id, tdp.window_column AS port_rank_within_security_group_by_port_id, ndp.window_column AS min_admin_state_up_in_3_preceding_1_following_window, sgc.down_port_count FROM TenantDownPortsBySecurityGroup AS tdp JOIN NetworkDownPortsWithMinAdminStateWindow AS ndp ON tdp.security_group_id = ndp.security_group_id AND tdp.mac_address = ndp.mac_address JOIN SecurityGroupDownPortCounts AS sgc ON tdp.security_group_id = sgc.security_group_id WHERE sgc.down_port_count >= 2 ORDER BY sgc.down_port_count DESC, tdp.security_group_id, tdp.port_id) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(security_group_id) OVER (ORDER BY security_group_id_sort, security_group_id, port_id) = security_group_id THEN NULL ELSE security_group_id END AS security_group_id, port_id, tenant_id, network_id, port_name, mac_address, admin_state_up, status, device_owner, port_rank_within_security_group_by_port_id, min_admin_state_up_in_3_preceding_1_following_window, down_port_count FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.security_group_id) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.security_group_id END AS security_group_id_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.security_group_id) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.security_group_id END AS security_group_id, i.port_id, i.tenant_id, i.network_id, i.port_name, i.mac_address, i.admin_state_up, i.status, i.device_owner, i.port_rank_within_security_group_by_port_id, i.min_admin_state_up_in_3_preceding_1_following_window, COUNT(*) AS down_port_count FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb2 ON sgpb2.security_group_id = i.security_group_id AND sgpb2.port_id = i.port_id JOIN PORTS AS p2 ON p2.id = sgpb2.port_id GROUP BY i.security_group_id, i.port_id, i.tenant_id, i.network_id, i.port_name, i.mac_address, i.admin_state_up, i.status, i.device_owner, i.port_rank_within_security_group_by_port_id, i.min_admin_state_up_in_3_preceding_1_following_window WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY security_group_id_sort, security_group_id, port_id;

question: For each network, return the network ID and the maximum (across DOWN port status and device owner) distinct port count among ports bound to a security group for tenant ID '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7', along with (for the same network) the minimum admin_state_up and average standard_attr_id for ports bound with VIF type 'ovs' whose device_id is 'da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7'. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Tenant ID "17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')" Device ID "da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7" is predicated by "ports.device_id IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH PortSecurityGroupStats AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS min_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS spb ON p.ID = spb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), OvsBindingPortStats AS ( SELECT p.STATUS, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) AS min_admin_state_up, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS avg_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS b ON p.ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE b.VIF_TYPE = 'ovs' AND p.DEVICE_ID IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS ) SELECT psgs.port_status, psgs.device_owner, psgs.port_count, psgs.min_standard_attr_id, obs.min_admin_state_up, obs.avg_standard_attr_id FROM PortSecurityGroupStats psgs JOIN OvsBindingPortStats obs ON psgs.port_status = obs.STATUS) SELECT p.NETWORK_ID AS network_id, MAX(inner_cte.port_count) AS max_distinct_port_count, MIN(inner_cte.min_admin_state_up) AS min_admin_state_up, AVG(inner_cte.avg_standard_attr_id) AS avg_standard_attr_id FROM inner_cte JOIN PORTS p ON p.STATUS = inner_cte.port_status GROUP BY p.NETWORK_ID;

question: For the RBAC action **access_as_shared**, return the action name together with the previously computed subnet IP-version statistics, and additionally report (for that same action) the **maximum number of distinct target tenants** associated with any single referenced network (i.e., per network, count distinct `TARGET_TENANT`, then take the maximum across networks). Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "exclusion of shared networks" is predicated by "networks.id NOT IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))" "access_as_shared" permission is predicated by "networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH Subq1 AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.ENABLE_DHCP = 1 AND s.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.ACTION HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY ip_version_stddev DESC ), Subq2 AS ( SELECT n.ACTION AS rbac_action, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, MAX(s.IP_VERSION) - MIN(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_range, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION IN (4, 6) AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_range DESC ) SELECT s2.rbac_action, s2.avg_ip_version, s2.ip_version_range, s2.ip_version_variance, s1.ip_version_stddev FROM Subq2 s2 LEFT JOIN Subq1 s1 ON s1.ACTION = s2.rbac_action ) , TargetTenantCountsPerNetwork AS ( SELECT n.action, n.object_id AS network_id, COUNT(DISTINCT n.target_tenant) AS distinct_target_tenants FROM NETWORKRBACS n JOIN SUBNETS s ON s.network_id = n.object_id WHERE n.action = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.action, n.object_id ), MaxTargetTenantsByAction AS ( SELECT action, MAX(distinct_target_tenants) AS max_distinct_target_tenants_on_any_network FROM TargetTenantCountsPerNetwork GROUP BY action ) SELECT i.rbac_action, i.avg_ip_version, i.ip_version_range, i.ip_version_variance, i.ip_version_stddev, m.max_distinct_target_tenants_on_any_network FROM inner_cte i LEFT JOIN MaxTargetTenantsByAction m ON m.action = i.rbac_action;

question: For tenant ID '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7' and ports with status 'DOWN', for each device owner show the port status, the number of distinct ports that are bound to a security group, the minimum standard attribute ID, and (for that same port status) the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of port security bindings per port; only include device owners whose distinct security-group-bound port count is greater than the average distinct security-group-bound port count among device owners with the same port status. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Tenant ID "17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH PortStatusOwnerSecurityGroupStats AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS min_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS spb ON p.ID = spb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), PortStatusBindingCountDispersion AS ( SELECT p.status, MAX(ps.binding_count) - MIN(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_range, VARIANCE(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_variance, STDDEV(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_stddev FROM ports AS p JOIN ( SELECT p2.id AS port_id, COUNT(*) AS binding_count FROM ports AS p2 JOIN portsecuritybindings AS b ON p2.id = b.port_id WHERE p2.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p2.id ) AS ps ON p.id = ps.port_id GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY binding_count_range DESC ) SELECT psosgs.port_status, psosgs.device_owner, psosgs.port_count, psosgs.min_standard_attr_id, psbcd.binding_count_range, psbcd.binding_count_variance, psbcd.binding_count_stddev FROM PortStatusOwnerSecurityGroupStats psosgs JOIN PortStatusBindingCountDispersion psbcd ON psosgs.port_status = psbcd.status ORDER BY psosgs.port_count DESC) , StatusAverages AS ( SELECT port_status, AVG(port_count) AS avg_port_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY port_status ) SELECT i.port_status, i.device_owner, i.port_count, i.min_standard_attr_id, i.binding_count_range, i.binding_count_variance, i.binding_count_stddev FROM inner_cte i JOIN StatusAverages sa ON sa.port_status = i.port_status WHERE i.port_count > (SELECT avg_port_count FROM StatusAverages WHERE StatusAverages.port_status = i.port_status) ORDER BY i.port_count DESC;

question: For tenant ID '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7', among DOWN ports on network '0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d' that are bound to a security group, list each device owner and security group ID along with the device-owner-level distinct DOWN port count and minimum standard attribute ID, include how many matching DOWN ports in that network fall under each device owner and security group, and also show the overall average of these matching DOWN-port counts across all returned device-owner/security-group rows. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Tenant ID "17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')" Network ID "0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d" is predicated by "ports.network_id IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH PortStatusOwnerAgg AS (SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS min_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS spb ON p.ID = spb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER), DownNetworkPortDetails AS (SELECT p.NAME, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER ( ORDER BY p.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.NETWORK_ID IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d')) SELECT dnpd.DEVICE_OWNER, dnpd.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, psa.port_count, psa.min_standard_attr_id, COUNT(*) AS matching_down_ports_in_network FROM DownNetworkPortDetails dnpd JOIN PORTS p ON p.MAC_ADDRESS = dnpd.MAC_ADDRESS AND p.NETWORK_ID = dnpd.NETWORK_ID AND p.DEVICE_OWNER = dnpd.DEVICE_OWNER AND p.STATUS = dnpd.STATUS JOIN PortStatusOwnerAgg psa ON psa.port_status = dnpd.STATUS AND psa.device_owner = dnpd.DEVICE_OWNER WHERE p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY dnpd.DEVICE_OWNER, dnpd.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, psa.port_count, psa.min_standard_attr_id ORDER BY matching_down_ports_in_network DESC, dnpd.DEVICE_OWNER, dnpd.SECURITY_GROUP_ID) SELECT inner_cte.DEVICE_OWNER, inner_cte.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, inner_cte.port_count, inner_cte.min_standard_attr_id, inner_cte.matching_down_ports_in_network, avg_stats.avg_matching_down_ports_in_network FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT AVG(matching_down_ports_in_network) AS avg_matching_down_ports_in_network FROM inner_cte) AS avg_stats ON 1 = 1;

question: For each port status, list the port status, device owner, number of ports, earliest standard attribute updated timestamp, and the variance of the standard attribute ID (using the same filtering rules as before: only ports whose standard attribute resource type is 'ports', excluding shared networks, and restricting to port statuses that also have an IP allocation with IP address 10.150.64.113/8). Do not repeat the port status if it is the same as the previous row, and include a subtotal row per port status across all device owners. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "exclusion of shared networks" is predicated by "networks.id NOT IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))" IP Address "10.150.64.113/8" is predicated by "ipallocations.ip_address IN ('10.150.64.113/8')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH PortStatusOwnerStats AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), PortStatusAttrIdVariance AS ( SELECT p.STATUS, VARIANCE(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS standard_attr_id_variance FROM PORTS AS p JOIN IPALLOCATIONS AS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID IS NOT NULL AND ia.IP_ADDRESS IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.STATUS ORDER BY standard_attr_id_variance DESC ) SELECT psos.port_status, psos.device_owner, psos.port_count, psos.earliest_standard_attr_update, psav.standard_attr_id_variance FROM PortStatusOwnerStats psos JOIN PortStatusAttrIdVariance psav ON psos.port_status = psav.STATUS ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(port_status) OVER (ORDER BY port_status_sort, port_status, device_owner) = port_status THEN NULL ELSE port_status END AS port_status, device_owner, port_count, earliest_standard_attr_update, standard_attr_id_variance FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.port_status) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.port_status END AS port_status_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.port_status) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.port_status END AS port_status, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.device_owner) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE i.device_owner END AS device_owner, SUM(i.port_count) AS port_count, MIN(i.earliest_standard_attr_update) AS earliest_standard_attr_update, MAX(i.standard_attr_id_variance) AS standard_attr_id_variance FROM inner_cte i GROUP BY i.port_status, i.device_owner WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY port_status_sort, port_status, device_owner;

question: Using the subnet with ID `012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48` (IPv4 only) and considering only routes whose next hop is `10.30.19.197/8`, return the subnet name, the range and variance of allocation-pool starting IPs (FIRST_IP) across its IP allocation pools, the dense-rank of its associated standard attribute when ordered by the standard attribute UPDATED_AT timestamp using a window frame of the current row and the 2 preceding rows, and also include the subnet CIDR and gateway IP. ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d') ), down_ports_with_security_groups_tenant_filtered AS ( SELECT dpsg.NAME, dpsg.NETWORK_ID, dpsg.MAC_ADDRESS, dpsg.ADMIN_STATE_UP, dpsg.STATUS, dpsg.DEVICE_OWNER, dpsg.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, dpsg.window_column FROM down_ports_with_security_groups dpsg JOIN ports p ON p.network_id = dpsg.NETWORK_ID AND p.mac_address = dpsg.MAC_ADDRESS WHERE p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') ) SELECT psbs.status, psbs.binding_count_range, psbs.binding_count_variance, psbs.binding_count_stddev, COUNT(*) AS down_port_rows_for_tenant_and_network FROM port_security_binding_stats_by_status psbs CROSS JOIN down_ports_with_security_groups_tenant_filtered dptf GROUP BY psbs.status, psbs.binding_count_range, psbs.binding_count_variance, psbs.binding_count_stddev ORDER BY psbs.binding_count_range DESC) , DownPortSecurityGroups AS ( SELECT p.network_id, p.id AS port_id, COUNT(DISTINCT spb.security_group_id) AS security_group_count FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ports p ON p.status = ic.status JOIN securitygroupportbindings spb ON p.id = spb.port_id WHERE p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') AND p.status = 'DOWN' AND p.network_id IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d') GROUP BY p.network_id, p.id ) SELECT ic.status, ic.binding_count_range, ic.binding_count_variance, ic.binding_count_stddev, ic.down_port_rows_for_tenant_and_network, MAX(dpsg.security_group_count) AS max_security_groups_on_any_down_port FROM inner_cte ic JOIN DownPortSecurityGroups dpsg ON dpsg.network_id IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d') GROUP BY ic.status, ic.binding_count_range, ic.binding_count_variance, ic.binding_count_stddev, ic.down_port_rows_for_tenant_and_network ORDER BY ic.binding_count_range DESC;

question: Among the (port status, device owner) pairs returned by the existing port aggregation (only ports whose standard attribute resource type is 'ports' and excluding shared networks), list only those pairs where more than 25% of the ports are DOWN ports on network ID '0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d' that have a security-group binding. For each qualifying pair, show the total port count, the earliest standard attribute updated timestamp, the count of such DOWN+security-group ports, and the resulting ratio. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "exclusion of shared networks" is predicated by "networks.id NOT IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))" Network ID "0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d" is predicated by "ports.network_id IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH PortStatusOwnerAgg AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), DownPortsWithSG AS ( SELECT p.NAME, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER ( ORDER BY p.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.NETWORK_ID IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d') ), DownPortsSGCounts AS ( SELECT dp.STATUS AS port_status, dp.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(*) AS down_ports_in_network_with_sg FROM DownPortsWithSG dp GROUP BY dp.STATUS, dp.DEVICE_OWNER ) SELECT psoa.port_status, psoa.device_owner, psoa.port_count, psoa.earliest_standard_attr_update, dpsc.down_ports_in_network_with_sg FROM PortStatusOwnerAgg psoa JOIN DownPortsSGCounts dpsc ON psoa.port_status = dpsc.port_status AND psoa.device_owner = dpsc.device_owner ORDER BY psoa.port_count DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.port_status, inner_cte.device_owner, inner_cte.port_count, inner_cte.earliest_standard_attr_update, inner_cte.down_ports_in_network_with_sg, (inner_cte.down_ports_in_network_with_sg * 1.0 / NULLIF(inner_cte.port_count, 0)) AS down_sg_ratio FROM inner_cte JOIN PORTS p2 ON p2.DEVICE_OWNER = inner_cte.device_owner AND p2.STATUS = inner_cte.port_status WHERE (inner_cte.down_ports_in_network_with_sg * 1.0 / NULLIF(inner_cte.port_count, 0)) > 0.25 GROUP BY inner_cte.port_status, inner_cte.device_owner, inner_cte.port_count, inner_cte.earliest_standard_attr_update, inner_cte.down_ports_in_network_with_sg ORDER BY down_sg_ratio DESC, inner_cte.port_count DESC;

question: For the RBAC action access_as_shared, list the top 10 RBAC-owning tenants (by number of distinct networks referenced by that action) and show, for each tenant: (1) the number of distinct networks referenced, (2) the average subnet IP version, (3) the subnet IP version range (max minus min), (4) the variance of subnet IP version considering only public RBAC entries where target_tenant = '*', and (5) the overall variance of subnet IP version across all subnets on networks referenced by that tenant’s RBAC entries for the action. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "public access" (wildcard) is predicated by "networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*'" "access_as_shared" permission is predicated by "networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH q1 AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' AND n.TARGET_TENANT = '*' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_variance DESC ), q2 AS ( SELECT n.ACTION AS rbac_action, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, MAX(s.IP_VERSION) - MIN(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_range, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION IN (4, 6) AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_range DESC ) SELECT q1.ACTION AS rbac_action, q2.avg_ip_version, q2.ip_version_range, q1.ip_version_variance AS public_access_ip_version_variance, q2.ip_version_variance AS overall_ip_version_variance FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.ACTION = q2.rbac_action ORDER BY q2.ip_version_range DESC ), tenant_stats AS ( SELECT n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT n.OBJECT_ID) AS distinct_networks_referenced, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, MAX(s.IP_VERSION) - MIN(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_range, VARIANCE(CASE WHEN n.TARGET_TENANT = '*' THEN s.IP_VERSION END) AS public_access_ip_version_variance, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS overall_ip_version_variance FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' AND s.IP_VERSION IN (4, 6) GROUP BY n.TENANT_ID ) SELECT t.tenant_id, t.distinct_networks_referenced, t.avg_ip_version, t.ip_version_range, t.public_access_ip_version_variance, t.overall_ip_version_variance, i.rbac_action AS action_name, i.public_access_ip_version_variance AS action_level_public_access_ip_version_variance, i.overall_ip_version_variance AS action_level_overall_ip_version_variance FROM tenant_stats t CROSS JOIN inner_cte i ORDER BY t.distinct_networks_referenced DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Using the existing result set for tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" (administratively-up ports on ACTIVE networks owned by the same tenant), summarize by tenant and report: the tenant ID, the total number of distinct matching networks, the total number of distinct matching ports, and whether the tenant has any matching ports with VIF type "ovs". Order by total ports descending and return only the top 10 tenants. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "networks.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')" Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH ActiveTenantNetworks AS (SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM NETWORKS n JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND n.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), AdminUpTenantPorts AS (SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')) SELECT n.network_id, n.network_name, n.tenant_id, n.admin_state_up AS network_admin_state_up, n.mtu, n.standard_attr_updated_at AS network_standard_attr_updated_at, n.window_column AS network_row_number_within_tenant, p.PORT_ID AS port_id, p.HOST AS port_host, p.VIF_TYPE AS port_vif_type, p.VNIC_TYPE AS port_vnic_type, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS port_mac_address, p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS port_device_owner, p.window_column AS port_avg_standard_attr_id_window FROM ActiveTenantNetworks n JOIN AdminUpTenantPorts p ON p.NETWORK_ID = n.network_id AND p.TENANT_ID = n.tenant_id ORDER BY n.network_name, p.PORT_ID) SELECT i.tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT i.network_id) AS total_networks, COUNT(DISTINCT i.port_id) AS total_ports, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN i.port_vif_type = 'ovs' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_ovs_vif_type FROM inner_cte i GROUP BY i.tenant_id ORDER BY total_ports DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each ACTIVE network (with a security binding) that has an RBAC action of either 'access_as_shared' or 'access_as_external' and whose maximum MTU is greater than 8000, list the network name, the RBAC action, that maximum MTU, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of subnet IP version numbers for that RBAC action considering only DHCP-enabled subnets and excluding shared networks (those with an `access_as_shared` RBAC entry targeting `'*'` or `'9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'`), keeping only RBAC actions with more than 5 matching subnets. Do not repeat the network name if it is the same as the previous row, and include a final TOTAL row across all returned networks. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "exclusion of shared networks" is predicated by "networks.id NOT IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))" "access_as_shared" permission is predicated by "networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared'" "access_as_external" permission is predicated by "networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_external'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH RbacActionIpVersionStddev AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.ENABLE_DHCP = 1 AND s.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.ACTION HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY ip_version_stddev DESC ), ActiveHighMtuNetworksByRbacAction AS ( SELECT n.name AS network_name, r.action AS rbac_action, MAX(n.mtu) AS max_mtu FROM NETWORKSECURITYBINDINGS nsb JOIN NETWORKS n ON nsb.network_id = n.id JOIN NETWORKRBACS r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND r.action IN ('access_as_shared', 'access_as_external') GROUP BY n.name, r.action HAVING MAX(n.mtu) > 8000 ) SELECT ahmn.network_name, ahmn.rbac_action, ahmn.max_mtu, raivs.ip_version_stddev FROM ActiveHighMtuNetworksByRbacAction ahmn JOIN RbacActionIpVersionStddev raivs ON ahmn.rbac_action = raivs.ACTION ORDER BY ahmn.max_mtu DESC, raivs.ip_version_stddev DESC) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(network_name) OVER (ORDER BY network_name_sort, network_name, rbac_action) = network_name THEN NULL ELSE network_name END AS network_name, rbac_action, max_mtu, ip_version_stddev FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(network_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE network_name END AS network_name_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(network_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE network_name END AS network_name, rbac_action, MAX(max_mtu) AS max_mtu, AVG(ip_version_stddev) AS ip_version_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY network_name, rbac_action WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY network_name_sort, network_name, rbac_action;

question: For the RBAC action restricted to the **access_as_shared** permission, show the action name together with (1) the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of subnet IP version considering only IPv4 subnets, and (2) the average, range (max minus min), and variance of subnet IP version considering both IPv4 and IPv6 subnets, for subnets whose network is referenced by that RBAC entry; additionally, include the deviation of each “both IPv4/IPv6” average from the overall average of those “both IPv4/IPv6” averages. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "access_as_shared" permission is predicated by "networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH sq1 AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_variance DESC ), sq2 AS ( SELECT n.ACTION AS rbac_action, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, MAX(s.IP_VERSION) - MIN(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_range, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION IN (4, 6) AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_range DESC ) SELECT sq2.rbac_action, sq1.avg_ip_version AS avg_ip_version_ipv4_only, sq1.ip_version_variance AS ip_version_variance_ipv4_only, sq1.ip_version_stddev AS ip_version_stddev_ipv4_only, sq2.avg_ip_version AS avg_ip_version_ipv4_or_ipv6, sq2.ip_version_range, sq2.ip_version_variance AS ip_version_variance_ipv4_or_ipv6 FROM sq2 JOIN sq1 ON sq2.rbac_action = sq1.ACTION ORDER BY sq2.ip_version_range DESC ), overall_avg AS ( SELECT AVG(avg_ip_version_ipv4_or_ipv6) AS overall_avg_ip_version_ipv4_or_ipv6 FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.rbac_action, i.avg_ip_version_ipv4_only, i.ip_version_variance_ipv4_only, i.ip_version_stddev_ipv4_only, i.avg_ip_version_ipv4_or_ipv6, i.ip_version_range, i.ip_version_variance_ipv4_or_ipv6, (i.avg_ip_version_ipv4_or_ipv6 - oa.overall_avg_ip_version_ipv4_or_ipv6) AS deviation_from_overall_avg_ipv4_or_ipv6 FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa ORDER BY i.ip_version_range DESC;

question: For tenant ID '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57', for each qualifying administratively up port that is both bound to a security group and has at least one IP allocation, return the port ID, tenant ID, port name, MAC address, the number of security group bindings, the total number of DNS records on the port, the number of IP allocations, the total number of subnet-id rows from those allocations, along with the average number of IP allocations per qualifying port for that tenant. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH SecurityGroupAndDnsByPort AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.name AS port_name, COUNT(sgpb.security_group_id) AS security_group_binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pd.port_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS dns_record_count FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS sgpb JOIN PORTS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id LEFT JOIN PORTDNSES pd ON p.id = pd.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.name ), IpAllocationsByPort AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ia.subnet_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subnet_id_rows FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON ia.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND ia.ip_address IS NOT NULL AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address ) SELECT sgd.port_id, sgd.tenant_id, sgd.port_name, ipa.mac_address, sgd.security_group_binding_count, sgd.dns_record_count, ipa.ip_allocation_count, ipa.subnet_id_rows FROM SecurityGroupAndDnsByPort sgd JOIN IpAllocationsByPort ipa ON ipa.port_id = sgd.port_id AND ipa.tenant_id = sgd.tenant_id) SELECT i.port_id, i.tenant_id, i.port_name, i.mac_address, i.security_group_binding_count, i.dns_record_count, i.ip_allocation_count, i.subnet_id_rows, avg_ip.avg_ip_allocations_per_port FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT tenant_id, AVG(ip_allocation_count) AS avg_ip_allocations_per_port FROM inner_cte GROUP BY tenant_id ) AS avg_ip ON avg_ip.tenant_id = i.tenant_id;

question: For each ACTIVE network (excluding shared networks with an `access_as_shared` RBAC entry targeting `'*'` or `9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b`), list the network name, status, and admin_state_up along with its RBAC action and target tenant (including the dense-rank window column) and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of subnet IP version for that RBAC action (computed only from DHCP-enabled subnets on non-shared networks, considering only actions that have more than 5 matching subnets). Additionally, only include networks whose DHCP-enabled subnet count is above the average DHCP-enabled subnet count across all non-shared networks. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "exclusion of shared networks" is predicated by "networks.id NOT IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH RbacActionIpVersionStddev AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.ENABLE_DHCP = 1 AND s.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.ACTION HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY ip_version_stddev DESC ), ActiveNetworkRbacDetails AS ( SELECT n.name, n.status, n.admin_state_up, r.action, r.target_tenant, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.id ORDER BY n.id) AS window_column FROM networksecuritybindings b JOIN networks n ON b.network_id = n.id JOIN networkrbacs r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND n.id NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) ) SELECT anrd.name, anrd.status, anrd.admin_state_up, anrd.action, anrd.target_tenant, anrd.window_column, rais.ip_version_stddev FROM ActiveNetworkRbacDetails anrd JOIN RbacActionIpVersionStddev rais ON anrd.action = rais.action ORDER BY rais.ip_version_stddev DESC, anrd.name) , NetworkDhcpSubnetCounts AS ( SELECT n.id AS network_id, COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) AS dhcp_subnet_count FROM networks n JOIN subnets s ON s.network_id = n.id WHERE s.enable_dhcp = 1 AND n.id NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.id ), AvgDhcpSubnetCount AS ( SELECT AVG(dhcp_subnet_count * 1.0) AS avg_dhcp_subnet_count FROM NetworkDhcpSubnetCounts ) SELECT i.name, i.status, i.admin_state_up, i.action, i.target_tenant, i.window_column, i.ip_version_stddev, ndsc.dhcp_subnet_count FROM inner_cte i JOIN networks n ON n.name = i.name AND n.status = i.status AND n.admin_state_up = i.admin_state_up JOIN NetworkDhcpSubnetCounts ndsc ON ndsc.network_id = n.id CROSS JOIN AvgDhcpSubnetCount adc WHERE ndsc.dhcp_subnet_count > adc.avg_dhcp_subnet_count ORDER BY i.ip_version_stddev DESC, ndsc.dhcp_subnet_count DESC, i.name;

question: For ACTIVE networks that have an RBAC entry with action **access_as_shared** and whose maximum MTU (within each network name and RBAC action group) is greater than 8000, list the network name, RBAC action, and that maximum MTU, along with the average, range (max minus min), and variance of subnet IP version (restricted to IP versions 4 and 6) for subnets whose network is referenced by **access_as_shared** RBAC entries. SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH RbacSubnetIpVersionStats AS ( SELECT n.ACTION AS rbac_action, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, MAX(s.IP_VERSION) - MIN(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_range, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION IN (4, 6) AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_range DESC ), HighMtuActiveRbacNetworks AS ( SELECT n.name AS network_name, r.action AS rbac_action, MAX(n.mtu) AS max_mtu FROM NETWORKSECURITYBINDINGS nsb JOIN NETWORKS n ON nsb.network_id = n.id JOIN NETWORKRBACS r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND r.action IN ('access_as_shared', 'access_as_external') GROUP BY n.name, r.action HAVING MAX(n.mtu) > 8000 ) SELECT hman.network_name, hman.rbac_action, hman.max_mtu, rsivs.avg_ip_version, rsivs.ip_version_range, rsivs.ip_version_variance FROM HighMtuActiveRbacNetworks hman JOIN RbacSubnetIpVersionStats rsivs ON hman.rbac_action = rsivs.rbac_action WHERE hman.rbac_action = 'access_as_shared' ORDER BY hman.max_mtu DESC, hman.network_name ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(network_name) OVER (ORDER BY network_name_sort, network_name) = network_name THEN NULL ELSE network_name END AS network_name, rbac_action, max_mtu, avg_ip_version, ip_version_range, ip_version_variance FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(network_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE network_name END AS network_name_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(network_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE network_name END AS network_name, MAX(rbac_action) AS rbac_action, MAX(max_mtu) AS max_mtu, AVG(avg_ip_version) AS avg_ip_version, AVG(ip_version_range) AS ip_version_range, AVG(ip_version_variance) AS ip_version_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY network_name WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY network_name_sort, network_name;

question: For tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57", return the active network count, the latest network standard-attribute updated_at timestamp, and the admin-up port/IP-allocation summary; additionally, compute what percentage of that tenant’s IP allocation rows have a non-NULL subnet_id (subnet-id row utilization percentage) and only return the tenant if this percentage is greater than 75%. SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH active_networks AS ( SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM NETWORKS n JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND n.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), admin_up_ports_with_ip_allocs AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ia.subnet_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subnet_id_rows FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON ia.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND ia.ip_address IS NOT NULL AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address ), tenant_port_ip_summary AS ( SELECT p.tenant_id, COUNT(*) AS admin_up_port_count, SUM(p.ip_allocation_count) AS total_ip_allocations, SUM(p.subnet_id_rows) AS total_subnet_id_rows FROM admin_up_ports_with_ip_allocs p GROUP BY p.tenant_id ) SELECT an.tenant_id, COUNT(an.network_id) AS active_network_count, MAX(an.standard_attr_updated_at) AS latest_network_standard_attr_updated_at, tps.admin_up_port_count, tps.total_ip_allocations, tps.total_subnet_id_rows FROM active_networks an JOIN tenant_port_ip_summary tps ON tps.tenant_id = an.tenant_id WHERE an.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY an.tenant_id, tps.admin_up_port_count, tps.total_ip_allocations, tps.total_subnet_id_rows ) SELECT tenant_id, active_network_count, latest_network_standard_attr_updated_at, admin_up_port_count, total_ip_allocations, total_subnet_id_rows, (total_subnet_id_rows * 1.0 / NULLIF(total_ip_allocations, 0)) AS subnet_id_row_utilization_pct FROM inner_cte WHERE total_ip_allocations > 0 AND (total_subnet_id_rows * 1.0 / total_ip_allocations) > 0.75;

question: For each port status and device owner, considering only ports whose standard attribute resource type is 'ports' and excluding shared networks (networks whose IDs appear in networkrbacs with action = 'access_as_shared' and target_tenant = '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'), list the port count and the earliest standard attribute updated timestamp, and also include (by port status) the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of allocated IP address string lengths for ports with port security enabled restricted to IP address '10.150.64.113/8'. Then, for each port status, return the maximum coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) observed across its device owners. Do not return any rounded answers.

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH PortCountsAndEarliestUpdate AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), PortStatusIpLengthVariation AS ( SELECT p.status, STDDEV(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) / NULLIF(AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM portsecuritybindings psb JOIN ports p ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON p.id = ia.port_id WHERE psb.port_security_enabled = 1 AND ia.ip_address IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), CombinedPortStatusMetrics AS ( SELECT pc.port_status AS port_status, pc.device_owner AS device_owner, pc.port_count AS port_count, pc.earliest_standard_attr_update AS earliest_standard_attr_update, pv.coefficient_of_variation AS coefficient_of_variation FROM PortCountsAndEarliestUpdate pc JOIN PortStatusIpLengthVariation pv ON pv.status = pc.port_status ) SELECT port_status, device_owner, port_count, earliest_standard_attr_update, coefficient_of_variation FROM CombinedPortStatusMetrics ORDER BY port_status, device_owner) SELECT port_status, MAX(coefficient_of_variation) AS max_coefficient_of_variation_across_device_owners FROM inner_cte GROUP BY port_status ORDER BY port_status;

question: Using the per-(DOWN status, device owner) port statistics for ports in tenant '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7' that are bound to a security group (including the matching per-status OVS-binding stats for device_id 'da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7'), list the top 10 device owners by distinct port count and indicate whether each device owner has any of those ports bound with VIF type 'ovs'. SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH PortSecurityGroupStats AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS min_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS spb ON p.ID = spb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), OvsBindingPortStats AS ( SELECT p.STATUS, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) AS min_admin_state_up, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS avg_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS b ON p.ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE b.VIF_TYPE = 'ovs' AND p.DEVICE_ID IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS ) SELECT psgs.port_status, psgs.device_owner, psgs.port_count, psgs.min_standard_attr_id, obs.min_admin_state_up, obs.avg_standard_attr_id FROM PortSecurityGroupStats psgs JOIN OvsBindingPortStats obs ON psgs.port_status = obs.STATUS) SELECT i.device_owner, i.port_status, i.port_count, i.min_standard_attr_id, i.min_admin_state_up, i.avg_standard_attr_id, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT b2.port_id) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_ovs_bound_ports FROM inner_cte i LEFT JOIN PORTS p2 ON p2.DEVICE_OWNER = i.device_owner AND p2.STATUS = i.port_status LEFT JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS b2 ON b2.PORT_ID = p2.ID AND b2.VIF_TYPE = 'ovs' GROUP BY i.device_owner, i.port_status, i.port_count, i.min_standard_attr_id, i.min_admin_state_up, i.avg_standard_attr_id ORDER BY i.port_count DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each port status and device owner, show the number of ports and the earliest standard-attribute updated timestamp (considering only ports whose standard attribute resource type is 'ports' and excluding shared networks), and also include the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of ports’ standard attribute IDs for that same port status (considering only ports that have both a security group port binding and a port security binding, restricted to tenant_id '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7'). SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH PortStatusVariation AS ( SELECT p.status, STDDEV(p.standard_attr_id) / NULLIF(AVG(p.standard_attr_id), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM securitygroupportbindings AS sgpb JOIN ports AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN portsecuritybindings AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(p.standard_attr_id) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), PortStatusDeviceOwnerStats AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ) SELECT psdo.port_status, psdo.device_owner, psdo.port_count, psdo.earliest_standard_attr_update, psv.coefficient_of_variation FROM PortStatusDeviceOwnerStats psdo JOIN PortStatusVariation psv ON psdo.port_status = psv.status ORDER BY psdo.port_count DESC, psv.coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(port_status) OVER (ORDER BY port_status_sort, port_status, device_owner) = port_status THEN NULL ELSE port_status END AS port_status, device_owner, port_count, earliest_standard_attr_update, coefficient_of_variation FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN device_owner, SUM(i.port_count) AS port_count, MIN(i.earliest_standard_attr_update) AS earliest_standard_attr_update, AVG(i.coefficient_of_variation) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte i GROUP SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH sq1 AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN tenant_port_rows, AVG(sq2.window_column) AS avg_window_standard_attr_id FROM sq2 JOIN sq1 ON sq2.STATUS = sq1.port_status AND sq2.DEVICE_OWNER = sq1.device_owner WHERE sq2.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT i.earliest_standard_attr_update, i.tenant_port_rows, i.avg_window_standard_attr_id, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN sa2.UPDATED_AT IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_missing_standard_attr_updated_at FROM inner_cte i JOIN PORTS p2 ON p2.STATUS = i.port_status AND p2.DEVICE_OWNER = i.device_owner JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa2 ON sa2.ID = p2.STANDARD_ATTR_ID AND question: Using the existing result set that (a) aggregates port counts and earliest standard-attribute update time by (port status, device owner) while excluding shared networks and (b) lists DOWN ports on network '0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d' with their security-group bindings and a 3-preceding/1-following window minimum of admin_state_up, return the top 10 (port status, device owner) pairs by port_count and, for each pair, show the port_count, earliest_standard_attr_update, and whether any of the DOWN ports in the detailed set have at least one security group bound.
