SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH PortStatusOwnerAgg AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), DownPortsWithSecGroup AS ( SELECT p.NAME, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER ( ORDER BY p.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.NETWORK_ID IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d') ) SELECT psa.port_status, psa.device_owner, psa.port_count, psa.earliest_standard_attr_update, dp.NAME AS down_port_name, dp.NETWORK_ID AS down_port_network_id, dp.MAC_ADDRESS AS down_port_mac_address, dp.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS down_port_admin_state_up, dp.STATUS AS down_port_status, dp.DEVICE_OWNER AS down_port_device_owner, dp.SECURITY_GROUP_ID AS down_port_security_group_id, dp.window_column AS down_port_window_min_admin_state_up FROM PortStatusOwnerAgg psa CROSS JOIN DownPortsWithSecGroup dp) SELECT inner_cte.port_status, inner_cte.device_owner, MAX(inner_cte.port_count) AS port_count, MIN(inner_cte.earliest_standard_attr_update) AS earliest_standard_attr_update, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT inner_cte.down_port_security_group_id) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS any_down_ports_have_security_group FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.port_status, inner_cte.device_owner ORDER BY port_count DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For the IPv4 subnet with ID '012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48', return the subnet’s name, tenant ID, network ID, IP version, CIDR, gateway IP, DHCP enabled flag, and allocation pool first/last IP, along with each associated subnet route’s destination and next hop. Also include (1) the maximum subnet standard attribute ID over the current subnet row and the next two rows when ordered by subnet ID, (2) the dense-rank value for each route within the subnet, and (3) a Yes/No flag indicating whether the subnet has any routes at all plus the total number of distinct routes for that subnet. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Subnet ID "012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48" is predicated by "subnets.id IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH q1 AS ( SELECT s.NAME, s.TENANT_ID, s.NETWORK_ID, s.IP_VERSION, s.CIDR, s.GATEWAY_IP, s.ENABLE_DHCP, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, MAX(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( ORDER BY s.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN IPALLOCATIONPOOLS AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') ), q2 AS ( SELECT r.DESTINATION, r.NEXTHOP, s.NAME AS subnet_name, s.CIDR AS subnet_cidr, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.SUBNET_ID ORDER BY r.SUBNET_ID) AS window_column FROM SUBNETROUTES r JOIN SUBNETS s ON r.SUBNET_ID = s.ID JOIN IPALLOCATIONPOOLS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') ) SELECT q1.NAME AS subnet_name, q1.TENANT_ID, q1.NETWORK_ID, q1.IP_VERSION, q1.CIDR, q1.GATEWAY_IP, q1.ENABLE_DHCP, q1.FIRST_IP AS allocation_first_ip, q1.LAST_IP AS allocation_last_ip, q1.max_standard_attr_id_next2, q2.DESTINATION AS route_destination, q2.NEXTHOP AS route_nexthop, q2.window_column AS route_dense_rank_within_subnet FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.NAME = q2.subnet_name AND q1.CIDR = q2.subnet_cidr AND q1.FIRST_IP = q2.FIRST_IP AND q1.LAST_IP = q2.LAST_IP ORDER BY q1.NAME, q2.window_column, q2.DESTINATION ), route_stats AS ( SELECT s.id AS subnet_id, COUNT(DISTINCT r.destination || '|' || r.nexthop) AS total_distinct_routes, CASE WHEN COUNT(r.subnet_id) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_any_routes FROM subnets s LEFT JOIN subnetroutes r ON r.subnet_id = s.id WHERE s.ip_version = 4 AND s.id IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') GROUP BY s.id ) SELECT i.subnet_name, i.tenant_id, i.network_id, i.ip_version, i.cidr, i.gateway_ip, i.enable_dhcp, i.allocation_first_ip, i.allocation_last_ip, i.max_standard_attr_id_next2, i.route_destination, i.route_nexthop, i.route_dense_rank_within_subnet, rs.has_any_routes, rs.total_distinct_routes FROM inner_cte i JOIN subnets s ON s.name = i.subnet_name AND s.cidr = i.cidr AND s.ip_version = i.ip_version JOIN ipallocationpools p ON p.subnet_id = s.id AND p.first_ip = i.allocation_first_ip AND p.last_ip = i.allocation_last_ip JOIN route_stats rs ON rs.subnet_id = s.id ORDER BY i.subnet_name, i.route_dense_rank_within_subnet, i.route_destination;

question: For tenant ID '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57', among VIF types where more than 25% of administratively up ports are also in the DOWN-port set (as identified via security-group-to-port bindings), show the VIF type, the number of admin-up ports, the number of those that are DOWN, the DOWN fraction, and whether any of those admin-up ports have at least one security group binding. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DownTenantPortsBySecurityGroup AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, sgpb.security_group_id, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sgpb.security_group_id ORDER BY p.id) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), AdminUpTenantPortsWithVifWindow AS (SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')) SELECT aup.VIF_TYPE, COUNT(*) AS admin_up_port_count, COUNT(dtp.port_id) AS down_port_count, (COUNT(dtp.port_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(*)) AS down_share_of_admin_up_ports FROM AdminUpTenantPortsWithVifWindow aup LEFT JOIN DownTenantPortsBySecurityGroup dtp ON dtp.port_id = aup.PORT_ID GROUP BY aup.VIF_TYPE HAVING (COUNT(dtp.port_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(*)) > 0.25) SELECT i.VIF_TYPE, i.admin_up_port_count, i.down_port_count, i.down_share_of_admin_up_ports, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT sgpb.port_id) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_any_security_group_binding_among_admin_up_ports FROM inner_cte i JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS b ON b.VIF_TYPE = i.VIF_TYPE JOIN PORTS p ON p.id = b.port_id AND p.tenant_id = '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57' AND p.admin_state_up = 1 LEFT JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS sgpb ON sgpb.port_id = p.id GROUP BY i.VIF_TYPE, i.admin_up_port_count, i.down_port_count, i.down_share_of_admin_up_ports ORDER BY i.down_share_of_admin_up_ports DESC;

question: For each port status (for tenant '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7' ports that have at least one port security binding), report the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of port security bindings per port; and alongside that, for administratively up ports belonging to tenant '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57', show how many such ports exist and whether any of them have an ML2 port binding with VIF type 'ovs', plus the average of their windowed average standard attribute ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Tenant ID "17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')" Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH port_security_binding_stats_by_status AS ( SELECT p.status, MAX(ps.binding_count) - MIN(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_range, VARIANCE(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_variance, STDDEV(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_stddev FROM ports AS p JOIN ( SELECT p2.id AS port_id, COUNT(*) AS binding_count FROM ports AS p2 JOIN portsecuritybindings AS b ON p2.id = b.port_id WHERE p2.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p2.id ) AS ps ON p.id = ps.port_id GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY binding_count_range DESC ), admin_up_port_windowed_standard_attr AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ) SELECT psbs.status, psbs.binding_count_range, psbs.binding_count_variance, psbs.binding_count_stddev, COUNT(aw.PORT_ID) AS admin_up_ports_count, AVG(aw.window_column) AS avg_window_column FROM port_security_binding_stats_by_status psbs CROSS JOIN admin_up_port_windowed_standard_attr aw GROUP BY psbs.status, psbs.binding_count_range, psbs.binding_count_variance, psbs.binding_count_stddev) SELECT i.status, i.binding_count_range, i.binding_count_variance, i.binding_count_stddev, i.admin_up_ports_count, i.avg_window_column, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT mb.PORT_ID) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_any_ovs_binding FROM inner_cte i LEFT JOIN PORTS p_admin ON p_admin.TENANT_ID = '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57' AND p_admin.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 LEFT JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS mb ON mb.PORT_ID = p_admin.ID AND mb.VIF_TYPE = 'ovs' GROUP BY i.status, i.binding_count_range, i.binding_count_variance, i.binding_count_stddev, i.admin_up_ports_count, i.avg_window_column;

question: For each network ID, find the network ID and the highest security-group binding count of any port in that network, considering only ports that (1) are bound to a security group, have admin_state_up = 1, and belong to tenant ID '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57', and also (2) are DOWN on network ID '0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d'. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')" Network ID "0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d" is predicated by "ports.network_id IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH TenantAdminUpBoundPorts AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.name AS port_name, COUNT(sgpb.security_group_id) AS security_group_binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pd.port_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS dns_record_count FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS sgpb JOIN PORTS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id LEFT JOIN PORTDNSES pd ON p.id = pd.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.name ), DownNetworkPortsWithWindow AS ( SELECT p.NAME, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER ( ORDER BY p.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.NETWORK_ID IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d') ), DownNetworkPortsWithWindowAndId AS ( SELECT p.ID AS port_id, q.NAME, q.NETWORK_ID, q.MAC_ADDRESS, q.ADMIN_STATE_UP, q.STATUS, q.DEVICE_OWNER, q.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, q.window_column FROM DownNetworkPortsWithWindow q JOIN PORTS p ON p.NAME = q.NAME AND p.NETWORK_ID = q.NETWORK_ID AND p.MAC_ADDRESS = q.MAC_ADDRESS AND p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = q.ADMIN_STATE_UP AND p.STATUS = q.STATUS AND p.DEVICE_OWNER = q.DEVICE_OWNER ) SELECT d.port_id, t.tenant_id, t.port_name, d.network_id, d.mac_address, d.admin_state_up, d.status, d.device_owner, d.security_group_id, d.window_column, t.security_group_binding_count, t.dns_record_count FROM DownNetworkPortsWithWindowAndId d JOIN TenantAdminUpBoundPorts t ON d.port_id = t.port_id ORDER BY d.network_id, d.port_id, d.security_group_id) SELECT network_id, MAX(security_group_binding_count) AS max_security_group_bindings_on_any_port FROM inner_cte GROUP BY network_id;

question: For each port status, list the status, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) (standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) divided by average) of allocated IP address string lengths for ports with port security enabled restricted to IP address '10.150.64.113/8', along with the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of port security bindings per port for ports belonging to tenant ID '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7', and also include the total number of distinct ports observed for that status and the average of those per-status port totals across all statuses. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: IP Address "10.150.64.113/8" is predicated by "ipallocations.ip_address IN ('10.150.64.113/8')" Tenant ID "17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH PortStatusIPLenCV AS ( SELECT p.status, STDDEV(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) / NULLIF(AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM portsecuritybindings psb JOIN ports p ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON p.id = ia.port_id WHERE psb.port_security_enabled = 1 AND ia.ip_address IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), PortStatusBindingDispersion AS ( SELECT p.status, MAX(ps.binding_count) - MIN(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_range, VARIANCE(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_variance, STDDEV(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_stddev FROM ports AS p JOIN ( SELECT p2.id AS port_id, COUNT(*) AS binding_count FROM ports AS p2 JOIN portsecuritybindings AS b ON p2.id = b.port_id WHERE p2.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p2.id ) AS ps ON p.id = ps.port_id GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY binding_count_range DESC ) SELECT pilcv.status, pilcv.coefficient_of_variation, pbd.binding_count_range, pbd.binding_count_variance, pbd.binding_count_stddev FROM PortStatusIPLenCV pilcv JOIN PortStatusBindingDispersion pbd ON pilcv.status = pbd.status ORDER BY pilcv.coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT i.status, i.coefficient_of_variation, i.binding_count_range, i.binding_count_variance, i.binding_count_stddev, sp.status_port_count, avg_sp.avg_status_port_count FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN ( SELECT p.status, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS status_port_count FROM ports p JOIN ipallocations ia ON ia.port_id = p.id JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON psb.port_id = p.id WHERE psb.port_security_enabled = 1 AND ia.ip_address IN ('10.150.64.113/8') AND p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.status ) AS sp ON sp.status = i.status JOIN ( SELECT AVG(status_port_count) AS avg_status_port_count FROM ( SELECT p2.status, COUNT(DISTINCT p2.id) AS status_port_count FROM ports p2 JOIN ipallocations ia2 ON ia2.port_id = p2.id JOIN portsecuritybindings psb2 ON psb2.port_id = p2.id WHERE psb2.port_security_enabled = 1 AND ia2.ip_address IN ('10.150.64.113/8') AND p2.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p2.status ) AS sub ) AS avg_sp ORDER BY i.coefficient_of_variation DESC;

question: For the IPv4 subnet with subnet ID in ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48'), return the subnet name, tenant ID, network ID, IP version, CIDR, gateway IP, DHCP enabled flag, allocation pool first and last IPs, the maximum subnet standard attribute ID over the current row and next 2 rows (ordered by subnet ID), and the dense-rank window value of its standard attribute when ordered by the standard attribute updated-at timestamp over the current row and 2 preceding rows; also include the tenant’s total number of IPv4 subnets and the average number of IPv4 subnets per tenant across all tenants. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Subnet ID "012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48" is predicated by "subnets.id IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH SubnetPoolAndMaxAttrNext2 AS (SELECT s.NAME, s.TENANT_ID, s.NETWORK_ID, s.IP_VERSION, s.CIDR, s.GATEWAY_IP, s.ENABLE_DHCP, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, MAX(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( ORDER BY s.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN IPALLOCATIONPOOLS AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48')), SubnetAttrDenseRankWindow AS (SELECT s.NAME, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY sa.UPDATED_AT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES AS sa ON sa.ID = s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48')) SELECT sp.NAME AS subnet_name, sp.TENANT_ID, sp.NETWORK_ID, sp.IP_VERSION, sp.CIDR, sp.GATEWAY_IP, sp.ENABLE_DHCP, sp.FIRST_IP, sp.LAST_IP, sp.max_standard_attr_id_next2, sadr.window_column AS standard_attr_dense_rank_window FROM SubnetPoolAndMaxAttrNext2 sp JOIN SubnetAttrDenseRankWindow sadr ON sp.NAME = sadr.NAME) SELECT i.subnet_name, i.tenant_id, i.network_id, i.ip_version, i.cidr, i.gateway_ip, i.enable_dhcp, i.first_ip, i.last_ip, i.max_standard_attr_id_next2, i.standard_attr_dense_rank_window, tenant_subnets.total_ipv4_subnets, avg_subnets.avg_ipv4_subnets_per_tenant FROM inner_cte i JOIN (SELECT tenant_id, COUNT(id) AS total_ipv4_subnets FROM subnets WHERE ip_version = 4 GROUP BY tenant_id) AS tenant_subnets ON tenant_subnets.tenant_id = i.tenant_id JOIN (SELECT AVG(subnet_count) AS avg_ipv4_subnets_per_tenant FROM (SELECT COUNT(id) AS subnet_count FROM subnets WHERE ip_version = 4 GROUP BY tenant_id) AS per_tenant) AS avg_subnets ON 1 = 1;

question: Using the RBAC/subnet IP-version statistics result as an inner CTE, for each RBAC action show the action-level metrics (average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of IP version for the shared IPv4 set; and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of IP version for the DHCP-enabled not-shared set) and also include a rollup that adds a subtotal row per action and a grand total row across all actions. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "access_as_shared" permission is predicated by "networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared'" "exclusion of shared networks" is predicated by "networks.id NOT IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH rbac_ip_version_stats_shared AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_variance DESC ), rbac_ip_version_stddev_dhcp_not_shared AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.ENABLE_DHCP = 1 AND s.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.ACTION HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY ip_version_stddev DESC ) SELECT s1.ACTION, s1.avg_ip_version, s1.ip_version_variance, s1.ip_version_stddev AS shared_ip_version_stddev, s2.ip_version_stddev AS dhcp_not_shared_ip_version_stddev FROM rbac_ip_version_stats_shared s1 JOIN rbac_ip_version_stddev_dhcp_not_shared s2 ON s1.ACTION = s2.ACTION) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.ACTION) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE i.ACTION END AS ACTION, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.avg_ip_version) = 1 AND GROUPING(i.ACTION) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE 'DETAIL' END AS row_level, AVG(i.avg_ip_version) AS avg_ip_version, AVG(i.ip_version_variance) AS ip_version_variance, AVG(i.shared_ip_version_stddev) AS shared_ip_version_stddev, AVG(i.dhcp_not_shared_ip_version_stddev) AS dhcp_not_shared_ip_version_stddev FROM inner_cte i JOIN NETWORKRBACS n ON n.ACTION = i.ACTION GROUP BY i.ACTION, i.avg_ip_version WITH ROLLUP;

question: For tenant_id '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7' and ports with status 'DOWN' that are bound to a security group, list each device owner with the distinct port count and the minimum standard attribute ID, also show (by port status) the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of standard attribute IDs for ports that have both a security group port binding and a port security binding, and additionally indicate whether each device owner has any ports that are associated with a floating IP (via fixed_port_id). Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Tenant ID "17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH Subq1 AS ( SELECT p.status, STDDEV(p.standard_attr_id) / NULLIF(AVG(p.standard_attr_id), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM securitygroupportbindings AS sgpb JOIN ports AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN portsecuritybindings AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(p.standard_attr_id) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), Subq2 AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS min_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS spb ON p.ID = spb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ) SELECT s2.port_status, s2.device_owner, s2.port_count, s2.min_standard_attr_id, s1.coefficient_of_variation FROM Subq2 s2 JOIN Subq1 s1 ON s2.port_status = s1.status ) SELECT i.port_status, i.device_owner, i.port_count, i.min_standard_attr_id, i.coefficient_of_variation, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT f.id) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_floating_ips FROM inner_cte i JOIN ports p2 ON p2.tenant_id = '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7' AND p2.status = i.port_status AND p2.device_owner = i.device_owner LEFT JOIN floatingips f ON p2.id = f.fixed_port_id GROUP BY i.port_status, i.device_owner, i.port_count, i.min_standard_attr_id, i.coefficient_of_variation;

question: For each port status and device owner (considering only ports whose standard attribute resource type is 'ports' and excluding shared networks where networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' and target_tenant is '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'), return the port status, device owner, number of ports, earliest standard attribute updated timestamp, and (for that same port status) the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of allocated IP address string lengths for ports with port security enabled and allocated IP address '10.150.64.113/8', ordered by the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) descending; additionally, only include (port status, device owner) groups whose port_count is greater than the average port_count across all returned (port status, device owner) groups. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "exclusion of shared networks" is predicated by "networks.id NOT IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))" IP Address "10.150.64.113/8" is predicated by "ipallocations.ip_address IN ('10.150.64.113/8')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH PortStatusOwnerCounts AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), PortStatusIpLenCV AS ( SELECT p.status, STDDEV(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) / NULLIF(AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM portsecuritybindings psb JOIN ports p ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON p.id = ia.port_id WHERE psb.port_security_enabled = 1 AND ia.ip_address IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT psoc.port_status, psoc.device_owner, psoc.port_count, psoc.earliest_standard_attr_update, psicv.coefficient_of_variation FROM PortStatusOwnerCounts psoc JOIN PortStatusIpLenCV psicv ON psoc.port_status = psicv.status WHERE psoc.port_count > 0 ORDER BY psicv.coefficient_of_variation DESC, psoc.port_count DESC ) SELECT port_status, device_owner, port_count, earliest_standard_attr_update, coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte WHERE port_count > (SELECT AVG(port_count) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC, port_count DESC;

question: For RBAC actions that (1) are `access_as_shared` and reference IPv4 subnets and (2) also have more than 5 DHCP-enabled subnets on non-shared networks (excluding networks shared to `'*'` or tenant `9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b`), return the action along with the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of subnet IP version for the shared/IPv4 case, plus the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of subnet IP version for the DHCP-enabled non-shared case; also include the overall average of the shared/IPv4 standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) across all returned actions as a benchmark and label each action as 'HIGH_VOLATILITY' (at least 50% above benchmark), 'LOW_VOLATILITY' (at least 50% below benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_VOLATILITY'. p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), NetworkPortRollup AS ( SELECT avg_admin_up_ports_per_active_network FROM inner_cte GROUP BY tenant_id ) SELECT i.tenant_id, i.network_id, i.network_name, i.admin_state_up, i.mtu, i.standard_attr_updated_at, SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH PortStatusBindingStats AS ( SELECT p.status, MAX(ps.binding_count) - MIN(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_range, VARIANCE(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_variance, p2.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p2.id ) AS ps ON p.id = ps.port_id GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY binding_count_range DESC ), AdminUpPortWindowDetails AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), PortStatusCounts AS ( SELECT p.status, COUNT(*) AS port_count FROM PORTS p JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.status ) SELECT psbs.status, psc.port_count, psbs.binding_count_range, psbs.binding_count_variance, psbs.binding_count_stddev FROM PortStatusBindingStats psbs JOIN PortStatusCounts psc ON psbs.status = psc.status WHERE psbs.status IN (SELECT STATUS FROM AdminUpPortWindowDetails)) , StatusVifCounts AS ( SELECT p.status, b.vif_type, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_ports FROM PORTS p JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS b ON p.id = b.port_id JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') AND p.status IN (SELECT status FROM inner_cte) GROUP BY p.status, b.vif_type ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(status) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE status END AS status, CASE WHEN GROUPING(vif_type) = 1 AND GROUPING(status) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE vif_type END AS vif_type, SUM(total_ports) AS total_ports FROM StatusVifCounts GROUP BY status, vif_type WITH question: For each port status and device owner, considering only ports whose standard attribute resource type is 'ports' and excluding shared networks (networks whose IDs appear in networkrbacs with action = 'access_as_shared' and target_tenant = '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'), show the number of ports and the earliest standard attribute updated timestamp, and also include (by port status) the variance of the standard attribute ID across ports that have an IP allocation with IP address 10.150.64.113/8; then return only those (port status, device owner) groups whose port_count is greater than the average port_count for the same port_status. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "exclusion of shared networks" is predicated by "networks.id NOT IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))" IP Address "10.150.64.113/8" is predicated by "ipallocations.ip_address IN ('10.150.64.113/8')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH sq1 AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), sq2 AS ( SELECT p.STATUS, VARIANCE(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS standard_attr_id_variance FROM PORTS AS p JOIN IPALLOCATIONS AS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID IS NOT NULL AND ia.IP_ADDRESS IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.STATUS ORDER BY standard_attr_id_variance DESC ) SELECT sq1.port_status, sq1.device_owner, sq1.port_count, sq1.earliest_standard_attr_update, sq2.standard_attr_id_variance FROM sq1 JOIN sq2 ON sq1.port_status = sq2.STATUS ORDER BY sq1.port_count DESC, sq2.standard_attr_id_variance DESC ), StatusAverages AS ( SELECT port_status, AVG(port_count) AS avg_port_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY port_status ) SELECT i.port_status, i.device_owner, i.port_count, i.earliest_standard_attr_update, i.standard_attr_id_variance FROM inner_cte i JOIN StatusAverages sa ON sa.port_status = i.port_status WHERE i.port_count > sa.avg_port_count ORDER BY i.port_status, i.port_count DESC, i.standard_attr_id_variance DESC;

question: For each ACTIVE network (excluding shared networks where the RBAC action is 'access_as_shared' and the target tenant is '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'), list the network name, status, admin_state_up, RBAC action, target tenant, and its dense-rank-by-network-ID value, and also show (for the 'access_as_shared' RBAC action) the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of subnet IP version across referenced subnets restricted to IPv4 (IP_VERSION = 4). Additionally, only keep networks whose referenced IPv4 subnets make up more than 75% of all subnets on that network, and include the total subnet count and IPv4 subnet count per network. SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH Subq1 AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_variance DESC ), Subq2 AS ( SELECT n.name, n.status, n.admin_state_up, r.action, r.target_tenant, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.id ORDER BY n.id) AS window_column FROM networksecuritybindings b JOIN networks n ON b.network_id = n.id JOIN networkrbacs r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND n.id NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) ) SELECT s2.name, s2.status, s2.admin_state_up, s2.action, s2.target_tenant, s2.window_column, s1.avg_ip_version, s1.ip_version_variance, s1.ip_version_stddev FROM Subq2 s2 CROSS JOIN Subq1 s1 WHERE s1.action = 'access_as_shared'), SubnetCounts AS ( SELECT n.id AS network_id, COUNT(s.id) AS total_subnets, SUM(CASE WHEN s.ip_version = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ipv4_subnets FROM networks n JOIN subnets s ON s.network_id = n.id GROUP BY n.id ) SELECT i.name, i.status, i.admin_state_up, i.action, i.target_tenant, i.window_column, i.avg_ip_version, i.ip_version_variance, i.ip_version_stddev, sc.total_subnets, sc.ipv4_subnets FROM inner_cte i JOIN networks n ON n.name = i.name JOIN SubnetCounts sc ON sc.network_id = n.id WHERE sc.total_subnets > 0 AND (sc.ipv4_subnets * 1.0 / sc.total_subnets) > 0.75;

question: Using the same set of administratively up ports for tenant ID `98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57` (including the windowed average standard attribute ID and the status-level variance among ports with IP `10.150.64.113/8`), summarize the results by port status and VIF type. SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH PortBindingWindow AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), PortStatusVariance AS ( SELECT p.STATUS, VARIANCE(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS standard_attr_id_variance FROM PORTS AS p JOIN IPALLOCATIONS AS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID IS NOT NULL AND ia.IP_ADDRESS IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.STATUS ORDER BY standard_attr_id_variance DESC ) SELECT pbw.PORT_ID, pbw.HOST, pbw.VIF_TYPE, pbw.VNIC_TYPE, pbw.TENANT_ID, pbw.NETWORK_ID, pbw.MAC_ADDRESS, pbw.STATUS, pbw.DEVICE_OWNER, pbw.window_column, psv.standard_attr_id_variance FROM PortBindingWindow pbw JOIN PortStatusVariance psv ON pbw.STATUS = psv.STATUS ORDER BY pbw.VIF_TYPE, pbw.PORT_ID ), StatusVifSummary AS ( SELECT i.STATUS, i.VIF_TYPE, COUNT(DISTINCT i.PORT_ID) AS total_ports, AVG(i.window_column) AS avg_windowed_standard_attr_id FROM inner_cte i GROUP BY i.STATUS, i.VIF_TYPE ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(STATUS) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE STATUS END AS status, CASE WHEN GROUPING(VIF_TYPE) = 1 AND GROUPING(STATUS) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(VIF_TYPE) = 1 AND GROUPING(STATUS) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE VIF_TYPE END AS vif_type, SUM(total_ports) AS total_ports, AVG(avg_windowed_standard_attr_id) AS avg_windowed_standard_attr_id FROM StatusVifSummary GROUP BY STATUS, VIF_TYPE WITH ROLLUP;

question: For administratively up ports belonging to tenant `98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57`, list each port’s ID, host, VIF type, VNIC type, tenant ID, network ID, MAC address, status, device owner, and the windowed average of standard attribute ID (2 preceding to 2 following rows per VIF type ordered by standard attribute ID). SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH PortStatusOwnerAgg AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), TenantAdminUpPortWindow AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ) SELECT t.PORT_ID, t.HOST, t.VIF_TYPE, t.VNIC_TYPE, t.TENANT_ID, t.NETWORK_ID, t.MAC_ADDRESS, t.STATUS, t.DEVICE_OWNER, t.window_column, a.port_count, a.earliest_standard_attr_update FROM TenantAdminUpPortWindow t JOIN PortStatusOwnerAgg a ON a.port_status = t.STATUS AND a.device_owner = t.DEVICE_OWNER ORDER BY t.NETWORK_ID, t.PORT_ID) SELECT inner_cte.PORT_ID, inner_cte.HOST, inner_cte.VIF_TYPE, inner_cte.VNIC_TYPE, inner_cte.TENANT_ID, inner_cte.NETWORK_ID, inner_cte.MAC_ADDRESS, inner_cte.STATUS, inner_cte.DEVICE_OWNER, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.port_count, inner_cte.earliest_standard_attr_update FROM inner_cte JOIN PORTS p2 ON p2.ID = inner_cte.PORT_ID WHERE inner_cte.port_count > 10 ORDER BY inner_cte.NETWORK_ID, inner_cte.PORT_ID;

question: For tenant ID `17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7`, for each port that is administratively up and also has a binding on host `drive-59`, return the port ID, tenant ID, MAC address, the number of port security bindings on that port, the total number of times port security is enabled across those bindings, and the running sum of the port standard attribute IDs within each VIF type group (ordered by standard attribute ID). SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH PortSecurityAgg AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(psb.port_id) AS binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN psb.port_security_enabled THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS port_security_enabled_total FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address), HostWindowSum AS (SELECT b.PORT_ID, p.TENANT_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE b.HOST = 'drive-59' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')) SELECT psa.port_id, psa.tenant_id, psa.mac_address, psa.binding_count, psa.port_security_enabled_total, hws.window_column FROM PortSecurityAgg psa JOIN HostWindowSum hws ON psa.port_id = hws.PORT_ID AND psa.tenant_id = hws.TENANT_ID AND psa.mac_address = hws.MAC_ADDRESS ), PortVifType AS ( SELECT i.port_id, b.vif_type FROM inner_cte i JOIN ml2_port_bindings b ON b.port_id = i.port_id AND b.host = 'drive-59' ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(pvt.vif_type) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE pvt.vif_type END AS vif_type, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.port_id) = 1 AND GROUPING(pvt.vif_type) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE i.port_id END AS port_id, MAX(i.tenant_id) AS tenant_id, MAX(i.mac_address) AS mac_address, SUM(i.binding_count) AS binding_count, SUM(i.port_security_enabled_total) AS port_security_enabled_total, MAX(i.window_column) AS window_column, COUNT(*) AS total_ports FROM inner_cte i JOIN PortVifType pvt ON pvt.port_id = i.port_id GROUP BY pvt.vif_type, i.port_id WITH ROLLUP;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DownPortsWithWindow AS ( SELECT p.NAME, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER ( ORDER BY p.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.NETWORK_ID IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d') ), SecurityGroupGeomMean AS ( SELECT s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, EXP(AVG(LN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID))) AS geometric_mean_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS AS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID > 0 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY geometric_mean_standard_attr_id DESC ) SELECT dpw.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, COUNT(*) AS down_port_count_in_network, AVG(dpw.window_column) AS avg_window_min_admin_state_up, MAX(sgg.geometric_mean_standard_attr_id) AS geometric_mean_standard_attr_id_for_tenant FROM DownPortsWithWindow dpw LEFT JOIN SecurityGroupGeomMean sgg ON dpw.SECURITY_GROUP_ID = sgg.SECURITY_GROUP_ID GROUP BY dpw.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY down_port_count_in_network DESC ), tenant_down_presence AS ( SELECT s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS tenant_down_ports FROM PORTS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.NETWORK_ID IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d') AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ) SELECT i.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, i.down_port_count_in_network, i.avg_window_min_admin_state_up, i.geometric_mean_standard_attr_id_for_tenant, CASE WHEN COALESCE(tdp.tenant_down_ports, 0) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_any_down_ports_in_tenant FROM inner_cte i LEFT JOIN tenant_down_presence tdp ON i.SECURITY_GROUP_ID = tdp.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY i.down_port_count_in_network DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For tenant ID `17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7`, return the same administratively up port-security summary (tenant ID, admin-up port count, total port-security binding count, total enabled count, enabled-to-binding ratio rounded, and the average down-port standard-attribute running-sum window value), and also include the tenant’s total port count and the overall average port count across all tenants.
evidence: Tenant ID "17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH PortSecurityStats AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(psb.port_id) AS binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN psb.port_security_enabled THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS port_security_enabled_total FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address), DownPortWindow AS (SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, SUM(sa.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY sa.RESOURCE_TYPE ORDER BY sa.ID) AS window_column FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')) SELECT pss.tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT pss.port_id) AS admin_up_port_count, SUM(pss.binding_count) AS total_binding_count, SUM(pss.port_security_enabled_total) AS total_port_security_enabled_across_bindings, ROUND( SUM(pss.port_security_enabled_total) / NULLIF(SUM(pss.binding_count), 0), 2 ) AS port_security_enabled_ratio, AVG(dpw.window_column) AS avg_down_port_window_sum FROM PortSecurityStats pss LEFT JOIN DownPortWindow dpw ON dpw.port_id = pss.port_id AND dpw.tenant_id = pss.tenant_id GROUP BY pss.tenant_id ORDER BY port_security_enabled_ratio DESC ) SELECT i.tenant_id, i.admin_up_port_count, i.total_binding_count, i.total_port_security_enabled_across_bindings, i.port_security_enabled_ratio, i.avg_down_port_window_sum, COUNT(p_all.id) AS total_ports_for_tenant, avg_ports.avg_port_count AS avg_ports_across_all_tenants FROM inner_cte i JOIN ports p_all ON p_all.tenant_id = i.tenant_id JOIN ( SELECT AVG(port_count) AS avg_port_count FROM ( SELECT COUNT(id) AS port_count FROM ports GROUP BY tenant_id ) AS sub ) AS avg_ports GROUP BY i.tenant_id, i.admin_up_port_count, i.total_binding_count, i.total_port_security_enabled_across_bindings, i.port_security_enabled_ratio, i.avg_down_port_window_sum, avg_ports.avg_port_count;

question: For tenant ID `98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57`, among administratively up ports that have at least one IP allocation, list only those ports whose IP allocation count is greater than the average IP allocation count for ports with the same VIF type (computed over this tenant’s administratively up ports with at least one IP allocation). Return the port ID, tenant ID, network ID, MAC address, host, VIF type, VNIC type, status, device owner, the average standard attribute ID over a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows partitioned by VIF type, along with the number of IP allocations on the port and the number of those allocations with a non-null subnet ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH PortIpAllocStats AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ia.subnet_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subnet_id_rows FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON ia.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND ia.ip_address IS NOT NULL AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address ), PortBindingWindowStats AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ) SELECT pbws.PORT_ID AS port_id, pbws.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, pbws.NETWORK_ID AS network_id, pbws.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, pbws.HOST AS host, pbws.VIF_TYPE AS vif_type, pbws.VNIC_TYPE AS vnic_type, pbws.STATUS AS status, pbws.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, pbws.window_column AS avg_standard_attr_id_window, pias.ip_allocation_count AS ip_allocation_count, pias.subnet_id_rows AS subnet_id_rows FROM PortBindingWindowStats pbws JOIN PortIpAllocStats pias ON pias.port_id = pbws.PORT_ID ORDER BY pbws.VIF_TYPE, pbws.PORT_ID ), VifTypeAverages AS ( SELECT vif_type, AVG(ip_allocation_count) AS avg_ip_allocations FROM inner_cte GROUP BY vif_type ) SELECT i.port_id, i.tenant_id, i.network_id, i.mac_address, i.host, i.vif_type, i.vnic_type, i.status, i.device_owner, i.avg_standard_attr_id_window, i.ip_allocation_count, i.subnet_id_rows FROM inner_cte i JOIN VifTypeAverages vta ON vta.vif_type = i.vif_type WHERE i.ip_allocation_count > vta.avg_ip_allocations ORDER BY i.vif_type, i.port_id;

question: For the unified set of DOWN ports that either (a) belong to tenant ID `98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57` or (b) belong to network ID `0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d`, compute how many ports appear under each reason label, and return only those reason labels whose port count is greater than the average port count across the reason labels. SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH TenantDownPorts AS (SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), NetworkDownPorts AS (SELECT p.NAME, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER ( ORDER BY p.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.NETWORK_ID IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d')), CombinedDownPorts AS ( SELECT t.port_id AS port_identifier, t.tenant_id AS scope_id, t.mac_address, t.window_column AS window_metric, 'Tenant Filter' AS reason FROM TenantDownPorts t UNION ALL SELECT n.NAME AS port_identifier, n.NETWORK_ID AS scope_id, n.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, n.window_column AS window_metric, 'Network Filter' AS reason FROM NetworkDownPorts n ) SELECT * FROM CombinedDownPorts ORDER BY reason, scope_id, port_identifier ), ReasonCounts AS ( SELECT reason, COUNT(*) AS total_ports FROM inner_cte GROUP BY reason ) SELECT reason, total_ports FROM ReasonCounts WHERE total_ports > (SELECT AVG(total_ports) FROM ReasonCounts) ORDER BY total_ports DESC, reason;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH sq1 AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS min_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS spb ON p.ID = spb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), sq2 AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ) SELECT sq2.VIF_TYPE, sq2.DEVICE_OWNER, sq1.port_status, sq1.port_count, sq1.min_standard_attr_id, COUNT(DISTINCT sq2.PORT_ID) AS admin_up_port_count, AVG(sq2.window_column) AS avg_window_standard_attr_id FROM sq2 JOIN sq1 ON sq2.DEVICE_OWNER = sq1.device_owner GROUP BY sq2.VIF_TYPE, sq2.DEVICE_OWNER, sq1.port_status, sq1.port_count, sq1.min_standard_attr_id ORDER BY admin_up_port_count DESC ) SELECT VIF_TYPE, MAX(admin_up_port_count) AS max_admin_up_port_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY VIF_TYPE;

question: Among the top 10 tenants with the most ACTIVE networks (excluding shared networks where RBAC action = 'access_as_shared' and target tenant is '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'), show each tenant’s ID, total number of ACTIVE networks, and whether they have any RBAC entries at all on those networks. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "exclusion of shared networks" is predicated by "networks.id NOT IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH NetworkStatusSecurityStats AS ( SELECT n.STATUS AS network_status, VARIANCE(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_variance, STDDEV(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_stddev FROM NETWORKS AS n JOIN NETWORKSECURITYBINDINGS AS nsb ON n.ID = nsb.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.STATUS ORDER BY port_security_enabled_variance DESC ), ActiveNetworkRbacDetails AS ( SELECT n.name, n.status, n.admin_state_up, r.action, r.target_tenant, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.id ORDER BY n.id) AS window_column FROM networksecuritybindings b JOIN networks n ON b.network_id = n.id JOIN networkrbacs r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND n.id NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) ), ActiveNetworkCountsByStatus AS ( SELECT status AS network_status, COUNT(DISTINCT name) AS active_network_count FROM ActiveNetworkRbacDetails GROUP BY status ) SELECT nsss.network_status, anc.active_network_count, nsss.port_security_enabled_variance, nsss.port_security_enabled_stddev FROM NetworkStatusSecurityStats nsss JOIN ActiveNetworkCountsByStatus anc ON nsss.network_status = anc.network_status ORDER BY anc.active_network_count DESC, nsss.port_security_enabled_variance DESC ), tenant_active_networks AS ( SELECT n.tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id) AS total_active_networks FROM networks n WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND n.id NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.tenant_id ), tenant_rbac_presence AS ( SELECT n.tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) AS total_rbac_rows FROM networks n LEFT JOIN networkrbacs r ON r.object_id = n.id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND n.id NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.tenant_id ) SELECT tan.tenant_id, tan.total_active_networks, CASE WHEN trp.total_rbac_rows > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_any_network_rbac, COUNT(DISTINCT ic.network_status) AS statuses_covered_in_inner_cte FROM tenant_active_networks tan LEFT JOIN tenant_rbac_presence trp ON trp.tenant_id = tan.tenant_id LEFT JOIN networks n ON n.tenant_id = tan.tenant_id LEFT JOIN inner_cte ic ON ic.network_status = n.status GROUP BY tan.tenant_id, tan.total_active_networks, trp.total_rbac_rows ORDER BY tan.total_active_networks DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Using the same port-status/device-owner port counts and earliest standard-attribute update timestamps (restricted to standard attributes with resource type = 'ports' and excluding ports on shared networks where networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' and target_tenant is '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'), and the same per-port-status range/variance/stddev of port security binding counts for ports with at least one binding in tenant '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7', return the detailed rows plus subtotals per port status and a grand total. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "exclusion of shared networks" is predicated by "networks.id NOT IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))" Tenant ID "17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH PortStatusOwnerStats AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), PortStatusBindingStats AS ( SELECT p.status, MAX(ps.binding_count) - MIN(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_range, VARIANCE(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_variance, STDDEV(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_stddev FROM ports AS p JOIN ( SELECT p2.id AS port_id, COUNT(*) AS binding_count FROM ports AS p2 JOIN portsecuritybindings AS b ON p2.id = b.port_id WHERE p2.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p2.id ) AS ps ON p.id = ps.port_id GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY binding_count_range DESC ), CombinedPortStatusStats AS ( SELECT pso.port_status, pso.device_owner, pso.port_count, pso.earliest_standard_attr_update, pbs.binding_count_range, pbs.binding_count_variance, pbs.binding_count_stddev FROM PortStatusOwnerStats pso JOIN PortStatusBindingStats pbs ON pso.port_status = pbs.status ) SELECT port_status, device_owner, port_count, earliest_standard_attr_update, binding_count_range, binding_count_variance, binding_count_stddev FROM CombinedPortStatusStats ORDER BY port_status, device_owner ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(port_status) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE port_status END AS port_status, CASE WHEN GROUPING(device_owner) = 1 AND GROUPING(port_status) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(device_owner) = 1 AND GROUPING(port_status) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE device_owner END AS device_owner, SUM(port_count) AS port_count, MIN(earliest_standard_attr_update) AS earliest_standard_attr_update, MAX(binding_count_range) AS binding_count_range, AVG(binding_count_variance) AS binding_count_variance, AVG(binding_count_stddev) AS binding_count_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY port_status, device_owner WITH ROLLUP;

question: For each IPv4 subnet whose subnet ID is in ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48'), list the subnet name, tenant ID, network ID, IP version, CIDR, gateway IP, DHCP enabled flag, the allocation pool’s first and last IPs, the maximum subnet standard attribute ID considering the current row and the next 2 rows when ordered by subnet ID, and also the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of routes per subnet (grouped by subnet name), along with the average route-count range across all returned subnet names. Do not return any rounded answers.

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH SubnetPoolAndAttrStats AS ( SELECT s.NAME, s.TENANT_ID, s.NETWORK_ID, s.IP_VERSION, s.CIDR, s.GATEWAY_IP, s.ENABLE_DHCP, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, MAX(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( ORDER BY s.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN IPALLOCATIONPOOLS AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') ), SubnetRouteCountDispersion AS ( SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, MAX(route_count) - MIN(route_count) AS route_count_range, VARIANCE(route_count) AS route_count_variance, STDDEV(route_count) AS route_count_stddev FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN ( SELECT sr.SUBNET_ID, COUNT(*) AS route_count FROM SUBNETROUTES AS sr GROUP BY sr.SUBNET_ID, sr.NEXTHOP ) AS route_stats ON s.ID = route_stats.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') GROUP BY s.NAME ORDER BY route_count_range DESC ) SELECT spa.NAME AS subnet_name, spa.TENANT_ID, spa.NETWORK_ID, spa.IP_VERSION, spa.CIDR, spa.GATEWAY_IP, spa.ENABLE_DHCP, spa.FIRST_IP AS allocation_pool_first_ip, spa.LAST_IP AS allocation_pool_last_ip, spa.max_standard_attr_id_next2, srcd.route_count_range, srcd.route_count_variance, srcd.route_count_stddev FROM SubnetPoolAndAttrStats spa JOIN SubnetRouteCountDispersion srcd ON spa.NAME = srcd.subnet_name ORDER BY spa.NAME) SELECT i.subnet_name, i.TENANT_ID, i.NETWORK_ID, i.IP_VERSION, i.CIDR, i.GATEWAY_IP, i.ENABLE_DHCP, i.allocation_pool_first_ip, i.allocation_pool_last_ip, i.max_standard_attr_id_next2, i.route_count_range, i.route_count_variance, i.route_count_stddev, avg_stats.avg_route_count_range FROM inner_cte i JOIN (SELECT AVG(route_count_range) AS avg_route_count_range FROM (SELECT route_count_range FROM inner_cte) AS sub) AS avg_stats ON 1 = 1;

question: For each IPv4 subnet that has at least one DNS nameserver entry, show the subnet name, tenant ID, network ID, IP version, CIDR, gateway IP, DHCP enabled flag, allocation pool first IP and last IP, the maximum subnet standard attribute ID over the current subnet and the next 2 subnets by subnet ID, and also the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of IP allocation pools per subnet (grouped by subnet name), ordered by the pool-count range descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH SubnetPoolStatsByName AS ( SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, MAX(pool_count) - MIN(pool_count) AS pool_count_range, VARIANCE(pool_count) AS pool_count_variance, STDDEV(pool_count) AS pool_count_stddev FROM subnets AS s JOIN dnsnameservers AS d ON d.subnet_id = s.id JOIN ( SELECT s2.id AS subnet_id, COUNT(*) AS pool_count FROM subnets AS s2 JOIN ipallocationpools AS p ON p.subnet_id = s2.id GROUP BY s2.id, p.id ) AS pool_stats ON pool_stats.subnet_id = s.id GROUP BY s.name ORDER BY pool_count_range DESC ), SubnetDetailsWithWindowMax AS ( SELECT s.NAME, s.TENANT_ID, s.NETWORK_ID, s.IP_VERSION, s.CIDR, s.GATEWAY_IP, s.ENABLE_DHCP, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, MAX(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( ORDER BY s.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN IPALLOCATIONPOOLS AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 ), DnsSubnetNames AS ( SELECT DISTINCT s.name AS subnet_name FROM subnets s JOIN dnsnameservers d ON d.subnet_id = s.id ) SELECT sd.NAME AS subnet_name, sd.TENANT_ID, sd.NETWORK_ID, sd.IP_VERSION, sd.CIDR, sd.GATEWAY_IP, sd.ENABLE_DHCP, sd.FIRST_IP, sd.LAST_IP, sd.max_standard_attr_id_next2, sp.pool_count_range, sp.pool_count_variance, sp.pool_count_stddev FROM SubnetDetailsWithWindowMax sd JOIN SubnetPoolStatsByName sp ON sd.NAME = sp.subnet_name JOIN DnsSubnetNames dn ON sd.NAME = dn.subnet_name ORDER BY sp.pool_count_range DESC, sd.NAME;

question: For tenants whose administratively-up ports are in status DOWN, list the tenant ID, the average of the “average standard attribute ID” window metric (partitioned by VIF type with 2 preceding and 2 following rows), the number of distinct security groups that contain DOWN ports for that tenant, and whether the tenant has any DOWN ports; only include tenants where this average window metric is greater than 100. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH AdminUpPorts AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 ), DownPortsBySecurityGroup AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, sgpb.security_group_id, RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY sgpb.security_group_id ORDER BY p.id ) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' ) SELECT aup.TENANT_ID, AVG(aup.window_column) AS Avg_AdminUp_StdAttr_Window, COUNT(DISTINCT dpsg.security_group_id) AS Down_Security_Group_Count, CASE WHEN COUNT(dpsg.port_id) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS Has_Down_Ports FROM AdminUpPorts AS aup LEFT JOIN DownPortsBySecurityGroup AS dpsg ON dpsg.tenant_id = aup.TENANT_ID WHERE aup.STATUS = 'DOWN' GROUP BY aup.TENANT_ID HAVING AVG(aup.window_column) > 100 ORDER BY Avg_AdminUp_StdAttr_Window DESC;

question: For each load balancer operating status that (1) has more than 1 load balancer associated with the “haproxy” provider and (2) has more than 1,000,000 total incoming bytes among load balancers in ACTIVE provisioning status, return the operating status, the total haproxy load balancer count, and the total incoming bytes. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH HaprxoyLBCountsByOpStatus AS ( SELECT lb.OPERATING_STATUS, COUNT(*) AS total_loadbalancers FROM LBAAS_LOADBALANCERS AS lb JOIN PROVIDERRESOURCEASSOCIATIONS AS pra ON lb.ID = pra.RESOURCE_ID WHERE pra.PROVIDER_NAME = 'haproxy' GROUP BY lb.OPERATING_STATUS HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ), ActiveLBBytesInByOpStatus AS ( SELECT lb.OPERATING_STATUS, SUM(s.BYTES_IN) AS total_bytes_in FROM LBAAS_LOADBALANCERS AS lb JOIN LBAAS_LOADBALANCER_STATISTICS AS s ON lb.ID = s.LOADBALANCER_ID WHERE lb.PROVISIONING_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY lb.OPERATING_STATUS HAVING SUM(s.BYTES_IN) > 1000000 ) SELECT h.OPERATING_STATUS, h.total_loadbalancers, a.total_bytes_in FROM HaprxoyLBCountsByOpStatus h JOIN ActiveLBBytesInByOpStatus a ON h.OPERATING_STATUS = a.OPERATING_STATUS ORDER BY a.total_bytes_in DESC;

question: For ports whose status is DOWN, return each port’s ID and tenant ID along with its binding host and VIF type, allocated IP address (with a row number ordered by IP address using a window frame of 2 preceding rows and 1 following row), and also the port’s MAC address with the running sum of standard attribute IDs within each resource type group ordered by standard attribute ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DownPortBindingIPs AS (SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, b.HOST AS host, b.VIF_TYPE AS vif_type, ia.IP_ADDRESS AS ip_address, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY ia.IP_ADDRESS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS b JOIN PORTS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN IPALLOCATIONS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN'), DownPortMacAttrSums AS (SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, SUM(sa.ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY sa.RESOURCE_TYPE ORDER BY sa.ID ) AS window_column FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN') SELECT d1.port_id, d1.tenant_id, d1.host, d1.vif_type, d1.ip_address, d1.window_column AS ip_row_number_window, d2.mac_address, d2.window_column AS standard_attr_running_sum_window FROM DownPortBindingIPs d1 JOIN DownPortMacAttrSums d2 ON d1.port_id = d2.port_id ORDER BY d1.tenant_id, d1.port_id, d1.ip_address;

question: List the port ID, tenant ID, MAC address, and the running-sum window column for all ports that are either DOWN or on host "drive-59", along with a reason indicating whether the row came from the DOWN-ports-by-security-group calculation or the drive-59-ports-by-VIF-type calculation. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DownPortsBySecurityGroup AS ( SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' ), Drive59PortsByVifType AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, p.TENANT_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE b.HOST = 'drive-59' ), CombinedPorts AS ( SELECT port_id, tenant_id, mac_address, window_column, 'DOWN (by Security Group)' AS reason FROM DownPortsBySecurityGroup UNION ALL SELECT PORT_ID AS port_id, TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, window_column, 'Host drive-59 (by VIF Type)' AS reason FROM Drive59PortsByVifType ) SELECT port_id, tenant_id, mac_address, window_column, reason FROM CombinedPorts ORDER BY tenant_id, port_id;

question: For each VIF type, show the VIF type, the number of DOWN ports, the average of the per-port windowed average admin_state_up (2 preceding and 2 following rows partitioned by VIF type and ordered by MAC address), and the average (across the involved hosts) variance of port standard attribute IDs for DOWN ports that have an IP allocation. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DownPortsWindow AS ( SELECT p.NAME, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, AVG(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.MAC_ADDRESS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b ON p.ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' ORDER BY p.MAC_ADDRESS ), HostStandardAttrVariance AS ( SELECT b.HOST, VARIANCE(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS standard_attr_id_variance FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN IPALLOCATIONS AS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND ia.PORT_ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY b.HOST ORDER BY standard_attr_id_variance DESC ) SELECT dpw.VIF_TYPE, COUNT(*) AS down_ports_count, AVG(dpw.window_column) AS avg_window_admin_state_up, AVG(hsav.standard_attr_id_variance) AS avg_standard_attr_id_variance_across_hosts FROM DownPortsWindow dpw JOIN HostStandardAttrVariance hsav ON dpw.HOST = hsav.HOST GROUP BY dpw.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY down_ports_count DESC;

question: Find load balancers associated with the provider named 'haproxy' whose highest admin_state_up value is 1, and for each such load balancer return its name and operating status along with the total incoming bytes for that operating status across ACTIVE-provisioning load balancers, keeping only operating statuses where the total incoming bytes exceed 1,000,000. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH ActiveStatusBytes AS ( SELECT lb.OPERATING_STATUS, SUM(s.BYTES_IN) AS total_bytes_in FROM LBAAS_LOADBALANCERS AS lb JOIN LBAAS_LOADBALANCER_STATISTICS AS s ON lb.ID = s.LOADBALANCER_ID WHERE lb.PROVISIONING_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY lb.OPERATING_STATUS HAVING SUM(s.BYTES_IN) > 1000000 ), HaproxyAdminUpLoadBalancers AS ( SELECT lb.name AS loadbalancer_name, MAX(lb.admin_state_up) AS max_admin_state_up, lb.operating_status FROM LBAAS_LOADBALANCERS lb JOIN PROVIDERRESOURCEASSOCIATIONS pra ON lb.id = pra.resource_id WHERE pra.provider_name = 'haproxy' GROUP BY lb.name, lb.operating_status HAVING MAX(lb.admin_state_up) = 1 ) SELECT h.loadbalancer_name, h.operating_status, a.total_bytes_in FROM HaproxyAdminUpLoadBalancers h JOIN ActiveStatusBytes a ON h.operating_status = a.OPERATING_STATUS ORDER BY h.operating_status, h.loadbalancer_name;

question: For each port status (considering only administratively up ports), what is the count of administratively up ports and the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of port security bindings per port (considering only ports that have at least one port security binding)? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH administratively_up_ports AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 ), port_status_binding_stats AS ( SELECT p.status, MAX(ps.binding_count) - MIN(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_range, VARIANCE(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_variance, STDDEV(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_stddev FROM ports AS p JOIN ( SELECT p2.id AS port_id, COUNT(*) AS binding_count FROM ports AS p2 JOIN portsecuritybindings AS b ON p2.id = b.port_id GROUP BY p2.id ) AS ps ON p.id = ps.port_id GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY binding_count_range DESC ), up_port_counts_by_status AS ( SELECT aup.STATUS, COUNT(*) AS administratively_up_port_count FROM administratively_up_ports aup GROUP BY aup.STATUS ) SELECT psbs.status, ucs.administratively_up_port_count, psbs.binding_count_range, psbs.binding_count_variance, psbs.binding_count_stddev FROM port_status_binding_stats psbs JOIN up_port_counts_by_status ucs ON psbs.status = ucs.STATUS ORDER BY psbs.binding_count_range DESC;

question: For each VIF type among ports that are DOWN, show the VIF type, total number of distinct DOWN ports, the average of the MAC-address-based admin_state_up window metric, the maximum IP-address-based row-number window value, and the number of distinct tenants, by combining the DOWN-port MAC window results with the DOWN-port IP allocation row-number results joined on host and VIF type. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH PortDownMacWindow AS ( SELECT p.NAME, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, AVG(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.MAC_ADDRESS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b ON p.ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' ORDER BY p.MAC_ADDRESS ), PortDownIpRowNumber AS ( SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, b.HOST AS host, b.VIF_TYPE AS vif_type, ia.IP_ADDRESS AS ip_address, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY ia.IP_ADDRESS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS b JOIN PORTS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN IPALLOCATIONS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' ) SELECT p2.vif_type, COUNT(DISTINCT p2.port_id) AS Total_Down_Ports, AVG(p1.window_column) AS Avg_AdminStateUp_Window_Across_Ports, MAX(p2.window_column) AS Max_Ip_RowNumber_Window, COUNT(DISTINCT p2.tenant_id) AS Distinct_Tenants FROM PortDownIpRowNumber p2 JOIN PortDownMacWindow p1 ON p1.HOST = p2.host AND p1.VIF_TYPE = p2.vif_type GROUP BY p2.vif_type ORDER BY Total_Down_Ports DESC;

question: For DOWN ports, list the tenant ID, the tenant’s total number of DOWN ports and average admin_state_up (rounded), along with each port’s security group ID and rank within that security group (by port ID), plus the port name, MAC address, admin_state_up flag, binding host, VIF type, the 2-preceding-to-2-following VIF-type window average of admin_state_up (ordered by MAC address), and the normalized ratio of that window average to the tenant’s average admin_state_up for DOWN ports.
SQL: WITH PortBindingsWindow AS ( SELECT p.NAME, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, AVG(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.MAC_ADDRESS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b ON p.ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' ORDER BY p.MAC_ADDRESS ), SecurityGroupPortRank AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, sgpb.security_group_id, RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY sgpb.security_group_id ORDER BY p.id ) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' ), TenantDownPortSummary AS ( SELECT p.tenant_id, COUNT(*) AS down_port_count, AVG(p.admin_state_up) AS avg_admin_state_up_down FROM PORTS p WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' GROUP BY p.tenant_id ) SELECT sgpr.tenant_id, tds.down_port_count, ROUND(tds.avg_admin_state_up_down, 2) AS avg_admin_state_up_down, sgpr.security_group_id, sgpr.port_id, pbw.NAME AS port_name, sgpr.mac_address, pbw.ADMIN_STATE_UP, pbw.HOST AS binding_host, pbw.VIF_TYPE, pbw.window_column AS avg_admin_state_up_viftype_mac_window, sgpr.window_column AS port_rank_within_security_group, ROUND( pbw.window_column / NULLIF(tds.avg_admin_state_up_down, 0), 2 ) AS normalized_viftype_window_vs_tenant_avg FROM SecurityGroupPortRank sgpr JOIN PortBindingsWindow pbw ON pbw.MAC_ADDRESS = sgpr.mac_address JOIN TenantDownPortSummary tds ON tds.tenant_id = sgpr.tenant_id ORDER BY normalized_viftype_window_vs_tenant_avg DESC, sgpr.security_group_id, sgpr.port_id;

question: For each network status, show the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED across networks with at least one security binding, along with the total number of ports (restricted to standard attributes where RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports') for that same status; also list, for the matching port status, each device owner’s port count and the earliest standard attribute UPDATED_AT timestamp. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH NetworkSecurityStats AS ( SELECT n.STATUS AS network_status, VARIANCE(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_variance, STDDEV(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_stddev FROM NETWORKS AS n JOIN NETWORKSECURITYBINDINGS AS nsb ON n.ID = nsb.NETWORK_ID GROUP BY n.STATUS ORDER BY port_security_enabled_variance DESC ), PortOwnerStats AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), NetworkPortCountsByStatus AS ( SELECT n.STATUS AS network_status, COUNT(p.ID) AS total_ports_in_status FROM NETWORKS n JOIN PORTS p ON p.NETWORK_ID = n.ID JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' GROUP BY n.STATUS ) SELECT nss.network_status, nss.port_security_enabled_variance, nss.port_security_enabled_stddev, npc.total_ports_in_status, pos.port_status, pos.device_owner, pos.port_count, pos.earliest_standard_attr_update FROM NetworkSecurityStats nss JOIN NetworkPortCountsByStatus npc ON nss.network_status = npc.network_status JOIN PortOwnerStats pos ON pos.port_status = nss.network_status ORDER BY npc.total_ports_in_status DESC, nss.port_security_enabled_variance DESC, pos.port_count DESC;

question: For subnet names that are IPv4 and belong to networks with an RBAC action of 'access_as_shared' (keeping only subnet name/gateway IP groups where the maximum IP version is greater than 3), list each subnet name and gateway IP along with the maximum IP version and the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of routes per subnet. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH route_metrics AS ( SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, MAX(route_count) - MIN(route_count) AS route_count_range, VARIANCE(route_count) AS route_count_variance, STDDEV(route_count) AS route_count_stddev FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN ( SELECT sr.SUBNET_ID, COUNT(*) AS route_count FROM SUBNETROUTES AS sr GROUP BY sr.SUBNET_ID, sr.NEXTHOP ) AS route_stats ON s.ID = route_stats.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 GROUP BY s.NAME ORDER BY route_count_range DESC ), shared_rbac_max_ip AS ( SELECT s.name, MAX(s.ip_version) AS max_ip_version, s.gateway_ip FROM NETWORKRBACS n JOIN SUBNETS s ON n.object_id = s.network_id WHERE n.action = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY s.name, s.gateway_ip HAVING MAX(s.ip_version) > 3 ) SELECT rm.subnet_name, srm.gateway_ip, srm.max_ip_version, rm.route_count_range, rm.route_count_variance, rm.route_count_stddev FROM route_metrics rm JOIN shared_rbac_max_ip srm ON rm.subnet_name = srm.name ORDER BY rm.route_count_range DESC;

question: For ports whose standard attribute resource type is 'ports', list each port status and device owner with the number of ports and the earliest standard attribute updated timestamp, and also include (per port status) the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of standard attribute IDs considering only ports that have both a security group port binding and a port security binding. Do not return any rounded answers.
