SQL: WITH ActiveTenantNetworks AS (SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM NETWORKS n JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND n.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), AdminUpTenantPorts AS (SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), CombinedNetworkPortView AS ( SELECT n.tenant_id, n.network_id, n.network_name, n.admin_state_up AS network_admin_state_up, n.mtu, n.standard_attr_updated_at, n.window_column AS network_row_number_by_name, p.PORT_ID AS port_id, p.HOST AS host, p.VIF_TYPE AS vif_type, p.VNIC_TYPE AS vnic_type, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, p.window_column AS avg_standard_attr_id_window_2_pre_2_fol_by_vif_type FROM ActiveTenantNetworks n JOIN AdminUpTenantPorts p ON p.TENANT_ID = n.tenant_id AND p.NETWORK_ID = n.network_id ) SELECT * FROM CombinedNetworkPortView ORDER BY tenant_id, network_name, port_id;

question: For the RBAC action "access_as_shared", return the action name along with (1) the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of subnet IP version for IP version 4 subnets on networks referenced by RBAC entries, and (2) the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of subnet IP version for DHCP-enabled subnets on non-shared networks (excluding networks shared to target tenant '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') where the action has more than 5 matching subnets. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "access_as_shared" permission is predicated by "networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared'" "exclusion of shared networks" is predicated by "networks.id NOT IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))"
SQL: WITH RbacIpVersionStatsShared AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_variance DESC ), RbacIpVersionStddevDhcpNonShared AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.ENABLE_DHCP = 1 AND s.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.ACTION HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY ip_version_stddev DESC ) SELECT r1.ACTION, r1.avg_ip_version, r1.ip_version_variance, r1.ip_version_stddev AS shared_access_ip_version_stddev, r2.ip_version_stddev AS dhcp_nonshared_ip_version_stddev FROM RbacIpVersionStatsShared r1 JOIN RbacIpVersionStddevDhcpNonShared r2 ON r1.ACTION = r2.ACTION WHERE r1.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' ORDER BY r1.ip_version_variance DESC;

question: For each ACTIVE network (excluding shared networks where the RBAC action is 'access_as_shared' and the target tenant is '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'), list the network name, status, admin_state_up, RBAC action, target tenant, and its dense-rank-by-network-ID value, and also show (for the 'access_as_shared' RBAC action) the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of subnet IP version across referenced subnets restricted to IPv4 (IP_VERSION = 4). Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "access_as_shared" permission is predicated by "networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared'" "exclusion of shared networks" is predicated by "networks.id NOT IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))"
SQL: WITH Subq1 AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_variance DESC ), Subq2 AS ( SELECT n.name, n.status, n.admin_state_up, r.action, r.target_tenant, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.id ORDER BY n.id) AS window_column FROM networksecuritybindings b JOIN networks n ON b.network_id = n.id JOIN networkrbacs r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND n.id NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) ) SELECT s2.name, s2.status, s2.admin_state_up, s2.action, s2.target_tenant, s2.window_column, s1.avg_ip_version, s1.ip_version_variance, s1.ip_version_stddev FROM Subq2 s2 CROSS JOIN Subq1 s1 WHERE s1.action = 'access_as_shared';

question: For tenant ID `98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57`, for each administratively up port that has at least one IP allocation, list the port ID, tenant ID, network ID, MAC address, host, VIF type, VNIC type, status, device owner, the average standard attribute ID computed over a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows partitioned by VIF type, along with the number of IP allocations on the port and the total number of rows with a non-null subnet ID among those IP allocations. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')"
SQL: WITH PortIpAllocStats AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ia.subnet_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subnet_id_rows FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON ia.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND ia.ip_address IS NOT NULL AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address ), PortBindingWindowStats AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ) SELECT pbws.PORT_ID AS port_id, pbws.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, pbws.NETWORK_ID AS network_id, pbws.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, pbws.HOST AS host, pbws.VIF_TYPE AS vif_type, pbws.VNIC_TYPE AS vnic_type, pbws.STATUS AS status, pbws.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, pbws.window_column AS avg_standard_attr_id_window, pias.ip_allocation_count AS ip_allocation_count, pias.subnet_id_rows AS subnet_id_rows FROM PortBindingWindowStats pbws JOIN PortIpAllocStats pias ON pias.port_id = pbws.PORT_ID ORDER BY pbws.VIF_TYPE, pbws.PORT_ID;

question: Give the total count of non-shared default external networks (where IS_DEFAULT = 0 and excluding networks shared via RBAC to target tenant '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'), and also list each ACTIVE non-shared network’s name, status, admin_state_up, RBAC action, target tenant, and its dense-rank within the network. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "exclusion of shared networks" is predicated by "networks.id NOT IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))"
SQL: WITH DefaultExternalNonSharedNetworks AS ( SELECT e.NETWORK_ID, e.IS_DEFAULT, n.TENANT_ID, n.NAME, n.STATUS, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP, n.MTU, n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID, MIN(n.MTU) OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.TENANT_ID) AS window_column FROM EXTERNALNETWORKS e JOIN NETWORKS n ON e.NETWORK_ID = n.ID WHERE e.IS_DEFAULT = 0 AND n.ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) ), ActiveNetworksWithRbacNonShared AS ( SELECT n.name, n.status, n.admin_state_up, r.action, r.target_tenant, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.id ORDER BY n.id) AS window_column FROM networksecuritybindings b JOIN networks n ON b.network_id = n.id JOIN networkrbacs r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND n.id NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) ), DefaultExternalNonSharedNetworkCount AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS Default_External_NonShared_Network_Count FROM DefaultExternalNonSharedNetworks ) SELECT c.Default_External_NonShared_Network_Count, a.name, a.status, a.admin_state_up, a.action, a.target_tenant, a.window_column AS Active_Network_Rbac_Dense_Rank FROM DefaultExternalNonSharedNetworkCount c CROSS JOIN ActiveNetworksWithRbacNonShared a;

question: For each port status that appears in both (a) ports bound with VIF type 'ovs' for device_id 'da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7' and (b) ports that have an IP allocation with IP address '10.150.64.113/8', return the status along with the minimum admin_state_up, the average standard_attr_id, and the variance of standard_attr_id (from the IP-allocation-filtered ports), ordered by the variance descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: IP Address "10.150.64.113/8" is predicated by "ipallocations.ip_address IN ('10.150.64.113/8')" Device ID "da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7" is predicated by "ports.device_id IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7')"
SQL: WITH IPAllocStatusVariance AS (SELECT p.STATUS, VARIANCE(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS standard_attr_id_variance FROM PORTS AS p JOIN IPALLOCATIONS AS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID IS NOT NULL AND ia.IP_ADDRESS IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.STATUS ORDER BY standard_attr_id_variance DESC), OVSDeviceStatusStats AS (SELECT p.STATUS, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) AS min_admin_state_up, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS avg_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS b ON p.ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE b.VIF_TYPE = 'ovs' AND p.DEVICE_ID IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS) SELECT o.STATUS, o.min_admin_state_up, o.avg_standard_attr_id, i.standard_attr_id_variance FROM OVSDeviceStatusStats o JOIN IPAllocStatusVariance i ON o.STATUS = i.STATUS ORDER BY i.standard_attr_id_variance DESC;

question: For each port status and device owner (considering only ports whose standard attribute resource type is 'ports' and excluding shared networks), list the port status, device owner, number of ports, earliest standard attribute updated timestamp, and the associated network status; also include, for that network status, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED across networks with at least one security binding (excluding shared networks), and compute a derived metric of ports per security standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) (port_count divided by the network-status PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP)), ordered by this derived metric descending.

SQL: WITH NetworkStatusSecurityStats AS ( SELECT n.STATUS AS network_status, VARIANCE(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_variance, STDDEV(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_stddev FROM NETWORKS AS n JOIN NETWORKSECURITYBINDINGS AS nsb ON n.ID = nsb.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.STATUS ORDER BY port_security_enabled_variance DESC ), PortStatusOwnerStats AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), PortStatusOwnerWithNetworkStatus AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, n.STATUS AS network_status FROM PORTS p JOIN NETWORKS n ON n.ID = p.NETWORK_ID JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) ) SELECT psos.port_status, psos.device_owner, psos.port_count, psos.earliest_standard_attr_update, psonws.network_status, nsss.port_security_enabled_variance, nsss.port_security_enabled_stddev, ROUND(psos.port_count / NULLIF(nsss.port_security_enabled_stddev, 0), 2) AS ports_per_security_stddev FROM PortStatusOwnerStats psos JOIN PortStatusOwnerWithNetworkStatus psonws ON psonws.port_status = psos.port_status AND psonws.device_owner = psos.device_owner JOIN NetworkStatusSecurityStats nsss ON nsss.network_status = psonws.network_status ORDER BY ports_per_security_stddev DESC;

question: For tenant ID '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57', list ports that are DOWN and also have admin_state_up = 1 and are bound to a security group, showing the port ID, tenant ID, MAC address, security group ID, the port’s rank within its security group ordered by port ID, the port name, the number of security group bindings for the port, and the total number of DNS records associated with the port. SQL: WITH DownPortsBySecurityGroup AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, sgpb.security_group_id, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sgpb.security_group_id ORDER BY p.id) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), AdminUpPortsSecurityGroupAndDNSCounts AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.name AS port_name, COUNT(sgpb.security_group_id) AS security_group_binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pd.port_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS dns_record_count FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS sgpb JOIN PORTS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id LEFT JOIN PORTDNSES pd ON p.id = pd.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.name) SELECT dp.port_id, dp.tenant_id, dp.mac_address, dp.security_group_id, dp.window_column AS down_port_rank_within_security_group, au.port_name, au.security_group_binding_count, au.dns_record_count FROM DownPortsBySecurityGroup dp JOIN AdminUpPortsSecurityGroupAndDNSCounts au ON au.port_id = dp.port_id AND au.tenant_id = dp.tenant_id;

SQL: WITH DownPortsBySecurityGroup AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, sgpb.security_group_id, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sgpb.security_group_id ORDER BY p.id) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), ActiveNetworksByTenant AS ( SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM NETWORKS n JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND n.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ActiveNetworksByTenant) AS total_active_networks, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DownPortsBySecurityGroup) AS total_down_ports, ROUND( (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DownPortsBySecurityGroup) / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ActiveNetworksByTenant), 0), 2 ) AS avg_down_ports_per_active_network ;

SQL: WITH PortStatusBindingStats AS ( SELECT p.status, MAX(ps.binding_count) - MIN(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_range, VARIANCE(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_variance, STDDEV(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_stddev FROM ports AS p JOIN ( SELECT p2.id AS port_id, COUNT(*) AS binding_count FROM ports AS p2 JOIN portsecuritybindings AS b ON p2.id = b.port_id WHERE p2.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p2.id ) AS ps ON p.id = ps.port_id GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY binding_count_range DESC ), AdminUpPortWindowDetails AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), PortStatusCounts AS ( SELECT p.status, COUNT(*) AS port_count FROM PORTS p JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.status ) SELECT psbs.status, psc.port_count, psbs.binding_count_range, psbs.binding_count_variance, psbs.binding_count_stddev FROM PortStatusBindingStats psbs JOIN PortStatusCounts psc ON psbs.status = psc.status WHERE psbs.status IN (SELECT STATUS FROM AdminUpPortWindowDetails);

SQL: WITH TenantDownPortsBySecurityGroup AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, sgpb.security_group_id, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sgpb.security_group_id ORDER BY p.id) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), NetworkDownPortsWithMinAdminStateWindow AS ( SELECT p.NAME, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER ( ORDER BY p.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.NETWORK_ID IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d') ), SecurityGroupDownPortCounts AS ( SELECT sgpb.security_group_id, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS down_port_count FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') AND p.network_id IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d') GROUP BY sgpb.security_group_id ) SELECT tdp.port_id, tdp.tenant_id, ndp.network_id, ndp.name AS port_name, tdp.mac_address, ndp.admin_state_up, ndp.status, ndp.device_owner, tdp.security_group_id, tdp.window_column AS port_rank_within_security_group_by_port_id, ndp.window_column AS min_admin_state_up_in_3_preceding_1_following_window, sgc.down_port_count FROM TenantDownPortsBySecurityGroup AS tdp JOIN NetworkDownPortsWithMinAdminStateWindow AS ndp ON tdp.security_group_id = ndp.security_group_id AND tdp.mac_address = ndp.mac_address JOIN SecurityGroupDownPortCounts AS sgc ON tdp.security_group_id = sgc.security_group_id WHERE sgc.down_port_count >= 2 ORDER BY sgc.down_port_count DESC, tdp.security_group_id, tdp.port_id;

question: For DOWN ports in tenant '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7' that are bound to a security group, and for administratively up ports in tenant '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57' with ML2 bindings and port security bindings, what are the port status, device owner, distinct port count, and minimum standard attribute ID from the first set, along with the number of distinct admin-up ports and the average of the VIF-type windowed average standard attribute ID from the second set? SQL: WITH port_status_owner_sg_summary AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS min_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS spb ON p.ID = spb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), admin_up_ports_with_window AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ) SELECT pso.port_status, pso.device_owner, pso.port_count, pso.min_standard_attr_id, COUNT(DISTINCT aup.PORT_ID) AS admin_up_port_rows, AVG(aup.window_column) AS avg_window_column FROM port_status_owner_sg_summary pso CROSS JOIN admin_up_ports_with_window aup GROUP BY pso.port_status, pso.device_owner, pso.port_count, pso.min_standard_attr_id;

question: For ACTIVE networks (excluding shared networks where the RBAC action is 'access_as_shared' and the target tenant is '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'), list each network’s name, status, and admin_state_up along with its RBAC action, target tenant, and dense-rank-by-network-ID window value, and also show (for the matching RBAC action restricted to 'access_as_shared') the average, range (max minus min), and variance of subnet IP version for subnets whose network is referenced by that RBAC entry. Do not return any rounded answers.

SQL: WITH Subq1 AS ( SELECT n.ACTION AS rbac_action, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, MAX(s.IP_VERSION) - MIN(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_range, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION IN (4, 6) AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_range DESC ), Subq2 AS ( SELECT n.name, n.status, n.admin_state_up, r.action, r.target_tenant, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.id ORDER BY n.id) AS window_column FROM networksecuritybindings b JOIN networks n ON b.network_id = n.id JOIN networkrbacs r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND n.id NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) ) SELECT s2.name, s2.status, s2.admin_state_up, s2.action, s2.target_tenant, s2.window_column, s1.rbac_action, s1.avg_ip_version, s1.ip_version_range, s1.ip_version_variance FROM Subq2 s2 JOIN Subq1 s1 ON s2.action = s1.rbac_action ORDER BY s1.ip_version_range DESC, s2.name;

question: For tenant ID `17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7`, for each port that is administratively up and also has a binding on host `drive-59`, return the port ID, tenant ID, MAC address, the number of port security bindings on that port, the total number of times port security is enabled across those bindings, and the running sum of the port standard attribute IDs within each VIF type group (ordered by standard attribute ID). SQL: WITH PortSecurityAgg AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(psb.port_id) AS binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN psb.port_security_enabled THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS port_security_enabled_total FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address), HostWindowSum AS (SELECT b.PORT_ID, p.TENANT_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE b.HOST = 'drive-59' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')) SELECT psa.port_id, psa.tenant_id, psa.mac_address, psa.binding_count, psa.port_security_enabled_total, hws.window_column FROM PortSecurityAgg psa JOIN HostWindowSum hws ON psa.port_id = hws.PORT_ID AND psa.tenant_id = hws.TENANT_ID AND psa.mac_address = hws.MAC_ADDRESS;

SQL: WITH PortStatusOwnerSecurityGroupStats AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS min_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS spb ON p.ID = spb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), AdminUpPortBindingWindow AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), AdminUpPortBindingWindow_WithSecurityGroup AS ( SELECT aupbw.PORT_ID, aupbw.HOST, aupbw.VIF_TYPE, aupbw.VNIC_TYPE, aupbw.TENANT_ID, aupbw.NETWORK_ID, aupbw.MAC_ADDRESS, aupbw.STATUS, aupbw.DEVICE_OWNER, aupbw.window_column FROM AdminUpPortBindingWindow aupbw JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS spb ON aupbw.PORT_ID = spb.PORT_ID ) SELECT psosgs.port_status, psosgs.device_owner, psosgs.port_count, psosgs.min_standard_attr_id, aupbwsg.PORT_ID, aupbwsg.HOST, aupbwsg.VIF_TYPE, aupbwsg.VNIC_TYPE, aupbwsg.TENANT_ID, aupbwsg.NETWORK_ID, aupbwsg.MAC_ADDRESS, aupbwsg.STATUS, aupbwsg.window_column FROM PortStatusOwnerSecurityGroupStats psosgs JOIN AdminUpPortBindingWindow_WithSecurityGroup aupbwsg ON psosgs.device_owner = aupbwsg.DEVICE_OWNER AND psosgs.port_status = aupbwsg.STATUS;

question: For ports that are administratively up and belong to tenant ID `98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57`, list the port ID, host, VIF type, VNIC type, tenant ID, network ID, MAC address, status, device owner, and the average standard attribute ID computed over a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows (partitioned by VIF type and ordered by standard attribute ID), and also show (by matching on port status) the variance of standard attribute ID for ports with an IP allocation of `10.150.64.113/8`. SQL: WITH PortDetails AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), StatusVariance AS ( SELECT p.STATUS, VARIANCE(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS standard_attr_id_variance FROM PORTS AS p JOIN IPALLOCATIONS AS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID IS NOT NULL AND ia.IP_ADDRESS IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.STATUS ORDER BY standard_attr_id_variance DESC ) SELECT pd.PORT_ID, pd.HOST, pd.VIF_TYPE, pd.VNIC_TYPE, pd.TENANT_ID, pd.NETWORK_ID, pd.MAC_ADDRESS, pd.STATUS, pd.DEVICE_OWNER, pd.window_column, sv.standard_attr_id_variance FROM PortDetails AS pd LEFT JOIN StatusVariance AS sv ON pd.STATUS = sv.STATUS;

question: For tenant_id '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7' and ports with status 'DOWN' that are bound to a security group, list each device owner with the distinct port count and the minimum standard attribute ID, and also show (by port status) the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of standard attribute IDs for ports that have both a security group port binding and a port security binding. SQL: WITH Subq1 AS ( SELECT p.status, STDDEV(p.standard_attr_id) / NULLIF(AVG(p.standard_attr_id), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM securitygroupportbindings AS sgpb JOIN ports AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN portsecuritybindings AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(p.standard_attr_id) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), Subq2 AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS min_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS spb ON p.ID = spb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ) SELECT s2.port_status, s2.device_owner, s2.port_count, s2.min_standard_attr_id, s1.coefficient_of_variation FROM Subq2 s2 JOIN Subq1 s1 ON s2.port_status = s1.status;

SQL: WITH SubnetDetails AS ( SELECT s.NAME, s.TENANT_ID, s.NETWORK_ID, s.IP_VERSION, s.CIDR, s.GATEWAY_IP, s.ENABLE_DHCP, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, MAX(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( ORDER BY s.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN IPALLOCATIONPOOLS AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') ), FirstIpStatsBySubnet AS ( SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, MAX(p.FIRST_IP) - MIN(p.FIRST_IP) AS first_ip_range, VARIANCE(p.FIRST_IP) AS first_ip_variance FROM SUBNETROUTES r JOIN SUBNETS s ON r.SUBNET_ID = s.ID JOIN IPALLOCATIONPOOLS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE r.NEXTHOP = '10.30.19.197/8' AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') GROUP BY s.NAME ORDER BY first_ip_range DESC ) SELECT sd.NAME, sd.TENANT_ID, sd.NETWORK_ID, sd.IP_VERSION, sd.CIDR, sd.GATEWAY_IP, sd.ENABLE_DHCP, sd.FIRST_IP, sd.LAST_IP, sd.max_standard_attr_id_next2, fs.first_ip_range, fs.first_ip_variance FROM SubnetDetails sd LEFT JOIN FirstIpStatsBySubnet fs ON fs.subnet_name = sd.NAME;

question: For tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57", count how many ACTIVE networks they have and how many administratively-up ports they have on those networks, then compute the ports-per-active-network ratio (ports divided by active networks, rounded to 2 decimals), along with the average of the ports’ windowed standard attribute ID metric and the latest network standard-attribute updated_at timestamp.

SQL: WITH ActiveTenantNetworks AS ( SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM NETWORKS n JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND n.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), AdminUpTenantPorts AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ) SELECT n.tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT n.network_id) AS active_network_count, COUNT(DISTINCT p.PORT_ID) AS admin_up_port_count, ROUND( COUNT(DISTINCT p.PORT_ID) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT n.network_id), 0), 2 ) AS ports_per_active_network_ratio, ROUND(AVG(p.window_column), 2) AS avg_port_window_standard_attr_id, MAX(n.standard_attr_updated_at) AS latest_network_standard_attr_updated_at FROM ActiveTenantNetworks n JOIN AdminUpTenantPorts p ON p.tenant_id = n.tenant_id AND p.NETWORK_ID = n.network_id WHERE n.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY n.tenant_id ORDER BY ports_per_active_network_ratio DESC;

question: For each ACTIVE (non-shared) network, list the network name, status, admin_state_up, its RBAC action and target tenant, and the dense-rank value; also show the variance of subnet IP version for public “access_as_shared” RBAC entries (target_tenant = '*') as a comparison metric. SQL: WITH sq1 AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' AND n.TARGET_TENANT = '*' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_variance DESC ), sq2 AS ( SELECT n.name, n.status, n.admin_state_up, r.action, r.target_tenant, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.id ORDER BY n.id) AS window_column FROM networksecuritybindings b JOIN networks n ON b.network_id = n.id JOIN networkrbacs r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND n.id NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) ) SELECT sq2.name, sq2.status, sq2.admin_state_up, sq2.action, sq2.target_tenant, sq2.window_column, sq1.ip_version_variance FROM sq2 CROSS JOIN sq1 ORDER BY sq1.ip_version_variance DESC, sq2.name;

SQL: WITH port_security_binding_stats_by_status AS ( SELECT p.status, MAX(ps.binding_count) - MIN(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_range, VARIANCE(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_variance, STDDEV(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_stddev FROM ports AS p JOIN ( SELECT p2.id AS port_id, COUNT(*) AS binding_count FROM ports AS p2 JOIN portsecuritybindings AS b ON p2.id = b.port_id WHERE p2.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p2.id ) AS ps ON p.id = ps.port_id GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY binding_count_range DESC ), down_ports_with_security_groups AS ( SELECT p.NAME, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER ( ORDER BY p.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.NETWORK_ID IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d') ), down_ports_with_security_groups_tenant_filtered AS ( SELECT dpsg.NAME, dpsg.NETWORK_ID, dpsg.MAC_ADDRESS, dpsg.ADMIN_STATE_UP, dpsg.STATUS, dpsg.DEVICE_OWNER, dpsg.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, dpsg.window_column FROM down_ports_with_security_groups dpsg JOIN ports p ON p.network_id = dpsg.NETWORK_ID AND p.mac_address = dpsg.MAC_ADDRESS WHERE p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') ) SELECT psbs.status, psbs.binding_count_range, psbs.binding_count_variance, psbs.binding_count_stddev, COUNT(*) AS down_port_rows_for_tenant_and_network FROM port_security_binding_stats_by_status psbs CROSS JOIN down_ports_with_security_groups_tenant_filtered dptf GROUP BY psbs.status, psbs.binding_count_range, psbs.binding_count_variance, psbs.binding_count_stddev ORDER BY psbs.binding_count_range DESC;

question: For each port status, report the port security binding count range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) for ports that have at least one port security binding and belong to tenant ID '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7', along with the variance of STANDARD_ATTR_ID for ports that have an IP allocation with IP address 10.150.64.113/8, and compute the ratio of binding-count variance to STANDARD_ATTR_ID variance.

SQL: WITH PortSecurityBindingStats AS ( SELECT p.status, MAX(ps.binding_count) - MIN(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_range, VARIANCE(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_variance, STDDEV(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_stddev FROM ports AS p JOIN ( SELECT p2.id AS port_id, COUNT(*) AS binding_count FROM ports AS p2 JOIN portsecuritybindings AS b ON p2.id = b.port_id WHERE p2.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p2.id ) AS ps ON p.id = ps.port_id GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY binding_count_range DESC ), StandardAttrIdVarianceByStatus AS ( SELECT p.STATUS, VARIANCE(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS standard_attr_id_variance FROM PORTS AS p JOIN IPALLOCATIONS AS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID IS NOT NULL AND ia.IP_ADDRESS IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.STATUS ORDER BY standard_attr_id_variance DESC ) SELECT psbs.status, psbs.binding_count_range, psbs.binding_count_variance, psbs.binding_count_stddev, saivs.standard_attr_id_variance, ROUND(psbs.binding_count_variance / NULLIF(saivs.standard_attr_id_variance, 0), 4) AS BindingCountVariance_To_StandardAttrIdVariance_Ratio FROM PortSecurityBindingStats psbs JOIN StandardAttrIdVarianceByStatus saivs ON psbs.status = saivs.status ORDER BY BindingCountVariance_To_StandardAttrIdVariance_Ratio DESC;

SQL: WITH PortOwnerStatusStats AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), PortStatusIPLenCV AS ( SELECT p.status, STDDEV(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) / NULLIF(AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM portsecuritybindings psb JOIN ports p ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON p.id = ia.port_id WHERE psb.port_security_enabled = 1 AND ia.ip_address IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT pos.port_status, pos.device_owner, pos.port_count, pos.earliest_standard_attr_update, psc.coefficient_of_variation FROM PortOwnerStatusStats pos LEFT JOIN PortStatusIPLenCV psc ON pos.port_status = psc.status ORDER BY pos.port_count DESC;

question: For tenant ID `17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7`, summarize the administratively up ports by showing the tenant ID, the number of admin-up ports, the total number of port security bindings on those ports, the total number of times port security is enabled across those bindings, the enabled-to-binding ratio (enabled total divided by binding total, rounded), and the average running-sum standard-attribute window value for any of those ports that are also in DOWN status.
evidence: Tenant ID "17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')"
SQL: WITH PortSecurityStats AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(psb.port_id) AS binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN psb.port_security_enabled THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS port_security_enabled_total FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address), DownPortWindow AS (SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, SUM(sa.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY sa.RESOURCE_TYPE ORDER BY sa.ID) AS window_column FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')) SELECT pss.tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT pss.port_id) AS admin_up_port_count, SUM(pss.binding_count) AS total_binding_count, SUM(pss.port_security_enabled_total) AS total_port_security_enabled_across_bindings, ROUND( SUM(pss.port_security_enabled_total) / NULLIF(SUM(pss.binding_count), 0), 2 ) AS port_security_enabled_ratio, AVG(dpw.window_column) AS avg_down_port_window_sum FROM PortSecurityStats pss LEFT JOIN DownPortWindow dpw ON dpw.port_id = pss.port_id AND dpw.tenant_id = pss.tenant_id GROUP BY pss.tenant_id ORDER BY port_security_enabled_ratio DESC;

question: For each port status that appears in both result sets, show the port status along with (1) the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of allocated IP address string lengths for ports with port security enabled and allocated IP address in ('10.150.64.113/8'), and (2) the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of port security bindings per port for ports belonging to tenant ID '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7'. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: IP Address "10.150.64.113/8" is predicated by "ipallocations.ip_address IN ('10.150.64.113/8')" Tenant ID "17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')"
SQL: WITH sq1 AS ( SELECT p.status, STDDEV(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) / NULLIF(AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM portsecuritybindings psb JOIN ports p ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON p.id = ia.port_id WHERE psb.port_security_enabled = 1 AND ia.ip_address IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), sq2 AS ( SELECT p.status, MAX(ps.binding_count) - MIN(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_range, VARIANCE(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_variance, STDDEV(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_stddev FROM ports AS p JOIN ( SELECT p2.id AS port_id, COUNT(*) AS binding_count FROM ports AS p2 JOIN portsecuritybindings AS b ON p2.id = b.port_id WHERE p2.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p2.id ) AS ps ON p.id = ps.port_id GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY binding_count_range DESC ) SELECT sq2.status, sq1.coefficient_of_variation, sq2.binding_count_range, sq2.binding_count_variance, sq2.binding_count_stddev FROM sq2 JOIN sq1 ON sq2.status = sq1.status ORDER BY sq2.binding_count_range DESC;

question: For tenant ID '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57', find ports that are DOWN but also have admin_state_up = 1 and are bound to a security group. For each such port, return the port ID, tenant ID, MAC address, security group ID, the port’s rank within its security group when ordered by port ID, the port name, the number of security-group bindings on the port, and the total number of DNS records associated with the port. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')"
SQL: WITH DownPortsBySecurityGroup AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, sgpb.security_group_id, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sgpb.security_group_id ORDER BY p.id) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), AdminUpPortBindingAndDNSCounts AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.name AS port_name, COUNT(sgpb.security_group_id) AS security_group_binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pd.port_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS dns_record_count FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS sgpb JOIN PORTS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id LEFT JOIN PORTDNSES pd ON p.id = pd.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.name), DownPortsThatAreAlsoAdminUp AS ( SELECT dpsg.port_id, dpsg.tenant_id, dpsg.mac_address, dpsg.security_group_id, dpsg.window_column, aup.port_name, aup.security_group_binding_count, aup.dns_record_count FROM DownPortsBySecurityGroup dpsg JOIN AdminUpPortBindingAndDNSCounts aup ON dpsg.port_id = aup.port_id AND dpsg.tenant_id = aup.tenant_id ) SELECT port_id, tenant_id, mac_address, security_group_id, window_column AS port_rank_within_security_group_by_port_id, port_name, security_group_binding_count, dns_record_count FROM DownPortsThatAreAlsoAdminUp ORDER BY security_group_id, port_id;

question: For non-shared networks (excluding any network IDs that appear in networkrbacs with action = 'access_as_shared' and target_tenant = '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'), what is the port count and earliest standard-attribute updated timestamp for each port status and device owner (considering only standardattributes.resource_type = 'ports'), and—at the same time—what is the number of RBAC rows for each (action, target_tenant) among ACTIVE networks? Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "exclusion of shared networks" is predicated by "networks.id NOT IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))"
SQL: WITH port_status_owner_summary AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), active_network_rbac_details AS ( SELECT n.name, n.status, n.admin_state_up, r.action, r.target_tenant, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.id ORDER BY n.id) AS window_column FROM networksecuritybindings b JOIN networks n ON b.network_id = n.id JOIN networkrbacs r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND n.id NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) ), active_network_rbac_counts AS ( SELECT action, target_tenant, COUNT(*) AS active_network_rbac_row_count FROM active_network_rbac_details GROUP BY action, target_tenant ) SELECT p.port_status, p.device_owner, p.port_count, p.earliest_standard_attr_update, c.action, c.target_tenant, c.active_network_rbac_row_count FROM port_status_owner_summary p CROSS JOIN active_network_rbac_counts c;

question: For the RBAC action access_as_shared, return the action name along with (1) the variance of subnet IP version (IPv4 vs IPv6) considering only public RBAC entries where TARGET_TENANT = '*', and (2) the average, range (max minus min), and variance of subnet IP version across all referenced subnets with IP version 4 or 6. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "public access" (wildcard) is predicated by "networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*'" "access_as_shared" permission is predicated by "networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared'"
SQL: WITH Subq1 AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' AND n.TARGET_TENANT = '*' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_variance DESC ), Subq2 AS ( SELECT n.ACTION AS rbac_action, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, MAX(s.IP_VERSION) - MIN(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_range, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION IN (4, 6) AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_range DESC ) SELECT s1.ACTION, s1.ip_version_variance AS public_access_ip_version_variance, s2.avg_ip_version, s2.ip_version_range, s2.ip_version_variance AS overall_ip_version_variance FROM Subq1 s1 JOIN Subq2 s2 ON s1.ACTION = s2.rbac_action;

question: For the IPv4 subnet with ID '012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48', list (1) its subnet name and the dense-rank window value of its associated standard attribute (ordered by the standard attribute UPDATED_AT with a frame of the current row and 2 preceding rows) and (2) the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of routes per subnet name, combining both result types into one output and labeling each row with a reason. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Subnet ID "012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48" is predicated by "subnets.id IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48')"
SQL: WITH SubnetAttributeWindow AS ( SELECT s.NAME, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY sa.UPDATED_AT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES AS sa ON sa.ID = s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') ), SubnetRouteStats AS ( SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, MAX(route_count) - MIN(route_count) AS route_count_range, VARIANCE(route_count) AS route_count_variance, STDDEV(route_count) AS route_count_stddev FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN ( SELECT sr.SUBNET_ID, COUNT(*) AS route_count FROM SUBNETROUTES AS sr GROUP BY sr.SUBNET_ID, sr.NEXTHOP ) AS route_stats ON s.ID = route_stats.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') GROUP BY s.NAME ORDER BY route_count_range DESC ), CombinedSubnetMetrics AS ( SELECT saw.NAME AS subnet_name, saw.window_column, NULL AS route_count_range, NULL AS route_count_variance, NULL AS route_count_stddev, 'Standard Attribute Window Rank' AS reason FROM SubnetAttributeWindow AS saw UNION ALL SELECT srs.subnet_name, NULL AS window_column, srs.route_count_range, srs.route_count_variance, srs.route_count_stddev, 'Route Count Stats' AS reason FROM SubnetRouteStats AS srs ) SELECT * FROM CombinedSubnetMetrics ORDER BY subnet_name, reason;

question: For each port status, for ports associated with the allocated IP address '10.150.64.113/8' (and with port security enabled where applicable), show the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of allocated IP address string length and the variance of STANDARD_ATTR_ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: IP Address "10.150.64.113/8" is predicated by "ipallocations.ip_address IN ('10.150.64.113/8')"
SQL: WITH CoeffOfVarByStatus AS ( SELECT p.status, STDDEV(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) / NULLIF(AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM portsecuritybindings psb JOIN ports p ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON p.id = ia.port_id WHERE psb.port_security_enabled = 1 AND ia.ip_address IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), StdAttrIdVarByStatus AS ( SELECT p.STATUS, VARIANCE(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS standard_attr_id_variance FROM PORTS AS p JOIN IPALLOCATIONS AS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID IS NOT NULL AND ia.IP_ADDRESS IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.STATUS ORDER BY standard_attr_id_variance DESC ) SELECT cv.status, cv.coefficient_of_variation, sv.standard_attr_id_variance FROM CoeffOfVarByStatus cv JOIN StdAttrIdVarByStatus sv ON cv.status = sv.status;

question: For tenant_id '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7', for each port status that has ports with both a security group port binding and a port security binding, show the port status and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of standard_attr_id, along with (for DOWN ports bound to a security group) the device owner, the number of distinct ports, and the minimum standard_attr_id. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Tenant ID "17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')"
SQL: WITH port_status_cov AS ( SELECT p.status, STDDEV(p.standard_attr_id) / NULLIF(AVG(p.standard_attr_id), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM securitygroupportbindings AS sgpb JOIN ports AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN portsecuritybindings AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(p.standard_attr_id) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), down_ports_by_owner AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS min_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS spb ON p.ID = spb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ) SELECT psc.status, psc.coefficient_of_variation, dpo.device_owner, dpo.port_count, dpo.min_standard_attr_id FROM port_status_cov psc JOIN down_ports_by_owner dpo ON psc.status = dpo.port_status;

question: For the IPv4 subnet whose ID is `012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48`, return the subnet name along with (1) the dense rank of its associated standard attribute when ordered by the standard attribute UPDATED_AT timestamp using a window frame of the current row and the 2 preceding rows, and (2) the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of routes per subnet. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Subnet ID "012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48" is predicated by "subnets.id IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48')"
SQL: WITH SubnetWindowRanks AS ( SELECT s.NAME, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY sa.UPDATED_AT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES AS sa ON sa.ID = s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') ), SubnetRouteStats AS ( SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, MAX(route_count) - MIN(route_count) AS route_count_range, VARIANCE(route_count) AS route_count_variance, STDDEV(route_count) AS route_count_stddev FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN ( SELECT sr.SUBNET_ID, COUNT(*) AS route_count FROM SUBNETROUTES AS sr GROUP BY sr.SUBNET_ID, sr.NEXTHOP ) AS route_stats ON s.ID = route_stats.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') GROUP BY s.NAME ORDER BY route_count_range DESC ) SELECT swr.NAME AS subnet_name, swr.window_column, srs.route_count_range, srs.route_count_variance, srs.route_count_stddev FROM SubnetWindowRanks AS swr JOIN SubnetRouteStats AS srs ON srs.subnet_name = swr.NAME ORDER BY swr.NAME, swr.window_column;

question: For administratively up ports belonging to tenant ID `98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57`, list the port ID, host, VIF type, VNIC type, tenant ID, network ID, MAC address, status, device owner, and the 2-preceding-to-2-following window average of standard attribute ID (partitioned by VIF type and ordered by standard attribute ID), and also include (matched by port status) the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of allocated IP address string lengths for ports with port security enabled restricted to allocated IP address `10.150.64.113/8`. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: IP Address "10.150.64.113/8" is predicated by "ipallocations.ip_address IN ('10.150.64.113/8')" Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')"
SQL: WITH PortStatusIPLenCV AS (SELECT p.status, STDDEV(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) / NULLIF(AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM portsecuritybindings psb JOIN ports p ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON p.id = ia.port_id WHERE psb.port_security_enabled = 1 AND ia.ip_address IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC), AdminUpTenantPorts AS (SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')) SELECT a.PORT_ID, a.HOST, a.VIF_TYPE, a.VNIC_TYPE, a.TENANT_ID, a.NETWORK_ID, a.MAC_ADDRESS, a.STATUS, a.DEVICE_OWNER, a.window_column, cv.coefficient_of_variation FROM AdminUpTenantPorts a JOIN PortStatusIPLenCV cv ON a.STATUS = cv.status;

question: For tenant ID `98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57`, for each security group that contains both DOWN ports and non-DOWN ports, show the security group ID, the total number of ports in the security group, the number of DOWN ports, the average running-sum (within the security group) of DOWN ports’ standard attribute IDs, the number of administratively UP ports that have at least one IP allocation, the average number of IP allocations per such administratively UP port, and the maximum number of subnet-id rows among those administratively UP ports. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')"
SQL: WITH PortIpAllocationStats AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ia.subnet_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subnet_id_rows FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON ia.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND ia.ip_address IS NOT NULL AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address ), DownPortsWindowBySecurityGroup AS ( SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), SecurityGroupCountsForTenant AS ( SELECT sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID AS security_group_id, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS total_ports_in_sg_for_tenant, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.STATUS = 'DOWN' THEN p.ID END) AS down_ports_in_sg_for_tenant FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS sgpb JOIN PORTS p ON sgpb.PORT_ID = p.ID WHERE p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ) SELECT sct.security_group_id, sct.total_ports_in_sg_for_tenant, sct.down_ports_in_sg_for_tenant, AVG(dpw.window_column) AS avg_down_port_running_sum_standard_attr_id, COUNT(DISTINCT pia.port_id) AS admin_up_ports_with_ip_allocations_in_sg, AVG(pia.ip_allocation_count) AS avg_ip_allocations_per_admin_up_port_in_sg, MAX(pia.subnet_id_rows) AS max_subnet_id_rows_among_admin_up_ports_in_sg FROM SecurityGroupCountsForTenant sct JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS sgpb ON sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID = sct.security_group_id LEFT JOIN DownPortsWindowBySecurityGroup dpw ON dpw.port_id = sgpb.PORT_ID LEFT JOIN PortIpAllocationStats pia ON pia.port_id = sgpb.PORT_ID WHERE sct.down_ports_in_sg_for_tenant > 0 AND (sct.total_ports_in_sg_for_tenant - sct.down_ports_in_sg_for_tenant) > 0 GROUP BY sct.security_group_id, sct.total_ports_in_sg_for_tenant, sct.down_ports_in_sg_for_tenant ORDER BY sct.total_ports_in_sg_for_tenant DESC;

question: For each port status and device owner, excluding ports on shared networks (networks listed in networkrbacs with action = 'access_as_shared' and target_tenant = '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') and considering only ports whose standard attribute resource type is 'ports', return the port count and earliest standard attribute updated timestamp, but only for statuses that also have ports bound with VIF type 'ovs' for device_id 'da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7'; include the minimum admin_state_up and average standard_attr_id for those statuses. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "exclusion of shared networks" is predicated by "networks.id NOT IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))" Device ID "da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7" is predicated by "ports.device_id IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7')"
SQL: WITH PortStatusOwnerStats AS (SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER), OvsBoundDevicePortStats AS (SELECT p.STATUS, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) AS min_admin_state_up, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS avg_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS b ON p.ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE b.VIF_TYPE = 'ovs' AND p.DEVICE_ID IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS) SELECT psos.port_status, psos.device_owner, psos.port_count, psos.earliest_standard_attr_update, obdps.min_admin_state_up, obdps.avg_standard_attr_id FROM PortStatusOwnerStats psos JOIN OvsBoundDevicePortStats obdps ON psos.port_status = obdps.STATUS ORDER BY psos.port_status, psos.device_owner;

question: For tenant ID `98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57`, list ports that are DOWN but also have admin state up and at least one IP allocation; for each such port, return the tenant ID, port ID, MAC address, the running sum of the port’s standard attribute ID within its security group (ordered by standard attribute ID), the number of IP allocations on the port, and the number of rows with a non-null subnet ID among those allocations. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')"
SQL: WITH PortIpAllocationStats AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ia.subnet_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subnet_id_rows FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON ia.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND ia.ip_address IS NOT NULL AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address ), DownPortsSecurityGroupWindow AS ( SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ) SELECT dpsgw.tenant_id, dpsgw.port_id, dpsgw.mac_address, dpsgw.window_column, pis.ip_allocation_count, pis.subnet_id_rows FROM DownPortsSecurityGroupWindow dpsgw JOIN PortIpAllocationStats pis ON pis.port_id = dpsgw.port_id AND pis.tenant_id = dpsgw.tenant_id WHERE pis.ip_allocation_count >= 1 ORDER BY dpsgw.window_column DESC, dpsgw.port_id;

question: For the RBAC action access_as_shared, return the action name along with the average, range (max minus min), variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of subnet IP versions (IPv4/IPv6), where the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) is computed only over DHCP-enabled subnets on non-shared networks (excluding networks that have an access_as_shared RBAC entry with target tenant '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') and only if there are more than 5 such matching subnets. SQL: WITH RbacIpVersionStddev AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.ENABLE_DHCP = 1 AND s.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.ACTION HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY ip_version_stddev DESC ), AccessAsSharedIpVersionStats AS ( SELECT n.ACTION AS rbac_action, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, MAX(s.IP_VERSION) - MIN(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_range, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION IN (4, 6) AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_range DESC ) SELECT aasis.rbac_action, aasis.avg_ip_version, aasis.ip_version_range, aasis.ip_version_variance, rivs.ip_version_stddev FROM AccessAsSharedIpVersionStats aasis JOIN RbacIpVersionStddev rivs ON aasis.rbac_action = rivs.ACTION ORDER BY aasis.ip_version_range DESC;

question: For each IPv4 subnet whose subnet ID is in ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48'), show the subnet name, tenant ID, network ID, IP version, CIDR, gateway IP, DHCP enabled flag, the allocation pool’s first and last IP, the maximum subnet standard attribute ID considering the current row and the next 2 rows (ordered by subnet ID), the dense rank of its standard attribute ID ordered by the standard attribute updated-at timestamp using a window of the current row and 2 preceding rows, and the ratio of that dense rank to the max standard attribute ID.

SQL: WITH SubnetPools AS (SELECT s.NAME, s.TENANT_ID, s.NETWORK_ID, s.IP_VERSION, s.CIDR, s.GATEWAY_IP, s.ENABLE_DHCP, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, MAX(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( ORDER BY s.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN IPALLOCATIONPOOLS AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48')), SubnetAttrDenseRank AS (SELECT s.NAME, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY sa.UPDATED_AT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES AS sa ON sa.ID = s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48')) SELECT sp.NAME AS subnet_name, sp.TENANT_ID, sp.NETWORK_ID, sp.IP_VERSION, sp.CIDR, sp.GATEWAY_IP, sp.ENABLE_DHCP, sp.FIRST_IP AS allocation_pool_first_ip, sp.LAST_IP AS allocation_pool_last_ip, sp.max_standard_attr_id_next2, sadr.window_column AS standard_attr_dense_rank_window, ROUND(sadr.window_column / NULLIF(sp.max_standard_attr_id_next2, 0), 4) AS dense_rank_to_max_attr_ratio FROM SubnetPools sp JOIN SubnetAttrDenseRank sadr ON sp.NAME = sadr.NAME ORDER BY dense_rank_to_max_attr_ratio DESC;

question: For administratively up ports belonging to tenant ID `98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57`, list each port’s ID, host, VIF type, VNIC type, tenant ID, network ID, MAC address, status, device owner, and the 2-preceding/2-following windowed average of standard attribute ID (partitioned by VIF type and ordered by standard attribute ID), along with the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of standard attribute IDs for that same port status computed over ports that have both a security group port binding and a port security binding for tenant `17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7`. SQL: WITH sq1 AS ( SELECT p.status, STDDEV(p.standard_attr_id) / NULLIF(AVG(p.standard_attr_id), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM securitygroupportbindings AS sgpb JOIN ports AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN portsecuritybindings AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(p.standard_attr_id) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), sq2 AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ) SELECT sq2.PORT_ID, sq2.HOST, sq2.VIF_TYPE, sq2.VNIC_TYPE, sq2.TENANT_ID, sq2.NETWORK_ID, sq2.MAC_ADDRESS, sq2.STATUS, sq2.DEVICE_OWNER, sq2.window_column, sq1.coefficient_of_variation FROM sq2 JOIN sq1 ON sq2.STATUS = sq1.status ORDER BY sq1.coefficient_of_variation DESC, sq2.window_column DESC;

SQL: WITH sq1 AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), sq2 AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ) SELECT sq2.VIF_TYPE, sq2.STATUS AS port_status, sq2.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, sq1.port_count, sq1.earliest_standard_attr_update, COUNT(sq2.PORT_ID) AS tenant_port_rows, AVG(sq2.window_column) AS avg_window_standard_attr_id FROM sq2 JOIN sq1 ON sq2.STATUS = sq1.port_status AND sq2.DEVICE_OWNER = sq1.device_owner WHERE sq2.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY sq2.VIF_TYPE, sq2.STATUS, sq2.DEVICE_OWNER, sq1.port_count, sq1.earliest_standard_attr_update ORDER BY tenant_port_rows DESC;

question: For ports that are DOWN and belong to tenant ID '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57', list each port’s ID, tenant ID, MAC address, and security group ID, along with (1) the port’s rank within its security group when ordered by port ID and (2) the running sum of the port’s standard attribute ID within the same security group ordered by standard attribute ID. evidence: Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')"
SQL: WITH ports_rank_within_sg AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, sgpb.security_group_id, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sgpb.security_group_id ORDER BY p.id) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), ports_running_sum_std_attr AS ( SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ) SELECT prws.port_id, prws.tenant_id, prws.mac_address, prws.security_group_id, prws.window_column AS rank_within_security_group_by_port_id, prssa.window_column AS running_sum_standard_attr_id_within_security_group FROM ports_rank_within_sg prws JOIN ports_running_sum_std_attr prssa ON prssa.port_id = prws.port_id AND prssa.tenant_id = prws.tenant_id AND prssa.mac_address = prws.mac_address;

question: For tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57", for tenants that have at least 2 administratively-up ports, return the tenant ID, the count of those admin-up ports, the number of ACTIVE networks for that tenant, and the most recent (latest) network standard-attribute updated_at timestamp. SQL: WITH ActiveTenantNetworks AS (SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM NETWORKS n JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND n.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), AdminUpTenantPorts AS (SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), TenantPortCounts AS ( SELECT ap.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.PORT_ID) AS admin_up_port_count FROM AdminUpTenantPorts ap GROUP BY ap.TENANT_ID ) SELECT an.tenant_id, tpc.admin_up_port_count, COUNT(DISTINCT an.network_id) AS active_network_count, MAX(an.standard_attr_updated_at) AS latest_network_standard_attr_updated_at FROM ActiveTenantNetworks an JOIN TenantPortCounts tpc ON an.tenant_id = tpc.tenant_id WHERE tpc.admin_up_port_count >= 2 GROUP BY an.tenant_id, tpc.admin_up_port_count ORDER BY tpc.admin_up_port_count DESC, active_network_count DESC;

SQL: WITH RankedPortsBySecurityGroup AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, sgpb.security_group_id, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sgpb.security_group_id ORDER BY p.id) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), RunningSumStandardAttrIdBySecurityGroup AS ( SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ) SELECT r.port_id, r.tenant_id, r.mac_address, r.security_group_id, r.window_column AS rank_within_security_group_by_port_id, s.window_column AS running_sum_standard_attr_id_within_security_group FROM RankedPortsBySecurityGroup r JOIN RunningSumStandardAttrIdBySecurityGroup s ON s.port_id = r.port_id AND s.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND s.mac_address = r.mac_address;

SQL: WITH DownPortsBySecurityGroup AS ( SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), AdminUpPortsByVifType AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ) SELECT a.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT a.PORT_ID) AS admin_up_port_count, COUNT(DISTINCT d.port_id) AS down_port_count, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT d.port_id) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT a.PORT_ID), 0), 2) AS down_to_admin_up_port_ratio, AVG(a.window_column) AS avg_admin_up_window_avg_standard_attr_id, AVG(d.window_column) AS avg_down_window_running_sum_standard_attr_id FROM AdminUpPortsByVifType a LEFT JOIN DownPortsBySecurityGroup d ON d.tenant_id = a.TENANT_ID GROUP BY a.TENANT_ID ORDER BY down_to_admin_up_port_ratio DESC;

SQL: WITH SubnetPoolsAndMaxStdAttrNext2 AS ( SELECT s.NAME, s.TENANT_ID, s.NETWORK_ID, s.IP_VERSION, s.CIDR, s.GATEWAY_IP, s.ENABLE_DHCP, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, MAX(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( ORDER BY s.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN IPALLOCATIONPOOLS AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') ), SubnetStdAttrDenseRankWindow AS ( SELECT s.NAME, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY sa.UPDATED_AT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES AS sa ON sa.ID = s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') ) SELECT sp.NAME AS subnet_name, sp.TENANT_ID, sp.NETWORK_ID, sp.IP_VERSION, sp.CIDR, sp.GATEWAY_IP, sp.ENABLE_DHCP, sp.FIRST_IP, sp.LAST_IP, sp.max_standard_attr_id_next2, sr.window_column AS dense_rank_by_updated_at_window FROM SubnetPoolsAndMaxStdAttrNext2 sp JOIN SubnetStdAttrDenseRankWindow sr ON sp.NAME = sr.NAME;
