question: For confirmed migrations and for instances whose display name is 'forge', return a combined report (joined by instance display name) that includes the migration status, source and destination compute hosts, the instance display name and network_info, the dense rank within each migration status plus the overall average dense-rank across confirmed migrations and each row’s deviation from that average; and also includes the forge instance UUID, VM state, memory (MB), vCPUs, instance-extra ID and created timestamp, cached network_info JSON, the minimum instance-extra ID in a 3-preceding/1-following window ordered by memory, and whether the instance has any deleted instance-extra record. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH confirmed_migrations AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, i.display_name, ic.network_info, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.status ORDER BY m.status) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'confirmed'), avg_rank AS ( SELECT AVG(window_column) AS avg_window_column FROM inner_cte ) SELECT c.status, c.source_compute, c.dest_compute, c.display_name, c.network_info, c.window_column, a.avg_window_column, (c.window_column - a.avg_window_column) AS deviation_from_avg_dense_rank FROM inner_cte c CROSS JOIN avg_rank a), forge_instances AS (WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ie.CREATED_AT AS instance_extra_created_at, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, MIN(ie.ID) OVER ( ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' ) SELECT ic.instance_uuid, ic.display_name, ic.vm_state, ic.memory_mb, ic.vcpus, ic.instance_extra_id, ic.instance_extra_created_at, ic.network_info, ic.window_column, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie2 JOIN INSTANCES i2 ON i2.UUID = ie2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i2.UUID = ic.instance_uuid AND ie2.DELETED <> 0 ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_deleted_instance_extra FROM inner_cte ic) SELECT cm.status AS migration_status, cm.source_compute, cm.dest_compute, cm.display_name AS migration_instance_display_name, cm.network_info AS migration_network_info, cm.window_column AS migration_dense_rank_within_status, cm.avg_window_column AS avg_migration_dense_rank_across_confirmed, cm.deviation_from_avg_dense_rank, fi.instance_uuid AS forge_instance_uuid, fi.display_name AS forge_display_name, fi.vm_state AS forge_vm_state, fi.memory_mb AS forge_memory_mb, fi.vcpus AS forge_vcpus, fi.instance_extra_id AS forge_instance_extra_id, fi.instance_extra_created_at AS forge_instance_extra_created_at, fi.network_info AS forge_network_info, fi.window_column AS forge_min_instance_extra_id_window, fi.has_deleted_instance_extra FROM confirmed_migrations cm JOIN forge_instances fi ON fi.display_name = cm.display_name;

question: For completed migrations, show the average standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of MEMORY_TOTAL by availability zone and instance display name (including subtotals per availability zone and a grand total), and also return (as overall summary values) the total number of system-metadata rows and the average running-sum of instance IDs for instances whose display name is 'forge'. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_total) AS memory_total_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY memory_total_stddev DESC ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.availability_zone) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE i.availability_zone END AS availability_zone, CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.display_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(i.availability_zone) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE inner_cte.display_name END AS display_name, AVG(inner_cte.memory_total_stddev) AS avg_memory_total_stddev FROM inner_cte JOIN instances AS i ON i.display_name = inner_cte.display_name GROUP BY i.availability_zone, inner_cte.display_name WITH ROLLUP ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, ism.key AS metadata_key, ism.value AS metadata_value, i.power_state, SUM(i.id) OVER (PARTITION BY i.power_state ORDER BY i.id) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.display_name = 'forge' ) SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.metadata_key, inner_cte.metadata_value, inner_cte.power_state, inner_cte.window_column, stats.total_rows, stats.avg_window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_rows, AVG(window_column) AS avg_window_column FROM inner_cte ) AS stats ON 1 = 1 ) SELECT q1.availability_zone, q1.display_name, q1.avg_memory_total_stddev, q2.total_rows AS forge_metadata_total_rows, q2.avg_window_column AS forge_metadata_avg_running_sum FROM q1 CROSS JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT total_rows, avg_window_column FROM q2 ) AS q2;

question: For completed migrations, list the migration ID, instance display name, the instance-memory variance/standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) (plus average and max MEMORY_MB) computed only for display names that have a non-deleted system metadata entry with KEY = 'image_image_type' and whose average MEMORY_MB is greater than 75% of the max MEMORY_MB for that display name; also show each migration row’s system metadata key/value, its row number (ordered by metadata key with a 2-preceding/1-following window frame), the overall average row number benchmark, and whether the row number is above, below, or at that benchmark. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH MemoryStatsByDisplayName AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND ism.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) AS max_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON i.DISPLAY_NAME = inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND ism.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev HAVING (AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) * 1.0 / MAX(i.MEMORY_MB)) > 0.75 ORDER BY avg_memory_mb DESC ), CompletedMigrationMetadataRownum AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY ism.KEY ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' ), avg_window AS ( SELECT AVG(window_column) AS avg_window_column FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.migration_id, ic.instance_display_name, ic.metadata_key, ic.metadata_value, ic.window_column, aw.avg_window_column AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.window_column > aw.avg_window_column THEN 'ABOVE_AVG_ROWNUM' WHEN ic.window_column < aw.avg_window_column THEN 'BELOW_AVG_ROWNUM' ELSE 'AT_AVG_ROWNUM' END AS rownum_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_window aw ) SELECT cmr.migration_id, cmr.instance_display_name, ms.memory_mb_variance, ms.memory_mb_stddev, ms.avg_memory_mb, ms.max_memory_mb, cmr.metadata_key, cmr.metadata_value, cmr.window_column, cmr.benchmark, cmr.rownum_category FROM CompletedMigrationMetadataRownum cmr JOIN MemoryStatsByDisplayName ms ON ms.DISPLAY_NAME = cmr.instance_display_name ORDER BY ms.avg_memory_mb DESC, cmr.migration_id, cmr.metadata_key;

question: For each (VM state, display name) group that has more than 8 VCPUs per instance and whose instance count is greater than the average instance count across all such groups, show the VM state, display name, instance count, and minimum memory (MB); and for the matching 'forge' groups, also show the average deviation from the overall 'forge' average memory (MB) and the minimum 3-preceding/1-following windowed minimum memory (MB) computed over instance extra IDs. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( ORDER BY ie.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge'), avg_mem AS (SELECT AVG(memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.instance_uuid, ic.hostname, ic.vm_state, ic.memory_mb, ic.instance_extra_id, ic.window_column, (ic.memory_mb - am.avg_memory_mb) AS deviation_from_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_mem am ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(i.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VCPUS > 8 GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME) SELECT VM_STATE, DISPLAY_NAME, instance_count, min_memory_mb FROM inner_cte WHERE instance_count > (SELECT AVG(instance_count) FROM inner_cte) ) SELECT s2.VM_STATE, s2.DISPLAY_NAME, s2.instance_count, s2.min_memory_mb, AVG(s1.deviation_from_avg_memory_mb) AS avg_deviation_from_avg_memory_mb_among_forge_instances_in_group, MIN(s1.window_column) AS min_windowed_memory_mb_among_forge_instances_in_group FROM subq2 s2 JOIN subq1 s1 ON s1.vm_state = s2.VM_STATE AND s2.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' GROUP BY s2.VM_STATE, s2.DISPLAY_NAME, s2.instance_count, s2.min_memory_mb ORDER BY s2.instance_count DESC;

question: For instances with display name equal to 'forge', list each instance’s project ID (with per-project subtotal rows), instance ID, UUID, user ID, hostname, VM state, power state, memory (MB), vCPUs, availability zone, and the related instance-info-cache record ID and network info; also show the minimum memory (MB) within each project, the per-project total forge instance count and average memory (MB), plus the running average memory (MB) within the 'forge' display-name group ordered by memory, along with the overall total number of 'forge' instances and overall average memory (MB). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, i.uuid, i.memory_mb, c.network_info, c.id AS cache_id, AVG(i.memory_mb) OVER (PARTITION BY i.display_name ORDER BY i.memory_mb) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.display_name = 'forge' ORDER BY i.memory_mb ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.uuid, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.network_info, inner_cte.cache_id, inner_cte.window_column, forge_stats.total_forge_instances, forge_stats.avg_forge_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_forge_instances, AVG(memory_mb) AS avg_forge_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) AS forge_stats ON 1 = 1 ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.ID AS instance_id, i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.USER_ID, i.PROJECT_ID, i.HOSTNAME, i.VM_STATE, i.POWER_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, c.ID AS info_cache_id, c.NETWORK_INFO, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.PROJECT_ID ORDER BY i.PROJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(project_name) OVER (ORDER BY project_sort, project_name) = project_name THEN NULL ELSE project_name END AS project_id, instance_id, instance_uuid, user_id, hostname, vm_state, power_state, memory_mb, vcpus, availability_zone, info_cache_id, network_info, window_column AS min_memory_mb_in_project, total_instances, avg_memory_mb FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(project_id) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE project_id END AS project_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(project_id) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE project_id END AS project_name, instance_id, instance_uuid, user_id, hostname, vm_state, power_state, memory_mb, vcpus, availability_zone, info_cache_id, network_info, window_column, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY project_id) AS total_instances, AVG(memory_mb) OVER (PARTITION BY project_id) AS avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte GROUP BY project_id, instance_id, instance_uuid, user_id, hostname, vm_state, power_state, memory_mb, vcpus, availability_zone, info_cache_id, network_info, window_column WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY project_sort, project_name, instance_id ) SELECT q2.project_id, q2.instance_id, q2.instance_uuid, q2.user_id, q2.hostname, q2.vm_state, q2.power_state, q2.memory_mb, q2.vcpus, q2.availability_zone, q2.info_cache_id, q2.network_info, q2.min_memory_mb_in_project, q2.total_instances AS total_forge_instances_in_project, q2.avg_memory_mb AS avg_forge_memory_mb_in_project, q1.window_column AS avg_memory_mb_within_display_name_ordered_by_memory, q1.total_forge_instances AS total_forge_instances_overall, q1.avg_forge_memory_mb AS avg_forge_memory_mb_overall FROM q2 LEFT JOIN q1 ON q2.instance_uuid = q1.uuid ORDER BY q2.project_id, q2.instance_id;

question: For each instance display name (considering only instances that have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type'), show the memory range and memory variance (MB) along with the overall average memory range benchmark and its variability category, and also show the average memory and memory variance (MB) along with the overall average variance benchmark and its variance category. Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each display name as 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' (at least 50% above the benchmark), 'LOW_VARIABILITY' (at least 50% below the benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_VARIABILITY'.
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_range_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_variance_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_range_mb DESC ), AverageRange AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_range_mb) AS avg_memory_range_mb FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_range_mb, ic.memory_variance_mb, ar.avg_memory_range_mb AS benchmark_memory_range_mb, CASE WHEN ic.memory_range_mb > ar.avg_memory_range_mb * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN ic.memory_range_mb < ar.avg_memory_range_mb * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIABILITY' END AS variability_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AverageRange ar ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), VarianceBenchmark AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb_variance) AS avg_variance_benchmark FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.avg_memory_mb, ic.memory_mb_variance, vb.avg_variance_benchmark AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.memory_mb_variance > vb.avg_variance_benchmark * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN ic.memory_mb_variance < vb.avg_variance_benchmark * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN VarianceBenchmark vb ORDER BY ic.memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT q1.display_name, q1.memory_range_mb, q1.memory_variance_mb, q1.benchmark_memory_range_mb, q1.variability_category, q2.avg_memory_mb, q2.memory_mb_variance, q2.benchmark AS variance_benchmark, q2.variance_category FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.display_name = q2.display_name;

question: For availability zone 'flare3', among the top 10 instance display names with the most network info cache records, return only those display names whose total memory (in MB) across instances in VM state 'shelved_offloaded' is greater than 20000 MB and also greater than the average total memory across such display names; for each, show the display name, total memory, cache record count, the average cache record count across the top 10, and the deviation from that average. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH ShelvedOffloadedHighMemory AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING SUM(i.memory_mb) > 20000) SELECT display_name, total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte WHERE total_memory_mb > (SELECT AVG(total_memory_mb) FROM inner_cte)), Top10Flare3CacheStats AS (WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(iic.id) AS cache_records FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY cache_records DESC LIMIT 10 ), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(cache_records) AS avg_cache_records FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.cache_records, ac.avg_cache_records, (ic.cache_records - ac.avg_cache_records) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte ac ORDER BY ic.cache_records DESC) SELECT t.display_name, s.total_memory_mb, t.cache_records, t.avg_cache_records, t.deviation_from_avg FROM Top10Flare3CacheStats t JOIN ShelvedOffloadedHighMemory s ON s.display_name = t.display_name WHERE s.total_memory_mb > 20000 ORDER BY s.total_memory_mb DESC, t.cache_records DESC;

question: For each instance VM state and display name (considering only instances that have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type'), list the VM state, display name, number of instances, minimum memory (MB), the deviation of that minimum memory from the overall average of these per-(VM state, display name) minimum memories, and the maximum (by VM state) geometric mean of instance memory (MB) for instances with memory greater than 0. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH PerStateDisplayNameMinMemory AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(i.ID) AS instance_count, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(min_memory_mb) AS avg_min_memory_mb FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.VM_STATE, ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.instance_count, ic.min_memory_mb, (ic.min_memory_mb - ac.avg_min_memory_mb) AS deviation_from_avg_min_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte ac ), PerStateMaxGeometricMeanMemory AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.vm_state, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.vm_state ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC) SELECT vm_state, MAX(geometric_mean_memory_mb) AS max_geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM inner_cte GROUP BY vm_state ORDER BY max_geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC ) SELECT psdn.VM_STATE, psdn.DISPLAY_NAME, psdn.instance_count, psdn.min_memory_mb, psdn.deviation_from_avg_min_memory_mb, psgm.max_geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM PerStateDisplayNameMinMemory psdn JOIN PerStateMaxGeometricMeanMemory psgm ON psdn.VM_STATE = psgm.vm_state ORDER BY psdn.VM_STATE, psdn.DISPLAY_NAME;

question: How many instance display names (among instances with system metadata KEY = 'image_image_type') have a memory (MEMORY_MB) standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the overall average of per-display-name standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP)s, and how many (VM_STATE, DISPLAY_NAME) groups (also restricted to KEY = 'image_image_type') have a minimum memory greater than 75% of the maximum group minimum—counting only groups whose display name is one of those high-standard-deviation display names? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH stddev_by_display_name AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC ), StddevAverage AS ( SELECT AVG(inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev) AS avg_memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte ) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev > (SELECT avg_memory_mb_stddev FROM StddevAverage) ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev DESC ), min_memory_groups AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(i.ID) AS instance_count, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME) SELECT ic.VM_STATE, ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.instance_count, ic.min_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ic WHERE ic.min_memory_mb > 0.75 * (SELECT MAX(min_memory_mb) FROM inner_cte) ) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sbdn.DISPLAY_NAME) AS display_names_with_high_memory_stddev_count, COUNT(*) AS vm_state_display_name_groups_with_high_min_memory_count FROM stddev_by_display_name sbdn JOIN min_memory_groups mmg ON mmg.DISPLAY_NAME = sbdn.DISPLAY_NAME;

question: For each VM state and instance display name (considering only instances with more than 8 VCPUs), show the instance count, the minimum memory (MB), and how far that minimum memory is from the overall average of per-group minimum memories, but only for display names whose coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of (instance info cache last-updated time minus instance created time, in days) is greater than the average coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) across all non-deleted instances. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH cov_by_display_name AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(c.updated_at - i.created_at) / NULLIF(AVG(c.updated_at - i.created_at), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS e ON e.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON c.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(c.updated_at - i.created_at) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT display_name, coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte WHERE coefficient_of_variation > (SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), min_mem_stats_by_state_and_name AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(i.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VCPUS > 8 GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(min_memory_mb) AS avg_min_memory_mb FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.VM_STATE, ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.instance_count, ic.min_memory_mb, (ic.min_memory_mb - ac.avg_min_memory_mb) AS deviation_from_avg_min_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte ac ) SELECT m.VM_STATE, m.DISPLAY_NAME, m.instance_count, m.min_memory_mb, m.deviation_from_avg_min_memory_mb, c.coefficient_of_variation FROM min_mem_stats_by_state_and_name AS m JOIN cov_by_display_name AS c ON c.display_name = m.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY c.coefficient_of_variation DESC, m.VM_STATE, m.DISPLAY_NAME;

question: Find non-deleted instances in the “shelved_offloaded” VM state that also have a completed migration whose migration ID is greater than the average migration ID among all completed migrations. For those instances, show the instance UUID, display name, power state, system metadata key and value, cached network_info JSON, and the per-key row number (ordered by instance UUID); also include, per metadata key, the total number of rows for that key and the average power state across that key, and do not repeat the metadata key if it is the same as the previous row. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH shelved_metadata AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(metadata_key) OVER (ORDER BY metadata_key, instance_uuid) = metadata_key THEN NULL ELSE metadata_key END AS metadata_key, instance_uuid, display_name, power_state, metadata_value, network_info, window_column, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY metadata_key) AS total_rows_per_key, AVG(power_state) OVER (PARTITION BY metadata_key) AS avg_power_state_per_key FROM inner_cte ORDER BY metadata_key, instance_uuid ), high_completed_migrations AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE AS instance_availability_zone, m.STATUS AS migration_status, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed') SELECT inner_cte.migration_id, inner_cte.instance_display_name, inner_cte.instance_availability_zone, inner_cte.migration_status, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.migration_id > (SELECT AVG(m2.ID * 1.0) FROM MIGRATIONS AS m2 WHERE m2.STATUS = 'completed') ORDER BY inner_cte.migration_id ), high_completed_migration_instances AS ( SELECT DISTINCT m.INSTANCE_UUID AS instance_uuid FROM MIGRATIONS AS m WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND m.INSTANCE_UUID IN ( SELECT i.UUID FROM INSTANCES AS i WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' ) AND m.ID IN (SELECT migration_id FROM high_completed_migrations) ) SELECT sm.metadata_key, sm.instance_uuid, sm.display_name, sm.power_state, sm.metadata_value, sm.network_info, sm.window_column, sm.total_rows_per_key, sm.avg_power_state_per_key FROM shelved_metadata AS sm WHERE sm.instance_uuid IN (SELECT instance_uuid FROM high_completed_migration_instances) ORDER BY sm.metadata_key, sm.instance_uuid;

question: For all non-deleted instances whose VM state is one of the “high total memory” VM states (where the VM-state total memory across non-deleted instances exceeds the overall average instance memory plus one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP)), list each instance’s ID, UUID, user ID, project ID, display name, VM state, memory (MB), vCPUs, and info cache record ID, along with the maximum instance ID over the current row and next 2 rows (by instance ID), the total non-deleted instances in that project, the average of those per-project totals across projects, and also the VM-state total memory and the (avg + stddev) threshold value. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH vm_state_memory_thresholds AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.vm_state, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.vm_state HAVING SUM(i.memory_mb) > ( SELECT AVG(i2.memory_mb) + STDDEV(i2.memory_mb) FROM instances AS i2 JOIN instance_extra AS ie2 ON i2.uuid = ie2.instance_uuid WHERE i2.deleted = 0 )) SELECT inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.total_memory_mb, threshold_stats.avg_plus_stddev AS avg_plus_stddev_threshold FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT AVG(i3.memory_mb) + STDDEV(i3.memory_mb) AS avg_plus_stddev FROM instances AS i3 JOIN instance_extra AS ie3 ON i3.uuid = ie3.instance_uuid WHERE i3.deleted = 0) AS threshold_stats ), instance_project_window_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.id AS instance_id, i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.user_id, i.project_id, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, c.id AS info_cache_id, MAX(i.id) OVER (ORDER BY i.id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_id_next_2 FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND c.deleted = 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.instance_id, inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.user_id, inner_cte.project_id, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.vcpus, inner_cte.info_cache_id, inner_cte.max_instance_id_next_2, project_totals.total_instances_in_project, avg_instances.avg_instance_count FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT project_id, COUNT(*) AS total_instances_in_project FROM inner_cte GROUP BY project_id ) AS project_totals ON inner_cte.project_id = project_totals.project_id JOIN ( SELECT AVG(instance_count) AS avg_instance_count FROM ( SELECT project_id, COUNT(*) AS instance_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY project_id ) AS sub ) AS avg_instances ORDER BY inner_cte.instance_id ) SELECT ips.instance_id, ips.instance_uuid, ips.user_id, ips.project_id, ips.display_name, ips.vm_state, ips.memory_mb, ips.vcpus, ips.info_cache_id, ips.max_instance_id_next_2, ips.total_instances_in_project, ips.avg_instance_count, vst.total_memory_mb AS vm_state_total_memory_mb, vst.avg_plus_stddev_threshold FROM instance_project_window_stats AS ips JOIN vm_state_memory_thresholds AS vst ON ips.vm_state = vst.vm_state ORDER BY ips.instance_id;

question: For instance display names that (a) have at least one system metadata entry with KEY = 'image_image_type' and have a maximum instance memory greater than 16000 MB (reported per display name and launch time with rollup), and (b) also have an average of more than 10 non-deleted system-metadata entries per instance, show the display name, launch time, maximum memory (MB), and the metadata-count range/variance/standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) along with the average metadata-entry count. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) AS max_memory_mb, i.launched_at FROM instances i JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name, i.launched_at HAVING MAX(i.memory_mb) > 16000 ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE display_name END AS display_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(launched_at) = 1 AND GROUPING(display_name) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE CAST(launched_at AS CHAR) END AS launched_at, MAX(max_memory_mb) AS max_memory_mb FROM inner_cte GROUP BY display_name, launched_at WITH ROLLUP ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(meta_entry_count) - MIN(meta_entry_count) AS metadata_count_range, VARIANCE(meta_entry_count) AS metadata_count_variance, STDDEV(meta_entry_count) AS metadata_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN ( SELECT i2.display_name, i2.uuid, COUNT(*) AS meta_entry_count FROM instances AS i2 JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i2.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i2.display_name, i2.uuid ) AS per_instance_counts ON i.display_name = per_instance_counts.display_name GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY metadata_count_range DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.metadata_count_range, inner_cte.metadata_count_variance, inner_cte.metadata_count_stddev, avg_counts.avg_meta_entry_count FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT i.display_name, AVG(per_instance_counts.meta_entry_count) AS avg_meta_entry_count FROM instances AS i JOIN ( SELECT i2.display_name, i2.uuid, COUNT(*) AS meta_entry_count FROM instances AS i2 JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i2.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i2.display_name, i2.uuid ) AS per_instance_counts ON i.display_name = per_instance_counts.display_name GROUP BY i.display_name ) AS avg_counts ON inner_cte.display_name = avg_counts.display_name WHERE avg_counts.avg_meta_entry_count > 10 ORDER BY inner_cte.metadata_count_range DESC ) SELECT q1.display_name, q1.launched_at, q1.max_memory_mb, q2.metadata_count_range, q2.metadata_count_variance, q2.metadata_count_stddev, q2.avg_meta_entry_count FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.display_name = q2.display_name WHERE q1.display_name <> 'GRAND TOTAL' AND q1.launched_at <> 'SUBTOTAL' ORDER BY q1.display_name, q1.launched_at;

question: For migrations whose related instance is in the “shelved_offloaded” VM state, list each migration status and migration type where the migration count is greater than the average migration count across all such (status, migration_type) groups, showing the migration count and the minimum total memory (MEMORY_TOTAL) for those migrations, along with the memory variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) (MEMORY_MB) for the “shelved_offloaded” VM state among instances that have system metadata with KEY = 'image_image_type'. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH MigrationStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.status, m.migration_type, COUNT(m.id) AS migration_count, MIN(m.memory_total) AS min_memory_total FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' GROUP BY m.status, m.migration_type ), GroupAverages AS ( SELECT AVG(inner_cte.migration_count * 1.0) AS avg_migration_count FROM inner_cte ) SELECT inner_cte.status, inner_cte.migration_type, inner_cte.migration_count, inner_cte.min_memory_total FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.migration_count > (SELECT avg_migration_count FROM GroupAverages) ), VmStateMemoryDispersion AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(vm_state_name) OVER (ORDER BY vm_state_sort, vm_state_name) = vm_state_name THEN NULL ELSE vm_state_name END AS vm_state, memory_mb_variance, memory_mb_stddev FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.VM_STATE) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE inner_cte.VM_STATE END AS vm_state_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.VM_STATE) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE inner_cte.VM_STATE END AS vm_state_name, VARIANCE(inner_cte.memory_mb_variance) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.VM_STATE WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY vm_state_sort, vm_state_name ) SELECT ms.status, ms.migration_type, ms.migration_count, ms.min_memory_total, vms.vm_state, vms.memory_mb_variance, vms.memory_mb_stddev FROM MigrationStats ms JOIN VmStateMemoryDispersion vms ON vms.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' ORDER BY ms.migration_count DESC, ms.status, ms.migration_type;

question: How many non-deleted instances in the “shelved_offloaded” VM state have system metadata rows (joined to cached network_info), and how many non-deleted instances have memory_mb greater than the average memory_mb of all non-deleted instances? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(metadata_key) OVER (ORDER BY metadata_key, instance_uuid) = metadata_key THEN NULL ELSE metadata_key END AS metadata_key, instance_uuid, display_name, power_state, metadata_value, network_info, window_column, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY metadata_key) AS total_rows_per_key, AVG(power_state) OVER (PARTITION BY metadata_key) AS avg_power_state_per_key FROM inner_cte ORDER BY metadata_key, instance_uuid ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, c.network_info, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.project_id ORDER BY i.project_id) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.network_info, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(i2.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb FROM instances AS i2 WHERE i2.deleted = 0 ) AS mem_avg ON 1 = 1 WHERE inner_cte.memory_mb > mem_avg.avg_memory_mb ) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT q1.instance_uuid) AS shelved_offloaded_instances_with_system_metadata_count, COUNT(DISTINCT q2.display_name) AS above_avg_memory_instances_count FROM q1 CROSS JOIN q2;

question: How many completed migrations involve instances whose display name is among the “shelved_offloaded” instances with total memory greater than 50000 MB and also above the average total memory of those qualifying instances, and how many such high-memory shelved instance display names are there? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH completed_migration_memory_deviation AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND ic.DELETED = 0 ), InstanceMemory AS ( SELECT inner_cte.migration_id, inner_cte.SOURCE_COMPUTE, inner_cte.DEST_COMPUTE, inner_cte.instance_display_name, inner_cte.window_column, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN MIGRATIONS m ON m.ID = inner_cte.migration_id JOIN INSTANCES i ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID ), AverageMemory AS ( SELECT AVG(instance_memory_mb) AS avg_instance_memory_mb FROM InstanceMemory ) SELECT im.migration_id, im.SOURCE_COMPUTE, im.DEST_COMPUTE, im.instance_display_name, im.window_column AS rank_within_status, im.instance_memory_mb, (im.instance_memory_mb - am.avg_instance_memory_mb) AS deviation_from_avg_instance_memory_mb FROM InstanceMemory im CROSS JOIN AverageMemory am ORDER BY im.migration_id ), high_memory_shelved_instances AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) AS total_memory_mb FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME HAVING SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) > 50000) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.total_memory_mb > (SELECT AVG(inner_cte.total_memory_mb * 1.0) FROM inner_cte) ) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cmd.migration_id) AS completed_migrations_for_high_memory_shelved_instances_count, COUNT(DISTINCT hms.DISPLAY_NAME) AS high_memory_shelved_instance_display_names_count FROM completed_migration_memory_deviation cmd JOIN high_memory_shelved_instances hms ON cmd.instance_display_name = hms.DISPLAY_NAME;

question: For the top 10 instance display names with the most system metadata entries (counting only non-deleted instances and only metadata rows where the key is 'image_image_type'), show each display name along with its metadata entry count, the maximum vCPU count among instances with that display name, and the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of instance memory (in MB) for that same display name (computed over instances that have system metadata with key = 'image_image_type'). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(ism.ID) AS metadata_entries FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY metadata_entries DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.metadata_entries, MAX(i2.VCPUS) AS max_vcpus_in_display_name FROM inner_cte JOIN INSTANCES i2 ON i2.DISPLAY_NAME = inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME AND i2.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.metadata_entries ORDER BY inner_cte.metadata_entries DESC), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(display_name) OVER (ORDER BY display_name_sort, display_name) = display_name THEN NULL ELSE display_name END AS display_name, memory_mb_variance, memory_mb_stddev FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE display_name END AS display_name_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE display_name END AS display_name, AVG(memory_mb_variance) AS memory_mb_variance, AVG(memory_mb_stddev) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY display_name WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY display_name_sort, display_name) SELECT q1.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, q1.metadata_entries, q1.max_vcpus_in_display_name, q2.memory_mb_variance, q2.memory_mb_stddev FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q2.display_name = q1.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY q1.metadata_entries DESC;

question: Among the top 10 instance display names with the highest coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of root disk size (ROOT_GB) computed only from instance system-metadata rows where the key is 'image_image_type' (also showing the total vCPUs and total memory summed across those same rows), return only those display names that also have completed migrations whose per-(display name, status, created_at) maximum MEMORY_TOTAL is greater than the overall average of those maximums; for each matching display name, show the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), total vCPUs, total memory (MB), the migration status, the max MEMORY_TOTAL, and the migration created timestamp. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.root_gb) / NULLIF(AVG(i.root_gb), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(i.root_gb) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN instances AS i ON i.display_name = inner_cte.display_name JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation ORDER BY inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC LIMIT 10 ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, m.status, MAX(m.memory_total) AS max_memory_total, m.created_at FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY i.display_name, m.status, m.created_at HAVING MAX(m.memory_total) > 0) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.status, inner_cte.max_memory_total, inner_cte.created_at FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.max_memory_total > (SELECT AVG(inner_cte2.max_memory_total * 1.0) FROM inner_cte inner_cte2) ) SELECT q1.display_name, q1.coefficient_of_variation, q1.total_vcpus, q1.total_memory_mb, q2.status AS migration_status, q2.max_memory_total, q2.created_at AS migration_created_at FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q2.display_name = q1.display_name ORDER BY q1.coefficient_of_variation DESC, q2.max_memory_total DESC, q2.created_at DESC;

question: For each instance display name that (a) has more than 5 completed migration records with a non-deleted instance info cache entry and (b) has instance extra metadata and a memory (MB) variance greater than the average variance across all non-deleted instances, show the instance’s migration MEMORY_TOTAL standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), the overall average of those per-instance migration standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP)s, the instance’s deviation from that overall average, and the instance’s MEMORY_MB variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_total) AS memory_total_stddev FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND ic.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY memory_total_stddev DESC ), avg_stddev AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_total_stddev) AS avg_memory_total_stddev FROM inner_cte ) SELECT c.display_name, c.memory_total_stddev, a.avg_memory_total_stddev, (c.memory_total_stddev - a.avg_memory_total_stddev) AS deviation_from_avg_stddev FROM inner_cte c CROSS JOIN avg_stddev a ORDER BY deviation_from_avg_stddev DESC ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_mb_variance, ic.memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte ic WHERE ic.memory_mb_variance > (SELECT AVG(inner_cte.memory_mb_variance) FROM inner_cte) ) SELECT q1.display_name, q1.memory_total_stddev, q1.avg_memory_total_stddev, q1.deviation_from_avg_stddev, q2.memory_mb_variance, q2.memory_mb_stddev FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.display_name = q2.display_name ORDER BY q1.deviation_from_avg_stddev DESC;

question: How many instance display names are in the top 10 by number of system metadata entries (for non-deleted instances where the system metadata KEY is 'image_image_type'), and how many display names have a MEMORY_MB standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) (among instances with system metadata KEY = 'image_image_type') that is greater than the overall average of those per-display-name standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP)s? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH top10_metadata_by_display_name AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(ism.ID) AS metadata_entries FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY metadata_entries DESC LIMIT 10 ), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(metadata_entries) AS avg_metadata_entries FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.metadata_entries, ac.avg_metadata_entries, (ic.metadata_entries - ac.avg_metadata_entries) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte ac ORDER BY ic.metadata_entries DESC ), high_memory_stddev_display_names AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC ), StddevAverage AS ( SELECT AVG(inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev) AS avg_memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte ) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev > (SELECT avg_memory_mb_stddev FROM StddevAverage) ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev DESC ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS top10_display_names_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM high_memory_stddev_display_names) AS high_memory_stddev_display_names_count FROM top10_metadata_by_display_name;

question: For the top 10 projects with the highest total instance memory (considering only non-deleted instances), list each project’s ID, its total memory used (MB), and whether it has any instance whose memory-based dense rank (using a window frame of the current row and the 2 preceding rows) equals 1; for every non-deleted instance in those projects, also show the instance ID, UUID, user ID, display name, VM state, memory (MB), vCPUs, the instance info cache record ID, the maximum instance ID over the current row and the next 2 rows (ordered by instance ID), plus the total number of non-deleted instances in that project and the average of those per-project totals across all projects. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH top_projects AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.UUID, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t1.DELETED = 0 ) SELECT i.project_id AS project_id, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM inner_cte ic JOIN instances i2 ON ic.uuid = i2.uuid WHERE i2.project_id = i.project_id AND ic.window_column = 1 ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_rank1_instance_by_window FROM instances i JOIN instance_extra ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches iic ON iic.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.project_id ORDER BY total_memory_mb DESC LIMIT 10 ), instance_details AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.id AS instance_id, i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.user_id, i.project_id, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, c.id AS info_cache_id, MAX(i.id) OVER (ORDER BY i.id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_id_next_2 FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND c.deleted = 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.instance_id, inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.user_id, inner_cte.project_id, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.vcpus, inner_cte.info_cache_id, inner_cte.max_instance_id_next_2, project_totals.total_instances_in_project, avg_instances.avg_instance_count FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT project_id, COUNT(*) AS total_instances_in_project FROM inner_cte GROUP BY project_id ) AS project_totals ON inner_cte.project_id = project_totals.project_id JOIN ( SELECT AVG(instance_count) AS avg_instance_count FROM ( SELECT project_id, COUNT(*) AS instance_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY project_id ) AS sub ) AS avg_instances ORDER BY inner_cte.instance_id ) SELECT tp.project_id, tp.total_memory_mb, tp.has_rank1_instance_by_window, id.instance_id, id.instance_uuid, id.user_id, id.display_name, id.vm_state, id.memory_mb, id.vcpus, id.info_cache_id, id.max_instance_id_next_2, id.total_instances_in_project, id.avg_instance_count FROM top_projects tp JOIN instance_details id ON id.project_id = tp.project_id ORDER BY tp.total_memory_mb DESC, id.instance_id;

question: List (1) each instance display name whose total ROOT_GB across instances with system metadata key 'image_image_type' exceeds 50 GB, and (2) each image type (from that same system metadata key) with its maximum coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of migration memory_remaining among completed migrations, returning a combined result set with the entity name, the metric value, and a reason label indicating which condition produced the row. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH RootDiskTotals AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, SUM(i.ROOT_GB) AS total_root_gb FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME HAVING SUM(i.ROOT_GB) > 50 ), avg_totals AS ( SELECT AVG(total_root_gb) AS avg_total_root_gb FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.total_root_gb, at.avg_total_root_gb, (ic.total_root_gb - at.avg_total_root_gb) AS deviation_from_avg_total_root_gb FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_totals at ), MigrationMemoryCVByImageType AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT ism.value AS image_type, MAX(inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation) AS max_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte JOIN instances AS i ON i.display_name = inner_cte.display_name JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY ism.value ORDER BY max_coefficient_of_variation DESC ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT rdt.DISPLAY_NAME AS entity_name, rdt.total_root_gb AS metric_value, 'High Total Root Disk (GB)' AS reason FROM RootDiskTotals rdt UNION ALL SELECT mmc.image_type AS entity_name, mmc.max_coefficient_of_variation AS metric_value, 'Max Migration Memory Remaining CV (Completed Migrations)' AS reason FROM MigrationMemoryCVByImageType mmc ) SELECT entity_name, metric_value, reason FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY entity_name;

question: For each migration status and instance VM state (considering only migrations where the instance has at least 8 vCPUs), return the migration count, earliest migration creation time, and the deviation from the overall average migration count, along with the variance of instance memory (MB) for that VM state among instances that have a network info cache record, the overall average of these variances as a benchmark, and the VM state’s variance category (HIGH_VARIANCE/LOW_VARIANCE/AVERAGE_VARIANCE). Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each VM state as 'HIGH_VARIANCE' (at least 50% above the benchmark), 'LOW_VARIANCE' (at least 50% below the benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE'.
SQL: WITH migration_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.STATUS AS migration_status, ins.VM_STATE AS instance_vm_state, COUNT(m.ID) AS migration_count, MIN(m.CREATED_AT) AS earliest_migration_created_at FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES ins ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA ie ON ins.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ins.VCPUS >= 8 GROUP BY m.STATUS, ins.VM_STATE), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(migration_count) AS avg_migration_count FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.migration_status, i.instance_vm_state, i.migration_count, i.earliest_migration_created_at, (i.migration_count - a.avg_migration_count) AS deviation_from_avg_migration_count FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_cte a ), memory_variance_by_state AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb_variance) AS avg_memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.VM_STATE, ic.memory_mb_variance, ac.avg_memory_mb_variance AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.memory_mb_variance > ac.avg_memory_mb_variance * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN ic.memory_mb_variance < ac.avg_memory_mb_variance * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte ac ) SELECT ms.migration_status, ms.instance_vm_state, ms.migration_count, ms.earliest_migration_created_at, ms.deviation_from_avg_migration_count, mv.memory_mb_variance, mv.benchmark AS avg_memory_mb_variance_benchmark, mv.variance_category FROM migration_stats ms JOIN memory_variance_by_state mv ON ms.instance_vm_state = mv.VM_STATE;

question: For instances that are not deleted and whose display names are in the top 10 by number of network info cache records, show (for their completed migrations where the VM state is “shelved_offloaded”) the migration status, source compute, destination compute, instance UUID, display name, instance memory (MB), system metadata key/value, the windowed minimum memory (MB) over 3 preceding and 1 following migration rows (ordered by migration ID), the overall average of that windowed minimum and each row’s deviation from it, along with the cache record count, the overall average cache record count across the top 10, and each display name’s deviation from that cache-record average. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.memory_mb, ism.key, ism.value, MIN(i.memory_mb) OVER ( ORDER BY m.id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' ), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(window_column) AS avg_window_min_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.status, ic.source_compute, ic.dest_compute, ic.instance_uuid, ic.display_name, ic.memory_mb, ic.key, ic.value, ic.window_column, av.avg_window_min_memory_mb, (ic.window_column - av.avg_window_min_memory_mb) AS deviation_from_avg_window_min FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte av ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(iic.ID) AS cache_records FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY cache_records DESC LIMIT 10), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(cache_records) AS avg_cache_records FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.cache_records, ac.avg_cache_records, (ic.cache_records - ac.avg_cache_records) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte ac ORDER BY ic.cache_records DESC ) SELECT q1.status AS migration_status, q1.source_compute, q1.dest_compute, q1.instance_uuid, q1.display_name, q1.memory_mb, q1.key AS system_metadata_key, q1.value AS system_metadata_value, q1.window_column AS window_min_memory_mb, q1.avg_window_min_memory_mb, q1.deviation_from_avg_window_min, q2.cache_records, q2.avg_cache_records, q2.deviation_from_avg AS cache_records_deviation_from_avg FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.display_name = q2.DISPLAY_NAME JOIN instances i ON i.uuid = q1.instance_uuid WHERE i.DELETED = 0 ORDER BY q2.cache_records DESC, q1.instance_uuid;

question: For instance display names that (a) have system metadata with KEY = 'image_image_type', (b) appear in more than one such instance, and (c) have a memory (MEMORY_MB) standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) greater than the overall average of these per-display-name standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP)s, show each display name along with its memory standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), its coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of memory across system metadata rows (for non-deleted instances), and the deviation of that coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) from the overall average coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC ), StddevAverage AS ( SELECT AVG(inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev) AS avg_memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte ) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev > (SELECT avg_memory_mb_stddev FROM StddevAverage) ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev DESC ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) / NULLIF(AVG(i.memory_mb), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(i.memory_mb) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), avg_cov AS ( SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.coefficient_of_variation, (ic.coefficient_of_variation - ac.avg_coefficient_of_variation) AS deviation_from_avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_cov ac ORDER BY deviation_from_avg_coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT q1.DISPLAY_NAME, q1.memory_mb_stddev, q2.coefficient_of_variation, q2.deviation_from_avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.DISPLAY_NAME = q2.display_name ORDER BY q1.memory_mb_stddev DESC;

question: List all instances in availability zone 'flare3' that have cached network_info and whose display_name also appears in the per-display-name memory variance calculation (based on instances that have a matching row in INSTANCE_EXTRA), returning the instance UUID, display name, VM state, memory_mb, cached network_info, the 2-preceding/2-following window average memory_mb per VM state, the total instance count per VM state and the average instance count across VM states, plus the display name’s memory_mb variance, the overall average of those variances, and the display name’s deviation from that overall average; include a “Reason” column indicating whether the row is included as a flare3 instance detail or as a display-name variance summary. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH variance_by_display_name AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), avg_variance AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb_variance) AS avg_memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_mb_variance, av.avg_memory_mb_variance, (ic.memory_mb_variance - av.avg_memory_mb_variance) AS deviation_from_avg_variance FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_variance av ORDER BY deviation_from_avg_variance DESC ), instances_in_flare3_with_cache AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, c.network_info, AVG(i.memory_mb) OVER ( PARTITION BY i.vm_state ORDER BY i.memory_mb ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' ORDER BY i.memory_mb ) SELECT ic.uuid, ic.display_name, ic.vm_state, ic.memory_mb, ic.network_info, ic.window_column, COUNT(ic.uuid) OVER (PARTITION BY ic.vm_state) AS total_instances_in_vm_state, avg_states.avg_instance_count_per_vm_state FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN ( SELECT AVG(instance_count) AS avg_instance_count_per_vm_state FROM ( SELECT vm_state, COUNT(*) AS instance_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY vm_state ) AS sub ) AS avg_states ON 1 = 1 ORDER BY ic.memory_mb ), CombinedInstanceInsights AS ( SELECT iic.uuid, iic.display_name, iic.vm_state, iic.memory_mb, iic.network_info, iic.window_column, iic.total_instances_in_vm_state, iic.avg_instance_count_per_vm_state, vbdn.memory_mb_variance, vbdn.avg_memory_mb_variance, vbdn.deviation_from_avg_variance, 'Flare3 Instance With Cache' AS Reason FROM instances_in_flare3_with_cache iic JOIN variance_by_display_name vbdn ON iic.display_name = vbdn.display_name UNION ALL SELECT iic.uuid, iic.display_name, iic.vm_state, iic.memory_mb, iic.network_info, iic.window_column, iic.total_instances_in_vm_state, iic.avg_instance_count_per_vm_state, vbdn.memory_mb_variance, vbdn.avg_memory_mb_variance, vbdn.deviation_from_avg_variance, 'Display Name Memory Variance Summary' AS Reason FROM variance_by_display_name vbdn JOIN instances_in_flare3_with_cache iic ON iic.display_name = vbdn.display_name ) SELECT * FROM CombinedInstanceInsights ORDER BY display_name, uuid, Reason;

question: List all instance-related rows that either (a) are for instances with display name 'forge' and have system metadata (including instance UUID, metadata key/value, the row number ordered by metadata key using a window frame of 2 preceding rows and 1 following row, and instance memory in MB) where the instance memory is greater than 16000 MB, OR (b) are for instances with a completed migration where the migration’s processed memory share (memory_processed divided by memory_total) is greater than 75%, returning the instance UUID and a reason for inclusion; for the migration-based rows, only include instances whose display name is 'forge'. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH ForgeMetadata AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.UUID, ism.KEY, ism.VALUE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ism.KEY ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' ) SELECT inner_cte.UUID, inner_cte.KEY, inner_cte.VALUE, inner_cte.window_column, i.MEMORY_MB FROM inner_cte JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON i.UUID = inner_cte.UUID WHERE i.MEMORY_MB > 16000 ), CompletedMigrationHighProcessed AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, i.availability_zone, m.status, m.migration_type, i.uuid, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.uuid ORDER BY i.uuid) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.availability_zone, inner_cte.status, inner_cte.migration_type, inner_cte.uuid, inner_cte.window_column, (m.memory_processed * 1.0 / NULLIF(m.memory_total, 0)) AS memory_processed_ratio FROM inner_cte JOIN migrations AS m ON m.instance_uuid = inner_cte.uuid AND m.status = inner_cte.status AND m.migration_type = inner_cte.migration_type WHERE (m.memory_processed * 1.0 / NULLIF(m.memory_total, 0)) > 0.75 ), CombinedInstanceSignals AS ( SELECT fm.UUID AS uuid, fm.KEY AS signal_key, fm.VALUE AS signal_value, fm.window_column AS signal_window_column, fm.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, 'Forge metadata (memory > 16000MB)' AS reason, NULL AS display_name, NULL AS availability_zone, NULL AS migration_status, NULL AS migration_type, NULL AS migration_window_column, NULL AS memory_processed_ratio FROM ForgeMetadata fm UNION ALL SELECT cm.uuid AS uuid, NULL AS signal_key, NULL AS signal_value, NULL AS signal_window_column, NULL AS memory_mb, 'Completed migration (memory processed ratio > 0.75)' AS reason, cm.display_name, cm.availability_zone, cm.status AS migration_status, cm.migration_type, cm.window_column AS migration_window_column, cm.memory_processed_ratio FROM CompletedMigrationHighProcessed cm WHERE cm.display_name = 'forge' ) SELECT * FROM CombinedInstanceSignals ORDER BY uuid, reason;

question: For instance display names that (a) are from non-deleted instances with a non-empty key name and have an instance-memory range (in MB) greater than the average range across such display names, show each display name’s memory range and memory variance, along with its coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of memory (from system metadata rows for non-deleted instances) and the deviation of that coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) from the overall average coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_range_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_variance_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON iic.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.key_name <> '' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_range_mb DESC) SELECT display_name, memory_range_mb, memory_variance_mb FROM inner_cte WHERE memory_range_mb > (SELECT AVG(memory_range_mb) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY memory_range_mb DESC ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) / NULLIF(AVG(i.memory_mb), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(i.memory_mb) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), avg_cov AS ( SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.coefficient_of_variation, (ic.coefficient_of_variation - ac.avg_coefficient_of_variation) AS deviation_from_avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_cov ac ORDER BY deviation_from_avg_coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT q1.display_name, q1.memory_range_mb, q1.memory_variance_mb, q2.coefficient_of_variation, q2.deviation_from_avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.display_name = q2.display_name ORDER BY q1.memory_range_mb DESC;

question: For instances with display name 'forge', show the instance UUID, hostname, VM state (suppressing repeats when the VM state matches the previous row by UUID), memory in MB, cached network info JSON, the minimum memory in a 2-preceding/2-following window ordered by instance ID, plus the total count and average memory across all 'forge' rows; also include the total memory (in MB) for the 'forge' display name among 'shelved_offloaded' instances where the display-name total exceeds 20000 MB and is above the overall average of such totals. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING SUM(i.memory_mb) > 20000 ), AvgTotals AS ( SELECT AVG(inner_cte.total_memory_mb * 1.0) AS avg_total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.total_memory_mb > (SELECT avg_total_memory_mb FROM AvgTotals) ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.UUID, i.HOSTNAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, c.NETWORK_INFO, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( ORDER BY i.ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(vm_state) OVER (ORDER BY uuid) = vm_state THEN NULL ELSE vm_state END AS vm_state, uuid, hostname, memory_mb, network_info, window_column, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_forge_instances, AVG(memory_mb) OVER () AS avg_forge_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ORDER BY uuid ) SELECT q2.uuid, q2.hostname, q2.vm_state, q2.memory_mb, q2.network_info, q2.window_column, q2.total_forge_instances, q2.avg_forge_memory_mb, q1.total_memory_mb AS shelved_offloaded_total_memory_mb_for_display_name FROM q2 JOIN q1 ON q1.display_name = 'forge' ORDER BY q2.uuid;

question: For each instance display name whose total memory across “shelved_offloaded” instances is greater than 20000 MB and also greater than the average total memory across such display names, show the display name and that total memory, along with how many instances under that display name have total memory (summed across their records) greater than the overall average memory plus one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and the sum of total memory (in MB) for those high-memory instances. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.uuid, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.uuid HAVING SUM(i.memory_mb) > ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb) + STDDEV(memory_mb) FROM instances ) ) SELECT inner_cte.uuid, inner_cte.total_memory_mb, i.hostname FROM inner_cte JOIN instances AS i ON i.uuid = inner_cte.uuid ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING SUM(i.memory_mb) > 20000) SELECT display_name, total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte WHERE total_memory_mb > (SELECT AVG(total_memory_mb) FROM inner_cte) ) SELECT q2.display_name, q2.total_memory_mb AS shelved_offloaded_display_name_total_memory_mb, COUNT(DISTINCT q1.uuid) AS high_memory_instance_count, SUM(q1.total_memory_mb) AS high_memory_instances_total_memory_mb FROM q2 JOIN instances i ON i.display_name = q2.display_name JOIN q1 ON q1.uuid = i.uuid GROUP BY q2.display_name, q2.total_memory_mb ORDER BY shelved_offloaded_display_name_total_memory_mb DESC;

question: How many instance display-name groups are categorized as HIGH_MEMORY (vs their benchmark) for instances in availability zone 'flare3' with system metadata KEY = 'image_image_type', and how many display-name groups are categorized as HIGH_MEMORY (vs their benchmark) among instances involved in migrations with status = 'completed'? Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each display name as 'HIGH_MEMORY' (at least 50% above the benchmark), 'LOW_MEMORY' (at least 50% below the benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_MEMORY'.
SQL: WITH az_image_type_memory AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(i.ID) AS min_instance_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ), AverageMemory AS ( SELECT AVG(avg_memory_mb) AS benchmark_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.min_instance_id, ic.avg_memory_mb, am.benchmark_avg_memory_mb AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.avg_memory_mb > am.benchmark_avg_memory_mb * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_MEMORY' WHEN ic.avg_memory_mb < am.benchmark_avg_memory_mb * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_MEMORY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_MEMORY' END AS memory_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AverageMemory am ), completed_migration_memory AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), OverallBenchmark AS ( SELECT AVG(avg_memory_mb) AS benchmark_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) SELECT cte.DISPLAY_NAME, cte.avg_memory_mb, cte.memory_mb_variance, ob.benchmark_avg_memory_mb AS benchmark, CASE WHEN cte.avg_memory_mb > ob.benchmark_avg_memory_mb * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_MEMORY' WHEN cte.avg_memory_mb < ob.benchmark_avg_memory_mb * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_MEMORY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_MEMORY' END AS memory_category FROM inner_cte cte CROSS JOIN OverallBenchmark ob ORDER BY cte.memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM az_image_type_memory WHERE memory_category = 'HIGH_MEMORY') AS az_image_type_high_memory_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM completed_migration_memory WHERE memory_category = 'HIGH_MEMORY') AS completed_migration_high_memory_count FROM az_image_type_memory aitm CROSS JOIN completed_migration_memory cmm LIMIT 1;

question: For each non-deleted instance that also has a non-deleted instance info cache record, list the instance details (ID, UUID, user ID, project ID, display name, VM state, memory in MB, vCPUs, info cache record ID, and the maximum instance ID over the current row and next 2 rows by instance ID), and also show (1) the variance of MEMORY_MB for that instance’s display name across system-metadata-linked entries and (2) the overall average of those per-display-name memory variances across all display names, along with the per-project total non-deleted instance count and the average of those per-project totals. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH memory_variances AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, avg_variances.avg_memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb_variance) AS avg_memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte ) AS avg_variances ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb_variance DESC ), instance_details AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.id AS instance_id, i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.user_id, i.project_id, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, c.id AS info_cache_id, MAX(i.id) OVER (ORDER BY i.id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_id_next_2 FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND c.deleted = 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.instance_id, inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.user_id, inner_cte.project_id, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.vcpus, inner_cte.info_cache_id, inner_cte.max_instance_id_next_2, project_totals.total_instances_in_project, avg_instances.avg_instance_count FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT project_id, COUNT(*) AS total_instances_in_project FROM inner_cte GROUP BY project_id ) AS project_totals ON inner_cte.project_id = project_totals.project_id JOIN ( SELECT AVG(instance_count) AS avg_instance_count FROM ( SELECT project_id, COUNT(*) AS instance_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY project_id ) AS sub ) AS avg_instances ORDER BY inner_cte.instance_id ) SELECT id.instance_id, id.instance_uuid, id.user_id, id.project_id, id.display_name, id.vm_state, id.memory_mb, id.vcpus, id.info_cache_id, id.max_instance_id_next_2, id.total_instances_in_project, id.avg_instance_count, mv.memory_mb_variance, mv.avg_memory_mb_variance FROM instance_details id JOIN memory_variances mv ON id.display_name = mv.display_name ORDER BY id.instance_id;

question: How many 'forge' instances have memory (MB) above the average for the 'forge' display name, and (for the same display name) how many instance display names in availability zone 'flare3' have a computed memory standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) (with extra metadata and a network info cache entry)? Do not return any rounded answers.
