SQL: WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, m.STATUS AS migration_status, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND m.STATUS = 'completed' ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(m.MIGRATION_TYPE) OVER (ORDER BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.instance_uuid) = m.MIGRATION_TYPE THEN NULL ELSE m.MIGRATION_TYPE END AS migration_type, inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.instance_display_name, inner_cte.migration_status, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = inner_cte.instance_uuid AND m.STATUS = inner_cte.migration_status ORDER BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.instance_uuid), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE display_name END AS display_name, AVG(avg_memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, AVG(memory_mb_stddev) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY display_name WITH ROLLUP) SELECT q1.migration_type, q1.instance_uuid, q1.instance_display_name, q1.migration_status, q1.window_column, q2.avg_memory_mb, q2.memory_mb_stddev FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q2.display_name = q1.instance_display_name ORDER BY q1.migration_type, q1.window_column, q1.instance_uuid;

question: For confirmed migrations where the source compute is ether-60, list the migration ID, migration status, source compute, destination compute, destination host, instance UUID, instance display name, instance VM state, cached network info, and the row number within each migration status (ordered by migration ID), along with the total number of such migrations and the average number of such migrations per destination compute; only include rows whose instance display name is also among the “shelved_offloaded” instances with total memory greater than 50000 MB and greater than the average total memory of those qualifying instances, and show that total memory value as well. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH migration_details AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.VM_STATE AS instance_vm_state, c.NETWORK_INFO AS cached_network_info, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'confirmed' AND m.SOURCE_COMPUTE = 'ether-60' ) SELECT inner_cte.migration_id, inner_cte.migration_status, inner_cte.SOURCE_COMPUTE, inner_cte.DEST_COMPUTE, inner_cte.DEST_HOST, inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.instance_display_name, inner_cte.instance_vm_state, inner_cte.cached_network_info, inner_cte.window_column, COUNT(inner_cte.migration_id) OVER () AS total_confirmed_ether60_migrations, avg_by_dest.avg_migrations_per_dest_compute FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(migrations_per_dest) AS avg_migrations_per_dest_compute FROM ( SELECT DEST_COMPUTE, COUNT(*) AS migrations_per_dest FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEST_COMPUTE ) AS per_dest ) AS avg_by_dest ON 1 = 1 ORDER BY inner_cte.migration_id ), high_memory_shelved_instances AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) AS total_memory_mb FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME HAVING SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) > 50000) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.total_memory_mb > (SELECT AVG(inner_cte.total_memory_mb * 1.0) FROM inner_cte) ) SELECT md.migration_id, md.migration_status, md.SOURCE_COMPUTE, md.DEST_COMPUTE, md.DEST_HOST, md.instance_uuid, md.instance_display_name, md.instance_vm_state, md.cached_network_info, md.window_column, md.total_confirmed_ether60_migrations, md.avg_migrations_per_dest_compute, hmsi.total_memory_mb AS shelved_offloaded_total_memory_mb_for_display_name FROM migration_details md JOIN high_memory_shelved_instances hmsi ON md.instance_display_name = hmsi.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY md.migration_id;

question: For instances in VM state "shelved_offloaded" whose display name also has at least one completed migration with a per-status maximum memory_total greater than 0, list the instance ID, display name, availability zone, cached network info, the instance’s rank within its availability zone ordered by instance ID, its deviation from the average instance ID across all such shelved_offloaded instances, and the display name’s maximum-of-per-status maximum completed-migration memory_total. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH shelved_instances AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.ID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, c.NETWORK_INFO, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE ORDER BY i.ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded'), avg_ids AS (SELECT AVG(ID) AS avg_instance_id FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.ID, ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, ic.NETWORK_INFO, ic.window_column, (ic.ID - ai.avg_instance_id) AS deviation_from_avg_instance_id FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_ids ai ), completed_migration_memory_by_display_name AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(m.memory_total) AS max_memory_total, m.status FROM instances i JOIN migrations m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY i.display_name, m.status HAVING MAX(m.memory_total) > 0 ) SELECT display_name, MAX(max_memory_total) AS max_of_max_memory_total FROM inner_cte GROUP BY display_name ) SELECT si.ID AS instance_id, si.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, si.AVAILABILITY_ZONE AS availability_zone, si.NETWORK_INFO AS cached_network_info, si.window_column AS rank_within_availability_zone_by_instance_id, si.deviation_from_avg_instance_id, cm.max_of_max_memory_total FROM shelved_instances si JOIN completed_migration_memory_by_display_name cm ON si.DISPLAY_NAME = cm.display_name ORDER BY si.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, si.ID;

question: For instance display names that (1) have a system metadata entry with KEY = 'image_image_type' and (2) have completed migrations, list each VM state and display name along with the instance count, the minimum configured memory (MB) and its deviation from the overall average of these per-(VM state, display name) minimum memories; also include the completed-migration total-memory range and variance, the instance’s configured memory (MEMORY_MB), and the ratio of completed-migration memory range to configured memory, keeping only rows where the deviation from the average minimum memory is positive. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH q1_inner_cte AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(i.ID) AS instance_count, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME), q1_avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(min_memory_mb) AS avg_min_memory_mb FROM q1_inner_cte), q1 AS (SELECT ic.VM_STATE, ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.instance_count, ic.min_memory_mb, (ic.min_memory_mb - ac.avg_min_memory_mb) AS deviation_from_avg_min_memory_mb FROM q1_inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN q1_avg_cte ac), q2_inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(m.memory_total) - MIN(m.memory_total) AS memory_total_range, VARIANCE(m.memory_total) AS memory_total_variance FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_total_range DESC), q2 AS (SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_total_range, inner_cte.memory_total_variance, i.memory_mb AS instance_memory_mb, (inner_cte.memory_total_range * 1.0 / NULLIF(i.memory_mb, 0)) AS range_to_instance_memory_ratio FROM q2_inner_cte inner_cte JOIN instances AS i ON i.display_name = inner_cte.display_name ORDER BY range_to_instance_memory_ratio DESC) SELECT q1.VM_STATE, q1.DISPLAY_NAME, q1.instance_count, q1.min_memory_mb, q1.deviation_from_avg_min_memory_mb, q2.memory_total_range, q2.memory_total_variance, q2.instance_memory_mb, q2.range_to_instance_memory_ratio FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.DISPLAY_NAME = q2.DISPLAY_NAME WHERE q1.deviation_from_avg_min_memory_mb > 0 ORDER BY q2.range_to_instance_memory_ratio DESC;

question: For each migration status, list the migration status, the average/range/variance of instance memory size (in MB) for instances involved in migrations that have the system metadata key 'image_image_type', the total number of such migrations and the overall average of those per-status migration counts across all statuses, along with (for comparison) each instance VM state’s memory variance (in MB) for instances that have a corresponding network info cache record, the overall average of these VM-state variances as a benchmark, and the variance category (HIGH_VARIANCE/LOW_VARIANCE/AVERAGE_VARIANCE). Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each VM state as 'HIGH_VARIANCE' (at least 50% above the benchmark), 'LOW_VARIANCE' (at least 50% below the benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE'.
SQL: WITH migration_status_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.status AS migration_status, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_instance_memory_mb, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS instance_memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS instance_memory_mb_variance FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY instance_memory_mb_range DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.migration_status, inner_cte.avg_instance_memory_mb, inner_cte.instance_memory_mb_range, inner_cte.instance_memory_mb_variance, COUNT(m2.id) AS total_migrations_with_image_image_type, avg_counts.avg_migration_count_per_status FROM inner_cte JOIN migrations AS m2 ON m2.status = inner_cte.migration_status JOIN instances AS i2 ON m2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism2 ON i2.uuid = ism2.instance_uuid JOIN ( SELECT AVG(migration_count) AS avg_migration_count_per_status FROM ( SELECT m3.status, COUNT(m3.id) AS migration_count FROM migrations AS m3 JOIN instances AS i3 ON m3.instance_uuid = i3.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism3 ON i3.uuid = ism3.instance_uuid WHERE ism3.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY m3.status ) AS sub ) AS avg_counts ON 1 = 1 WHERE ism2.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY inner_cte.migration_status, inner_cte.avg_instance_memory_mb, inner_cte.instance_memory_mb_range, inner_cte.instance_memory_mb_variance, avg_counts.avg_migration_count_per_status ORDER BY inner_cte.instance_memory_mb_range DESC ), vm_state_variance_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb_variance) AS avg_memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.VM_STATE, ic.memory_mb_variance, ac.avg_memory_mb_variance AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.memory_mb_variance > ac.avg_memory_mb_variance * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN ic.memory_mb_variance < ac.avg_memory_mb_variance * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte ac ) SELECT mss.migration_status, mss.avg_instance_memory_mb, mss.instance_memory_mb_range, mss.instance_memory_mb_variance, mss.total_migrations_with_image_image_type, mss.avg_migration_count_per_status, vsvs.VM_STATE, vsvs.memory_mb_variance, vsvs.benchmark, vsvs.variance_category FROM migration_status_stats mss JOIN vm_state_variance_stats vsvs ON 1 = 1 ORDER BY mss.instance_memory_mb_range DESC, vsvs.memory_mb_variance DESC;

question: For instance display names that (1) have a system metadata key of 'image_image_type' (with that metadata row not deleted) and (2) are associated with non-deleted instances whose memory_mb is greater than the average memory_mb of all non-deleted instances, list the display name along with the instance VM state, instance memory in MB, cached network_info JSON, the dense rank within the instance’s project_id, and also the display name’s average memory, memory variance, and deviation of its average memory from the overall average (computed across all instances with the 'image_image_type' metadata key). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON iic.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND ism.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), overall_avg AS ( SELECT AVG(avg_memory_mb) AS overall_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.avg_memory_mb, ic.memory_mb_variance, (ic.avg_memory_mb - oa.overall_avg_memory_mb) AS deviation_from_overall_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa ORDER BY ic.memory_mb_variance DESC ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, c.network_info, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.project_id ORDER BY i.project_id) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.network_info, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(i2.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb FROM instances AS i2 WHERE i2.deleted = 0 ) AS mem_avg ON 1 = 1 WHERE inner_cte.memory_mb > mem_avg.avg_memory_mb ) SELECT q1.display_name, q2.vm_state, q2.memory_mb, q2.network_info, q2.window_column, q1.avg_memory_mb, q1.memory_mb_variance, q1.deviation_from_overall_avg_memory_mb FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.display_name = q2.display_name ORDER BY q1.memory_mb_variance DESC;

question: For completed migrations whose instances are non-deleted and have a non-empty key name, list each migration’s id, instance UUID, source and destination compute, instance display name, instance extra flavor JSON, running average migration id per instance UUID, project id, per-instance average migration id, and whether the migration id is above or below/equal to the per-instance average; also include the memory range and variance (MB) for that display name plus the overall average memory range, and compute a normalized memory-range ratio (display-name memory range divided by the overall average memory range).
SQL: WITH MigrationDetails AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.INSTANCE_UUID, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, ie.FLAVOR, AVG(m.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY m.INSTANCE_UUID ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' ORDER BY m.ID), InstanceAvg AS ( SELECT INSTANCE_UUID, AVG(migration_id) AS avg_migration_id_per_instance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY INSTANCE_UUID ) SELECT ic.migration_id, ic.INSTANCE_UUID, ic.SOURCE_COMPUTE, ic.DEST_COMPUTE, ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.FLAVOR, ic.window_column, i.PROJECT_ID, ia.avg_migration_id_per_instance, CASE WHEN ic.migration_id > ia.avg_migration_id_per_instance THEN 'ABOVE_INSTANCE_AVG_MIGRATION_ID' ELSE 'BELOW_OR_EQUAL_INSTANCE_AVG_MIGRATION_ID' END AS migration_id_category FROM inner_cte ic JOIN INSTANCES i ON ic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN InstanceAvg ia ON ic.INSTANCE_UUID = ia.INSTANCE_UUID ORDER BY ic.migration_id ), MemoryStatsByDisplayName AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_range_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_variance_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON iic.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.key_name <> '' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_range_mb DESC ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_range_mb, ic.memory_variance_mb, avg_ranges.avg_memory_range_mb FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN ( SELECT AVG(memory_range_mb) AS avg_memory_range_mb FROM ( SELECT memory_range_mb FROM inner_cte ) AS sub ) AS avg_ranges ORDER BY ic.memory_range_mb DESC ) SELECT md.migration_id, md.instance_uuid, md.source_compute, md.dest_compute, md.display_name, md.flavor, md.window_column, md.project_id, md.avg_migration_id_per_instance, md.migration_id_category, ms.memory_range_mb, ms.memory_variance_mb, ms.avg_memory_range_mb, ROUND(ms.memory_range_mb / NULLIF(ms.avg_memory_range_mb, 0), 2) AS normalized_memory_range_ratio FROM MigrationDetails md JOIN MemoryStatsByDisplayName ms ON md.display_name = ms.display_name JOIN instances i ON i.uuid = md.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.key_name <> '' ORDER BY normalized_memory_range_ratio DESC, md.migration_id;

question: In availability zone “flare3”, for the top 10 VM states ranked by the total number of matching INSTANCE_EXTRA records, show each VM state’s distinct instance count, total matching INSTANCE_EXTRA record count, total sum of INSTANCE_EXTRA IDs, and (from the per-instance utilization analysis) the total instances in that VM state, the average instances-per-state benchmark, and the utilization category (HIGH_UTILIZATION/LOW_UTILIZATION/AVERAGE_UTILIZATION). Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each VM state as 'HIGH_UTILIZATION' (at least 50% more than average), 'LOW_UTILIZATION' (at least 50% less than average), or 'AVERAGE_UTILIZATION'.
SQL: WITH top_vm_states AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.vm_state, COUNT(ie.id) AS extra_record_count, SUM(ie.id) AS extra_id_sum FROM instances i JOIN instance_extra ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.vm_state ) SELECT inner_cte.vm_state, COUNT(DISTINCT inner_cte.instance_uuid) AS instance_count, SUM(inner_cte.extra_record_count) AS total_extra_record_count, SUM(inner_cte.extra_id_sum) AS total_extra_id_sum FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.vm_state ORDER BY total_extra_record_count DESC LIMIT 10 ), instance_utilization_detail AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3'), StateCounts AS ( SELECT vm_state, COUNT(*) AS total_instances FROM inner_cte GROUP BY vm_state ), AverageStateCounts AS ( SELECT AVG(total_instances) AS avg_instances FROM StateCounts ) SELECT ic.instance_uuid, ic.display_name, ic.vm_state, ic.memory_mb, ic.vcpus, ic.instance_extra_id, ic.window_column, sc.total_instances, ascnts.avg_instances AS benchmark, CASE WHEN sc.total_instances > ascnts.avg_instances * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_UTILIZATION' WHEN sc.total_instances < ascnts.avg_instances * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_UTILIZATION' ELSE 'AVERAGE_UTILIZATION' END AS utilization_category FROM inner_cte ic JOIN StateCounts sc ON ic.vm_state = sc.vm_state CROSS JOIN AverageStateCounts ascnts ) SELECT tvs.vm_state, tvs.instance_count, tvs.total_extra_record_count, tvs.total_extra_id_sum, iud.total_instances, iud.benchmark, iud.utilization_category FROM top_vm_states tvs JOIN instance_utilization_detail iud ON tvs.vm_state = iud.vm_state GROUP BY tvs.vm_state, tvs.instance_count, tvs.total_extra_record_count, tvs.total_extra_id_sum, iud.total_instances, iud.benchmark, iud.utilization_category ORDER BY tvs.total_extra_record_count DESC;

question: For each VM state whose total memory (in MB) across non-deleted instances is greater than the overall average memory plus one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), list the VM state, its total memory, the overall (avg + stddev) threshold value, the geometric mean instance memory (in MB) for non-deleted instances in that VM state, and the deviation of that geometric mean from the overall geometric mean memory across all VM states. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.vm_state, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.vm_state ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC ), overall_cte AS ( SELECT EXP(AVG(LN(geometric_mean_memory_mb))) AS overall_geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.vm_state, ic.geometric_mean_memory_mb, (ic.geometric_mean_memory_mb - oc.overall_geometric_mean_memory_mb) AS deviation_from_overall_geometric_mean_mb FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN overall_cte oc ORDER BY ic.geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.vm_state, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.vm_state HAVING SUM(i.memory_mb) > ( SELECT AVG(i2.memory_mb) + STDDEV(i2.memory_mb) FROM instances AS i2 JOIN instance_extra AS ie2 ON i2.uuid = ie2.instance_uuid WHERE i2.deleted = 0 )) SELECT inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.total_memory_mb, threshold_stats.avg_plus_stddev AS avg_plus_stddev_threshold FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT AVG(i3.memory_mb) + STDDEV(i3.memory_mb) AS avg_plus_stddev FROM instances AS i3 JOIN instance_extra AS ie3 ON i3.uuid = ie3.instance_uuid WHERE i3.deleted = 0) AS threshold_stats ) SELECT q2.vm_state, q2.total_memory_mb, q2.avg_plus_stddev_threshold, q1.geometric_mean_memory_mb, q1.deviation_from_overall_geometric_mean_mb FROM q2 JOIN q1 ON q2.vm_state = q1.vm_state ORDER BY q2.total_memory_mb DESC;

question: For each instance VM state that has a memory variance (in MB) across instances with a system metadata entry key = 'image_image_type' that is higher than the overall average of these per-VM-state memory variances, return the VM state, its memory variance, the overall average memory variance, its coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of migration memory remaining for completed migrations, and the overall average coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) across all VM states. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH MemoryVarianceByVMState AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, avg_variances.avg_memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb_variance) AS avg_memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte ) AS avg_variances ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb_variance DESC ), MigrationMemoryRemainingCVByVMState AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.vm_state, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY i.vm_state HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, overall_avg.avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte ) AS overall_avg ORDER BY inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT mv.VM_STATE, mv.memory_mb_variance, mv.avg_memory_mb_variance, cv.coefficient_of_variation, cv.avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM MemoryVarianceByVMState mv JOIN MigrationMemoryRemainingCVByVMState cv ON mv.VM_STATE = cv.vm_state WHERE mv.memory_mb_variance > mv.avg_memory_mb_variance ORDER BY mv.memory_mb_variance DESC;

question: For each instance display name and image type value (from system metadata) in availability zone 'flare3' with system metadata KEY = 'image_image_type', list the display name, image type value, minimum instance ID, and average memory (MB), but only for display names whose non-deleted instances have a memory range (max minus min memory_mb) greater than the average memory range across all display names; also compute the ratio of average memory to memory range (rounded).
SQL: WITH MemoryRangeVariance AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_range_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_variance_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_range_mb DESC ) SELECT display_name, memory_range_mb, memory_variance_mb FROM inner_cte WHERE memory_range_mb > (SELECT AVG(memory_range_mb) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY memory_range_mb DESC ), DisplayNameImageTypeRollup AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(i.ID) AS min_instance_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ), DisplayNameImageTypeStats AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, ism.VALUE AS image_type_value, MIN(i.ID) AS min_instance_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID JOIN inner_cte ic ON ic.min_instance_id = ic.min_instance_id WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME, ism.VALUE ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(DISPLAY_NAME) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE DISPLAY_NAME END AS display_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(image_type_value) = 1 AND GROUPING(DISPLAY_NAME) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE image_type_value END AS image_type_value, MIN(min_instance_id) AS min_instance_id, AVG(avg_memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb FROM DisplayNameImageTypeStats GROUP BY DISPLAY_NAME, image_type_value WITH ROLLUP ) SELECT ditr.display_name, ditr.image_type_value, ditr.min_instance_id, ditr.avg_memory_mb, mrv.memory_range_mb, mrv.memory_variance_mb, ROUND(ditr.avg_memory_mb / NULLIF(mrv.memory_range_mb, 0), 2) AS AvgMemory_to_MemoryRange_Ratio FROM DisplayNameImageTypeRollup ditr JOIN MemoryRangeVariance mrv ON ditr.display_name = mrv.display_name WHERE ditr.display_name NOT IN ('GRAND TOTAL') AND ditr.image_type_value NOT IN ('SUBTOTAL') ORDER BY AvgMemory_to_MemoryRange_Ratio DESC;

question: For non-deleted instances (deleted = 0) whose memory_mb is above the average memory_mb of all non-deleted instances, and that also have at least 2 completed migrations, list the (non-repeated) migration destination host label, instance display name, instance UUID, instance memory_mb, cached network_info JSON, the migration status, the per-UUID average memory_mb window value ordered by destination host, and the total count of completed migrations. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH NonDeletedAboveAvgMemory AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, c.network_info, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.project_id ORDER BY i.project_id) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0) SELECT display_name, vm_state, memory_mb, network_info, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE memory_mb > (SELECT AVG(memory_mb) FROM inner_cte)), CompletedMigrationsWithWindow AS (WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.UUID, i.MEMORY_MB, m.STATUS, m.DEST_HOST, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.UUID ORDER BY m.DEST_HOST) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' ORDER BY m.DEST_HOST ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(DEST_HOST) OVER (ORDER BY DEST_HOST, UUID) = DEST_HOST THEN NULL ELSE DEST_HOST END AS dest_host, DISPLAY_NAME, UUID, MEMORY_MB, STATUS, window_column FROM inner_cte ORDER BY DEST_HOST, UUID), CompletedMigrationCounts AS ( SELECT m.instance_uuid AS uuid, COUNT(*) AS Completed_Migration_Count FROM migrations m WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY m.instance_uuid ) SELECT cm.dest_host, cm.display_name, cm.uuid, cm.memory_mb, nd.network_info, cm.status, cm.window_column AS Avg_Memory_MB_Within_UUID_By_DestHost, cmc.Completed_Migration_Count FROM CompletedMigrationsWithWindow cm JOIN instances i ON i.uuid = cm.uuid JOIN NonDeletedAboveAvgMemory nd ON nd.display_name = i.display_name AND nd.vm_state = i.vm_state AND nd.memory_mb = i.memory_mb JOIN CompletedMigrationCounts cmc ON cmc.uuid = cm.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND cmc.Completed_Migration_Count >= 2 ORDER BY cm.dest_host, cm.uuid;

question: For instances with display name equal to 'forge' that have memory in MB greater than the average memory in MB of all 'forge' instances, list the instance display name, instance UUID, instance memory in MB, cached network info, cache record ID, the windowed average memory within the display name group, and also the display-name-level coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of instance memory (for non-deleted instances) with its system metadata row count and the overall average coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) across all display names, ordered by instance memory. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH ForgeAboveAverageInstances AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, i.uuid, i.memory_mb, c.network_info, c.id AS cache_id, AVG(i.memory_mb) OVER (PARTITION BY i.display_name ORDER BY i.memory_mb) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.display_name = 'forge' ORDER BY i.memory_mb ), DisplayNameAverages AS ( SELECT i2.display_name, AVG(i2.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb FROM instances AS i2 WHERE i2.display_name = 'forge' GROUP BY i2.display_name ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.uuid, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.network_info, inner_cte.cache_id, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN DisplayNameAverages ON DisplayNameAverages.display_name = inner_cte.display_name WHERE inner_cte.memory_mb > ( SELECT avg_memory_mb FROM DisplayNameAverages WHERE DisplayNameAverages.display_name = inner_cte.display_name ) ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb ), DisplayNameMemoryVariation AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) / NULLIF(AVG(i.memory_mb), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(i.memory_mb) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, meta_counts.system_metadata_rows, avg_cov.avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(ism.id) AS system_metadata_rows FROM instances i JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ) AS meta_counts ON meta_counts.display_name = inner_cte.display_name JOIN ( SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte ) AS avg_cov ORDER BY inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT fai.display_name, fai.uuid, fai.memory_mb, fai.network_info, fai.cache_id, fai.window_column AS avg_memory_mb_window_within_display_name, dmv.coefficient_of_variation, dmv.system_metadata_rows, dmv.avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM ForgeAboveAverageInstances AS fai JOIN DisplayNameMemoryVariation AS dmv ON dmv.display_name = fai.display_name ORDER BY fai.memory_mb;

question: For each migration status, what are the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of instance memory (MEMORY_MB) for instances with a matching migration record, what are the overall (all-status) average and variance benchmarks for MEMORY_MB, how is each status categorized as HIGH_VARIABILITY/LOW_VARIABILITY/AVERAGE_VARIABILITY relative to the overall variance, and how many distinct instances have a completed migration for that same status? Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each status as 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' (variance at least 50% above the overall average variance), 'LOW_VARIABILITY' (variance at least 50% below the overall average variance), or 'AVERAGE_VARIABILITY'.
SQL: WITH status_variability AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.STATUS AS migration_status, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM INSTANCES i JOIN MIGRATIONS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.MEMORY_MB IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.STATUS ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC), OverallBenchmarks AS ( SELECT AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS overall_avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS overall_variance_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES i JOIN MIGRATIONS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.MEMORY_MB IS NOT NULL ) SELECT ic.migration_status, ic.memory_mb_variance, ic.memory_mb_stddev, ob.overall_avg_memory_mb AS benchmark_avg_memory_mb, ob.overall_variance_memory_mb AS benchmark_variance_memory_mb, CASE WHEN ic.memory_mb_variance > ob.overall_variance_memory_mb * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN ic.memory_mb_variance < ob.overall_variance_memory_mb * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIABILITY' END AS variability_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN OverallBenchmarks ob ), completed_instance_details AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.UUID, i.MEMORY_MB, m.STATUS, m.DEST_HOST, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.UUID ORDER BY m.DEST_HOST) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' ORDER BY m.DEST_HOST ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(DEST_HOST) OVER (ORDER BY DEST_HOST, UUID) = DEST_HOST THEN NULL ELSE DEST_HOST END AS dest_host, DISPLAY_NAME, UUID, MEMORY_MB, STATUS, window_column FROM inner_cte ORDER BY DEST_HOST, UUID ) SELECT sv.migration_status, sv.memory_mb_variance, sv.memory_mb_stddev, sv.benchmark_avg_memory_mb, sv.benchmark_variance_memory_mb, sv.variability_category, COUNT(DISTINCT cid.UUID) AS completed_instances_count FROM status_variability sv JOIN completed_instance_details cid ON cid.STATUS = sv.migration_status GROUP BY sv.migration_status, sv.memory_mb_variance, sv.memory_mb_stddev, sv.benchmark_avg_memory_mb, sv.benchmark_variance_memory_mb, sv.variability_category ORDER BY completed_instances_count DESC, sv.memory_mb_variance DESC;

question: For each instance display name that (1) has completed migrations and (2) has an `instance_system_metadata` entry with key = `image_image_type` whose average instance memory is above the overall average for such instances, show the instance’s average and variance of memory (MB) for completed migrations, the overall completed-migration benchmark average memory, the completed-migration memory category (HIGH_MEMORY/LOW_MEMORY/AVERAGE_MEMORY), and also the average and variance of memory (MB) for the `image_image_type`-tagged instances. Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each instance as 'HIGH_MEMORY' (at least 50% above the benchmark), 'LOW_MEMORY' (at least 50% below the benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_MEMORY'.
SQL: WITH CompletedMigrationMemoryStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), OverallBenchmark AS ( SELECT AVG(avg_memory_mb) AS benchmark_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) SELECT cte.DISPLAY_NAME, cte.avg_memory_mb, cte.memory_mb_variance, ob.benchmark_avg_memory_mb AS benchmark, CASE WHEN cte.avg_memory_mb > ob.benchmark_avg_memory_mb * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_MEMORY' WHEN cte.avg_memory_mb < ob.benchmark_avg_memory_mb * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_MEMORY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_MEMORY' END AS memory_category FROM inner_cte cte CROSS JOIN OverallBenchmark ob ORDER BY cte.memory_mb_variance DESC ), ImageTypeAboveOverallAvgMemory AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.avg_memory_mb > (SELECT AVG(i2.memory_mb) FROM migrations m2 JOIN instances i2 ON m2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism2 ON i2.uuid = ism2.instance_uuid WHERE ism2.key = 'image_image_type') ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT c.DISPLAY_NAME, c.avg_memory_mb AS completed_migrations_avg_memory_mb, c.memory_mb_variance AS completed_migrations_memory_mb_variance, c.benchmark AS completed_migrations_benchmark_avg_memory_mb, c.memory_category, it.avg_memory_mb AS image_type_avg_memory_mb, it.memory_mb_variance AS image_type_memory_mb_variance FROM CompletedMigrationMemoryStats c JOIN ImageTypeAboveOverallAvgMemory it ON it.display_name = c.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY c.memory_mb_variance DESC;

question: In availability zone "flare3", for instances whose running average memory (MB) (computed within each instance UUID ordered by system metadata key) is greater than the overall average of that running-average-memory metric, return the instance UUID, hostname, display name, instance extra record ID, system metadata key/value, the running average memory (MB), and (for that instance’s display name) the top-10 display-name system-metadata entry count along with the average of those top-10 counts and the deviation from that average. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY i.UUID ORDER BY ism.KEY ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' ) SELECT instance_uuid, hostname, instance_extra_id, metadata_key, metadata_value, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > ( SELECT AVG(window_column) FROM inner_cte ) ), Subquery2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(ism.id) AS metadata_entries FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY metadata_entries DESC LIMIT 10), AverageMetadata AS ( SELECT AVG(metadata_entries) AS avg_metadata_entries FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.metadata_entries, am.avg_metadata_entries, (ic.metadata_entries - am.avg_metadata_entries) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AverageMetadata am ) SELECT s1.instance_uuid, s1.hostname, i.display_name, s1.instance_extra_id, s1.metadata_key, s1.metadata_value, s1.window_column AS running_avg_instance_memory_mb, s2.metadata_entries, s2.avg_metadata_entries, s2.deviation_from_avg FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN INSTANCES i ON i.uuid = s1.instance_uuid JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s2.display_name = i.display_name;

question: For instance display names that (1) have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type' and (2) are not deleted and have an average memory (MB) greater than the overall average memory across all such not-deleted instances, return (by VM state and display name) the instance count, the minimum memory (MB), the deviation of that minimum memory from the overall average of per-(VM state, display name) minimum memories, plus the minimum instance ID and the average memory (MB). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(i.ID) AS instance_count, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(min_memory_mb) AS avg_min_memory_mb FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.VM_STATE, ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.instance_count, ic.min_memory_mb, (ic.min_memory_mb - ac.avg_min_memory_mb) AS deviation_from_avg_min_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte ac ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MIN(i.ID) AS min_instance_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism JOIN INSTANCES i ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME) SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.min_instance_id, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN INSTANCES i ON i.ID = inner_cte.min_instance_id WHERE inner_cte.avg_memory_mb > ( SELECT AVG(inner_cte2.avg_memory_mb) FROM inner_cte AS inner_cte2 ) ) SELECT q1.VM_STATE, q1.DISPLAY_NAME, q1.instance_count, q1.min_memory_mb, q1.deviation_from_avg_min_memory_mb, q2.min_instance_id, q2.avg_memory_mb FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.DISPLAY_NAME = q2.DISPLAY_NAME;

question: For the availability zone 'flare3', list each instance display name that has extra instance metadata and a network info cache entry and whose instance MEMORY_MB standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) is greater than 5000 MB, and show the display name, the MEMORY_MB standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), the average MEMORY_MB, and the average range/variance/standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of completed migration counts for that display name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH MemoryStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN instances i ON i.display_name = inner_cte.display_name JOIN instance_extra ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches iic ON iic.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev HAVING inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev > 5000 ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev DESC ), MigrationRollup AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(migration_count) - MIN(migration_count) AS migration_count_range, VARIANCE(migration_count) AS migration_count_variance, STDDEV(migration_count) AS migration_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid JOIN ( SELECT m.instance_uuid, m.dest_compute, COUNT(*) AS migration_count FROM migrations AS m WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY m.instance_uuid, m.dest_compute ) AS mig_stats ON i.uuid = mig_stats.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY migration_count_range DESC ), ZoneAgg AS ( SELECT i.availability_zone, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.migration_count_range, inner_cte.migration_count_variance, inner_cte.migration_count_stddev FROM inner_cte JOIN instances i ON i.display_name = inner_cte.display_name JOIN instance_extra ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(availability_zone) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE availability_zone END AS availability_zone, CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(availability_zone) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(availability_zone) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE display_name END AS display_name, AVG(migration_count_range) AS avg_migration_count_range, AVG(migration_count_variance) AS avg_migration_count_variance, AVG(migration_count_stddev) AS avg_migration_count_stddev FROM ZoneAgg GROUP BY availability_zone, display_name WITH ROLLUP ) SELECT mr.availability_zone, mr.display_name, ms.memory_mb_stddev, ms.avg_memory_mb, mr.avg_migration_count_range, mr.avg_migration_count_variance, mr.avg_migration_count_stddev FROM MigrationRollup mr JOIN MemoryStats ms ON mr.display_name = ms.display_name WHERE mr.availability_zone = 'flare3' ORDER BY ms.memory_mb_stddev DESC;

question: For each instance display name that appears in both (a) the set of instances in availability zone 'flare3' that have extra instance metadata and a network info cache entry (with more than 5 such instances per display name) and (b) the set of non-deleted instances that have system metadata entries, show the per-display-name standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of instance memory (MEMORY_MB), the overall average of those standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP)s and the display name’s deviation from that average, and also the per-display-name variance of instance memory and the overall average of those variances. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH StddevsInFlare3WithNetInfo AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC), avg_stddev AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb_stddev) AS avg_memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_mb_stddev, av.avg_memory_mb_stddev, (ic.memory_mb_stddev - av.avg_memory_mb_stddev) AS deviation_from_avg_stddev FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_stddev av ORDER BY ic.memory_mb_stddev DESC ), VariancesForNonDeletedInstances AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, avg_variances.avg_memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb_variance) AS avg_memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte ) AS avg_variances ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT s.display_name, s.memory_mb_stddev, s.avg_memory_mb_stddev, s.deviation_from_avg_stddev, v.memory_mb_variance, v.avg_memory_mb_variance FROM StddevsInFlare3WithNetInfo s JOIN VariancesForNonDeletedInstances v ON s.display_name = v.display_name ORDER BY s.memory_mb_stddev DESC;

question: Among the top 10 instance display names in availability zone 'flare3' with the highest number of network info cache records, return only those display names that also have a non-deleted system metadata entry with KEY = 'image_image_type' and whose average instance MEMORY_MB is greater than 75% of the maximum MEMORY_MB for that same display name. For each such display name, show the cache record count, total vCPUs, total memory (MB), and the MEMORY_MB variance, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), average, and maximum. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH MemoryStatsByDisplayName AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND ism.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) AS max_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON i.DISPLAY_NAME = inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND ism.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev HAVING (AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) * 1.0 / MAX(i.MEMORY_MB)) > 0.75 ORDER BY avg_memory_mb DESC ), Top10CacheRecordsFlare3 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(iic.id) AS cache_records FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY cache_records DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.cache_records, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON i.display_name = inner_cte.display_name AND i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.cache_records ORDER BY inner_cte.cache_records DESC ) SELECT t.display_name, t.cache_records, t.total_vcpus, t.total_memory_mb, m.memory_mb_variance, m.memory_mb_stddev, m.avg_memory_mb, m.max_memory_mb FROM Top10CacheRecordsFlare3 AS t JOIN MemoryStatsByDisplayName AS m ON m.DISPLAY_NAME = t.display_name ORDER BY t.cache_records DESC, m.avg_memory_mb DESC;

question: For each security group name and its TCP “from port” variability status (High if the from-port range is at least 1000, otherwise Low)—including subtotals per security group name and a grand total—show the total number of security groups in that category and how many qualifying (non-deleted) security group rules belong to that security group where the security group’s id is greater than the average id across all non-deleted security groups. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH sg_tcp_from_port_variability_rollup AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sg.NAME AS security_group_name, MAX(sgr.FROM_PORT) - MIN(sgr.FROM_PORT) AS from_port_range, VARIANCE(sgr.FROM_PORT) AS from_port_variance FROM SECURITY_GROUPS AS sg JOIN SECURITY_GROUP_RULES AS sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sgr.PROTOCOL = 'tcp' GROUP BY sg.NAME ORDER BY from_port_range DESC), RangeStatus AS ( SELECT security_group_name, CASE WHEN from_port_range >= 1000 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS variability_status, COUNT(*) AS total_security_groups FROM inner_cte GROUP BY security_group_name, variability_status ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(security_group_name) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE security_group_name END AS security_group_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(variability_status) = 1 AND GROUPING(security_group_name) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE variability_status END AS variability_status, SUM(total_security_groups) AS total_security_groups FROM RangeStatus GROUP BY security_group_name, variability_status WITH ROLLUP ), sg_rule_details_with_max_next_2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sg.NAME, sgr.PROTOCOL, sgr.FROM_PORT, sgr.TO_PORT, sgr.CIDR, sgr.ID AS RULE_ID, MAX(sg.ID) OVER (ORDER BY sgr.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS MAX_GROUP_ID_NEXT_2 FROM SECURITY_GROUPS AS sg JOIN SECURITY_GROUP_RULES AS sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sgr.DELETED = 0 ) SELECT i.NAME, i.PROTOCOL, i.FROM_PORT, i.TO_PORT, i.CIDR, i.RULE_ID, i.MAX_GROUP_ID_NEXT_2 FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN SECURITY_GROUPS AS sg2 ON sg2.NAME = i.NAME WHERE sg2.DELETED = 0 AND sg2.ID > ( SELECT AVG(sg3.ID) * 1.0 FROM SECURITY_GROUPS AS sg3 WHERE sg3.DELETED = 0 ) ) SELECT v.security_group_name, v.variability_status, v.total_security_groups, COUNT(r.RULE_ID) AS qualifying_rule_count FROM sg_tcp_from_port_variability_rollup v LEFT JOIN sg_rule_details_with_max_next_2 r ON r.NAME = v.security_group_name GROUP BY v.security_group_name, v.variability_status, v.total_security_groups ORDER BY v.security_group_name, v.variability_status;

question: For instances that are in VM state "shelved_offloaded" and have a migration status of "completed", return the instance UUID, display name, VM state, migration status, source compute host, destination compute host, the row number within the "completed" migration-status group ordered by instance UUID, and the deviation of that row number from the average row number across all such instances; additionally, for those same instances whose display name is among the top 10 display names with the most completed migrations, also show the completed-migration count for that display name and how far that count deviates from the average completed-migration count across those top 10 display names. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.VM_STATE AS instance_vm_state, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE AS migration_source_compute, m.DEST_COMPUTE AS migration_dest_compute, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' AND m.STATUS = 'completed'), avg_window AS (SELECT AVG(window_column) AS avg_window_column FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.instance_uuid, ic.instance_display_name, ic.instance_vm_state, ic.migration_status, ic.migration_source_compute, ic.migration_dest_compute, ic.window_column, (ic.window_column - aw.avg_window_column) AS deviation_from_avg_row_number FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_window aw ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(m.id) AS migrations FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY migrations DESC LIMIT 10), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(migrations) AS avg_migrations FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.migrations, (ic.migrations - ac.avg_migrations) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte ac ORDER BY ic.migrations DESC ) SELECT q1.instance_uuid, q1.instance_display_name, q1.instance_vm_state, q1.migration_status, q1.migration_source_compute, q1.migration_dest_compute, q1.window_column, q1.deviation_from_avg_row_number, q2.migrations AS completed_migrations_for_display_name_in_top10, q2.deviation_from_avg AS deviation_from_avg_completed_migrations_in_top10 FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.instance_display_name = q2.display_name;

question: For availability-zone “flare3” instances whose display name is among the top 10 display names with the highest geometric mean instance memory (MB) (considering only instances with memory_mb > 0 and a system metadata key of 'image_image_type'), list each matching instance’s UUID, display name, VM state, memory_mb, cached network_info JSON, the 2-preceding/2-following windowed average of memory_mb within its VM state, plus that display name’s geometric-mean memory and contributing instance count; only include instances that also have system metadata key = 'image_image_type' and whose memory_mb is greater than the overall average memory_mb of the flare3 result set. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.geometric_mean_memory_mb, COUNT(DISTINCT i.uuid) AS contributing_instance_count FROM inner_cte JOIN instances AS i ON i.display_name = inner_cte.display_name JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.geometric_mean_memory_mb ORDER BY inner_cte.geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC LIMIT 10 ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, c.network_info, AVG(i.memory_mb) OVER ( PARTITION BY i.vm_state ORDER BY i.memory_mb ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' ORDER BY i.memory_mb ) SELECT inner_cte.uuid, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.network_info, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.memory_mb > (SELECT AVG(memory_mb) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb ) SELECT q2.uuid, q2.display_name, q2.vm_state, q2.memory_mb, q2.network_info, q2.window_column, q1.geometric_mean_memory_mb, q1.contributing_instance_count FROM q2 JOIN q1 ON q1.display_name = q2.display_name JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = q2.uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' ORDER BY q1.geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC, q2.memory_mb DESC;

question: How many of the top 10 VM state/availability zone combinations (ranked by instance count) that have at least one instance with system metadata key = 'image_image_type' are there, and do any of those top combinations have a VM state that matches the VM state reported for completed migrations where the related instance is in the 'shelved_offloaded' state (including whether any such instances have a network info cache record)? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH top_vmstate_az_by_image_type AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ins.VM_STATE, ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, COUNT(ins.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(ins.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES ins ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON ins.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY ins.VM_STATE, ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE ) SELECT inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, inner_cte.instance_count, inner_cte.min_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.instance_count DESC LIMIT 10 ), shelved_offloaded_completed_migration_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_instance_memory_mb, SUM(m.MEMORY_PROCESSED) AS total_migration_memory_processed FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' ) SELECT i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, inner_cte.min_instance_memory_mb, inner_cte.total_migration_memory_processed, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM MIGRATIONS m2 JOIN INSTANCES i2 ON m2.INSTANCE_UUID = i2.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES ic2 ON i2.UUID = ic2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m2.STATUS = 'completed' AND i2.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' AND ic2.DELETED = 0 ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_network_info_cache FROM inner_cte JOIN INSTANCES i ON i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, inner_cte.min_instance_memory_mb, inner_cte.total_migration_memory_processed ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS top_vmstate_az_combinations_count, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM top_vmstate_az_by_image_type t JOIN shelved_offloaded_completed_migration_stats s ON s.vm_state = t.VM_STATE ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS any_top_combination_matches_shelved_offloaded_migration_vm_state FROM top_vmstate_az_by_image_type;

question: For instances in availability zone "flare3" (including their system metadata) whose vCPU count is greater than the average vCPU count of instances with the same VM state in "flare3", list the instance UUID, display name, VM state, memory (MB), vCPUs, metadata key and value, and the row number within each metadata key group ordered by instance UUID, along with the completed migration status, the maximum total migration memory (MEMORY_TOTAL), and the migration created timestamp, but only for completed migrations where MEMORY_PROCESSED divided by MEMORY_TOTAL is greater than 75%. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH MigrationMemoryStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, m.status, MAX(m.memory_total) AS max_memory_total, m.created_at FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name, m.status, m.created_at HAVING MAX(m.memory_total) > 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.status, inner_cte.max_memory_total, inner_cte.created_at FROM inner_cte JOIN migrations m ON m.created_at = inner_cte.created_at AND m.status = inner_cte.status JOIN instances i ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE m.memory_total > 0 AND (m.memory_processed * 1.0 / m.memory_total) > 0.75 ), Flare3HighVcpuMetadata AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' ), VmStateAverages AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, AVG(i.VCPUS * 1.0) AS avg_vcpus FROM INSTANCES AS i WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ) SELECT ic.instance_uuid, ic.display_name, ic.vm_state, ic.memory_mb, ic.vcpus, ic.metadata_key, ic.metadata_value, ic.window_column FROM inner_cte AS ic WHERE ic.vcpus > ( SELECT vsa.avg_vcpus FROM VmStateAverages AS vsa WHERE vsa.vm_state = ic.vm_state ) ) SELECT f.instance_uuid, f.display_name, f.vm_state, f.memory_mb, f.vcpus, f.metadata_key, f.metadata_value, f.window_column, mms.status AS migration_status, mms.max_memory_total, mms.created_at AS migration_created_at FROM Flare3HighVcpuMetadata f JOIN MigrationMemoryStats mms ON mms.display_name = f.display_name ORDER BY f.instance_uuid, f.metadata_key, f.window_column;

question: For “forge” instances, for each availability zone list the availability zone, the number of “forge” instances, the total vCPUs, the normalized vCPU-per-MB ratio (total vCPUs divided by total memory in MB, rounded), and the average deviation of instance ID from the overall average “forge” instance ID (rounded).
SQL: WITH q1_inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ie.CREATED_AT AS instance_extra_created_at, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, MIN(ie.ID) OVER ( ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' ), q1 AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(display_name) OVER (ORDER BY memory_mb, instance_uuid) = display_name THEN NULL ELSE display_name END AS display_name, instance_uuid, vm_state, memory_mb, vcpus, instance_extra_id, instance_extra_created_at, network_info, window_column FROM q1_inner_cte ORDER BY memory_mb, instance_uuid ), q2_inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.UUID, t0.HOSTNAME, t0.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, t2.NETWORK_INFO, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.AVAILABILITY_ZONE ORDER BY t0.ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS t0 JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS t1 ON t1.INSTANCE_UUID = t0.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS t2 ON t2.INSTANCE_UUID = t0.UUID WHERE t0.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge'), q2_avg_ids AS (SELECT AVG(t0.ID) AS avg_instance_id FROM INSTANCES AS t0 WHERE t0.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge'), q2 AS ( SELECT i.UUID, i.HOSTNAME, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, i.NETWORK_INFO, i.window_column AS rank_within_az_by_id, (t0.ID - a.avg_instance_id) AS deviation_from_avg_instance_id FROM q2_inner_cte i JOIN INSTANCES AS t0 ON t0.UUID = i.UUID CROSS JOIN q2_avg_ids a ) SELECT q2.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, COUNT(*) AS forge_instance_count, SUM(q1.vcpus) AS total_vcpus, ROUND(SUM(q1.vcpus) / NULLIF(SUM(q1.memory_mb), 0), 6) AS normalized_vcpu_per_mb_ratio, ROUND(AVG(q2.deviation_from_avg_instance_id), 2) AS avg_deviation_from_avg_instance_id FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q2.UUID = q1.instance_uuid GROUP BY q2.AVAILABILITY_ZONE ORDER BY normalized_vcpu_per_mb_ratio DESC;

question: For the top 10 instance display names with the highest variance in instance memory (MB) among instances in the “shelved_offloaded” VM state, show each display name and availability zone along with its average memory, memory variance, total vCPUs, and the (completed) migration-count range/variance/standard-deviation metrics for that same display name and availability zone. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH mem_var_top10 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus FROM inner_cte JOIN instances AS i ON i.display_name = inner_cte.display_name JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb_variance DESC LIMIT 10), mig_rollup AS (WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(migration_count) - MIN(migration_count) AS migration_count_range, VARIANCE(migration_count) AS migration_count_variance, STDDEV(migration_count) AS migration_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid JOIN ( SELECT m.instance_uuid, m.dest_compute, COUNT(*) AS migration_count FROM migrations AS m WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY m.instance_uuid, m.dest_compute ) AS mig_stats ON i.uuid = mig_stats.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY migration_count_range DESC ), ZoneAgg AS ( SELECT i.availability_zone, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.migration_count_range, inner_cte.migration_count_variance, inner_cte.migration_count_stddev FROM inner_cte JOIN instances i ON i.display_name = inner_cte.display_name JOIN instance_extra ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(availability_zone) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE availability_zone END AS availability_zone, CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(availability_zone) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(availability_zone) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE display_name END AS display_name, AVG(migration_count_range) AS avg_migration_count_range, AVG(migration_count_variance) AS avg_migration_count_variance, AVG(migration_count_stddev) AS avg_migration_count_stddev FROM ZoneAgg GROUP BY availability_zone, display_name WITH ROLLUP) SELECT mvt.display_name, i.availability_zone, mvt.avg_memory_mb, mvt.memory_mb_variance, mvt.total_vcpus, mr.avg_migration_count_range, mr.avg_migration_count_variance, mr.avg_migration_count_stddev FROM mem_var_top10 AS mvt JOIN instances AS i ON i.display_name = mvt.display_name JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid LEFT JOIN mig_rollup AS mr ON mr.display_name = mvt.display_name AND mr.availability_zone = i.availability_zone WHERE i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' GROUP BY mvt.display_name, i.availability_zone, mvt.avg_memory_mb, mvt.memory_mb_variance, mvt.total_vcpus, mr.avg_migration_count_range, mr.avg_migration_count_variance, mr.avg_migration_count_stddev ORDER BY mvt.memory_mb_variance DESC, mvt.display_name, i.availability_zone;

question: For compute instances created in 2014 that are not deleted and whose display name appears in the top 10 (display name, system-metadata key) groups with maximum memory greater than 16000 MB, show the instance UUID, display name, VM state, power state, memory (MB), vCPUs, the windowed maximum INSTANCE_EXTRA id over the current and next 2 instances (ordered by UUID), the overall average of that windowed maximum and the instance’s deviation from it, plus the matched system-metadata key, the group’s maximum memory, and whether any instance in that (display name, key) group has a system-metadata value of 'neon'. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, ism.key, MAX(i.memory_mb) AS max_memory_mb FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.created_at) = 2014 GROUP BY i.display_name, ism.key HAVING MAX(i.memory_mb) > 16000 ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.key, inner_cte.max_memory_mb, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM instances i2 JOIN instance_system_metadata ism2 ON i2.uuid = ism2.instance_uuid WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i2.created_at) = 2014 AND i2.display_name = inner_cte.display_name AND ism2.key = inner_cte.key AND ism2.value = 'neon' ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_neon_value_for_key FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.max_memory_mb DESC LIMIT 10 ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.power_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, MAX(ie.id) OVER (ORDER BY i.uuid ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_extra_id_next2 FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 ), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(max_instance_extra_id_next2) AS avg_max_instance_extra_id_next2 FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.uuid, ic.display_name, ic.vm_state, ic.power_state, ic.memory_mb, ic.vcpus, ic.max_instance_extra_id_next2, ac.avg_max_instance_extra_id_next2, (ic.max_instance_extra_id_next2 - ac.avg_max_instance_extra_id_next2) AS deviation_from_avg_max_next2 FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte ac ) SELECT q2.uuid, q2.display_name, q2.vm_state, q2.power_state, q2.memory_mb, q2.vcpus, q2.max_instance_extra_id_next2, q2.avg_max_instance_extra_id_next2, q2.deviation_from_avg_max_next2, q1.key AS system_metadata_key, q1.max_memory_mb AS group_max_memory_mb, q1.has_neon_value_for_key FROM q2 JOIN q1 ON q2.display_name = q1.display_name WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM (SELECT i.created_at FROM instances i WHERE i.uuid = q2.uuid)) = 2014 ORDER BY q1.max_memory_mb DESC, q2.uuid;

question: For availability zone 'flare3', for the top 10 instance display names with the most instance info cache records, return each display name’s cache record count, the average cache record count across those top 10 and its deviation from that average, along with the display name’s memory variability metrics (memory range, variance, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP)) and its memory variability category compared to the overall average memory range across all non-deleted instances. Do not return any rounded answers. Compare the memory range to the average memory range across all (non-deleted) instance display names, categorizing each display name as 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' (at least 50% above average), 'LOW_VARIABILITY' (at least 50% below average), or 'AVERAGE_VARIABILITY'.
SQL: WITH mem_inner_cte AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC ), AverageRange AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb_range) AS avg_memory_mb_range FROM inner_cte ) SELECT c.display_name, c.memory_mb_range, c.memory_mb_variance, c.memory_mb_stddev, ar.avg_memory_mb_range AS benchmark, CASE WHEN c.memory_mb_range > ar.avg_memory_mb_range * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN c.memory_mb_range < ar.avg_memory_mb_range * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIABILITY' END AS variability_category FROM inner_cte c CROSS JOIN AverageRange ar ), net_inner_cte AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(iic.id) AS cache_records FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY cache_records DESC LIMIT 10 ), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(cache_records) AS avg_cache_records FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.cache_records, ac.avg_cache_records, (ic.cache_records - ac.avg_cache_records) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte ac ORDER BY ic.cache_records DESC ) SELECT n.display_name, n.cache_records, n.avg_cache_records, n.deviation_from_avg, m.memory_mb_range, m.memory_mb_variance, m.memory_mb_stddev, m.benchmark AS avg_memory_mb_range_benchmark, m.variability_category FROM net_inner_cte n JOIN mem_inner_cte m ON n.display_name = m.display_name ORDER BY n.cache_records DESC;

question: For each instance display name, list the display name along with (1) the variance, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), average, and maximum of MEMORY_MB computed over instances that have a non-deleted INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA row with KEY = 'image_image_type' (keeping only display names where AVG(MEMORY_MB) is greater than 75% of MAX(MEMORY_MB) for that display name), and (2) the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of MEMORY_MB among instances that have a non-deleted INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES record, keeping only those display names whose cache-based memory variance is above the overall average cache-based memory variance. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH ImageTypeMemoryStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND ism.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) AS max_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON i.DISPLAY_NAME = inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND ism.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev HAVING (AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) * 1.0 / MAX(i.MEMORY_MB)) > 0.75 ORDER BY avg_memory_mb DESC ), NonDeletedCacheVarianceAboveAvg AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE ic.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC), VarianceAverages AS ( SELECT AVG(inner_cte.memory_mb_variance * 1.0) AS avg_memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.memory_mb_variance > (SELECT avg_memory_mb_variance FROM VarianceAverages) ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT itms.DISPLAY_NAME, itms.memory_mb_variance AS image_type_memory_mb_variance, itms.memory_mb_stddev AS image_type_memory_mb_stddev, itms.avg_memory_mb AS image_type_avg_memory_mb, itms.max_memory_mb AS image_type_max_memory_mb, ndc.memory_mb_variance AS non_deleted_cache_memory_mb_variance, ndc.memory_mb_stddev AS non_deleted_cache_memory_mb_stddev FROM ImageTypeMemoryStats itms JOIN NonDeletedCacheVarianceAboveAvg ndc ON ndc.display_name = itms.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY itms.avg_memory_mb DESC;

question: For instances with display name equal to 'forge' whose memory in MB is greater than the average memory in MB of all 'forge' instances, show the instance display name, instance UUID, instance memory in MB, cached network info, cache record ID, and the average instance memory in MB within the display name group (ordered by memory), along with that display name’s coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of instance memory (computed over non-deleted instances with system metadata), the number of system metadata rows for the display name, and the overall average coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) across all display names. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH forge_above_avg AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, i.uuid, i.memory_mb, c.network_info, c.id AS cache_id, AVG(i.memory_mb) OVER (PARTITION BY i.display_name ORDER BY i.memory_mb) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.display_name = 'forge' ORDER BY i.memory_mb ), DisplayNameAverages AS ( SELECT i2.display_name, AVG(i2.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb FROM instances AS i2 WHERE i2.display_name = 'forge' GROUP BY i2.display_name ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.uuid, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.network_info, inner_cte.cache_id, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN DisplayNameAverages ON DisplayNameAverages.display_name = inner_cte.display_name WHERE inner_cte.memory_mb > ( SELECT avg_memory_mb FROM DisplayNameAverages WHERE DisplayNameAverages.display_name = inner_cte.display_name ) ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb ), display_name_cov AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) / NULLIF(AVG(i.memory_mb), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(i.memory_mb) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, meta_counts.system_metadata_rows, avg_cov.avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(ism.id) AS system_metadata_rows FROM instances i JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ) AS meta_counts ON meta_counts.display_name = inner_cte.display_name JOIN ( SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte ) AS avg_cov ORDER BY inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT faa.display_name, faa.uuid, faa.memory_mb, faa.network_info, faa.cache_id, faa.window_column, dnc.coefficient_of_variation, dnc.system_metadata_rows, dnc.avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM forge_above_avg AS faa JOIN display_name_cov AS dnc ON dnc.display_name = faa.display_name ORDER BY faa.memory_mb;

question: How many distinct instances in availability zone flare3 both (1) have non-deleted image_image_type system metadata values whose instance counts are above the average across all non-deleted image_image_type values, and (2) belong to one of the top 10 instance display names by number of network info cache records in flare3; and how many distinct display names meet both conditions? Do not return any rounded answers.
