question: For migrations with status = 'completed' where the instance is on host 'blaze8-12', list each instance UUID and display name with the migration source and destination compute and status, the instance flavor JSON, the dense-rank value (partitioned by migration status) along with its average and deviation from that average, the minimum instance memory (MB) over a window of 3 preceding and 1 following migration rows ordered by migration ID, the instance project ID and that project’s total vCPUs across all non-deleted instances, and compute the ratio of project total vCPUs to the average dense-rank value.
evidence: Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, i.display_name, ie.flavor, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.status ORDER BY m.status) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ), avg_rank AS ( SELECT AVG(window_column) AS avg_window_column FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.status, ic.source_compute, ic.dest_compute, ic.display_name, ic.flavor, ic.window_column, ar.avg_window_column, (ic.window_column - ar.avg_window_column) AS deviation_from_avg_window_column FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_rank ar ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.status, MIN(i.memory_mb) OVER ( ORDER BY m.id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT inner_cte.uuid, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.source_compute, inner_cte.dest_compute, inner_cte.status, inner_cte.window_column, i.project_id, SUM(i_all.vcpus) AS project_total_vcpus FROM inner_cte JOIN instances AS i ON i.uuid = inner_cte.uuid JOIN instances AS i_all ON i_all.project_id = i.project_id AND i_all.deleted = 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.uuid, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.source_compute, inner_cte.dest_compute, inner_cte.status, inner_cte.window_column, i.project_id ORDER BY project_total_vcpus DESC, inner_cte.uuid ) SELECT q2.uuid AS instance_uuid, q2.display_name AS instance_display_name, q2.status AS migration_status, q2.source_compute, q2.dest_compute, q1.flavor AS instance_flavor_json, q1.window_column AS dense_rank_value, q1.avg_window_column AS avg_dense_rank_value, q1.deviation_from_avg_window_column AS dense_rank_deviation_from_avg, q2.window_column AS min_instance_memory_mb_window_3_preceding_1_following, q2.project_id, q2.project_total_vcpus, ROUND(q2.project_total_vcpus / NULLIF(q1.avg_window_column, 0), 2) AS project_vcpus_per_avg_dense_rank FROM q2 JOIN q1 ON q1.status = q2.status AND q1.source_compute = q2.source_compute AND q1.dest_compute = q2.dest_compute AND q1.display_name = q2.display_name ORDER BY project_vcpus_per_avg_dense_rank DESC, q2.project_total_vcpus DESC, q2.uuid;

question: List all instances that either (a) are in availability zone 'flare3' on host 'blaze8-12' and have MEMORY_MB greater than the average MEMORY_MB of instances with the same VCPUS on that host, or (b) are in availability zone 'flare3' with a display name matching the pattern 'flare' and have cached NETWORK_INFO longer than the average for that set; return the instance UUID, display name, VM state, memory_mb, vcpus, key name, instance_extra_id, network_info, and a Reason indicating which condition included the row. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'" "Display 'flare'" is predicated by "instances.display_name REGEXP 'flare'"
SQL: WITH MemoryAboveVcpuAvg AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, i.KEY_NAME, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.VCPUS ORDER BY i.VCPUS) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), VcpuAverages AS ( SELECT i2.VCPUS, AVG(i2.MEMORY_MB * 1.0) AS avg_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i2 WHERE i2.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i2.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i2.VCPUS ) SELECT inner_cte.UUID, inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.MEMORY_MB, inner_cte.VCPUS, inner_cte.KEY_NAME, inner_cte.instance_extra_id, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.MEMORY_MB > ( SELECT VcpuAverages.avg_memory_mb FROM VcpuAverages WHERE VcpuAverages.VCPUS = inner_cte.VCPUS )), NetworkInfoAboveAvg AS (WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.DISPLAY_NAME, t1.UUID AS instance_uuid, t2.NETWORK_INFO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.DISPLAY_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t1.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND t1.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'flare' ), NetworkInfoAverages AS ( SELECT AVG(LENGTH(inner_cte.NETWORK_INFO) * 1.0) AS avg_network_info_len FROM inner_cte ) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.NETWORK_INFO, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE LENGTH(inner_cte.NETWORK_INFO) > (SELECT avg_network_info_len FROM NetworkInfoAverages)), CombinedInstances AS ( SELECT m.UUID AS instance_uuid, m.DISPLAY_NAME, m.VM_STATE, m.MEMORY_MB, m.VCPUS, m.KEY_NAME, m.instance_extra_id, n.NETWORK_INFO, 'High Memory vs VCPU Avg (flare3, blaze8-12)' AS Reason FROM MemoryAboveVcpuAvg m LEFT JOIN NetworkInfoAboveAvg n ON n.instance_uuid = m.UUID UNION ALL SELECT n.instance_uuid, n.DISPLAY_NAME, NULL AS VM_STATE, NULL AS MEMORY_MB, NULL AS VCPUS, NULL AS KEY_NAME, NULL AS instance_extra_id, n.NETWORK_INFO, 'High Cached Network Info Length vs Avg (flare3, name~flare)' AS Reason FROM NetworkInfoAboveAvg n ) SELECT * FROM CombinedInstances ORDER BY instance_uuid, Reason;

question: For each non-deleted instance display name matching the pattern 'prime' (and with a non-deleted network info cache record), show the display name, total number of qualifying instances, average instance memory (MB), variance of instance memory (MB), and the maximum (worst-case) standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the network info cache update lag (in days) for that display name, including a grand total row. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "Display 'prime'" is predicated by "instances.display_name REGEXP 'prime'"
SQL: WITH mem_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND ic.deleted = 0 AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(display_name) OVER (ORDER BY display_sort, display_name) = display_name THEN NULL ELSE display_name END AS display_name, total_instances, avg_memory_mb, memory_mb_variance FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.display_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.display_name END AS display_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.display_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.display_name END AS display_name, COUNT(i.id) AS total_instances, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid JOIN inner_cte ON inner_cte.display_name = i.display_name WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND ic.deleted = 0 AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY display_sort, display_name ), lag_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(c.updated_at - i.created_at) AS avg_cache_update_lag, STDDEV(c.updated_at - i.created_at) AS cache_update_lag_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY cache_update_lag_stddev DESC) SELECT display_name, MAX(cache_update_lag_stddev) AS max_cache_update_lag_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY display_name ) SELECT mem_stats.display_name, mem_stats.total_instances, mem_stats.avg_memory_mb, mem_stats.memory_mb_variance, lag_stats.max_cache_update_lag_stddev FROM mem_stats LEFT JOIN lag_stats ON lag_stats.display_name = mem_stats.display_name ORDER BY mem_stats.display_name;

question: For each instance availability zone on host blaze8-12, list the availability zone name, the geometric mean of instance memory (in MB) for zones whose geometric mean is greater than the overall geometric mean across all qualifying instances (not deleted and having at least one system metadata entry), and the maximum number of non-deleted instances with a network info cache entry found in that availability zone. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
SQL: WITH GeoMeanByAZ AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.availability_zone, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.memory_mb > 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.availability_zone ORDER BY geometric_mean DESC ), OverallGeoMean AS ( SELECT EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS overall_geometric_mean FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.memory_mb > 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT inner_cte.availability_zone, inner_cte.geometric_mean FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.geometric_mean > (SELECT overall_geometric_mean FROM OverallGeoMean) ORDER BY inner_cte.geometric_mean DESC ), MaxNetworkCacheInstancesByAZ AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS flare3_instances_with_network_cache FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), ZoneCounts AS (SELECT i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE AS availability_zone, COUNT(*) AS instances_with_network_cache_on_host FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE) SELECT availability_zone, MAX(instances_with_network_cache_on_host) AS max_instances_with_network_cache_on_host FROM ZoneCounts GROUP BY availability_zone ) SELECT g.availability_zone, g.geometric_mean AS geometric_mean_instance_memory_mb, m.max_instances_with_network_cache_on_host FROM GeoMeanByAZ g JOIN MaxNetworkCacheInstancesByAZ m ON g.availability_zone = m.availability_zone ORDER BY g.geometric_mean DESC;

question: For host 'blaze8-12', list the VM states that (a) have a system metadata entry with KEY = 'image_image_type' and (b) have completed migrations whose total memory moved range exceeds 10,000,000,000; for each such VM state, show the average/range/variance of ROOT_GB, the overall average of the per-VM-state average ROOT_GB across all VM states in the filtered set, and the range and variance of MIGRATIONS.MEMORY_TOTAL, ordered by memory_total_range descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
SQL: WITH root_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, AVG(i.ROOT_GB) AS avg_root_gb, MAX(i.ROOT_GB) - MIN(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_range, VARIANCE(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY root_gb_range DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.avg_root_gb, inner_cte.root_gb_range, inner_cte.root_gb_variance, overall_avg.avg_of_vmstate_avg_root_gb FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(avg_root_gb) AS avg_of_vmstate_avg_root_gb FROM inner_cte ) AS overall_avg ON 1 = 1 ORDER BY inner_cte.root_gb_range DESC ), migration_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, MAX(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) - MIN(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) AS memory_total_range, VARIANCE(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) AS memory_total_variance FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_total_range DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.memory_total_range, inner_cte.memory_total_variance FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.memory_total_range > 10000000000 ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_total_range DESC ) SELECT ms.VM_STATE, rs.avg_root_gb, rs.root_gb_range, rs.root_gb_variance, rs.avg_of_vmstate_avg_root_gb, ms.memory_total_range, ms.memory_total_variance FROM migration_stats AS ms JOIN root_stats AS rs ON ms.VM_STATE = rs.VM_STATE ORDER BY ms.memory_total_range DESC;

question: For completed migrations where the instance display name matches the pattern 'prime', show the instance UUID, instance display name, migration status, source compute host, destination compute host, migration memory total, the 2-preceding/2-following window average of migration memory total within the instance availability zone, and the instance project ID, vCPU count, and memory (MB); also indicate whether that same instance UUID has any completed migrations whose instance display name matches the pattern 'flare', and include the overall average migration id across those returned 'flare' migrations. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "Display 'prime'" is predicated by "instances.display_name REGEXP 'prime'" "Display 'flare'" is predicated by "instances.display_name REGEXP 'flare'"
SQL: WITH prime_migrations AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE AS source_compute, m.DEST_COMPUTE AS dest_compute, m.MEMORY_TOTAL AS memory_total, AVG(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) OVER ( PARTITION BY i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE ORDER BY m.MEMORY_TOTAL ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES i JOIN MIGRATIONS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'prime' ORDER BY m.MEMORY_TOTAL ) SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.instance_display_name, inner_cte.migration_status, inner_cte.source_compute, inner_cte.dest_compute, inner_cte.memory_total, inner_cte.window_column, i.project_id AS instance_project_id, i.vcpus AS instance_vcpus, i.memory_mb AS instance_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN INSTANCES i ON i.uuid = inner_cte.instance_uuid ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_total ), flare_migrations AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.INSTANCE_UUID, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, ie.FLAVOR, AVG(m.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY m.INSTANCE_UUID ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'flare' ORDER BY m.ID ), avg_migration AS ( SELECT AVG(migration_id) AS avg_migration_id FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.migration_id, ic.INSTANCE_UUID, ic.SOURCE_COMPUTE, ic.DEST_COMPUTE, ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.FLAVOR, ic.window_column, am.avg_migration_id, (ic.migration_id - am.avg_migration_id) AS deviation_from_overall_avg_migration_id FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_migration am ORDER BY ic.migration_id ) SELECT pm.instance_uuid, pm.instance_display_name, pm.migration_status, pm.source_compute, pm.dest_compute, pm.memory_total, pm.window_column AS prime_memory_total_window_avg, pm.instance_project_id, pm.instance_vcpus, pm.instance_memory_mb, fm.avg_migration_id AS flare_overall_avg_migration_id, CASE WHEN COUNT(fm.migration_id) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS Has_Completed_Flare_Migrations FROM prime_migrations pm LEFT JOIN flare_migrations fm ON fm.INSTANCE_UUID = pm.instance_uuid WHERE pm.migration_status = 'completed' GROUP BY pm.instance_uuid, pm.instance_display_name, pm.migration_status, pm.source_compute, pm.dest_compute, pm.memory_total, pm.window_column, pm.instance_project_id, pm.instance_vcpus, pm.instance_memory_mb, fm.avg_migration_id ORDER BY pm.memory_total;

question: For instances whose display name matches the regular expression 'prime' and that have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type', find the (VM state, display name) groups on host "blaze8-12" with more than 8 VCPUs, and return each group’s instance count and minimum memory (MB) along with the overall average of these group counts; only include display names that also have an average memory greater than 75% of the maximum memory observed for that same display name, and show the corresponding average, variance, and maximum memory for those display names. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "Display 'prime'" is predicated by "instances.display_name REGEXP 'prime'" Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
SQL: WITH prime_memory_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, mx.max_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) AS max_memory_mb FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ) mx ON mx.display_name = inner_cte.display_name WHERE (inner_cte.avg_memory_mb * 1.0 / mx.max_memory_mb) > 0.75 ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb_variance DESC ), blaze8_12_state_name_counts AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(i.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VCPUS > 8 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.instance_count, inner_cte.min_memory_mb, avg_counts.avg_instance_count FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(instance_count) AS avg_instance_count FROM inner_cte ) AS avg_counts ) SELECT b.VM_STATE, b.DISPLAY_NAME, b.instance_count, b.min_memory_mb, b.avg_instance_count, p.avg_memory_mb, p.memory_mb_variance, p.max_memory_mb FROM blaze8_12_state_name_counts b JOIN prime_memory_stats p ON p.display_name = b.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY b.VM_STATE, b.DISPLAY_NAME;

question: For each instance availability zone and VM state (including per-availability-zone subtotals and a grand total) for non-deleted instances hosted on “prime-35” (joined via instance UUID to both the instance extra record and the instance network info cache), list the availability zone, VM state, number of instances, and earliest instance creation time, and also show the number of completed migrations per VM state for instances hosted on “blaze8-12”, along with the overall average of these per-VM-state completed-migration counts and the completed-migration count specifically for shelved_offloaded instances. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Host "prime-35" is predicated by "instances.host = 'prime-35'" Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
SQL: WITH InstanceZoneStateRollup AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, ins.VM_STATE, COUNT(ins.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(ins.CREATED_AT) AS earliest_created_at FROM INSTANCES AS ins JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID WHERE ins.DELETED = 0 AND ins.HOST = 'prime-35' GROUP BY ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, ins.VM_STATE ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(AVAILABILITY_ZONE) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE AVAILABILITY_ZONE END AS AVAILABILITY_ZONE, CASE WHEN GROUPING(VM_STATE) = 1 AND GROUPING(AVAILABILITY_ZONE) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE VM_STATE END AS VM_STATE, SUM(instance_count) AS instance_count, MIN(earliest_created_at) AS earliest_created_at FROM inner_cte GROUP BY AVAILABILITY_ZONE, VM_STATE WITH ROLLUP ), CompletedMigrationCountsByState AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS completed_migrations_for_shelved_instances FROM INSTANCES i JOIN MIGRATIONS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, COUNT(*) AS completed_migrations_for_state, avg_counts.avg_completed_migrations_per_state, inner_cte.completed_migrations_for_shelved_instances FROM INSTANCES i JOIN MIGRATIONS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID JOIN inner_cte ON 1 = 1 JOIN ( SELECT AVG(state_migration_count) AS avg_completed_migrations_per_state FROM ( SELECT i2.VM_STATE, COUNT(*) AS state_migration_count FROM INSTANCES i2 JOIN MIGRATIONS m2 ON i2.UUID = m2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m2.STATUS = 'completed' AND i2.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i2.VM_STATE ) AS sub ) AS avg_counts ON 1 = 1 WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, avg_counts.avg_completed_migrations_per_state, inner_cte.completed_migrations_for_shelved_instances ) SELECT izsr.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, izsr.VM_STATE, izsr.instance_count, izsr.earliest_created_at, cmcbs.completed_migrations_for_state, cmcbs.avg_completed_migrations_per_state, cmcbs.completed_migrations_for_shelved_instances FROM InstanceZoneStateRollup izsr LEFT JOIN CompletedMigrationCountsByState cmcbs ON izsr.VM_STATE = cmcbs.vm_state ORDER BY izsr.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, izsr.VM_STATE;

question: For the rollup rows produced (including subtotals and the grand total) from (1) instances on host 'prime-35' that have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type' summarized by instance display name, and (2) instances in availability zone 'flare3' on host 'blaze8-12' that have at least one system metadata entry summarized by system metadata key, list the display name rollup row, its total memory range (MB) and average memory variance (MB), the metadata key rollup row with its minimum memory (MB) and total vCPUs, the overall minimum memory and overall total vCPUs, and compute the vCPU share of overall total vCPUs for each metadata-key rollup row.
evidence: Host "prime-35" is predicated by "instances.host = 'prime-35'" Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_range_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_variance_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'prime-35' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_range_mb DESC ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE display_name END AS display_name, SUM(memory_range_mb) AS total_memory_range_mb, AVG(memory_variance_mb) AS avg_memory_variance_mb FROM inner_cte GROUP BY display_name WITH ROLLUP ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb, SUM(i.VCPUS) AS total_vcpus FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ), KeyAgg AS ( SELECT ism.KEY AS metadata_key, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb, SUM(i.VCPUS) AS total_vcpus FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY ism.KEY ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(metadata_key) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE metadata_key END AS metadata_key, SUM(min_memory_mb) AS min_memory_mb, SUM(total_vcpus) AS total_vcpus, (SELECT min_memory_mb FROM inner_cte) AS overall_min_memory_mb, (SELECT total_vcpus FROM inner_cte) AS overall_total_vcpus FROM KeyAgg GROUP BY metadata_key WITH ROLLUP ) SELECT q1.display_name, q1.total_memory_range_mb, q1.avg_memory_variance_mb, q2.metadata_key, q2.min_memory_mb, q2.total_vcpus, q2.overall_min_memory_mb, q2.overall_total_vcpus, ROUND(q2.total_vcpus / NULLIF(q2.overall_total_vcpus, 0), 4) AS vcpu_share_of_overall FROM q1 CROSS JOIN q2 ORDER BY q1.display_name, q2.metadata_key;

question: For the top 10 non-deleted instance display names matching the pattern 'prime' with the most system metadata records where the key is 'image_image_type', show each display name’s metadata record count and its deviation from the top-10 average, along with the minimum completed migration ID and the average instance memory (MB) for that display name, including the overall benchmark average memory and a HIGH/LOW/AVERAGE memory category relative to that benchmark. Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each display name as 'HIGH_MEMORY' (at least 50% above the benchmark), 'LOW_MEMORY' (at least 50% below the benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_MEMORY'.
evidence: "Display 'prime'" is predicated by "instances.display_name REGEXP 'prime'"
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MIN(m.ID) AS min_migration_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_instance_memory_mb FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.DELETED = 0 AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ), benchmark_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(avg_instance_memory_mb) AS benchmark_avg_instance_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.min_migration_id, ic.avg_instance_memory_mb, b.benchmark_avg_instance_memory_mb AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.avg_instance_memory_mb > b.benchmark_avg_instance_memory_mb * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_MEMORY' WHEN ic.avg_instance_memory_mb < b.benchmark_avg_instance_memory_mb * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_MEMORY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_MEMORY' END AS memory_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN benchmark_cte b ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(ism.ID) AS metadata_records FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY metadata_records DESC LIMIT 10 ), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(metadata_records) AS avg_metadata_records FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.metadata_records, (ic.metadata_records - ac.avg_metadata_records) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte ac ORDER BY ic.metadata_records DESC ) SELECT q2.DISPLAY_NAME, q2.metadata_records, q2.deviation_from_avg, q1.min_migration_id, q1.avg_instance_memory_mb, q1.benchmark, q1.memory_category FROM q2 LEFT JOIN q1 ON q2.DISPLAY_NAME = q1.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY q2.metadata_records DESC;

question: List all instance display names matching the pattern "prime" that either (a) have a 2014-created max memory (MB) over 16000 when grouped by system-metadata key (including subtotals per display name and a grand total), or (b) have completed migrations (with DELETED = 0) whose average instance memory (MB) is above the overall average across such "prime" completed migrations; return the display name, metadata key (when applicable), the metric value, and a reason indicating which condition produced the row. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "Display 'prime'" is predicated by "instances.display_name REGEXP 'prime'"
SQL: WITH MaxMemoryRollup AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, ism.key, MAX(i.memory_mb) AS max_memory_mb FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.created_at) = 2014 AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name, ism.key HAVING MAX(i.memory_mb) > 16000 ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE display_name END AS display_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(`key`) = 1 AND GROUPING(display_name) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE `key` END AS `key`, MAX(max_memory_mb) AS max_memory_mb FROM inner_cte GROUP BY display_name, `key` WITH ROLLUP ), MigrationMemoryAboveAvg AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MIN(m.ID) AS min_migration_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_instance_memory_mb FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.DELETED = 0 AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.min_migration_id, inner_cte.avg_instance_memory_mb FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.avg_instance_memory_mb > ( SELECT AVG(inner_cte2.avg_instance_memory_mb) FROM inner_cte AS inner_cte2 ) ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT mmr.display_name AS display_name, mmr.`key` AS metadata_key, mmr.max_memory_mb AS metric_value, '2014 Prime Max Memory (Rollup)' AS reason FROM MaxMemoryRollup mmr UNION ALL SELECT mma.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, NULL AS metadata_key, mma.avg_instance_memory_mb AS metric_value, 'Completed Migration Avg Memory Above Overall Avg' AS reason FROM MigrationMemoryAboveAvg mma ) SELECT display_name, metadata_key, metric_value, reason FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY display_name, reason, metadata_key;

question: On host 'blaze8-12', for the top 10 instances that have an instance_system_metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type' (ranked by total memory processed across all their migrations), show each instance’s UUID, display name, migration status, migration count, total memory processed, and whether it has any active (non-completed/non-failed/non-error) migrations; additionally, for those same instances, include the completed-migration rollup metrics for metadata_key = 'image_image_type' (total migrations and the running sum of migration IDs). Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name AS instance_display_name, m.status AS migration_status, COUNT(m.id) AS migration_count, SUM(m.memory_processed) AS total_memory_processed FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, m.status ) SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.instance_display_name, inner_cte.migration_status, inner_cte.migration_count, inner_cte.total_memory_processed, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM migrations m2 JOIN instances i2 ON m2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism2 ON i2.uuid = ism2.instance_uuid WHERE i2.uuid = inner_cte.instance_uuid AND ism2.key = 'image_image_type' AND i2.host = 'blaze8-12' AND m2.deleted = 0 AND m2.status NOT IN ('completed', 'failed', 'error') ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_active_migrations FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.total_memory_processed DESC LIMIT 10 ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, SUM(m.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(metadata_key) OVER (ORDER BY metadata_key_sort, metadata_key, instance_display_name_sort, instance_display_name) = metadata_key THEN NULL ELSE metadata_key END AS metadata_key, CASE WHEN LAG(instance_display_name) OVER (PARTITION BY metadata_key_sort, metadata_key ORDER BY instance_display_name_sort, instance_display_name) = instance_display_name THEN NULL ELSE instance_display_name END AS instance_display_name, total_migrations, running_sum_migration_ids FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(metadata_key) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE metadata_key END AS metadata_key_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(metadata_key) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE metadata_key END AS metadata_key, CASE WHEN GROUPING(instance_display_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE instance_display_name END AS instance_display_name_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(instance_display_name) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE instance_display_name END AS instance_display_name, COUNT(*) AS total_migrations, MAX(window_column) AS running_sum_migration_ids FROM inner_cte GROUP BY metadata_key, instance_display_name WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY metadata_key_sort, metadata_key, instance_display_name_sort, instance_display_name ) SELECT q1.instance_uuid, q1.instance_display_name, q1.migration_status, q1.migration_count, q1.total_memory_processed, q1.has_active_migrations, q2.metadata_key, q2.total_migrations, q2.running_sum_migration_ids FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q2.instance_display_name = q1.instance_display_name WHERE q2.metadata_key = 'image_image_type' ORDER BY q1.total_memory_processed DESC, q1.instance_uuid;

question: For host "blaze8-12", list each instance that has a completed migration with its display name, hostname, VM state, memory (MB), vCPU count, instance UUID, migration status, and the maximum migration ID over the current row and the next 2 rows (ordered by instance UUID), along with (a) the total number of completed migrations on that host and the average number of completed migrations per host across all hosts, and (b) the total memory (MB) by VM state for instances in availability zone "flare3" on "blaze8-12" (only VM states whose summed memory exceeds 50000 MB, including the final TOTAL row). Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.HOSTNAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, i.UUID, m.STATUS, MAX(m.ID) OVER ( ORDER BY i.UUID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_migration_id_next2 FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.HOSTNAME, inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.MEMORY_MB, inner_cte.VCPUS, inner_cte.UUID, inner_cte.STATUS, inner_cte.max_migration_id_next2, host_stats.completed_migrations_on_host, avg_stats.avg_completed_migrations_per_host FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT i.host AS host, COUNT(*) AS completed_migrations_on_host FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' GROUP BY i.host ) AS host_stats ON host_stats.host = 'blaze8-12' JOIN ( SELECT AVG(completed_migration_count) AS avg_completed_migrations_per_host FROM ( SELECT i.host AS host, COUNT(*) AS completed_migration_count FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' GROUP BY i.host ) AS sub ) AS avg_stats ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) AS total_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE HAVING SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) > 50000 ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(vm_state_name) OVER (ORDER BY vm_state_sort, vm_state_name) = vm_state_name THEN NULL ELSE vm_state_name END AS vm_state, total_memory_mb FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(vm_state) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE vm_state END AS vm_state_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(vm_state) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE vm_state END AS vm_state_name, SUM(total_memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte GROUP BY vm_state WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY vm_state_sort, vm_state_name ) SELECT q1.DISPLAY_NAME, q1.HOSTNAME, q1.VM_STATE, q1.MEMORY_MB, q1.VCPUS, q1.UUID, q1.STATUS, q1.max_migration_id_next2, q1.completed_migrations_on_host, q1.avg_completed_migrations_per_host, q2.vm_state AS az_host_vm_state, q2.total_memory_mb AS az_host_total_memory_mb FROM q1 LEFT JOIN q2 ON q2.vm_state = q1.VM_STATE ORDER BY q1.UUID, q2.vm_state;

question: List (1) each non-deleted instance display name matching the pattern 'prime' with its cache-update time coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), the overall average coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) as a benchmark, and a variability category, and (2) each instance in availability zone 'flare3' whose display name matches the pattern 'flare' with its deviation from the overall average memory (using that overall average as the benchmark), returning a combined result set with a reason indicating which rule produced each row. Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each display name as 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' (at least 50% above the benchmark), 'LOW_VARIABILITY' (at least 50% below the benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_VARIABILITY'.
evidence: "Display 'prime'" is predicated by "instances.display_name REGEXP 'prime'" "Display 'flare'" is predicated by "instances.display_name REGEXP 'flare'"
SQL: WITH prime_variability AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(c.updated_at - i.created_at) / NULLIF(AVG(c.updated_at - i.created_at), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS e ON e.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON c.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(c.updated_at - i.created_at) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.coefficient_of_variation, ac.avg_coefficient_of_variation AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.coefficient_of_variation > ac.avg_coefficient_of_variation * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN ic.coefficient_of_variation < ac.avg_coefficient_of_variation * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIABILITY' END AS variability_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte ac ORDER BY ic.coefficient_of_variation DESC ), flare_memory AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ie.CREATED_AT AS instance_extra_created_at, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'flare' ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ), overall_avg AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb) AS overall_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.instance_uuid, ic.hostname, ic.memory_mb, ic.instance_extra_id, ic.instance_extra_created_at, ic.window_column, oa.overall_avg_memory_mb, (ic.memory_mb - oa.overall_avg_memory_mb) AS deviation_from_overall_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa ORDER BY ic.memory_mb ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT pv.display_name AS entity_name, pv.coefficient_of_variation AS metric_value, pv.benchmark AS benchmark_value, pv.variability_category AS category, 'Prime display-name cache-update variability' AS reason FROM prime_variability pv UNION ALL SELECT fm.instance_uuid AS entity_name, fm.deviation_from_overall_avg_memory_mb AS metric_value, fm.overall_avg_memory_mb AS benchmark_value, CASE WHEN fm.deviation_from_overall_avg_memory_mb > 0 THEN 'ABOVE_OVERALL_AVG' WHEN fm.deviation_from_overall_avg_memory_mb < 0 THEN 'BELOW_OVERALL_AVG' ELSE 'AT_OVERALL_AVG' END AS category, 'Flare3 instance memory deviation' AS reason FROM flare_memory fm ) SELECT entity_name, metric_value, benchmark_value, category, reason FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY entity_name;

question: For instances that have a system metadata entry with KEY = 'image_image_type' and are running on host 'blaze8-12', return (by VM state) the average/range/variance of instance memory (MEMORY_MB) and the average/range/variance of ROOT_GB, also showing the overall average of the per-VM-state average ROOT_GB across all VM states; include the subtotal row across all VM states and do not repeat the VM state label when it is the same as the previous row. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
SQL: WITH mem_by_vm_state AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) - MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(vm_state_name) OVER (ORDER BY vm_state_sort, vm_state_name) = vm_state_name THEN NULL ELSE vm_state_name END AS vm_state, avg_memory_mb, memory_mb_range, memory_mb_variance FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(VM_STATE) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE VM_STATE END AS vm_state_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(VM_STATE) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE VM_STATE END AS vm_state_name, AVG(avg_memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, MAX(memory_mb_range) AS memory_mb_range, AVG(memory_mb_variance) AS memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY VM_STATE WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY vm_state_sort, vm_state_name ), root_by_vm_state AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, AVG(i.ROOT_GB) AS avg_root_gb, MAX(i.ROOT_GB) - MIN(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_range, VARIANCE(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY root_gb_range DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.avg_root_gb, inner_cte.root_gb_range, inner_cte.root_gb_variance, overall_avg.avg_of_vmstate_avg_root_gb FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(avg_root_gb) AS avg_of_vmstate_avg_root_gb FROM inner_cte ) AS overall_avg ON 1 = 1 ORDER BY inner_cte.root_gb_range DESC ) SELECT m.vm_state, m.avg_memory_mb, m.memory_mb_range, m.memory_mb_variance, r.avg_root_gb, r.root_gb_range, r.root_gb_variance, r.avg_of_vmstate_avg_root_gb FROM mem_by_vm_state AS m LEFT JOIN root_by_vm_state AS r ON r.VM_STATE = m.vm_state ORDER BY CASE WHEN m.vm_state IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, m.vm_state;

question: For instances in availability zone 'flare3' running on host 'blaze8-12' that have a per-VM-state instance count greater than the overall average instances-per-state, list the instance UUID, display name, VM state, memory_mb, cached network_info JSON (and its 2-preceding/2-following windowed average of memory_mb by VM state), along with any matching completed migration details on the same host (migration status, source compute, destination compute, instance flavor JSON, the migration dense-rank value, the average dense-rank, and the deviation from that average). Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
SQL: WITH migration_details AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, i.display_name, ie.flavor, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.status ORDER BY m.status) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ), avg_rank AS ( SELECT AVG(window_column) AS avg_window_column FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.status, ic.source_compute, ic.dest_compute, ic.display_name, ic.flavor, ic.window_column, ar.avg_window_column, (ic.window_column - ar.avg_window_column) AS deviation_from_avg_window_column FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_rank ar ), instance_details AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, c.network_info, AVG(i.memory_mb) OVER ( PARTITION BY i.vm_state ORDER BY i.memory_mb ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ORDER BY i.memory_mb ) SELECT inner_cte.uuid, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.network_info, inner_cte.window_column, state_counts.total_in_state, avg_state_counts.avg_instances_per_state FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT vm_state, COUNT(*) AS total_in_state FROM inner_cte GROUP BY vm_state ) AS state_counts ON inner_cte.vm_state = state_counts.vm_state JOIN ( SELECT AVG(state_total) AS avg_instances_per_state FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS state_total FROM inner_cte GROUP BY vm_state ) AS sub ) AS avg_state_counts ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb ) SELECT id.uuid, id.display_name, id.vm_state, id.memory_mb, id.network_info, id.window_column AS memory_mb_window_avg, id.total_in_state, id.avg_instances_per_state, md.status AS migration_status, md.source_compute, md.dest_compute, md.flavor, md.window_column AS migration_dense_rank, md.avg_window_column AS avg_migration_dense_rank, md.deviation_from_avg_window_column AS migration_dense_rank_deviation FROM instance_details AS id JOIN migration_details AS md ON id.display_name = md.display_name WHERE id.total_in_state > id.avg_instances_per_state ORDER BY id.memory_mb;

question: For availability-zone flare3, find instances whose display name matches the pattern "flare" that are also on host "blaze8-12" (as identified by the per-instance/subtotal/grand-total rollup of instance extra IDs and system metadata keys). For those matching instances, return the instance UUID, display name, VM state, memory (MB), vCPUs, system metadata key/value with its row number per key (ordered by instance UUID), the percent of ROOT_GB relative to MEMORY_MB, plus the hostname and the per-instance counts of distinct instance extra record IDs and distinct system metadata keys. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "Display 'flare'" is predicated by "instances.display_name REGEXP 'flare'" Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND ic.DELETED = 0 AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY migration_count DESC LIMIT 10 ), avg_cte AS ( SELECT question: For instances running on host 'blaze8-12' (using only non-deleted instance info cache rows and non-deleted system metadata entries for key 'image_image_type'), show the image type, host migration activity label (Active/Inactive), instance display name, the average coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of root disk size (GB) with rollup subtotals and a grand total, the row count, and (when the display name matches REGEXP 'prime') the maximum completed-migration memory_total observed for that display name (only when that maximum is greater than 0). image_type, host_migration_status, display_name WITH ROLLUP ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(m.memory_total) AS max_memory_total, m.status FROM instances i JOIN migrations m ON MAX(inner_cte.max_memory_total) AS max_completed_migration_memory_total FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name ) SELECT q1.image_type, q1.host_migration_status, q1.display_name, q1.avg_coefficient_of_variation, q1.row_count, q2.max_completed_migration_memory_total FROM q1 LEFT JOIN q2 ON q2.display_name = q1.display_name ORDER BY q1.image_type, q1.host_migration_status, question: For instance display names matching the pattern 'prime' (considering only non-deleted instances), list each display name (suppressing repeats), the number of matching instance records, and the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of MEMORY_MB for that display name, and also show the overall average of the per-display-name MEMORY_MB ranges across all such display names (with a final TOTAL row). evidence: "Display 'prime'" is predicated by "instances.display_name REGEXP 'prime'"
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(display_name) OVER (ORDER BY display_name_sort, display_name) = display_name THEN NULL ELSE display_name END AS display_name, total_records, memory_mb_range, memory_mb_variance, memory_mb_stddev FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.display_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE inner_cte.display_name END AS display_name_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.display_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE inner_cte.display_name END AS display_name, COUNT(*) AS total_records, MAX(inner_cte.memory_mb_range) AS memory_mb_range, AVG(inner_cte.memory_mb_variance) AS memory_mb_variance, AVG(inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY display_name_sort, display_name ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_mb_range, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev, avg_ranges.avg_memory_mb_range FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb_range) AS avg_memory_mb_range FROM inner_cte ) AS avg_ranges ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb_range DESC ) SELECT q1.display_name, q1.total_records, q1.memory_mb_range, q1.memory_mb_variance, q1.memory_mb_stddev, q2.avg_memory_mb_range FROM q1 LEFT JOIN q2 ON q1.display_name = q2.display_name ORDER BY CASE WHEN q1.display_name = 'TOTAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, q1.display_name;

question: For instance display names matching the pattern 'prime', return the top 10 display names by highest memory standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) (MB) among instances that have system metadata KEY = 'image_image_type', and for each of those display names also show its memory variance (MB), the overall average variance benchmark, and the variance category (HIGH_VARIANCE/LOW_VARIANCE/AVERAGE_VARIANCE), along with the average memory (MB), memory standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) (MB), and the number of distinct image types (metadata VALUEs). Do not return any rounded answers. Whose display name matches the pattern "prime".
evidence: "Display 'prime'" is predicated by "instances.display_name REGEXP 'prime'"
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev, COUNT(DISTINCT ism2.value) AS distinct_image_types FROM inner_cte JOIN instances i2 ON i2.display_name = inner_cte.display_name JOIN instance_system_metadata ism2 ON ism2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid AND ism2.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev DESC LIMIT 10 ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), AverageVariance AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb_variance) AS avg_memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.memory_mb_variance, av.avg_memory_mb_variance AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.memory_mb_variance > av.avg_memory_mb_variance * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN ic.memory_mb_variance < av.avg_memory_mb_variance * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AverageVariance av ORDER BY ic.memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT q1.display_name, q1.avg_memory_mb, q1.memory_mb_stddev, q1.distinct_image_types, q2.memory_mb_variance, q2.benchmark, q2.variance_category FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q2.DISPLAY_NAME = q1.display_name ORDER BY q1.memory_mb_stddev DESC;

question: For instances hosted on blaze8-12 that have a system metadata entry with key image_image_type, show the instances whose average memory usage is more than 75% of the maximum memory observed among those instances, and for each such instance return the display name, average memory, memory variance, the maximum memory used for the comparison, plus the image_image_type metadata value, cached network info, the row-number window column, and how the metadata value deviates from the average metadata value across all returned rows. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
SQL: WITH mem_threshold AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), max_mem AS ( SELECT MAX(i.memory_mb) AS max_memory_mb FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.avg_memory_mb, ic.memory_mb_variance, mm.max_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN max_mem mm WHERE (ic.avg_memory_mb * 1.0 / mm.max_memory_mb) > 0.75 ORDER BY ic.avg_memory_mb DESC ), meta_network_deviation AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.DISPLAY_NAME, t0.VALUE AS metadata_value, t2.NETWORK_INFO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t0.VALUE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t0.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND t1.host = 'blaze8-12' ), avg_meta AS ( SELECT AVG(CAST(metadata_value AS REAL)) AS avg_metadata_value FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.metadata_value, ic.NETWORK_INFO, ic.window_column, (CAST(ic.metadata_value AS REAL) - am.avg_metadata_value) AS deviation_from_avg_metadata_value FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_meta am ) SELECT mt.display_name, mt.avg_memory_mb, mt.memory_mb_variance, mt.max_memory_mb, mnd.metadata_value, mnd.NETWORK_INFO, mnd.window_column, mnd.deviation_from_avg_metadata_value FROM mem_threshold mt JOIN meta_network_deviation mnd ON mt.display_name = mnd.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY mt.avg_memory_mb DESC, mnd.window_column;

question: For host 'blaze8-12', for each VM state and display name among instances with more than 8 VCPUs, show the geometric mean instance memory (MB) and the count of distinct instances contributing to that geometric mean for instances that have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type' (and memory_mb > 0), along with the number of >8-VCPU instances, their minimum memory (MB), and how far that minimum is above the overall minimum memory (MB) across all such >8-VCPU instances. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.vm_state, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.vm_state ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC) SELECT inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.geometric_mean_memory_mb, COUNT(DISTINCT i.uuid) AS instance_count FROM inner_cte JOIN instances AS i ON i.vm_state = inner_cte.vm_state JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.geometric_mean_memory_mb ORDER BY inner_cte.geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(i.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VCPUS > 8 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME ), OverallMin AS ( SELECT MIN(min_memory_mb) AS overall_min_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.VM_STATE, ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.instance_count, ic.min_memory_mb, (ic.min_memory_mb - om.overall_min_memory_mb) AS min_memory_deviation_from_overall_min FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN OverallMin om ) SELECT q2.VM_STATE, q2.DISPLAY_NAME, q1.geometric_mean_memory_mb, q1.instance_count AS image_image_type_instance_count, q2.instance_count AS high_vcpu_instance_count, q2.min_memory_mb AS high_vcpu_min_memory_mb, q2.min_memory_deviation_from_overall_min FROM q2 JOIN q1 ON q2.VM_STATE = q1.vm_state ORDER BY q2.VM_STATE, q2.DISPLAY_NAME;

question: For completed migrations whose instances are hosted on blaze8-12, list the migration ID, the instance display name, the instance memory in MB, the running sum of instance memory in MB within the completed-status group ordered by migration ID, the deviation of that running sum from the average running-sum value across all returned rows, and (for the same instance display name on blaze8-12 among non-deleted instances with extra metadata) the memory variance, memory standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and the deviation of that variance from the overall average memory variance. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
SQL: WITH MigrationMemoryWindow AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ), avg_window AS ( SELECT AVG(window_column) AS avg_window_column FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.migration_id, ic.instance_display_name, ic.instance_memory_mb, ic.window_column AS running_sum_instance_memory_mb, (ic.window_column - aw.avg_window_column) AS deviation_from_avg_running_sum_instance_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_window aw ), InstanceMemoryVarianceStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC), avg_stats AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb_variance) AS avg_memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_mb_variance, ic.memory_mb_stddev, (ic.memory_mb_variance - a.avg_memory_mb_variance) AS deviation_from_avg_memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_stats a ORDER BY ic.memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT mmw.migration_id, mmw.instance_display_name, mmw.instance_memory_mb, mmw.running_sum_instance_memory_mb, mmw.deviation_from_avg_running_sum_instance_memory_mb, imvs.memory_mb_variance, imvs.memory_mb_stddev, imvs.deviation_from_avg_memory_mb_variance FROM MigrationMemoryWindow mmw JOIN InstanceMemoryVarianceStats imvs ON mmw.instance_display_name = imvs.display_name ORDER BY mmw.migration_id;

question: For each active migration status (excluding 'accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', and 'completed') for instances whose system metadata key is 'image_image_type', show the status, the total migration memory processed (only where the total is greater than 0), the overall average of those per-status totals as a benchmark, the status’s memory category (HIGH_MEMORY/LOW_MEMORY/AVERAGE_MEMORY relative to the benchmark), and the average/variance/standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of instance memory (MB) for instances with that migration status. Do not return any rounded answers. Only include statuses where the total processed memory is greater than 0.
evidence: "Active migrations" is predicated by "migrations.status NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed')"
SQL: WITH mem_by_status AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.status, SUM(m.memory_processed) AS total_memory_processed FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND m.status NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') GROUP BY m.status HAVING SUM(m.memory_processed) > 0 ), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(total_memory_processed) AS avg_total_memory_processed FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.status, ic.total_memory_processed, a.avg_total_memory_processed AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.total_memory_processed > a.avg_total_memory_processed * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_MEMORY' WHEN ic.total_memory_processed < a.avg_total_memory_processed * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_MEMORY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_MEMORY' END AS memory_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte a ), instance_mem_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.status, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb IS NOT NULL AND m.status NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(status_name) OVER (ORDER BY status_sort, status_name) = status_name THEN NULL ELSE status_name END AS status, avg_memory_mb, memory_mb_variance, memory_mb_stddev FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(status) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE status END AS status_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(status) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE status END AS status_name, AVG(avg_memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, AVG(memory_mb_variance) AS memory_mb_variance, AVG(memory_mb_stddev) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY status WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY status_sort, status_name ) SELECT mbs.status, mbs.total_memory_processed, mbs.benchmark, mbs.memory_category, ims.avg_memory_mb, ims.memory_mb_variance, ims.memory_mb_stddev FROM mem_by_status mbs JOIN instance_mem_stats ims ON ims.status = mbs.status;

question: List (1) the instances on host blaze8-12 whose system metadata key is image_image_type and whose 2-preceding-to-2-following windowed average of MEMORY_MB (partitioned by metadata value and ordered by instance created-at) is greater than the overall average of that windowed average, and (2) the per-display-name memory spread statistics (range, variance, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), plus the overall average range) for non-deleted instances whose display name matches prime, returning a combined result set with a “reason” indicating which rule each row came from. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'" "Display 'prime'" is predicated by "instances.display_name REGEXP 'prime'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY ism.VALUE ORDER BY i.CREATED_AT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ORDER BY i.CREATED_AT), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT instance_uuid AS entity_id, instance_display_name AS entity_name, metadata_key AS detail_key, metadata_value AS detail_value, network_info AS detail_blob, window_column AS metric_1, NULL AS metric_2, NULL AS metric_3, NULL AS metric_4, 'Image-type metadata rows with above-average windowed memory on host blaze8-12' AS reason FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > (SELECT AVG(window_column) FROM inner_cte) UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS entity_id, inner_cte2.display_name AS entity_name, NULL AS detail_key, NULL AS detail_value, NULL AS detail_blob, inner_cte2.memory_mb_range AS metric_1, inner_cte2.memory_mb_variance AS metric_2, inner_cte2.memory_mb_stddev AS metric_3, avg_ranges.avg_memory_mb_range AS metric_4, 'Prime display names (not deleted) with memory spread stats' AS reason FROM inner_cte2 JOIN ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb_range) AS avg_memory_mb_range FROM inner_cte2 ) AS avg_ranges ) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY reason, metric_1 DESC, entity_name, entity_id;

question: For migrations with status = 'completed' where the instance is hosted on 'blaze8-12', and for those instances whose display name also appears among instances on host 'prime-35' that have system metadata key = 'image_image_type', list each matching instance UUID and instance display name along with (1) the maximum per-instance running average migration id (over migration id order) and (2) the total instances, variance of memory_mb, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of memory_mb for that display name; order the results by the maximum running average migration id descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'" Host "prime-35" is predicated by "instances.host = 'prime-35'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.INSTANCE_UUID, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, AVG(m.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY m.INSTANCE_UUID ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ORDER BY m.ID), inner_cte_2 AS ( SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'prime-35' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT q1.INSTANCE_UUID, q1.instance_display_name, q1.max_running_avg_migration_id, q2.total_instances, q2.memory_mb_variance, q2.memory_mb_stddev FROM (SELECT inner_cte.INSTANCE_UUID, inner_cte.instance_display_name, MAX(inner_cte.window_column) AS max_running_avg_migration_id FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.INSTANCE_UUID, inner_cte.instance_display_name ORDER BY max_running_avg_migration_id DESC) AS q1 JOIN (SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(display_name) OVER (ORDER BY display_name_sort, display_name) = display_name THEN NULL ELSE display_name END AS display_name, total_instances, memory_mb_variance, memory_mb_stddev FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE display_name END AS display_name_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE display_name END AS display_name, COUNT(*) AS total_instances, AVG(memory_mb_variance) AS memory_mb_variance, AVG(memory_mb_stddev) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte_2 GROUP BY display_name WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY display_name_sort, display_name) AS q2 ON q1.instance_display_name = q2.display_name ORDER BY q1.max_running_avg_migration_id DESC;

question: For instances in availability zone "flare3" whose display name matches the pattern "prime", list the instance display name, the completed-migration memory_total range/variance/standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), the overall average memory_total range benchmark and variability category, and whether the instance also appears among the "flare3" instances with display names matching "flare" whose cached network info length is above that group's average. Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each instance as 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' (at least 50% above the benchmark), 'LOW_VARIABILITY' (at least 50% below the benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_VARIABILITY'.
evidence: "Display 'flare'" is predicated by "instances.display_name REGEXP 'flare'" "Display 'prime'" is predicated by "instances.display_name REGEXP 'prime'"
SQL: WITH FlareNetworkInfoOutliers AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.DISPLAY_NAME, t1.UUID AS instance_uuid, t2.NETWORK_INFO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.DISPLAY_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t1.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND t1.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'flare' ), NetworkInfoAverages AS ( SELECT AVG(LENGTH(inner_cte.NETWORK_INFO) * 1.0) AS avg_network_info_len FROM inner_cte ) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.NETWORK_INFO, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE LENGTH(inner_cte.NETWORK_INFO) > (SELECT avg_network_info_len FROM NetworkInfoAverages) ), PrimeMigrationVariability AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(m.memory_total) - MIN(m.memory_total) AS memory_total_range, VARIANCE(m.memory_total) AS memory_total_variance, STDDEV(m.memory_total) AS memory_total_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_total_range DESC ), AverageRange AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_total_range) AS avg_memory_total_range FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_total_range, ic.memory_total_variance, ic.memory_total_stddev, ar.avg_memory_total_range AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.memory_total_range > ar.avg_memory_total_range * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN ic.memory_total_range < ar.avg_memory_total_range * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIABILITY' END AS variability_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AverageRange ar ), PrimeInstancesInFlare3 AS ( SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name FROM instances i WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' ) SELECT pif.display_name, pmv.memory_total_range, pmv.memory_total_variance, pmv.memory_total_stddev, pmv.benchmark, pmv.variability_category, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT fno.instance_uuid) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS Has_Above_Average_Flare_NetworkInfo_Length FROM PrimeInstancesInFlare3 pif JOIN PrimeMigrationVariability pmv ON pif.display_name = pmv.display_name LEFT JOIN FlareNetworkInfoOutliers fno ON pif.instance_uuid = fno.instance_uuid GROUP BY pif.display_name, pmv.memory_total_range, pmv.memory_total_variance, pmv.memory_total_stddev, pmv.benchmark, pmv.variability_category ORDER BY pmv.memory_total_range DESC;

question: For instance display names that (1) match the pattern 'prime' and have a system metadata entry with KEY = 'image_image_type', and (2) also appear among instances with KEY = 'image_image_type' running on host 'prime-35' with maximum memory greater than 16000 MB, show each display name’s MEMORY_MB range and variance, how far its memory range deviates from the average memory range across all such 'prime' display names, and also report the max memory and launched time from the 'prime-35' host results. question: On host blaze8-12, for each instance display name that has non-empty cached network information, show the display name, the number of such instances, the geometric mean of instance memory (MB), and the range/variance/standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of non-deleted system metadata entries per non-deleted instance; include the TOTAL rows and only keep display names whose geometric-mean memory is greater than 0. evidence: Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
SQL: WITH GeomMeanMemoryByDisplayName AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE iic.network_info <> '[]' AND i.memory_mb > 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(display_name) OVER (ORDER BY display_name_sort, display_name) = display_name THEN NULL ELSE display_name END AS display_name, total_instances, geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.display_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE inner_cte.display_name END AS display_name_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.display_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE inner_cte.display_name END AS display_name, COUNT(*) AS total_instances, AVG(inner_cte.geometric_mean_memory_mb) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY display_name_sort, display_name ), SystemMetaStatsByDisplayName AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(meta_entry_count) - MIN(meta_entry_count) AS meta_count_range, VARIANCE(meta_entry_count) AS meta_count_variance, STDDEV(meta_entry_count) AS meta_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN ( SELECT i2.uuid AS instance_uuid, COUNT(*) AS meta_entry_count FROM instances AS i2 JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i2.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i2.uuid ) AS meta_stats ON meta_stats.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY meta_count_range DESC ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(display_name) OVER (ORDER BY display_name_sort, display_name) = display_name THEN NULL ELSE display_name END AS display_name, total_instances, meta_count_range, meta_count_variance, meta_count_stddev FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.display_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.display_name END AS display_name_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.display_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.display_name END AS display_name, COUNT(DISTINCT i.uuid) AS total_instances, MAX(inner_cte.meta_count_range) AS meta_count_range, MAX(inner_cte.meta_count_variance) AS meta_count_variance, MAX(inner_cte.meta_count_stddev) AS meta_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid LEFT JOIN inner_cte ON inner_cte.display_name = i.display_name WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY display_name_sort, display_name ) SELECT g.display_name, g.total_instances AS instances_with_nonempty_cached_network_info, g.geometric_mean_memory_mb, s.meta_count_range, s.meta_count_variance, s.meta_count_stddev FROM GeomMeanMemoryByDisplayName AS g JOIN SystemMetaStatsByDisplayName AS s ON g.display_name = s.display_name WHERE g.geometric_mean_memory_mb > 0 ORDER BY g.geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC;

SQL: WITH migration_stats_by_vm_state AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, MAX(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) - MIN(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) AS memory_total_range, VARIANCE(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) AS memory_total_variance FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_total_range DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.memory_total_range, inner_cte.memory_total_variance FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.memory_total_range > 10000000000 ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_total_range DESC ), geomean_memory_by_vm_state AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.vm_state, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.vm_state ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC) SELECT inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.geometric_mean_memory_mb, COUNT(DISTINCT i.uuid) AS instance_count FROM inner_cte JOIN instances AS i ON i.vm_state = inner_cte.vm_state JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.geometric_mean_memory_mb ORDER BY inner_cte.geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC ) SELECT ms.VM_STATE, ms.memory_total_range, ms.memory_total_variance, gm.geometric_mean_memory_mb, gm.instance_count FROM migration_stats_by_vm_state AS ms JOIN geomean_memory_by_vm_state AS gm ON gm.vm_state = ms.VM_STATE ORDER BY ms.memory_total_range DESC;

question: List the instance display name for completed migrations where the instance display name matches the regular expression 'prime', returning a combined report that includes (1) each display name’s coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of migration memory remaining (MEMORY_REMAINING) along with the overall average coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and (2) each (display name, status) whose maximum migration total memory (MEMORY_TOTAL) is greater than 0 and also greater than the overall average of these per-(display name, status) maxima; include a “reason” column indicating whether the row comes from the CoV metric or the above-average max total memory metric. = 'blaze8-12') SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(vm_state) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE vm_state END AS vm_state, COUNT(*) AS total_instances, SUM(memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb, SUM(vcpus) AS total_vcpus FROM inner_cte GROUP BY vm_state WITH ROLLUP ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS completed_migrations_for_shelved_instances FROM INSTANCES i JOIN MIGRATIONS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, COUNT(*) AS completed_migrations_for_state, avg_counts.avg_completed_migrations_per_state, inner_cte.completed_migrations_for_shelved_instances FROM INSTANCES i JOIN MIGRATIONS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID JOIN inner_cte ON 1 = 1 JOIN ( SELECT AVG(state_migration_count) AS avg_completed_migrations_per_state FROM ( SELECT i2.VM_STATE, COUNT(*) AS state_migration_count FROM INSTANCES i2 JOIN MIGRATIONS m2 ON i2.UUID = m2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m2.STATUS = 'completed' AND i2.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i2.VM_STATE ) AS sub ) AS avg_counts ON 1 = 1 WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE,
