avg_counts.avg_completed_migrations_per_state, inner_cte.completed_migrations_for_shelved_instances ) SELECT q1.vm_state, q1.total_instances, q1.total_memory_mb, q1.total_vcpus, q2.completed_migrations_for_state, q2.avg_completed_migrations_per_state, q2.completed_migrations_for_shelved_instances, ROUND(q2.completed_migrations_for_state / NULLIF(q1.total_instances, 0), 4) AS completed_migrations_per_instance_ratio FROM q1 LEFT JOIN q2 ON q1.vm_state = q2.vm_state ORDER BY CASE WHEN q1.vm_state = 'GRAND TOTAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, q1.vm_state;

question: For instances with a system metadata entry where KEY = 'image_image_type' that are running on host 'prime-35' and have a maximum memory greater than 16000 MB, list each instance display name (with repeated display names suppressed as in the subtotal output), its maximum memory (MB), and launched time, and also include (when available for that same display name among display names matching the pattern 'prime') the memory range and variance of MEMORY_MB across instances plus how far that memory range deviates from the average memory range across all such 'prime' display names. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "Display 'prime'" is predicated by "instances.display_name REGEXP 'prime'" Host "prime-35" is predicated by "instances.host = 'prime-35'"
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_range_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_variance_mb FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_range_mb DESC), avg_ranges AS (SELECT AVG(memory_range_mb) AS avg_memory_range_mb FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_range_mb, ic.memory_variance_mb, (ic.memory_range_mb - ar.avg_memory_range_mb) AS deviation_from_avg_memory_range_mb FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_ranges ar ORDER BY deviation_from_avg_memory_range_mb DESC ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) AS max_memory_mb, i.launched_at FROM instances i JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'prime-35' GROUP BY i.display_name, i.launched_at HAVING MAX(i.memory_mb) > 16000 ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(display_name) OVER (ORDER BY display_name, launched_at) = display_name THEN NULL ELSE display_name END AS display_name, max_memory_mb, launched_at FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE display_name END AS display_name_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE display_name END AS display_name, MAX(max_memory_mb) AS max_memory_mb, MAX(launched_at) AS launched_at FROM inner_cte GROUP BY display_name WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY display_name_sort, launched_at ) SELECT q2.display_name, q2.max_memory_mb, q2.launched_at, q1.memory_range_mb, q1.memory_variance_mb, q1.deviation_from_avg_memory_range_mb FROM q2 LEFT JOIN q1 ON q2.display_name = q1.display_name WHERE q2.max_memory_mb > 16000 ORDER BY q2.display_name, q2.launched_at;

question: For instance display names matching the regular expression 'prime' that have a system metadata entry with KEY = 'image_image_type', show (for the top 10 display names by system-metadata record count among non-deleted instances) each display name’s metadata record count, its deviation from the average metadata record count across those top 10, and—only when that display name’s average memory exceeds the overall average of per-display-name average memory—the display name’s average memory (MB) and memory standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) (MB). Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "Display 'prime'" is predicated by "instances.display_name REGEXP 'prime'"
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(ism.ID) AS metadata_records FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY metadata_records DESC LIMIT 10 ), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(metadata_records) AS avg_metadata_records FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.metadata_records, (ic.metadata_records - ac.avg_metadata_records) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte ac ORDER BY ic.metadata_records DESC ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC) SELECT display_name, avg_memory_mb, memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_memory_mb > (SELECT AVG(avg_memory_mb) FROM inner_cte) ) SELECT q1.DISPLAY_NAME, q1.metadata_records, q1.deviation_from_avg, q2.avg_memory_mb, q2.memory_mb_stddev FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.DISPLAY_NAME = q2.display_name ORDER BY q1.metadata_records DESC;

question: How many distinct instance display names matching the regular expression 'prime' have (1) an 'image_image_type' system metadata entry and an average memory greater than the overall average of the per-display-name averages, and (2) completed migrations and an average memory greater than 16384 MB? Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "Display 'prime'" is predicated by "instances.display_name REGEXP 'prime'"
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC) SELECT display_name, avg_memory_mb, memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_memory_mb > (SELECT AVG(avg_memory_mb) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.avg_memory_mb > 16384 ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT q1.display_name) AS metadata_prime_display_name_count, COUNT(DISTINCT q2.DISPLAY_NAME) AS completed_migration_prime_display_name_count FROM q1 CROSS JOIN q2;

question: For instance display names matching the pattern 'prime' (and having a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type'), show each display name and migration status (including subtotals per display name and a grand total) along with the variance of instance memory (MB) across migrations, and also show the average and variance of MEMORY_TOTAL across completed migrations plus the overall benchmark average and the resulting memory category (HIGH_MEMORY/LOW_MEMORY/AVERAGE_MEMORY). Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each display name as 'HIGH_MEMORY' (at least 50% above the benchmark), 'LOW_MEMORY' (at least 50% below the benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_MEMORY'.
evidence: "Display 'prime'" is predicated by "instances.display_name REGEXP 'prime'"
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), DisplayNameStatus AS ( SELECT i.display_name, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM migrations m2 WHERE m2.instance_uuid = i.uuid AND m2.deleted = 0 AND m2.status NOT IN ('completed', 'failed', 'error') ) THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END AS migration_status, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance AS memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte JOIN instances i ON i.display_name = inner_cte.display_name ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE display_name END AS display_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(migration_status) = 1 AND GROUPING(display_name) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE migration_status END AS migration_status, AVG(memory_mb_variance) AS memory_mb_variance FROM DisplayNameStatus GROUP BY display_name, migration_status WITH ROLLUP ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(m.memory_total) AS avg_memory_total, VARIANCE(m.memory_total) AS memory_total_variance FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_total_variance DESC), Benchmark AS ( SELECT AVG(avg_memory_total) AS benchmark_avg_memory_total FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.avg_memory_total, ic.memory_total_variance, b.benchmark_avg_memory_total AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.avg_memory_total > b.benchmark_avg_memory_total * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_MEMORY' WHEN ic.avg_memory_total < b.benchmark_avg_memory_total * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_MEMORY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_MEMORY' END AS memory_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN Benchmark b ) SELECT q1.display_name, q1.migration_status, q1.memory_mb_variance, q2.avg_memory_total, q2.memory_total_variance, q2.benchmark, q2.memory_category FROM q1 LEFT JOIN q2 ON q1.display_name = q2.display_name ORDER BY CASE WHEN q1.display_name = 'GRAND TOTAL' THEN 2 WHEN q1.migration_status = 'SUBTOTAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, q1.display_name, q1.migration_status;

question: For instances running on host "blaze8-12", for each VM state and display name where the instances have more than 8 VCPUs and the group’s minimum memory is at least 75% of the maximum minimum-memory value across all such groups, return the VM state, display name, number of instances, minimum memory (MB), the minimum-memory-to-max ratio, and the maximum geometric mean instance memory (MB) for that display name computed from instances with non-empty cached network information. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
SQL: WITH GeomMeanByDisplayName AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE iic.network_info <> '[]' AND i.memory_mb > 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, MAX(inner_cte.geometric_mean_memory_mb) AS max_geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name ORDER BY max_geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC), MinMemoryGroups AS (WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(i.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VCPUS > 8 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.instance_count, inner_cte.min_memory_mb, (inner_cte.min_memory_mb * 1.0 / max_vals.max_min_memory_mb) AS min_memory_vs_max_ratio FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT MAX(min_memory_mb) AS max_min_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) AS max_vals ON 1 = 1 WHERE (inner_cte.min_memory_mb * 1.0 / max_vals.max_min_memory_mb) >= 0.75) SELECT mmg.VM_STATE, mmg.DISPLAY_NAME, mmg.instance_count, mmg.min_memory_mb, mmg.min_memory_vs_max_ratio, gmbdn.max_geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM MinMemoryGroups AS mmg JOIN GeomMeanByDisplayName AS gmbdn ON mmg.DISPLAY_NAME = gmbdn.display_name ORDER BY mmg.min_memory_vs_max_ratio DESC, gmbdn.max_geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC, mmg.instance_count DESC;

question: For instances in availability zone "flare3" running on host "blaze8-12", what are the VM-state rollups (VM state, total instances, total memory MB, total vCPUs), and for each matching VM state what is the migration activity category (Active/Inactive/Subtotal) and the average variance of migration memory total for non-deleted instances with non-completed/failed/confirmed/accepted/reverted/error migrations? Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'" "Active migrations" is predicated by "migrations.status NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed')"
SQL: WITH instance_state_rollup AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12') SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(vm_state) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE vm_state END AS vm_state, COUNT(*) AS total_instances, SUM(memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb, SUM(vcpus) AS total_vcpus FROM inner_cte GROUP BY vm_state WITH ROLLUP ), vmstate_migration_activity_rollup AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, VARIANCE(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) AS memory_total_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND m.STATUS NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_total_variance DESC ), VmStateMigrationActivity AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM MIGRATIONS m2 WHERE m2.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID AND m2.STATUS NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') ) THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END AS migration_activity, AVG(inner_cte.memory_total_variance) AS avg_memory_total_variance FROM INSTANCES i JOIN inner_cte ON inner_cte.VM_STATE = i.VM_STATE WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, migration_activity ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(VM_STATE) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE VM_STATE END AS VM_STATE, CASE WHEN GROUPING(migration_activity) = 1 AND GROUPING(VM_STATE) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE migration_activity END AS migration_activity, AVG(avg_memory_total_variance) AS avg_memory_total_variance FROM VmStateMigrationActivity GROUP BY VM_STATE, migration_activity WITH ROLLUP ) SELECT isr.vm_state, isr.total_instances, isr.total_memory_mb, isr.total_vcpus, vmar.migration_activity, vmar.avg_memory_total_variance FROM instance_state_rollup AS isr LEFT JOIN vmstate_migration_activity_rollup AS vmar ON vmar.VM_STATE = isr.vm_state ORDER BY isr.vm_state, vmar.migration_activity;

question: From the top 10 instance display names with the largest instance-memory range (in MB) among instances in availability zone 'flare3' whose display name matches the regular expression 'prime', show each display name’s memory range, variance, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), total vCPUs, and total memory, and also include (for the same display names) the average, variance, and maximum instance memory (in MB) computed only from instances that have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type' and where the average memory is greater than 75% of the maximum memory for that display name. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "Display 'prime'" is predicated by "instances.display_name REGEXP 'prime'"
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, mx.max_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) AS max_memory_mb FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ) mx ON mx.display_name = inner_cte.display_name WHERE (inner_cte.avg_memory_mb * 1.0 / mx.max_memory_mb) > 0.75 ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb_variance DESC ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_mb_range, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN instances AS i ON i.display_name = inner_cte.display_name JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_mb_range, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb_range DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT q2.display_name, q2.memory_mb_range, q2.memory_mb_variance AS az_flare3_memory_mb_variance, q2.memory_mb_stddev, q2.total_vcpus, q2.total_memory_mb, q1.avg_memory_mb AS image_meta_avg_memory_mb, q1.memory_mb_variance AS image_meta_memory_mb_variance, q1.max_memory_mb AS image_meta_max_memory_mb FROM q2 JOIN q1 ON q1.display_name = q2.display_name ORDER BY q2.memory_mb_range DESC;

question: For each instance display name, show the total root disk size (in GB) across instances that have system metadata with the key 'image_image_type' (only keeping display names where this total exceeds 50 GB), along with the overall average of these per-display-name totals and the deviation of each display name’s total from that average. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, SUM(i.ROOT_GB) AS total_root_gb FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME HAVING SUM(i.ROOT_GB) > 50 ), avg_totals AS ( SELECT AVG(total_root_gb) AS avg_total_root_gb FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.total_root_gb, at.avg_total_root_gb, (ic.total_root_gb - at.avg_total_root_gb) AS deviation_from_avg_total_root_gb FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_totals at;

question: For instances in availability zone "flare3", find each system metadata key and the maximum vCPUs among instances that have that key, using the per-instance metadata listing (with row numbers per key ordered by instance UUID) as an inner CTE. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3') SELECT metadata_key, MAX(vcpus) AS max_vcpus_for_key FROM inner_cte GROUP BY metadata_key;

question: For each security group name whose total number of ports covered across its TCP rules is greater than 100, list the security group name and total ports covered, but only include those security groups whose total ports covered is greater than the average total ports covered across all such security groups. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sg.NAME AS security_group_name, SUM(sgr.TO_PORT - sgr.FROM_PORT + 1) AS total_ports_covered FROM SECURITY_GROUPS sg JOIN SECURITY_GROUP_RULES sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sgr.PROTOCOL = 'tcp' GROUP BY sg.NAME HAVING SUM(sgr.TO_PORT - sgr.FROM_PORT + 1) > 100 ) SELECT security_group_name, total_ports_covered FROM inner_cte WHERE total_ports_covered > (SELECT AVG(total_ports_covered) FROM inner_cte);

question: For instances whose total memory (summed across their records) is greater than the overall average memory plus one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), list the instance UUID, the total memory (in MB), and the instance hostname. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.uuid, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.uuid HAVING SUM(i.memory_mb) > ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb) + STDDEV(memory_mb) FROM instances ) ) SELECT inner_cte.uuid, inner_cte.total_memory_mb, i.hostname FROM inner_cte JOIN instances AS i ON i.uuid = inner_cte.uuid;

question: For each instance VM state and display name (considering only instances that have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type'), return the number of instances and the minimum memory (in MB), along with the deviation of that minimum memory from the overall average of these per-(VM state, display name) minimum memories. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(i.ID) AS instance_count, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(min_memory_mb) AS avg_min_memory_mb FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.VM_STATE, ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.instance_count, ic.min_memory_mb, (ic.min_memory_mb - ac.avg_min_memory_mb) AS deviation_from_avg_min_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte ac;

question: For each instance display name and system-metadata key, show the maximum memory (in MB) among instances that were created in 2014 and have a maximum memory greater than 16000; also include the overall average of these per-(display name, key) maximums as a benchmark and label each group as 'ABOVE_BENCHMARK' if its maximum is at least 20% higher than the benchmark, 'BELOW_BENCHMARK' if it is at least 20% lower, or 'NEAR_BENCHMARK' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, ism.key, MAX(i.memory_mb) AS max_memory_mb FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.created_at) = 2014 GROUP BY i.display_name, ism.key HAVING MAX(i.memory_mb) > 16000 ), Benchmark AS ( SELECT AVG(max_memory_mb) AS avg_of_group_max_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.key, ic.max_memory_mb, b.avg_of_group_max_memory_mb AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.max_memory_mb >= b.avg_of_group_max_memory_mb * 1.2 THEN 'ABOVE_BENCHMARK' WHEN ic.max_memory_mb <= b.avg_of_group_max_memory_mb * 0.8 THEN 'BELOW_BENCHMARK' ELSE 'NEAR_BENCHMARK' END AS benchmark_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN Benchmark b;

question: For each VM state, show the VM state, the average/range/variance of instance memory (in MB) for instances that have a non-empty PCI requests value recorded in the instance extra table, along with the overall average of the per-VM-state average memory across all VM states. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) - MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ie.PCI_REQUESTS <> '[]' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb, inner_cte.memory_mb_range, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, overall_avg.avg_of_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(avg_memory_mb) AS avg_of_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) AS overall_avg;

question: For security group rules whose parent security group has the name "aurum-xenon", list the rule protocol and a rule activity status ("Active" if the rule is not deleted and "Inactive" otherwise), along with the number of rules in each category. Include subtotals for each protocol and a grand total. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sg.NAME AS security_group_name, sgr.PROTOCOL AS rule_protocol, sgr.CIDR AS rule_cidr, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY sgr.CIDR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM SECURITY_GROUPS AS sg JOIN SECURITY_GROUP_RULES AS sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sg.NAME = 'aurum-xenon'), RuleStatusCounts AS ( SELECT ic.rule_protocol, CASE WHEN sgr2.DELETED = 0 THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END AS rule_status, COUNT(*) AS total_rules FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SECURITY_GROUP_RULES AS sgr2 ON sgr2.CIDR = ic.rule_cidr AND sgr2.PROTOCOL = ic.rule_protocol GROUP BY ic.rule_protocol, rule_status ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(rule_protocol) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE rule_protocol END AS rule_protocol, CASE WHEN GROUPING(rule_status) = 1 AND GROUPING(rule_protocol) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE rule_status END AS rule_status, SUM(total_rules) AS total_rules FROM RuleStatusCounts GROUP BY rule_protocol, rule_status WITH ROLLUP;

question: For instances that are in the “shelved_offloaded” VM state and have a migration with status “completed”, what are the minimum instance memory (in MB) and the total migration memory remaining, and only return the result if the total migration memory remaining is greater than the average migration memory remaining across those same instances? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_instance_memory_mb, SUM(m.MEMORY_REMAINING) AS total_migration_memory_remaining FROM INSTANCES i JOIN MIGRATIONS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' AND m.STATUS = 'completed') SELECT min_instance_memory_mb, total_migration_memory_remaining FROM inner_cte WHERE total_migration_memory_remaining > (SELECT AVG(m2.MEMORY_REMAINING) FROM INSTANCES i2 JOIN MIGRATIONS m2 ON i2.UUID = m2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i2.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' AND m2.STATUS = 'completed');

question: For each instance display name, show the cache-count range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of network-info cache records per instance (only for instances that are not deleted), include the overall average cache-count range across all display names as a benchmark, and categorize each display name as 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' (at least 50% above the benchmark), 'LOW_VARIABILITY' (at least 50% below the benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_VARIABILITY'. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MAX(cache_row_count) - MIN(cache_row_count) AS cache_count_range, VARIANCE(cache_row_count) AS cache_count_variance, STDDEV(cache_row_count) AS cache_count_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN ( SELECT iic.INSTANCE_UUID, COUNT(*) AS cache_row_count FROM INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic GROUP BY iic.INSTANCE_UUID, iic.ID ) AS cache_stats ON cache_stats.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY cache_count_range DESC), AverageRange AS (SELECT AVG(cache_count_range) AS avg_cache_count_range FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.cache_count_range, ic.cache_count_variance, ic.cache_count_stddev, ar.avg_cache_count_range AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.cache_count_range > ar.avg_cache_count_range * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN ic.cache_count_range < ar.avg_cache_count_range * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIABILITY' END AS variability_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AverageRange ar;

question: For each migration status and instance VM state (only including migrations where the instance has at least 8 vCPUs), return the number of migrations and the earliest migration creation time, but only for groups where the earliest migration creation time is after 2015-01-01. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.STATUS AS migration_status, ins.VM_STATE AS instance_vm_state, COUNT(m.ID) AS migration_count, MIN(m.CREATED_AT) AS earliest_migration_created_at FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES ins ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA ie ON ins.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ins.VCPUS >= 8 GROUP BY m.STATUS, ins.VM_STATE ) SELECT inner_cte.migration_status, inner_cte.instance_vm_state, inner_cte.migration_count, inner_cte.earliest_migration_created_at FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.earliest_migration_created_at > '2015-01-01T00:00:00';

question: For completed migrations, list the migration id, status, source compute, destination compute, instance UUID, instance display name, instance memory in MB, instance extra record id, and the minimum instance memory (in MB) over a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by migration id, but only include rows where the instance memory is greater than the average instance memory across all completed migrations. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.INSTANCE_UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( ORDER BY m.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed') SELECT inner_cte.migration_id, inner_cte.migration_status, inner_cte.SOURCE_COMPUTE, inner_cte.DEST_COMPUTE, inner_cte.INSTANCE_UUID, inner_cte.instance_display_name, inner_cte.instance_memory_mb, inner_cte.instance_extra_id, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.instance_memory_mb > ( SELECT AVG(inner_cte.instance_memory_mb * 1.0) FROM inner_cte );

question: For each instance VM state, return the VM state, the geometric mean of the instance memory (in MB) for instances that have a completed migration, and the deviation of that geometric mean from the overall geometric mean across all VM states. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.vm_state, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.memory_mb > 0 GROUP BY i.vm_state ORDER BY geometric_mean DESC ), overall_cte AS ( SELECT EXP(AVG(LN(geometric_mean))) AS overall_geometric_mean FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.vm_state, ic.geometric_mean, (ic.geometric_mean - oc.overall_geometric_mean) AS deviation_from_overall_geometric_mean FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN overall_cte oc ORDER BY ic.geometric_mean DESC;

question: For each instance display name, list the average and variance of the total memory to be migrated (MEMORY_TOTAL) across its completed migrations, along with the instance’s average configured memory (MEMORY_MB). Do not repeat the display name if it is the same as the previous row, and include a grand total row across all instances. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, AVG(m.memory_total) AS avg_memory_total, VARIANCE(m.memory_total) AS memory_total_variance FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_total_variance DESC ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(display_name) OVER (ORDER BY display_name_sort, display_name) = display_name THEN NULL ELSE display_name END AS display_name, avg_memory_total, memory_total_variance, avg_instance_memory_mb FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.display_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE inner_cte.display_name END AS display_name_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.display_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE inner_cte.display_name END AS display_name, inner_cte.avg_memory_total, inner_cte.memory_total_variance, AVG(i2.memory_mb) AS avg_instance_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN instances AS i2 ON i2.display_name = inner_cte.display_name AND i2.deleted = 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.avg_memory_total, inner_cte.memory_total_variance WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY display_name_sort, display_name;

question: For migrations with status = 'completed', show the migration status, source compute, destination compute, the instance display name, and the instance flavor JSON. Then, for each migration status, include the total number of completed migrations and the number of distinct instances involved, along with a dense rank partitioned by the migration status and ordered by the migration status. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, i.display_name, ie.flavor, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.status ORDER BY m.status) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' ), status_summary AS ( SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS total_completed_migrations, COUNT(DISTINCT display_name) AS distinct_instances_involved FROM inner_cte GROUP BY status ) SELECT i.status, i.source_compute, i.dest_compute, i.display_name, i.flavor, i.window_column, s.total_completed_migrations, s.distinct_instances_involved FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN status_summary AS s ON i.status = s.status;

question: From the top 10 instance display names with the highest geometric mean of instance memory (in MB) across instances that have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type' and where the memory is greater than 0, display each display name, the geometric mean memory, and the number of distinct instances contributing to that display name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.geometric_mean_memory_mb, COUNT(DISTINCT i.uuid) AS contributing_instance_count FROM inner_cte JOIN instances AS i ON i.display_name = inner_cte.display_name JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.geometric_mean_memory_mb ORDER BY inner_cte.geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each quota resource type, list the resource name along with the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of reservation delta values, and only include resources where the average reservation delta is greater than 10% of the quota’s in-use amount. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT qu.RESOURCE AS resource, AVG(r.DELTA) AS avg_reservation_delta, STDDEV(r.DELTA) AS reservation_delta_stddev FROM QUOTA_USAGES AS qu JOIN RESERVATIONS AS r ON qu.ID = r.USAGE_ID WHERE qu.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY qu.RESOURCE ORDER BY reservation_delta_stddev DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.resource, inner_cte.avg_reservation_delta, inner_cte.reservation_delta_stddev, AVG(qu.IN_USE) AS avg_in_use FROM inner_cte JOIN QUOTA_USAGES AS qu ON qu.RESOURCE = inner_cte.resource AND qu.DELETED = 0 WHERE inner_cte.avg_reservation_delta > 0.10 * qu.IN_USE GROUP BY inner_cte.resource, inner_cte.avg_reservation_delta, inner_cte.reservation_delta_stddev ORDER BY inner_cte.avg_reservation_delta DESC;

question: For each VM state and display name among instances in the availability zone “flare3”, list the VM state, display name, the number of distinct instances, the total number of matching INSTANCE_EXTRA records, and the total memory (in MB) summed across those matching records. Include subtotals for each VM state and a grand total. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.vm_state, COUNT(ie.id) AS extra_record_count, SUM(ie.id) AS extra_id_sum FROM instances i JOIN instance_extra ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.vm_state ), StateNameAgg AS ( SELECT vm_state, display_name, COUNT(DISTINCT instance_uuid) AS total_instances, SUM(extra_record_count) AS total_extra_records, SUM(extra_id_sum) AS total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte GROUP BY vm_state, display_name ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(vm_state) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE vm_state END AS vm_state, CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(vm_state) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE display_name END AS display_name, SUM(total_instances) AS total_instances, SUM(total_extra_records) AS total_extra_records, SUM(total_memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM StateNameAgg GROUP BY vm_state, display_name WITH ROLLUP;

question: For each instance display name, list the display name, average memory remaining (in bytes), and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of memory remaining (in bytes) across its completed migrations. Do not repeat the display name if it is the same as the previous row. Include a final grand total row across all instances. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, AVG(m.memory_remaining) AS avg_memory_remaining_bytes, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) AS memory_remaining_stddev_bytes FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_remaining_stddev_bytes DESC ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(display_name) OVER (ORDER BY display_name) = display_name THEN NULL ELSE display_name END AS display_name, avg_memory_remaining_bytes, memory_remaining_stddev_bytes FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE display_name END AS display_name_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE display_name END AS display_name, AVG(avg_memory_remaining_bytes) AS avg_memory_remaining_bytes, AVG(memory_remaining_stddev_bytes) AS memory_remaining_stddev_bytes FROM inner_cte GROUP BY display_name WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY display_name_sort, display_name;

question: From the top 10 VM states (among non-deleted instances) with the highest variance in migration memory total, show the VM state, the memory total variance, the number of distinct instances involved in migrations, and whether any of those migrations are currently active (not completed/failed/error and not deleted). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, VARIANCE(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) AS memory_total_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_total_variance DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.memory_total_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT i.uuid) AS migrated_instance_count, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM migrations m2 JOIN instances i2 ON m2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid WHERE i2.deleted = 0 AND i2.vm_state = inner_cte.vm_state AND m2.deleted = 0 AND m2.status NOT IN ('completed', 'failed', 'error') ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_active_migrations FROM inner_cte JOIN instances i ON i.vm_state = inner_cte.vm_state AND i.deleted = 0 JOIN migrations m ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid GROUP BY inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.memory_total_variance ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_total_variance DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each instance whose total migration memory processed is more than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the overall mean MEMORY_PROCESSED across all migrations, list the instance UUID, the instance display name, and the total amount of migration memory processed across its migrations. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, SUM(m.memory_processed) AS total_memory_processed FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.uuid HAVING SUM(m.memory_processed) > ( SELECT AVG(memory_processed) + STDDEV(memory_processed) FROM migrations ) ) SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, i.display_name, inner_cte.total_memory_processed FROM inner_cte JOIN instances AS i ON i.uuid = inner_cte.instance_uuid;

question: For each security group and rule protocol, list the security group name, description, project ID, the rule protocol, and the number of non-deleted rules. Also include subtotals per security group and a grand total, considering only non-deleted groups and rules. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sg.NAME, sg.DESCRIPTION, sg.PROJECT_ID, sgr.PROTOCOL, sgr.FROM_PORT, sgr.TO_PORT, sgr.CIDR, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sg.ID ORDER BY sgr.ID) AS window_column FROM SECURITY_GROUPS sg JOIN SECURITY_GROUP_RULES sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sg.DELETED = 0 AND sgr.DELETED = 0), RuleCounts AS ( SELECT NAME, DESCRIPTION, PROJECT_ID, PROTOCOL, COUNT(*) AS total_rules FROM inner_cte GROUP BY NAME, DESCRIPTION, PROJECT_ID, PROTOCOL ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(NAME) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE NAME END AS security_group_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(DESCRIPTION) = 1 AND GROUPING(NAME) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE DESCRIPTION END AS security_group_description, CASE WHEN GROUPING(PROJECT_ID) = 1 AND GROUPING(NAME) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE PROJECT_ID END AS project_id, CASE WHEN GROUPING(PROTOCOL) = 1 AND GROUPING(NAME) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE PROTOCOL END AS protocol, SUM(total_rules) AS total_rules FROM RuleCounts GROUP BY NAME, DESCRIPTION, PROJECT_ID, PROTOCOL WITH ROLLUP;

question: For instances in availability zone “flare3”, list the instance UUID, display name, VM state, memory in MB, and cached network_info JSON (including the 2-preceding/2-following windowed average of memory_mb partitioned by VM state and ordered by memory_mb), but only return those rows where the instance’s memory_mb is greater than the overall average memory_mb of all instances returned by that same flare3 query. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, c.network_info, AVG(i.memory_mb) OVER ( PARTITION BY i.vm_state ORDER BY i.memory_mb ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' ORDER BY i.memory_mb ) SELECT inner_cte.uuid, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.network_info, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.memory_mb > (SELECT AVG(memory_mb) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb;

question: From the top 10 (display name, launched-at timestamp) groups with the highest maximum memory among instances launched in 2014 (only keeping groups where that maximum exceeds 16000 MB), show the display name, launched-at timestamp, the group’s maximum memory, and whether any instance in that group has a non-empty NUMA topology recorded in INSTANCE_EXTRA. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) AS max_memory_mb, i.LAUNCHED_AT FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.LAUNCHED_AT) = 2014 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.LAUNCHED_AT HAVING MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) > 16000 ) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.LAUNCHED_AT, inner_cte.max_memory_mb, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM INSTANCES i2 JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA ie2 ON ie2.INSTANCE_UUID = i2.UUID WHERE i2.DISPLAY_NAME = inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME AND i2.LAUNCHED_AT = inner_cte.LAUNCHED_AT AND ie2.NUMA_TOPOLOGY IS NOT NULL AND ie2.NUMA_TOPOLOGY <> '' ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_numa_topology FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.max_memory_mb DESC LIMIT 10;

question: From the top 10 projects with the highest total instance memory among completed migrations, show each project’s ID and total migrated memory (MB), and indicate whether the project has any active (non-completed/non-failed/non-error) migrations. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, c.NETWORK_INFO, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (ORDER BY m.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' ) SELECT inner_cte.project_id AS project_id, SUM(inner_cte.instance_memory_mb) AS total_migrated_memory_mb, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM migrations m2 JOIN instances i2 ON m2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid WHERE i2.project_id = inner_cte.project_id AND m2.deleted = 0 AND m2.status NOT IN ('completed', 'failed', 'error') ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_active_migrations FROM ( SELECT i.project_id AS project_id, inner_cte.instance_memory_mb AS instance_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN instances i ON i.display_name = inner_cte.instance_display_name ) AS inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.project_id ORDER BY total_migrated_memory_mb DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each instance display name, calculate the range and variance of the instance memory size (in MB) for instances that are not deleted, and only return display names whose average memory size is greater than 16384 MB. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_range_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_variance_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_range_mb DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_range_mb, inner_cte.memory_variance_mb, AVG(i2.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN instances AS i2 ON i2.display_name = inner_cte.display_name JOIN instance_extra AS ie2 ON i2.uuid = ie2.instance_uuid WHERE i2.deleted = 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_range_mb, inner_cte.memory_variance_mb HAVING AVG(i2.memory_mb) > 16384 ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_range_mb DESC;

question: For each instance display name and launch time, show the maximum memory (in MB) among its instances, but only for instances that have a system metadata entry with KEY = 'image_image_type' and where the maximum memory is greater than 16000 MB. Also include a rollup that provides subtotals per display name and a grand total. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) AS max_memory_mb, i.launched_at FROM instances i JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name, i.launched_at HAVING MAX(i.memory_mb) > 16000 ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE display_name END AS display_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(launched_at) = 1 AND GROUPING(display_name) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE CAST(launched_at AS CHAR) END AS launched_at, MAX(max_memory_mb) AS max_memory_mb FROM inner_cte GROUP BY display_name, launched_at WITH ROLLUP;

question: From the VM states in availability zone 'flare3' whose total memory across instances exceeds 50000 MB, display each VM state, the total memory (MB), and the number of distinct instances contributing to that total. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) AS total_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE HAVING SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) > 50000 ) SELECT inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.total_memory_mb, COUNT(DISTINCT i.UUID) AS instance_count FROM inner_cte JOIN INSTANCES i ON i.VM_STATE = inner_cte.VM_STATE AND i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID GROUP BY inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.total_memory_mb ORDER BY inner_cte.total_memory_mb DESC;

question: For each instance VM state, show the minimum migration ID and the average instance memory (in MB) for migrations whose status is 'completed' and whose instance info cache record is not deleted (DELETED = 0), along with the overall average of these per-VM-state average memories across all VM states. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(m.ID) AS min_migration_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_instance_memory_mb FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND c.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ) SELECT inner_cte.min_migration_id, inner_cte.avg_instance_memory_mb, overall_avg.overall_avg_instance_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(avg_instance_memory_mb) AS overall_avg_instance_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) AS overall_avg;

question: For each instance display name, show the minimum instance ID and the average memory (in MB) among instances that are not deleted and have system metadata with the key 'image_image_type', and then report the maximum of those average-memory values across all display names. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(i.ID) AS min_instance_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ) SELECT MAX(avg_memory_mb) AS max_avg_memory_mb_across_display_names FROM inner_cte;

question: For each availability zone, list the availability zone name, the total number of instances that are in the VM state "shelved_offloaded", and the average number of such instances across all availability zones. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.ID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, c.NETWORK_INFO, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE ORDER BY i.ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' ) SELECT inner_cte.AVAILABILITY_ZONE AS availability_zone, COUNT(inner_cte.ID) AS total_shelved_offloaded_instances, avg_az.avg_instance_count AS avg_shelved_offloaded_instances_per_az FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(instance_count) AS avg_instance_count FROM ( SELECT COUNT(ID) AS instance_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY AVAILABILITY_ZONE ) AS sub ) AS avg_az GROUP BY inner_cte.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, avg_az.avg_instance_count;

question: For each security group name, among only 'tcp' rules, list the security group name, the variance of the starting port (FROM_PORT), and the total number of tcp rules, keeping only security groups whose tcp rule count is greater than the average tcp rule count across all security groups. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sg.NAME AS security_group_name, VARIANCE(sgr.FROM_PORT) AS from_port_variance FROM SECURITY_GROUPS AS sg JOIN SECURITY_GROUP_RULES AS sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sgr.PROTOCOL = 'tcp' GROUP BY sg.NAME ORDER BY from_port_variance DESC ), tcp_rule_counts AS ( SELECT sg.NAME AS security_group_name, COUNT(*) AS tcp_rule_count FROM SECURITY_GROUPS AS sg JOIN SECURITY_GROUP_RULES AS sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sgr.PROTOCOL = 'tcp' GROUP BY sg.NAME ), avg_tcp_rule_count AS ( SELECT AVG(tcp_rule_count * 1.0) AS avg_tcp_rule_count FROM tcp_rule_counts ) SELECT i.security_group_name, i.from_port_variance, trc.tcp_rule_count FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN tcp_rule_counts AS trc ON i.security_group_name = trc.security_group_name CROSS JOIN avg_tcp_rule_count AS a WHERE trc.tcp_rule_count > a.avg_tcp_rule_count ORDER BY i.from_port_variance DESC;

question: For instances whose display name is "forge", show the instance ID, UUID, user ID, project ID, hostname, VM state, power state, memory (MB), vCPUs, availability zone, the related instance-info-cache record ID and network info, and the minimum memory (MB) within each project (partitioned and ordered by project ID), along with the total number of "forge" instances per project and the average of those per-project "forge" instance counts across all projects. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.ID AS instance_id, i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.USER_ID, i.PROJECT_ID, i.HOSTNAME, i.VM_STATE, i.POWER_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, c.ID AS info_cache_id, c.NETWORK_INFO, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.PROJECT_ID ORDER BY i.PROJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' ) SELECT inner_cte.instance_id, inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.user_id, inner_cte.project_id, inner_cte.hostname, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.power_state, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.vcpus, inner_cte.availability_zone, inner_cte.info_cache_id, inner_cte.network_info, inner_cte.window_column AS min_memory_mb_in_project, COUNT(inner_cte.instance_id) OVER (PARTITION BY inner_cte.project_id) AS total_forge_instances_in_project, avg_counts.avg_forge_instances_per_project FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(forge_instance_count) AS avg_forge_instances_per_project FROM ( SELECT project_id, COUNT(*) AS forge_instance_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY project_id ) AS per_project_counts ) AS avg_counts ON 1 = 1;

question: For confirmed migrations where the source compute is ether-60, list the migration ID, migration status, source compute, destination compute, destination host, the instance UUID, the instance display name, the instance VM state, and the cached network info (with row numbers within each migration status group ordered by migration ID), along with the total number of such migrations and the average number of such migrations per destination compute across all destination computes. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.VM_STATE AS instance_vm_state, c.NETWORK_INFO AS cached_network_info, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'confirmed' AND m.SOURCE_COMPUTE = 'ether-60' ) SELECT inner_cte.migration_id, inner_cte.migration_status, inner_cte.SOURCE_COMPUTE, inner_cte.DEST_COMPUTE, inner_cte.DEST_HOST, inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.instance_display_name, inner_cte.instance_vm_state, inner_cte.cached_network_info, inner_cte.window_column, COUNT(inner_cte.migration_id) OVER () AS total_confirmed_ether60_migrations, avg_by_dest.avg_migrations_per_dest_compute FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(migrations_per_dest) AS avg_migrations_per_dest_compute FROM ( SELECT DEST_COMPUTE, COUNT(*) AS migrations_per_dest FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEST_COMPUTE ) AS per_dest ) AS avg_by_dest ON 1 = 1 ORDER BY inner_cte.migration_id;

question: Using the per-(instance display name, metadata key) maximum-memory results for non-deleted instances (keeping only those with max memory greater than 16000 MB), list each metadata key and a memory tier label ('Very Large' if the max memory is at least 32768 MB, otherwise 'Large'), along with the number of such (display name, key, launched timestamp) groups. Include subtotals per metadata key and a grand total. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) AS max_memory_mb, i.LAUNCHED_AT FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism JOIN INSTANCES i ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME, ism.KEY, i.LAUNCHED_AT HAVING MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) > 16000 ), MemoryTierCounts AS ( SELECT inner_cte.metadata_key, CASE WHEN inner_cte.max_memory_mb >= 32768 THEN 'Very Large' ELSE 'Large' END AS memory_tier, COUNT(*) AS total_groups FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.metadata_key, memory_tier ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(metadata_key) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE metadata_key END AS metadata_key, CASE WHEN GROUPING(memory_tier) = 1 AND GROUPING(metadata_key) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE memory_tier END AS memory_tier, SUM(total_groups) AS total_groups FROM MemoryTierCounts GROUP BY metadata_key, memory_tier WITH ROLLUP;

question: From the top 10 instance display names with the highest variance in instance memory (in MB) among instances that have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type', show each display name, the average memory, the memory variance, the total vCPUs across those instances, and whether any of those instances have a non-null NUMA topology recorded in instance_extra. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.avg_memory_mb, ic.memory_mb_variance, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM instances i2 JOIN instance_extra ie2 ON ie2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism2 ON ism2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid WHERE i2.display_name = ic.display_name AND ism2.key = 'image_image_type' AND ie2.numa_topology IS NOT NULL AND ie2.numa_topology <> '' ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_numa_topology FROM inner_cte ic JOIN instances i ON i.display_name = ic.display_name JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY ic.display_name, ic.avg_memory_mb, ic.memory_mb_variance ORDER BY ic.memory_mb_variance DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each VM state, list the VM state, an activity label ('Active' if there is at least one not-deleted instance in that VM state and 'Inactive' otherwise), and the number of distinct projects represented by those not-deleted instances. Include subtotals for each VM state and a grand total. Use the not-deleted instance details (display name, VM state, memory in MB, cached network_info JSON, and the dense rank by project_id) as the base dataset. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, c.network_info, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.project_id ORDER BY i.project_id) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 ), VmStateProjectCounts AS ( SELECT ic.vm_state, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM inner_cte ic2 WHERE ic2.vm_state = ic.vm_state ) THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END AS activity_status, COUNT(DISTINCT ic.window_column) AS total_projects FROM inner_cte ic GROUP BY ic.vm_state, activity_status ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(vm_state) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE vm_state END AS vm_state, CASE WHEN GROUPING(activity_status) = 1 AND GROUPING(vm_state) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE activity_status END AS activity_status, SUM(total_projects) AS total_projects FROM VmStateProjectCounts GROUP BY vm_state, activity_status WITH ROLLUP;

question: For each instance display name, show the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the instance memory size (in MB) across instances that have at least one system metadata entry (considering only instances that are not deleted), along with the deviation of that standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) from the overall average standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) across all display names. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC ), avg_stddev AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb_stddev) AS avg_memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_mb_stddev, (ic.memory_mb_stddev - a.avg_memory_mb_stddev) AS deviation_from_avg_stddev FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_stddev a ORDER BY ic.memory_mb_stddev DESC;

question: Among the non-deleted instances that are in the “shelved_offloaded” VM state and also have a non-deleted instance info cache record (matched by instance UUID), show the total count and the total vCPUs and memory (MB) consumed by those instances. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS shelved_offloaded_instances_with_cache FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' AND i.DELETED = 0 AND ic.DELETED = 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.shelved_offloaded_instances_with_cache, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN INSTANCES i ON 1 = 1 JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' AND i.DELETED = 0 AND ic.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.shelved_offloaded_instances_with_cache;

question: For each instance display name, compute the maximum (across display names) of the per-display-name instance memory size (MEMORY_MB) range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), considering only instances that are not deleted. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC ) SELECT MAX(memory_mb_range) AS max_memory_mb_range, MAX(memory_mb_variance) AS max_memory_mb_variance, MAX(memory_mb_stddev) AS max_memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte;

question: For each instance display name, show the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the instance memory (MEMORY_MB) across instances that have a non-deleted system metadata entry with KEY = 'image_image_type', and only include display names where the average MEMORY_MB is greater than 75% of the maximum MEMORY_MB observed for that same display name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND ism.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) AS max_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON i.DISPLAY_NAME = inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND ism.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev HAVING (AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) * 1.0 / MAX(i.MEMORY_MB)) > 0.75 ORDER BY avg_memory_mb DESC;

question: For each instance display name, show the minimum instance ID and average memory (in MB) for instances in availability zone 'flare3' that have system metadata with KEY = 'image_image_type'. Also include the overall average of these per-display-name average memories as a benchmark, and categorize each display name as 'HIGH_MEMORY' (at least 50% above the benchmark), 'LOW_MEMORY' (at least 50% below the benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_MEMORY'. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(i.ID) AS min_instance_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ), AverageMemory AS ( SELECT AVG(avg_memory_mb) AS benchmark_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.min_instance_id, ic.avg_memory_mb, am.benchmark_avg_memory_mb AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.avg_memory_mb > am.benchmark_avg_memory_mb * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_MEMORY' WHEN ic.avg_memory_mb < am.benchmark_avg_memory_mb * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_MEMORY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_MEMORY' END AS memory_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AverageMemory am;

question: For instances whose display name is 'forge', list only those instance UUIDs whose number of system metadata rows is greater than the average system metadata row count across all 'forge' instances; for each returned metadata row, show the instance UUID, the system metadata key and value, and a row number ordered by the metadata key using a window frame of 2 preceding rows and 1 following row. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.UUID, ism.KEY, ism.VALUE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ism.KEY ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' ), ForgeMetaCounts AS ( SELECT i.UUID, COUNT(*) AS meta_row_count FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' GROUP BY i.UUID ) SELECT inner_cte.UUID, inner_cte.KEY, inner_cte.VALUE, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN ForgeMetaCounts fmc ON inner_cte.UUID = fmc.UUID WHERE fmc.meta_row_count > (SELECT AVG(meta_row_count) FROM ForgeMetaCounts);

question: For completed instance migrations involving instances in the 'shelved_offloaded' VM state, list the instance UUID, instance hostname, migration source compute, destination compute, and the percentage of migration memory that has been processed (memory_processed divided by memory_total), keeping only rows where more than 75% of the migration memory has been processed. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS completed_migrations_for_shelved_instances FROM INSTANCES i JOIN MIGRATIONS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' ) SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS instance_hostname, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE AS source_compute, m.DEST_COMPUTE AS dest_compute, (m.MEMORY_PROCESSED * 1.0 / NULLIF(m.MEMORY_TOTAL, 0)) AS memory_processed_ratio, inner_cte.completed_migrations_for_shelved_instances FROM INSTANCES i JOIN MIGRATIONS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID CROSS JOIN inner_cte WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' AND (m.MEMORY_PROCESSED * 1.0 / NULLIF(m.MEMORY_TOTAL, 0)) > 0.75;

question: For each instance VM state and migration status (considering only migrations that are not hidden), return the number of instances involved and the minimum total memory recorded for the migration, along with the overall average of these per-group instance counts as a benchmark and a utilization category: 'HIGH_VOLUME' (at least 50% above the benchmark), 'LOW_VOLUME' (at least 50% below the benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_VOLUME'. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, m.STATUS AS migration_status, COUNT(i.ID) AS instance_count, MIN(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) AS min_memory_total FROM INSTANCES i JOIN MIGRATIONS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.HIDDEN = 0 GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, m.STATUS), AverageInstanceCount AS ( SELECT AVG(instance_count) AS avg_instance_count FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.vm_state, ic.migration_status, ic.instance_count, ic.min_memory_total, aic.avg_instance_count AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.instance_count > aic.avg_instance_count * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VOLUME' WHEN ic.instance_count < aic.avg_instance_count * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VOLUME' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VOLUME' END AS volume_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AverageInstanceCount aic;

question: For each migration status whose average instance memory (MB) is greater than the overall average instance memory (MB) across all non-deleted migrations, show the migration status along with the average, range, and variance of instance memory size in MB. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.status AS migration_status, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.deleted = 0 GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC) SELECT ic.migration_status, ic.avg_memory_mb, ic.memory_mb_range, ic.memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte ic WHERE ic.avg_memory_mb > ( SELECT AVG(i2.memory_mb) * 1.0 FROM migrations AS m2 JOIN instances AS i2 ON m2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie2 ON i2.uuid = ie2.instance_uuid WHERE m2.deleted = 0 ) ORDER BY ic.memory_mb_range DESC;

question: For each quota usage record that has a matching reservation, show the quota usage id, project id, resource, in-use amount, reserved amount, and the reservation UUID, and also compute the maximum reservation delta considering the current row and the next 2 rows when rows are ordered by reservation id. Only include rows where the in-use amount is greater than the average in-use amount for the same resource across all non-deleted quota usage records. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT q.ID AS quota_usage_id, q.PROJECT_ID, q.RESOURCE, q.IN_USE, q.RESERVED, r.UUID AS reservation_uuid, MAX(r.DELTA) OVER (ORDER BY r.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_delta_next_2 FROM QUOTA_USAGES AS q JOIN RESERVATIONS AS r ON q.ID = r.USAGE_ID WHERE q.DELETED = 0 ), ResourceInUseAverages AS ( SELECT q2.RESOURCE, AVG(q2.IN_USE * 1.0) AS avg_in_use FROM QUOTA_USAGES AS q2 WHERE q2.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY q2.RESOURCE ) SELECT i.quota_usage_id, i.PROJECT_ID, i.RESOURCE, i.IN_USE, i.RESERVED, i.reservation_uuid, i.max_delta_next_2 FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN ResourceInUseAverages AS a ON a.RESOURCE = i.RESOURCE WHERE i.IN_USE > ( SELECT a2.avg_in_use FROM ResourceInUseAverages AS a2 WHERE a2.RESOURCE = i.RESOURCE );

question: For non-deleted instances that are in the “shelved_offloaded” VM state, show the instance UUID, display name, power state, system metadata key and value, cached network_info JSON, and the per-key row number (ordered by instance UUID). Also include, for each metadata key, the total number of rows for that key and the average power state across that key, and do not repeat the metadata key if it is the same as the previous row. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(metadata_key) OVER (ORDER BY metadata_key, instance_uuid) = metadata_key THEN NULL ELSE metadata_key END AS metadata_key, instance_uuid, display_name, power_state, metadata_value, network_info, window_column, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY metadata_key) AS total_rows_per_key, AVG(power_state) OVER (PARTITION BY metadata_key) AS avg_power_state_per_key FROM inner_cte ORDER BY metadata_key, instance_uuid;

question: For each instance display name, show the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total memory (MEMORY_TOTAL) across its completed migrations (only for instances with more than 5 related migration records and a non-deleted instance info cache entry), along with the overall average of these per-instance standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP)s across all such instances. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_total) AS memory_total_stddev FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND ic.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY memory_total_stddev DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_total_stddev, avg_stddevs.avg_memory_total_stddev FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(memory_total_stddev) AS avg_memory_total_stddev FROM inner_cte ) AS avg_stddevs ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_total_stddev DESC;

question: Among the top 10 instance display names with the most system metadata entries (counting only non-deleted instances and only metadata rows where the key is 'image_image_type'), what is the maximum number of vCPUs of any instance in each display name group? Return the instance display name, the metadata entry count, and the maximum vCPU count. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(ism.ID) AS metadata_entries FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY metadata_entries DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.metadata_entries, MAX(i2.VCPUS) AS max_vcpus_in_display_name FROM inner_cte JOIN INSTANCES i2 ON i2.DISPLAY_NAME = inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME AND i2.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.metadata_entries ORDER BY inner_cte.metadata_entries DESC;

question: For each security group and tcp-rule CIDR, list the security group ID, name, and description, the CIDR, and the number of tcp rules and total TO_PORT across those rules. Include subtotals per security group and a grand total. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sg.ID AS security_group_id, sg.NAME AS security_group_name, sg.DESCRIPTION AS security_group_description, COUNT(sgr.ID) AS rule_count, SUM(sgr.TO_PORT) AS total_to_port FROM SECURITY_GROUPS sg JOIN SECURITY_GROUP_RULES sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sgr.PROTOCOL = 'tcp' GROUP BY sg.ID, sg.NAME, sg.DESCRIPTION), CidrBreakdown AS ( SELECT sg.ID AS security_group_id, sg.NAME AS security_group_name, sg.DESCRIPTION AS security_group_description, sgr.CIDR AS cidr, COUNT(sgr.ID) AS cidr_rule_count, SUM(sgr.TO_PORT) AS cidr_total_to_port FROM SECURITY_GROUPS sg JOIN SECURITY_GROUP_RULES sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID JOIN inner_cte i ON i.security_group_id = sg.ID WHERE sgr.PROTOCOL = 'tcp' GROUP BY sg.ID, sg.NAME, sg.DESCRIPTION, sgr.CIDR ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(security_group_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE security_group_id END AS security_group_id, CASE WHEN GROUPING(security_group_name) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE security_group_name END AS security_group_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(security_group_description) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE security_group_description END AS security_group_description, CASE WHEN GROUPING(cidr) = 1 AND GROUPING(security_group_id) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(cidr) = 1 AND GROUPING(security_group_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE cidr END AS cidr, SUM(cidr_rule_count) AS rule_count, SUM(cidr_total_to_port) AS total_to_port FROM CidrBreakdown GROUP BY security_group_id, security_group_name, security_group_description, cidr WITH ROLLUP;

question: For each instance that has a completed migration, list the instance display name, availability zone, migration status, migration type, and instance UUID, along with the percent of migration memory processed (memory_processed divided by memory_total) for migrations where the processed share is greater than 75%. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, i.availability_zone, m.status, m.migration_type, i.uuid, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.uuid ORDER BY i.uuid) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.availability_zone, inner_cte.status, inner_cte.migration_type, inner_cte.uuid, inner_cte.window_column, (m.memory_processed * 1.0 / NULLIF(m.memory_total, 0)) AS memory_processed_ratio FROM inner_cte JOIN migrations AS m ON m.instance_uuid = inner_cte.uuid AND m.status = inner_cte.status AND m.migration_type = inner_cte.migration_type WHERE (m.memory_processed * 1.0 / NULLIF(m.memory_total, 0)) > 0.75;

question: From the top 10 system metadata keys (by number of rows) used by instances in availability zone "flare3", show the metadata key, how many rows it has, how many distinct instances it appears on, the total vCPUs and total memory (MB) across those instances, and whether any of those instances have a non-null migration context in their instance extra record. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.FLAVOR AS flavor, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' ) SELECT inner_cte.metadata_key AS metadata_key, COUNT(*) AS metadata_row_count, COUNT(DISTINCT inner_cte.instance_uuid) AS distinct_instance_count, SUM(inner_cte.vcpus) AS total_vcpus, SUM(inner_cte.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie2 WHERE ie2.INSTANCE_UUID IN ( SELECT DISTINCT inner_cte2.instance_uuid FROM inner_cte inner_cte2 WHERE inner_cte2.metadata_key = inner_cte.metadata_key ) AND ie2.MIGRATION_CONTEXT IS NOT NULL ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_any_migration_context FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.metadata_key ORDER BY metadata_row_count DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For instances whose display name is 'forge', list each instance UUID, its flavor JSON, and the dense rank of that instance when ordering by the instance’s memory (in MB) using a window frame of the current row and the 2 preceding rows. Only return those instances whose windowed dense rank is greater than the average windowed dense rank across all 'forge' instances. Do not return any rounded answers.
