SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.uuid, ie.flavor, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY i.memory_mb ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.display_name = 'forge' ) SELECT uuid, flavor, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > (SELECT AVG(window_column) FROM inner_cte);

question: For instances that are in the availability zone 'flare3', what are the minimum instance memory in MB and the total (sum) of vCPUs across those instances (considering only instances that have at least one system metadata entry), and what percentage of the total vCPUs do the instances with that minimum memory represent? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb, SUM(i.VCPUS) AS total_vcpus FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' ) SELECT inner_cte.min_memory_mb, inner_cte.total_vcpus, (SUM(CASE WHEN i.MEMORY_MB = inner_cte.min_memory_mb THEN i.VCPUS ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / inner_cte.total_vcpus) AS pct_vcpus_at_min_memory FROM inner_cte JOIN INSTANCES i ON i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID GROUP BY inner_cte.min_memory_mb, inner_cte.total_vcpus;

question: For confirmed migrations, list the migration status, source compute host, destination compute host, instance display name, and instance network_info, along with the dense rank within each migration status ordered by that status; also include the overall average dense-rank value across these confirmed migrations and the deviation of each row’s dense rank from that average. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, i.display_name, ic.network_info, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.status ORDER BY m.status) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'confirmed'), avg_rank AS ( SELECT AVG(window_column) AS avg_window_column FROM inner_cte ) SELECT c.status, c.source_compute, c.dest_compute, c.display_name, c.network_info, c.window_column, a.avg_window_column, (c.window_column - a.avg_window_column) AS deviation_from_avg_dense_rank FROM inner_cte c CROSS JOIN avg_rank a;

question: For each project and resource among quota usage records that have a positive in-use amount, show the project ID, resource type, and whether the project has any “high reservation” usage (where the total reserved delta across linked reservations exceeds the in-use amount). Also return the number of usage records, total reservations, and total reserved delta. Include subtotals per project and a grand total. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT q.ID AS usage_id, q.PROJECT_ID, q.RESOURCE, COUNT(r.ID) AS reservation_count, SUM(r.DELTA) AS total_reserved_delta FROM QUOTA_USAGES q JOIN RESERVATIONS r ON q.ID = r.USAGE_ID WHERE q.IN_USE > 0 GROUP BY q.ID, q.PROJECT_ID, q.RESOURCE ), ProjectResourceStatus AS ( SELECT i.PROJECT_ID, i.RESOURCE, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM QUOTA_USAGES q2 JOIN inner_cte i2 ON i2.usage_id = q2.ID WHERE q2.IN_USE > 0 AND q2.PROJECT_ID = i.PROJECT_ID AND q2.RESOURCE = i.RESOURCE AND i2.total_reserved_delta > q2.IN_USE ) THEN 'High' ELSE 'Normal' END AS reservation_pressure, COUNT(DISTINCT i.usage_id) AS usage_records, SUM(i.reservation_count) AS total_reservations, SUM(i.total_reserved_delta) AS total_reserved_delta FROM inner_cte i GROUP BY i.PROJECT_ID, i.RESOURCE, reservation_pressure ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(PROJECT_ID) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE PROJECT_ID END AS project_id, CASE WHEN GROUPING(RESOURCE) = 1 AND GROUPING(PROJECT_ID) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE RESOURCE END AS resource, CASE WHEN GROUPING(reservation_pressure) = 1 AND GROUPING(RESOURCE) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(reservation_pressure) = 1 AND GROUPING(RESOURCE) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE reservation_pressure END AS reservation_pressure, SUM(usage_records) AS usage_records, SUM(total_reservations) AS total_reservations, SUM(total_reserved_delta) AS total_reserved_delta FROM ProjectResourceStatus GROUP BY PROJECT_ID, RESOURCE, reservation_pressure WITH ROLLUP;

question: For each of the top 10 instance display names with the most system metadata entries (only for non-deleted instances and only where the system metadata key is 'image_image_type'), show the display name, the metadata entry count, the overall average metadata entry count across these top 10 display names, and the deviation of each display name’s count from that average. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(ism.ID) AS metadata_entries FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY metadata_entries DESC LIMIT 10 ), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(metadata_entries) AS avg_metadata_entries FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.metadata_entries, ac.avg_metadata_entries, (ic.metadata_entries - ac.avg_metadata_entries) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte ac ORDER BY ic.metadata_entries DESC;

question: For each instance display name, show its memory variance (in MB) across migrations for instances that have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type', also report the overall average of these variances as a benchmark, and categorize each instance as 'HIGH_VARIANCE' (at least 50% above the benchmark), 'LOW_VARIANCE' (at least 50% below the benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE'. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb_variance) AS avg_memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_mb_variance, a.avg_memory_mb_variance AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.memory_mb_variance > a.avg_memory_mb_variance * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN ic.memory_mb_variance < a.avg_memory_mb_variance * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte a ORDER BY ic.memory_mb_variance DESC;

question: For migrations that are in the status "completed" and whose related instance is in the "shelved_offloaded" VM state, return the minimum instance memory in MB and the total migration memory processed, but only if the total migration memory processed is greater than the average total migration memory processed across all migration/instance pairs. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_instance_memory_mb, SUM(m.MEMORY_PROCESSED) AS total_migration_memory_processed FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded') SELECT min_instance_memory_mb, total_migration_memory_processed FROM inner_cte WHERE total_migration_memory_processed > (SELECT AVG(m2.MEMORY_PROCESSED) FROM MIGRATIONS m2 JOIN INSTANCES i2 ON m2.INSTANCE_UUID = i2.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES ic2 ON i2.UUID = ic2.INSTANCE_UUID);

question: For each instance VM state, show the VM state, the variance of instance memory (in MB) for instances that have a corresponding network info cache record, the overall average of these variances across all VM states as a benchmark, and categorize each VM state as 'HIGH_VARIANCE' (at least 50% above the benchmark), 'LOW_VARIANCE' (at least 50% below the benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE'. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb_variance) AS avg_memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.VM_STATE, ic.memory_mb_variance, ac.avg_memory_mb_variance AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.memory_mb_variance > ac.avg_memory_mb_variance * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN ic.memory_mb_variance < ac.avg_memory_mb_variance * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte ac;

question: For instances whose memory utilization per vCPU is greater than 2048 MB per vCPU, list the instance UUID, display name, VM state, power state, memory (MB), vCPU count, system metadata key and value, and the maximum INSTANCE_EXTRA row ID over the current row and the next 2 rows when ordered by instance UUID, considering only instances that are not deleted and system metadata rows that are not deleted. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, MAX(ie.ID) OVER ( ORDER BY i.UUID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_instance_extra_id_next_2 FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.DELETED = 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.power_state, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.vcpus, inner_cte.metadata_key, inner_cte.metadata_value, inner_cte.max_instance_extra_id_next_2 FROM inner_cte WHERE (inner_cte.memory_mb * 1.0 / NULLIF(inner_cte.vcpus, 0)) > 2048;

question: For each instance VM state, list the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of instance memory (in MB) for instances that have a matching row in INSTANCE_EXTRA, and only include VM states where the average memory is greater than 75% of the maximum average memory across all VM states. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN ( SELECT MAX(avg_memory_mb) AS max_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) AS mx WHERE (inner_cte.avg_memory_mb * 1.0 / mx.max_avg_memory_mb) > 0.75 ORDER BY inner_cte.avg_memory_mb DESC;

question: For each instance power state, list the power state, total number of instances, and the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of instance memory (in MB) for instances that have a non-empty network_info entry in the instance info cache. Do not repeat the power state if it is the same as the previous row. Include a grand total row. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.power_state, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE iic.network_info IS NOT NULL GROUP BY i.power_state ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(power_state_name) OVER (ORDER BY power_state_sort, power_state_name) = power_state_name THEN NULL ELSE power_state_name END AS power_state, total_power_states, avg_memory_mb, memory_mb_variance, memory_mb_stddev FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.power_state) = 1 THEN 999999 ELSE inner_cte.power_state END AS power_state_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.power_state) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE CAST(inner_cte.power_state AS CHAR) END AS power_state_name, COUNT(*) AS total_power_states, AVG(inner_cte.avg_memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, AVG(inner_cte.memory_mb_variance) AS memory_mb_variance, AVG(inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.power_state WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY power_state_sort, power_state_name;

question: For instances whose availability zone is 'flare3', list each instance UUID, the system metadata value for the key 'image_image_type', and the dense rank of that instance when ordering by the instance's memory (in MB) using a window frame of the current row and the 2 preceding rows. Also include the overall average of this dense-rank value across all returned instances as a benchmark, and categorize each instance as 'HIGH_RANK' (at least 50% above the average), 'LOW_RANK' (at least 50% below the average), or 'AVERAGE_RANK'. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.UUID AS instance_uuid, t2.VALUE AS metadata_value, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t1.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND t2.KEY = 'image_image_type'), AverageRank AS ( SELECT AVG(window_column) AS avg_window_rank FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.instance_uuid, ic.metadata_value, ic.window_column, ar.avg_window_rank AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.window_column > ar.avg_window_rank * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_RANK' WHEN ic.window_column < ar.avg_window_rank * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_RANK' ELSE 'AVERAGE_RANK' END AS rank_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AverageRank ar;

question: For each instance display name and instance availability zone, show the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of completed migrations per instance. Include subtotals for each availability zone and a grand total. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(migration_count) - MIN(migration_count) AS migration_count_range, VARIANCE(migration_count) AS migration_count_variance, STDDEV(migration_count) AS migration_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid JOIN ( SELECT m.instance_uuid, m.dest_compute, COUNT(*) AS migration_count FROM migrations AS m WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY m.instance_uuid, m.dest_compute ) AS mig_stats ON i.uuid = mig_stats.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY migration_count_range DESC ), ZoneAgg AS ( SELECT i.availability_zone, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.migration_count_range, inner_cte.migration_count_variance, inner_cte.migration_count_stddev FROM inner_cte JOIN instances i ON i.display_name = inner_cte.display_name JOIN instance_extra ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(availability_zone) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE availability_zone END AS availability_zone, CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(availability_zone) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(availability_zone) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE display_name END AS display_name, AVG(migration_count_range) AS avg_migration_count_range, AVG(migration_count_variance) AS avg_migration_count_variance, AVG(migration_count_stddev) AS avg_migration_count_stddev FROM ZoneAgg GROUP BY availability_zone, display_name WITH ROLLUP;

question: For each security group name, return the security group name, its geometric mean of rule port-range sizes (TO_PORT − FROM_PORT + 1) across rules where TO_PORT is at least FROM_PORT, the overall average of these geometric means across all security groups as a benchmark, and categorize each security group as 'WIDE_RANGES' (at least 50% above the benchmark), 'NARROW_RANGES' (at least 50% below the benchmark), or 'TYPICAL_RANGES'. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sg.NAME AS security_group_name, EXP(AVG(LN(sgr.TO_PORT - sgr.FROM_PORT + 1))) AS geometric_mean_port_range_size FROM SECURITY_GROUPS AS sg JOIN SECURITY_GROUP_RULES AS sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sgr.TO_PORT >= sgr.FROM_PORT GROUP BY sg.NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean_port_range_size DESC), Benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(geometric_mean_port_range_size) AS avg_geometric_mean_port_range_size FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.security_group_name, i.geometric_mean_port_range_size, b.avg_geometric_mean_port_range_size AS benchmark, CASE WHEN i.geometric_mean_port_range_size > b.avg_geometric_mean_port_range_size * 1.5 THEN 'WIDE_RANGES' WHEN i.geometric_mean_port_range_size < b.avg_geometric_mean_port_range_size * 0.5 THEN 'NARROW_RANGES' ELSE 'TYPICAL_RANGES' END AS range_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN Benchmark b;

question: For each instance display name, show its standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of instance memory size (in MB) across records (only for instances that have extra metadata and are in the “shelved_offloaded” VM state), also include the overall average of these per-display-name standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP)s as a benchmark, and categorize each display name as 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' (at least 50% above the benchmark), 'LOW_VARIABILITY' (at least 50% below the benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_VARIABILITY'. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC ), AvgStddev AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb_stddev) AS avg_memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_mb_stddev, a.avg_memory_mb_stddev AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.memory_mb_stddev > a.avg_memory_mb_stddev * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN ic.memory_mb_stddev < a.avg_memory_mb_stddev * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIABILITY' END AS variability_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AvgStddev a;

question: For each migration status, show the status, total number of 'resize' migrations, and compute the average, range, and variance of the migrated instance memory size in MB. Do not repeat the status if it is the same as the previous row. Include a grand total row across all statuses. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.status AS migration_status, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_instance_memory_mb, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS instance_memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS instance_memory_mb_variance FROM instances i JOIN migrations m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.migration_type = 'resize' GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY instance_memory_mb_range DESC ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(migration_status) OVER (ORDER BY status_sort, migration_status) = migration_status THEN NULL ELSE migration_status END AS migration_status, total_resize_migrations, avg_instance_memory_mb, instance_memory_mb_range, instance_memory_mb_variance FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(m.status) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE m.status END AS status_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(m.status) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE m.status END AS migration_status, COUNT(*) AS total_resize_migrations, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_instance_memory_mb, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS instance_memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS instance_memory_mb_variance FROM instances i JOIN migrations m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid JOIN inner_cte ic ON ic.migration_status = m.status WHERE m.migration_type = 'resize' GROUP BY m.status WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY status_sort, migration_status;

question: For instances in availability zone "flare3", show the instance UUID, its display name, its VM state, and the running sum of the instance IDs within each VM-state group ordered by instance ID (using the instance extra record matched by UUID). Also include a formatted output where the VM state is not repeated if it is the same as the previous row, and include a subtotal row for each VM state. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, SUM(i.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(vm_state) OVER (ORDER BY vm_state_sort, vm_state, instance_uuid) = vm_state THEN NULL ELSE vm_state END AS vm_state, instance_uuid, display_name, window_column, subtotal_instances FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.vm_state) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE inner_cte.vm_state END AS vm_state_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.vm_state) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE inner_cte.vm_state END AS vm_state, CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.vm_state) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE inner_cte.instance_uuid END AS instance_uuid, CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.vm_state) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE inner_cte.display_name END AS display_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.vm_state) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE inner_cte.window_column END AS window_column, COUNT(*) AS subtotal_instances FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.window_column WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY vm_state_sort, vm_state, instance_uuid;

question: For migrations with status = 'completed', show the migration status, source compute, destination compute, the instance display name, and the instance flavor JSON, along with a dense rank partitioned by the migration status and ordered by the migration status; also include, for each source compute, the total number of completed migrations from that source and the average number of completed migrations per source compute across all source computes. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, i.display_name, ie.flavor, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.status ORDER BY m.status) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' ) SELECT inner_cte.status, inner_cte.source_compute, inner_cte.dest_compute, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.flavor, inner_cte.window_column, COUNT(*) AS total_completed_migrations_from_source, avg_sources.avg_completed_migrations_per_source FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(source_count) AS avg_completed_migrations_per_source FROM ( SELECT source_compute, COUNT(*) AS source_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY source_compute ) AS sub ) AS avg_sources ON 1 = 1 GROUP BY inner_cte.status, inner_cte.source_compute, inner_cte.dest_compute, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.flavor, inner_cte.window_column, avg_sources.avg_completed_migrations_per_source;

question: For each quota resource type, show the resource name and the geometric mean of reservation deltas for reservations linked to that quota usage (considering only reservations where the delta is greater than 0), but return only those resources whose geometric mean is greater than the overall average geometric mean across all resources. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT q.RESOURCE AS resource, EXP(AVG(LN(r.DELTA))) AS geometric_mean FROM QUOTA_USAGES AS q JOIN RESERVATIONS AS r ON q.ID = r.USAGE_ID WHERE r.DELTA > 0 GROUP BY q.RESOURCE ORDER BY geometric_mean DESC) SELECT resource, geometric_mean FROM inner_cte WHERE geometric_mean > (SELECT AVG(geometric_mean) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY geometric_mean DESC;

question: For each VM state and display name, considering only instances with more than 8 VCPUs, return the number of instances and the minimum memory (in MB) among those instances; then, for each VM state, report the maximum of those per-(VM state, display name) instance counts. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(i.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VCPUS > 8 GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME ) SELECT VM_STATE, MAX(instance_count) AS max_instance_count_per_display_name FROM inner_cte GROUP BY VM_STATE;

question: From the top 10 instance display names with the highest number of completed migrations (considering only instances that have an `image_image_type` entry in instance system metadata), show each display name, the completed migration count, the total vCPUs across those instances, the total memory (MB) across those instances, and whether any of those instances have a non-completed migration. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(m.id) AS migrations FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY migrations DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.migrations AS completed_migrations, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM migrations m2 JOIN instances i2 ON m2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism2 ON i2.uuid = ism2.instance_uuid WHERE i2.display_name = inner_cte.display_name AND ism2.key = 'image_image_type' AND m2.status <> 'completed' ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_non_completed_migrations FROM inner_cte JOIN instances i ON i.display_name = inner_cte.display_name JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.migrations ORDER BY inner_cte.migrations DESC;

question: From the top 10 instance display names with the largest MEMORY_MB range (max minus min) among non-deleted instances, show the display name, the memory range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and indicate whether any instance with that display name has a non-deleted instance_info_cache record. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_mb_range, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM instances i2 JOIN instance_info_caches ic2 ON i2.uuid = ic2.instance_uuid WHERE i2.deleted = 0 AND ic2.deleted = 0 AND i2.display_name = inner_cte.display_name ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_active_info_cache FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb_range DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each VM state, list the VM state and the total amount of memory (in MB) across non-deleted instances, but only include VM states whose total memory is greater than the overall average memory plus one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) (computed across all non-deleted instances). Use a CTE to compute the per-VM-state totals first, then filter in the outer query. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.vm_state, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.vm_state HAVING SUM(i.memory_mb) > ( SELECT AVG(i2.memory_mb) + STDDEV(i2.memory_mb) FROM instances AS i2 JOIN instance_extra AS ie2 ON i2.uuid = ie2.instance_uuid WHERE i2.deleted = 0 )) SELECT vm_state, total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte;

question: For instances that are in the “shelved_offloaded” VM state and have a migration with status “completed”, show the minimum instance memory (in MB) and the total migration memory remaining. Also include the count of distinct instances involved and the count of completed migrations. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_instance_memory_mb, SUM(m.MEMORY_REMAINING) AS total_migration_memory_remaining FROM INSTANCES i JOIN MIGRATIONS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' AND m.STATUS = 'completed') SELECT inner_cte.min_instance_memory_mb, inner_cte.total_migration_memory_remaining, COUNT(DISTINCT i.UUID) AS distinct_instance_count, COUNT(m.ID) AS completed_migration_count FROM inner_cte JOIN INSTANCES i ON 1 = 1 JOIN MIGRATIONS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' AND m.STATUS = 'completed' GROUP BY inner_cte.min_instance_memory_mb, inner_cte.total_migration_memory_remaining;

question: For each VM state, show the VM state and its total memory (in MB) across non-deleted instances, but only keep VM states whose total memory is greater than the overall average memory plus one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) (computed across all non-deleted instances); also include the overall threshold value (avg + stddev) alongside each returned VM state. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.vm_state, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.vm_state HAVING SUM(i.memory_mb) > ( SELECT AVG(i2.memory_mb) + STDDEV(i2.memory_mb) FROM instances AS i2 JOIN instance_extra AS ie2 ON i2.uuid = ie2.instance_uuid WHERE i2.deleted = 0 )) SELECT inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.total_memory_mb, threshold_stats.avg_plus_stddev AS avg_plus_stddev_threshold FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT AVG(i3.memory_mb) + STDDEV(i3.memory_mb) AS avg_plus_stddev FROM instances AS i3 JOIN instance_extra AS ie3 ON i3.uuid = ie3.instance_uuid WHERE i3.deleted = 0) AS threshold_stats;

question: For instances whose display name is 'forge', return only those instance/metadata rows where the instance memory (MB) is greater than the average memory (MB) across all 'forge' instances. Show the instance UUID, display name, memory (MB), system metadata key and value, and the average memory (MB) within each display-name group ordered by memory. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ), ForgeAverages AS ( SELECT display_name, AVG(memory_mb * 1.0) AS avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte GROUP BY display_name ) SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.metadata_key, inner_cte.metadata_value, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN ForgeAverages ON ForgeAverages.display_name = inner_cte.display_name WHERE inner_cte.memory_mb > ( SELECT avg_memory_mb FROM ForgeAverages WHERE ForgeAverages.display_name = inner_cte.display_name ) ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb;

question: For each destination compute host, find the destination compute name and the maximum of the per-migration window minimum instance memory (in MB), considering only migrations whose status is "completed". Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.INSTANCE_UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( ORDER BY m.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed') SELECT DEST_COMPUTE, MAX(window_column) AS max_window_min_instance_memory_mb FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEST_COMPUTE;

question: For each availability zone and coefficient-of-variation status, list the availability zone, a status label ('High' if the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) is at least 1 and 'Low' otherwise), and the number of distinct instance display names. Include subtotals for each availability zone and a grand total, considering only instances that are not deleted and only groups with a positive average time difference. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(c.updated_at - i.created_at) / NULLIF(AVG(c.updated_at - i.created_at), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS e ON e.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON c.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(c.updated_at - i.created_at) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), AZCVStatus AS ( SELECT i.availability_zone, CASE WHEN ic.coefficient_of_variation >= 1 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS cv_status, COUNT(DISTINCT ic.display_name) AS total_display_names FROM inner_cte ic JOIN instances i ON i.display_name = ic.display_name AND i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.availability_zone, cv_status ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(availability_zone) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE availability_zone END AS availability_zone, CASE WHEN GROUPING(cv_status) = 1 AND GROUPING(availability_zone) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE cv_status END AS cv_status, SUM(total_display_names) AS total_display_names FROM AZCVStatus GROUP BY availability_zone, cv_status WITH ROLLUP;

question: For each migration status, show the status, the variance of the instance memory (in MB) for instances involved in non-deleted migrations, and include a grand total row across all statuses. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.status, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.deleted = 0 GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(status) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE status END AS status, AVG(memory_mb_variance) AS memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY status WITH ROLLUP;

question: For each migration status, show the migration status, the average/range/variance of instance memory size (in MB) for instances involved in migrations that have the system metadata key 'image_image_type', along with the total number of such migrations and the overall average of those per-status migration counts across all statuses. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.status AS migration_status, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_instance_memory_mb, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS instance_memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS instance_memory_mb_variance FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY instance_memory_mb_range DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.migration_status, inner_cte.avg_instance_memory_mb, inner_cte.instance_memory_mb_range, inner_cte.instance_memory_mb_variance, COUNT(m2.id) AS total_migrations_with_image_image_type, avg_counts.avg_migration_count_per_status FROM inner_cte JOIN migrations AS m2 ON m2.status = inner_cte.migration_status JOIN instances AS i2 ON m2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism2 ON i2.uuid = ism2.instance_uuid JOIN ( SELECT AVG(migration_count) AS avg_migration_count_per_status FROM ( SELECT m3.status, COUNT(m3.id) AS migration_count FROM migrations AS m3 JOIN instances AS i3 ON m3.instance_uuid = i3.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism3 ON i3.uuid = ism3.instance_uuid WHERE ism3.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY m3.status ) AS sub ) AS avg_counts ON 1 = 1 WHERE ism2.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY inner_cte.migration_status, inner_cte.avg_instance_memory_mb, inner_cte.instance_memory_mb_range, inner_cte.instance_memory_mb_variance, avg_counts.avg_migration_count_per_status ORDER BY inner_cte.instance_memory_mb_range DESC;

question: For instances whose display name is 'forge', list each instance UUID, the flavor JSON, and the dense rank of that instance when ordering by the instance’s memory (in MB) using a window frame of the current row and the 2 preceding rows. Only return those rows whose windowed dense rank is greater than the average windowed dense rank across all such 'forge' instances. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.uuid, ie.flavor, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY i.memory_mb ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.display_name = 'forge' ), RankAverages AS ( SELECT AVG(inner_cte.window_column * 1.0) AS avg_window_rank FROM inner_cte ) SELECT inner_cte.uuid, inner_cte.flavor, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.window_column > (SELECT avg_window_rank FROM RankAverages);

question: For each instance display name and its launched-at timestamp, list the maximum memory (in MB) among instances that were launched in 2014 (only keeping groups where that maximum is greater than 16000 MB), along with the average of these per-(display name, launched-at) maximum-memory values across all such groups. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) AS max_memory_mb, i.LAUNCHED_AT FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.LAUNCHED_AT) = 2014 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.LAUNCHED_AT HAVING MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) > 16000 ) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.LAUNCHED_AT, inner_cte.max_memory_mb, avg_max_mem.avg_max_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(max_memory_mb) AS avg_max_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) AS avg_max_mem ON 1 = 1;

question: For non-deleted instances whose system metadata key is image_image_type, list the instance UUID, its dense rank when ordering by instance memory (in MB) using a window frame of the current row and the 2 preceding rows, and the deviation of that instance’s memory from the average memory (in MB) across all such instances. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.UUID AS instance_uuid, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t0.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND t1.DELETED = 0 ), AvgMem AS ( SELECT AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ic JOIN INSTANCES i ON i.UUID = ic.instance_uuid ) SELECT ic.instance_uuid, ic.window_column, (i.MEMORY_MB - am.avg_memory_mb) AS deviation_from_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ic JOIN INSTANCES i ON i.UUID = ic.instance_uuid CROSS JOIN AvgMem am;

question: For each quota resource type, show the minimum quota usage ID and the average reservation delta for non-deleted quota usage records (q.DELETED = 0) where the reservation resource is either 'cores' or 'instances', and also include how that average reservation delta deviates from the overall average reservation delta across all such records. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(q.ID) AS min_usage_id, AVG(r.DELTA) AS avg_reservation_delta FROM QUOTA_USAGES q JOIN RESERVATIONS r ON q.ID = r.USAGE_ID WHERE q.DELETED = 0 AND r.RESOURCE IN ('cores', 'instances') GROUP BY q.RESOURCE ), overall_avg AS ( SELECT AVG(r.DELTA) AS overall_avg_reservation_delta FROM QUOTA_USAGES q JOIN RESERVATIONS r ON q.ID = r.USAGE_ID WHERE q.DELETED = 0 AND r.RESOURCE IN ('cores', 'instances') ) SELECT i.min_usage_id, i.avg_reservation_delta, (i.avg_reservation_delta - oa.overall_avg_reservation_delta) AS deviation_from_overall_avg FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa;

question: For each availability zone, list the availability zone name, the total number of completed migrations for instances in that zone, and the average number of completed migrations per availability zone across all zones. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, i.availability_zone, m.status, m.migration_type, i.uuid, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.uuid ORDER BY i.uuid) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' ) SELECT DISTINCT inner_cte.availability_zone AS availability_zone, COUNT(*) AS total_completed_migrations, avg_migrations.avg_migration_count FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(migration_count) AS avg_migration_count FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS migration_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY availability_zone ) AS sub ) AS avg_migrations GROUP BY inner_cte.availability_zone, avg_migrations.avg_migration_count;

question: For each instance display name, show the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the instance memory (MEMORY_MB) across instances that have system metadata with KEY = 'image_image_type'. Only include display names that appear in more than 1 such instance, and only return display names whose memory standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) is greater than the overall average of these per-display-name standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP)s. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC ), StddevAverage AS ( SELECT AVG(inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev) AS avg_memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte ) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev > (SELECT avg_memory_mb_stddev FROM StddevAverage) ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev DESC;

question: For each instance VM state and display name, considering only instances that have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type', return the instance count and minimum memory (in MB). Also include subtotals per VM state and a grand total. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(i.ID) AS instance_count, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(VM_STATE) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE VM_STATE END AS VM_STATE, CASE WHEN GROUPING(DISPLAY_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(VM_STATE) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE DISPLAY_NAME END AS DISPLAY_NAME, SUM(instance_count) AS instance_count, MIN(min_memory_mb) AS min_memory_mb FROM inner_cte GROUP BY VM_STATE, DISPLAY_NAME WITH ROLLUP;

question: For each instance display name and image type (from system metadata key = 'image_image_type'), return the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) (standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) divided by average) of the instance root disk size in GB, considering only instances that have a non-deleted system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type' and only non-deleted instance info cache rows. Include subtotals per display name and a grand total. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.root_gb) / NULLIF(AVG(i.root_gb), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND iic.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(i.root_gb) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), DisplayNameImageTypeStats AS ( SELECT i.display_name, ism.value AS image_type, STDDEV(i.root_gb) / NULLIF(AVG(i.root_gb), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation, COUNT(*) AS instance_count FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid JOIN inner_cte ON inner_cte.display_name = i.display_name WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND ism.deleted = 0 AND iic.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name, ism.value HAVING AVG(i.root_gb) > 0 ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE display_name END AS display_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(image_type) = 1 AND GROUPING(display_name) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE image_type END AS image_type, AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation, SUM(instance_count) AS total_instances FROM DisplayNameImageTypeStats GROUP BY display_name, image_type WITH ROLLUP ORDER BY GROUPING(display_name), display_name, GROUPING(image_type), image_type;

question: For confirmed migrations where the source compute is 'ether-60', show the migration ID, instance UUID, migration status, source compute, destination compute, instance display name, instance VM state, and instance memory in MB (with row numbers within each migration status ordered by migration ID), and also include the instance’s project ID and a flag indicating whether that project has any other active (not completed/failed/error) non-deleted migrations. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.INSTANCE_UUID AS instance_uuid, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE AS source_compute, m.DEST_COMPUTE AS dest_compute, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.VM_STATE AS instance_vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'confirmed' AND m.SOURCE_COMPUTE = 'ether-60' ) SELECT inner_cte.migration_id, inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.migration_status, inner_cte.source_compute, inner_cte.dest_compute, inner_cte.instance_display_name, inner_cte.instance_vm_state, inner_cte.instance_memory_mb, inner_cte.window_column, i.project_id AS project_id, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM migrations m2 JOIN instances i2 ON m2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid WHERE i2.project_id = i.project_id AND m2.deleted = 0 AND m2.status NOT IN ('completed', 'failed', 'error') AND m2.id <> inner_cte.migration_id ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS project_has_other_active_migrations FROM inner_cte JOIN instances i ON inner_cte.instance_uuid = i.uuid ORDER BY inner_cte.migration_status, inner_cte.migration_id;

question: For each migration status, show the status, the range (maximum minus minimum) and variance of the instance memory in MB for instances involved in those migrations (considering only non-deleted migrations and non-deleted instance info cache entries), and also include the percentage of that memory range relative to the maximum instance memory for the same status. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.status, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.deleted = 0 AND ic.deleted = 0 GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.status, inner_cte.memory_mb_range, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, (inner_cte.memory_mb_range * 1.0 / MAX(i2.memory_mb)) AS memory_range_pct_of_max FROM inner_cte JOIN migrations AS m2 ON m2.status = inner_cte.status JOIN instances AS i2 ON m2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic2 ON i2.uuid = ic2.instance_uuid WHERE m2.deleted = 0 AND ic2.deleted = 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.status, inner_cte.memory_mb_range, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb_range DESC;

question: From the top 10 instance display names (for non-deleted instances) with the highest maximum completed-migration total memory, show the instance display name, migration status, the maximum MEMORY_TOTAL among completed migrations, the migration created timestamp, and whether the instance has any system metadata records. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, m.status, MAX(m.memory_total) AS max_memory_total, m.created_at FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name, m.status, m.created_at HAVING MAX(m.memory_total) > 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.status, inner_cte.max_memory_total, inner_cte.created_at, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM instances i2 JOIN instance_system_metadata ism2 ON i2.uuid = ism2.instance_uuid WHERE i2.display_name = inner_cte.display_name AND i2.deleted = 0 AND ism2.deleted = 0 ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_system_metadata FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.max_memory_total DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each instance display name, list the total memory (in MB) for “shelved_offloaded” instances whose total memory is greater than 20000 MB, but only include display names whose total memory is greater than the overall average total memory (across display names) for “shelved_offloaded” instances, using the instance UUID links to include instance extra details and the instance network info cache. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING SUM(i.memory_mb) > 20000 ), AvgTotals AS ( SELECT AVG(inner_cte.total_memory_mb * 1.0) AS avg_total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.total_memory_mb > (SELECT avg_total_memory_mb FROM AvgTotals);

question: For each migration status and instance VM state, considering only migrations where the instance has system metadata with the key 'image_image_type', list only those (status, vm_state) groups whose migration count is greater than the average migration count across all such groups, and return the migration count and the minimum instance memory (in MB). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.status AS migration_status, i.vm_state AS instance_vm_state, COUNT(m.id) AS migration_count, MIN(i.memory_mb) AS min_instance_memory_mb FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY m.status, i.vm_state), GroupAverages AS ( SELECT AVG(inner_cte.migration_count * 1.0) AS avg_migration_count FROM inner_cte ) SELECT inner_cte.migration_status, inner_cte.instance_vm_state, inner_cte.migration_count, inner_cte.min_instance_memory_mb FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.migration_count > (SELECT avg_migration_count FROM GroupAverages);

question: For instance display names that have a number of completed migrations greater than the average completed-migration count across all instances that have an `image_image_type` entry in instance system metadata, list the display name and its completed migration count. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(m.id) AS migrations FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY migrations DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT display_name, migrations FROM inner_cte WHERE migrations > (SELECT AVG(migrations) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY migrations DESC;

question: For instances whose display name is 'forge', list the instance UUID, the system metadata key and value, and the instance memory in MB, and keep only rows where the instance memory is greater than 16000 MB; also assign a row number ordered by the metadata key using a window frame of 2 preceding rows and 1 following row. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.UUID, ism.KEY, ism.VALUE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ism.KEY ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' ) SELECT inner_cte.UUID, inner_cte.KEY, inner_cte.VALUE, inner_cte.window_column, i.MEMORY_MB FROM inner_cte JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON i.UUID = inner_cte.UUID WHERE i.MEMORY_MB > 16000;

question: For each migration status, show the status and the maximum (across all projects) of the per-project instance-memory range (maximum minus minimum) in MB for instances involved in those migrations, considering only migrations that are not deleted and whose instance has a non-deleted instance info cache entry. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.status, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.deleted = 0 AND ic.deleted = 0 GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC ), StatusProjectRanges AS ( SELECT m.status, i.project_id, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS project_memory_mb_range FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.deleted = 0 AND ic.deleted = 0 GROUP BY m.status, i.project_id ) SELECT spr.status, MAX(spr.project_memory_mb_range) AS max_project_memory_mb_range FROM StatusProjectRanges AS spr JOIN inner_cte AS base ON base.status = spr.status GROUP BY spr.status ORDER BY max_project_memory_mb_range DESC;

question: For instances whose display name is "forge", show the instance UUID, display name, VM state, memory in MB, and the instance-extra record ID, along with the average memory (in MB) in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows partitioned by VM state and ordered by memory; only include rows where the instance’s memory is greater than 75% of the maximum memory (in MB) among these "forge" instances. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' ) SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.instance_extra_id, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN ( SELECT MAX(memory_mb) AS max_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) m WHERE (inner_cte.memory_mb * 1.0 / m.max_memory_mb) > 0.75;

question: For instances whose display name is 'forge', show the instance UUID, hostname, VM state, memory in MB, the cached network info JSON, and the minimum memory (in MB) in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows ordered by instance ID. Also include the total number of such rows and the average memory across them, and do not repeat the VM state if it is the same as the previous row when ordered by instance UUID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.UUID, i.HOSTNAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, c.NETWORK_INFO, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( ORDER BY i.ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(vm_state) OVER (ORDER BY uuid) = vm_state THEN NULL ELSE vm_state END AS vm_state, uuid, hostname, memory_mb, network_info, window_column, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_forge_instances, AVG(memory_mb) OVER () AS avg_forge_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ORDER BY uuid;

question: For each instance display name, show the memory range and variance (in MB) for non-deleted instances with a non-empty key name, along with the overall average memory range across all such display names. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_range_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_variance_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON iic.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.key_name <> '' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_range_mb DESC ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_range_mb, ic.memory_variance_mb, avg_ranges.avg_memory_range_mb FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN ( SELECT AVG(memory_range_mb) AS avg_memory_range_mb FROM ( SELECT memory_range_mb FROM inner_cte ) AS sub ) AS avg_ranges ORDER BY ic.memory_range_mb DESC;

question: For the top 10 instance display names with the most completed migrations, show the instance display name, the number of completed migrations, and the instance’s total memory (MB) and vCPU count. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(m.id) AS migrations FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY migrations DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.migrations, MAX(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb, MAX(i.vcpus) AS vcpus FROM inner_cte JOIN instances AS i ON i.display_name = inner_cte.display_name GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.migrations ORDER BY inner_cte.migrations DESC;

question: For each instance display name whose system-metadata-entry count range is greater than the average range across all instance display names, list the display name along with the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of system metadata entries per instance (counting only instances that are not deleted and only metadata rows that are not deleted). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(meta_entry_count) - MIN(meta_entry_count) AS meta_count_range, VARIANCE(meta_entry_count) AS meta_count_variance, STDDEV(meta_entry_count) AS meta_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN ( SELECT i2.uuid AS instance_uuid, COUNT(*) AS meta_entry_count FROM instances AS i2 JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i2.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i2.uuid ) AS meta_stats ON meta_stats.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY meta_count_range DESC) SELECT display_name, meta_count_range, meta_count_variance, meta_count_stddev FROM inner_cte WHERE meta_count_range > (SELECT AVG(meta_count_range) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY meta_count_range DESC;

question: Among the VM state and availability zone groups that have at least one instance with a system metadata entry where key = 'image_image_type', list the top 10 (by instance count) VM state/availability zone combinations, showing the instance count and the minimum memory (in MB) in each group. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ins.VM_STATE, ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, COUNT(ins.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(ins.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES ins ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON ins.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY ins.VM_STATE, ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE ) SELECT inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, inner_cte.instance_count, inner_cte.min_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.instance_count DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For confirmed migrations where the destination compute is 'glint-94', show the migration id, source compute, destination compute, destination host, migration status, instance UUID, instance display name, instance VM state, system metadata key and value, and the row number within each migration status (ordered by migration id). Also include, for each migration status, the total number of rows returned and the average migration id as a benchmark, and categorize each row as 'ABOVE_AVG_ID', 'BELOW_AVG_ID', or 'AT_AVG_ID' based on whether its migration id is above, below, or equal to that status benchmark. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, m.STATUS AS migration_status, i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.VM_STATE AS instance_vm_state, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'confirmed' AND m.DEST_COMPUTE = 'glint-94' ), StatusBenchmarks AS ( SELECT migration_status, COUNT(*) AS total_rows_in_status, AVG(migration_id) AS avg_migration_id_in_status FROM inner_cte GROUP BY migration_status ) SELECT ic.migration_id, ic.SOURCE_COMPUTE, ic.DEST_COMPUTE, ic.DEST_HOST, ic.migration_status, ic.instance_uuid, ic.instance_display_name, ic.instance_vm_state, ic.metadata_key, ic.metadata_value, ic.window_column, sb.total_rows_in_status, sb.avg_migration_id_in_status AS benchmark_avg_migration_id, CASE WHEN ic.migration_id > sb.avg_migration_id_in_status THEN 'ABOVE_AVG_ID' WHEN ic.migration_id < sb.avg_migration_id_in_status THEN 'BELOW_AVG_ID' ELSE 'AT_AVG_ID' END AS id_vs_benchmark_category FROM inner_cte ic JOIN StatusBenchmarks sb ON ic.migration_status = sb.migration_status;

question: For each migration status, show the status, the geometric mean of the migrated instances’ memory (in MB), and the geometric mean of the migrated instances’ vCPU count for migrations where the instance memory is greater than zero. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.status, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC ) SELECT m.status, inner_cte.geometric_mean_memory_mb, EXP(AVG(LN(i.vcpus))) AS geometric_mean_vcpus FROM inner_cte JOIN migrations AS m ON m.status = inner_cte.status JOIN instances AS i ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 AND i.vcpus > 0 GROUP BY m.status, inner_cte.geometric_mean_memory_mb ORDER BY inner_cte.geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC;

question: For each instance display name, show the variance of the instance memory size in MB (considering only instances that have a matching row in INSTANCE_EXTRA), along with the overall average of these per-display-name variances and each display name’s deviation from that overall average. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), avg_variance AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb_variance) AS avg_memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_mb_variance, av.avg_memory_mb_variance, (ic.memory_mb_variance - av.avg_memory_mb_variance) AS deviation_from_avg_variance FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_variance av ORDER BY deviation_from_avg_variance DESC;

question: For each instance VM state, show the VM state and its average, range, and variance of instance memory (in MB) for instances that are not deleted and have a non-empty network_info cache entry, and then list only the VM states whose average memory is greater than the overall average of these per-state averages. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) - MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND iic.NETWORK_INFO <> '[]' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC) SELECT vm_state, avg_memory_mb, memory_mb_range, memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_memory_mb > (SELECT AVG(avg_memory_mb) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY avg_memory_mb DESC;

question: For each instance display name, find the memory range and variance (in MB) for non-deleted instances, and then report the maximum memory range observed across all display names. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_range_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_variance_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_range_mb DESC ) SELECT MAX(inner_cte.memory_range_mb) AS max_memory_range_mb FROM inner_cte;

question: For instances that are not deleted (DELETED = 0) and are in the availability zone “flare3”, group the results by system metadata key and a memory bucket (“HighMem” if memory_mb ≥ 32768 and “LowMem” otherwise). For each group, list the system metadata key, the memory bucket, the number of distinct instances, and the average of the per-row windowed average instance memory (MB) (computed over 2 preceding and 2 following rows partitioned by the system metadata key and ordered by instance memory). Include subtotals for each system metadata key and a grand total. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.FLAVOR AS flavor, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3'), Bucketed AS ( SELECT metadata_key, CASE WHEN memory_mb >= 32768 THEN 'HighMem' ELSE 'LowMem' END AS memory_bucket, instance_uuid, window_column FROM inner_cte ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(metadata_key) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE metadata_key END AS metadata_key, CASE WHEN GROUPING(memory_bucket) = 1 AND GROUPING(metadata_key) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE memory_bucket END AS memory_bucket, COUNT(DISTINCT instance_uuid) AS total_instances, AVG(window_column) AS avg_windowed_memory_mb FROM Bucketed GROUP BY metadata_key, memory_bucket WITH ROLLUP;

question: For each migration source compute, considering only migrations with status equal to 'completed', show the source compute and the maximum value of the 3-preceding-and-1-following-row minimum instance memory (in MB) when ordered by migration ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.status, MIN(i.memory_mb) OVER ( ORDER BY m.id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' ) SELECT inner_cte.source_compute, MAX(inner_cte.window_column) AS max_window_min_memory_mb FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.source_compute;

question: For each instance VM state, show the VM state, the average/range/variance of instance memory (in MB) for instances that have a non-empty PCI requests value recorded in the instance extra table, and also compute how far each VM state's average memory deviates from the overall average memory across all such instances. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) - MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ie.PCI_REQUESTS <> '[]' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC), OverallAvg AS (SELECT AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS overall_avg_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ie.PCI_REQUESTS <> '[]') SELECT ic.vm_state, ic.avg_memory_mb, ic.memory_mb_range, ic.memory_mb_variance, (ic.avg_memory_mb - oa.overall_avg_memory_mb) AS deviation_from_overall_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN OverallAvg oa;

question: For each quota usage resource, show its average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of reservation delta amounts, include the overall average delta across all quota usage resources as a benchmark, and categorize each resource as 'HIGH_DELTA' (at least 50% above the overall average), 'LOW_DELTA' (at least 50% below the overall average), or 'AVERAGE_DELTA'. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT qu.RESOURCE AS quota_resource, AVG(r.DELTA) AS avg_delta, VARIANCE(r.DELTA) AS delta_variance, STDDEV(r.DELTA) AS delta_stddev FROM QUOTA_USAGES AS qu JOIN RESERVATIONS AS r ON qu.ID = r.USAGE_ID WHERE qu.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY qu.RESOURCE ORDER BY delta_variance DESC), overall_avg AS ( SELECT AVG(avg_delta) AS overall_avg_delta FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.quota_resource, ic.avg_delta, ic.delta_variance, ic.delta_stddev, oa.overall_avg_delta AS benchmark_avg_delta, CASE WHEN ic.avg_delta > oa.overall_avg_delta * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_DELTA' WHEN ic.avg_delta < oa.overall_avg_delta * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_DELTA' ELSE 'AVERAGE_DELTA' END AS delta_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa;

question: For availability zone "flare3", how many non-deleted instances have a non-deleted network info cache entry, and is this count greater than the average number of such instances per availability zone? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS flare3_instances_with_network_cache FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.DELETED = 0 ), ZoneCounts AS ( SELECT i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, COUNT(*) AS instances_with_network_cache FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE ), ZoneAverages AS ( SELECT AVG(instances_with_network_cache * 1.0) AS avg_instances_with_network_cache FROM ZoneCounts ) SELECT inner_cte.flare3_instances_with_network_cache, CASE WHEN inner_cte.flare3_instances_with_network_cache > (SELECT avg_instances_with_network_cache FROM ZoneAverages) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS flare3_above_zone_average FROM inner_cte;

question: For instances whose display name is 'forge', show the instance UUID, display name, memory (MB), the system metadata key and value, and the average memory (MB) within each display-name group ordered by memory; then return only those rows where the instance memory (MB) is greater than the overall average memory (MB) across all returned rows. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ) SELECT instance_uuid, display_name, memory_mb, metadata_key, metadata_value, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE memory_mb > (SELECT AVG(memory_mb) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY memory_mb;

question: For the top 10 instance display names with the most network info cache records in availability zone 'flare3', return the instance display name, its cache record count, the overall average cache record count across these top-10 display names as a benchmark, and categorize each display name as 'HIGH_CACHE' (at least 50% above the benchmark), 'LOW_CACHE' (at least 50% below the benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_CACHE'. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(iic.id) AS cache_records FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY cache_records DESC LIMIT 10 ), AverageCache AS ( SELECT AVG(cache_records) AS avg_cache_records FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.cache_records, ac.avg_cache_records AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.cache_records > ac.avg_cache_records * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_CACHE' WHEN ic.cache_records < ac.avg_cache_records * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_CACHE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_CACHE' END AS cache_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AverageCache ac;

question: For each instance VM state, among non-hidden and active migrations (i.e., migration status not in ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed')), return the VM state and the maximum (across migration statuses) of the per-status minimum total migration memory, considering only VM states that have at least 2 instances involved in such migrations. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "Active migrations" is predicated by "migrations.status NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, m.STATUS AS migration_status, COUNT(i.ID) AS instance_count, MIN(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) AS min_memory_total FROM INSTANCES i JOIN MIGRATIONS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.HIDDEN = 0 AND m.STATUS NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, m.STATUS ) SELECT vm_state, MAX(min_memory_total) AS max_of_min_memory_total FROM inner_cte WHERE instance_count >= 2 GROUP BY vm_state;

question: For instances that are not deleted (DELETED = 0) and are on host "blaze8-12", show each instance UUID and its dense rank when ordering by the instance’s memory in MB (using a window frame of the current row and the 2 preceding rows). Also display the instance’s hostname and whether it has any non-deleted instance info cache record. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.UUID, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t1.DELETED = 0 AND t1.host = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, inner_cte.window_column AS dense_rank_by_memory_window, i.hostname AS instance_hostname, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES iic2 WHERE iic2.instance_uuid = i.uuid AND iic2.deleted = 0 ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_instance_info_cache FROM inner_cte JOIN INSTANCES i ON i.uuid = inner_cte.uuid;

question: For each instance display name, list the display name, total number of matching instances, and the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of days between when the instance was created and when it was launched, considering only instances that have a system metadata entry with KEY = 'image_image_type' and whose display name matches the pattern 'flare'. Do not repeat the display name if it is the same as the previous row. Include a grand total row across all display names. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "Display 'flare'" is predicated by "instances.display_name REGEXP 'flare'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.launched_at - i.created_at) AS avg_days_to_launch, STDDEV(i.launched_at - i.created_at) AS days_to_launch_stddev FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'flare' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY days_to_launch_stddev DESC ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(display_name) OVER (ORDER BY display_sort, display_name) = display_name THEN NULL ELSE display_name END AS display_name, total_instances, avg_days_to_launch, days_to_launch_stddev FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.display_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE inner_cte.display_name END AS display_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.display_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE inner_cte.display_name END AS display_name, COUNT(i.uuid) AS total_instances, AVG(i.launched_at - i.created_at) AS avg_days_to_launch, STDDEV(i.launched_at - i.created_at) AS days_to_launch_stddev FROM inner_cte JOIN instances i ON i.display_name = inner_cte.display_name JOIN instance_extra ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' WHERE i.display_name REGEXP 'flare' GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY display_sort, display_name;

question: For each quota usage record, return the quota usage ID, its resource type, and the total reserved delta from its linked reservations, considering only reservations that expired before 2021-11-16 19:30:59 and only non-deleted quota usages; include only those quota usages where the total reserved delta is more than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the mean reservation delta across all (filtered) reservations. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "Reservations expired before 2021-11-16 19:30:59" is predicated by "reservations.expire < '2021-11-16 19:30:59'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT qu.ID AS usage_id, SUM(r.DELTA) AS total_reserved_delta FROM QUOTA_USAGES AS qu JOIN RESERVATIONS AS r ON qu.ID = r.USAGE_ID WHERE r.expire < '2021-11-16 19:30:59' GROUP BY qu.ID HAVING SUM(r.DELTA) > ( SELECT AVG(DELTA) + STDDEV(DELTA) FROM RESERVATIONS WHERE expire < '2021-11-16 19:30:59' )) SELECT inner_cte.usage_id, qu.RESOURCE AS usage_resource, inner_cte.total_reserved_delta FROM inner_cte JOIN QUOTA_USAGES AS qu ON qu.ID = inner_cte.usage_id WHERE qu.DELETED = 0;

question: From the top 10 instance display names with the largest instance-memory range (in MB) among instances that have a matching row in INSTANCE_EXTRA, are in availability zone 'flare3', and whose display name matches the regular expression 'prime', show each display name, the memory range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), along with the total vCPUs and total memory across those instances. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "Display 'prime'" is predicated by "instances.display_name REGEXP 'prime'"
