SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_mb_range, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN instances AS i ON i.display_name = inner_cte.display_name JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_mb_range, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb_range DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For migrations with status = 'completed' and where the instance is on host 'blaze8-12', list the migration id, source compute, destination compute, instance display name, instance memory in MB, the instance system metadata key and value, and the average instance memory (in MB) over a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows partitioned by migration status and ordered by migration id. Do not repeat the migration status if it is the same as the previous row. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.MEMORY_MB, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(m.STATUS) OVER (ORDER BY inner_cte.migration_id) = m.STATUS THEN NULL ELSE m.STATUS END AS migration_status, inner_cte.migration_id, inner_cte.SOURCE_COMPUTE, inner_cte.DEST_COMPUTE, inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.MEMORY_MB, inner_cte.metadata_key, inner_cte.metadata_value, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON m.ID = inner_cte.migration_id ORDER BY inner_cte.migration_id;

question: For each availability zone, find the availability zone name and the highest total memory (in MB) among VM states for instances hosted on 'blaze8-12' in availability zone 'flare3', considering only VM states whose total memory is greater than 50000 MB. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) AS total_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE HAVING SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) > 50000) SELECT 'flare3' AS availability_zone, MAX(inner_cte.total_memory_mb) AS max_total_memory_mb_across_vm_states FROM inner_cte;

question: For each instance VM state, return the VM state, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of migration memory remaining (standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of MEMORY_REMAINING divided by the average MEMORY_REMAINING) for completed migrations on host "blaze8-12", and the count of completed migrations contributing to that statistic. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.vm_state, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.vm_state HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, COUNT(m2.id) AS completed_migration_count FROM inner_cte JOIN instances i2 ON i2.vm_state = inner_cte.vm_state JOIN migrations m2 ON m2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid WHERE m2.status = 'completed' AND i2.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation ORDER BY inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC;

question: For instances that are not deleted (DELETED = 0) and are on host "blaze8-12", list the instance UUID, display name, VM state, the system metadata key and value, and the rank of each metadata row within its metadata key group ordered by instance UUID; additionally, only include rows where the instance’s memory is above the average memory of all non-deleted instances on that host. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, ism.KEY, ism.VALUE, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT inner_cte.UUID, inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.KEY, inner_cte.VALUE, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN INSTANCES AS i2 ON i2.UUID = inner_cte.UUID WHERE i2.MEMORY_MB > ( SELECT AVG(i3.MEMORY_MB * 1.0) FROM INSTANCES AS i3 WHERE i3.DELETED = 0 AND i3.HOST = 'blaze8-12' );

question: For each instance availability zone and VM state, considering only instances that are not deleted and that are running on host "prime-35", show the availability zone, VM state, the number of instances, and the earliest instance creation time. Also include subtotals for each availability zone and a grand total, using the instance UUID links to include both the instance extra record and the instance network info cache. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Host "prime-35" is predicated by "instances.host = 'prime-35'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, ins.VM_STATE, COUNT(ins.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(ins.CREATED_AT) AS earliest_created_at FROM INSTANCES AS ins JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID WHERE ins.DELETED = 0 AND ins.HOST = 'prime-35' GROUP BY ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, ins.VM_STATE ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(AVAILABILITY_ZONE) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE AVAILABILITY_ZONE END AS AVAILABILITY_ZONE, CASE WHEN GROUPING(VM_STATE) = 1 AND GROUPING(AVAILABILITY_ZONE) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE VM_STATE END AS VM_STATE, SUM(instance_count) AS instance_count, MIN(earliest_created_at) AS earliest_created_at FROM inner_cte GROUP BY AVAILABILITY_ZONE, VM_STATE WITH ROLLUP;

question: For each instance on host 'blaze8-12' that has a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type', show the instance UUID, the instance display name, the migration status, the number of migrations recorded for that instance, and the total memory processed across those migrations; additionally, only include rows where the total memory processed is greater than 75% of the total memory for those migrations. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name AS instance_display_name, m.status AS migration_status, COUNT(m.id) AS migration_count, SUM(m.memory_processed) AS total_memory_processed FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, m.status ) SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.instance_display_name, inner_cte.migration_status, inner_cte.migration_count, inner_cte.total_memory_processed FROM inner_cte JOIN migrations m2 ON m2.instance_uuid = inner_cte.instance_uuid AND m2.status = inner_cte.migration_status GROUP BY inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.instance_display_name, inner_cte.migration_status, inner_cte.migration_count, inner_cte.total_memory_processed HAVING (inner_cte.total_memory_processed * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(m2.memory_total), 0)) > 0.75;

question: For each availability zone, find the availability zone name and the highest number of instance-extra records associated with any single instance display name, considering only instances hosted on “blaze8-12”. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(ie.id) AS extra_records FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY extra_records DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT i.availability_zone, MAX(inner_cte.extra_records) AS max_extra_records_per_display_name FROM inner_cte JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON i.display_name = inner_cte.display_name WHERE i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.availability_zone;

question: For each **active** migration status, list the status along with the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of instance memory (MEMORY_MB) for instances that have a matching migration record, and only keep statuses whose memory variance is greater than the average memory variance across all active migration statuses. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "Active migrations" is predicated by "migrations.status NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.STATUS AS migration_status, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM INSTANCES i JOIN MIGRATIONS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.MEMORY_MB IS NOT NULL AND m.status NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') GROUP BY m.STATUS ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), VarianceAverages AS ( SELECT AVG(inner_cte.memory_mb_variance) AS avg_memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte ) SELECT inner_cte.migration_status, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.memory_mb_variance > (SELECT avg_memory_mb_variance FROM VarianceAverages) ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb_variance DESC;

question: For each instance display name, show the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total memory involved in its migrations (MIGRATIONS.MEMORY_TOTAL), considering only instances that have at least 2 related system-metadata rows where the metadata key is 'image_image_type', and only for instances whose display name matches 'prime'. Do not repeat the display name if it is the same as the previous row. Include a final TOTAL row as a subtotal across all qualifying instances. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "Display 'prime'" is predicated by "instances.display_name REGEXP 'prime'"
SQL: SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(display_name) OVER (ORDER BY display_name_sort, display_name) = display_name THEN NULL ELSE display_name END AS display_name, memory_total_stddev FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.display_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE inner_cte.display_name END AS display_name_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.display_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE inner_cte.display_name END AS display_name, STDDEV(inner_cte.memory_total_stddev) AS memory_total_stddev FROM ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_total) AS memory_total_stddev FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(ism.id) > 1 ORDER BY memory_total_stddev DESC ) AS inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY display_name_sort, display_name;

question: For each VM state on host `blaze8-12`, list the VM state, the total number of non-deleted instances that have a system metadata entry with key `image_image_type` and also have a non-deleted network info cache record, and the average memory (MB) of those instances. Do not repeat the VM state if it is the same as the previous row. Include a grand total row. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS instance_count FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(vm_state_name) OVER (ORDER BY vm_state_sort, vm_state_name) = vm_state_name THEN NULL ELSE vm_state_name END AS vm_state, total_instances, avg_memory_mb FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.VM_STATE) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.VM_STATE END AS vm_state_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.VM_STATE) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.VM_STATE END AS vm_state_name, COUNT(i.ID) AS total_instances, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID CROSS JOIN inner_cte WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND iic.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.VM_STATE WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY vm_state_sort, vm_state_name;

question: Among reservations whose resource is 'cores' and that expired before 2021-05-13 16:53:07, show the top 10 projects (by total reserved cores delta) along with the project ID, total reserved delta, the maximum dense rank (computed over the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the associated quota usage IN_USE value), and whether the project has any reservation with a positive quota usage RESERVED value. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "Reservations expired before 2021-05-13 16:53:07" is predicated by "reservations.expire < '2021-05-13 16:53:07'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.UUID, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY t0.IN_USE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM QUOTA_USAGES t0 JOIN RESERVATIONS t1 ON t0.ID = t1.USAGE_ID WHERE t1.RESOURCE = 'cores' AND t1.EXPIRE < '2021-05-13 16:53:07' ) SELECT r.PROJECT_ID AS project_id, SUM(r.DELTA) AS total_reserved_delta, MAX(i.window_column) AS max_dense_rank_in_project, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM RESERVATIONS r2 JOIN QUOTA_USAGES q2 ON q2.ID = r2.USAGE_ID WHERE r2.PROJECT_ID = r.PROJECT_ID AND r2.RESOURCE = 'cores' AND r2.EXPIRE < '2021-05-13 16:53:07' AND q2.RESERVED > 0 ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_any_positive_reserved_quota FROM inner_cte i JOIN RESERVATIONS r ON r.UUID = i.UUID JOIN QUOTA_USAGES q ON q.ID = r.USAGE_ID WHERE r.RESOURCE = 'cores' AND r.EXPIRE < '2021-05-13 16:53:07' GROUP BY r.PROJECT_ID ORDER BY total_reserved_delta DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each instance, show its display name, availability zone, VM state, memory in MB, vCPU count, instance UUID, and the maximum system-metadata ID over a window that includes the current row and the next 2 rows when ordered by instance UUID, considering only instances in availability zone 'flare3' whose display name matches the pattern 'flare'. Also include the instance’s deviation from the average of this “max metadata ID over the next 2 rows” value across all returned instances. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "Display 'flare'" is predicated by "instances.display_name REGEXP 'flare'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, i.availability_zone, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, i.uuid, MAX(ism.id) OVER ( ORDER BY i.uuid ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_metadata_id_next_2 FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'flare' ), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(max_metadata_id_next_2) AS avg_max_metadata_id_next_2 FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.availability_zone, ic.vm_state, ic.memory_mb, ic.vcpus, ic.uuid, ic.max_metadata_id_next_2, (ic.max_metadata_id_next_2 - ac.avg_max_metadata_id_next_2) AS deviation_from_avg_max_metadata_id_next_2 FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte ac;

question: For the availability zone "flare3" on host "blaze8-12", how many non-deleted instances have a non-deleted network info cache entry, and what is the deviation of that count from the average such count across all (availability zone, host) pairs? Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS flare3_instances_with_network_cache FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), HostZoneCounts AS (SELECT i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, i.HOST, COUNT(*) AS instances_with_network_cache FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, i.HOST), AverageCount AS (SELECT AVG(instances_with_network_cache) AS avg_instances_with_network_cache FROM HostZoneCounts) SELECT ic.flare3_instances_with_network_cache, (ic.flare3_instances_with_network_cache - ac.avg_instances_with_network_cache) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AverageCount ac;

question: For confirmed migrations where the instance is on host "blaze8-12", show the migration status, source compute host, destination compute host, the instance display name, and the instance network_info, along with a dense rank within each migration status ordered by that status; also include the instance project_id and classify each row as 'HAS_PROJECT' when project_id is present or 'NO_PROJECT' otherwise. SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(m.id) AS migrations FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY migrations DESC LIMIT 10), DisplayNameImageType AS ( SELECT inner_cte.display_name, ism.value AS image_type, inner_cte.migrations FROM inner_cte JOIN instances i ON i.display_name = inner_cte.display_name JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE display_name END AS display_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(image_type) = 1 AND GROUPING(display_name) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(image_type) = 1 AND GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE image_type END AS image_type, SUM(migrations) AS migrations FROM DisplayNameImageType GROUP BY display_name, image_type WITH ROLLUP ORDER BY migrations DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each migration status and instance VM state (considering only active migrations where the instance has at least 8 vCPUs), return the number of migrations and the earliest migration creation time, along with the overall average migration count across all (migration status, VM state) groups and a utilization category of 'HIGH_MIGRATION_ACTIVITY' (at least 50% above average), 'LOW_MIGRATION_ACTIVITY' (at least 50% below average), or 'AVERAGE_MIGRATION_ACTIVITY'. evidence: "Active migrations" is predicated by "migrations.status NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.STATUS AS migration_status, ins.VM_STATE AS instance_vm_state, COUNT(m.ID) AS migration_count, MIN(m.CREATED_AT) AS earliest_migration_created_at FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES ins ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA ie ON ins.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ins.VCPUS >= 8 AND m.STATUS NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') GROUP BY m.STATUS, ins.VM_STATE), AverageMigrations AS ( SELECT AVG(migration_count) AS avg_migration_count FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.migration_status, ic.instance_vm_state, ic.migration_count, ic.earliest_migration_created_at, am.avg_migration_count AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.migration_count > am.avg_migration_count * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_MIGRATION_ACTIVITY' WHEN ic.migration_count < am.avg_migration_count * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_MIGRATION_ACTIVITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_MIGRATION_ACTIVITY' END AS migration_activity_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AverageMigrations am;

question: For security group rules that use the tcp protocol, list the security group ID, security group name, rule ID, rule CIDR, and the rank of each rule within its security group ordered by rule ID, but only keep those rules whose rule ID is greater than the average rule ID among all such tcp rules for services where the binary is 'nova-scheduler'. SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sg.ID AS security_group_id, sg.NAME AS security_group_name, sgr.ID AS rule_id, sgr.CIDR AS rule_cidr, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sg.ID ORDER BY sgr.ID) AS window_column FROM SECURITY_GROUPS AS sg JOIN SECURITY_GROUP_RULES AS sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID JOIN services AS s ON s.binary = 'nova-scheduler' WHERE sgr.PROTOCOL = 'tcp' ) SELECT security_group_id, security_group_name, rule_id, rule_cidr, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE rule_id > (SELECT AVG(rule_id) FROM inner_cte);

question: For each instance display name that matches 'prime', list the display name, the range/variance/standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of completed-migration counts per destination compute, and include a subtotal row per display name plus a grand total across all matching display names. evidence: "Display 'prime'" is predicated by "instances.display_name REGEXP 'prime'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(migration_count) - MIN(migration_count) AS migration_count_range, VARIANCE(migration_count) AS migration_count_variance, STDDEV(migration_count) AS migration_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid JOIN ( SELECT m.instance_uuid, m.dest_compute, COUNT(*) AS migration_count FROM migrations AS m WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY m.instance_uuid, m.dest_compute ) AS mig_stats ON i.uuid = mig_stats.instance_uuid WHERE i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY migration_count_range DESC) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE display_name END AS display_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 0 THEN 'DETAIL' ELSE 'SUBTOTAL/GRAND TOTAL' END AS row_type, SUM(migration_count_range) AS total_migration_count_range, AVG(migration_count_variance) AS avg_migration_count_variance, AVG(migration_count_stddev) AS avg_migration_count_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY display_name WITH ROLLUP;

question: For each instance display name that matches the pattern 'prime' (and is not deleted), show the memory range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of MEMORY_MB across that instance’s records, along with the overall average of the per-display-name memory ranges across all such display names. evidence: "Display 'prime'" is predicated by "instances.display_name REGEXP 'prime'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_mb_range, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev, avg_ranges.avg_memory_mb_range FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb_range) AS avg_memory_mb_range FROM inner_cte ) AS avg_ranges ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb_range DESC;

question: From the top 10 migration statuses (among active, non-deleted migrations with a non-deleted instance info cache entry) with the highest variance in instance memory (MB), display the migration status, average memory, memory variance, memory standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and the total vCPUs used by the instances in that status. evidence: "Active migrations" is predicated by "migrations.status NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.status, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.deleted = 0 AND ic.deleted = 0 AND m.status NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC) SELECT inner_cte.status, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus_in_status FROM inner_cte JOIN migrations AS m ON m.status = inner_cte.status JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.deleted = 0 AND ic.deleted = 0 AND m.status NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') GROUP BY inner_cte.status, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb_variance DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each VM state, list the VM state, the total number of instances that are on host 'blaze8-12' and have at least one instance system metadata entry where the metadata key is 'image_image_type', and the number of distinct users for those instances. question: For instances that are in the “flare3” availability zone and have a display name matching the pattern “flare”, report the minimum memory size in MB and the total (sum) of INSTANCE_EXTRA.ID values for those instances, along with how each of those two values deviates from its overall average across the same filtered set. question: For instance display names whose average memory usage is more than 75% of the maximum memory (in MB) observed among instances that have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type' and are hosted on 'blaze8-12', list the display name, average memory, memory variance, and the maximum memory used for the comparison. evidence: Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), max_mem AS ( SELECT MAX(i.memory_mb) AS max_memory_mb FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.avg_memory_mb, ic.memory_mb_variance, mm.max_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN max_mem mm WHERE (ic.avg_memory_mb * 1.0 / mm.max_memory_mb) > 0.75 ORDER BY ic.avg_memory_mb DESC;

question: For instances on host `blaze8-12` that are not deleted and have system metadata with the key `image_image_type`, list the image type value, the total number of matching instances, and the total number of network-info cache records across those instances. SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name, ism.value AS image_type_value, COUNT(iic.id) AS cache_record_count, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances i JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches iic ON iic.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, ism.value ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(image_type_value) OVER (ORDER BY image_type_sort, image_type_value) = image_type_value THEN NULL ELSE image_type_value END AS image_type_value, total_instances, total_cache_records FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(image_type_value) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE image_type_value END AS image_type_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(image_type_value) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE image_type_value END AS image_type_value, COUNT(DISTINCT instance_uuid) AS total_instances, SUM(cache_record_count) AS total_cache_records FROM inner_cte GROUP BY image_type_value WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY image_type_sort, image_type_value;

question: For completed migrations where the instance is on host "blaze8-12", list the migration id, migration status, source compute, destination compute, the instance display name, and the instance network info, along with the average migration id within each status group ordered by migration id; then return only those rows whose migration id is greater than the overall average migration id for this same set of migrations. question: For instances that are not deleted (DELETED = 0) and are on host "blaze8-12", group the results by whether the instance has cached network info ('HasCache' if a matching INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES row exists and 'NoCache' otherwise). question: For each migration status, show the status, the average/range/variance of instance memory size (in MB) for instances involved in active migrations that have the system metadata key 'image_image_type', and also show how that average memory compares to the overall average instance memory (in MB) across all such active-migration instances. question: For each `image_image_type` metadata value among instances on host `blaze8-12` (considering only instances that are not deleted and that have that system metadata key), find the maximum total memory (in MB) summed across network-info cache records for any single instance with that metadata value, and also report how many distinct instances achieve that maximum. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name, ism.value AS image_type_value, COUNT(iic.id) AS cache_record_count, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances i JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches iic ON iic.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, ism.value), MaxMemoryPerImageType AS ( SELECT image_type_value, MAX(total_memory_mb) AS max_total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte GROUP BY image_type_value ) SELECT m.image_type_value, m.max_total_memory_mb, COUNT(*) AS instance_count_at_max FROM MaxMemoryPerImageType m JOIN inner_cte ic ON ic.image_type_value = m.image_type_value AND ic.total_memory_mb = m.max_total_memory_mb GROUP BY m.image_type_value, m.max_total_memory_mb;

question: For instances in availability zone "flare3" that are running on host "blaze8-12", return only the rows whose vCPU count is greater than the average vCPU count of all instances on the same host within that availability zone, and list the instance UUID, display name, memory (MB), vCPUs, the instance extra flavor JSON, the system metadata key and value, and assign row numbers within each metadata key group ordered by instance UUID. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.FLAVOR AS flavor, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ), HostAverages AS ( SELECT i.HOST AS host, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE AS availability_zone, AVG(i.VCPUS * 1.0) AS avg_vcpus FROM INSTANCES AS i WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.HOST, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE ) SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.vcpus, inner_cte.flavor, inner_cte.metadata_key, inner_cte.metadata_value, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.vcpus > ( SELECT HostAverages.avg_vcpus FROM HostAverages ) ORDER BY inner_cte.metadata_key, inner_cte.instance_uuid;

question: For each instance display name and metadata key, among instances that are not deleted and are hosted on blaze8-12, return only those groups whose maximum instance memory (in MB) is greater than the overall average of these per-(display name, metadata key) maximum memories; also show the group’s maximum memory and the instance launched timestamp. evidence: Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) AS max_memory_mb, i.LAUNCHED_AT FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism JOIN INSTANCES i ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME, ism.KEY, i.LAUNCHED_AT HAVING MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) > 16000), MaxMemoryAverages AS ( SELECT AVG(inner_cte.max_memory_mb * 1.0) AS avg_of_group_max_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.metadata_key, inner_cte.max_memory_mb, inner_cte.LAUNCHED_AT FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.max_memory_mb > (SELECT avg_of_group_max_memory_mb FROM MaxMemoryAverages);

evidence: Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON iic.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.uuid HAVING SUM(i.memory_mb) > ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb) + STDDEV(memory_mb) FROM instances ) ) SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.total_memory_mb, iic.network_info FROM inner_cte JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON iic.instance_uuid = inner_cte.instance_uuid;

question: For each security group, list the security group name and its coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of rule port-range sizes (standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of (to_port − from_port) divided by the average of (to_port − from_port)), but only return those security groups whose coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) is greater than the overall average coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) across all non-deleted security groups and non-deleted rules, considering only enabled instance types (instance_types.disabled = false). Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "Enabled instance types" is predicated by "instance_types.disabled = false"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sg.name, STDDEV(sgr.to_port - sgr.from_port) / NULLIF(AVG(sgr.to_port - sgr.from_port), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SECURITY_GROUPS AS sg JOIN SECURITY_GROUP_RULES AS sgr ON sg.id = sgr.parent_group_id JOIN INSTANCE_TYPES AS it ON 1 = 1 WHERE sg.deleted = 0 AND sgr.deleted = 0 AND it.disabled = false GROUP BY sg.name HAVING AVG(sgr.to_port - sgr.from_port) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC), OverallAvg AS ( SELECT AVG(inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_cov FROM inner_cte ) SELECT inner_cte.name, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation > (SELECT avg_cov FROM OverallAvg) ORDER BY inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC;

question: From the top 10 instance display names (restricted to instances that are not deleted, have a power state of 4, and are running on host 'blaze8-12' using the instance UUID links between INSTANCES, INSTANCE_EXTRA, and INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES), show each display name, the minimum instance ID, the average memory (in MB), and whether any instance in that display-name group has a non-empty migration context recorded in INSTANCE_EXTRA. evidence: Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(i.ID) AS min_instance_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES ic ON ic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.POWER_STATE = 4 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ) SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, inner_cte.min_instance_id, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM INSTANCES i2 JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA ie2 ON ie2.INSTANCE_UUID = i2.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES ic2 ON ic2.INSTANCE_UUID = i2.UUID WHERE i2.DELETED = 0 AND i2.POWER_STATE = 4 AND i2.HOST = 'blaze8-12' AND i2.DISPLAY_NAME = i.DISPLAY_NAME AND ie2.MIGRATION_CONTEXT IS NOT NULL AND ie2.MIGRATION_CONTEXT <> '' ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_migration_context FROM inner_cte JOIN INSTANCES i ON i.ID = inner_cte.min_instance_id ORDER BY inner_cte.avg_memory_mb DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For the top 10 instance display names with the highest number of matching instance-extra records (considering only instances in the “flare3” availability zone that are hosted on “blaze8-12”), list the display name, the extra-record count, and the average memory (MB) of the instances in each display name group. Do not repeat the display name if it is the same as the previous row, and include a final TOTAL row across all returned display names. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(ie.id) AS extra_records FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY extra_records DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(display_name) OVER (ORDER BY display_name_sort, display_name) = display_name THEN NULL ELSE display_name END AS display_name, extra_records, avg_memory_mb FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.display_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE inner_cte.display_name END AS display_name_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.display_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE inner_cte.display_name END AS display_name, SUM(inner_cte.extra_records) AS extra_records, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON i.display_name = inner_cte.display_name AND i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY display_name_sort, display_name;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(ism.ID) AS metadata_records FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY metadata_records DESC LIMIT 10 ), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(metadata_records) AS avg_metadata_records FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.metadata_records, (ic.metadata_records - ac.avg_metadata_records) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte ac ORDER BY ic.metadata_records DESC;

question: For each VM state, show the VM state and the maximum (across projects) of the geometric mean of instance memory (in MB) for instances that have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type', where the instance memory is greater than 0, and only for instances running on host 'blaze8-12'. question: For instances in availability zone 'flare3' that are running on host 'blaze8-12', compute the average dense rank (based on ordering by the instance's memory in MB, using a window frame of the current row and the 2 preceding rows) across all such instances that have a system metadata key equal to 'image_image_type'. SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.UUID AS instance_uuid, t2.VALUE AS metadata_value, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t1.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND t1.HOST = 'blaze8-12' AND t2.KEY = 'image_image_type'), avg_rank AS ( SELECT AVG(window_column) AS avg_dense_rank FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ar.avg_dense_rank, CASE WHEN ar.avg_dense_rank >= 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_RANK' WHEN ar.avg_dense_rank <= 0.5 THEN 'LOW_RANK' ELSE 'AVERAGE_RANK' END AS rank_category FROM avg_rank ar;

question: For each instance display name, list the instance display name, the variance of instance memory (MB) among instances that have a matching row in INSTANCE_EXTRA, and the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of instance memory (MB) among instances that have a system metadata entry with KEY = 'image_image_type'. SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH InstanceExtraMemoryVariance AS ( SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), ImageTypeMemoryStats AS ( SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC ) SELECT iemv.display_name, iemv.memory_mb_variance, itms.avg_memory_mb, itms.memory_mb_stddev FROM InstanceExtraMemoryVariance iemv JOIN ImageTypeMemoryStats itms ON iemv.display_name = itms.display_name ORDER BY iemv.memory_mb_variance DESC) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev, COUNT(DISTINCT i1.uuid) AS instance_extra_instance_count, COUNT(DISTINCT i2.uuid) AS image_type_instance_count FROM inner_cte JOIN instances AS i1 ON i1.display_name = inner_cte.display_name JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i1.uuid JOIN instances AS i2 ON i2.display_name = inner_cte.display_name JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i2.uuid AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' WHERE inner_cte.memory_mb_variance > 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb_variance DESC;

question: For non-deleted instances in availability zone “flare3” whose display name is among the top 10 display names by number of completed migrations (counting migrations by migration ID and only for instances with a non-empty key name), list the instance UUID, display name, VM state, power state, memory (MB), vCPUs, the instance extra record ID, the maximum instance ID considering the current row and the next 2 rows when ordered by instance ID, the completed migrations count, the completed-migrations-per-vCPU ratio rounded, and keep only those rows whose completed-migrations-per-vCPU ratio is greater than the overall average completed-migrations-per-vCPU ratio across the same result set.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH InstanceDetails AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MAX(i.ID) OVER (ORDER BY i.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_id_next_2 FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' ), TopCompletedMigrations AS ( SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(m.id) AS completed_migrations FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.key_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY completed_migrations DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT id.instance_uuid, id.display_name, id.vm_state, id.power_state, id.memory_mb, id.vcpus, id.instance_extra_id, id.max_instance_id_next_2, tcm.completed_migrations, ROUND(tcm.completed_migrations / NULLIF(id.vcpus, 0), 2) AS completed_migrations_per_vcpu FROM InstanceDetails id JOIN TopCompletedMigrations tcm ON tcm.display_name = id.display_name ORDER BY completed_migrations_per_vcpu DESC, tcm.completed_migrations DESC ), OverallAvg AS ( SELECT AVG(inner_cte.completed_migrations * 1.0 / NULLIF(inner_cte.vcpus, 0)) AS avg_completed_migrations_per_vcpu FROM inner_cte ) SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.power_state, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.vcpus, inner_cte.instance_extra_id, inner_cte.max_instance_id_next_2, inner_cte.completed_migrations, inner_cte.completed_migrations_per_vcpu FROM inner_cte WHERE (inner_cte.completed_migrations * 1.0 / NULLIF(inner_cte.vcpus, 0)) > (SELECT avg_completed_migrations_per_vcpu FROM OverallAvg) ORDER BY inner_cte.completed_migrations_per_vcpu DESC, inner_cte.completed_migrations DESC;

question: For instance display names that are among the top 10 by number of completed migrations (counting only instances that have an `image_image_type` entry in instance system metadata), show the instance display name, the number of completed migrations, and the total memory (in MB) for those display names whose instances are in the `shelved_offloaded` VM state and have total memory greater than 50000 MB. Also include a subtotal row and a grand total row for the total memory and completed migrations. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH TopCompletedMigrations AS (SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(m.id) AS migrations FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY migrations DESC LIMIT 10), ShelvedOffloadedHighMemory AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) AS total_memory_mb FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME HAVING SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) > 50000) SELECT tcm.display_name, tcm.migrations AS completed_migrations, sohm.total_memory_mb FROM TopCompletedMigrations tcm JOIN ShelvedOffloadedHighMemory sohm ON tcm.display_name = sohm.display_name ORDER BY tcm.migrations DESC ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.display_name) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE inner_cte.display_name END AS display_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.display_name) = 1 THEN SUM(inner_cte.completed_migrations) ELSE SUM(inner_cte.completed_migrations) END AS completed_migrations, SUM(inner_cte.total_memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name WITH ROLLUP;

question: For completed migrations of instances in availability zone 'flare3' that have a system metadata key of 'image_image_type', list only those migrations whose memory_remaining is greater than the average memory_remaining across all such flare3 completed migrations, and show the instance UUID, display name, hostname, migration type, and memory_remaining. SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH instance_zone_metadata_rank AS ( SELECT t1.UUID AS instance_uuid, t2.VALUE AS metadata_value, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t1.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND t2.KEY = 'image_image_type' ), completed_migrations_memory AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.HOSTNAME AS instance_hostname, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE AS migration_source_compute, m.DEST_COMPUTE AS migration_dest_compute, m.DEST_HOST AS migration_dest_host, m.MIGRATION_TYPE AS migration_type, m.MEMORY_TOTAL AS memory_total, m.MEMORY_PROCESSED AS memory_processed, m.MEMORY_REMAINING AS memory_remaining, MIN(m.MEMORY_REMAINING) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.INSTANCE_UUID ORDER BY m.INSTANCE_UUID ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES i JOIN MIGRATIONS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' ), flare3_completed_migrations_with_image_type AS ( SELECT cmm.instance_uuid, cmm.instance_display_name, cmm.instance_hostname, cmm.migration_source_compute, cmm.migration_dest_compute, cmm.migration_dest_host, cmm.migration_type, cmm.memory_total, cmm.memory_processed, cmm.memory_remaining, cmm.window_column AS min_memory_remaining_within_instance_uuid FROM completed_migrations_memory cmm JOIN INSTANCES i ON i.UUID = cmm.instance_uuid JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS flare3_completed_migrations_with_image_type_count FROM flare3_completed_migrations_with_image_type) , flare3_migrations_detail AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.HOSTNAME AS instance_hostname, m.MIGRATION_TYPE AS migration_type, m.MEMORY_REMAINING AS memory_remaining FROM INSTANCES i JOIN MIGRATIONS m ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND m.STATUS = 'completed' AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' ), flare3_avg_memory_remaining AS ( SELECT AVG(fmd.memory_remaining * 1.0) AS avg_memory_remaining FROM flare3_migrations_detail fmd ) SELECT fmd.instance_uuid, fmd.instance_display_name, fmd.instance_hostname, fmd.migration_type, fmd.memory_remaining FROM flare3_migrations_detail fmd WHERE fmd.memory_remaining > (SELECT avg_memory_remaining FROM flare3_avg_memory_remaining);

question: For each key name used by instances in availability zone 'flare3' that have both system metadata and cached network info, find the maximum total vCPUs (summed across system metadata rows per instance) among those instances for that key name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH InstanceMetadataSummary AS (SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.key_name, COUNT(ism.id) AS metadata_entry_count, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus FROM instances i JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.key_name), InstanceNetworkWindow AS (SELECT t1.DISPLAY_NAME, t1.UUID AS instance_uuid, t2.NETWORK_INFO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.DISPLAY_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t1.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3') SELECT ims.instance_uuid, ims.display_name, ims.key_name, ims.metadata_entry_count, ims.total_vcpus, inw.NETWORK_INFO, inw.window_column FROM InstanceMetadataSummary ims JOIN InstanceNetworkWindow inw ON ims.instance_uuid = inw.instance_uuid ORDER BY ims.display_name, ims.instance_uuid) SELECT key_name, MAX(total_vcpus) AS max_total_vcpus_per_instance_for_key FROM inner_cte GROUP BY key_name;

question: For instances that have completed migrations, list each instance display name, instance UUID, migration destination host, instance memory (MB), the windowed average instance memory (MB) within each instance UUID group ordered by destination host, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of memory remaining (bytes) across completed migrations for that display name, compute the average-memory-remaining to instance-memory ratio (avg memory remaining bytes divided by instance memory bytes), and also show the deviation of that ratio from the overall average ratio across all completed-migration instances, ordered by this deviation descending.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH MemoryStatsByDisplayName AS ( SELECT i.display_name, AVG(m.memory_remaining) AS avg_memory_remaining_bytes, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) AS memory_remaining_stddev_bytes FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_remaining_stddev_bytes DESC ), CompletedMigrationInstanceDetails AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.UUID, i.MEMORY_MB, m.STATUS, m.DEST_HOST, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.UUID ORDER BY m.DEST_HOST) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' ORDER BY m.DEST_HOST ) SELECT cmd.DISPLAY_NAME, cmd.UUID AS instance_uuid, cmd.DEST_HOST, cmd.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, cmd.window_column AS avg_instance_memory_mb_within_uuid_by_dest_host, ms.avg_memory_remaining_bytes, ms.memory_remaining_stddev_bytes, ROUND(ms.avg_memory_remaining_bytes / NULLIF(cmd.MEMORY_MB * 1024 * 1024, 0), 6) AS avg_memory_remaining_to_instance_memory_ratio FROM CompletedMigrationInstanceDetails AS cmd JOIN MemoryStatsByDisplayName AS ms ON cmd.DISPLAY_NAME = ms.display_name ORDER BY avg_memory_remaining_to_instance_memory_ratio DESC ), AverageRatio AS ( SELECT AVG(avg_memory_remaining_to_instance_memory_ratio) AS overall_avg_ratio FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.instance_uuid, ic.DEST_HOST, ic.instance_memory_mb, ic.avg_instance_memory_mb_within_uuid_by_dest_host, ic.avg_memory_remaining_bytes, ic.memory_remaining_stddev_bytes, ic.avg_memory_remaining_to_instance_memory_ratio, (ic.avg_memory_remaining_to_instance_memory_ratio - ar.overall_avg_ratio) AS deviation_from_overall_avg_ratio FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AverageRatio ar ORDER BY deviation_from_overall_avg_ratio DESC;

question: For display name 'forge', return only the per-instance metadata rows (instance UUID, hostname, metadata key, and the running sum of instance IDs within each metadata key group ordered by instance ID) where the running sum is greater than the average running sum for the same metadata key among 'forge' instances that have a non-deleted instance info cache record; include a “reason” column indicating why each row is included. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH ForgeInstanceMetadata AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, SUM(i.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge'), MigrationStatsByDisplayName AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(s.migration_count) - MIN(s.migration_count) AS migration_count_range, VARIANCE(s.migration_count) AS migration_count_variance, STDDEV(s.migration_count) AS migration_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid JOIN ( SELECT m.instance_uuid, COUNT(*) AS migration_count FROM migrations AS m GROUP BY m.instance_uuid, m.dest_compute ) AS s ON i.uuid = s.instance_uuid WHERE ic.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY migration_count_range DESC), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT fim.instance_uuid, fim.hostname, fim.metadata_key, fim.window_column, NULL AS migration_count_range, NULL AS migration_count_variance, NULL AS migration_count_stddev, 'Forge Instance Metadata' AS reason FROM ForgeInstanceMetadata fim UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS instance_uuid, NULL AS hostname, NULL AS metadata_key, NULL AS window_column, ms.migration_count_range, ms.migration_count_variance, ms.migration_count_stddev, 'Migration Stats By Display Name' AS reason FROM MigrationStatsByDisplayName ms WHERE ms.display_name = 'forge' ) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY reason, instance_uuid, hostname, metadata_key) SELECT icr.instance_uuid, icr.hostname, icr.metadata_key, icr.window_column, 'Above-key average running-sum (non-deleted cache only)' AS reason FROM inner_cte icr JOIN instances i ON i.uuid = icr.instance_uuid JOIN instance_info_caches ic ON ic.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE icr.reason = 'Forge Instance Metadata' AND ic.deleted = 0 AND icr.window_column > ( SELECT AVG(icr2.window_column * 1.0) FROM inner_cte icr2 JOIN instances i2 ON i2.uuid = icr2.instance_uuid JOIN instance_info_caches ic2 ON ic2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid WHERE icr2.reason = 'Forge Instance Metadata' AND ic2.deleted = 0 AND icr2.metadata_key = icr.metadata_key ) ORDER BY icr.metadata_key, icr.window_column, icr.instance_uuid;

question: For each VM state and completed-migration status category (label as 'HasCompletedMigration' if any completed migrations exist for that VM state among instances with display name 'forge', otherwise 'NoCompletedMigration'), list the VM state, the category label, and the number of distinct forge instances. Include subtotals for each VM state and a grand total. Use the forge instances that also have completed migrations, and keep the per-instance window outputs (running sum of instance memory within VM state ordered by memory, and the 3-preceding/1-following minimum memory window over completed migrations ordered by migration ID) as the inner CTE. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH ForgeInstanceWindow AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' ), CompletedMigrationWindow AS ( SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.status, MIN(i.memory_mb) OVER ( ORDER BY m.id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' ) SELECT f.instance_uuid, f.hostname, f.instance_extra_id, f.window_column AS forge_running_memory_sum_mb_by_vm_state, cm.display_name, cm.source_compute, cm.dest_compute, cm.status AS migration_status, cm.window_column AS completed_migration_min_memory_mb_window FROM ForgeInstanceWindow AS f JOIN CompletedMigrationWindow AS cm ON cm.uuid = f.instance_uuid WHERE cm.display_name = 'forge' ORDER BY f.instance_uuid, cm.source_compute, cm.dest_compute ), ForgeVmStateMigrationStatus AS ( SELECT i.vm_state, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM migrations m WHERE m.instance_uuid = i.uuid AND m.status = 'completed' AND m.deleted = 0 ) THEN 'HasCompletedMigration' ELSE 'NoCompletedMigration' END AS completed_migration_category, COUNT(DISTINCT i.uuid) AS total_instances FROM inner_cte ic JOIN instances i ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.vm_state, completed_migration_category ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(vm_state) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE vm_state END AS vm_state, CASE WHEN GROUPING(completed_migration_category) = 1 AND GROUPING(vm_state) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE completed_migration_category END AS completed_migration_category, SUM(total_instances) AS total_instances FROM ForgeVmStateMigrationStatus GROUP BY vm_state, completed_migration_category WITH ROLLUP;

question: For instances that are both (1) non-deleted and in VM state 'shelved_offloaded' with system metadata, and (2) have display name 'forge', list the instance UUID, hostname, display name, project ID, power state, system metadata key/value, VM state, memory (MB), cached network info JSON, the max instance memory (MB) over the current row and next 2 rows ordered by instance UUID, the min memory (MB) over a 2-preceding/2-following window ordered by instance ID, the instance’s vCPU count, and the deviation of that vCPU count from the average vCPU count across all matching instances. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH ShelvedOffloadedInstancesWithMetadata AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.PROJECT_ID AS project_id, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (ORDER BY i.UUID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_memory_mb_next_2 FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded'), ForgeInstancesWithNetworkInfo AS (SELECT i.UUID, i.HOSTNAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, c.NETWORK_INFO, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( ORDER BY i.ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge') SELECT f.UUID AS instance_uuid, f.HOSTNAME AS hostname, s.display_name, s.project_id, s.power_state, s.metadata_key, s.metadata_value, f.VM_STATE AS vm_state, f.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, f.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, s.max_memory_mb_next_2, f.window_column AS min_memory_mb_window_2_pre_2_fol FROM ForgeInstancesWithNetworkInfo AS f JOIN ShelvedOffloadedInstancesWithMetadata AS s ON s.instance_uuid = f.UUID ORDER BY f.UUID, s.metadata_key ), InstanceVcpu AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.VCPUS AS vcpus FROM INSTANCES i ), AverageVcpu AS ( SELECT AVG(v.vcpus) AS avg_vcpus FROM InstanceVcpu v JOIN inner_cte ic ON ic.instance_uuid = v.instance_uuid ) SELECT ic.instance_uuid, ic.hostname, ic.display_name, ic.project_id, ic.power_state, ic.metadata_key, ic.metadata_value, ic.vm_state, ic.memory_mb, ic.network_info, ic.max_memory_mb_next_2, ic.min_memory_mb_window_2_pre_2_fol, v.vcpus, (v.vcpus - av.avg_vcpus) AS deviation_from_avg_vcpus FROM inner_cte ic JOIN InstanceVcpu v ON v.instance_uuid = ic.instance_uuid CROSS JOIN AverageVcpu av ORDER BY ic.instance_uuid, ic.metadata_key;

question: For migrations with status = 'completed', list the migration status, source compute, destination compute, instance display name, instance flavor JSON, the dense rank (partitioned by migration status and ordered by migration status), and also include (joined by status) the variance of instance memory (in MB) for each migration status among instances that have an instance info cache record. Additionally, for each migration status, include the total number of completed migrations (as a subtotal per status) and a grand total across all statuses. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH CompletedMigrationDetails AS ( SELECT m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, i.display_name, ie.flavor, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.status ORDER BY m.status) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' ), MigrationStatusMemoryVariance AS ( SELECT m.status, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.deleted = 0 GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT cmd.status, cmd.source_compute, cmd.dest_compute, cmd.display_name, cmd.flavor, cmd.window_column, msmv.memory_mb_variance FROM CompletedMigrationDetails AS cmd JOIN MigrationStatusMemoryVariance AS msmv ON cmd.status = msmv.status ORDER BY msmv.memory_mb_variance DESC, cmd.status, cmd.window_column ), StatusCounts AS ( SELECT m.status, COUNT(*) AS completed_migrations FROM migrations m WHERE m.deleted = 0 AND m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY m.status ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.status) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE i.status END AS status, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.source_compute) = 1 AND GROUPING(i.status) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE i.source_compute END AS source_compute, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.dest_compute) = 1 AND GROUPING(i.status) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE i.dest_compute END AS dest_compute, MAX(i.display_name) AS display_name, MAX(i.flavor) AS flavor, MAX(i.window_column) AS window_column, MAX(i.memory_mb_variance) AS memory_mb_variance, SUM(COALESCE(sc.completed_migrations, 0)) AS completed_migrations FROM inner_cte i LEFT JOIN StatusCounts sc ON i.status = sc.status GROUP BY i.status, i.source_compute, i.dest_compute WITH ROLLUP;

question: For the completed migrations belonging to the top 10 instance display names with the most system metadata entries where the metadata key is 'image_image_type' and the instance is not deleted, return only those migrations whose metadata entry count is greater than the average metadata entry count across those top 10 instances. Include the migration ID, instance display name, instance availability zone, migration status, the migration’s rank within the 'completed' status group ordered by migration ID, and the instance’s metadata entry count. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH top_metadata AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(ism.ID) AS metadata_entries FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY metadata_entries DESC LIMIT 10 ), completed_migrations AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE AS instance_availability_zone, m.STATUS AS migration_status, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' ) SELECT cm.migration_id, cm.instance_display_name, cm.instance_availability_zone, cm.migration_status, cm.window_column, tm.metadata_entries FROM completed_migrations cm JOIN top_metadata tm ON tm.DISPLAY_NAME = cm.instance_display_name ORDER BY tm.metadata_entries DESC, cm.migration_id ) SELECT migration_id, instance_display_name, instance_availability_zone, migration_status, window_column, metadata_entries FROM inner_cte WHERE metadata_entries > (SELECT AVG(metadata_entries) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY metadata_entries DESC, migration_id;

question: From the top 10 instance display names with the most completed migrations (counting migration IDs) where the instance key name is not NULL, show each display name and its completed migration count, along with the matching instance UUID, VM state, memory in MB, vCPU count, key name, related instance_extra record ID, the minimum memory_mb within its vCPU group, and whether that instance has any non-completed (active) migrations. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH sq1 AS ( SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, i.KEY_NAME, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, min(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.VCPUS ORDER BY i.VCPUS) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' ), sq2 AS ( SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(m.id) AS completed_migrations FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.key_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY completed_migrations DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT sq2.display_name, sq2.completed_migrations, sq1.uuid, sq1.vm_state, sq1.memory_mb, sq1.vcpus, sq1.key_name, sq1.instance_extra_id, sq1.window_column AS min_memory_mb_in_vcpu_group FROM sq2 JOIN sq1 ON sq2.display_name = sq1.display_name ORDER BY sq2.completed_migrations DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.completed_migrations, inner_cte.uuid, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.vcpus, inner_cte.key_name, inner_cte.instance_extra_id, inner_cte.min_memory_mb_in_vcpu_group, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM migrations m2 JOIN instances i2 ON m2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid WHERE i2.uuid = inner_cte.uuid AND m2.deleted = 0 AND m2.status NOT IN ('completed', 'failed', 'error') ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_active_migrations FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.completed_migrations DESC;

question: Using only migrations with status = 'completed', produce a rollup summary by availability zone and section label (Migration Details vs Migration Memory Window) showing the number of rows in each section, plus subtotals per availability zone and a grand total. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH CompletedMigrationDetails AS ( SELECT m.id AS migration_id, m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.dest_host, i.display_name, i.vm_state, MAX(i.memory_mb) OVER (ORDER BY m.id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_memory_mb_next_2 FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' ), CompletedMigrationMemoryWindow AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE AS source_compute, m.DEST_COMPUTE AS dest_compute, m.MEMORY_TOTAL AS memory_total, AVG(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) OVER ( PARTITION BY i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE ORDER BY m.MEMORY_TOTAL ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES i JOIN MIGRATIONS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' ORDER BY m.MEMORY_TOTAL ), CombinedCompletedMigrations AS ( SELECT cmd.migration_id, cmd.status AS migration_status, cmd.source_compute, cmd.dest_compute, cmd.dest_host, cmd.display_name AS instance_display_name, cmd.vm_state, cmd.max_memory_mb_next_2, NULL AS instance_uuid, NULL AS memory_total, NULL AS avg_memory_total_window, 'Migration Details (Max Instance Memory Next 2)' AS reason FROM CompletedMigrationDetails cmd UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS migration_id, cmmw.migration_status, cmmw.source_compute, cmmw.dest_compute, NULL AS dest_host, cmmw.instance_display_name, NULL AS vm_state, NULL AS max_memory_mb_next_2, cmmw.instance_uuid, cmmw.memory_total, cmmw.window_column AS avg_memory_total_window, 'Migration Memory Window (Avg Memory Total ±2 in AZ)' AS reason FROM CompletedMigrationMemoryWindow cmmw ) SELECT migration_id, migration_status, source_compute, dest_compute, dest_host, instance_uuid, instance_display_name, vm_state, max_memory_mb_next_2, memory_total, avg_memory_total_window, reason FROM CombinedCompletedMigrations ORDER BY reason, migration_id, instance_uuid ), LabeledRows AS ( SELECT i.availability_zone, inner_cte.reason, COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN instances i ON i.uuid = COALESCE(inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.instance_uuid) GROUP BY i.availability_zone, inner_cte.reason ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(availability_zone) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE availability_zone END AS availability_zone, CASE WHEN GROUPING(reason) = 1 AND GROUPING(availability_zone) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE reason END AS reason, SUM(row_count) AS total_rows FROM LabeledRows GROUP BY availability_zone, reason WITH ROLLUP;

question: From the top 10 VM states with the highest variance in instance memory (MB) among non-deleted instances that have a matching row in INSTANCE_EXTRA, display each VM state’s average/variance/standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of memory, along with (for comparison) each migration status’s average/variance/standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of instance memory (MB) considering only non-deleted migrations (and only instances that also have a matching row in INSTANCE_EXTRA). Additionally, for each VM state, show the total vCPUs and total memory (MB) used by instances in that VM state, and whether there exist any active (non-completed/failed/error) non-deleted migrations for instances in that VM state. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH vm_state_stats AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), migration_status_stats AS ( SELECT m.status, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.deleted = 0 GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), top_vm_state_by_variance AS ( SELECT VM_STATE, memory_mb_variance FROM vm_state_stats LIMIT 10 ) SELECT tvs.VM_STATE, vss.avg_memory_mb AS vm_state_avg_memory_mb, vss.memory_mb_variance AS vm_state_memory_mb_variance, vss.memory_mb_stddev AS vm_state_memory_mb_stddev, mss.status AS migration_status, mss.avg_memory_mb AS migration_status_avg_memory_mb, mss.memory_mb_variance AS migration_status_memory_mb_variance, mss.memory_mb_stddev AS migration_status_memory_mb_stddev FROM top_vm_state_by_variance tvs JOIN vm_state_stats vss ON tvs.VM_STATE = vss.VM_STATE CROSS JOIN migration_status_stats mss ORDER BY tvs.memory_mb_variance DESC, mss.memory_mb_variance DESC) SELECT ic.VM_STATE, ic.vm_state_avg_memory_mb, ic.vm_state_memory_mb_variance, ic.vm_state_memory_mb_stddev, ic.migration_status, ic.migration_status_avg_memory_mb, ic.migration_status_memory_mb_variance, ic.migration_status_memory_mb_stddev, SUM(i.vcpus) AS vm_state_total_vcpus, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS vm_state_total_memory_mb, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM migrations m2 JOIN instances i2 ON m2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid JOIN instance_extra ie2 ON i2.uuid = ie2.instance_uuid WHERE i2.vm_state = ic.vm_state AND i2.deleted = 0 AND m2.deleted = 0 AND m2.status NOT IN ('completed', 'failed', 'error') ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_active_migrations_in_vm_state FROM inner_cte ic JOIN instances i ON i.vm_state = ic.vm_state AND i.deleted = 0 JOIN instance_extra ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid GROUP BY ic.VM_STATE, ic.vm_state_avg_memory_mb, ic.vm_state_memory_mb_variance, ic.vm_state_memory_mb_stddev, ic.migration_status, ic.migration_status_avg_memory_mb, ic.migration_status_memory_mb_variance, ic.migration_status_memory_mb_stddev ORDER BY ic.vm_state_memory_mb_variance DESC, ic.migration_status_memory_mb_variance DESC;

question: For instances whose display name is 'forge' and whose total memory (summed across their records) is greater than the overall average memory plus one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), list the instance UUID, hostname, system metadata key, the running sum of instance IDs within each metadata key group (ordered by instance ID), the instance’s total memory (MB), and whether the instance has any associated instance_info_caches record. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH subq1 AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, SUM(i.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' ), subq2 AS ( SELECT i.uuid, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.uuid HAVING SUM(i.memory_mb) > ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb) + STDDEV(memory_mb) FROM instances ) ) SELECT subq1.instance_uuid, subq1.hostname, subq1.metadata_key, subq1.window_column, subq2.total_memory_mb FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.instance_uuid = subq2.uuid ORDER BY subq2.total_memory_mb DESC, subq1.metadata_key, subq1.window_column ) SELECT c.instance_uuid, c.hostname, c.metadata_key, c.window_column, c.total_memory_mb, CASE WHEN ic.instance_uuid IS NOT NULL THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_info_cache FROM inner_cte c LEFT JOIN instance_info_caches ic ON ic.instance_uuid = c.instance_uuid ORDER BY c.total_memory_mb DESC, c.metadata_key, c.window_column;

question: For completed migrations (only where the instance has a maximum recorded migration total memory greater than 0), list each migration’s ID, source compute, destination compute, instance display name, the instance’s maximum total memory across its completed migrations, the migration’s rank within the completed status group (ordered by migration ID), and the ratio of that maximum total memory divided by the migration rank (rounded to 2 decimals). Also include a subtotal row labeled TOTAL that shows the total number of such migrations and the average of the max-memory-per-rank ratio across all returned migrations, and do not repeat the instance display name if it is the same as the previous row.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH MaxMemoryByInstanceStatus AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(m.memory_total) AS max_memory_total, m.status FROM instances i JOIN migrations m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY i.display_name, m.status HAVING MAX(m.memory_total) > 0 ), CompletedMigrationsRanked AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND ic.DELETED = 0 ) SELECT cmr.migration_id, cmr.SOURCE_COMPUTE, cmr.DEST_COMPUTE, cmr.instance_display_name, mm.max_memory_total, cmr.window_column AS migration_rank_within_completed_status, ROUND(mm.max_memory_total / NULLIF(cmr.window_column, 0), 2) AS max_memory_per_rank_ratio FROM CompletedMigrationsRanked cmr JOIN MaxMemoryByInstanceStatus mm ON cmr.instance_display_name = mm.display_name ORDER BY max_memory_per_rank_ratio DESC, cmr.migration_id) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(instance_display_name) OVER (ORDER BY instance_sort, max_memory_per_rank_ratio DESC, migration_id) = instance_display_name THEN NULL ELSE instance_display_name END AS instance_display_name, migration_id, source_compute, dest_compute, max_memory_total, migration_rank_within_completed_status, max_memory_per_rank_ratio, total_migrations, avg_max_memory_per_rank_ratio FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.instance_display_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.instance_display_name END AS instance_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.instance_display_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.instance_display_name END AS instance_display_name, i.migration_id, i.source_compute, i.dest_compute, i.max_memory_total, i.migration_rank_within_completed_status, i.max_memory_per_rank_ratio, COUNT(i.migration_id) AS total_migrations, AVG(i.max_memory_per_rank_ratio) AS avg_max_memory_per_rank_ratio FROM inner_cte i GROUP BY i.instance_display_name, i.migration_id, i.source_compute, i.dest_compute, i.max_memory_total, i.migration_rank_within_completed_status, i.max_memory_per_rank_ratio WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY instance_sort, max_memory_per_rank_ratio DESC, migration_id;

question: For each system metadata key, find the key and the highest average memory (MB) among instance display names in the “shelved_offloaded” VM state, and also include the corresponding memory standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), instance UUID, instance extra flavor JSON, and the dense rank partitioned by that system metadata key (considering only non-deleted instance extra and system metadata rows).
