Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH MemoryStatsByDisplayName AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC), NonDeletedInstanceMetadata AS (SELECT ie.INSTANCE_UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, ie.FLAVOR, ism.KEY, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY ism.KEY) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ie.DELETED = 0 AND ism.DELETED = 0) SELECT ms.display_name, ms.avg_memory_mb, ms.memory_mb_stddev, ndm.INSTANCE_UUID, ndm.FLAVOR, ndm.KEY, ndm.window_column FROM MemoryStatsByDisplayName ms JOIN NonDeletedInstanceMetadata ndm ON ndm.DISPLAY_NAME = ms.display_name JOIN INSTANCES i ON i.UUID = ndm.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded') SELECT inner_cte.KEY, MAX(inner_cte.avg_memory_mb) AS max_avg_memory_mb, MAX(inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev) AS memory_mb_stddev_for_max_avg, MAX(inner_cte.INSTANCE_UUID) AS instance_uuid_for_max_avg, MAX(inner_cte.FLAVOR) AS flavor_for_max_avg, MAX(inner_cte.window_column) AS dense_rank_for_max_avg FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.KEY;

question: For instances in availability zone 'flare3' that have migrations where the instance memory is greater than zero, list each instance’s display name, availability zone, VM state, memory (MB), vCPU count, instance UUID, and the maximum system-metadata ID over a window of the current row plus the next 2 rows ordered by instance UUID, along with the migration status and the geometric mean migrated-instance memory (MB) for that status; additionally, include the migration’s source and destination compute hosts and the maximum migration ID over a window of the current row plus the next 2 rows ordered by instance UUID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH sq1 AS ( SELECT i.display_name, i.availability_zone, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, i.uuid, MAX(ism.id) OVER ( ORDER BY i.uuid ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_metadata_id_next_2 FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' ), sq2 AS ( SELECT m.status, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC ) SELECT sq1.display_name, sq1.availability_zone, sq1.vm_state, sq1.memory_mb, sq1.vcpus, sq1.uuid, sq1.max_metadata_id_next_2, sq2.status AS migration_status, sq2.geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM sq1 JOIN migrations AS m ON m.instance_uuid = sq1.uuid JOIN sq2 ON sq2.status = m.status JOIN instances AS i2 ON i2.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE i2.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i2.memory_mb > 0 ORDER BY sq2.geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC, sq1.uuid ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.availability_zone, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.vcpus, inner_cte.uuid, inner_cte.max_metadata_id_next_2, inner_cte.migration_status, inner_cte.geometric_mean_memory_mb, m2.source_compute, m2.dest_compute, MAX(m2.id) OVER ( ORDER BY inner_cte.uuid ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_migration_id_next_2 FROM inner_cte JOIN migrations AS m2 ON m2.instance_uuid = inner_cte.uuid JOIN instances AS i3 ON i3.uuid = inner_cte.uuid WHERE i3.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i3.memory_mb > 0 ORDER BY inner_cte.geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC, inner_cte.uuid;

question: For each completed migration whose instance is in availability zone 'flare3', list the migration id, status, source compute, destination compute, destination host, instance display name, instance VM state, the maximum instance memory (in MB) over a window ordered by migration id that includes the current row and the next 2 rows, along with the instance UUID, key name, metadata entry count, total vCPUs across those metadata rows, and the average vCPUs per metadata entry (total vCPUs divided by Avg metadata entry count) rounded. Also include subtotals by migration status and a grand total of migrations using a rollup.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH CompletedMigrations AS ( SELECT m.id AS migration_id, m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.dest_host, i.display_name, i.vm_state, MAX(i.memory_mb) OVER (ORDER BY m.id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_memory_mb_next_2 FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' ), Flare3InstanceMetadata AS ( SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.key_name, COUNT(ism.id) AS metadata_entry_count, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus FROM instances i JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.key_name ) SELECT cm.migration_id, cm.status, cm.source_compute, cm.dest_compute, cm.dest_host, cm.display_name, cm.vm_state, cm.max_memory_mb_next_2, fim.instance_uuid, fim.key_name, fim.metadata_entry_count, fim.total_vcpus, ROUND(fim.total_vcpus / NULLIF(fim.metadata_entry_count, 0), 2) AS Avg_vCPUs_Per_Metadata_Entry FROM CompletedMigrations cm JOIN migrations m ON m.id = cm.migration_id JOIN Flare3InstanceMetadata fim ON fim.instance_uuid = m.instance_uuid ORDER BY Avg_vCPUs_Per_Metadata_Entry DESC, cm.migration_id ), StatusRollup AS ( SELECT status, COUNT(DISTINCT migration_id) AS total_migrations, SUM(metadata_entry_count) AS total_metadata_entries, SUM(total_vcpus) AS total_vcpus FROM inner_cte GROUP BY status WITH ROLLUP ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(status) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE status END AS status, SUM(total_migrations) AS total_migrations, SUM(total_metadata_entries) AS total_metadata_entries, SUM(total_vcpus) AS total_vcpus, ROUND(SUM(total_vcpus) / NULLIF(SUM(total_metadata_entries), 0), 2) AS Avg_vCPUs_Per_Metadata_Entry FROM StatusRollup GROUP BY status WITH ROLLUP;

question: For each instance display name that is not deleted and is in the “shelved_offloaded” VM state (with extra metadata and more than 5 records), list the instance display name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of its memory_mb across system metadata rows, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of its memory_mb, and the deviation of that instance’s coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) from the overall average coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) across all returned instances. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH InstanceMemoryCV AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) / NULLIF(AVG(i.memory_mb), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(i.memory_mb) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC), ShelvedOffloadedMemoryStddev AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC) SELECT imcv.display_name, imcv.coefficient_of_variation, soms.memory_mb_stddev FROM InstanceMemoryCV imcv JOIN ShelvedOffloadedMemoryStddev soms ON imcv.display_name = soms.display_name ORDER BY imcv.coefficient_of_variation DESC), AverageCV AS ( SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.coefficient_of_variation, ic.memory_mb_stddev, (ic.coefficient_of_variation - ac.avg_coefficient_of_variation) AS deviation_from_avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AverageCV ac ORDER BY ic.coefficient_of_variation DESC;

question: For each project that has at least one non-deleted instance in VM state 'shelved_offloaded' and also has at least one migration with status 'completed' for those instances, list the project ID and the maximum of the per-instance “max memory (MB) over the current row and next 2 rows ordered by instance UUID”, along with the maximum of the per-migration “min memory (MB) over a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by migration ID” within that project. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH ShelvedOffloadedInstances AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.PROJECT_ID AS project_id, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (ORDER BY i.UUID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_memory_mb_next_2 FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' ), CompletedMigrations AS ( SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.status, MIN(i.memory_mb) OVER ( ORDER BY m.id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' ) SELECT soi.instance_uuid, soi.display_name AS shelved_display_name, soi.project_id, soi.power_state, soi.metadata_key, soi.metadata_value, soi.max_memory_mb_next_2, cm.source_compute, cm.dest_compute, cm.status AS migration_status, cm.window_column AS min_memory_mb_window_3_preceding_1_following FROM ShelvedOffloadedInstances soi JOIN CompletedMigrations cm ON cm.uuid = soi.instance_uuid ORDER BY soi.instance_uuid) SELECT inner_cte.project_id, MAX(inner_cte.max_memory_mb_next_2) AS max_of_instance_max_memory_mb_next_2, MAX(inner_cte.min_memory_mb_window_3_preceding_1_following) AS max_of_migration_min_memory_mb_window FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.project_id ORDER BY inner_cte.project_id;

question: For instance display names in availability zone 'flare3' that (a) have INSTANCE_EXTRA rows and (b) also have an INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES entry with more than 5 matching instances, show each display name’s memory (MEMORY_MB) range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) (from the INSTANCE_EXTRA population), along with the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) computed only over instances that have both INSTANCE_EXTRA and INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES; additionally, include subtotals per display name and a grand total across all qualifying display names. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH StddevWithNetworkAndExtra AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC ), RangeVarianceStddevWithExtra AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC ) SELECT r.display_name, r.memory_mb_range, r.memory_mb_variance, r.memory_mb_stddev AS memory_mb_stddev_with_extra, s.memory_mb_stddev AS memory_mb_stddev_with_extra_and_network_info_cache FROM RangeVarianceStddevWithExtra r JOIN StddevWithNetworkAndExtra s ON r.display_name = s.display_name ORDER BY r.memory_mb_range DESC ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.display_name) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE inner_cte.display_name END AS display_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.display_name) = 0 THEN 'DETAIL' ELSE 'TOTAL' END AS row_type, AVG(inner_cte.memory_mb_range) AS avg_memory_mb_range, AVG(inner_cte.memory_mb_variance) AS avg_memory_mb_variance, AVG(inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev_with_extra) AS avg_memory_mb_stddev_with_extra, AVG(inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev_with_extra_and_network_info_cache) AS avg_memory_mb_stddev_with_extra_and_network_info_cache FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name WITH ROLLUP;

question: Using the top 10 instances with the highest coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) in completed-migration memory remaining, show a rollup summary by instance (display name and creation timestamp) that includes the maximum completed-migration total memory (only where that maximum is greater than 0), the average coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and a grand total row. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH sq1 AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(m.memory_total) AS max_memory_total, i.created_at FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY i.display_name, i.created_at, m.status HAVING MAX(m.memory_total) > 0 ), sq2 AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT sq2.display_name, sq1.created_at, sq1.max_memory_total, sq2.coefficient_of_variation FROM sq2 JOIN sq1 ON sq2.display_name = sq1.display_name ORDER BY sq2.coefficient_of_variation DESC LIMIT 10 ), Top10WithDetails AS ( SELECT ic.display_name, ic.created_at, ic.max_memory_total, ic.coefficient_of_variation, i.uuid AS instance_uuid FROM inner_cte ic JOIN instances i ON i.display_name = ic.display_name AND i.created_at = ic.created_at JOIN instance_extra ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE display_name END AS display_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(created_at) = 1 AND GROUPING(display_name) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE CAST(created_at AS CHAR) END AS created_at, MAX(max_memory_total) AS max_completed_migration_memory_total, AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM Top10WithDetails GROUP BY display_name, created_at WITH ROLLUP;

question: For the top 10 display names (among non-deleted instances) with the highest total vCPU usage, show the display name, total vCPUs, total memory in MB, and whether that display name has any instances that appear in the detailed “forge” instance report (including hostname, VM state, memory window minimum, cached network info, and ranked system metadata rows). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH InstanceSystemMetadataRanks AS (SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, ism.KEY, ism.VALUE, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0), ForgeInstanceMemoryWindows AS (SELECT i.UUID, i.HOSTNAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, c.NETWORK_INFO, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( ORDER BY i.ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge') SELECT f.UUID, f.HOSTNAME, f.VM_STATE, f.MEMORY_MB, f.NETWORK_INFO, f.window_column AS Min_Memory_MB_Window_2_Preceding_2_Following, ism.KEY AS System_Metadata_Key, ism.VALUE AS System_Metadata_Value, ism.window_column AS Metadata_Rank_Within_Key_By_UUID FROM ForgeInstanceMemoryWindows f JOIN InstanceSystemMetadataRanks ism ON f.UUID = ism.UUID WHERE ism.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' ORDER BY f.UUID, ism.KEY, ism.window_column) SELECT i.display_name AS display_name, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inner_cte d JOIN instances i2 ON i2.uuid = d.uuid WHERE i2.display_name = i.display_name AND i2.deleted = 0) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_any_instances_in_forge_detail_report FROM instances i WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY total_vcpus DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For instance display names that (1) have a migration with status equal to 'completed' and (2) have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type', list the instance display name, the migration status, the migration destination compute host, the row number ordered by destination compute using a window frame of 2 preceding rows and 1 following row, and the average and variance of instance memory (in MB) for that display name. Also include subtotals per migration destination compute and a grand total, showing the number of distinct display names in each rollup row. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH CompletedMigrations AS (SELECT t0.DISPLAY_NAME, t1.STATUS, t1.DEST_COMPUTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.DEST_COMPUTE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES t0 JOIN MIGRATIONS t1 ON t0.UUID = t1.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t1.STATUS = 'completed'), MemoryStatsByDisplayName AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC) SELECT cm.DISPLAY_NAME, cm.STATUS AS migration_status, cm.DEST_COMPUTE AS migration_dest_compute, cm.window_column, ms.avg_memory_mb, ms.memory_mb_variance FROM CompletedMigrations cm JOIN MemoryStatsByDisplayName ms ON cm.DISPLAY_NAME = ms.display_name ORDER BY cm.DEST_COMPUTE, cm.window_column ), RollupCounts AS ( SELECT ic.migration_dest_compute, ic.migration_status, COUNT(DISTINCT ic.display_name) AS distinct_display_names FROM inner_cte ic GROUP BY ic.migration_dest_compute, ic.migration_status ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(rc.migration_dest_compute) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE rc.migration_dest_compute END AS migration_dest_compute, CASE WHEN GROUPING(rc.migration_status) = 1 AND GROUPING(rc.migration_dest_compute) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE rc.migration_status END AS migration_status, SUM(rc.distinct_display_names) AS distinct_display_names, AVG(ic.avg_memory_mb) AS avg_of_avg_memory_mb, AVG(ic.memory_mb_variance) AS avg_of_memory_mb_variance FROM RollupCounts rc JOIN inner_cte ic ON ic.migration_dest_compute = rc.migration_dest_compute AND ic.migration_status = rc.migration_status GROUP BY rc.migration_dest_compute, rc.migration_status WITH ROLLUP;

question: For each VM state, find the VM state and the highest “max INSTANCE_EXTRA id over a window covering the current instance and the next 2 instances ordered by instance UUID” among non-deleted instances, considering only instances that have a corresponding network info cache record. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH VmStateMemoryVariance AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), InstanceWindowMaxExtraId AS ( SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.power_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, MAX(ie.id) OVER (ORDER BY i.uuid ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_extra_id_next2 FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 ) SELECT iw.uuid, iw.display_name, iw.vm_state, iw.power_state, iw.memory_mb, iw.vcpus, iw.max_instance_extra_id_next2, vsmv.memory_mb_variance FROM InstanceWindowMaxExtraId AS iw JOIN VmStateMemoryVariance AS vsmv ON iw.vm_state = vsmv.VM_STATE ), VmStateMaxOfWindowedExtra AS ( SELECT i.vm_state, MAX(inner_cte.max_instance_extra_id_next2) AS max_windowed_instance_extra_id_next2 FROM inner_cte JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON inner_cte.uuid = i.uuid JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND c.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.vm_state ) SELECT vm_state, max_windowed_instance_extra_id_next2 FROM VmStateMaxOfWindowedExtra;

question: For each instance VM state and completed-migration status, list the instance VM state, a migration activity label ('Active' if any completed migrations exist for that VM state and 'Inactive' otherwise), and the number of distinct instance display names represented. Include subtotals for each VM state and a grand total. Only consider instances whose display name has more than one completed migration, and base the result on the completed-migration details and memory statistics from the provided query.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH MigrationDetails AS ( SELECT m.id AS migration_id, m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.dest_host, i.display_name, i.vm_state, MAX(i.memory_mb) OVER (ORDER BY m.id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_memory_mb_next_2 FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' ), InstanceMemoryStddev AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_total) AS memory_total_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY memory_total_stddev DESC ) SELECT md.migration_id, md.status, md.source_compute, md.dest_compute, md.dest_host, md.display_name, md.vm_state, md.max_memory_mb_next_2, ims.memory_total_stddev, ROUND(md.max_memory_mb_next_2 / NULLIF(ims.memory_total_stddev, 0), 2) AS max_memory_to_stddev_ratio FROM MigrationDetails md JOIN InstanceMemoryStddev ims ON md.display_name = ims.display_name ORDER BY max_memory_to_stddev_ratio DESC, md.migration_id ), VmStateMigrationStatus AS ( SELECT i.vm_state, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM inner_cte x WHERE x.vm_state = i.vm_state AND x.status = 'completed' ) THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END AS migration_status, COUNT(DISTINCT i.display_name) AS total_display_names FROM inner_cte i GROUP BY i.vm_state, migration_status ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(vm_state) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE vm_state END AS vm_state, CASE WHEN GROUPING(migration_status) = 1 AND GROUPING(vm_state) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE migration_status END AS migration_status, SUM(total_display_names) AS total_display_names FROM VmStateMigrationStatus GROUP BY vm_state, migration_status WITH ROLLUP;

question: For compute instances in availability zone "flare3" whose vCPUs-per-MB ratio (vCPUs divided by memory) is greater than 0.0005, list the instance UUID, display name, VM state, power state, memory (MB), vCPUs, the maximum INSTANCE_EXTRA id over a window that includes the current instance and the next 2 instances when ordered by instance UUID, the cached network info, the row number ordered by display name using a window frame of 2 preceding rows and 1 following row, and the rounded vCPUs-per-MB ratio.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH InstanceWindowExtras AS (SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.power_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, MAX(ie.id) OVER (ORDER BY i.uuid ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_extra_id_next2 FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0), AZInstanceNetworkWindow AS (SELECT t1.DISPLAY_NAME, t1.UUID AS instance_uuid, t2.NETWORK_INFO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.DISPLAY_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t1.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3') SELECT iwe.uuid AS instance_uuid, iwe.display_name, iwe.vm_state, iwe.power_state, iwe.memory_mb, iwe.vcpus, iwe.max_instance_extra_id_next2, az.NETWORK_INFO, az.window_column, ROUND(iwe.vcpus / NULLIF(iwe.memory_mb, 0), 6) AS vcpus_per_mb_ratio FROM InstanceWindowExtras AS iwe JOIN AZInstanceNetworkWindow AS az ON az.instance_uuid = iwe.uuid ORDER BY vcpus_per_mb_ratio DESC, iwe.uuid ) SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.power_state, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.vcpus, inner_cte.max_instance_extra_id_next2, inner_cte.network_info, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.vcpus_per_mb_ratio FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.vcpus_per_mb_ratio > 0.0005 ORDER BY inner_cte.vcpus_per_mb_ratio DESC, inner_cte.instance_uuid;

question: For the instance with UUID '0003c04d-211b-4847-8916-102efabca5bc', list its instance ID, display name, user ID, project ID, VM state, power state, memory (MB), vCPUs, availability zone, and each system metadata key/value (including the minimum metadata ID per key via a window function). Also include—based on that same display name—the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of non-deleted system metadata entries per instance, and additionally show the total vCPUs and total memory (MB) consumed by all non-deleted instances that share that display name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH MetadataCountStatsByDisplayName AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(meta_entry_count) - MIN(meta_entry_count) AS metadata_count_range, VARIANCE(meta_entry_count) AS metadata_count_variance, STDDEV(meta_entry_count) AS metadata_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN ( SELECT i2.display_name, i2.uuid, COUNT(*) AS meta_entry_count FROM instances AS i2 JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i2.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i2.display_name, i2.uuid ) AS per_instance_counts ON i.display_name = per_instance_counts.display_name GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY metadata_count_range DESC ), InstanceMetadataDetails AS ( SELECT i.ID AS instance_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.USER_ID AS user_id, i.PROJECT_ID AS project_id, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE AS availability_zone, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ism.ID AS metadata_id, MIN(ism.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY ism.KEY) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.UUID = '0003c04d-211b-4847-8916-102efabca5bc' ) SELECT d.instance_id, d.display_name, d.user_id, d.project_id, d.vm_state, d.power_state, d.memory_mb, d.vcpus, d.availability_zone, d.metadata_key, d.metadata_value, d.metadata_id, d.window_column, s.metadata_count_range, s.metadata_count_variance, s.metadata_count_stddev FROM InstanceMetadataDetails AS d JOIN MetadataCountStatsByDisplayName AS s ON d.display_name = s.display_name ORDER BY d.display_name, d.metadata_key, d.metadata_id) SELECT ic.instance_id, ic.display_name, ic.user_id, ic.project_id, ic.vm_state, ic.power_state, ic.memory_mb, ic.vcpus, ic.availability_zone, ic.metadata_key, ic.metadata_value, ic.metadata_id, ic.window_column, ic.metadata_count_range, ic.metadata_count_variance, ic.metadata_count_stddev, agg.total_vcpus_for_display_name, agg.total_memory_mb_for_display_name FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN ( SELECT i.display_name, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus_for_display_name, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb_for_display_name FROM instances i WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ) AS agg ON ic.display_name = agg.display_name ORDER BY ic.display_name, ic.metadata_key, ic.metadata_id;

question: For the top 10 VM states (among instances that have a system metadata entry with KEY = 'image_image_type') with the highest average instance memory, show the VM state, the average memory, the memory range (max minus min), the memory variance computed from the stats query, the separately computed memory variance for the same VM state, and whether that VM state has any instances with a non-null NUMA_TOPOLOGY in INSTANCE_EXTRA. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH vm_state_memory_stats AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) - MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC), vm_state_memory_variance AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC) SELECT vms.VM_STATE, vms.avg_memory_mb, vms.memory_mb_range, vms.memory_mb_variance AS memory_mb_variance_from_stats, vmv.memory_mb_variance AS memory_mb_variance_from_variance_query FROM vm_state_memory_stats vms JOIN vm_state_memory_variance vmv ON vms.VM_STATE = vmv.VM_STATE), vm_state_numa_presence AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_numa_topology FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND ie.NUMA_TOPOLOGY IS NOT NULL AND ie.NUMA_TOPOLOGY <> '' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ) SELECT ic.VM_STATE, ic.avg_memory_mb, ic.memory_mb_range, ic.memory_mb_variance_from_stats, ic.memory_mb_variance_from_variance_query, COALESCE(vnp.has_numa_topology, 'No') AS has_numa_topology FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN vm_state_numa_presence vnp ON vnp.VM_STATE = ic.VM_STATE ORDER BY ic.avg_memory_mb DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each VM state among non-deleted instances in availability zone “flare3”, list the VM state, the number of such instances, and the average per-VM-state instance count across all VM states, considering only VM states whose geometric mean instance memory (MB) (computed over instances with a system metadata key of 'image_image_type' and memory greater than 0) is greater than 0. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH VmStateGeometricMeanMemory AS ( SELECT i.vm_state, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.vm_state ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC ), Flare3NonDeletedInstances AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MAX(i.ID) OVER (ORDER BY i.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_id_next_2 FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' ) SELECT f.instance_uuid, f.display_name, f.vm_state, f.power_state, f.memory_mb, f.vcpus, f.instance_extra_id, f.max_instance_id_next_2, v.geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM Flare3NonDeletedInstances f JOIN VmStateGeometricMeanMemory v ON f.vm_state = v.vm_state WHERE v.geometric_mean_memory_mb > 0 ORDER BY v.geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC, f.instance_uuid) SELECT i.vm_state, COUNT(i.instance_uuid) AS total_instances_in_flare3_vm_state, avg_counts.avg_instance_count_per_vm_state FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN ( SELECT AVG(vm_state_count) AS avg_instance_count_per_vm_state FROM ( SELECT vm_state, COUNT(*) AS vm_state_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY vm_state ) AS sub ) AS avg_counts GROUP BY i.vm_state, avg_counts.avg_instance_count_per_vm_state ORDER BY total_instances_in_flare3_vm_state DESC, i.vm_state;

question: Among not-deleted instances (DELETED = 0), return only those whose MEMORY_MB is greater than the average MEMORY_MB of not-deleted instances in the same AVAILABILITY_ZONE, and for each such instance show its UUID, display name, availability zone, memory_mb, and the zone’s average memory_mb. Use the not-deleted instance set defined in the provided query as the base.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH NotDeletedInstancesWindow AS ( SELECT t1.UUID, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t1.DELETED = 0 ), ForgeInstancesWindow AS ( SELECT i.uuid, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY i.memory_mb ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE i.display_name = 'forge' ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS Total_Not_Deleted_Instances, COUNT(f.uuid) AS Total_Forge_Instances, ROUND(COUNT(f.uuid) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS Forge_Share_Of_Not_Deleted FROM NotDeletedInstancesWindow nd LEFT JOIN ForgeInstancesWindow f ON nd.UUID = f.uuid), ZoneAverages AS ( SELECT i.availability_zone, AVG(i.memory_mb * 1.0) AS avg_zone_memory_mb FROM instances i WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.availability_zone ) SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, i.availability_zone, i.memory_mb, za.avg_zone_memory_mb FROM instances i JOIN instance_extra ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches ic ON ic.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN ZoneAverages za ON za.availability_zone = i.availability_zone WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.memory_mb > ( SELECT avg_zone_memory_mb FROM ZoneAverages WHERE ZoneAverages.availability_zone = i.availability_zone );

question: For completed migrations, list the migration status, source compute, destination compute, instance display name, instance flavor JSON, and the dense-rank window column; also include (for the same instance display name) the VM state, the number of instances, and the minimum memory in MB (considering only instances that have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type'), and additionally show the average of the per-display-name minimum memory (min_memory_mb) across all such display names. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH InstanceStateStats AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(i.ID) AS instance_count, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME), CompletedMigrations AS (SELECT m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, i.display_name, ie.flavor, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.status ORDER BY m.status) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed') SELECT cm.status AS migration_status, cm.source_compute, cm.dest_compute, cm.display_name, cm.flavor, cm.window_column, iss.VM_STATE, iss.instance_count, iss.min_memory_mb FROM CompletedMigrations AS cm JOIN InstanceStateStats AS iss ON cm.display_name = iss.DISPLAY_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.migration_status, inner_cte.source_compute, inner_cte.dest_compute, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.flavor, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.instance_count, inner_cte.min_memory_mb, avg_min_mem.avg_min_memory_mb_across_display_names FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(min_memory_mb) AS avg_min_memory_mb_across_display_names FROM ( SELECT MIN(min_memory_mb) AS min_memory_mb FROM inner_cte GROUP BY display_name ) AS per_display_name ) AS avg_min_mem;

question: For each VM state returned by the existing combined memory-metrics report, show the VM state, the memory metrics (avg/range/variance or geometric mean) and “Reason”, plus the total number of non-deleted instances in that VM state as a benchmark and a utilization category: 'HIGH_MEMORY_SPREAD' if the memory range is at least 50% higher than the average range across VM states (only for rows with range), 'LOW_MEMORY_SPREAD' if it is at least 50% lower, otherwise 'AVERAGE_MEMORY_SPREAD'; for geometric-mean-only rows, categorize as 'NO_RANGE_METRIC'. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH MemoryStatsByVMState AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) - MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC ), GeometricMeanMemoryByVMState AS ( SELECT i.vm_state, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.vm_state ORDER BY geometric_mean DESC ), CombinedVMStateMemoryMetrics AS ( SELECT ms.VM_STATE AS vm_state, ms.avg_memory_mb, ms.memory_mb_range, ms.memory_mb_variance, NULL AS geometric_mean, 'Has image_image_type system metadata' AS Reason FROM MemoryStatsByVMState ms UNION ALL SELECT gm.vm_state AS vm_state, NULL AS avg_memory_mb, NULL AS memory_mb_range, NULL AS memory_mb_variance, gm.geometric_mean, 'Not deleted and has network info cache' AS Reason FROM GeometricMeanMemoryByVMState gm ) SELECT vm_state, avg_memory_mb, memory_mb_range, memory_mb_variance, geometric_mean, Reason FROM CombinedVMStateMemoryMetrics ORDER BY vm_state, Reason), VMStateInstanceCounts AS ( SELECT i.vm_state, COUNT(*) AS total_non_deleted_instances FROM instances i LEFT JOIN instance_info_caches c ON c.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.vm_state ), AverageRangeBenchmark AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb_range) AS avg_memory_mb_range FROM inner_cte WHERE memory_mb_range IS NOT NULL ) SELECT ic.vm_state, ic.avg_memory_mb, ic.memory_mb_range, ic.memory_mb_variance, ic.geometric_mean, ic.Reason, vsc.total_non_deleted_instances AS vm_state_instance_benchmark, arb.avg_memory_mb_range AS range_benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.memory_mb_range IS NULL THEN 'NO_RANGE_METRIC' WHEN ic.memory_mb_range > arb.avg_memory_mb_range * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_MEMORY_SPREAD' WHEN ic.memory_mb_range < arb.avg_memory_mb_range * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_MEMORY_SPREAD' ELSE 'AVERAGE_MEMORY_SPREAD' END AS utilization_category FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN VMStateInstanceCounts vsc ON vsc.vm_state = ic.vm_state CROSS JOIN AverageRangeBenchmark arb ORDER BY ic.vm_state, ic.Reason;

question: For each instance availability zone and VM state, show the availability zone and VM state, the total number of instances and the earliest instance creation time (using the instance UUID links to include both the instance extra record and the instance network info cache), along with the number of distinct instances that have a completed migration and the average of the migration window minimum instance memory (in MB) for those completed migrations. Do not repeat the availability zone if it is the same as the previous row, and include subtotals per availability zone. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH InstanceZoneStateStats AS (SELECT ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, ins.VM_STATE, COUNT(ins.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(ins.CREATED_AT) AS earliest_created_at FROM INSTANCES AS ins JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID WHERE ins.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, ins.VM_STATE), CompletedMigrationWindow AS (SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.status, MIN(i.memory_mb) OVER ( ORDER BY m.id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed'), CompletedMigrationZoneState AS ( SELECT ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, ins.VM_STATE, COUNT(DISTINCT cmw.uuid) AS completed_migration_instance_count, AVG(cmw.window_column) AS avg_window_min_memory_mb FROM CompletedMigrationWindow cmw JOIN INSTANCES ins ON ins.UUID = cmw.uuid WHERE ins.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, ins.VM_STATE ) SELECT izss.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, izss.VM_STATE, izss.instance_count, izss.earliest_created_at, cmzs.completed_migration_instance_count, cmzs.avg_window_min_memory_mb FROM InstanceZoneStateStats izss JOIN CompletedMigrationZoneState cmzs ON izss.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = cmzs.AVAILABILITY_ZONE AND izss.VM_STATE = cmzs.VM_STATE ORDER BY izss.instance_count DESC ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(availability_zone) OVER (ORDER BY az_sort, availability_zone, vm_state) = availability_zone THEN NULL ELSE availability_zone END AS availability_zone, vm_state, instance_count, earliest_created_at, completed_migration_instance_count, avg_window_min_memory_mb FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(availability_zone) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE availability_zone END AS az_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(availability_zone) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE availability_zone END AS availability_zone, CASE WHEN GROUPING(vm_state) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE vm_state END AS vm_state, SUM(instance_count) AS instance_count, MIN(earliest_created_at) AS earliest_created_at, SUM(completed_migration_instance_count) AS completed_migration_instance_count, AVG(avg_window_min_memory_mb) AS avg_window_min_memory_mb FROM inner_cte GROUP BY availability_zone, vm_state WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY az_sort, availability_zone, vm_state;

question: For instances that are not deleted, among the top 10 instance display names with the most network info cache records, list only those instance display names and metadata keys whose maximum instance memory (MB) is greater than the overall average of the maximum instance memory (MB) across those top-10 instances; show the instance display name, metadata key, maximum memory (MB), launched timestamp, and the number of network info cache records. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH HighMemoryByMetadata AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) AS max_memory_mb, i.LAUNCHED_AT FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism JOIN INSTANCES i ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME, ism.KEY, i.LAUNCHED_AT HAVING MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) > 16000), TopCacheRecordInstances AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(iic.ID) AS cache_records FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY cache_records DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT hmbm.DISPLAY_NAME, hmbm.metadata_key, hmbm.max_memory_mb, hmbm.LAUNCHED_AT, tcri.cache_records FROM HighMemoryByMetadata hmbm JOIN TopCacheRecordInstances tcri ON hmbm.DISPLAY_NAME = tcri.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY tcri.cache_records DESC, hmbm.max_memory_mb DESC) SELECT DISPLAY_NAME, metadata_key, max_memory_mb, LAUNCHED_AT, cache_records FROM inner_cte WHERE max_memory_mb > (SELECT AVG(max_memory_mb) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY cache_records DESC, max_memory_mb DESC;

question: For instances whose display name is 'forge', list each instance UUID along with its system metadata key/value, its power state, the running sum of instance IDs within each power-state group (ordered by instance ID), and also include the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of MEMORY_TOTAL across completed migrations for the 'forge' display name (only where there are more than 5 completed migration records and the instance info cache entry is not deleted). Additionally, roll up the results to include subtotals per power state and a grand total, showing the number of metadata rows and the average of the running-sum window column. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH ForgeInstanceMetadataAndWindow AS (SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, ism.key AS metadata_key, ism.value AS metadata_value, i.power_state, SUM(i.id) OVER (PARTITION BY i.power_state ORDER BY i.id) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.display_name = 'forge'), MemoryStddevByDisplayName AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_total) AS memory_total_stddev FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND ic.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY memory_total_stddev DESC) SELECT f.instance_uuid, f.metadata_key, f.metadata_value, f.power_state, f.window_column, ms.memory_total_stddev FROM ForgeInstanceMetadataAndWindow AS f JOIN MemoryStddevByDisplayName AS ms ON ms.display_name = 'forge' ORDER BY f.power_state, f.instance_uuid, f.metadata_key) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.power_state) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE CAST(inner_cte.power_state AS CHAR) END AS power_state, CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.instance_uuid) = 1 AND GROUPING(inner_cte.power_state) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE inner_cte.instance_uuid END AS instance_uuid, COUNT(*) AS metadata_rows, AVG(inner_cte.window_column) AS avg_window_column, MAX(inner_cte.memory_total_stddev) AS memory_total_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.power_state, inner_cte.instance_uuid WITH ROLLUP;

question: For instances in availability zone "flare3" that have a corresponding instance info cache record and are associated with non-deleted migrations, for each migration status list the status, the variance of instance memory (in MB), and how many flare3 instances fall under that status. Do not repeat the status if it is the same as the previous row. Include a grand total row across all statuses. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH MigrationStatusMemoryVariance AS ( SELECT m.status, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.deleted = 0 GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), Flare3InstancesWithNetworkInfo AS ( SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, c.NETWORK_INFO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB DESC) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' ) SELECT msmv.status, msmv.memory_mb_variance, COUNT(*) AS flare3_instance_count FROM MigrationStatusMemoryVariance AS msmv JOIN migrations AS m ON m.status = msmv.status JOIN Flare3InstancesWithNetworkInfo AS f ON f.UUID = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.deleted = 0 GROUP BY msmv.status, msmv.memory_mb_variance ORDER BY msmv.memory_mb_variance DESC) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(status) OVER (ORDER BY status_sort, status) = status THEN NULL ELSE status END AS status, memory_mb_variance, flare3_instance_count FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(status) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE status END AS status_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(status) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE status END AS status, AVG(memory_mb_variance) AS memory_mb_variance, SUM(flare3_instance_count) AS flare3_instance_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY status WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY status_sort, status;

question: For the top 10 instance display names with the highest variance in instance memory (MB) among completed migrations (and with non-zero variance), return the instance display name, the average instance memory (MB), the variance of instance memory (MB), the total number of completed migrations, the minimum windowed instance memory (MB) (using a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by migration id), and whether the instance has any non-completed migrations. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH InstanceMemoryStats AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC), CompletedMigrationWindowedMins AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.INSTANCE_UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( ORDER BY m.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed') SELECT cmwm.instance_display_name, ims.avg_memory_mb, ims.memory_mb_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT cmwm.migration_id) AS completed_migration_count, MIN(cmwm.window_column) AS min_windowed_memory_mb FROM CompletedMigrationWindowedMins cmwm JOIN InstanceMemoryStats ims ON cmwm.instance_display_name = ims.DISPLAY_NAME WHERE ims.memory_mb_variance > 0 GROUP BY cmwm.instance_display_name, ims.avg_memory_mb, ims.memory_mb_variance ORDER BY ims.memory_mb_variance DESC) SELECT ic.instance_display_name, ic.avg_memory_mb, ic.memory_mb_variance, ic.completed_migration_count, ic.min_windowed_memory_mb, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM MIGRATIONS m2 JOIN INSTANCES i2 ON m2.INSTANCE_UUID = i2.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES ic2 ON i2.UUID = ic2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i2.DISPLAY_NAME = ic.instance_display_name AND m2.STATUS NOT IN ('completed', 'failed', 'error') AND m2.DELETED = 0 ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_active_migrations FROM inner_cte ic ORDER BY ic.memory_mb_variance DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For instances whose display name is "forge", list the instance details (ID, UUID, user ID, project ID, hostname, VM state, power state, memory, vCPUs, availability zone) along with the related instance-info-cache record (ID and network info) and the per-project minimum memory (windowed by project), and also include (matched by VM state) the migration status summary for instances that have system metadata key 'image_image_type' (migration status, migration count, and minimum instance memory). Additionally, for each returned row, show the deviation of the instance’s memory from the overall average memory across all returned "forge" instances. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH ForgeInstances AS (SELECT i.ID AS instance_id, i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.USER_ID, i.PROJECT_ID, i.HOSTNAME, i.VM_STATE, i.POWER_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, c.ID AS info_cache_id, c.NETWORK_INFO, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.PROJECT_ID ORDER BY i.PROJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge'), MigrationStats AS (SELECT m.status AS migration_status, i.vm_state AS instance_vm_state, COUNT(m.id) AS migration_count, MIN(i.memory_mb) AS min_instance_memory_mb FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY m.status, i.vm_state), Combined AS ( SELECT fi.instance_id, fi.instance_uuid, fi.user_id, fi.project_id, fi.hostname, fi.vm_state, fi.power_state, fi.memory_mb, fi.vcpus, fi.availability_zone, fi.info_cache_id, fi.network_info, fi.window_column, ms.migration_status, ms.migration_count, ms.min_instance_memory_mb FROM ForgeInstances fi LEFT JOIN MigrationStats ms ON fi.vm_state = ms.instance_vm_state ) SELECT * FROM Combined ORDER BY instance_id, migration_status), AverageMemory AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.instance_id, ic.instance_uuid, ic.user_id, ic.project_id, ic.hostname, ic.vm_state, ic.power_state, ic.memory_mb, ic.vcpus, ic.availability_zone, ic.info_cache_id, ic.network_info, ic.window_column, ic.migration_status, ic.migration_count, ic.min_instance_memory_mb, (ic.memory_mb - am.avg_memory_mb) AS deviation_from_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AverageMemory am ORDER BY ic.instance_id, ic.migration_status;

question: For each VM state, show the VM state (with a grand total row), whether there are any “forge” system-metadata rows for instances in that VM state (“Has forge metadata” vs “No forge metadata”), and the number of “flare3” instances that have a matching instance extra record. Include subtotals per VM state and a grand total. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH az_instances AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, SUM(i.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3'), forge_instances AS (SELECT i.UUID, i.HOSTNAME, i.VM_STATE, ism.KEY, ism.VALUE, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( ORDER BY i.ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge') SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM az_instances) AS flare3_instance_count_with_extra, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM forge_instances) AS forge_instance_metadata_row_count ), StateForgeStatus AS (SELECT ai.vm_state, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM INSTANCES i2 JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism2 ON ism2.INSTANCE_UUID = i2.UUID WHERE i2.VM_STATE = ai.vm_state AND i2.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge') THEN 'Has forge metadata' ELSE 'No forge metadata' END AS forge_metadata_status, COUNT(*) AS flare3_instances_with_extra_in_state FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT vm_state FROM INSTANCES) ai ON ai.vm_state = i.VM_STATE CROSS JOIN inner_cte WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' GROUP BY ai.vm_state, forge_metadata_status) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(vm_state) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE vm_state END AS vm_state, CASE WHEN GROUPING(forge_metadata_status) = 1 AND GROUPING(vm_state) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE forge_metadata_status END AS forge_metadata_status, SUM(flare3_instances_with_extra_in_state) AS flare3_instances_with_extra_in_state, MAX(inner_cte.flare3_instance_count_with_extra) AS flare3_instance_count_with_extra_overall, MAX(inner_cte.forge_instance_metadata_row_count) AS forge_instance_metadata_row_count_overall FROM StateForgeStatus CROSS JOIN inner_cte GROUP BY vm_state, forge_metadata_status WITH ROLLUP;

question: For instances whose display name is 'forge' and that have at least 1 completed migration, show the instance UUID, hostname, VM state, memory in MB, the instance extra record ID, the minimum memory (in MB) over a window of 3 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the instance extra ID, along with the completed migration status, the instance flavor JSON from instance extra, the row number over instance display name (with a window frame of 2 preceding and 1 following row), and the total count of completed migrations for that instance. Also include subtotals per VM state and a grand total of instances. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH ForgeInstancesWindow AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( ORDER BY ie.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' ), CompletedMigrationsWindow AS ( SELECT t0.STATUS AS migration_status, t1.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, t2.FLAVOR AS instance_flavor_json, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.DISPLAY_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS t0 JOIN INSTANCES t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t0.STATUS = 'completed' ), ForgeCompletedMigrationCounts AS ( SELECT m.INSTANCE_UUID AS instance_uuid, COUNT(*) AS completed_migration_count FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' GROUP BY m.INSTANCE_UUID ) SELECT fiw.instance_uuid, fiw.hostname, fiw.vm_state, fiw.memory_mb, fiw.instance_extra_id, fiw.window_column AS forge_min_memory_mb_window, cmw.migration_status, cmw.instance_flavor_json, cmw.window_column AS completed_migrations_row_number_window, fcmc.completed_migration_count FROM ForgeInstancesWindow fiw JOIN ForgeCompletedMigrationCounts fcmc ON fcmc.instance_uuid = fiw.instance_uuid JOIN CompletedMigrationsWindow cmw ON cmw.instance_display_name = 'forge' WHERE fcmc.completed_migration_count >= 1 ORDER BY fiw.instance_extra_id ), VmStateRollup AS ( SELECT ic.vm_state, COUNT(DISTINCT ic.instance_uuid) AS total_instances FROM inner_cte ic JOIN INSTANCES i2 ON i2.UUID = ic.instance_uuid JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA ie2 ON ie2.INSTANCE_UUID = i2.UUID GROUP BY ic.vm_state ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(vm_state) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE vm_state END AS vm_state, SUM(total_instances) AS total_instances FROM VmStateRollup GROUP BY vm_state WITH ROLLUP;

question: Using the combined UNION ALL report of (1) per-migration-status instance memory statistics and (2) per-VM-state instance root disk statistics as an inner CTE, list only the rows whose avg_value is greater than the overall average avg_value for the same “reason”, and show the category, avg_value, variance_value, stddev_value, range_value, and reason. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH MigrationMemoryStats AS (SELECT m.status, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC), VMStateRootDiskStats AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, AVG(i.ROOT_GB) AS avg_root_gb, MAX(i.ROOT_GB) - MIN(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_range, VARIANCE(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY root_gb_range DESC), CombinedStats AS ( SELECT status AS category, avg_memory_mb AS avg_value, memory_mb_variance AS variance_value, memory_mb_stddev AS stddev_value, NULL AS range_value, 'Migration Status Memory Stats' AS reason FROM MigrationMemoryStats UNION ALL SELECT vm_state AS category, avg_root_gb AS avg_value, root_gb_variance AS variance_value, NULL AS stddev_value, root_gb_range AS range_value, 'VM State Root Disk Stats' AS reason FROM VMStateRootDiskStats ) SELECT * FROM CombinedStats ORDER BY reason, category) SELECT ic.category, ic.avg_value, ic.variance_value, ic.stddev_value, ic.range_value, ic.reason FROM inner_cte AS ic WHERE ic.avg_value > ( SELECT AVG(ic2.avg_value) FROM inner_cte AS ic2 WHERE ic2.reason = ic.reason ) ORDER BY ic.reason, ic.avg_value DESC, ic.category;

question: For instances in availability zone 'flare3' whose system metadata entry count is greater than the average metadata entry count across all 'flare3' instances, list each instance UUID, display name, key name, metadata entry count, total vCPUs summed across those metadata rows, cached network info, and the window row number ordered by display name (using a window frame of 2 preceding rows and 1 following row). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH MetadataStats AS (SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.key_name, COUNT(ism.id) AS metadata_entry_count, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus FROM instances i JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.key_name), NetworkWindow AS (SELECT t1.DISPLAY_NAME, t1.UUID AS instance_uuid, t2.NETWORK_INFO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.DISPLAY_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t1.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3'), CombinedInstanceDetails AS ( SELECT ms.instance_uuid, ms.display_name, ms.key_name, ms.metadata_entry_count, ms.total_vcpus, nw.NETWORK_INFO, nw.window_column FROM MetadataStats ms JOIN NetworkWindow nw ON ms.instance_uuid = nw.instance_uuid ) SELECT * FROM CombinedInstanceDetails ORDER BY display_name, instance_uuid) SELECT instance_uuid, display_name, key_name, metadata_entry_count, total_vcpus, network_info, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE metadata_entry_count > (SELECT AVG(metadata_entry_count) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY display_name, instance_uuid;

question: For instances with display name 'forge' that have system metadata with KEY = 'image_image_type', list the display name, a ROOT_GB usage status ('HighRoot' if the display-name-level ROOT_GB range is at least 32 GB and 'LowRoot' otherwise), and the number of distinct instances. Include subtotals for each display name and a grand total. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH q1 AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MAX(i.ROOT_GB) - MIN(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_range, VARIANCE(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY root_gb_range DESC ), q2 AS ( SELECT i.UUID, ism.KEY, ism.VALUE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ism.KEY ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' ) SELECT q2.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME, q1.root_gb_range, q1.root_gb_variance, q2.KEY AS system_metadata_key, q2.VALUE AS system_metadata_value, q2.window_column FROM q2 JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON i.UUID = q2.UUID JOIN q1 ON q1.DISPLAY_NAME = i.DISPLAY_NAME JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism_img ON ism_img.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE ism_img.KEY = 'image_image_type' ORDER BY q1.root_gb_range DESC, q2.window_column ), DisplayRootStatus AS ( SELECT inner_cte.display_name, CASE WHEN inner_cte.root_gb_range >= 32 THEN 'HighRoot' ELSE 'LowRoot' END AS root_gb_status, COUNT(DISTINCT inner_cte.instance_uuid) AS total_instances FROM inner_cte JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = inner_cte.instance_uuid GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name, root_gb_status ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE display_name END AS display_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(root_gb_status) = 1 AND GROUPING(display_name) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE root_gb_status END AS root_gb_status, SUM(total_instances) AS total_instances FROM DisplayRootStatus GROUP BY display_name, root_gb_status WITH ROLLUP;

question: For non-deleted instances in availability zone 'flare3' that are in the 'shelved_offloaded' VM state, return the instance UUID and display name along with availability zone, VM state, power state, memory (MB), vCPU count, the system metadata key/value, the cached network_info JSON, the row number within each metadata-key group ordered by instance UUID, the maximum system-metadata ID over the window from the current instance UUID through the next 2 instance UUIDs, and only keep rows where the instance’s memory utilization ratio (memory_mb / (memory_mb + vcpus*1024)) is greater than 0.75. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH ShelvedOffloadedNonDeletedInstances AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded'), MaxMetadataIdNext2InFlare3 AS (SELECT i.display_name, i.availability_zone, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, i.uuid, MAX(ism.id) OVER ( ORDER BY i.uuid ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_metadata_id_next_2 FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3') SELECT s.instance_uuid, s.display_name, m.availability_zone, m.vm_state, s.power_state, m.memory_mb, m.vcpus, s.metadata_key, s.metadata_value, s.network_info, s.window_column, m.max_metadata_id_next_2 FROM ShelvedOffloadedNonDeletedInstances AS s JOIN MaxMetadataIdNext2InFlare3 AS m ON m.uuid = s.instance_uuid) SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.availability_zone, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.power_state, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.vcpus, inner_cte.metadata_key, inner_cte.metadata_value, inner_cte.network_info, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.max_metadata_id_next_2 FROM inner_cte WHERE (inner_cte.memory_mb * 1.0 / (inner_cte.memory_mb + inner_cte.vcpus * 1024)) > 0.75;

question: From the top 10 projects with the highest total “max-memory-per-rank” ratio across their completed migrations (consider only instances whose maximum recorded completed-migration total memory is greater than 0, and only non-deleted instance info cache rows), show each project’s ID, the project’s total of those ratios, the number of distinct instances contributing, and whether the project has any active (non-completed/failed/error) migrations.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH MaxMemoryByInstanceStatus AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(m.memory_total) AS max_memory_total, m.status FROM instances i JOIN migrations m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY i.display_name, m.status HAVING MAX(m.memory_total) > 0 ), CompletedMigrationsRanked AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND ic.DELETED = 0 ) SELECT cmr.migration_id, cmr.SOURCE_COMPUTE, cmr.DEST_COMPUTE, cmr.instance_display_name, mm.max_memory_total, cmr.window_column AS migration_rank_within_completed_status, ROUND(mm.max_memory_total / NULLIF(cmr.window_column, 0), 2) AS max_memory_per_rank_ratio FROM CompletedMigrationsRanked cmr JOIN MaxMemoryByInstanceStatus mm ON cmr.instance_display_name = mm.display_name ORDER BY max_memory_per_rank_ratio DESC, cmr.migration_id ), project_rollup AS ( SELECT i.project_id, SUM(inner_cte.max_memory_per_rank_ratio) AS total_max_memory_per_rank_ratio, COUNT(DISTINCT i.uuid) AS distinct_instances_contributing FROM inner_cte JOIN instances i ON i.display_name = inner_cte.instance_display_name AND i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.project_id ), ranked_projects AS ( SELECT pr.project_id, pr.total_max_memory_per_rank_ratio, pr.distinct_instances_contributing, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY pr.total_max_memory_per_rank_ratio DESC) AS project_rank FROM project_rollup pr ) SELECT rp.project_id, rp.total_max_memory_per_rank_ratio, rp.distinct_instances_contributing, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM migrations m2 JOIN instances i2 ON m2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid WHERE i2.project_id = rp.project_id AND m2.deleted = 0 AND m2.status NOT IN ('completed', 'failed', 'error') ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_active_migrations FROM ranked_projects rp WHERE rp.project_rank <= 10 ORDER BY rp.total_max_memory_per_rank_ratio DESC, rp.project_id;

question: For the instance with UUID '0003c04d-211b-4847-8916-102efabca5bc' and for completed migrations on that same instance, list the instance details and each system metadata key/value along with the migration ID, the running sum of migration IDs within each metadata key group, the minimum system metadata ID within each metadata key group, the ratio (running sum of migration IDs divided by the minimum metadata ID) rounded to 2 decimals, and categorize each row as 'HIGH_RATIO' (at least 50% above the overall average ratio), 'LOW_RATIO' (at least 50% below the overall average ratio), or 'AVERAGE_RATIO'.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH MigrationMetadata AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, SUM(m.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed'), InstanceMetadataDetails AS (SELECT i.ID AS instance_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.USER_ID AS user_id, i.PROJECT_ID AS project_id, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE AS availability_zone, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ism.ID AS metadata_id, MIN(ism.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY ism.KEY) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.UUID = '0003c04d-211b-4847-8916-102efabca5bc') SELECT imd.instance_id, imd.display_name, imd.user_id, imd.project_id, imd.vm_state, imd.power_state, imd.memory_mb, imd.vcpus, imd.availability_zone, imd.metadata_key, imd.metadata_value, imd.metadata_id, imd.window_column AS min_metadata_id_in_key_group, mm.migration_id, mm.instance_display_name AS migration_instance_display_name, mm.window_column AS running_sum_migration_ids_in_key_group, ROUND(mm.window_column / NULLIF(imd.window_column, 0), 2) AS running_sum_to_min_metadata_id_ratio FROM InstanceMetadataDetails imd JOIN MigrationMetadata mm ON mm.metadata_key = imd.metadata_key AND mm.instance_display_name = imd.display_name ORDER BY running_sum_to_min_metadata_id_ratio DESC, mm.migration_id), AverageRatio AS ( SELECT AVG(running_sum_to_min_metadata_id_ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.instance_id, ic.display_name, ic.user_id, ic.project_id, ic.vm_state, ic.power_state, ic.memory_mb, ic.vcpus, ic.availability_zone, ic.metadata_key, ic.metadata_value, ic.metadata_id, ic.min_metadata_id_in_key_group, ic.migration_id, ic.migration_instance_display_name, ic.running_sum_migration_ids_in_key_group, ic.running_sum_to_min_metadata_id_ratio, ar.avg_ratio AS benchmark_avg_ratio, CASE WHEN ic.running_sum_to_min_metadata_id_ratio > ar.avg_ratio * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_RATIO' WHEN ic.running_sum_to_min_metadata_id_ratio < ar.avg_ratio * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_RATIO' ELSE 'AVERAGE_RATIO' END AS ratio_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AverageRatio ar ORDER BY ratio_category, ic.running_sum_to_min_metadata_id_ratio DESC, ic.migration_id;

question: For instances whose display name is 'forge', list the instance UUID, hostname, system metadata key, and the running sum of instance IDs within each metadata key group (ordered by instance ID), along with the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of instance memory (MB) for the 'forge' display name computed over instances that have system metadata with key = 'image_image_type'. Also show the total vCPUs and total memory (MB) used by the project that owns each 'forge' instance. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH ForgeInstanceMetadataWindow AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, SUM(i.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge'), DisplayNameMemoryStats AS (SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC) SELECT fimw.instance_uuid, fimw.hostname, fimw.metadata_key, fimw.window_column, dms.memory_mb_variance, dms.memory_mb_stddev FROM ForgeInstanceMetadataWindow fimw JOIN DisplayNameMemoryStats dms ON dms.display_name = 'forge' ORDER BY fimw.metadata_key, fimw.window_column), ProjectUsage AS ( SELECT i.project_id, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_project_vcpus, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_project_memory_mb FROM instances i WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.project_id ) SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.hostname, inner_cte.metadata_key, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev, i.project_id, pu.total_project_vcpus, pu.total_project_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN instances i ON i.uuid = inner_cte.instance_uuid JOIN ProjectUsage pu ON pu.project_id = i.project_id ORDER BY inner_cte.metadata_key, inner_cte.window_column;

question: For availability zone "flare3", among instances with non-empty cached NETWORK_INFO whose VM_STATE appears in the per-VM-state geometric mean of migrated MEMORY_TOTAL (computed only from migrations with MEMORY_TOTAL > 0 and non-empty cached NETWORK_INFO), list the top 10 projects (by total vCPUs of those matching instances) showing each project's ID, total vCPUs, total memory, whether the project has any active migrations, and the average of the geometric-mean migrated-memory values across the matching VM states for that project. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH vm_state_geom_mean_migrated_mem AS (SELECT i.vm_state, EXP(AVG(LN(m.memory_total))) AS geometric_mean_memory_total FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE m.memory_total > 0 AND c.network_info <> '' GROUP BY i.vm_state ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_total DESC), flare3_instances_ranked_by_mem AS (SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, c.NETWORK_INFO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB DESC) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3') SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fir.UUID) AS flare3_instance_count_with_geom_mean_migration_mem, AVG(vsgmmm.geometric_mean_memory_total) AS avg_geometric_mean_memory_total_across_matching_vm_states FROM flare3_instances_ranked_by_mem AS fir JOIN vm_state_geom_mean_migrated_mem AS vsgmmm ON fir.VM_STATE = vsgmmm.vm_state WHERE fir.NETWORK_INFO <> ''), flare3_matching_instances AS (SELECT i.project_id, i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.vcpus, i.memory_mb, i.vm_state, vsgmmm.geometric_mean_memory_total FROM instances i JOIN instance_info_caches c ON c.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN (SELECT i2.vm_state, EXP(AVG(LN(m.memory_total))) AS geometric_mean_memory_total FROM migrations m JOIN instances i2 ON m.instance_uuid = i2.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches c2 ON i2.uuid = c2.instance_uuid WHERE m.memory_total > 0 AND c2.network_info <> '' GROUP BY i2.vm_state) vsgmmm ON vsgmmm.vm_state = i.vm_state WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND c.network_info <> '' AND i.deleted = 0) SELECT fmi.project_id, SUM(fmi.vcpus) AS total_vcpus, SUM(fmi.memory_mb) AS total_memory, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM migrations m JOIN instances i2 ON m.instance_uuid = i2.uuid WHERE i2.project_id = fmi.project_id AND m.deleted = 0 AND m.status NOT IN ('completed', 'failed', 'error')) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_active_migrations, AVG(fmi.geometric_mean_memory_total) AS avg_geom_mean_migrated_memory_total_across_matching_vm_states, inner_cte.flare3_instance_count_with_geom_mean_migration_mem AS flare3_instance_count_with_geom_mean_migration_mem_overall, inner_cte.avg_geometric_mean_memory_total_across_matching_vm_states AS avg_geometric_mean_memory_total_across_matching_vm_states_overall FROM flare3_matching_instances fmi CROSS JOIN inner_cte GROUP BY fmi.project_id, inner_cte.flare3_instance_count_with_geom_mean_migration_mem, inner_cte.avg_geometric_mean_memory_total_across_matching_vm_states ORDER BY total_vcpus DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each VM state and availability zone, considering only instances that have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type' and only migrations with status = 'completed', return the VM state, availability zone, total instance count, minimum instance memory (MB), and completed migration count for those instances, but only for state/zone groups where completed migrations account for more than 75% of the instances; also include the overall average completed-migration ratio across all VM state/availability zone groups. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH InstanceStateAZStats AS ( SELECT ins.VM_STATE, ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, COUNT(ins.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(ins.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES ins ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON ins.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY ins.VM_STATE, ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE ), CompletedMigrationsWithMetadata AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, m.INSTANCE_UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.VM_STATE AS instance_vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS instance_vcpus, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, m.MEMORY_REMAINING AS migration_memory_remaining, MIN(m.MEMORY_REMAINING) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.DEST_COMPUTE ORDER BY m.DEST_COMPUTE ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' ), CompletedMigrationCountsByStateAZ AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, COUNT(m.ID) AS completed_migration_count FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE ) SELECT isaz.VM_STATE, isaz.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, isaz.instance_count, isaz.min_memory_mb, cmc.completed_migration_count FROM InstanceStateAZStats isaz JOIN CompletedMigrationCountsByStateAZ cmc ON isaz.VM_STATE = cmc.VM_STATE AND isaz.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = cmc.AVAILABILITY_ZONE WHERE (cmc.completed_migration_count * 1.0 / isaz.instance_count) > 0.75 ), avg_ratio AS ( SELECT AVG(completed_migration_count * 1.0 / NULLIF(instance_count, 0)) AS avg_completed_migration_ratio FROM inner_cte ) SELECT inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, inner_cte.instance_count, inner_cte.min_memory_mb, inner_cte.completed_migration_count, avg_ratio.avg_completed_migration_ratio FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN avg_ratio;

question: For each VM state and “Reason” category produced by the existing memory-metrics logic, show the VM state, the reason, the corresponding memory summary metrics, and the number of distinct VMs contributing to that row. Include subtotals per VM state and a grand total across all VM states. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH MemoryStatsByVMState AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) - MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC ), GeometricMeanMemoryByVMState AS ( SELECT i.vm_state, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c
