question: For the VM state shelved_offloaded, where the instance memory variance (MB) is greater than 0, show the VM state’s average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of instance memory (for instances that have a matching row in INSTANCE_EXTRA), along with each migration status and the total migration memory processed for migrations of shelved_offloaded instances that have non-null cached network information (only including statuses where total processed memory is greater than 0). Do not repeat the VM state value if it is the same as the previous row. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH InstanceMemoryStatsByState AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC), MigrationMemoryProcessedByStatus AS (SELECT m.STATUS, SUM(m.MEMORY_PROCESSED) AS total_memory_processed FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' AND ic.NETWORK_INFO IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.STATUS HAVING SUM(m.MEMORY_PROCESSED) > 0) SELECT ims.VM_STATE, ims.avg_memory_mb, ims.memory_mb_variance, ims.memory_mb_stddev, mmp.STATUS AS migration_status, mmp.total_memory_processed FROM InstanceMemoryStatsByState ims JOIN MigrationMemoryProcessedByStatus mmp ON ims.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' WHERE ims.memory_mb_variance > 0 ORDER BY ims.memory_mb_variance DESC, mmp.total_memory_processed DESC) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(VM_STATE) OVER (ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC, total_memory_processed DESC) = VM_STATE THEN NULL ELSE VM_STATE END AS VM_STATE, avg_memory_mb, memory_mb_variance, memory_mb_stddev, migration_status, total_memory_processed FROM inner_cte ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC, total_memory_processed DESC;

question: For instances whose display name is 'forge', return only those instances whose dense rank by system metadata key (using a window frame of the current row and the 2 preceding rows) is greater than the average dense rank by system metadata key across all such 'forge' instances; list the instance UUID, the dense rank by system metadata key, and the dense rank by instance memory in MB (using a window frame of the current row and the 2 preceding rows). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH MetaKeyDenseRank AS (SELECT i.UUID, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY ism.KEY ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge'), MemoryDenseRank AS (SELECT i.uuid, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY i.memory_mb ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE i.display_name = 'forge') SELECT m.UUID AS instance_uuid, m.window_column AS dense_rank_by_system_metadata_key, r.window_column AS dense_rank_by_memory_mb FROM MetaKeyDenseRank AS m JOIN MemoryDenseRank AS r ON m.UUID = r.uuid), AvgMetaKeyRank AS ( SELECT AVG(inner_cte.dense_rank_by_system_metadata_key * 1.0) AS avg_dense_rank_by_system_metadata_key FROM inner_cte ) SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.dense_rank_by_system_metadata_key, inner_cte.dense_rank_by_memory_mb FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.dense_rank_by_system_metadata_key > (SELECT avg_dense_rank_by_system_metadata_key FROM AvgMetaKeyRank);

question: For instances that are not deleted (deleted = 0), list each instance UUID, display name, system metadata key and value, the dense rank within each instance UUID, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of root disk size (STDDEV(root_gb)/AVG(root_gb)) computed only for instances that have system metadata key = 'image_image_type' and non-deleted instance info cache rows (instance_info_caches.deleted = 0); additionally, only return rows where the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) is greater than 0.75. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH InstanceMetadataWindow AS ( SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, ism.key, ism.value, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.uuid ORDER BY i.uuid) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 ), RootGbVariationByDisplayName AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.root_gb) / NULLIF(AVG(i.root_gb), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND iic.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(i.root_gb) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT imw.uuid, imw.display_name, imw.key, imw.value, imw.window_column, rgv.coefficient_of_variation FROM InstanceMetadataWindow AS imw JOIN RootGbVariationByDisplayName AS rgv ON imw.display_name = rgv.display_name ORDER BY rgv.coefficient_of_variation DESC, imw.uuid, imw.window_column) SELECT inner_cte.uuid, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.key, inner_cte.value, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation > 0.75 ORDER BY inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC, inner_cte.uuid, inner_cte.window_column;

question: For each VM state among instances in availability zone "flare3" that also had at least one completed migration with positive memory processed, return the VM state and the maximum total memory processed (in bytes) across those instances, where each instance’s total memory processed is summed over its completed migrations. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH CompletedMigrationsByInstance AS (SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name AS instance_display_name, i.availability_zone AS availability_zone, COUNT(m.id) AS completed_migration_count, SUM(m.memory_processed) AS total_memory_processed FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND m.memory_processed > 0 GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.availability_zone), AZFlare3InstanceNetworkRank AS (SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, c.NETWORK_INFO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB DESC) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3') SELECT az.UUID AS instance_uuid, az.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, az.VM_STATE, az.MEMORY_MB, az.NETWORK_INFO, az.window_column AS vm_state_memory_rank, cm.completed_migration_count, cm.total_memory_processed FROM AZFlare3InstanceNetworkRank az JOIN CompletedMigrationsByInstance cm ON az.UUID = cm.instance_uuid WHERE cm.availability_zone = 'flare3' ) SELECT inner_cte.VM_STATE AS vm_state, MAX(inner_cte.total_memory_processed) AS max_total_memory_processed_bytes FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.VM_STATE;

question: For each instance display name that has completed migrations and where the ratio of completed migration count to (completed migration count plus the network-info cache count range) is greater than 75%, list the instance display name, completed migration count, the cache count range/variance/stddev, the average completed migration count across all qualifying display names as a benchmark, and categorize each display name as 'HIGH_MIGRATION_ACTIVITY' (at least 50% above benchmark), 'LOW_MIGRATION_ACTIVITY' (at least 50% below benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_MIGRATION_ACTIVITY'. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH CompletedMigrations AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, c.ID AS instance_info_cache_id, SUM(m.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY i.INSTANCE_TYPE_ID ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' ), InstanceCacheStats AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MAX(cache_row_count) - MIN(cache_row_count) AS cache_count_range, VARIANCE(cache_row_count) AS cache_count_variance, STDDEV(cache_row_count) AS cache_count_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN ( SELECT iic.INSTANCE_UUID, COUNT(*) AS cache_row_count FROM INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic GROUP BY iic.INSTANCE_UUID, iic.ID ) AS cache_stats ON cache_stats.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY cache_count_range DESC ), CompletedMigrationsPerDisplayName AS ( SELECT cm.instance_display_name, COUNT(*) AS completed_migration_count FROM CompletedMigrations cm GROUP BY cm.instance_display_name ) SELECT cm.instance_display_name, cmpdn.completed_migration_count, ics.cache_count_range, ics.cache_count_variance, ics.cache_count_stddev FROM CompletedMigrationsPerDisplayName cmpdn JOIN InstanceCacheStats ics ON cmpdn.instance_display_name = ics.DISPLAY_NAME JOIN CompletedMigrations cm ON cm.instance_display_name = cmpdn.instance_display_name WHERE (cmpdn.completed_migration_count * 1.0 / (cmpdn.completed_migration_count + ics.cache_count_range)) > 0.75 GROUP BY cm.instance_display_name, cmpdn.completed_migration_count, ics.cache_count_range, ics.cache_count_variance, ics.cache_count_stddev ORDER BY cmpdn.completed_migration_count DESC), Benchmark AS ( SELECT AVG(completed_migration_count) AS avg_completed_migration_count FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.instance_display_name, ic.completed_migration_count, ic.cache_count_range, ic.cache_count_variance, ic.cache_count_stddev, b.avg_completed_migration_count AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.completed_migration_count > b.avg_completed_migration_count * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_MIGRATION_ACTIVITY' WHEN ic.completed_migration_count < b.avg_completed_migration_count * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_MIGRATION_ACTIVITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_MIGRATION_ACTIVITY' END AS migration_activity_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN Benchmark b ORDER BY ic.completed_migration_count DESC;

question: For each security group and rule protocol where the maximum “to” port across its non-deleted rules is greater than 1000, list the security group name, the protocol, that maximum “to” port, and the (for tcp rules) range and variance of the “from” port values for the same security group. Do not repeat the security group name if it is the same as the previous row, and include a subtotal row per security group showing the total number of qualifying protocols and the overall maximum “to” port for that group. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH MaxToPortByGroupProtocol AS ( SELECT sg.NAME, MAX(sgr.TO_PORT) AS max_to_port, sgr.PROTOCOL FROM SECURITY_GROUPS sg JOIN SECURITY_GROUP_RULES sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sg.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY sg.NAME, sgr.PROTOCOL HAVING MAX(sgr.TO_PORT) > 1000 ), TcpFromPortStatsByGroup AS ( SELECT sg.NAME AS security_group_name, MAX(sgr.FROM_PORT) - MIN(sgr.FROM_PORT) AS from_port_range, VARIANCE(sgr.FROM_PORT) AS from_port_variance FROM SECURITY_GROUPS AS sg JOIN SECURITY_GROUP_RULES AS sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sgr.PROTOCOL = 'tcp' GROUP BY sg.NAME ORDER BY from_port_range DESC ) SELECT mtp.NAME AS security_group_name, mtp.PROTOCOL, mtp.max_to_port, tfs.from_port_range, tfs.from_port_variance FROM MaxToPortByGroupProtocol mtp JOIN TcpFromPortStatsByGroup tfs ON mtp.NAME = tfs.security_group_name ORDER BY mtp.max_to_port DESC ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(security_group_name) OVER (ORDER BY sg_sort, security_group_name, protocol) = security_group_name THEN NULL ELSE security_group_name END AS security_group_name, protocol, max_to_port, from_port_range, from_port_variance, qualifying_protocols FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.security_group_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.security_group_name END AS sg_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.security_group_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.security_group_name END AS security_group_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.security_group_name) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE i.PROTOCOL END AS protocol, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.security_group_name) = 1 THEN MAX(i.max_to_port) ELSE i.max_to_port END AS max_to_port, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.security_group_name) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE i.from_port_range END AS from_port_range, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.security_group_name) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE i.from_port_variance END AS from_port_variance, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.security_group_name) = 1 THEN COUNT(*) ELSE NULL END AS qualifying_protocols FROM inner_cte i GROUP BY i.security_group_name, i.PROTOCOL, i.max_to_port, i.from_port_range, i.from_port_variance WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY sg_sort, security_group_name, protocol;

question: For each instance creation date, find the creation date and the highest coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) (standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) divided by average) in completed-migration memory remaining among the top 10 instances with the highest coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), considering only instances whose maximum completed-migration total memory is greater than 0. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH sq1 AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(m.memory_total) AS max_memory_total, i.created_at FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY i.display_name, i.created_at, m.status HAVING MAX(m.memory_total) > 0 ), sq2 AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT sq2.display_name, sq1.created_at, sq1.max_memory_total, sq2.coefficient_of_variation FROM sq2 JOIN sq1 ON sq2.display_name = sq1.display_name ORDER BY sq2.coefficient_of_variation DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT DATE(inner_cte.created_at) AS instance_creation_date, MAX(inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation) AS max_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DATE(inner_cte.created_at) ORDER BY max_coefficient_of_variation DESC;

question: For instances whose display name is "forge", list each instance’s UUID, display name, memory (MB), vCPU count, and instance_extra record ID, along with the running average of memory within the "forge" display-name group (ordered by memory) and the overall average and variance of memory (MB) for that same display name among instances that have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type'. Also include a utilization category for each instance’s memory compared to the overall average for that display name: 'HIGH_MEMORY' (at least 50% above average), 'LOW_MEMORY' (at least 50% below average), or 'AVERAGE_MEMORY'. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH ForgeInstances AS (SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, ie.id AS instance_extra_id, AVG(i.memory_mb) OVER ( PARTITION BY i.display_name ORDER BY i.memory_mb ) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.display_name = 'forge' ORDER BY i.memory_mb), MemoryStatsByDisplayName AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC), Combined AS ( SELECT fi.uuid, fi.display_name, fi.memory_mb, fi.vcpus, fi.instance_extra_id, fi.window_column, ms.avg_memory_mb, ms.memory_mb_variance FROM ForgeInstances fi LEFT JOIN MemoryStatsByDisplayName ms ON fi.display_name = ms.display_name ) SELECT * FROM Combined ORDER BY display_name, memory_mb) SELECT ic.uuid, ic.display_name, ic.memory_mb, ic.vcpus, ic.instance_extra_id, ic.window_column, ic.avg_memory_mb, ic.memory_mb_variance, CASE WHEN ic.memory_mb > ic.avg_memory_mb * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_MEMORY' WHEN ic.memory_mb < ic.avg_memory_mb * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_MEMORY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_MEMORY' END AS memory_utilization_category FROM inner_cte ic ORDER BY ic.display_name, ic.memory_mb;

question: For each project that has at least one instance whose display name is "forge", find the project ID and the highest total vCPUs used by any VM state within that project, where the per-VM-state totals are computed from the full "forge" instance details (including instance-info-cache and the VM-state-matched migration status summary for instances with system metadata key 'image_image_type'). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH ForgeInstances AS (SELECT i.ID AS instance_id, i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.USER_ID, i.PROJECT_ID, i.HOSTNAME, i.VM_STATE, i.POWER_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, c.ID AS info_cache_id, c.NETWORK_INFO, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.PROJECT_ID ORDER BY i.PROJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge'), MigrationStats AS (SELECT m.status AS migration_status, i.vm_state AS instance_vm_state, COUNT(m.id) AS migration_count, MIN(i.memory_mb) AS min_instance_memory_mb FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY m.status, i.vm_state), Combined AS ( SELECT fi.instance_id, fi.instance_uuid, fi.user_id, fi.project_id, fi.hostname, fi.vm_state, fi.power_state, fi.memory_mb, fi.vcpus, fi.availability_zone, fi.info_cache_id, fi.network_info, fi.window_column, ms.migration_status, ms.migration_count, ms.min_instance_memory_mb FROM ForgeInstances fi LEFT JOIN MigrationStats ms ON fi.vm_state = ms.instance_vm_state ) SELECT * FROM Combined ORDER BY instance_id, migration_status), ProjectVmStateTotals AS ( SELECT ic.project_id, ic.vm_state, SUM(ic.vcpus) AS total_vcpus_in_vm_state FROM inner_cte ic GROUP BY ic.project_id, ic.vm_state ) SELECT project_id, MAX(total_vcpus_in_vm_state) AS max_total_vcpus_by_vm_state FROM ProjectVmStateTotals GROUP BY project_id ORDER BY project_id;

question: For completed migrations, show the migration ID, the (flare3) instance UUID and display name, the instance system metadata key and value, the row number over metadata key (with a frame of 2 preceding rows and 1 following row), and the running sum of instance IDs within each metadata key group for flare3 instances, matching records by instance display name and metadata key; then, for each migration ID, return the maximum flare3 running-sum value observed across its matched metadata rows. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH CompletedMigrationsWithMetadata AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY ism.KEY ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed'), Flare3InstancesMetadataRunningSum AS (SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, ism.KEY, SUM(i.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3') SELECT c.migration_id, f.UUID AS instance_uuid, c.instance_display_name, c.metadata_key, c.metadata_value, c.window_column AS completed_migrations_row_number_window, f.window_column AS flare3_instance_id_running_sum_window FROM CompletedMigrationsWithMetadata c JOIN Flare3InstancesMetadataRunningSum f ON c.instance_display_name = f.DISPLAY_NAME AND c.metadata_key = f.KEY ORDER BY c.migration_id, c.metadata_key ) SELECT migration_id, MAX(flare3_instance_id_running_sum_window) AS max_flare3_instance_id_running_sum_window_per_migration FROM inner_cte GROUP BY migration_id ORDER BY migration_id;

question: For 'forge' instances that also appear among instances with system metadata key image_image_type, list only those whose memory (MB) is greater than the average memory (MB) of all 'forge' instances. Return the instance UUID, hostname, VM state, memory (MB), instance extra record ID, the windowed minimum memory (ordered by instance extra ID with 3 preceding and 1 following rows), along with the image_image_type metadata value, cached network info, and the row number ordered by the metadata value (with a window frame of 2 preceding and 1 following rows). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH ImageTypeMetadataInstances AS (SELECT t1.DISPLAY_NAME, t0.VALUE AS metadata_value, t2.NETWORK_INFO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t0.VALUE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t0.KEY = 'image_image_type'), ForgeInstanceDetails AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( ORDER BY ie.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge') SELECT f.instance_uuid, f.hostname, f.vm_state, f.memory_mb, f.instance_extra_id, f.window_column AS forge_min_memory_window, im.metadata_value, im.NETWORK_INFO, im.window_column AS image_type_row_number_window FROM ForgeInstanceDetails AS f JOIN ImageTypeMetadataInstances AS im ON im.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' ORDER BY f.instance_extra_id, f.instance_uuid), ForgeAvgMemory AS (SELECT AVG(i.MEMORY_MB * 1.0) AS avg_forge_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge') SELECT ic.instance_uuid, ic.hostname, ic.vm_state, ic.memory_mb, ic.instance_extra_id, ic.forge_min_memory_window, ic.metadata_value, ic.NETWORK_INFO, ic.image_type_row_number_window FROM inner_cte AS ic WHERE ic.memory_mb > (SELECT avg_forge_memory_mb FROM ForgeAvgMemory) ORDER BY ic.instance_extra_id, ic.instance_uuid;

question: For migrations where the instance has a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type', show the migration status and instance VM state combinations whose migration count is more than 75% of the total number of such instances in that VM state, along with the migration count and minimum instance memory (MB). Also include subtotals by migration status and a grand total. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH InstanceStateDisplayStats AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(i.ID) AS instance_count, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME ), MigrationStatusInstanceStateStats AS ( SELECT m.status AS migration_status, i.vm_state AS instance_vm_state, COUNT(m.id) AS migration_count, MIN(i.memory_mb) AS min_instance_memory_mb FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY m.status, i.vm_state ), InstanceTotalsByVMState AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, COUNT(i.ID) AS total_instance_count FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ) SELECT msiss.migration_status, msiss.instance_vm_state, msiss.migration_count, msiss.min_instance_memory_mb FROM MigrationStatusInstanceStateStats msiss JOIN InstanceTotalsByVMState it ON msiss.instance_vm_state = it.VM_STATE WHERE (msiss.migration_count * 1.0 / it.total_instance_count) > 0.75 ), RollupStats AS ( SELECT inner_cte.migration_status, inner_cte.instance_vm_state, COUNT(*) AS qualifying_combinations, SUM(inner_cte.migration_count) AS total_migration_count, MIN(inner_cte.min_instance_memory_mb) AS min_instance_memory_mb FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.migration_status, inner_cte.instance_vm_state ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(migration_status) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE migration_status END AS migration_status, CASE WHEN GROUPING(instance_vm_state) = 1 AND GROUPING(migration_status) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE instance_vm_state END AS instance_vm_state, SUM(qualifying_combinations) AS qualifying_combinations, SUM(total_migration_count) AS total_migration_count, MIN(min_instance_memory_mb) AS min_instance_memory_mb FROM RollupStats GROUP BY migration_status, instance_vm_state WITH ROLLUP;

question: For each instance display name that is not deleted and has a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type', list the instance display name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the time (in days) between instance creation and the last update of its instance info cache, the memory range (in MB), the memory variance (in MB), and the normalized ratio of coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) divided by memory range. Do not repeat the display name if it is the same as the previous row. Include a final TOTAL row that shows the overall average of each metric across all returned display names.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH InstanceCacheTiming AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(c.updated_at - i.created_at) / NULLIF(AVG(c.updated_at - i.created_at), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS e ON e.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON c.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(c.updated_at - i.created_at) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC), InstanceMemorySpread AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_range_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_variance_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_range_mb DESC) SELECT ict.display_name, ict.coefficient_of_variation, ims.memory_range_mb, ims.memory_variance_mb, ROUND(ict.coefficient_of_variation / NULLIF(ims.memory_range_mb, 0), 6) AS cov_per_mb_range FROM InstanceCacheTiming ict JOIN InstanceMemorySpread ims ON ict.display_name = ims.display_name ORDER BY cov_per_mb_range DESC) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(display_name) OVER (ORDER BY display_name_sort, cov_per_mb_range DESC) = display_name THEN NULL ELSE display_name END AS display_name, coefficient_of_variation, memory_range_mb, memory_variance_mb, cov_per_mb_range FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.display_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.display_name END AS display_name_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.display_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.display_name END AS display_name, AVG(i.coefficient_of_variation) AS coefficient_of_variation, AVG(i.memory_range_mb) AS memory_range_mb, AVG(i.memory_variance_mb) AS memory_variance_mb, AVG(i.cov_per_mb_range) AS cov_per_mb_range FROM inner_cte i GROUP BY i.display_name WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY display_name_sort, cov_per_mb_range DESC;

question: For instance display names that have system metadata with key = 'image_image_type', and where an instance has at least 2 completed migrations, list the instance UUID, display name, availability zone, the number of completed migrations, the total memory processed across those completed migrations, and the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of instance memory (MB) for that display name. Do not repeat the display name if it is the same as the previous row. Include a subtotal row per display name showing the total number of qualifying instances, total completed migrations, and total memory processed. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH InstanceCompletedMigrationStats AS ( SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.availability_zone, COUNT(m.id) AS migration_count, SUM(m.memory_processed) AS total_memory_processed FROM instances i JOIN migrations m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.availability_zone ), InstanceDisplayNameMemoryStats AS ( SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT icms.instance_uuid, icms.display_name, icms.availability_zone, icms.migration_count, icms.total_memory_processed, idnms.memory_mb_variance, idnms.memory_mb_stddev FROM InstanceCompletedMigrationStats icms JOIN InstanceDisplayNameMemoryStats idnms ON icms.display_name = idnms.display_name WHERE icms.migration_count >= 2 ORDER BY icms.migration_count DESC, icms.total_memory_processed DESC ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(display_name) OVER (ORDER BY display_name_sort, display_name, instance_uuid) = display_name THEN NULL ELSE display_name END AS display_name, instance_uuid, availability_zone, migration_count, total_memory_processed, memory_mb_variance, memory_mb_stddev, qualifying_instances, total_migrations_for_display_name, total_memory_processed_for_display_name FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.display_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE inner_cte.display_name END AS display_name_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.display_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE inner_cte.display_name END AS display_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.display_name) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE inner_cte.instance_uuid END AS instance_uuid, CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.display_name) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE inner_cte.availability_zone END AS availability_zone, CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.display_name) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE inner_cte.migration_count END AS migration_count, CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.display_name) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE inner_cte.total_memory_processed END AS total_memory_processed, CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.display_name) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE inner_cte.memory_mb_variance END AS memory_mb_variance, CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.display_name) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev END AS memory_mb_stddev, COUNT(inner_cte.instance_uuid) AS qualifying_instances, SUM(inner_cte.migration_count) AS total_migrations_for_display_name, SUM(inner_cte.total_memory_processed) AS total_memory_processed_for_display_name FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.availability_zone, inner_cte.migration_count, inner_cte.total_memory_processed, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY display_name_sort, display_name, instance_uuid;

question: For instance display names that have completed migrations and where the ratio of completed migration count to (completed migration count plus the network-info cache count range) is greater than 75%, provide the instance display name, the number of completed migrations, the range/variance/standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of network-info cache record counts per (non-deleted) instance, and the deviation of that completed migration count from the overall average completed migration count across all qualifying display names. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH CompletedMigrations AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, c.ID AS instance_info_cache_id, SUM(m.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY i.INSTANCE_TYPE_ID ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' ), InstanceCacheStats AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MAX(cache_row_count) - MIN(cache_row_count) AS cache_count_range, VARIANCE(cache_row_count) AS cache_count_variance, STDDEV(cache_row_count) AS cache_count_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN ( SELECT iic.INSTANCE_UUID, COUNT(*) AS cache_row_count FROM INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic GROUP BY iic.INSTANCE_UUID, iic.ID ) AS cache_stats ON cache_stats.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY cache_count_range DESC ), CompletedMigrationsPerDisplayName AS ( SELECT cm.instance_display_name, COUNT(*) AS completed_migration_count FROM CompletedMigrations cm GROUP BY cm.instance_display_name ) SELECT cm.instance_display_name, cmpdn.completed_migration_count, ics.cache_count_range, ics.cache_count_variance, ics.cache_count_stddev FROM CompletedMigrationsPerDisplayName cmpdn JOIN InstanceCacheStats ics ON cmpdn.instance_display_name = ics.DISPLAY_NAME JOIN CompletedMigrations cm ON cm.instance_display_name = cmpdn.instance_display_name WHERE (cmpdn.completed_migration_count * 1.0 / (cmpdn.completed_migration_count + ics.cache_count_range)) > 0.75 GROUP BY cm.instance_display_name, cmpdn.completed_migration_count, ics.cache_count_range, ics.cache_count_variance, ics.cache_count_stddev ORDER BY cmpdn.completed_migration_count DESC ), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(completed_migration_count) AS avg_completed_migration_count FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.instance_display_name, ic.completed_migration_count, ic.cache_count_range, ic.cache_count_variance, ic.cache_count_stddev, (ic.completed_migration_count - ac.avg_completed_migration_count) AS deviation_from_avg_completed_migrations FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte ac ORDER BY ic.completed_migration_count DESC;

question: For availability zone 'flare3', show each instance (display name, UUID, VM state, memory in MB, vCPU count, the max system-metadata ID over the current row through the next 2 rows ordered by instance UUID, and the instance_info_caches ID), and also include (1) the total memory (in MB) across all instances in that same VM state (only for VM states whose total memory exceeds 50000 MB) and (2) the average of those per-VM-state total-memory values across all qualifying VM states. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH VMStateMemory AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) AS total_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE HAVING SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) > 50000), InstanceMetadataWindow AS (SELECT i.display_name, i.availability_zone, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, i.uuid, MAX(ism.id) OVER ( ORDER BY i.uuid ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_metadata_id_next_2 FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3') SELECT imw.display_name, imw.availability_zone, imw.vm_state, vsm.total_memory_mb, imw.memory_mb, imw.vcpus, imw.uuid, imw.max_metadata_id_next_2 FROM InstanceMetadataWindow imw JOIN VMStateMemory vsm ON imw.vm_state = vsm.VM_STATE) SELECT DISTINCT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.availability_zone, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.total_memory_mb, avg_totals.avg_total_memory_mb_across_states, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.vcpus, inner_cte.uuid, inner_cte.max_metadata_id_next_2, ic.id AS instance_info_cache_id FROM inner_cte JOIN instances i ON i.uuid = inner_cte.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches ic ON ic.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN ( SELECT AVG(state_totals.total_memory_mb) AS avg_total_memory_mb_across_states FROM ( SELECT vm_state, total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte GROUP BY vm_state, total_memory_mb ) AS state_totals ) AS avg_totals;

question: For each project, find the project ID and (1) the highest vCPU count among its non-deleted instances that also have a non-deleted instance info cache record and a completed migration, and (2) the total number of such instances in that project. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH q1 AS ( SELECT i.id AS instance_id, i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.user_id, i.project_id, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, c.id AS info_cache_id, MAX(i.id) OVER (ORDER BY i.id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_id_next_2 FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND c.deleted = 0 ), q2 AS ( SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.status, MIN(i.memory_mb) OVER ( ORDER BY m.id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' ) SELECT q1.instance_id, q1.instance_uuid, q1.user_id, q1.project_id, q1.display_name, q1.vm_state, q1.memory_mb, q1.vcpus, q1.info_cache_id, q1.max_instance_id_next_2, q2.source_compute, q2.dest_compute, q2.status AS migration_status, q2.window_column AS min_instance_memory_mb_window FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.instance_uuid = q2.uuid ORDER BY q1.instance_id) SELECT inner_cte.project_id, MAX(inner_cte.vcpus) AS max_vcpus_in_project, COUNT(DISTINCT inner_cte.instance_uuid) AS instance_count_in_project FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.project_id ORDER BY inner_cte.project_id;

question: For each completed migration whose instance is a non-deleted instance in availability zone “flare3”, show the migration id, status, source compute, destination compute, destination host, instance display name, instance VM state, the maximum instance memory (in MB) over a window ordered by migration id that includes the current row and the next 2 rows, plus the instance’s network_info cache, the number of linked instance_extra records, and the total memory (in MB) across those linked records; also include the average of total_memory_mb across all such flare3 instances as a benchmark and categorize each row as 'HIGH_MEMORY' (at least 50% above the benchmark), 'LOW_MEMORY' (at least 50% below the benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_MEMORY'. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH CompletedMigrations AS (SELECT m.id AS migration_id, m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.dest_host, i.display_name, i.vm_state, MAX(i.memory_mb) OVER (ORDER BY m.id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_memory_mb_next_2 FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed'), Flare3InstanceExtras AS (SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name, iic.network_info, COUNT(ie.id) AS extra_record_count, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances i JOIN instance_extra ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches iic ON iic.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, iic.network_info) SELECT cm.migration_id, cm.status, cm.source_compute, cm.dest_compute, cm.dest_host, cm.display_name, cm.vm_state, cm.max_memory_mb_next_2, fie.network_info, fie.extra_record_count, fie.total_memory_mb FROM CompletedMigrations cm JOIN instances i ON i.display_name = cm.display_name JOIN Flare3InstanceExtras fie ON fie.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.availability_zone = 'flare3' ORDER BY cm.migration_id ), AverageTotalMemory AS ( SELECT AVG(total_memory_mb) AS avg_total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.migration_id, ic.status, ic.source_compute, ic.dest_compute, ic.dest_host, ic.display_name, ic.vm_state, ic.max_memory_mb_next_2, ic.network_info, ic.extra_record_count, ic.total_memory_mb, atm.avg_total_memory_mb AS benchmark_total_memory_mb, CASE WHEN ic.total_memory_mb > atm.avg_total_memory_mb * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_MEMORY' WHEN ic.total_memory_mb < atm.avg_total_memory_mb * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_MEMORY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_MEMORY' END AS memory_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AverageTotalMemory atm;

question: For each availability zone and VM state (considering only non-deleted instances), list the availability zone, VM state, the number of instances, and the earliest instance creation time; additionally, for those same availability zone and VM state groups, show the average instance count across all availability zone/VM state groups, and for instances in VM state 'shelved_offloaded' also show the instance UUID, display name, project ID, power state, system metadata key and value, and the maximum instance memory (in MB) over the current row and the next 2 rows when ordering by instance UUID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH InstanceZoneStateStats AS (SELECT ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, ins.VM_STATE, COUNT(ins.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(ins.CREATED_AT) AS earliest_created_at FROM INSTANCES AS ins JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID WHERE ins.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, ins.VM_STATE), ShelvedOffloadedInstanceMetadata AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.PROJECT_ID AS project_id, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (ORDER BY i.UUID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_memory_mb_next_2 FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded') SELECT s.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, s.VM_STATE, s.instance_count, s.earliest_created_at, som.instance_uuid, som.display_name, som.project_id, som.power_state, som.metadata_key, som.metadata_value, som.max_memory_mb_next_2 FROM InstanceZoneStateStats s JOIN INSTANCES i ON i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = s.AVAILABILITY_ZONE AND i.VM_STATE = s.VM_STATE AND i.DELETED = 0 JOIN ShelvedOffloadedInstanceMetadata som ON som.instance_uuid = i.UUID ORDER BY s.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, s.VM_STATE, som.instance_uuid, som.metadata_key) SELECT ic.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, ic.VM_STATE, ic.instance_count, ic.earliest_created_at, ic.instance_uuid, ic.display_name, ic.project_id, ic.power_state, ic.metadata_key, ic.metadata_value, ic.max_memory_mb_next_2, avg_stats.avg_instance_count FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN ( SELECT AVG(instance_count) AS avg_instance_count FROM ( SELECT COUNT(ins2.UUID) AS instance_count FROM INSTANCES AS ins2 JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie2 ON ie2.INSTANCE_UUID = ins2.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic2 ON iic2.INSTANCE_UUID = ins2.UUID WHERE ins2.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY ins2.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, ins2.VM_STATE ) AS sub ) AS avg_stats ORDER BY ic.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, ic.VM_STATE, ic.instance_uuid, ic.metadata_key;

question: For each VM state and power state among non-deleted instances whose display name is 'forge', list the VM state, power state, the number of distinct instances, the total vCPUs, and the average of the instance-extra-ID-to-next-2-maximum ratio (rounded to 2 decimals). Include subtotals for each VM state and a grand total.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH ForgeInstances AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ie.CREATED_AT AS instance_extra_created_at, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, MIN(ie.ID) OVER ( ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge'), NonDeletedInstances AS (SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.power_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, MAX(ie.id) OVER (ORDER BY i.uuid ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_extra_id_next2 FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.display_name = 'forge') SELECT fi.instance_uuid, fi.display_name, fi.vm_state, ndi.power_state, fi.memory_mb, fi.vcpus, fi.instance_extra_id, fi.instance_extra_created_at, fi.network_info, fi.window_column AS min_instance_extra_id_window_3_preceding_1_following_by_memory, ndi.max_instance_extra_id_next2, ROUND(fi.instance_extra_id / NULLIF(ndi.max_instance_extra_id_next2, 0), 2) AS instance_extra_id_to_next2_max_ratio FROM ForgeInstances fi JOIN NonDeletedInstances ndi ON ndi.uuid = fi.instance_uuid ORDER BY instance_extra_id_to_next2_max_ratio DESC) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.vm_state) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE inner_cte.vm_state END AS vm_state, CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.power_state) = 1 AND GROUPING(inner_cte.vm_state) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE CAST(inner_cte.power_state AS CHAR) END AS power_state, COUNT(DISTINCT inner_cte.instance_uuid) AS total_instances, SUM(inner_cte.vcpus) AS total_vcpus, ROUND(AVG(inner_cte.instance_extra_id_to_next2_max_ratio), 2) AS avg_instance_extra_id_to_next2_max_ratio FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.power_state WITH ROLLUP;

question: For migrations with status "completed", list the migration id, source compute, destination compute, destination host, instance display name, instance memory (MB), the average instance memory (MB) over a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows (partitioned by migration status and ordered by migration id), and also include (by instance display name) the memory range (MB) and memory variance (MB) for instances that are not deleted; then return only those completed migrations whose instance memory (MB) is greater than the overall average instance memory (MB) across all completed migrations. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH CompletedMigrations AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.MEMORY_MB, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' ORDER BY m.ID ), InstanceMemoryStats AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_range_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_variance_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_range_mb DESC ) SELECT cm.migration_id, cm.source_compute, cm.dest_compute, cm.dest_host, cm.display_name, cm.memory_mb, cm.window_column AS avg_memory_mb_window_2_pre_2_fol, ims.memory_range_mb, ims.memory_variance_mb FROM CompletedMigrations cm JOIN InstanceMemoryStats ims ON cm.display_name = ims.display_name ORDER BY cm.migration_id ) SELECT inner_cte.migration_id, inner_cte.source_compute, inner_cte.dest_compute, inner_cte.dest_host, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb_window_2_pre_2_fol, inner_cte.memory_range_mb, inner_cte.memory_variance_mb FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.memory_mb > (SELECT AVG(memory_mb) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY inner_cte.migration_id;

question: For instances that are not deleted and have system metadata with the key `image_image_type`, list each instance’s UUID, display name, the `image_image_type` metadata value, the number of network-info cache records, the total memory (MB) summed across those cache records, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of `memory_remaining` for completed migrations, and the deviation of that coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) from the overall average coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) across all such instances. Order results by the deviation descending, then by instance UUID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH InstanceCacheAndImageType AS (SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name, ism.value AS image_type_value, COUNT(iic.id) AS cache_record_count, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances i JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches iic ON iic.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, ism.value), InstanceMigrationVariation AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT icait.instance_uuid, icait.display_name, icait.image_type_value, icait.cache_record_count, icait.total_memory_mb, imv.coefficient_of_variation FROM InstanceCacheAndImageType icait JOIN InstanceMigrationVariation imv ON imv.display_name = icait.display_name ORDER BY imv.coefficient_of_variation DESC, icait.instance_uuid), AvgCoeffVar AS (SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.instance_uuid, ic.display_name, ic.image_type_value, ic.cache_record_count, ic.total_memory_mb, ic.coefficient_of_variation, (ic.coefficient_of_variation - acv.avg_coefficient_of_variation) AS deviation_from_avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AvgCoeffVar acv ORDER BY deviation_from_avg_coefficient_of_variation DESC, ic.instance_uuid;

question: For instances whose display name is 'forge' and whose total memory (summed across their records) is greater than the overall average memory plus one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), show the instance UUID, hostname, system metadata key, the running sum of instance IDs within each metadata key group (ordered by instance ID), the instance’s total memory (MB), and the instance extra record ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH subq1 AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, SUM(i.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' ), subq2 AS ( SELECT i.uuid, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.uuid HAVING SUM(i.memory_mb) > ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb) + STDDEV(memory_mb) FROM instances ) ) SELECT subq1.instance_uuid, subq1.hostname, subq1.metadata_key, subq1.window_column, subq2.total_memory_mb FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.instance_uuid = subq2.uuid ORDER BY subq2.total_memory_mb DESC, subq1.metadata_key, subq1.window_column ) SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.hostname, inner_cte.metadata_key, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.total_memory_mb, ie.id AS instance_extra_id FROM inner_cte JOIN instance_extra ie ON ie.instance_uuid = inner_cte.instance_uuid ORDER BY inner_cte.total_memory_mb DESC, inner_cte.metadata_key, inner_cte.window_column, ie.id;

question: For non-deleted instances that also have a completed migration, list the instance ID, UUID, user ID, project ID, display name, VM state, memory (MB), vCPUs, and instance info cache record ID, along with (1) the maximum instance ID over the current row and the next 2 rows when ordered by instance ID, and (2) the migration source compute, destination compute, migration status, and the minimum instance memory (MB) over a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by migration ID; only keep rows where the instance’s vCPU count is greater than the average vCPU count of all non-deleted instances in the same VM state. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH q1 AS ( SELECT i.id AS instance_id, i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.user_id, i.project_id, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, c.id AS info_cache_id, MAX(i.id) OVER (ORDER BY i.id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_id_next_2 FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND c.deleted = 0 ), q2 AS ( SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.status, MIN(i.memory_mb) OVER ( ORDER BY m.id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' ) SELECT q1.instance_id, q1.instance_uuid, q1.user_id, q1.project_id, q1.display_name, q1.vm_state, q1.memory_mb, q1.vcpus, q1.info_cache_id, q1.max_instance_id_next_2, q2.source_compute, q2.dest_compute, q2.status AS migration_status, q2.window_column AS min_instance_memory_mb_window FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.instance_uuid = q2.uuid ORDER BY q1.instance_id ), VmStateVcpuAverages AS ( SELECT i.vm_state, AVG(i.vcpus * 1.0) AS avg_vcpus_in_state FROM instances i WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.vm_state ) SELECT inner_cte.instance_id, inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.user_id, inner_cte.project_id, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.vcpus, inner_cte.info_cache_id, inner_cte.max_instance_id_next_2, inner_cte.source_compute, inner_cte.dest_compute, inner_cte.migration_status, inner_cte.min_instance_memory_mb_window FROM inner_cte JOIN VmStateVcpuAverages vsa ON vsa.vm_state = inner_cte.vm_state WHERE inner_cte.vcpus > ( SELECT avg_vcpus_in_state FROM VmStateVcpuAverages WHERE VmStateVcpuAverages.vm_state = inner_cte.vm_state ) ORDER BY inner_cte.instance_id;

question: For each instance that has a completed migration, list the instance display name, hostname, VM state, memory in MB, vCPU count, instance UUID, migration status, and the maximum migration ID over the current row and the next 2 rows (ordered by instance UUID), along with the display-name-level range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of completed-migration counts; also calculate the vCPUs-per-MB ratio (vCPUs divided by memory_mb) and order results by this ratio descending. Additionally, include each instance’s project_id and the total number of non-deleted instances in that project, along with the average non-deleted instance count across all projects.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH InstanceMigrations AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.HOSTNAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, i.UUID, m.STATUS, MAX(m.ID) OVER (ORDER BY i.UUID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_migration_id_next2 FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed'), MigrationStats AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(migration_count) - MIN(migration_count) AS migration_count_range, VARIANCE(migration_count) AS migration_count_variance, STDDEV(migration_count) AS migration_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid JOIN ( SELECT m.instance_uuid, m.dest_compute, COUNT(*) AS migration_count FROM migrations AS m WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY m.instance_uuid, m.dest_compute ) AS mig_stats ON i.uuid = mig_stats.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY migration_count_range DESC) SELECT im.DISPLAY_NAME, im.HOSTNAME, im.VM_STATE, im.MEMORY_MB, im.VCPUS, im.UUID, im.STATUS, im.max_migration_id_next2, ms.migration_count_range, ms.migration_count_variance, ms.migration_count_stddev, ROUND(im.VCPUS / NULLIF(im.MEMORY_MB, 0), 6) AS vcpus_per_mb_ratio FROM InstanceMigrations im JOIN MigrationStats ms ON im.DISPLAY_NAME = ms.display_name ORDER BY vcpus_per_mb_ratio DESC ), project_instance_counts AS ( SELECT i.project_id, COUNT(*) AS total_instances_in_project FROM instances i WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.project_id ), avg_project_instances AS ( SELECT AVG(sub.instance_count) AS avg_instance_count_across_projects FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS instance_count FROM instances WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY project_id ) AS sub ) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.HOSTNAME, inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.MEMORY_MB, inner_cte.VCPUS, inner_cte.UUID, inner_cte.STATUS, inner_cte.max_migration_id_next2, inner_cte.migration_count_range, inner_cte.migration_count_variance, inner_cte.migration_count_stddev, inner_cte.vcpus_per_mb_ratio, i.project_id, pic.total_instances_in_project, api.avg_instance_count_across_projects FROM inner_cte JOIN instances i ON i.uuid = inner_cte.UUID LEFT JOIN project_instance_counts pic ON pic.project_id = i.project_id CROSS JOIN avg_project_instances api ORDER BY inner_cte.vcpus_per_mb_ratio DESC;

question: For instances named 'forge' that also have completed migrations while in the 'shelved_offloaded' VM state, list the same migration/instance/metadata fields as before, but only keep rows where the instance’s memory (MB) is greater than the average memory (MB) of all 'forge' instances in the 'shelved_offloaded' VM state. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH CompletedShelvedMigrations AS (SELECT m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.memory_mb, ism.key, ism.value, MIN(i.memory_mb) OVER ( ORDER BY m.id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded'), ForgeInstances AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( ORDER BY ie.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge') SELECT csm.status AS migration_status, csm.source_compute, csm.dest_compute, csm.instance_uuid, csm.display_name, csm.memory_mb, fi.hostname, fi.vm_state, fi.instance_extra_id, csm.key AS system_metadata_key, csm.value AS system_metadata_value, csm.window_column AS migration_window_min_memory_mb, fi.window_column AS instance_extra_window_min_memory_mb FROM CompletedShelvedMigrations csm JOIN ForgeInstances fi ON csm.instance_uuid = fi.instance_uuid ORDER BY csm.instance_uuid, fi.instance_extra_id), ForgeShelvedAvg AS ( SELECT AVG(i.memory_mb * 1.0) AS avg_forge_shelved_memory_mb FROM instances i WHERE i.display_name = 'forge' AND i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' ) SELECT ic.migration_status, ic.source_compute, ic.dest_compute, ic.instance_uuid, ic.display_name, ic.memory_mb, ic.hostname, ic.vm_state, ic.instance_extra_id, ic.system_metadata_key, ic.system_metadata_value, ic.migration_window_min_memory_mb, ic.instance_extra_window_min_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ic WHERE ic.memory_mb > (SELECT avg_forge_shelved_memory_mb FROM ForgeShelvedAvg) ORDER BY ic.instance_uuid, ic.instance_extra_id;

question: For instances whose display name is "forge", list each instance’s UUID, display name, memory (MB), vCPU count, and instance_extra record ID, along with the running average of memory within the "forge" display-name group (ordered by memory) and the overall average and variance of memory (MB) for that same display name among instances that have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type'. Also include, for each returned instance, the deviation of its memory (MB) from the overall average memory (MB) for that display name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH ForgeInstances AS (SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, ie.id AS instance_extra_id, AVG(i.memory_mb) OVER ( PARTITION BY i.display_name ORDER BY i.memory_mb ) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.display_name = 'forge' ORDER BY i.memory_mb), MemoryStatsByDisplayName AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC), Combined AS ( SELECT fi.uuid, fi.display_name, fi.memory_mb, fi.vcpus, fi.instance_extra_id, fi.window_column, ms.avg_memory_mb, ms.memory_mb_variance FROM ForgeInstances fi LEFT JOIN MemoryStatsByDisplayName ms ON fi.display_name = ms.display_name ) SELECT * FROM Combined ORDER BY display_name, memory_mb) SELECT ic.uuid, ic.display_name, ic.memory_mb, ic.vcpus, ic.instance_extra_id, ic.window_column, ic.avg_memory_mb, ic.memory_mb_variance, (ic.memory_mb - ic.avg_memory_mb) AS deviation_from_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ic ORDER BY ic.display_name, ic.memory_mb;

question: For each row produced by the combined “completed migrations matched to high-total-memory shelved_offloaded display names (plus unmatched high-total-memory shelved_offloaded names)” report, return only those rows whose shelved-offloaded total memory is greater than the average shelved-offloaded total memory across all high-total-memory display names, showing the migration details (when present), the windowed minimum instance memory, the shelved-offloaded total memory, and the reason. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH ShelvedOffloadedHighMemoryByName AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) AS total_memory_mb FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME HAVING SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) > 50000 ), CompletedMigrationsWithWindowMinMemory AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.INSTANCE_UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( ORDER BY m.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT cm.migration_id, cm.migration_status, cm.source_compute, cm.dest_compute, cm.instance_uuid, cm.instance_display_name, cm.instance_memory_mb, cm.instance_extra_id, cm.window_column, sh.total_memory_mb AS shelved_offloaded_total_memory_mb, 'Completed Migration' AS reason FROM CompletedMigrationsWithWindowMinMemory cm JOIN ShelvedOffloadedHighMemoryByName sh ON sh.DISPLAY_NAME = cm.instance_display_name UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS migration_id, NULL AS migration_status, NULL AS source_compute, NULL AS dest_compute, NULL AS instance_uuid, sh.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, NULL AS instance_memory_mb, NULL AS instance_extra_id, NULL AS window_column, sh.total_memory_mb AS shelved_offloaded_total_memory_mb, 'Shelved Offloaded High Total Memory' AS reason FROM ShelvedOffloadedHighMemoryByName sh ) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY instance_display_name, migration_id) , HighMemoryAverages AS ( SELECT AVG(shelved_offloaded_total_memory_mb * 1.0) AS avg_shelved_offloaded_total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte WHERE shelved_offloaded_total_memory_mb IS NOT NULL ) SELECT i.migration_id, i.migration_status, i.source_compute, i.dest_compute, i.instance_uuid, i.instance_display_name, i.instance_memory_mb, i.instance_extra_id, i.window_column, i.shelved_offloaded_total_memory_mb, i.reason FROM inner_cte i WHERE i.shelved_offloaded_total_memory_mb > ( SELECT avg_shelved_offloaded_total_memory_mb FROM HighMemoryAverages ) ORDER BY i.instance_display_name, i.migration_id;

question: For each display name that appears among instances in the “shelved_offloaded” VM state (and has a matching INSTANCE_EXTRA row), what is the maximum memory in MB used by any such instance, and how many shelved-offloaded instances contribute to that display name (counted from the same set of instances)? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH shelved_offloaded_instances AS (SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.MEMORY_MB, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.MEMORY_MB ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded'), memory_variance_by_display_name AS (SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC) SELECT soi.UUID, soi.DISPLAY_NAME, soi.MEMORY_MB, soi.instance_extra_id, soi.window_column AS memory_mb_rank_within_group_by_uuid, mv.memory_mb_variance FROM shelved_offloaded_instances AS soi JOIN memory_variance_by_display_name AS mv ON soi.DISPLAY_NAME = mv.display_name) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, MAX(inner_cte.memory_mb) AS max_memory_mb_among_shelved_offloaded, COUNT(*) AS shelved_offloaded_instance_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name;

question: For instances with display name 'forge' that have system metadata with KEY = 'image_image_type', show each instance UUID and display name along with the display-name-level ROOT_GB range and variance, plus each instance’s system metadata key/value and its row number ordered by metadata key (using a window frame of 2 preceding rows and 1 following row). Also include the deviation of that display name’s ROOT_GB range from the average ROOT_GB range across all display names that have 'image_image_type' metadata, ordering results by the ROOT_GB range descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH q1 AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MAX(i.ROOT_GB) - MIN(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_range, VARIANCE(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY root_gb_range DESC ), q2 AS ( SELECT i.UUID, ism.KEY, ism.VALUE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ism.KEY ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' ) SELECT q2.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME, q1.root_gb_range, q1.root_gb_variance, q2.KEY AS system_metadata_key, q2.VALUE AS system_metadata_value, q2.window_column FROM q2 JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON i.UUID = q2.UUID JOIN q1 ON q1.DISPLAY_NAME = i.DISPLAY_NAME JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism_img ON ism_img.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE ism_img.KEY = 'image_image_type' ORDER BY q1.root_gb_range DESC, q2.window_column ), avg_ranges AS ( SELECT AVG(root_gb_range) AS avg_root_gb_range FROM ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MAX(i.ROOT_GB) - MIN(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_range FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ) AS per_display_name ) SELECT ic.instance_uuid, ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.root_gb_range, ic.root_gb_variance, ic.system_metadata_key, ic.system_metadata_value, ic.window_column, (ic.root_gb_range - ar.avg_root_gb_range) AS deviation_from_avg_root_gb_range FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN avg_ranges AS ar ORDER BY ic.root_gb_range DESC, ic.window_column;

question: For availability zone "flare3", among instances that have at least one completed migration with a non-deleted instance info cache, show the top 10 instances by total vCPU count (summing vCPUs across the qualifying instances), including each instance's UUID, display name, total vCPUs, total memory, and whether the instance has any non-completed (active) migrations. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH az_instance_metadata AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3'), completed_migrations AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND ic.DELETED = 0), flare3_completed_migrations AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.INSTANCE_UUID FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' ) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT aim.instance_uuid) AS flare3_instances_with_completed_migrations_count, COUNT(DISTINCT fcm.migration_id) AS flare3_completed_migrations_count FROM flare3_completed_migrations fcm JOIN az_instance_metadata aim ON fcm.INSTANCE_UUID = aim.instance_uuid JOIN completed_migrations cm ON fcm.migration_id = cm.migration_id) SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name AS instance_name, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM migrations m2 WHERE m2.instance_uuid = i.uuid AND m2.deleted = 0 AND m2.status NOT IN ('completed', 'failed', 'error') ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_active_migrations FROM inner_cte x JOIN instances i ON i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.deleted = 0 JOIN migrations m ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid AND m.deleted = 0 AND m.status = 'completed' JOIN instance_info_caches ic ON ic.instance_uuid = i.uuid AND ic.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name ORDER BY total_vcpus DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each instance display name that has completed migrations and a non-zero variance in instance memory (MB), list the instance display name, the average instance memory (MB), the variance of instance memory (MB), and the number of completed migrations. Include subtotals for each instance display name and a grand total. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH InstanceMemoryStats AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC), CompletedMigrationWindowedMins AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.INSTANCE_UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( ORDER BY m.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed') SELECT cmwm.instance_display_name, ims.avg_memory_mb, ims.memory_mb_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT cmwm.migration_id) AS completed_migration_count, MIN(cmwm.window_column) AS min_windowed_memory_mb FROM CompletedMigrationWindowedMins cmwm JOIN InstanceMemoryStats ims ON cmwm.instance_display_name = ims.DISPLAY_NAME WHERE ims.memory_mb_variance > 0 GROUP BY cmwm.instance_display_name, ims.avg_memory_mb, ims.memory_mb_variance ORDER BY ims.memory_mb_variance DESC) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.instance_display_name) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE inner_cte.instance_display_name END AS instance_display_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.instance_display_name) = 0 AND GROUPING(inner_cte.avg_memory_mb) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE AVG(inner_cte.avg_memory_mb) END AS avg_instance_memory_mb, CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.instance_display_name) = 0 AND GROUPING(inner_cte.memory_mb_variance) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE AVG(inner_cte.memory_mb_variance) END AS memory_mb_variance, SUM(inner_cte.completed_migration_count) AS completed_migration_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.instance_display_name, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance WITH ROLLUP;

question: For instance display names matching the pattern 'prime', list (per display name) the migration-count range/variance/standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) for completed migrations, the variance/standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of MEMORY_MB among instances that have a non-deleted instance info cache record, the total number of such instances, and whether any of those instances have an active (non-completed/non-failed/non-error) non-deleted migration—restricted to only those display names where the migration-count range per display name is greater than 75% of the total instance count for that display name. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "Display 'prime'" is predicated by "instances.display_name REGEXP 'prime'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH MigrationStats AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(migration_count) - MIN(migration_count) AS migration_count_range, VARIANCE(migration_count) AS migration_count_variance, STDDEV(migration_count) AS migration_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid JOIN ( SELECT m.instance_uuid, m.dest_compute, COUNT(*) AS migration_count FROM migrations AS m WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY m.instance_uuid, m.dest_compute ) AS mig_stats ON i.uuid = mig_stats.instance_uuid WHERE i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY migration_count_range DESC), MemoryStats AS (SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE ic.deleted = 0 AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC), DisplayNameTotals AS ( SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(DISTINCT i.uuid) AS total_instances FROM instances i JOIN instance_info_caches ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE ic.deleted = 0 AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ) SELECT ms.display_name, ms.migration_count_range, ms.migration_count_variance, ms.migration_count_stddev, mem.memory_mb_variance, mem.memory_mb_stddev, dnt.total_instances FROM MigrationStats ms JOIN MemoryStats mem ON ms.display_name = mem.display_name JOIN DisplayNameTotals dnt ON ms.display_name = dnt.display_name WHERE (ms.migration_count_range * 1.0 / dnt.total_instances) > 0.75) SELECT c.display_name, c.migration_count_range, c.migration_count_variance, c.migration_count_stddev, c.memory_mb_variance, c.memory_mb_stddev, c.total_instances, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM instances i2 JOIN instance_info_caches ic2 ON ic2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid AND ic2.deleted = 0 JOIN migrations m2 ON m2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid WHERE i2.display_name = c.display_name AND m2.deleted = 0 AND m2.status NOT IN ('completed', 'failed', 'error') ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_active_migrations FROM inner_cte c ORDER BY c.migration_count_range DESC;

question: For instances whose display name matches the pattern 'prime', and considering only (a) instances that have a matching row in INSTANCE_EXTRA and (b) instances running on host 'blaze8-12' that have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type', which VM state and display name combinations have how many instances, what is their minimum memory (MB), and what is the variance of memory (MB) for that display name, and only keep results where the minimum memory is greater than 16384 MB? Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "Display 'prime'" is predicated by "instances.display_name REGEXP 'prime'" Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH memory_variance_by_display_name AS ( SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), instance_counts_and_min_memory_by_state_and_name AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(i.ID) AS instance_count, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME ) SELECT icmm.VM_STATE, icmm.DISPLAY_NAME, icmm.instance_count, icmm.min_memory_mb, mvbdn.memory_mb_variance FROM instance_counts_and_min_memory_by_state_and_name icmm JOIN memory_variance_by_display_name mvbdn ON icmm.DISPLAY_NAME = mvbdn.display_name ) SELECT inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.instance_count, inner_cte.min_memory_mb, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.min_memory_mb > 16384;

question: For non-deleted instances on host "blaze8-12", show the per-instance details (instance UUID, display name, VM state, memory in MB, cached network_info JSON, extra flavor JSON, and system metadata key) along with the two dense-rank window values (project_id-based and metadata-key-based). Additionally, summarize these rows by metadata key, returning the total number of rows and average memory_mb, and do not repeat the metadata key if it is the same as the previous row; include a final TOTAL row. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH InstanceNetworkCache AS (SELECT i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, c.network_info, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.project_id ORDER BY i.project_id) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12'), InstanceFlavorAndMetadata AS (SELECT ie.INSTANCE_UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, ie.FLAVOR, ism.KEY, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY ism.KEY) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ie.DELETED = 0 AND ism.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12') SELECT ifm.INSTANCE_UUID, ifm.DISPLAY_NAME, inc.vm_state, inc.memory_mb, inc.network_info, ifm.FLAVOR, ifm.KEY, inc.window_column AS project_dense_rank, ifm.window_column AS metadata_key_dense_rank FROM InstanceFlavorAndMetadata AS ifm JOIN InstanceNetworkCache AS inc ON ifm.DISPLAY_NAME = inc.display_name ORDER BY ifm.INSTANCE_UUID, ifm.KEY) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(metadata_key) OVER (ORDER BY key_sort, metadata_key) = metadata_key THEN NULL ELSE metadata_key END AS metadata_key, total_rows, avg_memory_mb FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.KEY) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE inner_cte.KEY END AS key_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.KEY) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE inner_cte.KEY END AS metadata_key, COUNT(*) AS total_rows, AVG(inner_cte.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.KEY WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY key_sort;
