question: For each active migration status (excluding accepted, confirmed, reverted, error, failed, and completed) where the geometric mean of migrated instances’ memory is greater than 0 MB, show the status, the geometric mean memory (MB), the average memory (MB), the memory variance, the memory standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), the total number of non-deleted migrations, and the average number of non-deleted migrations per status. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "Active migrations" is predicated by "migrations.status NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH GeometricMeanMemoryByStatus AS ( SELECT m.status, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 AND m.status NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC ), MemoryStatsByStatus AS ( SELECT m.status, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.deleted = 0 AND m.status NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT ms.status, gm.geometric_mean_memory_mb, ms.avg_memory_mb, ms.memory_mb_variance, ms.memory_mb_stddev FROM MemoryStatsByStatus ms JOIN GeometricMeanMemoryByStatus gm ON ms.status = gm.status WHERE gm.geometric_mean_memory_mb > 0 ORDER BY ms.memory_mb_variance DESC ), migration_counts AS ( SELECT m.status, COUNT(*) AS total_non_deleted_migrations FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE m.deleted = 0 AND m.status NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') GROUP BY m.status ), avg_migrations_per_status AS ( SELECT AVG(status_migration_count) AS avg_non_deleted_migrations_per_status FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS status_migration_count FROM migrations WHERE deleted = 0 AND status NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') GROUP BY status ) AS sub ) SELECT ic.status, ic.geometric_mean_memory_mb, ic.avg_memory_mb, ic.memory_mb_variance, ic.memory_mb_stddev, mc.total_non_deleted_migrations, am.avg_non_deleted_migrations_per_status FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN migration_counts AS mc ON mc.status = ic.status CROSS JOIN avg_migrations_per_status AS am ORDER BY ic.memory_mb_variance DESC;

question: For each VM state of non-deleted instances that currently have an active (non-terminal) migration, list the VM state, the migration memory_total variance, and the total number of non-deleted instances in that VM state. Do not repeat the VM state if it is the same as the previous row, and include a final TOTAL row across all VM states. Only include VM states where (variance ÷ total instances) is greater than the average standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of migration memory_total computed for instance display names matching 'prime' that have more than one 'image_image_type' system-metadata row. question: For instances in availability zone “flare3” on host “blaze8-12” whose display name matches the pattern “flare”, list the instance UUID, display name, VM state, memory (MB), vCPU count, the running sum of instance IDs within each VM-state group (ordered by instance ID), the maximum system-metadata ID over the current and next 2 instances (ordered by UUID), the normalized vCPU-per-MB ratio, and classify each instance’s vCPU-per-MB ratio as 'HIGH_DENSITY' (at least 50% above the overall average), 'LOW_DENSITY' (at least 50% below the overall average), or 'AVERAGE_DENSITY'.

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH q1 AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, SUM(i.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), q2 AS (SELECT i.display_name, i.availability_zone, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, i.uuid, MAX(ism.id) OVER ( ORDER BY i.uuid ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_metadata_id_next_2 FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'flare') SELECT q1.instance_uuid, q1.display_name, q1.vm_state, q2.memory_mb, q2.vcpus, q1.window_column AS running_sum_instance_ids_by_vm_state, q2.max_metadata_id_next_2, ROUND(q2.vcpus / NULLIF(q2.memory_mb, 0), 6) AS vcpus_per_mb_ratio FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.instance_uuid = q2.uuid WHERE q2.availability_zone = 'flare3' ORDER BY vcpus_per_mb_ratio DESC, q1.instance_uuid), avg_density AS ( SELECT AVG(vcpus_per_mb_ratio) AS avg_vcpus_per_mb_ratio FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.instance_uuid, ic.display_name, ic.vm_state, ic.memory_mb, ic.vcpus, ic.running_sum_instance_ids_by_vm_state, ic.max_metadata_id_next_2, ic.vcpus_per_mb_ratio, ad.avg_vcpus_per_mb_ratio AS benchmark_vcpus_per_mb_ratio, CASE WHEN ic.vcpus_per_mb_ratio > ad.avg_vcpus_per_mb_ratio * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_DENSITY' WHEN ic.vcpus_per_mb_ratio < ad.avg_vcpus_per_mb_ratio * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_DENSITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_DENSITY' END AS density_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_density ad ORDER BY ic.vcpus_per_mb_ratio DESC, ic.instance_uuid;

source_compute, CAST(NULL AS CHAR(255)) AS dest_compute, CAST(NULL AS SIGNED) AS memory_total, CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(30,10)) AS migration_memory_total_window_avg, 'System Metadata (ranked)' AS reason MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE ic.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC ) SELECT im.DISPLAY_NAME, im.HOSTNAME, im.VM_STATE, im.MEMORY_MB, im.VCPUS, im.UUID, im.STATUS, im.max_migration_id_next2, mms.avg_memory_mb, mms.memory_mb_range, mms.memory_mb_variance FROM InstanceMigrations AS im JOIN MigrationMemoryStats AS mms ON im.STATUS = mms.migration_status) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.HOSTNAME, inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.MEMORY_MB, inner_cte.VCPUS, inner_cte.UUID, inner_cte.STATUS, inner_cte.max_migration_id_next2, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb, inner_cte.memory_mb_range, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, status_ic_counts.total_non_deleted_info_cache_records, avg_status_ic_counts.avg_non_deleted_info_cache_records_per_status FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT m.status AS migration_status, COUNT(*) AS total_non_deleted_info_cache_records FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE ic.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY m.status ) AS status_ic_counts ON inner_cte.STATUS = status_ic_counts.migration_status JOIN ( SELECT AVG(per_status.total_non_deleted_info_cache_records) AS avg_non_deleted_info_cache_records_per_status FROM ( SELECT m.status AS migration_status, COUNT(*) AS total_non_deleted_info_cache_records FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE ic.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY m.status ) AS per_status ) AS avg_status_ic_counts;

question: For each instance display name matching the pattern 'prime', return the migration-count range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) for completed migrations per instance, along with the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of MEMORY_MB across instances that have a non-deleted instance info cache record; then, for each such display name, report the maximum of the per-metric values (migration-count range vs. MEMORY_MB variance) to identify which metric is larger. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "Display 'prime'" is predicated by "instances.display_name REGEXP 'prime'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH MigrationStats AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(migration_count) - MIN(migration_count) AS migration_count_range, VARIANCE(migration_count) AS migration_count_variance, STDDEV(migration_count) AS migration_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid JOIN ( SELECT m.instance_uuid, m.dest_compute, COUNT(*) AS migration_count FROM migrations AS m WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY m.instance_uuid, m.dest_compute ) AS mig_stats ON i.uuid = mig_stats.instance_uuid WHERE i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY migration_count_range DESC), MemoryStats AS (SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE ic.deleted = 0 AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC) SELECT ms.display_name, ms.migration_count_range, ms.migration_count_variance, ms.migration_count_stddev, mem.memory_mb_variance, mem.memory_mb_stddev FROM MigrationStats ms JOIN MemoryStats mem ON ms.display_name = mem.display_name) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, MAX(inner_cte.migration_count_range) AS max_migration_count_range, MAX(inner_cte.memory_mb_variance) AS max_memory_mb_variance, CASE WHEN MAX(inner_cte.migration_count_range) >= MAX(inner_cte.memory_mb_variance) THEN 'migration_count_range' ELSE 'memory_mb_variance' END AS larger_metric FROM inner_cte JOIN instances i2 ON i2.display_name = inner_cte.display_name JOIN instance_info_caches ic2 ON ic2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid AND ic2.deleted = 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name;

question: For each instance display name that matches the pattern 'flare' and has a system metadata entry with KEY = 'image_image_type', show the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of days from creation to launch, and also show how many non-deleted instances with that display name are on host 'blaze8-12' along with their average memory (MB) and average vCPU count; then, for each such display name, report the maximum of the per-project host instance counts (i.e., the largest number of those host instances contributed by any single project). SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DaysToLaunchStats AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.launched_at - i.created_at) AS avg_days_to_launch, STDDEV(i.launched_at - i.created_at) AS days_to_launch_stddev FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'flare' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY days_to_launch_stddev DESC), HostInstances AS (SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, ie.flavor, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.project_id ORDER BY i.project_id) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12') SELECT hi.display_name, dls.avg_days_to_launch, dls.days_to_launch_stddev, COUNT(DISTINCT hi.uuid) AS host_instance_count, AVG(hi.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb_on_host, AVG(hi.vcpus) AS avg_vcpus_on_host FROM HostInstances hi JOIN DaysToLaunchStats dls ON hi.display_name = dls.display_name GROUP BY hi.display_name, dls.avg_days_to_launch, dls.days_to_launch_stddev ORDER BY dls.days_to_launch_stddev DESC) , PerProjectHostCounts AS ( SELECT i.display_name, i.project_id, COUNT(DISTINCT i.uuid) AS host_instances_in_project FROM instances i JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'flare' GROUP BY i.display_name, i.project_id ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.avg_days_to_launch, ic.days_to_launch_stddev, ic.host_instance_count, ic.avg_memory_mb_on_host, ic.avg_vcpus_on_host, MAX(pphc.host_instances_in_project) AS max_host_instance_count_in_any_project FROM inner_cte ic JOIN PerProjectHostCounts pphc ON pphc.display_name = ic.display_name GROUP BY ic.display_name, ic.avg_days_to_launch, ic.days_to_launch_stddev, ic.host_instance_count, ic.avg_memory_mb_on_host, ic.avg_vcpus_on_host ORDER BY ic.days_to_launch_stddev DESC;

question: For each quota usage record with a positive in-use amount, list the quota usage ID, project ID, and resource type, along with the number of linked reservations and the total reserved delta across those reservations (only including reservations that expired before 2021-11-16 19:30:59). Also show, for that resource type, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of reservation delta values, and compute the average reserved delta per reservation (total reserved delta divided by reservation count). Finally, include subtotals per resource type and a grand total across all resources, ordering the detailed rows by delta variance descending.
evidence: "Reservations expired before 2021-11-16 19:30:59" is predicated by "reservations.expire < '2021-11-16 19:30:59'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH UsageReservationStats AS ( SELECT q.ID AS usage_id, q.PROJECT_ID, q.RESOURCE, COUNT(r.ID) AS reservation_count, SUM(r.DELTA) AS total_reserved_delta FROM QUOTA_USAGES q JOIN RESERVATIONS r ON q.ID = r.USAGE_ID WHERE q.IN_USE > 0 AND r.EXPIRE < '2021-11-16 19:30:59' GROUP BY q.ID, q.PROJECT_ID, q.RESOURCE ), ResourceDeltaDispersion AS ( SELECT qu.RESOURCE AS resource, VARIANCE(r.DELTA) AS delta_variance, STDDEV(r.DELTA) AS delta_stddev FROM QUOTA_USAGES AS qu JOIN RESERVATIONS AS r ON qu.ID = r.USAGE_ID WHERE qu.DELETED = 0 AND r.EXPIRE < '2021-11-16 19:30:59' GROUP BY qu.RESOURCE ORDER BY delta_variance DESC ) SELECT urs.usage_id, urs.PROJECT_ID, urs.RESOURCE, urs.reservation_count, urs.total_reserved_delta, rdd.delta_variance, rdd.delta_stddev, ROUND(urs.total_reserved_delta / NULLIF(urs.reservation_count, 0), 2) AS Avg_Reserved_Delta_Per_Reservation FROM UsageReservationStats urs JOIN ResourceDeltaDispersion rdd ON urs.RESOURCE = rdd.resource ORDER BY rdd.delta_variance DESC ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.RESOURCE) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE inner_cte.RESOURCE END AS resource, CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.usage_id) = 1 AND GROUPING(inner_cte.RESOURCE) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE CAST(inner_cte.usage_id AS CHAR) END AS usage_id, CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.usage_id) = 1 AND GROUPING(inner_cte.RESOURCE) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.RESOURCE) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE inner_cte.PROJECT_ID END AS project_id, SUM(inner_cte.reservation_count) AS reservation_count, SUM(inner_cte.total_reserved_delta) AS total_reserved_delta, MAX(inner_cte.delta_variance) AS delta_variance, MAX(inner_cte.delta_stddev) AS delta_stddev, ROUND(SUM(inner_cte.total_reserved_delta) / NULLIF(SUM(inner_cte.reservation_count), 0), 2) AS Avg_Reserved_Delta_Per_Reservation FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.RESOURCE, inner_cte.usage_id, inner_cte.PROJECT_ID WITH ROLLUP ORDER BY CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.RESOURCE) = 1 THEN 2 ELSE 0 END, MAX(inner_cte.delta_variance) DESC;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH MemoryStatsByDisplayName AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_range_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_variance_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'prime-35' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_range_mb DESC ), TopCacheRecordsByDisplayName AS ( SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(iic.id) AS cache_records FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'flare' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY cache_records DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT ms.display_name, ms.memory_range_mb, ms.memory_variance_mb, tc.cache_records FROM MemoryStatsByDisplayName ms JOIN TopCacheRecordsByDisplayName tc ON ms.display_name = tc.display_name ORDER BY tc.cache_records DESC, ms.memory_range_mb DESC) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.cache_records, inner_cte.memory_range_mb, inner_cte.memory_variance_mb, avg_cache.avg_cache_records FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(cache_records) AS avg_cache_records FROM inner_cte ) AS avg_cache ORDER BY inner_cte.cache_records DESC, inner_cte.memory_range_mb DESC;

question: For destination compute hosts that have at least 2 completed migrations for instances on host "ether-18", list the destination compute, the number of those completed migrations, whether there is any completed migration to the same destination compute for an instance on host "blaze8-12", and the average vCPU count of the migrated "ether-18" instances for that destination compute. SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH BlazeCompletedInstanceMigrations AS (SELECT t0.DISPLAY_NAME, t1.STATUS, t1.DEST_COMPUTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.DEST_COMPUTE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES t0 JOIN MIGRATIONS t1 ON t0.UUID = t1.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t1.STATUS = 'completed' AND t0.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), EtherCompletedMigrationsWithMetadata AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, m.INSTANCE_UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.VM_STATE AS instance_vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS instance_vcpus, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, m.MEMORY_REMAINING AS migration_memory_remaining, MIN(m.MEMORY_REMAINING) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.DEST_COMPUTE ORDER BY m.DEST_COMPUTE ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'ether-18') SELECT ecmwm.DEST_COMPUTE, COUNT(DISTINCT ecmwm.migration_id) AS Ether_Completed_Migration_Count, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT bcm.DISPLAY_NAME) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS Has_Blaze8_12_Completed_Migration_To_Same_Dest_Compute FROM EtherCompletedMigrationsWithMetadata ecmwm LEFT JOIN BlazeCompletedInstanceMigrations bcm ON ecmwm.DEST_COMPUTE = bcm.DEST_COMPUTE GROUP BY ecmwm.DEST_COMPUTE HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ecmwm.migration_id) >= 2 ORDER BY Ether_Completed_Migration_Count DESC, ecmwm.DEST_COMPUTE ) SELECT ic.DEST_COMPUTE, ic.Ether_Completed_Migration_Count, ic.Has_Blaze8_12_Completed_Migration_To_Same_Dest_Compute, ( SELECT AVG(i2.VCPUS * 1.0) FROM MIGRATIONS m2 JOIN INSTANCES i2 ON i2.UUID = m2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m2.STATUS = 'completed' AND i2.HOST = 'ether-18' AND m2.DEST_COMPUTE = ic.DEST_COMPUTE ) AS Avg_Ether18_Instance_VCPUs_To_Dest_Compute FROM inner_cte ic;

= 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM migration_instances_on_host) AS flare3_completed_flare_migrations_on_blaze8_12_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM host_instances) AS not_deleted_instances_on_blaze8_12_count FROM migration_instances_on_host mih CROSS JOIN host_instances hi LIMIT 1) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(migration_status) OVER (ORDER BY status_sort, migration_status) question: For instances in availability zone “flare3” that (1) have a display name matching the pattern “flare” and (2) are running on host “blaze8-12”, show the instance UUID, hostname, display name, VM state, memory in MB, instance extra record ID, instance extra created timestamp, cached network_info JSON, the windowed average memory_mb from each subquery (2 preceding and 2 following rows partitioned by VM state and ordered by memory_mb), and the difference between those two windowed averages; additionally, only return those instances whose instance_extra record was created after the average instance_extra created timestamp for instances in the same VM state. SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH FlareNamePatternInstances AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ie.CREATED_AT AS instance_extra_created_at, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'flare' ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB), BlazeHostInstances AS (SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, c.network_info, AVG(i.memory_mb) OVER ( PARTITION BY i.vm_state ORDER BY i.memory_mb ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ORDER BY i.memory_mb) SELECT f.instance_uuid, f.hostname, b.display_name, b.vm_state, f.memory_mb, f.instance_extra_id, f.instance_extra_created_at, b.network_info, f.window_column AS flare_namepattern_window_avg_memory_mb, b.window_column AS blaze_host_window_avg_memory_mb, (f.window_column - question: For host "blaze8-12", among the non-deleted instances that also have a completed migration, return the same per-instance details as before (instance ID, UUID, user ID, project ID, display name, VM state, memory (MB), vCPUs, instance info cache record ID, and the maximum instance ID over the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by instance ID), along with the migration status, destination compute host, the instance’s rank within its migration status group (ordered by instance UUID), and additionally filter to only those instances whose memory (MB) is greater than the average memory (MB) of all non-deleted instances on host "blaze8-12". Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH q1 AS ( SELECT i.id AS instance_id, i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.user_id, i.project_id, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, c.id AS info_cache_id, MAX(i.id) OVER (ORDER BY i.id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_id_next_2 FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND c.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ), q2 AS ( SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, m.STATUS, m.DEST_COMPUTE, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT q1.instance_id, q1.instance_uuid, q1.user_id, q1.project_id, q1.display_name, q1.vm_state, q1.memory_mb, q1.vcpus, q1.info_cache_id, q1.max_instance_id_next_2, q2.STATUS AS migration_status, q2.DEST_COMPUTE AS dest_compute, q2.window_column AS migration_status_rank FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.instance_uuid = q2.UUID ORDER BY q1.instance_id ) , HostAvgMem AS ( SELECT AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb FROM instances i WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT inner_cte.instance_id, inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.user_id, inner_cte.project_id, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.vcpus, inner_cte.info_cache_id, inner_cte.max_instance_id_next_2, inner_cte.migration_status, inner_cte.dest_compute, inner_cte.migration_status_rank FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN HostAvgMem WHERE inner_cte.memory_mb > HostAvgMem.avg_memory_mb ORDER BY inner_cte.instance_id;

question: For instances running on host 'blaze8-12' that have system metadata KEY = 'image_image_type', produce a rollup report by VM state and migration status that includes: the VM state, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of instance memory (MEMORY_MB) for that VM state, the migration status, the count of active migrations, and the minimum instance memory (MB). Include subtotals per VM state and a grand total. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'" "Active migrations" is predicated by "migrations.status NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH vm_state_memory_stats AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC), active_migration_stats AS (SELECT m.status AS migration_status, i.vm_state AS instance_vm_state, COUNT(m.id) AS migration_count, MIN(i.memory_mb) AS min_instance_memory_mb FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND m.status NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') GROUP BY m.status, i.vm_state), active_migration_stats_on_blaze8_12 AS ( SELECT ams.migration_status, ams.instance_vm_state, ams.migration_count, ams.min_instance_memory_mb FROM active_migration_stats ams JOIN instances i ON i.vm_state = ams.instance_vm_state AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY ams.migration_status, ams.instance_vm_state, ams.migration_count, ams.min_instance_memory_mb ) SELECT vsm.VM_STATE, vsm.memory_mb_variance, vsm.memory_mb_stddev, amsb.migration_status, amsb.migration_count, amsb.min_instance_memory_mb FROM vm_state_memory_stats vsm LEFT JOIN active_migration_stats_on_blaze8_12 amsb ON amsb.instance_vm_state = vsm.VM_STATE ORDER BY vsm.memory_mb_variance DESC, amsb.migration_count DESC ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.VM_STATE) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE inner_cte.VM_STATE END AS vm_state, AVG(inner_cte.memory_mb_variance) AS memory_mb_variance, AVG(inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev) AS memory_mb_stddev, CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.migration_status) = 1 AND GROUPING(inner_cte.VM_STATE) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE COALESCE(inner_cte.migration_status, 'No Active Migrations') END AS migration_status, SUM(COALESCE(inner_cte.migration_count, 0)) AS migration_count, MIN(inner_cte.min_instance_memory_mb) AS min_instance_memory_mb FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.migration_status WITH ROLLUP;

question: For the host "blaze8-12", for each active migration status and instance VM state (only for instances that have system metadata key 'image_image_type'), return the number of active migrations and the minimum instance memory (in MB), and also include the variance of instance memory (in MB) for that same VM state among instances on "blaze8-12" that have a corresponding network info cache record. Include subtotals per migration status and a grand total. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'" "Active migrations" is predicated by "migrations.status NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH VmStateMemoryVariance AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), ActiveMigrationStats AS ( SELECT m.status AS migration_status, i.vm_state AS instance_vm_state, COUNT(m.id) AS migration_count, MIN(i.memory_mb) AS min_instance_memory_mb FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND m.status NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') GROUP BY m.status, i.vm_state ) SELECT ams.migration_status, ams.instance_vm_state, ams.migration_count, ams.min_instance_memory_mb, vsmv.memory_mb_variance FROM ActiveMigrationStats ams JOIN VmStateMemoryVariance vsmv ON ams.instance_vm_state = vsmv.VM_STATE ORDER BY ams.migration_count DESC, vsmv.memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.migration_status) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE inner_cte.migration_status END AS migration_status, CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.instance_vm_state) = 1 AND GROUPING(inner_cte.migration_status) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE inner_cte.instance_vm_state END AS instance_vm_state, SUM(inner_cte.migration_count) AS total_active_migrations, MIN(inner_cte.min_instance_memory_mb) AS min_instance_memory_mb, AVG(inner_cte.memory_mb_variance) AS avg_memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.migration_status, inner_cte.instance_vm_state WITH ROLLUP;

question: For the top 10 non-deleted instances whose display name matches the regular expression 'prime' (ranked by the number of network info cache records), return each instance display name along with its network info cache record count, the range/variance/standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of system-metadata row counts per completed migration, and the percentage of completed migrations whose memory remaining is less than 25% of memory total. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "Display 'prime'" is predicated by "instances.display_name REGEXP 'prime'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH TopCacheInstances AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(iic.ID) AS cache_records FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY cache_records DESC LIMIT 10), MetadataStatsPerInstance AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(migration_metadata_count) - MIN(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_range, VARIANCE(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_variance, STDDEV(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN ( SELECT m.instance_uuid, m.id AS migration_id, COUNT(ism.id) AS migration_metadata_count FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i2 ON m.instance_uuid = i2.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i2.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i2.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY m.instance_uuid, m.id ) AS per_migration_stats ON i.uuid = per_migration_stats.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY metadata_count_range DESC) SELECT tci.DISPLAY_NAME, tci.cache_records, mspi.metadata_count_range, mspi.metadata_count_variance, mspi.metadata_count_stddev FROM TopCacheInstances tci JOIN MetadataStatsPerInstance mspi ON tci.DISPLAY_NAME = mspi.display_name ORDER BY tci.cache_records DESC ), migration_memory_pressure AS ( SELECT i.display_name, AVG( CASE WHEN m.memory_total IS NOT NULL AND m.memory_total > 0 AND m.memory_remaining IS NOT NULL AND (m.memory_remaining * 1.0 / m.memory_total) < 0.25 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END ) AS pct_migrations_memory_remaining_lt_25pct FROM instances i JOIN migrations m ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' AND m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY i.display_name ) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.cache_records, ic.metadata_count_range, ic.metadata_count_variance, ic.metadata_count_stddev, mmp.pct_migrations_memory_remaining_lt_25pct FROM inner_cte ic JOIN migration_memory_pressure mmp ON mmp.display_name = ic.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY ic.cache_records DESC;

question: For the overlapping instance display names from the provided “flare” launch-time stats and non-deleted “prime” memory stats, further restrict to only those overlaps where the average days from created_at to launched_at is greater than 75% of the maximum average days-to-launch among all overlaps; list the display name, avg_days_to_launch, days_to_launch_stddev, memory_range_mb, and memory_variance_mb. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "Display 'flare'" is predicated by "instances.display_name REGEXP 'flare'" "Display 'prime'" is predicated by "instances.display_name REGEXP 'prime'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH FlareLaunchStats AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.launched_at - i.created_at) AS avg_days_to_launch, STDDEV(i.launched_at - i.created_at) AS days_to_launch_stddev FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'flare' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY days_to_launch_stddev DESC), PrimeMemoryStats AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_range_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_variance_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON iic.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.key_name <> '' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_range_mb DESC), FlarePrimeOverlap AS ( SELECT f.display_name FROM FlareLaunchStats f INNER JOIN PrimeMemoryStats p ON p.display_name = f.display_name ) SELECT o.display_name, f.avg_days_to_launch, f.days_to_launch_stddev, p.memory_range_mb, p.memory_variance_mb FROM FlarePrimeOverlap o JOIN FlareLaunchStats f ON f.display_name = o.display_name JOIN PrimeMemoryStats p ON p.display_name = o.display_name ORDER BY o.display_name) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.avg_days_to_launch, ic.days_to_launch_stddev, ic.memory_range_mb, ic.memory_variance_mb FROM inner_cte ic JOIN (SELECT MAX(avg_days_to_launch) AS max_avg_days_to_launch FROM inner_cte) mx ON 1 = 1 WHERE ic.avg_days_to_launch > 0.75 * mx.max_avg_days_to_launch ORDER BY ic.avg_days_to_launch DESC;

question: For host 'blaze8-12', return the combined instance memory summary (high-vCPU instance counts/minimum memory by VM_STATE and DISPLAY_NAME, plus MEMORY_MB variance/standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) by DISPLAY_NAME for instances with a non-deleted 'image_image_type' system metadata key), but only include rows whose DISPLAY_NAME has a higher average MEMORY_MB than the overall average MEMORY_MB across all rows in that combined summary. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH HighVcpuInstancesByStateAndName AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(i.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VCPUS > 8 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME ), ImageTypeMetadataMemoryStatsByName AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND ism.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), CombinedInstanceMemorySummary AS ( SELECT hv.VM_STATE, hv.DISPLAY_NAME, hv.instance_count, hv.min_memory_mb, NULL AS memory_mb_variance, NULL AS memory_mb_stddev, 'High VCPU Instances' AS reason FROM HighVcpuInstancesByStateAndName hv UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS VM_STATE, ms.DISPLAY_NAME, NULL AS instance_count, NULL AS min_memory_mb, ms.memory_mb_variance, ms.memory_mb_stddev, 'Has image_image_type Metadata' AS reason FROM ImageTypeMetadataMemoryStatsByName ms ) SELECT * FROM CombinedInstanceMemorySummary ORDER BY DISPLAY_NAME, VM_STATE, reason ), DisplayNameAverages AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB * 1.0) AS avg_memory_mb_for_name FROM INSTANCES i WHERE i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ), OverallCombinedAverage AS ( SELECT AVG(COALESCE(d.avg_memory_mb_for_name, 0) * 1.0) AS overall_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte s JOIN DisplayNameAverages d ON d.DISPLAY_NAME = s.DISPLAY_NAME ) SELECT s.*, d.avg_memory_mb_for_name FROM inner_cte s JOIN DisplayNameAverages d ON d.DISPLAY_NAME = s.DISPLAY_NAME WHERE d.avg_memory_mb_for_name > (SELECT overall_avg_memory_mb FROM OverallCombinedAverage) ORDER BY s.DISPLAY_NAME, s.VM_STATE, s.reason;

question: For each system metadata key found on instances running on host "blaze8-12" in availability zone "flare3" that have a system metadata entry with key = "image_image_type", list the system metadata key, a migration activity label ("Active" if any non-completed/non-failed/non-error migrations exist for instances in that key group and "Inactive" otherwise), and the number of distinct instances. Include subtotals per system metadata key and a grand total. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH MigrationStats AS ( SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name AS instance_display_name, m.status AS migration_status, COUNT(m.id) AS migration_count, SUM(m.memory_processed) AS total_memory_processed FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, m.status ), MetadataWindowStats AS ( SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, ism.KEY, SUM(i.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT ms.instance_uuid, ms.instance_display_name, ms.migration_status, ms.migration_count, ms.total_memory_processed, mws.KEY AS system_metadata_key, mws.window_column FROM MigrationStats ms JOIN MetadataWindowStats mws ON ms.instance_uuid = mws.UUID ORDER BY ms.instance_uuid, ms.migration_status, mws.KEY, mws.window_column ), KeyMigrationStatus AS ( SELECT i.system_metadata_key, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM inner_cte x WHERE x.system_metadata_key = i.system_metadata_key AND x.migration_status NOT IN ('completed', 'failed', 'error') ) THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END AS migration_activity, COUNT(DISTINCT i.instance_uuid) AS total_instances FROM inner_cte i GROUP BY i.system_metadata_key, migration_activity ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(system_metadata_key) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE system_metadata_key END AS system_metadata_key, CASE WHEN GROUPING(migration_activity) = 1 AND GROUPING(system_metadata_key) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE migration_activity END AS migration_activity, SUM(total_instances) AS total_instances FROM KeyMigrationStatus GROUP BY system_metadata_key, migration_activity WITH ROLLUP;

question: For instances on host "blaze8-12" in availability zone "flare3" that also have completed migrations, return each instance UUID and the maximum vCPU count used by any (migration, system-metadata-key/value, instance-extra) row for that instance, along with the instance display name. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH MigrationMetadata AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.INSTANCE_UUID, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, AVG(m.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY m.INSTANCE_UUID ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ORDER BY m.ID), InstanceExtraDetails AS (SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, i.KEY_NAME, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.VCPUS ORDER BY i.VCPUS) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12') SELECT mm.migration_id, mm.INSTANCE_UUID, mm.SOURCE_COMPUTE, mm.DEST_COMPUTE, mm.instance_display_name, mm.metadata_key, mm.metadata_value, mm.window_column AS avg_migration_id_within_instance_uuid, ied.VM_STATE, ied.MEMORY_MB, ied.VCPUS, ied.KEY_NAME, ied.instance_extra_id, ied.window_column AS min_memory_mb_within_vcpus FROM MigrationMetadata AS mm JOIN InstanceExtraDetails AS ied ON mm.INSTANCE_UUID = ied.UUID ORDER BY mm.migration_id) SELECT inner_cte.INSTANCE_UUID, inner_cte.instance_display_name, MAX(inner_cte.VCPUS) AS max_vcpus_per_instance_uuid FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.INSTANCE_UUID, inner_cte.instance_display_name;

question: For each quota usage record with a positive in-use amount, list the quota usage ID, project ID, and resource type, along with the number of linked reservations and the total reserved delta across those reservations (only including reservations that expired before 2021-11-16 19:30:59). Also show, for that resource type, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of reservation delta values, compute the average reserved delta per reservation, and include the overall average reserved delta per reservation across all such usage records as a benchmark. Finally, categorize each usage record as 'HIGH_AVG_DELTA' (at least 50% above the benchmark), 'LOW_AVG_DELTA' (at least 50% below the benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_AVG_DELTA', ordering by delta variance descending.
evidence: "Reservations expired before 2021-11-16 19:30:59" is predicated by "reservations.expire < '2021-11-16 19:30:59'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH UsageReservationStats AS ( SELECT q.ID AS usage_id, q.PROJECT_ID, q.RESOURCE, COUNT(r.ID) AS reservation_count, SUM(r.DELTA) AS total_reserved_delta FROM QUOTA_USAGES q JOIN RESERVATIONS r ON q.ID = r.USAGE_ID WHERE q.IN_USE > 0 AND r.EXPIRE < '2021-11-16 19:30:59' GROUP BY q.ID, q.PROJECT_ID, q.RESOURCE ), ResourceDeltaDispersion AS ( SELECT qu.RESOURCE AS resource, VARIANCE(r.DELTA) AS delta_variance, STDDEV(r.DELTA) AS delta_stddev FROM QUOTA_USAGES AS qu JOIN RESERVATIONS AS r ON qu.ID = r.USAGE_ID WHERE qu.DELETED = 0 AND r.EXPIRE < '2021-11-16 19:30:59' GROUP BY qu.RESOURCE ORDER BY delta_variance DESC ) SELECT urs.usage_id, urs.PROJECT_ID, urs.RESOURCE, urs.reservation_count, urs.total_reserved_delta, rdd.delta_variance, rdd.delta_stddev, ROUND(urs.total_reserved_delta / NULLIF(urs.reservation_count, 0), 2) AS Avg_Reserved_Delta_Per_Reservation FROM UsageReservationStats urs JOIN ResourceDeltaDispersion rdd ON urs.RESOURCE = rdd.resource ORDER BY rdd.delta_variance DESC ), Benchmark AS ( SELECT AVG(Avg_Reserved_Delta_Per_Reservation) AS benchmark_avg_reserved_delta_per_reservation FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.usage_id, i.PROJECT_ID, i.RESOURCE, i.reservation_count, i.total_reserved_delta, i.delta_variance, i.delta_stddev, i.Avg_Reserved_Delta_Per_Reservation, b.benchmark_avg_reserved_delta_per_reservation AS benchmark, CASE WHEN i.Avg_Reserved_Delta_Per_Reservation > b.benchmark_avg_reserved_delta_per_reservation * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_AVG_DELTA' WHEN i.Avg_Reserved_Delta_Per_Reservation < b.benchmark_avg_reserved_delta_per_reservation * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_AVG_DELTA' ELSE 'AVERAGE_AVG_DELTA' END AS avg_delta_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN Benchmark b ORDER BY i.delta_variance DESC;

question: For migrations with status = 'completed' where the instance is on host 'blaze8-12', and only for metadata keys that account for more than 10% of all such completed migrations on that host, return the migration id, source compute, destination compute, instance display name, instance memory in MB, the instance system metadata key and value, the average instance memory (MB) over a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows (partitioned by migration status and ordered by migration id), the running sum of migration IDs within each metadata key group ordered by migration ID, the total number of rows for that metadata key, and the project ID for the instance. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH MigrationMemoryWindow AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.MEMORY_MB, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ), MigrationIdRunningSumByKey AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, SUM(m.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ), MetadataKeyMigrationCounts AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY) AS key_migration_count FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT mmw.migration_id, mmw.SOURCE_COMPUTE, mmw.DEST_COMPUTE, mmw.DISPLAY_NAME, mmw.MEMORY_MB, mmw.metadata_key, mmw.metadata_value, mmw.window_column AS avg_memory_mb_window_2_preceding_2_following, mirs.window_column AS running_sum_migration_id_within_metadata_key, mkmc.key_migration_count FROM MigrationMemoryWindow AS mmw JOIN MigrationIdRunningSumByKey AS mirs ON mmw.migration_id = mirs.migration_id AND mmw.metadata_key = mirs.metadata_key JOIN MetadataKeyMigrationCounts AS mkmc ON mmw.migration_id = mkmc.migration_id AND mmw.metadata_key = mkmc.metadata_key WHERE (mkmc.key_migration_count * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12')) > 0.10 ) SELECT ic.migration_id, ic.SOURCE_COMPUTE, ic.DEST_COMPUTE, ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.MEMORY_MB, ic.metadata_key, ic.metadata_value, question: For each instance display name matching the regular expression 'prime', list the instance display name, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of instance memory (in MB) across its system metadata rows (only including instances with at least 3 system metadata entries), along with the completed migration status, the maximum migration total memory (MEMORY_TOTAL) greater than 0, the migration created timestamp, and the instance’s cached network_info. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "Display 'prime'" is predicated by "instances.display_name REGEXP 'prime'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH InstanceMemoryStddev AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 2 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC ), CompletedMigrationMaxMemory AS ( SELECT i.display_name, m.status, MAX(m.memory_total) AS max_memory_total, m.created_at FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name, m.status, m.created_at HAVING MAX(m.memory_total) > 0 ) SELECT ims.display_name, ims.memory_mb_stddev, cmm.status AS migration_status, cmm.max_memory_total, cmm.created_at AS migration_created_at FROM InstanceMemoryStddev ims JOIN CompletedMigrationMaxMemory cmm ON ims.display_name = cmm.display_name ORDER BY ims.memory_mb_stddev DESC, cmm.max_memory_total DESC, cmm.created_at DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev, inner_cte.migration_status, inner_cte.max_memory_total, inner_cte.migration_created_at, ic.network_info FROM inner_cte JOIN instances i ON i.display_name = inner_cte.display_name JOIN instance_info_caches ic ON ic.instance_uuid = i.uuid ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev DESC, inner_cte.max_memory_total DESC, inner_cte.migration_created_at DESC;

question: For instances running on host "blaze8-12" in availability zone "flare3" that have a completed migration, show the instance UUID, instance display name, hostname, VM state, memory (MB), vCPU count, migration status, the maximum migration ID over the current row and the next 2 rows when ordered by instance UUID, along with the instance key name, system metadata entry count, and total vCPUs across those metadata rows; additionally, only keep instances whose vCPU count is greater than the average vCPU count of all instances on the same host and availability zone. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH q1 AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.HOSTNAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, i.UUID, m.STATUS, MAX(m.ID) OVER ( ORDER BY i.UUID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_migration_id_next2 FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ), q2 AS ( SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.key_name, COUNT(ism.id) AS metadata_entry_count, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus FROM instances i JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.key_name ) SELECT q1.UUID AS instance_uuid, q1.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, q1.HOSTNAME, q1.VM_STATE, q1.MEMORY_MB, q1.VCPUS, q1.STATUS AS migration_status, q1.max_migration_id_next2, q2.key_name, q2.metadata_entry_count, q2.total_vcpus FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.UUID = q2.instance_uuid ORDER BY q1.UUID ), HostAzVcpuAverages AS ( SELECT i.host, i.availability_zone, AVG(i.vcpus * 1.0) AS avg_vcpus FROM instances i WHERE i.host = 'blaze8-12' AND i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.host, i.availability_zone ) SELECT ic.instance_uuid, ic.instance_display_name, ic.hostname, ic.vm_state, ic.memory_mb, ic.vcpus, ic.migration_status, ic.max_migration_id_next2, ic.key_name, ic.metadata_entry_count, ic.total_vcpus FROM inner_cte ic JOIN instances i ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE ic.vcpus > ( SELECT ha.avg_vcpus FROM HostAzVcpuAverages ha WHERE ha.host = i.host AND ha.availability_zone = i.availability_zone ) ORDER BY ic.instance_uuid;

question: On host "prime-35", for each availability zone that has instances with completed migrations, show the maximum total memory processed by any single instance in that zone, along with (for the same availability zone) the VM state breakdown including the number of non-deleted instances and the earliest instance creation time. evidence: Host "prime-35" is predicated by "instances.host = 'prime-35'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH q1 AS ( SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.availability_zone, COUNT(m.id) AS migration_count, SUM(m.memory_processed) AS total_memory_processed FROM instances i JOIN migrations m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'prime-35' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.availability_zone ), q2 AS ( SELECT ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, ins.VM_STATE, COUNT(ins.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(ins.CREATED_AT) AS earliest_created_at FROM INSTANCES AS ins JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID WHERE ins.DELETED = 0 AND ins.HOST = 'prime-35' GROUP BY ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, ins.VM_STATE ) SELECT q1.instance_uuid, q1.display_name, q1.availability_zone, q2.vm_state, q2.instance_count, q2.earliest_created_at, q1.migration_count, q1.total_memory_processed FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.availability_zone = q2.availability_zone ORDER BY q1.total_memory_processed DESC, q1.migration_count DESC, q1.instance_uuid ) SELECT availability_zone, vm_state, instance_count, earliest_created_at, MAX(total_memory_processed) AS max_total_memory_processed_by_any_instance_in_zone FROM inner_cte GROUP BY availability_zone, vm_state, instance_count, earliest_created_at ORDER BY max_total_memory_processed_by_any_instance_in_zone DESC, availability_zone, vm_state;

question: For instances in availability zone "flare3" that have a migration with status "completed" and whose display name matches the pattern "flare", show the instance UUID, instance display name, migration status, the running sum of instance memory (MEMORY_MB) within each migration type ordered by instance memory, and (when the same display name also matches "prime" and has at least 3 system metadata entries) the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of instance memory (in MB) across its system metadata rows; only keep those instances whose running-sum memory is greater than the average running-sum memory across all such instances. evidence: "Display 'flare'" is predicated by "instances.display_name REGEXP 'flare'" "Display 'prime'" is predicated by "instances.display_name REGEXP 'prime'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH sq1 AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, m.STATUS AS migration_status, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'flare' ), sq2 AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 2 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC ) SELECT sq1.instance_uuid, sq1.instance_display_name, sq1.migration_status, sq1.window_column, sq2.memory_mb_stddev FROM sq1 JOIN sq2 ON sq1.instance_display_name = sq2.display_name ORDER BY sq2.memory_mb_stddev DESC ) SELECT instance_uuid, instance_display_name, migration_status, window_column, memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > (SELECT AVG(window_column) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC;

question: For completed migrations on host "blaze8-12", considering only instances whose display name also appears among instances on "blaze8-12" with non-empty cached network information, list the migration ID, instance display name, the geometric mean of instance memory (MB) for that display name, the instance system metadata key and value, and the row number ordered by the metadata key using a window frame of 2 preceding rows and 1 following row, but only for display names whose geometric mean memory is greater than the overall average of these geometric means. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH MigrationInstanceMetadataWindow AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY ism.KEY ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), GeometricMeanMemoryByDisplayName AS (SELECT i.display_name, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE iic.network_info <> '[]' AND i.memory_mb > 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC) SELECT mimw.migration_id, mimw.instance_display_name, gmm.geometric_mean_memory_mb, mimw.metadata_key, mimw.metadata_value, mimw.window_column FROM MigrationInstanceMetadataWindow AS mimw JOIN GeometricMeanMemoryByDisplayName AS gmm ON mimw.instance_display_name = gmm.display_name ORDER BY mimw.instance_display_name, mimw.migration_id, mimw.metadata_key ) SELECT migration_id, instance_display_name, geometric_mean_memory_mb, metadata_key, metadata_value, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE geometric_mean_memory_mb > (SELECT AVG(geometric_mean_memory_mb) FROM inner_cte);

question: For instances hosted on "blaze8-12" that have completed migrations (and have instance system metadata key "image_image_type"), show each instance’s UUID, display name, migration status, destination compute host, its rank within the completed-status group ordered by instance UUID, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of migration memory remaining for that instance’s completed migrations; additionally, include the instance’s project ID and the total number of non-deleted instances in that same project. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH MigrationMemoryVariation AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC), InstanceMigrationRanks AS (SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, m.STATUS, m.DEST_COMPUTE, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12') SELECT imr.UUID, imr.DISPLAY_NAME, imr.STATUS, imr.DEST_COMPUTE, imr.window_column, mmv.coefficient_of_variation FROM InstanceMigrationRanks imr JOIN MigrationMemoryVariation mmv ON imr.DISPLAY_NAME = mmv.display_name ORDER BY mmv.coefficient_of_variation DESC, imr.window_column, imr.UUID) SELECT inner_cte.UUID, inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.STATUS, inner_cte.DEST_COMPUTE, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, i.project_id, proj_counts.total_instances_in_project FROM inner_cte JOIN instances i ON i.uuid = inner_cte.UUID JOIN ( SELECT project_id, COUNT(*) AS total_instances_in_project FROM instances WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY project_id ) AS proj_counts ON proj_counts.project_id = i.project_id ORDER BY inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.UUID;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH top_cache AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(iic.ID) AS cache_records FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY cache_records DESC LIMIT 10 ), host_instances AS ( SELECT i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, c.network_info, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.project_id ORDER BY i.project_id) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT hi.display_name, tc.cache_records, hi.vm_state, hi.memory_mb, hi.network_info, hi.window_column FROM top_cache tc JOIN host_instances hi ON tc.display_name = hi.display_name ORDER BY tc.cache_records DESC ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.cache_records, ic.vm_state, ic.memory_mb, ic.network_info, ic.window_column, ie.flavor AS instance_flavor_json FROM inner_cte ic JOIN instances i ON i.display_name = ic.display_name AND i.deleted = 0 JOIN instance_extra ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid ORDER BY ic.cache_records DESC;

question: For migrations that are completed and whose instance is on host 'blaze8-12', return the migration ID, source compute, destination compute, instance display name, and the migration’s rank within its status group ordered by migration ID, along with (for any active, not-deleted migrations that share the same instance display name) the active migration status, source compute, destination compute, destination host, instance UUID, instance VM state, system metadata key/value, and the maximum instance memory (MB) over the current row through the next 2 rows ordered by migration ID. Also include the overall average of these “next-2-rows max memory” values as a benchmark, and categorize each joined row as 'HIGH_MEMORY' (at least 50% above the benchmark), 'LOW_MEMORY' (at least 50% below the benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_MEMORY'. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'" "Active migrations" is predicated by "migrations.status NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH CompletedMigrationsOnHost AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND ic.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ), ActiveNotDeletedMigrations AS ( SELECT m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.dest_host, m.instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.vm_state, ism.key, ism.value, MAX(i.memory_mb) OVER ( ORDER BY m.id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_memory_mb_next2 FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.deleted = 0 AND m.status NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') ) SELECT cm.migration_id, cm.source_compute AS completed_source_compute, cm.dest_compute AS completed_dest_compute, cm.instance_display_name, cm.window_column AS completed_status_rank_by_migration_id, anm.status AS active_migration_status, anm.source_compute AS active_source_compute, anm.dest_compute AS active_dest_compute, anm.dest_host AS active_dest_host, anm.instance_uuid AS active_instance_uuid, anm.display_name AS active_instance_display_name, anm.vm_state AS active_instance_vm_state, anm.key AS system_metadata_key, anm.value AS system_metadata_value, anm.max_memory_mb_next2 FROM CompletedMigrationsOnHost cm JOIN ActiveNotDeletedMigrations anm ON cm.instance_display_name = anm.display_name ORDER BY cm.migration_id ), AvgMaxMem AS ( SELECT AVG(max_memory_mb_next2) AS avg_max_memory_mb_next2 FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.migration_id, i.completed_source_compute, i.completed_dest_compute, i.instance_display_name, i.completed_status_rank_by_migration_id, i.active_migration_status, i.active_source_compute, i.active_dest_compute, i.active_dest_host, i.active_instance_uuid, i.active_instance_display_name, i.active_instance_vm_state, i.system_metadata_key, i.system_metadata_value, i.max_memory_mb_next2, a.avg_max_memory_mb_next2 AS benchmark_avg_max_memory_mb_next2, CASE WHEN i.max_memory_mb_next2 > a.avg_max_memory_mb_next2 * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_MEMORY' WHEN i.max_memory_mb_next2 < a.avg_max_memory_mb_next2 * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_MEMORY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_MEMORY' END AS memory_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN AvgMaxMem a ORDER BY i.migration_id;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH Blaze8_12_Instance_Migration_Summary AS ( SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name AS instance_display_name, i.availability_zone AS availability_zone, COUNT(m.id) AS completed_migration_count, SUM(m.memory_processed) AS total_memory_processed FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND m.memory_processed > 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.availability_zone ), Ether_18_Completed_Migration_Details AS ( SELECT m.ID AS instance_memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS instance_instance_vcpus, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, m.MEMORY_REMAINING AS migration_memory_remaining, MIN(m.MEMORY_REMAINING) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.DEST_COMPUTE ORDER BY m.DEST_COMPUTE ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'ether-18' ) SELECT b.instance_uuid, b.instance_display_name, b.availability_zone, b.completed_migration_count, b.total_memory_processed, COUNT(e.migration_id) AS ether_18_completed_migration_rows, MIN(e.window_column) AS min_migration_memory_remaining_within_dest_compute FROM Blaze8_12_Instance_Migration_Summary b CROSS JOIN Ether_18_Completed_Migration_Details e GROUP BY b.instance_uuid, b.instance_display_name, b.availability_zone, b.completed_migration_count, b.total_memory_processed) SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.instance_display_name, inner_cte.availability_zone, inner_cte.completed_migration_count, inner_cte.total_memory_processed, inner_cte.ether_18_completed_migration_rows, inner_cte.min_migration_memory_remaining_within_dest_compute, avg_min_per_dest_compute.avg_min_memory_remaining_across_dest_compute FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(min_per_dest_compute) AS avg_min_memory_remaining_across_dest_compute FROM ( SELECT m.DEST_COMPUTE, MIN(m.MEMORY_REMAINING) AS min_per_dest_compute FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'ether-18' GROUP BY m.DEST_COMPUTE ) AS sub ) AS avg_min_per_dest_compute ON 1 = 1;

question: Using the VM-state variance-per-instance results for non-deleted instances with active (non-terminal) migrations, list each VM state along with its migration memory-total variance, total instance count, and the deviation of its variance-per-instance from the overall average variance-per-instance across the returned VM states; only include VM states where (variance ÷ total instances) is greater than the average standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of migration memory total computed for instance display names matching 'prime' that have more than one 'image_image_type' system-metadata row. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "Display 'prime'" is predicated by "instances.display_name REGEXP 'prime'" "Active migrations" is predicated by "migrations.status NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DisplayNameMemoryStddev AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_total) AS memory_total_stddev FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(ism.id) > 1 ORDER BY memory_total_stddev DESC ), VMStateMemoryVariance AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, VARIANCE(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) AS memory_total_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND m.STATUS NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_total_variance DESC ), VMStateTotalInstances AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, COUNT(*) AS total_instance_count FROM INSTANCES AS i WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ) SELECT vsmv.VM_STATE, vsmv.memory_total_variance, vsti.total_instance_count FROM VMStateMemoryVariance vsmv JOIN VMStateTotalInstances vsti ON vsmv.VM_STATE = vsti.VM_STATE WHERE (vsmv.memory_total_variance * 1.0 / vsti.total_instance_count) > ( SELECT AVG(dnms.memory_total_stddev) FROM DisplayNameMemoryStddev dnms ) ORDER BY (vsmv.memory_total_variance * 1.0 / vsti.total_instance_count) DESC ), AverageVariancePerInstance AS ( SELECT AVG(inner_cte.memory_total_variance * 1.0 / inner_cte.total_instance_count) AS avg_variance_per_instance FROM inner_cte ) SELECT inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.memory_total_variance, inner_cte.total_instance_count, (inner_cte.memory_total_variance * 1.0 / inner_cte.total_instance_count) AS variance_per_instance, ((inner_cte.memory_total_variance * 1.0 / inner_cte.total_instance_count) - avpi.avg_variance_per_instance) AS deviation_from_avg_variance_per_instance FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN AverageVariancePerInstance avpi ORDER BY deviation_from_avg_variance_per_instance DESC;

question: For each instance VM state on host 'blaze8-12', list the VM state, the geometric mean of instance memory (MB) across instances that have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type' (and memory_mb > 0), and the total instance memory (MB) for that same VM state in availability zone 'flare3' (only including VM states where the total memory is greater than 50000 MB). Do not repeat the VM state if it is the same as the previous row, and include a final TOTAL row that sums the total_memory_mb across all returned VM states. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH VmStateGeometricMeanMemory AS ( SELECT i.vm_state, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.vm_state ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC ), VmStateTotalMemory AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) AS total_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE HAVING SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) > 50000 ) SELECT gmm.vm_state, gmm.geometric_mean_memory_mb, tms.total_memory_mb FROM VmStateGeometricMeanMemory gmm JOIN VmStateTotalMemory tms ON gmm.vm_state = tms.vm_state ORDER BY tms.total_memory_mb DESC) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(vm_state) OVER (ORDER BY vm_state_sort, vm_state) = vm_state THEN NULL ELSE vm_state END AS vm_state, geometric_mean_memory_mb, total_memory_mb FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(vm_state) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE vm_state END AS vm_state_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(vm_state) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE vm_state END AS vm_state, AVG(geometric_mean_memory_mb) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb, SUM(total_memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte GROUP BY vm_state WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY vm_state_sort, vm_state;

question: For each VM state on host "blaze8-12", report (1) the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of migration memory remaining (STDDEV(MEMORY_REMAINING) divided by AVG(MEMORY_REMAINING)) for completed migrations and (2) the geometric mean of instance memory (in MB) across instances that have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type'; then, across those per-VM-state results, return the maximum coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) observed for each geometric-mean-memory bucket (rounded to the nearest 1024 MB).
evidence: Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH migration_mem_cv_by_vm_state AS (SELECT i.vm_state, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.vm_state HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC), geom_mean_mem_by_vm_state AS (SELECT i.vm_state, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.vm_state ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC) SELECT mmc.vm_state, mmc.coefficient_of_variation, gmm.geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM migration_mem_cv_by_vm_state mmc JOIN geom_mean_mem_by_vm_state gmm ON mmc.vm_state = gmm.vm_state ) SELECT ROUND(inner_cte.geometric_mean_memory_mb / 1024.0) * 1024 AS geom_mean_memory_mb_bucket_1024, MAX(inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation) AS max_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte JOIN instances i ON i.vm_state = inner_cte.vm_state AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY ROUND(inner_cte.geometric_mean_memory_mb / 1024.0) * 1024 ORDER BY max_coefficient_of_variation DESC;

question: For non-deleted instances running on host 'blaze8-12', return each instance UUID, display name, memory (MB), vCPU count, flavor JSON, and the dense-rank-by-project window column, and also include (by matching display name) the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of root disk size (STDDEV(root_gb)/AVG(root_gb)) computed only from instances that have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type' and a non-deleted instance info cache row. Additionally, show the display name only on the first row for each display name (suppress repeats like the previous-row formatting), and include a per-display-name subtotal row (TOTAL) with the count of instances and average memory for that display name. evidence: Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH root_gb_cov_by_display_name AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.root_gb) / NULLIF(AVG(i.root_gb), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND iic.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(i.root_gb) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC), instance_details_with_flavor AS (SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, ie.flavor, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.project_id ORDER BY i.project_id) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12') SELECT idwf.uuid, idwf.display_name, idwf.memory_mb, idwf.vcpus, idwf.flavor, idwf.window_column, rgcbdn.coefficient_of_variation FROM instance_details_with_flavor AS idwf JOIN root_gb_cov_by_display_name AS rgcbdn ON idwf.display_name = rgcbdn.display_name ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(display_name) OVER (ORDER BY display_name_sort, display_name, uuid) = display_name THEN NULL ELSE display_name END AS display_name, uuid, memory_mb, vcpus, flavor, window_column, coefficient_of_variation, total_instances, avg_memory_mb FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.display_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE inner_cte.display_name END AS display_name_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.display_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE inner_cte.display_name END AS display_name, inner_cte.uuid, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.vcpus, inner_cte.flavor, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, COUNT(inner_cte.uuid) AS total_instances, AVG(inner_cte.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.uuid, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.vcpus, inner_cte.flavor, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY display_name_sort, display_name, uuid;

question: For host 'blaze8-12', show each completed migration’s migration id, instance UUID, migration type, source compute, destination compute, destination host, instance display name, VM state, memory (MB), VCPUs, and instance extra record id, along with (a) the minimum migration MEMORY_TOTAL within the same migration type and (b) for the same VM state and display name, the count of instances with more than 8 VCPUs on 'blaze8-12' and their minimum instance memory (MB); additionally, include the instance’s project_id and classify each row’s project as 'HIGH_UTILIZATION' (at least 50% more than the average completed-migration count per project on 'blaze8-12'), 'LOW_UTILIZATION' (at least 50% less than average), or 'AVERAGE_UTILIZATION'.
