SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH MigrationDetails AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.INSTANCE_UUID, m.MIGRATION_TYPE, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, m.MEMORY_TOTAL, MIN(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) OVER (PARTITION BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ), InstanceStateSummary AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(i.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VCPUS > 8 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME ) SELECT md.migration_id, md.instance_uuid, md.migration_type, md.source_compute, md.dest_compute, md.dest_host, md.display_name, md.vm_state, md.memory_mb, md.vcpus, md.instance_extra_id, md.memory_total, md.window_column AS min_memory_total_within_migration_type, iss.instance_count, iss.min_memory_mb FROM MigrationDetails md LEFT JOIN InstanceStateSummary iss ON md.vm_state = iss.vm_state AND md.display_name = iss.display_name ), ProjectMigrations AS ( SELECT i.project_id, COUNT(*) AS total_completed_migrations FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.project_id ), AverageProjectMigrations AS ( SELECT AVG(total_completed_migrations) AS avg_completed_migrations FROM ProjectMigrations ) SELECT ic.migration_id, ic.instance_uuid, ic.migration_type, ic.source_compute, ic.dest_compute, ic.dest_host, ic.display_name, ic.vm_state, ic.memory_mb, ic.vcpus, ic.instance_extra_id, ic.memory_total, ic.min_memory_total_within_migration_type, ic.instance_count, ic.min_memory_mb, i.project_id, pm.total_completed_migrations, apm.avg_completed_migrations AS benchmark_completed_migrations, CASE WHEN pm.total_completed_migrations > apm.avg_completed_migrations * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_UTILIZATION' WHEN pm.total_completed_migrations < apm.avg_completed_migrations * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_UTILIZATION' ELSE 'AVERAGE_UTILIZATION' END AS project_utilization_category FROM inner_cte ic JOIN INSTANCES i ON ic.instance_uuid = i.uuid LEFT JOIN ProjectMigrations pm ON i.project_id = pm.project_id CROSS JOIN AverageProjectMigrations apm;

question: For instances in availability zone “flare3” on host “blaze8-12” whose display name matches the pattern “flare”, group the results by VM state and a vCPU-per-MB ratio bucket (“High” if vCPUs per MB > 0.001, otherwise “Low”). For each group, list the VM state, ratio bucket, the number of distinct instances, the total of the running sums of instance IDs (within each VM-state group ordered by instance ID), the maximum “max system-metadata ID over the current and next 2 instances” observed in the group, and include subtotals per VM state and a grand total.
evidence: Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'" "Display 'flare'" is predicated by "instances.display_name REGEXP 'flare'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH q1 AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, SUM(i.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), q2 AS (SELECT i.display_name, i.availability_zone, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, i.uuid, MAX(ism.id) OVER ( ORDER BY i.uuid ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_metadata_id_next_2 FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'flare') SELECT q1.instance_uuid, q1.display_name, q1.vm_state, q2.memory_mb, q2.vcpus, q1.window_column AS running_sum_instance_ids_by_vm_state, q2.max_metadata_id_next_2, ROUND(q2.vcpus / NULLIF(q2.memory_mb, 0), 6) AS vcpus_per_mb_ratio FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.instance_uuid = q2.uuid WHERE q2.availability_zone = 'flare3' ORDER BY vcpus_per_mb_ratio DESC, q1.instance_uuid) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(vm_state) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE vm_state END AS vm_state, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ratio_bucket) = 1 AND GROUPING(vm_state) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE ratio_bucket END AS ratio_bucket, COUNT(DISTINCT instance_uuid) AS total_instances, SUM(running_sum_instance_ids_by_vm_state) AS sum_running_sums, MAX(max_metadata_id_next_2) AS max_of_max_metadata_id_next_2 FROM ( SELECT ic.*, CASE WHEN ic.vcpus_per_mb_ratio > 0.001 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS ratio_bucket FROM inner_cte ic ) grouped GROUP BY vm_state, ratio_bucket WITH ROLLUP;

question: For confirmed migrations where the instance is on host "blaze8-12", list the migration status, source compute host, destination compute host, instance display name, instance network_info, the dense rank within each migration status (ordered by that status), and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of ROOT_GB for that instance display name computed only from system-metadata rows where the key is 'image_image_type'. SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH ConfirmedMigrationsOnHost AS (SELECT m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, i.display_name, ic.network_info, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.status ORDER BY m.status) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'confirmed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12'), RootGbVariationByDisplayName AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.root_gb) / NULLIF(AVG(i.root_gb), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(i.root_gb) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT cm.status, cm.source_compute, cm.dest_compute, cm.display_name, cm.network_info, cm.window_column, rgbv.coefficient_of_variation FROM ConfirmedMigrationsOnHost AS cm JOIN RootGbVariationByDisplayName AS rgbv ON cm.display_name = rgbv.display_name ORDER BY cm.status, cm.window_column, rgbv.coefficient_of_variation DESC), StatusMaxVariation AS ( SELECT status, MAX(coefficient_of_variation) AS max_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte GROUP BY status ) SELECT i.status, i.source_compute, i.dest_compute, i.display_name, i.network_info, i.window_column, i.coefficient_of_variation, smv.max_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN StatusMaxVariation AS smv ON i.status = smv.status ORDER BY i.status, i.window_column, i.coefficient_of_variation DESC;

question: For instances hosted on prime-35 (and having system metadata KEY = 'image_image_type'), which display names have a total number of completed migrations greater than the average total completed migrations per display name, and for those display names show the ROOT_GB range and variance, the number of instances, the total completed migration count, and the total memory processed? SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH root_stats_by_display_name AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MAX(i.ROOT_GB) - MIN(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_range, VARIANCE(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'prime-35' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY root_gb_range DESC), migration_stats_by_instance AS (SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.availability_zone, COUNT(m.id) AS migration_count, SUM(m.memory_processed) AS total_memory_processed FROM instances i JOIN migrations m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'prime-35' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.availability_zone) SELECT r.display_name, r.root_gb_range, r.root_gb_variance, COUNT(ms.instance_uuid) AS instance_count, SUM(ms.migration_count) AS total_migration_count, SUM(ms.total_memory_processed) AS total_memory_processed FROM root_stats_by_display_name r JOIN migration_stats_by_instance ms ON ms.display_name = r.display_name GROUP BY r.display_name, r.root_gb_range, r.root_gb_variance ORDER BY total_migration_count DESC, total_memory_processed DESC) SELECT display_name, root_gb_range, root_gb_variance, instance_count, total_migration_count, total_memory_processed FROM inner_cte WHERE total_migration_count > (SELECT AVG(total_migration_count) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY total_migration_count DESC, total_memory_processed DESC;

END AS image_type_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ism.value) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE ism.value END AS image_image_type, ic.coefficient_of_variation, ic.min_instance_id, ic.avg_memory_mb, ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid AND ism.deleted = 0 AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY ic.display_name, ic.coefficient_of_variation, ic.min_instance_id, ic.avg_memory_mb, question: For instances in availability zone 'flare3' whose display name matches the pattern 'flare' and that are also on host "blaze8-12" with KEY = 'image_image_type' system metadata and an outlier total root disk size (SUM(ROOT_GB) greater than the overall average ROOT_GB plus one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP)), list the instance display name, availability zone, VM state, memory in MB, vCPU count, instance UUID, the maximum system-metadata ID over the current row and next 2 rows ordered by instance UUID, the total root disk size in GB, and the instance network_info from the instance info cache. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "Display 'flare'" is predicated by "instances.display_name REGEXP 'flare'" Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH InstanceWindowedMetadata AS (SELECT i.display_name, i.availability_zone, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, i.uuid, MAX(ism.id) OVER ( ORDER BY i.uuid ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_metadata_id_next_2 FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'flare'), HostOutlierRootDisk AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, SUM(i.ROOT_GB) AS total_root_gb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.UUID HAVING SUM(i.ROOT_GB) > ( SELECT AVG(ROOT_GB) + STDDEV(ROOT_GB) FROM INSTANCES )) SELECT iwm.display_name, iwm.availability_zone, iwm.vm_state, iwm.memory_mb, iwm.vcpus, iwm.uuid AS instance_uuid, iwm.max_metadata_id_next_2, hor.total_root_gb FROM InstanceWindowedMetadata AS iwm JOIN HostOutlierRootDisk AS hor ON iwm.uuid = hor.instance_uuid) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.availability_zone, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.vcpus, inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.max_metadata_id_next_2, inner_cte.total_root_gb, iic.network_info FROM inner_cte JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON iic.instance_uuid = inner_cte.instance_uuid;

question: For instances in availability zone 'flare3' whose display name matches the pattern 'flare', list each instance’s display name, availability zone, VM state, memory in MB, vCPU count, instance UUID, and the maximum system-metadata ID over a window covering the current row and the next 2 rows (ordered by instance UUID), and also show (by VM state) the geometric mean of instance memory (in MB) across instances with a system metadata key of 'image_image_type' and memory greater than 0 that are running on host 'blaze8-12'. Additionally, for each VM state, include a migration status of 'Active' if any non-deleted, non-terminal migrations exist where the migration’s source or destination compute matches the instance host, and 'Inactive' otherwise, and include subtotals per VM state and a grand total. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "Display 'flare'" is predicated by "instances.display_name REGEXP 'flare'" Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH InstanceDetails AS ( SELECT i.display_name, i.availability_zone, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, i.uuid, MAX(ism.id) OVER ( ORDER BY i.uuid ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_metadata_id_next_2 FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'flare' ), VMStateGeoMean AS ( SELECT i.vm_state, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.vm_state ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC ) SELECT id.display_name, id.availability_zone, id.vm_state, id.memory_mb, id.vcpus, id.uuid, id.max_metadata_id_next_2, vmg.geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM InstanceDetails id LEFT JOIN VMStateGeoMean vmg ON id.vm_state = vmg.vm_state ), VMStateMigrationStatus AS ( SELECT i.vm_state, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM migrations m WHERE (m.source_compute = i.host OR m.dest_compute = i.host) AND m.deleted = 0 AND m.status NOT IN ('completed', 'failed', 'error') ) THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END AS migration_status, COUNT(DISTINCT i.uuid) AS total_instances FROM inner_cte ic JOIN instances i ON i.uuid = ic.uuid GROUP BY i.vm_state, migration_status ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(vms.vm_state) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE vms.vm_state END AS vm_state, CASE WHEN GROUPING(vms.migration_status) = 1 AND GROUPING(vms.vm_state) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE vms.migration_status END AS migration_status, SUM(vms.total_instances) AS total_instances FROM VMStateMigrationStatus vms GROUP BY vms.vm_state, vms.migration_status WITH ROLLUP;

question: For migrations with status 'completed' on instance host 'prime3-77', show each migration’s ID, instance display name, instance availability zone, migration status, and its rank within the status (ordered by migration ID), along with the average, range, and variance of instance memory (MB) for that same migration status computed from instances on host 'blaze8-12' that have a non-deleted instance info cache record. Do not repeat the migration status if it is the same as the previous row. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Host "prime3-77" is predicated by "instances.host = 'prime3-77'" Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH subq1 AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE AS instance_availability_zone, m.STATUS AS migration_status, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'prime3-77' ), subq2 AS ( SELECT m.status AS migration_status, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE ic.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC ) SELECT s1.migration_id, s1.instance_display_name, s1.instance_availability_zone, s1.migration_status, s1.window_column AS migration_rank_within_status, s2.avg_memory_mb, s2.memory_mb_range, s2.memory_mb_variance FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.migration_status = s2.migration_status ORDER BY s2.memory_mb_range DESC, s1.migration_id ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(migration_status) OVER (ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC, migration_id) = migration_status THEN NULL ELSE migration_status END AS migration_status, migration_id, instance_display_name, instance_availability_zone, migration_rank_within_status, avg_memory_mb, memory_mb_range, memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC, migration_id;

question: Using the set of instances whose display name matches the pattern 'prime' and that have a system metadata entry with KEY = 'image_image_type', and that also have more than 8 VCPUs while running on host "blaze8-12", show (for the top 10 display names by total vCPU usage) each display name, the total vCPUs and total memory (MB) consumed by those instances, and whether any instance with that display name has a system metadata entry with KEY = 'image_image_location'. Also include the per-(VM state, display name) instance count, minimum memory (MB), and the memory range and variance (MB) for that display name. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "Display 'prime'" is predicated by "instances.display_name REGEXP 'prime'" Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH MemoryStatsByDisplayName AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_range_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_variance_mb FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_range_mb DESC ), HostVcpuStatsByStateAndName AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(i.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VCPUS > 8 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME ) SELECT hv.VM_STATE, hv.DISPLAY_NAME, hv.instance_count, hv.min_memory_mb, ms.memory_range_mb, ms.memory_variance_mb FROM HostVcpuStatsByStateAndName hv JOIN MemoryStatsByDisplayName ms ON hv.DISPLAY_NAME = ms.display_name ), DisplayNameTotals AS ( SELECT ic.display_name, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ic JOIN instances i ON i.display_name = ic.display_name GROUP BY ic.display_name ), Top10DisplayNames AS ( SELECT dnt.display_name, dnt.total_vcpus, dnt.total_memory_mb FROM DisplayNameTotals dnt ORDER BY dnt.total_vcpus DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT t10.display_name, t10.total_vcpus, t10.total_memory_mb, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM instances i2 JOIN instance_system_metadata ism2 ON ism2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid WHERE i2.display_name = t10.display_name AND ism2.key = 'image_image_location' ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_image_location_metadata, ic.vm_state, ic.instance_count, ic.min_memory_mb, ic.memory_range_mb, ic.memory_variance_mb FROM Top10DisplayNames t10 JOIN inner_cte ic ON ic.display_name = t10.display_name ORDER BY t10.total_vcpus DESC, t10.display_name, ic.vm_state;

question: For host "blaze8-12", show the completed migration count and active (non-deleted) instance count, and also list the average memory (MB) of the active instances. Do not repeat the host name if it is the same as the previous row, and include a TOTAL row. Do not return any rounded answers.

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH migration_details AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.MEMORY_MB, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ORDER BY m.ID ), instance_details AS ( SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, ie.flavor, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.project_id ORDER BY i.project_id) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ), host_summary AS ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT md.migration_id) AS completed_migration_count, COUNT(DISTINCT id.uuid) AS active_instance_count FROM migration_details md CROSS JOIN instance_details id ) SELECT hs.completed_migration_count, hs.active_instance_count FROM host_summary hs ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(host_name) OVER (ORDER BY host_sort, host_name) = host_name THEN NULL ELSE host_name END AS host_name, completed_migration_count, active_instance_count, avg_active_instance_memory_mb FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(h.host_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE h.host_name END AS host_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(h.host_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE h.host_name END AS host_name, MAX(ic.completed_migration_count) AS completed_migration_count, MAX(ic.active_instance_count) AS active_instance_count, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_active_instance_memory_mb FROM (SELECT 'blaze8-12' AS host_name) AS h JOIN inner_cte ic ON 1 = 1 LEFT JOIN instances i ON i.host = h.host_name AND i.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN instance_extra ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid GROUP BY h.host_name WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY host_sort;

question: For instances in availability zone 'flare3' that have migrations where the instance memory is greater than zero, list each instance’s display name, availability zone, VM state, memory (MB), vCPU count, instance UUID, and the maximum system-metadata ID over a window of the current row plus the next 2 rows ordered by instance UUID, along with the migration status and the geometric mean migrated-instance memory (MB) for that status. SQL: WITH sq1 AS ( SELECT i.display_name, i.availability_zone, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, i.uuid, MAX(ism.id) OVER ( ORDER BY i.uuid ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_metadata_id_next_2 FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' ), sq2 AS ( SELECT m.status, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC ) SELECT sq1.display_name, sq1.availability_zone, sq1.vm_state, sq1.memory_mb, sq1.vcpus, sq1.uuid, sq1.max_metadata_id_next_2, sq2.status AS migration_status, sq2.geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM sq1 JOIN migrations AS m ON m.instance_uuid = sq1.uuid JOIN sq2 ON sq2.status = m.status JOIN instances AS i2 ON i2.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE i2.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i2.memory_mb > 0 ORDER BY sq2.geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC, sq1.uuid;

question: For each non-deleted instance, display the instance ID, UUID, user ID, project ID, display name, VM state, memory (MB), vCPUs, instance info cache record ID, and the maximum instance ID over the current row and the next 2 rows (ordered by instance ID), along with the migration status that has the highest variance in instance memory (MB) among non-deleted migrations and that status’s average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of memory. SQL: WITH instance_window AS ( SELECT i.id AS instance_id, i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.user_id, i.project_id, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, c.id AS info_cache_id, MAX(i.id) OVER (ORDER BY i.id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_id_next_2 FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND c.deleted = 0 ), migration_memory_stats AS ( SELECT m.status, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.deleted = 0 GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), top_migration_status AS ( SELECT status, avg_memory_mb, memory_mb_variance, memory_mb_stddev FROM migration_memory_stats LIMIT 1 ) SELECT iw.instance_id, iw.instance_uuid, iw.user_id, iw.project_id, iw.display_name, iw.vm_state, iw.memory_mb, iw.vcpus, iw.info_cache_id, iw.max_instance_id_next_2, tms.status AS top_variance_migration_status, tms.avg_memory_mb AS top_status_avg_memory_mb, tms.memory_mb_variance AS top_status_memory_mb_variance, tms.memory_mb_stddev AS top_status_memory_mb_stddev FROM instance_window AS iw CROSS JOIN top_migration_status AS tms ORDER BY iw.instance_id;

question: For non-deleted instances in availability zone “flare3” whose display name is among the top 10 display names by number of completed migrations (counting migrations by migration ID and only for instances with a non-empty key name), list the instance UUID, display name, VM state, power state, memory (MB), vCPUs, the instance extra record ID, the maximum instance ID considering the current row and the next 2 rows when ordered by instance ID, the completed migrations count, and the completed-migrations-per-vCPU ratio rounded.
SQL: WITH InstanceDetails AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MAX(i.ID) OVER (ORDER BY i.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_id_next_2 FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3'), TopCompletedMigrations AS (SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(m.id) AS completed_migrations FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.key_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY completed_migrations DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT id.instance_uuid, id.display_name, id.vm_state, id.power_state, id.memory_mb, id.vcpus, id.instance_extra_id, id.max_instance_id_next_2, tcm.completed_migrations, ROUND(tcm.completed_migrations / NULLIF(id.vcpus, 0), 2) AS completed_migrations_per_vcpu FROM InstanceDetails id JOIN TopCompletedMigrations tcm ON tcm.display_name = id.display_name ORDER BY completed_migrations_per_vcpu DESC, tcm.completed_migrations DESC;

question: For instances whose display names are in the top 10 by number of system metadata rows where the key is 'image_image_type' (considering only non-deleted instances), list all completed migrations for those instances and return the migration id, instance UUID, migration type, source compute, destination compute, destination host, instance display name, VM state, memory (MB), vCPUs, instance extra record id, migration memory total, the minimum migration memory total within each migration type (windowed by migration type), along with the instance’s metadata entry count and its total number of completed migrations. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH CompletedMigrations AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.INSTANCE_UUID, m.MIGRATION_TYPE, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, m.MEMORY_TOTAL, MIN(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) OVER (PARTITION BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed'), TopMetadataInstances AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(ism.ID) AS metadata_entries FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY metadata_entries DESC LIMIT 10), TotalCompletedMigrations AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(m.ID) AS completed_migration_count FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME) SELECT cm.migration_id, cm.INSTANCE_UUID, cm.MIGRATION_TYPE, cm.SOURCE_COMPUTE, cm.DEST_COMPUTE, cm.DEST_HOST, cm.DISPLAY_NAME, cm.VM_STATE, cm.MEMORY_MB, cm.VCPUS, cm.instance_extra_id, cm.MEMORY_TOTAL, cm.window_column, tmi.metadata_entries, tcm.completed_migration_count FROM CompletedMigrations cm JOIN TopMetadataInstances tmi ON cm.DISPLAY_NAME = tmi.DISPLAY_NAME JOIN TotalCompletedMigrations tcm ON cm.DISPLAY_NAME = tcm.DISPLAY_NAME;

question: For instances that are not deleted, list the instances (limited to the top 10 by number of network info cache records) that also have a maximum memory greater than 16000 MB, showing the instance display name, the metadata key, the maximum memory (MB), the launched timestamp, and the number of network info cache records. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH HighMemoryByMetadata AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) AS max_memory_mb, i.LAUNCHED_AT FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism JOIN INSTANCES i ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME, ism.KEY, i.LAUNCHED_AT HAVING MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) > 16000), TopNetworkCacheByInstance AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(iic.ID) AS cache_records FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY cache_records DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT hmbm.DISPLAY_NAME, hmbm.metadata_key, hmbm.max_memory_mb, hmbm.LAUNCHED_AT, tnc.cache_records FROM HighMemoryByMetadata hmbm JOIN TopNetworkCacheByInstance tnc ON hmbm.DISPLAY_NAME = tnc.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY tnc.cache_records DESC, hmbm.max_memory_mb DESC;

question: For instances whose display name is 'forge', list the instance UUID, hostname, system metadata key, and the running sum of instance IDs within each metadata key group (ordered by instance ID), along with the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of instance memory (MB) for the 'forge' display name computed over instances that have system metadata with key = 'image_image_type'. SQL: WITH ForgeInstanceMetadataWindow AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, SUM(i.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge'), DisplayNameMemoryStats AS (SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC) SELECT fimw.instance_uuid, fimw.hostname, fimw.metadata_key, fimw.window_column, dms.memory_mb_variance, dms.memory_mb_stddev FROM ForgeInstanceMetadataWindow fimw JOIN DisplayNameMemoryStats dms ON dms.display_name = 'forge' ORDER BY fimw.metadata_key, fimw.window_column;

question: For the security group named "aurum-xenon" that is also among the top 10 security groups with the most non-deleted rules, show the security group name, its total rule count, each rule’s protocol and from port, and the running sum of from ports within each protocol ordered by from port. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( SELECT sg.NAME AS security_group_name, sgr.PROTOCOL, sgr.FROM_PORT, SUM(sgr.FROM_PORT) OVER ( PARTITION BY sgr.PROTOCOL ORDER BY sgr.FROM_PORT ) AS window_column FROM SECURITY_GROUPS AS sg JOIN SECURITY_GROUP_RULES AS sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sg.NAME = 'aurum-xenon' ), subq2 AS ( SELECT sg.NAME AS security_group_name, COUNT(sgr.ID) AS rule_count FROM SECURITY_GROUPS AS sg JOIN SECURITY_GROUP_RULES AS sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sg.DELETED = 0 AND sgr.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY sg.NAME ORDER BY rule_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT s1.security_group_name, s2.rule_count, s1.PROTOCOL, s1.FROM_PORT, s1.window_column FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.security_group_name = s2.security_group_name ORDER BY s2.rule_count DESC, s1.PROTOCOL, s1.FROM_PORT;

question: For the VM state shelved_offloaded, where the instance memory variance (MB) is greater than 0, show the VM state’s average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of instance memory (for instances that have a matching row in INSTANCE_EXTRA), along with each migration status and the total migration memory processed for migrations of shelved_offloaded instances that have non-null cached network information (only including statuses where total processed memory is greater than 0). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH InstanceMemoryStatsByState AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC), MigrationMemoryProcessedByStatus AS (SELECT m.STATUS, SUM(m.MEMORY_PROCESSED) AS total_memory_processed FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' AND ic.NETWORK_INFO IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.STATUS HAVING SUM(m.MEMORY_PROCESSED) > 0) SELECT ims.VM_STATE, ims.avg_memory_mb, ims.memory_mb_variance, ims.memory_mb_stddev, mmp.STATUS AS migration_status, mmp.total_memory_processed FROM InstanceMemoryStatsByState ims JOIN MigrationMemoryProcessedByStatus mmp ON ims.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' WHERE ims.memory_mb_variance > 0 ORDER BY ims.memory_mb_variance DESC, mmp.total_memory_processed DESC;

question: For instances whose display name is 'forge', list the instance UUID, system metadata key and value, the instance-extra creation timestamp, and the row number ordered by the system metadata key using a window frame of 2 preceding rows and 1 following row, and also include (for display name 'forge' considering only completed migrations) the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of system-metadata rows per migration. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH ForgeInstanceMetadataWindow AS (SELECT t1.UUID AS instance_uuid, t2.KEY AS metadata_key, t2.VALUE AS metadata_value, t0.CREATED_AT AS extra_created_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t2.KEY ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t1.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge'), PerDisplayNameMigrationMetadataStats AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(migration_metadata_count) - MIN(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_range, VARIANCE(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_variance, STDDEV(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN ( SELECT m.instance_uuid, m.id AS migration_id, COUNT(ism.id) AS migration_metadata_count FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i2 ON m.instance_uuid = i2.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i2.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY m.instance_uuid, m.id ) AS per_migration_stats ON i.uuid = per_migration_stats.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY metadata_count_range DESC) SELECT f.instance_uuid, f.metadata_key, f.metadata_value, f.extra_created_at, f.window_column, p.metadata_count_range, p.metadata_count_variance, p.metadata_count_stddev FROM ForgeInstanceMetadataWindow AS f JOIN PerDisplayNameMigrationMetadataStats AS p ON p.display_name = 'forge' ORDER BY f.window_column, f.metadata_key;

question: For instances with display name 'forge' that have system metadata with KEY = 'image_image_type', show each instance UUID and display name along with the display-name-level ROOT_GB range and variance, plus each instance’s system metadata key/value and its row number ordered by metadata key (using a window frame of 2 preceding rows and 1 following row), ordered by the ROOT_GB range descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MAX(i.ROOT_GB) - MIN(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_range, VARIANCE(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY root_gb_range DESC ), q2 AS ( SELECT i.UUID, ism.KEY, ism.VALUE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ism.KEY ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' ) SELECT q2.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME, q1.root_gb_range, q1.root_gb_variance, q2.KEY AS system_metadata_key, q2.VALUE AS system_metadata_value, q2.window_column FROM q2 JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON i.UUID = q2.UUID JOIN q1 ON q1.DISPLAY_NAME = i.DISPLAY_NAME JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism_img ON ism_img.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE ism_img.KEY = 'image_image_type' ORDER BY q1.root_gb_range DESC, q2.window_column;

question: From the top 10 instance display names with the most system metadata entries where the metadata key is 'image_image_type' and the instance is not deleted, show the completed migrations for those instances, including the migration ID, instance display name, instance availability zone, migration status, the migration’s rank within the 'completed' status group ordered by migration ID, and the instance’s metadata entry count. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH top_metadata AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(ism.ID) AS metadata_entries FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY metadata_entries DESC LIMIT 10 ), completed_migrations AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE AS instance_availability_zone, m.STATUS AS migration_status, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' ) SELECT cm.migration_id, cm.instance_display_name, cm.instance_availability_zone, cm.migration_status, cm.window_column, tm.metadata_entries FROM completed_migrations cm JOIN top_metadata tm ON tm.DISPLAY_NAME = cm.instance_display_name ORDER BY tm.metadata_entries DESC, cm.migration_id;

question: For instances in availability zone 'flare3', list each instance UUID, display name, key name, its number of system metadata entries, the total vCPUs summed across those metadata rows, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of memory_mb for that display name (computed only for display names with more than 2 system metadata rows). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH MemoryStddevByDisplayName AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 2 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC ), Flare3InstanceMetadataAndVcpus AS ( SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.key_name, COUNT(ism.id) AS metadata_entry_count, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus FROM instances i JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.key_name ) SELECT f.instance_uuid, f.display_name, f.key_name, f.metadata_entry_count, f.total_vcpus, m.memory_mb_stddev FROM Flare3InstanceMetadataAndVcpus f LEFT JOIN MemoryStddevByDisplayName m ON m.display_name = f.display_name;

question: For instances whose display name is 'forge' that also have a migration with status equal to 'completed', show the instance UUID, system metadata key and value, instance power state, the running sum of instance IDs within each power-state group ordered by instance ID, the migration source and destination compute, the migration status, and the minimum instance memory (in MB) over a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by migration ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH ForgeInstanceMetadata AS ( SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, ism.key AS metadata_key, ism.value AS metadata_value, i.power_state, SUM(i.id) OVER (PARTITION BY i.power_state ORDER BY i.id) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.display_name = 'forge' ), CompletedMigrations AS ( SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.status, MIN(i.memory_mb) OVER ( ORDER BY m.id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' ) SELECT fim.instance_uuid, fim.metadata_key, fim.metadata_value, fim.power_state, fim.window_column AS running_sum_instance_ids_within_power_state, cm.source_compute, cm.dest_compute, cm.status AS migration_status, cm.window_column AS min_instance_memory_mb_window FROM ForgeInstanceMetadata fim JOIN CompletedMigrations cm ON cm.uuid = fim.instance_uuid WHERE cm.display_name = 'forge' ORDER BY fim.instance_uuid, fim.metadata_key;

question: For instances in availability zone "flare3" that are in VM state "shelved_offloaded" and also have a migration with status "completed", show the instance UUID and display name, the migration status and the running sum of instance memory (MEMORY_MB) within each migration type ordered by instance memory, along with the instance ID, cached network info, and the instance’s rank within its availability zone ordered by instance ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH MigrationCompletedFlare3 AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, m.STATUS AS migration_status, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND m.STATUS = 'completed' ), ShelvedOffloadedInstances AS ( SELECT i.ID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, c.NETWORK_INFO, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE ORDER BY i.ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' ) SELECT mcf.instance_uuid, mcf.instance_display_name, mcf.migration_status, mcf.window_column AS migration_type_memory_running_sum, soi.ID AS instance_id, soi.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, soi.NETWORK_INFO, soi.window_column AS az_instance_id_rank FROM MigrationCompletedFlare3 AS mcf JOIN ShelvedOffloadedInstances AS soi ON soi.DISPLAY_NAME = mcf.instance_display_name WHERE soi.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' ORDER BY soi.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, soi.ID, mcf.instance_uuid;

question: For the instance with UUID '0003c04d-211b-4847-8916-102efabca5bc' and for completed migrations on that same instance, list the instance details and each system metadata key/value along with the migration ID, the running sum of migration IDs within each metadata key group, the minimum system metadata ID within each metadata key group, and the ratio (running sum of migration IDs divided by the minimum metadata ID) rounded to 2 decimals.
SQL: WITH MigrationMetadata AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, SUM(m.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed'), InstanceMetadataDetails AS (SELECT i.ID AS instance_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.USER_ID AS user_id, i.PROJECT_ID AS project_id, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE AS availability_zone, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ism.ID AS metadata_id, MIN(ism.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY ism.KEY) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.UUID = '0003c04d-211b-4847-8916-102efabca5bc') SELECT imd.instance_id, imd.display_name, imd.user_id, imd.project_id, imd.vm_state, imd.power_state, imd.memory_mb, imd.vcpus, imd.availability_zone, imd.metadata_key, imd.metadata_value, imd.metadata_id, imd.window_column AS min_metadata_id_in_key_group, mm.migration_id, mm.instance_display_name AS migration_instance_display_name, mm.window_column AS running_sum_migration_ids_in_key_group, ROUND(mm.window_column / NULLIF(imd.window_column, 0), 2) AS running_sum_to_min_metadata_id_ratio FROM InstanceMetadataDetails imd JOIN MigrationMetadata mm ON mm.metadata_key = imd.metadata_key AND mm.instance_display_name = imd.display_name ORDER BY running_sum_to_min_metadata_id_ratio DESC, mm.migration_id;

question: For instances whose display name is 'forge', list the instance UUID, hostname, VM state, memory in MB, the instance extra record ID, the minimum memory (in MB) over a window of 3 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the instance extra ID, and also include the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of system metadata entries per instance for the 'forge' display name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH ForgeInstanceWindow AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( ORDER BY ie.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge'), DisplayNameMetaStats AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(meta_entry_count) - MIN(meta_entry_count) AS meta_count_range, VARIANCE(meta_entry_count) AS meta_count_variance, STDDEV(meta_entry_count) AS meta_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN ( SELECT i2.uuid AS instance_uuid, COUNT(*) AS meta_entry_count FROM instances AS i2 JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i2.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i2.uuid ) AS meta_stats ON meta_stats.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY meta_count_range DESC) SELECT fiw.instance_uuid, fiw.hostname, fiw.vm_state, fiw.memory_mb, fiw.instance_extra_id, fiw.window_column, dms.meta_count_range, dms.meta_count_variance, dms.meta_count_stddev FROM ForgeInstanceWindow AS fiw JOIN DisplayNameMetaStats AS dms ON dms.display_name = 'forge' ORDER BY fiw.instance_extra_id;

question: For instances in availability zone 'flare3' that have a migration with status equal to 'completed', list the instance UUID, instance display name, availability zone, VM state, memory in MB, vCPU count, instance hostname, migration source compute, destination compute, destination host, migration type, memory total, memory processed, memory remaining, the minimum memory remaining within each instance UUID, the maximum system-metadata ID over the current row and next 2 rows (ordered by instance UUID), and the memory processed ratio (memory processed divided by memory total) rounded.
SQL: WITH MigrationCompleted AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.HOSTNAME AS instance_hostname, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE AS migration_source_compute, m.DEST_COMPUTE AS migration_dest_compute, m.DEST_HOST AS migration_dest_host, m.MIGRATION_TYPE AS migration_type, m.MEMORY_TOTAL AS memory_total, m.MEMORY_PROCESSED AS memory_processed, m.MEMORY_REMAINING AS memory_remaining, MIN(m.MEMORY_REMAINING) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.INSTANCE_UUID ORDER BY m.INSTANCE_UUID ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES i JOIN MIGRATIONS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed'), InstanceMetadataWindow AS (SELECT i.display_name, i.availability_zone, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, i.uuid, MAX(ism.id) OVER ( ORDER BY i.uuid ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_metadata_id_next_2 FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3') SELECT mc.instance_uuid, mc.instance_display_name, imw.availability_zone, imw.vm_state, imw.memory_mb, imw.vcpus, mc.instance_hostname, mc.migration_source_compute, mc.migration_dest_compute, mc.migration_dest_host, mc.migration_type, mc.memory_total, mc.memory_processed, mc.memory_remaining, mc.window_column AS min_memory_remaining_per_instance_uuid, imw.max_metadata_id_next_2, ROUND(mc.memory_processed / NULLIF(mc.memory_total, 0), 4) AS memory_processed_ratio FROM MigrationCompleted mc JOIN InstanceMetadataWindow imw ON imw.uuid = mc.instance_uuid ORDER BY memory_processed_ratio DESC;

question: For each instance VM state, list the VM state along with (1) the range and variance of total memory moved during completed migrations and (2) the average, range, and variance of instance memory (in MB) for instances that have a non-empty PCI requests value. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH MigrationMemoryStatsByVMState AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, MAX(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) - MIN(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) AS memory_total_range, VARIANCE(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) AS memory_total_variance FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_total_range DESC ), InstanceMemoryStatsWithPCIRequestsByVMState AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) - MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ie.PCI_REQUESTS <> '[]' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC ) SELECT mms.VM_STATE AS vm_state, mms.memory_total_range, mms.memory_total_variance, ims.avg_memory_mb, ims.memory_mb_range, ims.memory_mb_variance FROM MigrationMemoryStatsByVMState AS mms JOIN InstanceMemoryStatsWithPCIRequestsByVMState AS ims ON mms.VM_STATE = ims.vm_state ORDER BY mms.memory_total_range DESC;

question: For instances that are not deleted and have system metadata with the key `image_image_type`, find those whose display name also has at least one completed migration with a positive average `memory_remaining`. Return the instance UUID, display name, the `image_image_type` metadata value, the number of network-info cache records, the total memory (MB) summed across those cache records, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of `memory_remaining` for completed migrations, ordered by the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH InstanceCacheAndImageType AS (SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name, ism.value AS image_type_value, COUNT(iic.id) AS cache_record_count, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances i JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches iic ON iic.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, ism.value), InstanceMigrationVariation AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT icait.instance_uuid, icait.display_name, icait.image_type_value, icait.cache_record_count, icait.total_memory_mb, imv.coefficient_of_variation FROM InstanceCacheAndImageType icait JOIN InstanceMigrationVariation imv ON imv.display_name = icait.display_name ORDER BY imv.coefficient_of_variation DESC, icait.instance_uuid;

question: For instances whose display name is 'forge', return the instance UUID, display name, VM state, memory in MB, vCPUs, the instance-extra record ID and created timestamp, the cached network_info JSON, and the minimum instance-extra ID in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by instance memory (MB); also include the overall memory range and variance (in MB) for the 'forge' display name among non-deleted instances and the total count of non-deleted 'forge' instances, but only keep rows where the instance’s memory is more than 75% of the (non-deleted) 'forge' memory range. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH ForgeInstances AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ie.CREATED_AT AS instance_extra_created_at, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, MIN(ie.ID) OVER ( ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' ), DisplayNameMemoryStats AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_range_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_variance_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_range_mb DESC ), ForgeDisplayNameTotals AS ( SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(*) AS forge_instance_count FROM instances AS i WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.display_name = 'forge' GROUP BY i.display_name ) SELECT fi.instance_uuid, fi.display_name, fi.vm_state, fi.memory_mb, fi.vcpus, fi.instance_extra_id, fi.instance_extra_created_at, fi.network_info, fi.window_column, dms.memory_range_mb, dms.memory_variance_mb, fdt.forge_instance_count FROM ForgeInstances fi JOIN DisplayNameMemoryStats dms ON fi.display_name = dms.display_name JOIN ForgeDisplayNameTotals fdt ON fi.display_name = fdt.display_name WHERE (fi.memory_mb * 1.0 / NULLIF(dms.memory_range_mb, 0)) > 0.75;

question: How many instances are in the “shelved_offloaded” VM state and also belong to a (display name, launched-at) group launched in 2014 whose maximum memory is greater than 16000 MB? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH shelved_offloaded_instances AS (SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.MEMORY_MB, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.MEMORY_MB ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded'), launched_2014_high_memory AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) AS max_memory_mb, i.LAUNCHED_AT FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.LAUNCHED_AT) = 2014 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.LAUNCHED_AT HAVING MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) > 16000) SELECT COUNT(*) AS matching_instance_count FROM shelved_offloaded_instances soi JOIN launched_2014_high_memory lhm ON soi.DISPLAY_NAME = lhm.DISPLAY_NAME;

question: For each instance that has a completed migration, show the instance display name, availability zone, migration status, migration type, instance UUID, and the dense rank of migrations within each instance UUID, along with the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of non-deleted system metadata entries per instance for that same display name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH MetadataStatsByDisplayName AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(meta_entry_count) - MIN(meta_entry_count) AS metadata_count_range, VARIANCE(meta_entry_count) AS metadata_count_variance, STDDEV(meta_entry_count) AS metadata_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN ( SELECT i2.display_name, i2.uuid, COUNT(*) AS meta_entry_count FROM instances AS i2 JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i2.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i2.display_name, i2.uuid ) AS per_instance_counts ON i.display_name = per_instance_counts.display_name GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY metadata_count_range DESC ), CompletedMigrationsByInstance AS ( SELECT i.display_name, i.availability_zone, m.status, m.migration_type, i.uuid, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.uuid ORDER BY i.uuid) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' ) SELECT c.display_name, c.availability_zone, c.status, c.migration_type, c.uuid, c.window_column, ms.metadata_count_range, ms.metadata_count_variance, ms.metadata_count_stddev FROM CompletedMigrationsByInstance AS c JOIN MetadataStatsByDisplayName AS ms ON c.display_name = ms.display_name;

question: For each VM state, availability zone, and display name, compare (1) instances that have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type' versus (2) instances with more than 8 VCPUs by listing both instance counts and minimum memory (MB), and compute the ratios of the “>8 VCPU” counts and minimum memory to the metadata-filtered counts and minimum memory (rounded to 2 decimals), ordered by the count ratio descending.
SQL: WITH MetaByStateAZ AS ( SELECT ins.VM_STATE, ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, COUNT(ins.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(ins.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES ins ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON ins.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY ins.VM_STATE, ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE ), BigByStateName AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(i.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VCPUS > 8 GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME ) SELECT m.VM_STATE, m.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, b.DISPLAY_NAME, m.instance_count AS meta_instance_count, b.instance_count AS big_instance_count, m.min_memory_mb AS meta_min_memory_mb, b.min_memory_mb AS big_min_memory_mb, ROUND(b.instance_count / NULLIF(m.instance_count, 0), 2) AS Big_to_Meta_Instance_Count_Ratio, ROUND(b.min_memory_mb / NULLIF(m.min_memory_mb, 0), 2) AS Big_to_Meta_Min_Memory_Ratio FROM MetaByStateAZ m JOIN BigByStateName b ON m.VM_STATE = b.VM_STATE ORDER BY Big_to_Meta_Instance_Count_Ratio DESC;

question: For shelved_offloaded instances with display name 'forge', list the instance UUID, hostname, VM state, system metadata key/value, the minimum instance memory (MB) in a 2-preceding/2-following window ordered by instance ID, the total memory (MB) across all shelved_offloaded 'forge' instances (only when that total exceeds 20000 MB), and the ratio of the window minimum memory to that total memory.
SQL: WITH ShelvedOffloadedMemory AS ( SELECT i.display_name, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING SUM(i.memory_mb) > 20000 ), ForgeInstanceMetadataWindow AS ( SELECT i.UUID, i.HOSTNAME, i.VM_STATE, ism.KEY, ism.VALUE, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( ORDER BY i.ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' ) SELECT f.UUID, f.HOSTNAME, f.VM_STATE, f.KEY, f.VALUE, f.window_column, som.total_memory_mb, ROUND(f.window_column / NULLIF(som.total_memory_mb, 0), 4) AS Window_Min_to_TotalMemory_Ratio FROM ForgeInstanceMetadataWindow AS f JOIN ShelvedOffloadedMemory AS som ON som.display_name = 'forge' WHERE f.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' ORDER BY Window_Min_to_TotalMemory_Ratio DESC, f.UUID, f.KEY;

question: For instances whose display name is "forge" and that are not deleted and have system metadata with the key `image_image_type`, list the instance UUID, hostname, availability zone, cached network_info JSON, the instance’s rank within its availability zone ordered by instance ID, the instance display name, the `image_image_type` metadata value, the number of network-info cache records, and the total memory (in MB) summed across those cache records. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH ForgeInstanceDetails AS (SELECT t0.UUID, t0.HOSTNAME, t0.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, t2.NETWORK_INFO, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.AVAILABILITY_ZONE ORDER BY t0.ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS t0 JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS t1 ON t1.INSTANCE_UUID = t0.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS t2 ON t2.INSTANCE_UUID = t0.UUID WHERE t0.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge'), ImageTypeCacheMemoryStats AS (SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name, ism.value AS image_type_value, COUNT(iic.id) AS cache_record_count, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances i JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches iic ON iic.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, ism.value) SELECT fid.UUID AS instance_uuid, fid.HOSTNAME, fid.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, fid.NETWORK_INFO, fid.window_column AS az_rank_by_instance_id, itcms.display_name, itcms.image_type_value, itcms.cache_record_count, itcms.total_memory_mb FROM ForgeInstanceDetails fid JOIN ImageTypeCacheMemoryStats itcms ON fid.UUID = itcms.instance_uuid ORDER BY fid.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, fid.window_column, fid.UUID;

question: For non-deleted instances where the maximum instance memory (grouped by instance display name, metadata key, and launched timestamp) is greater than 16000 MB, list the instance display name, metadata key, maximum memory in MB, and launched timestamp, along with any completed migration details for that instance (migration status, source compute, destination compute, the instance flavor JSON, and the dense-rank window column). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH HighMemoryInstancesByMetadata AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) AS max_memory_mb, i.LAUNCHED_AT FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism JOIN INSTANCES i ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME, ism.KEY, i.LAUNCHED_AT HAVING MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) > 16000 ), CompletedMigrationsWithFlavor AS ( SELECT m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, i.display_name, ie.flavor, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.status ORDER BY m.status) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' ) SELECT hmi.DISPLAY_NAME, hmi.metadata_key, hmi.max_memory_mb, hmi.LAUNCHED_AT, cmwf.status AS migration_status, cmwf.source_compute, cmwf.dest_compute, cmwf.flavor AS instance_flavor_json, cmwf.window_column FROM HighMemoryInstancesByMetadata hmi JOIN CompletedMigrationsWithFlavor cmwf ON hmi.DISPLAY_NAME = cmwf.display_name ORDER BY hmi.max_memory_mb DESC, hmi.DISPLAY_NAME, hmi.metadata_key;

question: For instance display names that are among the top 10 by number of completed migrations (counting only instances that have an `image_image_type` entry in instance system metadata), show the instance display name, the number of completed migrations, and the total memory (in MB) for those display names whose instances are in the `shelved_offloaded` VM state and have total memory greater than 50000 MB. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH TopCompletedMigrations AS (SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(m.id) AS migrations FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY migrations DESC LIMIT 10), ShelvedOffloadedHighMemory AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) AS total_memory_mb FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME HAVING SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) > 50000) SELECT tcm.display_name, tcm.migrations AS completed_migrations, sohm.total_memory_mb FROM TopCompletedMigrations tcm JOIN ShelvedOffloadedHighMemory sohm ON tcm.display_name = sohm.display_name ORDER BY tcm.migrations DESC;

question: For instances that are not deleted (deleted = 0) and that also have a completed migration (status = 'completed'), list the instance UUID, display name, memory (MB), vCPU count, and instance flavor JSON, along with the migration status, source compute, destination compute, and the instance system metadata key; also include the dense-rank values from the migration-by-instance window and the instance-by-project window. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH CompletedMigrations AS (SELECT m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, i.display_name, ism.key, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.instance_uuid ORDER BY m.instance_uuid) AS window_column FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed'), ActiveInstancesWithFlavor AS (SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, ie.flavor, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.project_id ORDER BY i.project_id) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0), CombinedInstanceDetails AS ( SELECT ai.uuid AS instance_uuid, ai.display_name, ai.memory_mb, ai.vcpus, ai.flavor, cm.status AS migration_status, cm.source_compute, cm.dest_compute, cm.key AS system_metadata_key, cm.window_column AS migration_dense_rank, ai.window_column AS project_dense_rank FROM ActiveInstancesWithFlavor ai JOIN CompletedMigrations cm ON ai.display_name = cm.display_name ) SELECT instance_uuid, display_name, memory_mb, vcpus, flavor, migration_status, source_compute, dest_compute, system_metadata_key, migration_dense_rank, project_dense_rank FROM CombinedInstanceDetails ORDER BY instance_uuid, system_metadata_key;

question: For each instance VM state, list the VM state, the geometric mean of instance memory (in MB) across instances with a system metadata entry where key = 'image_image_type' (and memory_mb > 0), along with the average root disk size (ROOT_GB), the root disk size range, and the variance of ROOT_GB for instances with the same system metadata key. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH MemoryGeoMeanByVMState AS ( SELECT i.vm_state, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.vm_state ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC ), RootDiskStatsByVMState AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, AVG(i.ROOT_GB) AS avg_root_gb, MAX(i.ROOT_GB) - MIN(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_range, VARIANCE(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY root_gb_range DESC ) SELECT mg.vm_state, mg.geometric_mean_memory_mb, rd.avg_root_gb, rd.root_gb_range, rd.root_gb_variance FROM MemoryGeoMeanByVMState AS mg JOIN RootDiskStatsByVMState AS rd ON mg.vm_state = rd.vm_state ORDER BY mg.geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC;

question: For each migration status and instance VM state where the instance has system metadata key 'image_image_type' and the migration is not hidden, show the migration count, the minimum instance memory (MB), the number of instances involved, and the minimum migration total memory. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( SELECT m.status AS migration_status, i.vm_state AS instance_vm_state, COUNT(m.id) AS migration_count, MIN(i.memory_mb) AS min_instance_memory_mb FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY m.status, i.vm_state ), q2 AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, m.STATUS AS migration_status, COUNT(i.ID) AS instance_count, MIN(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) AS min_memory_total FROM INSTANCES i JOIN MIGRATIONS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.HIDDEN = 0 GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, m.STATUS ) SELECT q1.migration_status, q1.instance_vm_state, q1.migration_count, q1.min_instance_memory_mb, q2.instance_count, q2.min_memory_total FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.migration_status = q2.migration_status AND q1.instance_vm_state = q2.vm_state ORDER BY q1.migration_count DESC;

question: For completed migrations, show the migration ID, the (flare3) instance UUID and display name, the instance system metadata key and value, the row number over metadata key (with a frame of 2 preceding rows and 1 following row), and the running sum of instance IDs within each metadata key group for flare3 instances, matching records by instance display name and metadata key. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH CompletedMigrationsWithMetadata AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY ism.KEY ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed'), Flare3InstancesMetadataRunningSum AS (SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, ism.KEY, SUM(i.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3') SELECT c.migration_id, f.UUID AS instance_uuid, c.instance_display_name, c.metadata_key, c.metadata_value, c.window_column AS completed_migrations_row_number_window, f.window_column AS flare3_instance_id_running_sum_window FROM CompletedMigrationsWithMetadata c JOIN Flare3InstancesMetadataRunningSum f ON c.instance_display_name = f.DISPLAY_NAME AND c.metadata_key = f.KEY ORDER BY c.migration_id, c.metadata_key;

question: For availability zone "flare3", how many instances have non-empty cached NETWORK_INFO and have a VM_STATE that appears in the per-VM-state geometric mean of migrated MEMORY_TOTAL (computed only from migrations with MEMORY_TOTAL > 0 and non-empty cached NETWORK_INFO), and what is the average of those geometric-mean migrated-memory values across the matching VM states? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH vm_state_geom_mean_migrated_mem AS (SELECT i.vm_state, EXP(AVG(LN(m.memory_total))) AS geometric_mean_memory_total FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE m.memory_total > 0 AND c.network_info <> '' GROUP BY i.vm_state ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_total DESC), flare3_instances_ranked_by_mem AS (SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, c.NETWORK_INFO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB DESC) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3') SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fir.UUID) AS flare3_instance_count_with_geom_mean_migration_mem, AVG(vsgmmm.geometric_mean_memory_total) AS avg_geometric_mean_memory_total_across_matching_vm_states FROM flare3_instances_ranked_by_mem AS fir JOIN vm_state_geom_mean_migrated_mem AS vsgmmm ON fir.VM_STATE = vsgmmm.vm_state WHERE fir.NETWORK_INFO <> '';

question: For instance display names in availability zone 'flare3' that (a) have INSTANCE_EXTRA rows and (b) also have an INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES entry with more than 5 matching instances, show each display name’s memory (MEMORY_MB) range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) (from the INSTANCE_EXTRA population), along with the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) computed only over instances that have both INSTANCE_EXTRA and INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH StddevWithNetworkAndExtra AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC), RangeVarianceStddevWithExtra AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC) SELECT r.display_name, r.memory_mb_range, r.memory_mb_variance, r.memory_mb_stddev AS memory_mb_stddev_with_extra, s.memory_mb_stddev AS memory_mb_stddev_with_extra_and_network_info_cache FROM RangeVarianceStddevWithExtra r JOIN StddevWithNetworkAndExtra s ON r.display_name = s.display_name ORDER BY r.memory_mb_range DESC;

question: For each security group name, return the variance of the TCP rule starting port (FROM_PORT) and the total number of ports covered across its TCP rules (only including security groups whose total TCP ports covered is greater than 100). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH FromPortVariance AS ( SELECT sg.NAME AS security_group_name, VARIANCE(sgr.FROM_PORT) AS from_port_variance FROM SECURITY_GROUPS AS sg JOIN SECURITY_GROUP_RULES AS sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sgr.PROTOCOL = 'tcp' GROUP BY sg.NAME ORDER BY from_port_variance DESC ), TotalPortsCovered AS ( SELECT sg.NAME AS security_group_name, SUM(sgr.TO_PORT - sgr.FROM_PORT + 1) AS total_ports_covered FROM SECURITY_GROUPS sg JOIN SECURITY_GROUP_RULES sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sgr.PROTOCOL = 'tcp' GROUP BY sg.NAME HAVING SUM(sgr.TO_PORT - sgr.FROM_PORT + 1) > 100 ) SELECT fpv.security_group_name, fpv.from_port_variance, tpc.total_ports_covered FROM FromPortVariance fpv JOIN TotalPortsCovered tpc ON fpv.security_group_name = tpc.security_group_name;

question: For non-deleted instances in availability zone “flare3”, list the instance UUID, display name, VM state, power state, memory (MB), vCPUs, the instance extra record ID, the maximum instance ID over the current row and next 2 rows (ordered by instance ID), and the geometric mean instance memory (MB) for that VM state (computed over instances with a system metadata key of 'image_image_type' and memory greater than 0), keeping only VM states whose geometric mean memory is greater than 0. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH VmStateGeometricMeanMemory AS ( SELECT i.vm_state, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.vm_state ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC ), Flare3NonDeletedInstances AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MAX(i.ID) OVER (ORDER BY i.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_id_next_2 FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' ) SELECT f.instance_uuid, f.display_name, f.vm_state, f.power_state, f.memory_mb, f.vcpus, f.instance_extra_id, f.max_instance_id_next_2, v.geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM Flare3NonDeletedInstances f JOIN VmStateGeometricMeanMemory v ON f.vm_state = v.vm_state WHERE v.geometric_mean_memory_mb > 0 ORDER BY v.geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC, f.instance_uuid;

question: For instances in availability zone “flare3” that also appear in migrations with status “completed”, show the migration ID, instance UUID, display name, VM state, memory in MB, cached network_info JSON, the average memory_mb over a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows (partitioned by VM state and ordered by memory_mb), plus the instance system metadata key and value with a row number ordered by the metadata key using a window frame of 2 preceding rows and 1 following row. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, c.network_info, AVG(i.memory_mb) OVER ( PARTITION BY i.vm_state ORDER BY i.memory_mb ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' ORDER BY i.memory_mb ), q2 AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY ism.KEY ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' ) SELECT q2.migration_id, q1.uuid AS instance_uuid, q1.display_name, q1.vm_state, q1.memory_mb, q1.network_info, q1.window_column AS avg_memory_mb_window, q2.metadata_key, q2.metadata_value, q2.window_column AS metadata_row_number_window FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.display_name = q2.instance_display_name ORDER BY q2.migration_id, q1.memory_mb, q2.metadata_key;

question: For instances in the “flare3” availability zone that are in the “shelved_offloaded” VM state, list each instance’s UUID, display name, VM state, the number of matching INSTANCE_EXTRA records, the total of the matching INSTANCE_EXTRA IDs, and (for that display name) the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of instance memory (in MB), ordered by the memory standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH sq1 AS ( SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC ), sq2 AS ( SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.vm_state, COUNT(ie.id) AS extra_record_count, SUM(ie.id) AS extra_id_sum FROM instances i JOIN instance_extra ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.vm_state ) SELECT sq2.instance_uuid, sq2.display_name, sq2.vm_state, sq2.extra_record_count, sq2.extra_id_sum, sq1.avg_memory_mb, sq1.memory_mb_stddev FROM sq2 JOIN sq1 ON sq2.display_name = sq1.display_name WHERE sq2.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' ORDER BY sq1.memory_mb_stddev DESC;

question: For migrations with status 'completed', list each migration ID, the instance display name, the instance availability zone, the migration status, the migration’s rank within the 'completed' status group (ordered by migration ID), and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of that instance’s memory_mb across its system metadata rows (considering only instances that are not deleted). Do not return any rounded answers.
